atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。
summary.en: The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.

fields.name: 九一八事变 Mukden Incident 沈阳事变 Shenyang Incident
fields.summary: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。 The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 18 日夜，日本关东军自行炸毁沈阳北郊柳条湖附近的南满铁路路轨，反诬中国军队所为，随即进攻东北军北大营和沈阳城。此后数月，日军侵占东北大部。 本事件日期与地点为通行说法，具体战斗经过待史料校订。 On the night of 18 September 1931, the Japanese Kwantung Army destroyed a section of the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu, blamed Chinese troops, and attacked Beidaying and Shenyang. Within months Japanese forces occupied most of the Northeast. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts; details await historical review.
fields.entities: 日本 Japan 国民党军正面战场 KMT Frontline Forces

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 九一八事变次日，日军关东军进攻长春，中国守军抵抗后撤退，长春陷落。
summary.en: The day after the Mukden Incident, Japanese Kwantung Army forces attacked Changchun; the Chinese defenders withdrew and the city fell.

fields.name: 长春沦陷 Fall of Changchun
fields.summary: 九一八事变次日，日军关东军进攻长春，中国守军抵抗后撤退，长春陷落。 The day after the Mukden Incident, Japanese Kwantung Army forces attacked Changchun; the Chinese defenders withdrew and the city fell.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 19 日，关东军第 2 师团等部向长春发动进攻，驻长春中国军队与日军激战后退往吉林方向，长春当日陷落。长春是南满铁路与中东铁路交会点，沦陷后成为日军控制吉林、黑龙江的重要基地。日期与作战经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division and other Kwantung Army units attacked Changchun. The Chinese garrison fought briefly and withdrew toward Jilin, and the city fell the same day. As the junction of the South Manchuria and Chinese Eastern railways, Changchun became an important base for Japanese control of Jilin and Heilongjiang. Dates and operational details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队第三大队侵占营口。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 3rd Independent Guard Battalion occupied Yingkou.

fields.name: 营口沦陷 Fall of Yingkou
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队第三大队侵占营口。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 3rd Independent Guard Battalion occupied Yingkou.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日晨8时，日军独立守备队第三大队侵入营口，包围县政府、公安局及其他机关，缴去练军营官兵及警察枪械，炸毁电报、电话及河北车站无线电台。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《中共中央最早关注营口的1931年九一八事变宣言》。 At 8 a.m. on 19 September 1931 the Japanese 3rd Independent Guard Battalion entered Yingkou, surrounded the county government, police bureau and other offices, disarmed the militia and police, and blew up the telegraph, telephone and wireless station at Hebei station.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队侵占安东（今丹东）。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese Independent Guard Battalion occupied Andong (modern Dandong).

fields.name: 安东沦陷 Fall of Andong
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队侵占安东（今丹东）。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese Independent Guard Battalion occupied Andong (modern Dandong).
fields.description: 1931年9月19日晨5时，日军铁道独立守备队200余人分两路侵入安东市街，包围县政府、公安局，公安队和警察未抵抗即被缴械。安东为安奉铁路终点、中朝边境重镇，失守后日军控制鸭绿江下游。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《东北沦陷时期丹东大事记》。 At 5 a.m. on 19 September 1931 more than 200 men of the Japanese railway independent guard entered Andong in two columns, surrounded the county government and police bureau and disarmed the police without resistance. Andong was the terminus of the Anfeng railway and the key border town on the Yalu; its fall gave Japan control of the lower Yalu.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占抚顺。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Fushun.

fields.name: 抚顺沦陷 Fall of Fushun
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占抚顺。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Fushun.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，日军在侵占沈阳的同时，沿南满铁路占据抚顺。抚顺为东北最大煤矿区，日军占领后由满铁控制煤矿开采；次年9月16日又在平顶山制造惨案。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《九一八事变，侵占东北（1）》。 On 19 September 1931, while taking Shenyang, the Japanese occupied Fushun along the South Manchuria Railway. Fushun was the largest coal-mining area in the Northeast; after occupation the South Manchuria Railway Company controlled its mines, and on 16 September 1932 the Japanese carried out the Pingdingshan massacre.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军第2师团侵占辽阳。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division occupied Liaoyang.

fields.name: 辽阳沦陷 Fall of Liaoyang
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军第2师团侵占辽阳。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division occupied Liaoyang.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，驻辽阳的日军第2师团主力于凌晨5时抵沈阳，参加进攻沈阳；同日辽阳亦被日军控制。辽阳为南满铁路要地，第2师团司令部原驻于此。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《九一八事变，侵占东北（1）》。 On 19 September 1931 the main force of the Japanese 2nd Division, stationed at Liaoyang, reached Shenyang at 5 a.m. and joined the attack on the city; Liaoyang itself was also brought under Japanese control the same day. Liaoyang was a key point on the South Manchuria Railway and the original seat of the 2nd Division headquarters.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占鞍山。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Anshan.

fields.name: 鞍山沦陷 Fall of Anshan
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占鞍山。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Anshan.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，日军在侵占沈阳的同时占领鞍山。鞍山为南满铁路沿线铁矿重镇，日本独立守备队第六大队此前已驻鞍山“满铁附属地”；失守后鞍山铁矿被日本控制。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《鞍山地区抗日斗争的特点》。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Anshan together with Shenyang. Anshan was an iron-mining town on the South Manchuria Railway, and the Japanese 6th Independent Guard Battalion had already been stationed in its railway concession; after the fall the Anshan mines came under Japanese control.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占铁岭。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Tieling.

fields.name: 铁岭沦陷 Fall of Tieling
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占铁岭。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Tieling.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日凌晨4时，驻铁岭日军独立守备队赶赴沈阳，参加进攻北大营；同日铁岭亦被日军控制。铁岭为南满铁路要地，失守后日军控制沈阳以北铁路。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《九一八事变，侵占东北（1）》。 At 4 a.m. on 19 September 1931 the Japanese independent guard at Tieling rushed to Shenyang and joined the attack on Beidaying; Tieling itself was also brought under control that day. Tieling was a key point on the South Manchuria Railway, and its fall gave Japan control of the railway north of Shenyang.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占本溪。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Benxi.

fields.name: 本溪沦陷 Fall of Benxi
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占本溪。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Benxi.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，日军在侵占沈阳、安东的同时占领本溪。本溪为安奉铁路沿线煤铁重镇，失守后日军控制本溪湖煤矿。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《九一八事变，侵占东北（1）》。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Benxi together with Shenyang and Andong. Benxi was a coal-and-iron town on the Anfeng railway, and its fall gave Japan control of the Benxihu mines.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占海城。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Haicheng.

fields.name: 海城沦陷 Fall of Haicheng
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占海城。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Haicheng.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日晨8时，海城县城被日军全部占领；驻海城车站的日军独立守备队一个中队包围县政府，将县长、公安局长押往日本兵营。海城为南满铁路要地，失守后日军控制辽南交通。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《东北抗日义勇军大事记》。 At 8 a.m. on 19 September 1931 the Japanese fully occupied Haicheng; a company of the independent guard from the station surrounded the county government and took the county magistrate and police chief to the Japanese barracks. Haicheng was a key point on the South Manchuria Railway, and its fall gave Japan control of communications in southern Liaoning.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占盖平（今盖州）。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Gaiping (modern Gaizhou).

fields.name: 盖平沦陷 Fall of Gaiping
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占盖平（今盖州）。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Gaiping (modern Gaizhou).
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队第三大队自大石桥南犯，占领盖平（今盖州）。盖平为南满铁路辽南段要地，失守后日军继续南犯复县、瓦房店。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《中共中央最早关注营口的1931年九一八事变宣言》。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 3rd Independent Guard Battalion advanced south from Dashiqiao and occupied Gaiping (modern Gaizhou). Gaiping was a key point on the southern section of the South Manchuria Railway; the Japanese then moved on Fuxian and Wafangdian.

fields.name: 凤城沦陷 Fall of Fengcheng
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队侵占凤城。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese independent guard occupied Fengcheng.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日凌晨2时，日军从凤城以北四台子下火车，分两路包围县城，缴去姜全我部第一团官兵455名及公安警察200余名枪械，兵不血刃占领凤城。凤城为安奉铁路要地，失守后日军控制辽东。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《东北抗日义勇军大事记》。 At 2 a.m. on 19 September 1931 the Japanese left their train north of Fengcheng at Sitai and surrounded the county town in two columns, disarming 455 officers and men of Jiang Quanwo’s 1st Regiment and more than 200 police, taking Fengcheng without a fight. Fengcheng was a key point on the Anfeng railway, and its fall gave Japan control of eastern Liaoning.

summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Sipingjie.

fields.name: 四平街沦陷 Fall of Sipingjie
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占四平街。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Sipingjie.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，日军在侵占沈阳、长春的同时，沿南满铁路侵占四平街。四平街时为梨树县辖镇，是南满铁路与四洮铁路交会点，失守后成为日军进攻吉林、黑龙江的前进基地。日期据《东北沦陷时期的吉林》与《1931年（民国20年）》。 On 19 September 1931, while taking Shenyang and Changchun, the Japanese occupied Sipingjie along the South Manchuria Railway. Sipingjie was then a town of Lishu County and the junction of the South Manchuria and Sitao railways; its fall made it an advance base for the Japanese drive into Jilin and Heilongjiang.

fields.name: 中共中央发表《为日本帝国主义强暴占领东三省事件宣言》 CCP Central Committee issues the 20 September 1931 declaration on Manchuria
fields.summary: 九一八事变后第三天，中共中央发表宣言，号召反对日本强占东三省、立刻撤退日军。 Three days after the Mukden Incident the CCP Central Committee called for resistance and the immediate withdrawal of Japanese forces from Manchuria.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 20 日，中共中央发表《中国共产党为日本帝国主义强暴占领东三省事件宣言》，指出日本强占东三省是其掠夺中国、进攻苏联的既定步骤，号召工农兵士劳苦民众「反对日本帝国主义强占东三省」「立刻撤退占领东三省的海陆空军」。宣言原载 1931 年 10 月 18 日出版的《红旗周报》第 19 期。9 月 22 日，中共中央又作出《关于日本帝国主义强占满洲事变的决议》，部署在东北开展抗日游击战争。本事件为政策文件，不绘路线。 On 20 September 1931 the CCP Central Committee issued “The Chinese Communist Party’s Declaration on the Japanese Imperialists’ Violent Occupation of the Three Eastern Provinces”. It called on workers, peasants and soldiers to oppose the occupation and demanded the immediate withdrawal of Japanese land, sea and air forces. The text was printed in Red Flag Weekly no. 19 on 18 October 1931. On 22 September the Central Committee adopted a resolution on the Mukden Incident and began organising guerrilla resistance in Manchuria. This is a policy document, so no route is drawn.

name.zh: 中国向国联申诉九一八事变
name.en: China’s Appeal to the League of Nations

summary.zh: 中国代表施肇基援引《国联盟约》第十一条向国联申诉，要求制止日军进攻、恢复事变前状态。

fields.name: 中国向国联申诉九一八事变 China’s Appeal to the League of Nations
fields.summary: 中国代表施肇基援引《国联盟约》第十一条向国联申诉，要求制止日军进攻、恢复事变前状态。 Chinese representative Sao-Ke Alfred Sze appealed to the League of Nations under Article 11 of the Covenant, asking it to stop the Japanese advance and restore the status quo ante.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 21 日，中国驻国联代表施肇基向国联秘书长递交声明书，援引《国联盟约》第十一条，控告日本侵略中国领土，要求国联行政院立即采取行动，阻止事态扩大、恢复九一八事变前的状态，并确定中国应得的赔偿。 国民政府把制止日本侵略的希望主要寄托于国联调处，但国联行政院仅向中日双方发出内容相同的“紧急警告”，未将日本定为侵略者，也未采取制裁。此后国联决定派遣调查团，即李顿调查团。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 21 September 1931 Chinese representative Sao-Ke Alfred Sze submitted a note to the League of Nations Secretary-General invoking Article 11 of the Covenant, accusing Japan of invading Chinese territory and asking the Council to stop the widening of the incident, restore the status quo ante, and determine reparations. The Nationalist government placed its main hope in League mediation, but the Council only issued identical urgent warnings to both sides, neither naming Japan the aggressor nor imposing sanctions. The League subsequently decided to send a commission of inquiry — the Lytton Commission. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 吉林沦陷 Fall of Jilin
fields.place: 吉林吉林 Jilin City, Jilin
fields.summary: 日军占领长春后沿吉长铁路东进，吉林省城吉林陷落。 After taking Changchun, Japanese forces advanced east along the Jilin–Changchun railway and occupied Jilin City.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 21 日，日军第 2 师团一部沿吉长铁路进攻吉林省城吉林，代理吉林省主席熙洽下令不抵抗，日军占领吉林。吉林沦陷使日军迅速控制吉林省大部。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 21 September 1931 a detachment of the Japanese 2nd Division advanced along the Jilin–Changchun railway toward Jilin City. Acting Jilin governor Xi Qia ordered no resistance, and the Japanese occupied the city, rapidly extending their control over most of Jilin province. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1931年9月25日，日军进入洮南，洮辽镇守使张海鹏降日。
summary.en: On 25 September 1931 the Japanese entered Tao’nan and the Taoliao garrison commander Zhang Haipeng went over to Japan.

fields.name: 洮南沦陷 Fall of Tao’nan
fields.summary: 1931年9月25日，日军进入洮南，洮辽镇守使张海鹏降日。 On 25 September 1931 the Japanese entered Tao’nan and the Taoliao garrison commander Zhang Haipeng went over to Japan.
fields.description: 1931年9月24日，关东军派日军120余名携野炮2门，自四平乘3辆铁甲车向洮南进犯；张海鹏按与日本满铁公所密约，命令中国军队退出洮南城。25日9时，张海鹏与县长申振先等迎接日军入城，洮南沦陷。日军以伪黑龙江省长相许并接济军火，策动张海鹏北犯齐齐哈尔。日期据《洮南大事记（1924-1934）》与《1931年（民国20年）》。 On 24 September 1931 the Kwantung Army sent over 120 troops with two field guns from Siping in three armoured trains against Tao’nan. Under a secret agreement with the Japanese railway office, Zhang Haipeng ordered the Chinese garrison out, and at 9 a.m. on the 25th he and magistrate Shen Zhenxian welcomed the Japanese into the town. Japan then promised Zhang the puppet governorship of Heilongjiang and supplied arms to turn him north against Qiqihar.

name.en: Battle of the Nen River Bridge

summary.zh: 1931年11月4日至19日，马占山率黑龙江省防军在嫩江江桥抗击日军16天，是九一八事变后中国军队第一次有组织的大规模抵抗。
summary.en: From 4 to 19 November 1931 Ma Zhanshan’s Heilongjiang defence troops fought the Japanese at the Nen River bridge for sixteen days — the first organised large-scale resistance after the Mukden Incident.

fields.name: 江桥抗战 Battle of the Nen River Bridge
fields.place: 黑龙江泰来江桥 Jiangqiao, Tailai, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1931年11月4日至19日，马占山率黑龙江省防军在嫩江江桥抗击日军16天，是九一八事变后中国军队第一次有组织的大规模抵抗。 From 4 to 19 November 1931 Ma Zhanshan’s Heilongjiang defence troops fought the Japanese at the Nen River bridge for sixteen days — the first organised large-scale resistance after the Mukden Incident.
fields.description: 1931 年 10 月，日军指使投日的洮辽镇守使张海鹏北犯黑龙江，13 日派出 3 个团，16 日在嫩江桥被省防军击溃，守军随即炸毁桥梁两孔。11 月 2 日，日军驻齐齐哈尔特务机关长林义秀送达最后通牒，限中国军队 3 日正午前撤至距桥 10 公里以外；4 日，日军以飞机、装甲车掩护 4000 余人进攻，马占山部还击，江桥抗战爆发。战役分两阶段：4—6 日战于江桥至大兴，6 日晚守军撤至大兴以北的三间房；12 日起日军 7000 余人猛攻大兴至三间房一线，18 日三间房主阵地被突破，守军退向齐齐哈尔，19 日齐齐哈尔沦陷，战役结束，历时 16 天；另有以 10 月 13 日张海鹏部北犯为起点、计 38 天之说。中方战报称第一阶段毙伤日伪军 4000 余人，全线累计毙伤万余人（日军 6000 余人、伪军 5000 余人）；日方战报与部分日军联队史的数字明显低于此，双方统计口径不同，确切数字待考。本事件对应「江桥—大兴—三间房防线」一段路线。 In October 1931 the Japanese directed the turncoat Taonan commander Zhang Haipeng north into Heilongjiang; three regiments moved on the 13th, were routed at the Nen River bridge on the 16th, and the defenders blew two spans of the bridge. On 2 November the Japanese special-service chief at Qiqihar, Hayashi Yoshio, delivered an ultimatum demanding that Chinese troops withdraw ten kilometres from the bridge by noon on the 3rd; on the 4th more than 4,000 Japanese troops with aircraft and armoured cars attacked, Ma Zhanshan’s men replied, and the battle began. It had two phases: fighting between the bridge and Daxing from the 4th to the 6th, with the defenders falling back to Sanjianfang north of Daxing on the night of the 6th; and from the 12th, when over 7,000 Japanese troops assaulted the Daxing–Sanjianfang line, until the main position at Sanjianfang was broken on the 18th and the defenders retired on Qiqihar, which fell on the 19th, ending the sixteen-day battle; some accounts date it from Zhang Haipeng’s move north on 13 October, making 38 days. Chinese accounts claim over 4,000 Japanese and puppet casualties in the first phase and some 10,000 in all (6,000 Japanese, 5,000 puppet); Japanese unit records give markedly lower figures, as the two sides counted differently, and the exact total remains open. This event corresponds to the route segment “Jiangqiao–Daxing–Sanjianfang defence line”.

fields.description: 1931 年 11 月，日军第 2 师团等部沿洮昂铁路北犯，在嫩江江桥遭马占山部抗击。11 月 19 日，日军占领齐齐哈尔，黑龙江省城沦陷。江桥抗战是九一八后中国军队有组织的抵抗之一。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division and other units advanced north along the Tao’ang railway and met resistance from Ma Zhanshan’s forces at the Nen River bridge. On 19 November the Japanese occupied Qiqihar, the provincial capital. The Jiangqiao resistance was one of the first organized Chinese military stands after the Mukden Incident. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Deng Tiemei’s night raid on Fenghuangcheng

summary.zh: 1931年12月26日夜，邓铁梅率东北民众自卫军袭入凤凰城，毙伤日伪军警50余人，是辽东民众抗日的第一仗。
summary.en: On the night of 26 December 1931 Deng Tiemei’s Northeast People’s Self-Defence Army raided Fenghuangcheng, killing or wounding over fifty Japanese and puppet police — the first major action of the Liaodong volunteers.

fields.name: 邓铁梅夜袭凤凰城 Deng Tiemei’s night raid on Fenghuangcheng
fields.summary: 1931年12月26日夜，邓铁梅率东北民众自卫军袭入凤凰城，毙伤日伪军警50余人，是辽东民众抗日的第一仗。 On the night of 26 December 1931 Deng Tiemei’s Northeast People’s Self-Defence Army raided Fenghuangcheng, killing or wounding over fifty Japanese and puppet police — the first major action of the Liaodong volunteers.
fields.description: 邓铁梅原任凤城县公安局长，九一八事变后于 1931 年 10 月在凤城小汤沟顾家堡子创建东北民众自卫军，自任司令，至 12 月发展至 1500 余人。凤凰城（今凤城）是安奉铁路重镇，驻有日本铁道独立守备队和伪警察署。12 月 26 日夜 10 时，自卫军冒雪分路进袭：一路切断电话线并阻击安东、连山关方向援敌，一路攻打火车站，主力由邓铁梅亲率攻入县城。自卫军捣毁县衙、公安局与日本特务机关，砸开监狱释放被捕爱国群众，伪警察多系邓铁梅旧部，经喊话后放下武器。战斗持续至 27 日清晨 4 时，日军援兵乘铁甲车赶到，自卫军携战利品撤出。此役毙伤日伪军警 50 余人，缴获步枪 300 余支、轻机枪 3 挺、迫击炮 2 门。日伪《盛京时报》1931-12-27 报道「凤凰城被焚，通讯断绝，形势严重」。本事件不绘路线。 Deng Tiemei, a former Fenghuangcheng police chief, founded the Northeast People’s Self-Defence Army at Gujiabuzi in Xiaotanggou in October 1931, and by December it had grown to over 1,500 men. Fenghuangcheng was a key town on the Anfeng railway, garrisoned by the Japanese railway guard and a puppet police office. At ten on the night of 26 December the volunteers attacked in several columns through the snow: one cut the telephone lines and blocked relief from Andong and Lianshanguan, one attacked the station, and the main body under Deng entered the town. They wrecked the county office, the police bureau and the Japanese secret service post, broke open the gaol and freed imprisoned patriots; many of the puppet police had served under Deng and laid down their arms after being called on. The fighting lasted until four on the morning of the 27th, when Japanese reinforcements arrived by armoured train and the volunteers withdrew with their booty. More than fifty Japanese and puppet police were killed or wounded, and 300 rifles, three light machine guns, two mortars and ammunition were taken. The Japanese-controlled Shengjing Shibao reported on 27 December that “Fenghuangcheng has been burned, communications cut, the situation serious”. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 锦州沦陷 Fall of Jinzhou
fields.summary: 日军西进占领锦州，东北军退入关内，辽西沦陷。 Japanese forces advanced west and took Jinzhou; the Northeast Army withdrew inside the Great Wall, leaving western Liaoning occupied.
fields.description: 九一八事变后，日军沿南满铁路向北推进，同时西进辽西。1932 年 1 月 3 日占领锦州，东北军在张学良命令下未作有力抵抗即退入关内，辽西与热河门户洞开。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 After the Mukden Incident, Japanese forces pushed north along the South Manchuria Railway and west into western Liaoning. They occupied Jinzhou on 3 January 1932; the Northeast Army, under Zhang Xueliang’s orders, withdrew inside the Great Wall without effective resistance, leaving western Liaoning and the approaches to Rehe open. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 绥中沦陷 Fall of Suizhong
fields.summary: 1932年1月4日，日军侵占绥中。 On 4 January 1932 the Japanese occupied Suizhong.
fields.description: 1932年1月4日，日军侵犯绥中县、葫芦岛。绥中为辽西走廊西端、山海关以东要地，失守后日军直逼山海关。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1932年1月）》与《东北抗日义勇军大事记》。 On 4 January 1932 the Japanese invaded Suizhong and Huludao. Suizhong was the western end of the western Liaoning corridor, east of Shanhaiguan; its fall brought the Japanese to the gates of Shanhaiguan.

fields.name: 义县沦陷 Fall of Yi County

fields.description: 1932年1月7日，日军嘉村旅团自锦州向义县、北票推进，占领义县。义县为锦州通往热河的门户，失守后日军窥伺热河。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1932年1月）》与维基百科《1932年中国》。 On 7 January 1932 the Japanese Kamura brigade advanced from Jinzhou toward Yi County and Beipiao and occupied Yi County. Yi County was the gateway from Jinzhou to Rehe, and its fall opened the Japanese approach to Rehe.

name.zh: 江家屯大捷（围歼古贺骑兵联队）
name.en: The Jiangjiatun Victory: destruction of the Koga cavalry regiment

place.zh: 辽宁锦西江家屯（今葫芦岛钢屯）

summary.zh: 1932年1月9日，锦西民团与绿林武装联合伏击日军古贺骑兵联队，击毙联队长古贺传太郎，18日收复锦西县城。
summary.en: On 9 January 1932 Jinxi militia and Green Gang forces ambushed the Japanese Koga cavalry regiment, killing its commander, and recovered the county town on the 18th.

fields.name: 江家屯大捷（围歼古贺骑兵联队） The Jiangjiatun Victory: destruction of the Koga cavalry regiment
fields.place: 辽宁锦西江家屯（今葫芦岛钢屯） Jiangjiatun, Jinxi (modern Gangtun, Huludao), Liaoning
fields.summary: 1932年1月9日，锦西民团与绿林武装联合伏击日军古贺骑兵联队，击毙联队长古贺传太郎，18日收复锦西县城。 On 9 January 1932 Jinxi militia and Green Gang forces ambushed the Japanese Koga cavalry regiment, killing its commander, and recovered the county town on the 18th.
fields.description: 1932 年 1 月 3 日日军占领锦州。5 日，关东军第二十师团派骑兵第二十七联队长古贺传太郎中佐率骑兵 80 余人，会同石野步兵小队与松尾粮秣输送队共 130 余人西进，6 日占领锦西县城江家屯。锦西县公安局长苑凤台会同民团首领周玉桂、刘国璋及绿林首领刘春山、刘存启（报号亮山）等联合，编成义勇军，在县城西上坡子、龙王庙、西园子一带设伏。9 日上午，古贺率 50 余名骑兵和石野步兵小队出城「扫荡」，先后在上坡子、龙王庙遭伏击；回撤至西园子时，被据守炮楼的刘国臣等 11 人击中，午后 3 时毙命；同日松尾运输队在城东钱搭屯岭被千余民众包围，激战至午后全歼。战果各说不一：一说着重击毙古贺中佐、星野大尉、石野中尉等 4 名军官及士兵 40 余人、伤 20 余人；一说日军阵亡 49 人、重伤 22 人（辽宁日报 2025）；锦西地方资料合计「歼敌百余人」。1 月 18 日，日军被迫放弃锦西县城，县公署迁往连山，这是九一八事变后中国民众收复的第一座县城。本事件为民众伏击战，不绘路线。 The Japanese took Jinzhou on 3 January 1932. On the 5th the 20th Division sent the 27th Cavalry Regiment under Lieutenant-Colonel Koga Dentarō, with the Ishino infantry platoon and the Matsuo supply detachment — some 130 men — westward, and on the 6th they occupied the Jinxi county town of Jiangjiatun. Yuan Fengtai, the county police chief, joined the militia leaders Zhou Yugui and Liu Guozhang and the Green Gang leaders Liu Chunshan and Liu Cunqi (known as Liangshan) to form a volunteer force and lay ambushes at Shangpozi, Longwangmiao and Xiyuanzi west of the town. On the morning of the 9th Koga went out with over fifty cavalry and the Ishino platoon to “sweep” the countryside and was ambushed first at Shangpozi and then at Longwangmiao; withdrawing through Xiyuanzi he was shot by Liu Guochen and eleven men holding a watchtower and died at three in the afternoon. The same day the Matsuo supply train was surrounded by over a thousand villagers at Qianda village east of the town and wiped out. Accounts of the toll differ: one credits the volunteers with killing Koga, Captain Hoshino, Lieutenant Ishino and one other officer plus over forty soldiers and wounding twenty; another gives 49 Japanese dead and 22 seriously wounded (Liaoning Daily, 2025); local Jinxi material speaks of “over a hundred enemy dead” in all. On 18 January the Japanese abandoned the county town and moved the administration to Lianshan — the first county town recovered by Chinese civilians after the Mukden Incident. This was a civilian ambush; no route is drawn.

fields.name: 锦西沦陷 Fall of Jinxi
fields.summary: 1932年1月11日，日军依田旅团攻占锦西县城。 On 11 January 1932 the Japanese Ida brigade captured Jinxi.
fields.description: 1932年1月11日，日军依田旅团攻占锦西县城（江家屯）。1月9日锦西义勇军在江家屯伏击日军骑兵第27联队，击毙联队长古贺传太郎以下百余人；1月18日日军被迫放弃锦西县城。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1932年1月）》与《义勇军“江家屯大捷”》。 On 11 January 1932 the Japanese Ida brigade captured Jinxi (Jiangjiatun). On 9 January the Jinxi guerrillas ambushed the Japanese 27th Cavalry Regiment at Jiangjiatun, killing Colonel Koga Densaburo and over a hundred men; on 18 January the Japanese abandoned the county town.

fields.name: 北镇沦陷 Fall of Beizhen
fields.summary: 1932年1月13日，日军高地大队侵占北镇。 On 13 January 1932 the Japanese Takachi detachment occupied Beizhen.
fields.description: 1932年1月13日，日军占领锦州后派高地少佐一个大队向北镇进犯，驱散民团，占据北镇。北镇为辽西义勇军活动中心，失守后日军对北镇、黑山、台安等县大规模搜村。日期据《东北抗日义勇军大事记》与《中华民族抗日编年（1932年1月）》。 On 13 January 1932, after taking Jinzhou, the Japanese sent a battalion under Major Takachi against Beizhen, dispersed the militia and occupied the town. Beizhen was a centre of the western Liaoning guerrillas; after its fall the Japanese conducted large-scale sweeps through Beizhen, Heishan and Tai’an counties.

summary.zh: 1932年1月27日至2月5日，李杜、冯占海等部在哈尔滨抗击日伪军，2月5日哈尔滨陷落。
summary.en: From 27 January to 5 February 1932 Li Du, Feng Zhanhai and others defended Harbin against Japanese and puppet forces; the city fell on 5 February.

fields.name: 哈尔滨保卫战 Defence of Harbin
fields.place: 黑龙江哈尔滨 Harbin, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1932年1月27日至2月5日，李杜、冯占海等部在哈尔滨抗击日伪军，2月5日哈尔滨陷落。 From 27 January to 5 February 1932 Li Du, Feng Zhanhai and others defended Harbin against Japanese and puppet forces; the city fell on 5 February.
fields.description: 1931 年 10 月，投日的吉林省代主席熙洽任于琛澂为伪吉林省「剿匪军」司令，率伪军 4 个旅 9000 余人向哈尔滨推进；冯占海部在拉林阻击后退至阿城。1932 年 1 月 25 日，依兰镇守使李杜、吉林省警备司令冯占海率部进入哈尔滨，与丁超、邢占清、赵毅等会商合作抗日。27 日上午，于琛澂伪军在日军飞机、大炮配合下进攻上号（香坊）、三棵树、南岗，李杜、冯占海部还击并向伪军喊话，伪团长田德胜率部反正，伪军傍晚败退；日军 4 架飞机助战，被击落 1 架，飞行员清水大尉毙命。30 日至 31 日，驻双城的第二十二旅赵毅部先袭击双城东十里铺伪军刘宝林旅，俘 700 余人，继于双城堡车站袭击日军天野旅团兵车，毙伤数百人；日军以飞机、坦克反扑，双城于 2 月 1 日（一说 2 日）失守。31 日，吉林自卫军总司令部在哈尔滨成立，李杜任总司令，丁超任护路军总司令，冯占海任副总司令，参战部队约 2 万人。2 月 3 日外围战开始，4 日日军第二师团总攻，顾乡屯、南岗阵地相继被突破，5 日哈尔滨陷落，自卫军撤往巴彦、依兰、延寿一带。本事件为城市防御战，不另绘路线（日军进攻轴线见日军进攻层「双城堡—哈尔滨」段）。 In October 1931 Xi Qia, the pro-Japanese acting governor of Jilin, made Yu Chencheng commander of a puppet “bandit-suppression” force and sent four puppet brigades (over 9,000 men) toward Harbin; Feng Zhanhai blocked them at Lalin and fell back to Acheng. On 25 January 1932 Li Du, commander at Yilan, and Feng Zhanhai, commander of the Jilin garrison, entered Harbin and agreed with Ding Chao, Xing Zhanqing and Zhao Yi to resist together. On the morning of the 27th Yu’s puppet troops, supported by Japanese aircraft and artillery, attacked Xiangfang, Sanshu and Nangang; Li and Feng counter-attacked and called on the puppet soldiers not to fight their own people, Colonel Tian Desheng defected with his regiment, and the puppet force retreated that evening. Four Japanese aircraft took part, one was shot down and its pilot, Captain Shimizu, was killed. On 30–31 January Zhao Yi’s 22nd Brigade at Shuangcheng first surprised Liu Baolin’s puppet brigade east of the town, capturing over 700 men, then attacked the Japanese Ameno brigade’s troop trains at Shuangcheng station, inflicting several hundred casualties; Japanese aircraft and tanks counter-attacked and Shuangcheng fell on 1 February (some accounts say the 2nd). On the 31st the Jilin Self-Defence Army headquarters was formed at Harbin under Li Du, with Ding Chao over the railway troops and Feng Zhanhai as deputy; some 20,000 men took part. The outer battle began on 3 February, the Japanese 2nd Division attacked on the 4th, the Guxiangtun and Nangang positions were broken in turn, and Harbin fell on the 5th, the defenders withdrawing toward Bayan, Yilan and Yanshou. This was an urban defence and no separate route is drawn; the Japanese axis appears as “Shuangcheng–Harbin” in the Japanese advance layer.

fields.name: 一·二八事变 January 28 Incident 淞沪抗战 January 28 Resistance
fields.summary: 日军进攻上海闸北，第十九路军等部奋起抵抗，淞沪地区爆发激烈战斗。 Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai; the 19th Route Army and other Chinese units resisted in fierce fighting.
fields.description: 1932 年 1 月 28 日，日军以保护侨民为借口进攻上海闸北。第十九路军在蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴指挥下抵抗，双方在淞沪地区激战至 3 月。5 月，中日签订《淞沪停战协定》。 本事件日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On 28 January 1932, Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai under the pretext of protecting residents. The 19th Route Army, commanded by Jiang Guangnai and Cai Tingkai, resisted until March. In May, China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 双城堡失守 Fall of Shuangcheng
fields.summary: 1932年1月31日，日军攻占双城堡，哈尔滨南面门户洞开。 On 31 January 1932 the Japanese took Shuangcheng, opening the southern approaches to Harbin.
fields.description: 1932年1月底，赵毅部在双城堡东十里铺歼灭伪军刘宝林部，并在双城堡车站伏击北上日军。31日，日军增援后以优势兵力进攻，双城堡失守。双城堡是中东铁路南段要地，失守后日军直逼哈尔滨。日期据《七、日本帝国主义的殖民统治》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 In late January 1932 Zhao Yi’s troops destroyed Liu Baolin’s puppet unit at Shilipu east of Shuangcheng and ambushed the northbound Japanese at Shuangcheng station. On the 31st the reinforced Japanese attacked with superior force and took Shuangcheng, the key point on the southern section of the Chinese Eastern Railway, opening the road to Harbin.

fields.name: 哈尔滨沦陷 Fall of Harbin

fields.summary: 日军占领哈尔滨，东北主要城市至此基本沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Harbin, completing the occupation of the Northeast’s major cities.
fields.description: 1932 年 2 月 5 日，日军进入哈尔滨。此前齐齐哈尔、锦州等地已相继失守，东北三省主要城市至此基本被日军控制。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 Japanese troops entered Harbin on 5 February 1932. Qiqihar, Jinzhou, and other cities had already fallen, leaving the major cities of the three northeastern provinces largely under Japanese control. This event marks a route segment endpoint; the date follows conventional accounts and awaits historical review.

name.zh: 吉林中国国民救国军成立
name.en: Founding of the Jilin National Salvation Army

place.zh: 吉林延吉小城子（今汪清春阳）

summary.zh: 1932年2月8日，王德林率原东北军「老三营」在延吉小城子誓师，成立吉林中国国民救国军，提出「不分党派，共同一致对外」。
summary.en: On 8 February 1932 Wang Delin’s old 3rd Battalion declared the Jilin National Salvation Army at Xiaochengzi, calling for unity across party lines against Japan.

fields.name: 吉林中国国民救国军成立 Founding of the Jilin National Salvation Army
fields.place: 吉林延吉小城子（今汪清春阳） Xiaochengzi, Yanji (modern Chunyang, Wangqing), Jilin
fields.summary: 1932年2月8日，王德林率原东北军「老三营」在延吉小城子誓师，成立吉林中国国民救国军，提出「不分党派，共同一致对外」。 On 8 February 1932 Wang Delin’s old 3rd Battalion declared the Jilin National Salvation Army at Xiaochengzi, calling for unity across party lines against Japan.
fields.description: 九一八事变后，驻延吉明月沟（今安图明月镇）的东北陆军第二十七旅六七六团三营（「老三营」）营长王德林拒绝随旅长吉兴投日。1931 年 12 月 7 日，日军武装勘测队强行登上瓮声砬子炮台，哨兵鸣枪示警无效后将其击毙 2 人，是为「瓮声砬子事件」，王德林主动承担「责任」。1932 年 1 月，王德林将队伍拉至延吉县小城子（今汪清县春阳镇），2 月 8 日召开抗日誓师大会，成立「吉林中国国民救国军」，王德林任总指挥（总司令），孔宪荣任副指挥，吴义成任前方司令，李延禄任参谋长兼补充团团长。救国军提出「不分党派，共同一致对外」，是东北各支义军中首次明确提出这一主张；中共延和中心县委先后派李延禄、李光、孟泾清等进入，补充团由共产党人掌握，后成为抗联第四军的基础。2 月 20 日救国军攻敦化，毙伤日军守备队长长谷大尉以下 50 余人；至 3 月总兵力达 2 万余人，活动于宁安、穆棱、东宁、安图等十余县。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 After the Mukden Incident Wang Delin, commander of the 3rd Battalion of the 676th Regiment, 27th Brigade, stationed at Mingyuegou near Yanji, refused to follow his brigade commander Ji Xing into collaboration. On 7 December 1931 a Japanese armed survey party forced its way onto the Wengsheng Lazi gun emplacement; the sentries fired warning shots and then killed two of the intruders — the “Wengsheng Lazi incident” — and Wang took the “responsibility” on himself. In January 1932 Wang moved his men to Xiaochengzi in Yanji county (modern Chunyang, Wangqing), and on 8 February held a rally proclaiming the Jilin National Salvation Army, with Wang as commander-in-chief, Kong Xianrong as deputy, Wu Yicheng as front commander and Li Yanlu as chief of staff and commander of the supplementary regiment. It was the first volunteer force in the Northeast to declare “no distinction of party, united against the foreign enemy”; the Yanji-Helong county committee sent Li Yanlu, Li Guang, Meng Jingqing and others, and the supplementary regiment, led by Communists, later became the basis of the 4th Route Army. On 20 February the army attacked Dunhua, killing or wounding over fifty Japanese including Captain Hasegawa of the garrison; by March it numbered over 20,000 men in a dozen counties including Ning’an, Muling, Dongning and Antu. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

fields.name: 海林沦陷 Fall of Hailin
fields.summary: 1932年2月17日，日军佐佐木部队侵占海林镇。 On 17 February 1932 the Japanese Sasaki force occupied Hailin.
fields.description: 1932年2月17日，日军佐佐木部队长率步兵、骑兵、炮兵700余人，由哈尔滨沿中东铁路东进，占领海林镇，日军侵略铁蹄由此踏入牡丹江地区。2月19日夜，吉林自卫军刘万魁旅反攻海林，毙伤日军60余人，佐佐木部撤回哈尔滨。日期据《建党百年丨红色牡丹江》与《1932年（伪大同元年）》。 On 17 February 1932 Colonel Sasaki led more than 700 infantry, cavalry and artillery east from Harbin along the Chinese Eastern Railway and occupied Hailin, bringing the Japanese invasion into the Mudanjiang region. On the night of 19 February Liu Wankui’s brigade counter-attacked, killing or wounding over 60 Japanese, and Sasaki withdrew to Harbin.

fields.description: 1932 年 3 月 1 日，日本扶植清朝末代皇帝溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，随后以“日满议定书”等形式加以控制。中国政府与国际联盟均未承认该政权。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 1 March 1932, Japan installed Puyi, the last Qing emperor, as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, later controlling it through agreements such as the Japan-Manchukuo Protocol. Neither the Chinese government nor the League of Nations recognized the regime. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.place: 吉林宁安镜泊湖 Jingpo Lake, Ning’an, Jilin
fields.summary: 1932年3月13日至27日，李延禄率救国军补充团在镜泊湖“墙缝”等地连续伏击日军天野部队，战果数字至今争议极大。 From 13 to 27 March 1932 Li Yanlu’s supplementary regiment ambushed the Japanese Ameno force repeatedly around Jingpo Lake; the scale of the Japanese losses remains fiercely disputed.
fields.description: 1932 年 2 月，王德林率吉林中国国民救国军连克敦化、额穆、蛟河，关东军急调天野第十五旅团等部自敦化南进「讨伐」。救国军参谋长、共产党员李延禄率补充团 700 人，选择牡丹江入镜泊湖处「墙缝」高地设伏——此处是夹在牡丹江与山坡之间的五华里窄道，路边石壁时断时续，形如墙缝。3 月 13 日拂晓，猎户陈文起将日军引入伏击圈，补充团以手榴弹为主激战约十小时；随后又在松乙沟（火烧伏击）、宁安关家小铺、中东铁路高岭子车站连续伏击，至 3 月 27 日结束。战果争议极大，必须并列：李延禄回忆录与周保中《东北人民抗日战争概括》称歼天野部队 7000 人、墙缝一战毙伤 3500 人以上；《中共黑龙江党史大事记》《中共牡丹江市党的历史活动大事记》记「抗击上田支队，歼敌七八十人」；黑龙江省委党史研究室新编抗联史采用「墙缝战歼敌 120 余人，后续再伏击 130 人」；宁安党史资料记毙日军小川松本大尉以下 120 余人。本事件并列两说，不采单一数字。补充团由中共秘密领导，后成为东北抗联第四军的基础。本事件不绘路线。 In February 1932 Wang Delin’s Jilin National Salvation Army took Dunhua, Emu and Jiaohe in succession, and the Kwantung Army rushed the Ameno 15th Brigade and other units south from Dunhua to suppress it. Li Yanlu, the army’s chief of staff and a Communist, led its 700-strong supplementary regiment to the “wall cracks” (Qiangfeng) heights where the Mudan River enters Jingpo Lake — a five-li defile between the river and a hillside, its rock wall broken into gaps like cracks. At dawn on 13 March the hunter Chen Wenqi led the Japanese into the trap and the regiment fought for about ten hours, mainly with grenades; further ambushes followed at Songyigou (a fire trap), Guanjiaxiaopu near Ning’an and Gaolingzi station on the Chinese Eastern Railway, ending on 27 March. The results are fiercely disputed and are given here side by side: Li Yanlu’s memoirs and Zhou Baozhong’s 1960 survey claim the destruction of the 7,000-strong Ameno force, with over 3,500 killed or wounded at Qiangfeng alone; the Heilongjiang and Mudanjiang party histories record “over seventy or eighty enemy dead”; the Heilongjiang provincial party history office’s newer history gives “over 120 at Qiangfeng and another 130 in the later ambushes”; Ning’an party material gives over 120 including Captain Ogawa Matsumoto. Both versions are stated; no single figure is adopted. The regiment was secretly led by the Communist Party and became the basis of the 4th Route Army. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 间岛派遣队侵入延吉 Jiandao Expeditionary Force Enters Yanji
fields.summary: 1932年4月3日，日本驻朝鲜第19师团“间岛派遣队”侵入延吉。 On 3 April 1932 the “Jiandao Expeditionary Force” of the Japanese 19th Division in Korea entered Yanji.
fields.description: 1932年初，日本从辽西战场和朝鲜调兵，准备对东满抗日武装发动第一次大“讨伐”。4月3日，驻朝鲜罗南的第19师团组成“间岛派遣队”越图们江侵入延吉；4月17日，关东军平贺部队自长春东援，鹤见部队自宁安东犯，三路合击东满。同日龙井亦被侵入，见龙井事件。日期据《粉碎日军第一次大“讨伐”与“海兰江大血案”》与《侵华日军暴行总实录（十三）——吉林》。 In early 1932 Japan drew troops from western Liaoning and Korea for the first great “punitive campaign” in eastern Manchuria. On 3 April the “Jiandao Expeditionary Force” formed from the 19th Division at Ranam crossed the Tumen River and entered Yanji. On 17 April the Hiraga force reinforced from Changchun and the Tsurumi force advanced from Ning’an, converging on eastern Manchuria.

fields.name: 间岛派遣队侵入龙井 Jiandao Expeditionary Force Enters Longjing
fields.summary: 1932年4月3日，日本驻朝鲜第19师团“间岛派遣队”侵入龙井。 On 3 April 1932 the “Jiandao Expeditionary Force” of the Japanese 19th Division in Korea entered Longjing.
fields.description: 1932年4月3日，驻朝鲜罗南的日本第19师团组成“间岛派遣队”，越图们江侵入延吉、龙井等地。龙井为日本驻间岛总领事馆所在地，也是延边政治、商业中心，日军侵入后以此为基础对东满抗日武装发动第一次大“讨伐”。日期据《粉碎日军第一次大“讨伐”与“海兰江大血案”》与《侵华日军暴行总实录（十三）——吉林》。 On 3 April 1932 the “Jiandao Expeditionary Force” formed from the Japanese 19th Division at Ranam crossed the Tumen River and entered Yanji, Longjing and other places. Longjing was the seat of the Japanese consulate-general in Jiandao and the political and commercial centre of the Yanbian region; from there the Japanese launched the first great “punitive campaign” against the anti-Japanese forces of eastern Manchuria.

fields.name: 中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府宣布对日战争 Chinese Soviet Government declares war on Japan
fields.summary: 1932 年 4 月 15 日，中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府在瑞金发布《对日战争宣言》，公开宣布对日战争。 On 15 April 1932 the Chinese Soviet provisional central government at Ruijin issued its declaration of war on Japan.
fields.description: 1932 年 4 月 15 日，中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府在江西瑞金发布《中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府宣布对日战争宣言》，由毛泽东起草。宣言控诉日军继九一八之后进攻上海、轰炸中国城镇，正式宣布「对日战争」，号召全中国工农红军和广大被压迫民众以民族革命战争驱逐日本帝国主义出中国。宣言于 4 月 21 日刊登在临时中央政府机关报《红色中华》第 18 期，同日还发布《关于动员对日宣战的训令》。这是中国共产党领导的政权第一次以国家政权名义公开对日宣战。本事件为政策文件，不绘路线。 On 15 April 1932 the Chinese Soviet provisional central government at Ruijin, Jiangxi, issued its declaration of war on Japan, drafted by Mao Zedong. It denounced the Japanese attack on Shanghai after Mukden and formally declared war, calling on the Red Army and the oppressed masses to drive Japanese imperialism out of China by revolutionary national war. The declaration appeared in Red China no. 18 on 21 April, together with a mobilisation order. It was the first time a government led by the Communist Party formally declared war on Japan. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 国际联盟调查团抵达沈阳调查九一八事变；报告否认伪满洲国合法性，但未认定日本为侵略者。

fields.name: 国联李顿调查团赴东北 Lytton Commission in the Northeast
fields.summary: 国际联盟调查团抵达沈阳调查九一八事变；报告否认伪满洲国合法性，但未认定日本为侵略者。 The League of Nations commission reached Shenyang to investigate the Mukden Incident; its report denied Manchukuo’s legitimacy but did not name Japan an aggressor.
fields.description: 1932 年 4 月 21 日，国际联盟李顿调查团抵达沈阳，开始调查九一八事变后的东北局势。调查团由英、美、法、德、意五国代表组成，英国代表李顿任团长；中国代表顾维钧以顾问（襄助委员）身份参加。 调查团不是中国政府派出的：1931 年 9 月 21 日中国政府向国联申诉，同年 12 月 10 日国联行政院决议派遣调查团。中国政府是申诉方和当事国，负责接待与配合，但调查的发起、组成和结论都出自国联。 调查团 10 月 2 日公布报告书，承认东北是中国领土、否认伪满洲国的合法性，但未将日本定为侵略者，主张国际共管。1933 年 2 月国联大会通过报告书，日本随后退出国联。 国际事件，不绘制路线；日期、职务与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 21 April 1932 the League of Nations Lytton Commission reached Shenyang and began investigating the situation in the Northeast after the Mukden Incident. The commission consisted of representatives of Britain, the United States, France, Germany, and Italy, with the British representative Lord Lytton as chairman; the Chinese representative Wellington Koo took part as assessor. The commission was not sent by the Chinese government: China appealed to the League on 21 September 1931, and the League Council resolved on 10 December 1931 to send a commission of inquiry. China was the complainant and the party concerned and handled reception and cooperation, but the initiative, composition, and conclusions belonged to the League. The report, published on 2 October 1932, recognized the Northeast as Chinese territory and denied the legality of Manchukuo, but did not name Japan as an aggressor and proposed international administration. The League Assembly adopted the report in February 1933, and Japan withdrew from the League soon afterwards. An international event with no route drawn; dates, titles, and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Founding of the Liaoning People’s Self-Defence Army

summary.zh: 1932年4月21日，唐聚五在桓仁誓师成立辽宁民众自卫军，编18路军，是辽东最大的一支义勇军。
summary.en: On 21 April 1932 Tang Juwu proclaimed the Liaoning People’s Self-Defence Army at Huanren, with 18 route armies — the largest volunteer force in eastern Liaoning.

fields.name: 辽宁民众自卫军成立 Founding of the Liaoning People’s Self-Defence Army
fields.summary: 1932年4月21日，唐聚五在桓仁誓师成立辽宁民众自卫军，编18路军，是辽东最大的一支义勇军。 On 21 April 1932 Tang Juwu proclaimed the Liaoning People’s Self-Defence Army at Huanren, with 18 route armies — the largest volunteer force in eastern Liaoning.
fields.description: 唐聚五原任东边道镇守使署步兵第一团中校团副，驻防凤城。九一八后赴北平见张学良，受命回东北「召集自卫军，抗日救国」，遂到桓仁收集旧部。1932 年 3 月 21 日，唐聚五等在桓仁召开秘密会议，决定成立辽宁民众救国会与辽宁民众自卫军，推唐聚五为总司令，并定 4 月 21 日起义。4 月 21 日，唐聚五、孙秀岩、张宗周、郭景珊、黄宇宙等在桓仁县师范学校操场举行誓师大会，唐聚五以刀划破手指，血书「杀敌讨逆，救国爱民」，会后通电全国。自卫军编 18 路军，以通化、桓仁、新宾、宽甸、辑安、临江、柳河等 14 县的公安大队、警察队、民团、保甲兵与民众自发组织的大刀会为骨干；8 月扩至 37 路。兵力数字各说不一：《黑龙江日报》记总兵力 4000 余人，《人民政协报》记约 10 余万人，桓仁地方资料记扩至 24 万人——差异在于是否计入不脱产的大刀会与民团，确切数字待考。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 Tang Juwu was deputy colonel of the 1st Regiment of the East Liaoning garrison headquarters at Fengcheng. After the Mukden Incident he went to Beiping, where Zhang Xueliang ordered him back to “raise a self-defence army and resist Japan”, and he gathered his old troops at Huanren. On 21 March 1932 Tang and others held a secret meeting at Huanren, decided to found the Liaoning People’s National Salvation Association and the Liaoning People’s Self-Defence Army with Tang as commander-in-chief, and fixed the uprising for 21 April. On that day Tang, Sun Xiuyan, Zhang Zongzhou, Guo Jingshan and Huang Yuzhou held a oath-taking rally on the school ground at Huanren, where Tang cut his finger and wrote in blood “destroy the rebels, save the country, love the people”, and a national telegram was sent out. The army was organised into 18 route armies, built on the police, militia, baojia units and the popular Big Sword Societies of 14 counties including Tonghua, Huanren, Xinbin, Kuandian, Ji’an, Linjiang and Liuhe; by August it had grown to 37 routes. Troop numbers differ: the Heilongjiang Daily gives just over 4,000; the CPPCC Daily about 100,000; Huanren local material 240,000 — the difference lies in whether part-time Big Sword Society and militia members are counted, and the exact figure remains open. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

name.en: Signing of the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement

summary.zh: 中日签订《淞沪停战协定》，一·二八事变结束，中国军队退出上海市区。
summary.en: China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement, ending the January 28 Incident and requiring Chinese troops to withdraw from urban Shanghai.

fields.name: 《淞沪停战协定》签署 Signing of the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement
fields.summary: 中日签订《淞沪停战协定》，一·二八事变结束，中国军队退出上海市区。 China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement, ending the January 28 Incident and requiring Chinese troops to withdraw from urban Shanghai.
fields.description: 1932 年 5 月 5 日，中日双方签订《淞沪停战协定》，规定上海为非武装区，中国军队不得驻守市区，日军则可留驻部分区域。一·二八事变至此结束，但协定被舆论视为屈辱让步。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 5 May 1932 China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement, making Shanghai a demilitarized zone: Chinese troops were barred from the urban area while Japanese forces could remain in parts of it. The January 28 Incident thus ended, though the agreement was widely seen as a humiliating concession. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.en: On 17 May 1932 the Japanese 10th Division captured Yilan.

fields.name: 依兰沦陷 Fall of Yilan
fields.summary: 1932年5月17日，日军第10师团攻陷依兰。 On 17 May 1932 the Japanese 10th Division captured Yilan.
fields.description: 1932年4月，日军第10师团自日本调至哈尔滨，主力转向吉林自卫军中心区依兰。5月16日日军先头部队攻入依兰，17日依兰陷落。吉林自卫军后方基地失守，所储被服、粮食、武器弹药及修械所、医院尽落敌手。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与《七、日本帝国主义的殖民统治》。 In April 1932 the Japanese 10th Division arrived at Harbin from Japan and turned on Yilan, the centre of the Jilin Self-Defence Army. The Japanese advance guard entered Yilan on 16 May and the town fell on the 17th, costing the Self-Defence Army its rear base with its stores, workshops and hospital.

summary.en: On 17 May 1932 the Japanese occupied Jiamusi.

fields.name: 佳木斯沦陷 Fall of Jiamusi
fields.summary: 1932年5月17日，日军侵占佳木斯。 On 17 May 1932 the Japanese occupied Jiamusi.
fields.description: 1932年5月初，日军侵占依兰，佳木斯告急。桦川县县长张锡侯率城防自卫团、警务队及山林警察队编成4个团，在佳木斯西门、江沿构筑工事。5月8日，日伪军由依兰向佳木斯进发，以飞机10架轰炸城区，日军主力乘兵舰顺江而下，从东西两面登陆，激战五天五夜，5月17日佳木斯沦陷。日期据《第一节 抗日战争》与《黑龙江——走进佳木斯》。 In early May 1932 the Japanese took Yilan and threatened Jiamusi. Zhang Xihou, magistrate of Hua County, formed four regiments from the city defence corps, police and forest police and built works at the west gate and the riverfront. On 8 May Japanese and puppet forces advanced from Yilan, bombing the city with ten aircraft while the main force came downriver by gunboat and landed east and west of the city. After five days and nights of fighting Jiamusi fell on 17 May.

fields.name: 牡丹江沦陷 Fall of Mudanjiang
fields.summary: 1932年5月21日，日军再次攻占牡丹江站并占领铁岭河，牡丹江沦陷。 On 21 May 1932 the Japanese retook Mudanjiang station and occupied Tielinghe, completing the occupation of Mudanjiang.
fields.description: 1932年5月1日，日军渡少佐部队袭击牡丹江，2日王德林部突袭，5日各路抗日军反攻牡丹江站，击毙日军中村贞太郎少佐等300余人。7日日军占领牡丹江站；20日刘万奎部一度收复车站，日军调兵增援，21日晨再次攻占牡丹江站并占领铁岭河，牡丹江全境沦陷。日期据《1932年（伪大同元年）》与《建党百年丨红色牡丹江》。 On 1 May 1932 Major Wataru’s force raided Mudanjiang; on the 2nd Wang Delin’s troops counter-attacked; on the 5th Chinese forces retook the station area, killing Major Nakamura Sadatarō and over 300 Japanese. The Japanese took the station on the 7th; on the 20th Liu Wankui briefly recovered it, but reinforcements arrived and on the morning of the 21st the Japanese retook the station and occupied Tielinghe, completing the occupation of Mudanjiang.

fields.summary: 一·二八事变后，第十九路军由上海调驻福建。 After the January 28 Incident the 19th Route Army moved from Shanghai to Fujian.
fields.description: 1932 年 5 月《淞沪停战协定》签订后，第十九路军由上海调驻福建。1933 年 11 月，该部在福州发动福建事变，另立政府，次年失败。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 After the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement of May 1932, the 19th Route Army moved from Shanghai to Fujian. In November 1933 it launched the Fujian Incident at Fuzhou and formed a separate government, which collapsed the following year. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 海伦沦陷 Fall of Hailun
fields.summary: 1932年6月1日，日军平贺旅团侵占海伦。 On 1 June 1932 the Japanese Hiraga brigade occupied Hailun.
fields.description: 1932年5月30日，日军飞机6架轰炸海伦，炸毁房屋295间，炸死居民14人、炸伤18人。5月31日马占山部撤出海伦，6月1日日军平贺旅团及伪军200余人侵占海伦城。海伦为黑龙江省抗日军政中枢所在，失守后马占山部转至呼海铁路沿线游击。日期据《1912年-1944年》与《日军入侵海伦》。 On 30 May 1932 six Japanese aircraft bombed Hailun, destroying 295 houses and killing 14 and wounding 18 civilians. Ma Zhanshan’s troops withdrew on 31 May and on 1 June the Japanese Hiraga brigade with some 200 puppet troops occupied Hailun, the seat of Heilongjiang’s resistance administration; Ma then shifted to guerrilla warfare along the Huhai railway.

fields.place: 辽宁辑安 Ji’an (modern Ji’an, Jilin), Liaoning
fields.summary: 1932年6月9日，日军自朝鲜满浦渡鸭绿江侵入辑安（今吉林集安）。 On 9 June 1932 Japanese forces crossed the Yalu at Manpo from Korea and invaded Ji’an (modern Ji’an, Jilin).
fields.description: 1932年6月8日夜12时，驻朝鲜国境守备队队长吉江协一中佐、宪兵长吉房虎雄率日军700名、宪兵8名，由朝鲜满浦渡鸭绿江。9日晨2时，日军自对岸玻璃山炮击辑安城，炸死居民约10人、炸毁房屋20余间，随后在城东、城西、北面向抗日义勇军进攻。日本陆军省战报亦承认6月上旬侵占辑安等县城。日期据《侵华日军暴行总实录（十三）——吉林》与吉房虎雄笔供。 At midnight on 8 June 1932 Colonel Yoshie Kyōichi of the Korean border guard and gendarme chief Yoshifusa Torao led 700 Japanese troops and eight gendarmes across the Yalu at Manpo. At 2 a.m. on the 9th they shelled Ji’an from Glass Mountain on the far bank, killing about ten residents and destroying over twenty houses, then attacked the volunteer forces east, west and north of the town. The Japanese Army Ministry’s own communiqué admitted the occupation of Ji’an and other county towns in early June.

summary.zh: 1932年6月9日，日军自朝鲜渡鸭绿江侵入临江。
summary.en: On 9 June 1932 Japanese forces crossed the Yalu from Korea and invaded Linjiang.

fields.name: 日军侵入临江 Japanese Invasion of Linjiang
fields.place: 辽宁临江 Linjiang (modern Linjiang, Jilin), Liaoning
fields.summary: 1932年6月9日，日军自朝鲜渡鸭绿江侵入临江。 On 9 June 1932 Japanese forces crossed the Yalu from Korea and invaded Linjiang.
fields.description: 1932年6月8日半夜，日军开始向临江炮击；9日晨，550名日军和5名宪兵侵入临江城内，占领南围子后各处放火，连续三天烧毁民房700余间。占领期间，日军宪兵以“通谋抗日军”为名逮捕杀害城内和平居民。日期据《侵华日军暴行总实录（十三）——吉林》与吉房虎雄笔供。 Late on 8 June 1932 the Japanese began shelling Linjiang; at dawn on the 9th 550 troops and five gendarmes entered the town, seized the southern compound and set fires that burned over 700 houses in three days. During the occupation the gendarmes arrested and killed civilians on the pretext of “communicating with the anti-Japanese army”.

summary.zh: 日本与伪满洲国签订《日满议定书》，正式承认伪满并取得驻军、经营铁路等权益。
summary.en: Japan and the puppet state of Manchukuo signed the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol, formalizing Japanese recognition and securing garrison and railway rights.

fields.name: 《日满议定书》签订 Signing of the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol
fields.place: 吉林长春（伪满称“新京”） Changchun, Jilin (Japanese puppet capital “Xinjing”)
fields.summary: 日本与伪满洲国签订《日满议定书》，正式承认伪满并取得驻军、经营铁路等权益。 Japan and the puppet state of Manchukuo signed the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol, formalizing Japanese recognition and securing garrison and railway rights.
fields.description: 1932 年 9 月 15 日，日本驻伪满特命全权大使武藤信义与伪满洲国总理郑孝胥在长春签订《日满议定书》。日本据此承认伪满洲国，并取得在伪满驻军、管理铁路和开发资源等特权，东北进一步被纳入日本殖民统治体系。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 15 September 1932 Japanese ambassador Mutō Nobuyoshi and Manchukuo premier Zheng Xiaoxu signed the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol in Changchun. Japan recognized the puppet state and secured privileges including troop stationing, railway management and resource development, drawing Northeast China further into its colonial system. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军抚顺守备队在平顶山实施大屠杀，杀害大批矿工和平民。
summary.en: Japanese garrison troops carried out a massacre at Pingdingshan near Fushun, killing a large number of miners and civilians.

fields.name: 平顶山惨案 Pingdingshan Massacre
fields.place: 辽宁抚顺平顶山 Pingdingshan, Fushun, Liaoning
fields.summary: 日军抚顺守备队在平顶山实施大屠杀，杀害大批矿工和平民。 Japanese garrison troops carried out a massacre at Pingdingshan near Fushun, killing a large number of miners and civilians.
fields.description: 1932 年 9 月 16 日，日军抚顺守备队以报复抗日义勇军袭击为由，包围抚顺平顶山村落，屠杀村民并焚毁房屋。具体死难人数各说不一，通行说法为三千人左右，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。 On 16 September 1932 Japanese garrison troops at Fushun, claiming retaliation for an attack by anti-Japanese volunteers, surrounded the village of Pingdingshan, massacred residents and burned the houses. Accounts of the death toll differ; the conventional figure is about 3,000 and awaits page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1932年10月15日，日军骑兵第1旅团三面包围通化，上午入城。
summary.en: On 15 October 1932 the Japanese 1st Cavalry Brigade converged on Tonghua from three sides and entered the city that morning.

fields.name: 通化沦陷 Fall of Tonghua
fields.place: 辽宁通化 Tonghua (modern Tonghua, Jilin), Liaoning
fields.summary: 1932年10月15日，日军骑兵第1旅团三面包围通化，上午入城。 On 15 October 1932 the Japanese 1st Cavalry Brigade converged on Tonghua from three sides and entered the city that morning.
fields.description: 通化是辽宁民众自卫军总司令部和辽宁省政府所在地，为东北沦陷最晚的城市之一。1932年10月中旬，日军调集3万余兵力分三路进攻。15日晨，日军骑兵第1旅团从北、西北、东北三面包围通化，唐聚五已率总部撤离，日军于上午未战入城。日期据《历史上的今天 10月15日》与《抗日战争时期辽宁省政府在通成立始末》。 Tonghua was the headquarters of the Liaoning People’s Self-Defence Army and of the Liaoning provincial government, and one of the last cities in the Northeast to fall. In mid-October 1932 the Japanese committed over 30,000 troops in three columns. On the morning of the 15th the 1st Cavalry Brigade closed on Tonghua from the north, north-west and north-east; Tang Juwu had already withdrawn and the Japanese entered unopposed.

summary.zh: 1932年11月30日，日军混成第14旅团、骑兵第1旅团攻占扎兰屯。
summary.en: On 30 November 1932 the Japanese 14th Mixed Brigade and 1st Cavalry Brigade took Zhalantun.

fields.name: 扎兰屯失守 Fall of Zhalantun
fields.place: 黑龙江扎兰屯 Zhalantun, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1932年11月30日，日军混成第14旅团、骑兵第1旅团攻占扎兰屯。 On 30 November 1932 the Japanese 14th Mixed Brigade and 1st Cavalry Brigade took Zhalantun.
fields.description: 1932年11月28日，日军第14师团以4个旅团、3个飞行中队及伪黑龙江省警备军大部进攻苏炳文部。30日午后，服部兵次郎混成第14旅团、骑兵第1旅团自甘南迂回至扎兰屯近郊，在装甲车、坦克掩护下猛攻东山高地；救国军警卫营伤亡100余人，当日下午扎兰屯失守。日期据《“海满抗战”及扎兰屯的沦陷》与《中华民族抗日编年（1932年12月）》。 On 28 November 1932 the Japanese 14th Division attacked Su Bingwen’s forces with four brigades, three air squadrons and most of the puppet Heilongjiang army. At midday on the 30th Hattori’s 14th Mixed Brigade and the 1st Cavalry Brigade swung through Gannan to the outskirts of Zhalantun and stormed East Hill under armour; the guard battalion lost over 100 men and the town fell that afternoon.

summary.zh: 1932年12月2日，日军占领牙克石。
summary.en: On 2 December 1932 the Japanese occupied Yakeshi.

fields.name: 牙克石失守 Fall of Yakeshi
fields.place: 黑龙江牙克石 Yakeshi, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1932年12月2日，日军占领牙克石。 On 2 December 1932 the Japanese occupied Yakeshi.
fields.description: 1932年11月30日扎兰屯失守后，苏炳文部沿中东铁路向兴安岭以西撤退。12月2日，日军占领牙克石，继续以装甲列车为先导向海拉尔、满洲里追击。日期据《“海满抗战”及扎兰屯的沦陷》与《民国21年（公元1932年）》。 After Zhalantun fell on 30 November 1932, Su Bingwen’s forces withdrew west of the Greater Khingan along the Chinese Eastern Railway. On 2 December the Japanese took Yakeshi and continued the pursuit toward Hailar and Manzhouli with armoured trains in the lead.

summary.en: On 3 December 1932 the Japanese occupied Bukettu.

fields.name: 博克图失守 Fall of Bukettu
fields.place: 黑龙江博克图 Bukettu, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1932年12月3日，日军占领博克图。 On 3 December 1932 the Japanese occupied Bukettu.
fields.description: 1932年12月3日，日军占领博克图。苏炳文部后卫曾在博克图至兴安岭铁路隧道东口以载石货车溜放阻敌，日军装甲列车通过兴安岭隧道后继续向海拉尔追击。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1932年12月）》与《“海满抗战”及扎兰屯的沦陷》。 On 3 December 1932 the Japanese occupied Bukettu. Su Bingwen’s rearguard had tried to block the armoured train at the eastern portal of the Bukettu–Khingan tunnel by rolling loaded stone wagons down the grade; the Japanese cleared the tunnel and continued toward Hailar.

summary.zh: 1932年12月5日16时，日军混成第14旅团进入海拉尔。
summary.en: At 4 p.m. on 5 December 1932 the Japanese 14th Mixed Brigade entered Hailar.

fields.name: 海拉尔失守 Fall of Hailar
fields.place: 黑龙江海拉尔 Hailar, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1932年12月5日16时，日军混成第14旅团进入海拉尔。 At 4 p.m. on 5 December 1932 the Japanese 14th Mixed Brigade entered Hailar.
fields.description: 1932年12月4日夜，苏炳文、马占山率部乘火车离开海拉尔，5日晨抵满洲里以西中苏国境，交械后退入苏联。5日16时，日军混成第14旅团进入未遭抵抗的海拉尔，并继续向满洲里追击。日期据《“海满抗战”及扎兰屯的沦陷》与《中华民族抗日编年（1932年12月）》。 On the night of 4 December 1932 Su Bingwen and Ma Zhanshan left Hailar by train and on the morning of the 5th reached the Sino-Soviet border west of Manzhouli, where they surrendered their arms and entered the Soviet Union. At 4 p.m. on the 5th the Japanese 14th Mixed Brigade entered undefended Hailar and continued toward Manzhouli.

fields.place: 黑龙江满洲里 Manzhouli, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1932年12月6日凌晨2时，日军宫本先遣队占领满洲里。 At 2 a.m. on 6 December 1932 the Japanese Miyamoto advance force occupied Manzhouli.
fields.description: 1932年12月6日凌晨2时，日军第14师团宫本先遣队占领满洲里。至此，呼伦贝尔全境被日军侵占，黑龙江省全境沦陷。日期据《“海满抗战”及扎兰屯的沦陷》与《中华民族抗日编年（1932年12月）》。 At 2 a.m. on 6 December 1932 the Miyamoto advance force of the Japanese 14th Division occupied Manzhouli. With this the whole of Hulunbuir and all of Heilongjiang passed under Japanese occupation.

summary.zh: 1932年12月16日，日军侵占岫岩县城。
summary.en: On 16 December 1932 the Japanese occupied Xiuyan.

fields.name: 岫岩沦陷 Fall of Xiuyan
fields.summary: 1932年12月16日，日军侵占岫岩县城。 On 16 December 1932 the Japanese occupied Xiuyan.
fields.description: 1932年12月中旬，日军以第2师团主力和守备队及伪军组成岫岩、庄河两个讨伐队，进攻辽南三角抗区。12月15日刘景文部义勇军在岫岩大偏岭阻击，16日上午11时日军进入岫岩县城。日期据《东北抗日义勇军大事记》与《东北沦陷时期丹东大事记》。 In mid-December 1932 the Japanese formed two punitive columns from the 2nd Division, guard units and puppet troops against the southern Liaoning triangle. On 15 December Liu Jingwen’s guerrillas fought a delaying action at Dapianling; at 11 a.m. on the 16th the Japanese entered Xiuyan.

place.zh: 河北山海关（今属秦皇岛）

summary.zh: 日军进攻山海关，东北军何柱国部抵抗，榆关三日失守，长城抗战序幕拉开。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shanhaiguan; He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army troops resisted for three days before the pass fell, opening the Great Wall campaign.

fields.name: 榆关抗战 Defense of Shanhaiguan 山海关抗战 Battle of Shanhaiguan
fields.place: 河北山海关（今属秦皇岛） Shanhaiguan, Hebei (now Qinhuangdao)
fields.summary: 日军进攻山海关，东北军何柱国部抵抗，榆关三日失守，长城抗战序幕拉开。 Japanese forces attacked Shanhaiguan; He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army troops resisted for three days before the pass fell, opening the Great Wall campaign.
fields.description: 1933 年 1 月 1 日，日军以炮火进攻山海关，东北军第九旅何柱国部奋起抵抗。守军兵力单薄、后援不继，1 月 3 日榆关失守。此役是九一八事变后中国军队在华北的首次有组织抵抗，也被视为长城抗战的序幕。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 1 January 1933 Japanese artillery opened the attack on Shanhaiguan, and He Zhuguo’s 9th Brigade of the Northeast Army resisted. With insufficient troops and no reinforcements, the pass fell on 3 January. It was the first organized Chinese resistance in North China after the Mukden Incident and is regarded as the opening of the Great Wall campaign. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 绥芬河沦陷 Fall of Suifenhe
fields.summary: 1933年1月5日，日军竹本支队侵驻绥芬河，驻军2000余人被缴械。 On 5 January 1933 the Japanese Takeuchi detachment entered Suifenhe and disarmed the 2,000-strong Chinese garrison.
fields.description: 1933年1月初，日军广濑第10师团自牡丹江東进。1月5日，竹本支队2000余人侵驻绥芬河；驻绥芬河的吉林自卫军第21旅旅长关庆禄、市长赵凌霄等6人已先至穆棱向日军投降，所部2000余名官兵在车站北广场被集体缴械，后押至呼兰遣散。日期据《伪大同2年-伪康德12年》与《1933年（民国22年）》。 In early January 1933 the Japanese 10th Division under Hirose advanced east from Mudanjiang. On 5 January the Takeuchi detachment of over 2,000 men entered Suifenhe; brigade commander Guan Qinglu and mayor Zhao Lingxiao had already surrendered at Muling, and the 2,000-strong garrison was disarmed in the square north of the station and later deported to Hulan.

fields.name: 绥阳沦陷 Fall of Suiyang
fields.summary: 1933年1月5日，日军进占小绥芬（今绥阳）。 On 5 January 1933 the Japanese occupied Xiaosuifen (modern Suiyang).
fields.description: 1933年1月5日，日本军进占小绥芬（今绥阳镇）、绥芬河，并由绥芬河守备队派出40人驻小绥芬。绥阳时为东宁县辖镇，与绥芬河同处中东铁路东段，失守后日军控制绥芬河谷。日期据《伪大同2年-伪康德12年》与《1933年（民国22年）》。 On 5 January 1933 the Japanese occupied Xiaosuifen (modern Suiyang) and Suifenhe, stationing 40 men from the Suifenhe garrison at Xiaosuifen. Suiyang was then a town of Dongning County on the eastern section of the Chinese Eastern Railway; its fall gave Japan control of the Suifen valley.

fields.name: 梨树镇、鸡西街沦陷 Fall of Lishuzhen and Jixi
fields.place: 吉林梨树镇、鸡西街 Lishuzhen and Jixi, Jilin
fields.summary: 1933年1月5日，日军侵占梨树镇、鸡西街。 On 5 January 1933 the Japanese occupied Lishuzhen and Jixi.
fields.description: 1933年1月5日，日本侵略军侵占梨树镇、鸡西街，次日侵占密山县城。梨树镇为穆棱煤矿和密山抗日活动的中心，失守后日军于4月在梨树镇建立宪兵分遣队，镇压抗日志士。日期据《1932—1933》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 On 5 January 1933 the Japanese occupied Lishuzhen and Jixi and the next day took Mishan. Lishuzhen was the centre of the Muling coal mines and of anti-Japanese activity in Mishan; after its fall the Japanese set up a gendarmerie detachment there in April to suppress resistance.

summary.zh: 1933年1月6日夜，日军侵占密山县城。

fields.name: 密山沦陷 Fall of Mishan
fields.summary: 1933年1月6日夜，日军侵占密山县城。 On the night of 6 January 1933 the Japanese occupied Mishan.
fields.description: 1933年1月5日日军侵占梨树镇、鸡西街后，6日夜侵占密山县城。李杜率吉林自卫军余部向虎林方向转移，9日自虎林附近渡乌苏里江退入苏联境内。日期据《1932—1933》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 After taking Lishuzhen and Jixi on 5 January 1933, the Japanese occupied Mishan on the night of the 6th. Li Du led the remnants of the Jilin Self-Defence Army toward Hulin and on the 9th crossed the Ussuri into Soviet territory.

summary.en: On 9 January 1933 the Japanese force under Iizuka Chōgo occupied Baoqing.

fields.name: 宝清沦陷 Fall of Baoqing
fields.summary: 1933年1月9日，日军饭冢朝吾部侵占宝清。 On 9 January 1933 the Japanese force under Iizuka Chōgo occupied Baoqing.
fields.description: 1933年1月4日，日军第10师团饭冢朝吾大佐率第63联队及伪军一个团自佳木斯出发，经集贤、兴隆、三道岗，8日占星河镇，9日进入宝清街。另一路驻富锦日军小滨支队自富锦出发，8日抵宝清东部义顺号，向西南包抄。丁超在退路被断后率军官23人投降。日期据《第二节 东北沦陷时期战事》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 On 4 January 1933 Colonel Iizuka Chōgo of the Japanese 10th Division led the 63rd Regiment and a puppet regiment from Jiamusi through Jixian, Xinglong and Sandaogang, taking Xinghe on the 8th and entering Baoqing on the 9th. A second column, the Kobama detachment from Fujin, reached Yishunhao east of Baoqing on the 8th and closed from the south-west. With his retreat cut, Ding Chao surrendered with 23 officers.

name.en: Li Du’s forces withdraw into the Soviet Union

summary.zh: 1933年1月9日，吉林自卫军总司令李杜等率3000余人自虎林附近退入苏联；13日王德林部亦退入苏境。
summary.en: On 9 January 1933 Li Du and other Jilin Self-Defence Army commanders crossed into the Soviet Union near Hulin with some 3,000 men; Wang Delin’s force followed on the 13th.

fields.name: 李杜等部退入苏联 Li Du’s forces withdraw into the Soviet Union
fields.summary: 1933年1月9日，吉林自卫军总司令李杜等率3000余人自虎林附近退入苏联；13日王德林部亦退入苏境。 On 9 January 1933 Li Du and other Jilin Self-Defence Army commanders crossed into the Soviet Union near Hulin with some 3,000 men; Wang Delin’s force followed on the 13th.
fields.description: 1932 年底，日军集中兵力围攻吉东抗日各部。1933 年 1 月 5 日绥芬河失守，6 日密山失守，吉林自卫军总司令李杜率部撤至密山一带。1 月 9 日，李杜、邢占清、杨耀钧等率 3000 余人（一说 2000 余人）自虎林附近渡乌苏里江退入苏联境内；1 月 13 日，救国军总司令王德林、副总指挥孔宪荣率 600 余人及伤员、眷属自东宁退入苏境，14 日东宁失守。此后吉林自卫军、救国军余部或留在吉东坚持，或转入中共领导的抗日游击队，李延禄部补充团则于 1 月 4 日在穆棱五河林改编为抗日游击总队，后发展为抗联第四军。本事件为撤退事件，不绘路线（路线涉及越境，且为分散突围，不宜连线）。 At the end of 1932 the Japanese concentrated their forces against the anti-Japanese armies of eastern Jilin. Suifenhe fell on 5 January 1933 and Mishan on the 6th, and Li Du, commander of the Jilin Self-Defence Army, fell back toward Mishan. On 9 January Li Du, Xing Zhanqing and Yang Yaojun crossed the Ussuri near Hulin into Soviet territory with some 3,000 men (another account says over 2,000); on the 13th Wang Delin and Kong Xianrong of the National Salvation Army crossed from Dongning with over 600 men, the wounded and their families, and Dongning fell on the 14th. The remnants either stayed in eastern Jilin or joined the Communist-led guerrillas; Li Yanlu’s supplementary regiment had already been reorganised at Wuhelin in Muling on 4 January as a guerrilla group that became the 4th Route Army. This was a withdrawal and no route is drawn, since it involved crossing a frontier in dispersed parties.

fields.name: 东宁沦陷 Fall of Dongning
fields.summary: 1933年1月10日，日军石田荣雄大队侵占东宁县城三岔口。 On 10 January 1933 Major Ishida Eiyū’s battalion occupied Dongning’s county seat, Sanchakou.
fields.description: 1933年1月10日，日军一个大队在石田荣雄少佐率领下侵占东宁县城三岔口，王德林率救国军司令部人员撤入苏联境内。日军进城后驻扎县城西北角老爷庙、农会和西山炮台，并陆续在老黑山、南村、万宝湾设置守备队。日期据《伪大同2年-伪康德12年》与《建党百年丨红色牡丹江》。 On 10 January 1933 a Japanese battalion under Major Ishida Eiyū occupied Sanchakou, the seat of Dongning County, and Wang Delin withdrew the National Salvation Army headquarters into Soviet territory. The Japanese garrisoned the Laoyemiao, the farmers’ association and the West Hill fort, and later set up posts at Laoheishan, Nancun and Wanbaowan.

name.en: Declaration of the three conditions for joint resistance

summary.zh: 1933 年 1 月 17 日，中华苏维埃临时中央政府与工农红军革命军事委员会发表宣言，提出愿在三条件下与任何武装部队共同抗日。
summary.en: On 17 January 1933 the Chinese Soviet government and the Red Army Revolutionary Military Commission offered to conclude anti-Japanese pacts with any armed force under three conditions.

fields.name: 共同抗日三条件宣言 Declaration of the three conditions for joint resistance
fields.summary: 1933 年 1 月 17 日，中华苏维埃临时中央政府与工农红军革命军事委员会发表宣言，提出愿在三条件下与任何武装部队共同抗日。 On 17 January 1933 the Chinese Soviet government and the Red Army Revolutionary Military Commission offered to conclude anti-Japanese pacts with any armed force under three conditions.
fields.description: 1933 年 1 月 17 日，中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府主席毛泽东、副主席项英、张国焘和工农红军革命军事委员会主席朱德联名发表《为反对日本帝国主义侵入华北愿在三条件下与全国各军队共同抗日宣言》。三条件是：立即停止进攻苏维埃区域；立即保证民众的集会、结社、言论、罢工、出版等民主权利；立即武装民众、创立武装的义勇军。宣言表示中国工农红军准备在此基础上与任何武装部队订立停战协定、共同抗日。文件由中共驻共产国际代表团起草，以苏维埃政府和红军军委名义发表；1 月 28 日《红色中华》第 48 期刊载。这是中共较早公开提出「停止内战、一致抗日」的具体条件。本事件为政策文件，不绘路线。 On 17 January 1933 Mao Zedong, Xiang Ying and Zhang Guotao of the Chinese Soviet provisional government and Zhu De of the Red Army Revolutionary Military Commission issued a declaration offering to conclude truces with any armed force willing to fight Japan under three conditions: an immediate halt to attacks on Soviet areas; immediate guarantees of assembly, association, speech, strike and press freedoms; and immediate arming of the people to form volunteer forces. The text was drafted by the CCP delegation to the Comintern and published in Red China no. 48 on 28 January. It was an early public formulation of “stop the civil war, resist Japan together”. No route is drawn.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1933年1月26日，中共驻共产国际代表团以中共中央名义发出指示信，要求东北实行反日民族统一战线，联合义勇军、山林队等一切抗日力量。
summary.en: On 26 January 1933 the CCP delegation to the Comintern issued a directive in the Party’s name calling for an anti-Japanese national united front in Manchuria and alliance with all resistance forces.

fields.name: 《一·二六指示信》 The 26 January 1933 directive
fields.summary: 1933年1月26日，中共驻共产国际代表团以中共中央名义发出指示信，要求东北实行反日民族统一战线，联合义勇军、山林队等一切抗日力量。 On 26 January 1933 the CCP delegation to the Comintern issued a directive in the Party’s name calling for an anti-Japanese national united front in Manchuria and alliance with all resistance forces.
fields.description: 九一八事变后一年多，中共在东北沿用的是「北方会议」路线：建立苏区、分配土地、对义勇军与山林队采取关门政策，结果党领导的游击队只有数百人，与号称 30 万的义勇军互不往来。1933 年 1 月 26 日，中共驻共产国际代表团以中共中央名义发出《中央给满洲各级党部及全体党员的信——论满洲的状况和我们党的任务》（通称《一·二六指示信》），提出「尽可能的造成全民族的（计算到特殊的环境）反帝统一战线，来聚集和联合一切可能的、虽然是不可靠的动摇的力量，共同的与共同敌人日本帝国主义及其走狗斗争」。指示信在继续强调下层统一战线之外，首次提出「在某种程度和范围内，或能实行上层的统一战线」「与民族资产阶级的某一部分实行统一战线」。1933 年 5 月 15 日，中共满洲省委扩大会议作出接受指示信的决议，提出「联合一切反日力量」，并建立抗日联合军指挥部。这是东北抗战政策的转折点：此后才有东北人民革命军的建立（1933-09 起）与 1936 年的东北抗日联军统一建制。本事件为政策文件，日期取文件发出日；指示信由莫斯科发出、经满洲省委传达。本事件不绘路线。 For more than a year after the Mukden Incident the Communist Party in Manchuria followed the “Northern Conference” line — Soviet areas, land redistribution and a closed-door policy toward the volunteer armies and forest bands — with the result that the Party’s guerrillas numbered a few hundred while the 300,000-strong volunteers stood apart. On 26 January 1933 the CCP delegation to the Comintern issued, in the Party’s name, the letter “On the Situation in Manchuria and Our Party’s Tasks” (the 26 January directive), calling for “the widest possible national anti-imperialist united front … to unite every possible force, even unreliable and wavering ones, against the common enemy, Japanese imperialism and its running dogs.” Beyond the lower-level united front it now allowed “an upper-level united front to some extent and within limits” and “a united front with a section of the national bourgeoisie”. On 15 May 1933 the Manchurian Provincial Committee resolved to accept the directive, to “unite all anti-Japanese forces” and to set up a joint anti-Japanese military command. This was the turning point: the People’s Revolutionary Army followed from September 1933, and the United Army’s unification from 1936. The entry is dated by the letter’s issue; it was sent from Moscow and transmitted by the provincial committee. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 日军进攻热河 Japanese Invasion of Rehe
fields.place: 热河朝阳（今属辽宁） Chaoyang, Rehe (now Liaoning)
fields.summary: 日军分路进攻热河，中国守军节节败退，承德于三月失守。 Japanese forces attacked Rehe along several axes; Chinese defenders fell back and Chengde was lost in March.
fields.description: 1933 年 2 月 21 日，关东军与伪军分路向热河进攻，中国守军指挥不一、士气低落，防线迅速崩溃。3 月 4 日日军占领承德，热河全省沦陷，东北全部落入日本控制，日军兵锋直指长城各口。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 21 February 1933 the Kwantung Army and puppet troops attacked Rehe along several axes. Chinese defenders, poorly coordinated and demoralized, collapsed quickly. Chengde fell on 4 March, the whole province was occupied, and the Japanese advance reached the Great Wall passes. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 北票沦陷 Fall of Beipiao
fields.summary: 1933年2月23日，日军第8师团先遣队占领北票、南岭。 On 23 February 1933 the advance force of the Japanese 8th Division took Beipiao and Nanling.
fields.description: 1933年2月21日，日军第8师团先遣队乘火车自锦州至朝阳寺，22日在飞机、铁甲车配合下猛攻南岭，遭守军董福亭旅和义勇军耿继周部抵抗。23日，董旅第58团团长邵本良在前线投敌，北票、南岭相继失守，早川支队占领北票。日期据《热河沦陷 热河抗战》与《日军侵占热河南部朝阳》。 On 21 February 1933 the advance force of the Japanese 8th Division moved by rail from Jinzhou to Chaoyangsi and on the 22nd attacked Nanling with aircraft and armoured trains, meeting resistance from Dong Futing’s brigade and Geng Jizhou’s volunteers. On the 23rd the 58th Regiment commander Shao Benliang defected at the front, Beipiao and Nanling fell in succession, and the Hayakawa detachment occupied Beipiao.

fields.name: 开鲁沦陷 Fall of Kailu
fields.summary: 1933年2月23日，日军第6师团与伪军张海鹏部攻占开鲁。 On 23 February 1933 the Japanese 6th Division and Zhang Haipeng’s puppet troops took Kailu.
fields.description: 1933年2月21日，日军第6师团主力及第11旅团一部配以蒙族骑兵500余人，向热北重镇开鲁进攻。守军热河省军骑兵第17旅崔兴五部不战，22日日军以飞机10余架轮番轰炸，义勇军刘振东、李海青等部苦战后退往赤峰。23日伪军张海鹏部伙同日军进攻，崔兴五率全旅逃往林东，开鲁陷落。开鲁沦陷日期另有2月24日之说，见研究笔记。 On 21 February 1933 the main force of the Japanese 6th Division and part of the 11th Brigade with over 500 Mongol cavalry attacked Kailu, the key town of northern Rehe. Cui Xingwu’s 17th Cavalry Brigade of the Rehe provincial army offered no resistance; on the 22nd Japanese aircraft bombed the town repeatedly, and Liu Zhendong’s and Li Haiqing’s volunteers fell back toward Chifeng after hard fighting. On the 23rd Zhang Haipeng’s puppet troops joined the attack, Cui Xingwu fled with his brigade to Lindong, and Kailu fell. Some sources give 24 February.

name.zh: 国联大会通过李顿报告书
name.en: The League Assembly Adopts the Lytton Report

summary.zh: 国联大会通过李顿报告书，承认中国对东北的主权、不承认伪满洲国；日本随后退出国联。
summary.en: The League Assembly adopted the Lytton Report, recognizing Chinese sovereignty over the Northeast and denying Manchukuo; Japan then withdrew from the League.

fields.name: 国联大会通过李顿报告书 The League Assembly Adopts the Lytton Report
fields.summary: 国联大会通过李顿报告书，承认中国对东北的主权、不承认伪满洲国；日本随后退出国联。 The League Assembly adopted the Lytton Report, recognizing Chinese sovereignty over the Northeast and denying Manchukuo; Japan then withdrew from the League.
fields.description: 1933 年 2 月 24 日，国际联盟大会以压倒多数通过李顿报告书，承认东北是中国领土、不承认伪满洲国的合法性，要求日军撤出。日本投下唯一反对票，代表当场退场，并于 3 月 27 日正式退出国联；随后日军进攻热河，扩大侵华战争。 决议出自国联大会，中国政府是申诉方和受益方，但不是决议的制定者；国联也没有能力强制日本执行。 国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 24 February 1933 the League of Nations Assembly adopted the Lytton Report by an overwhelming majority, recognizing Chinese sovereignty over the Northeast, denying the legality of Manchukuo, and calling for the withdrawal of Japanese troops. Japan cast the sole opposing vote; its delegate left the hall, and Japan formally withdrew from the League on 27 March. Japanese forces then attacked Rehe (Jehol), widening the war. The resolution came from the League Assembly; the Chinese government was the complainant and beneficiary, not the author, and the League had no means to enforce it. An international event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1933年2月25日，日军第8师团进占朝阳。
summary.en: On 25 February 1933 the Japanese 8th Division entered Chaoyang.

fields.name: 朝阳沦陷 Fall of Chaoyang
fields.summary: 1933年2月25日，日军第8师团进占朝阳。 On 25 February 1933 the Japanese 8th Division entered Chaoyang.
fields.description: 1933年2月24日傍晚，日军第8师团先遣队会同步兵第16旅团主力到达朝阳以东及以北地区。当夜朝阳城内守军大部分撤走，董福亭旅又有一个营叛变引敌深入。25日拂晓日军进攻朝阳，未遇抵抗，中午进占朝阳城，第8师团主力随后集结。日期据《中国人民抗日战争——热河》与《日军侵占热河南部朝阳》。 On the evening of 24 February 1933 the advance force of the Japanese 8th Division with the main body of the 16th Infantry Brigade reached the approaches to Chaoyang. That night most of the garrison withdrew and another battalion of Dong Futing’s brigade defected, guiding the Japanese in. At dawn on the 25th the Japanese attacked, met no resistance and entered Chaoyang at noon; the main body of the 8th Division then concentrated there.

summary.zh: 1933年2月27日，下洼镇沦陷，热东防线崩溃。
summary.en: On 27 February 1933 Xiawa fell and the eastern Rehe defence line collapsed.

fields.name: 下洼镇沦陷 Fall of Xiawa
fields.summary: 1933年2月27日，下洼镇沦陷，热东防线崩溃。 On 27 February 1933 Xiawa fell and the eastern Rehe defence line collapsed.
fields.description: 1933年2月27日，下洼镇沦陷，日军进抵老哈河畔，热东防线崩溃。孙殿英率第107旅一部驰援赤峰。日军第6师团占开鲁后分兵两路，一路沿西拉木伦河、老哈河经白音套海直攻赤峰，一路经大沁他拉、下洼、新惠攻建平镇。日期据《中国人民抗日战争——热河》与《热河战役》。 On 27 February 1933 Xiawa fell and the Japanese reached the Laoha River, collapsing the eastern Rehe defence line; Sun Dianying rushed part of the 107th Brigade to Chifeng. After taking Kailu the Japanese 6th Division split, one column moving along the Xar Moron and Laoha rivers via Baiyintaohai toward Chifeng and the other through Daqintala, Xiawa and Xinhui toward Jianping.

summary.zh: 1933年2月28日，日军混成第14旅团侵占凌南（今建昌）。
summary.en: On 28 February 1933 the Japanese 14th Mixed Brigade occupied Lingnan (modern Jianchang).

fields.name: 凌南沦陷 Fall of Lingnan
fields.place: 热河凌南 Lingnan (modern Jianchang), Rehe
fields.summary: 1933年2月28日，日军混成第14旅团侵占凌南（今建昌）。 On 28 February 1933 the Japanese 14th Mixed Brigade occupied Lingnan (modern Jianchang).
fields.description: 1933年2月27日，日军混成第14旅团在绥中白石嘴边门集结，当日侵占凌南（今建昌），28日攻击沙帽山后向凌源乘车前进。凌南失守使日军打开由绥中进入热河南部的通道。日期另有2月27日之说，见研究笔记。 On 27 February 1933 the Japanese 14th Mixed Brigade concentrated at Baishizui Bianmen in Suizhong and occupied Lingnan (modern Jianchang) that day; on the 28th it attacked Shaomaoshan and moved by truck toward Lingyuan. The fall of Lingnan opened the route from Suizhong into southern Rehe. Some sources give 27 February.

summary.zh: 1933年3月1日，日军第8师团主力猛攻叶柏寿，守军于兆麟旅苦战后撤退。
summary.en: On 1 March 1933 the main force of the Japanese 8th Division stormed Yebaishou; Yu Zhaolin’s brigade withdrew after hard fighting.

fields.name: 叶柏寿失守 Fall of Yebaishou
fields.summary: 1933年3月1日，日军第8师团主力猛攻叶柏寿，守军于兆麟旅苦战后撤退。 On 1 March 1933 the main force of the Japanese 8th Division stormed Yebaishou; Yu Zhaolin’s brigade withdrew after hard fighting.
fields.description: 1933年3月1日，日军第8师团主力约5000余人，在飞机9架、坦克30余辆配合下进攻叶柏寿，守军黑龙江省军于兆麟旅顽强抵抗，激战六七小时，第688团第1连连长以下全部阵亡。日军攻击不下，主力绕道直取凌源。日期据《中国人民抗日战争——热河》与《日军侵占热河南部朝阳》。 On 1 March 1933 the main force of the Japanese 8th Division, over 5,000 strong with nine aircraft and more than thirty tanks, attacked Yebaishou. Yu Zhaolin’s Heilongjiang brigade resisted stubbornly for six or seven hours; the 1st Company of the 688th Regiment was wiped out. Unable to break through, the Japanese main body bypassed Yebaishou and drove on Lingyuan.

summary.zh: 1933年3月2日下午5时许，日军攻入赤峰，守军巷战后退出。
summary.en: At about 5 p.m. on 2 March 1933 the Japanese broke into Chifeng; the defenders withdrew after street fighting.

fields.name: 赤峰沦陷 Fall of Chifeng
fields.summary: 1933年3月2日下午5时许，日军攻入赤峰，守军巷战后退出。 At about 5 p.m. on 2 March 1933 the Japanese broke into Chifeng; the defenders withdrew after street fighting.
fields.description: 1933年2月28日，日军进逼赤峰东郊山水坡，孙殿英部第41军与日军交战。3月1日日军以飞机、重炮轰击城区，孙殿英部在红庙子、山水坡顽强抵抗。2日凌晨日军增援，中午攻抵城下，下午攻破头道街，守军展开巷战。下午5时许日军攻入城内，赤峰沦陷。日期据《热河沦陷 热河抗战》与《中国人民抗日战争——热河》。 On 28 February 1933 the Japanese closed on Shanshuipo east of Chifeng and engaged Sun Dianying’s 41st Army. On 1 March aircraft and heavy artillery bombarded the city while Sun’s troops held Hongmiaozi and Shanshuipo. Reinforcements arrived before dawn on the 2nd, the Japanese reached the walls at noon and broke into the First Street district in the afternoon; street fighting followed and the city fell at about 5 p.m.

summary.zh: 1933年3月2日上午，日军攻占凌源。
summary.en: On the morning of 2 March 1933 the Japanese captured Lingyuan.

fields.name: 凌源沦陷 Fall of Lingyuan
fields.summary: 1933年3月2日上午，日军攻占凌源。 On the morning of 2 March 1933 the Japanese captured Lingyuan.
fields.description: 1933年3月2日，日军第8师团川原挺进队到达凌源东侧，与自绥中方向前来的混成第14旅团米山先遣队会合，一同攻击。东北军丁喜春、缪澄流、孙德荃等旅纷纷后退，上午凌源失守，日军主力继续向平泉攻击。义勇军郭景珊部在牛河梁与日军混战一夜，毙伤日伪军百余名后退出。日期据《热河沦陷 热河抗战》与《日军侵占热河南部朝阳》。 On 2 March 1933 the Kawara drive force of the Japanese 8th Division reached the eastern approaches to Lingyuan and joined the Yoneyama advance force of the 14th Mixed Brigade coming from Suizhong. The Northeastern Army brigades of Ding Xichun, Miao Chengliu and Sun Dechen fell back, Lingyuan fell in the morning and the Japanese main body drove on Pingquan. Guo Jingshan’s volunteers fought all night at Niuheliang, killing or wounding over a hundred Japanese and puppet troops before withdrawing.

summary.zh: 1933年3月3日，日军占领平泉。
summary.en: On 3 March 1933 the Japanese occupied Pingquan.

fields.name: 平泉沦陷 Fall of Pingquan
fields.summary: 1933年3月3日，日军占领平泉。 On 3 March 1933 the Japanese occupied Pingquan.
fields.description: 1933年3月3日，日军占领平泉，承德以东各地相继失守。平泉为朝阳、凌源至承德公路上的要地，失守后日军直逼热河省会承德。日期据《中国人民抗日战争——热河》与《热河战役》。 On 3 March 1933 the Japanese occupied Pingquan and the positions east of Chengde collapsed in succession. Pingquan was a key point on the Chaoyang–Lingyuan–Chengde road, and its fall brought the Japanese to the approaches of the provincial capital.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军占领承德，热河全省沦陷，东北四省全部被日本控制。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Chengde and the whole of Rehe, completing the occupation of the four northeastern provinces.

fields.name: 承德失守 Fall of Chengde
fields.summary: 日军占领承德，热河全省沦陷，东北四省全部被日本控制。 Japanese forces occupied Chengde and the whole of Rehe, completing the occupation of the four northeastern provinces.
fields.description: 1933 年 3 月 4 日，日军先头部队进入承德，热河省主席汤玉麟此前已弃城逃走。热河沦陷后，东北四省全部被日本控制，日军与中国军队在长城一线形成对峙。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 4 March 1933 Japanese advance units entered Chengde after provincial chairman Tang Yulin had fled. With Rehe lost, all four northeastern provinces were under Japanese control, and Japanese and Chinese forces faced each other along the Great Wall. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 第29军、第17军、第32军及东北军等部在喜峰口、罗文峪、古北口、冷口等关口抗击日军，最终以《塘沽协定》收场。
summary.en: The 29th, 17th, and 32nd Armies and Northeast Army units fought the Japanese at Xifengkou, Luowenyu, Gubeikou, and Lengkou until the Tanggu Truce ended the campaign.

fields.name: 长城抗战 Defense of the Great Wall
fields.summary: 第29军、第17军、第32军及东北军等部在喜峰口、罗文峪、古北口、冷口等关口抗击日军，最终以《塘沽协定》收场。 The 29th, 17th, and 32nd Armies and Northeast Army units fought the Japanese at Xifengkou, Luowenyu, Gubeikou, and Lengkou until the Tanggu Truce ended the campaign.
fields.description: 1933 年 3 月至 5 月，中国军队依托长城各口抗击日军。主要参战部队： - 喜峰口、罗文峪：第29军（宋哲元），辖第37师（冯治安）、第38师（张自忠）、暂编第2师（刘汝明）； - 古北口、南天门：东北军第67军（王以哲）先守，中央军第17军（徐庭瑶）第2师（黄杰）、第25师（关麟征）、第83师（刘戡）增援； - 冷口：第32军（商震）第139师等部； - 界岭口：东北军第53军（万福麟）等部。 由于装备与指挥劣势，中国军队最终后撤，5 月 31 日签订《塘沽协定》。 日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。 From March to May 1933 Chinese forces defended the Great Wall passes. Main units: - Xifengkou and Luowenyu: 29th Army (Song Zheyuan), with the 37th Division (Feng Zhi’an), 38th Division (Zhang Zizhong), and Provisional 2nd Division (Liu Ruming); - Gubeikou and Nantianmen: Northeast Army’s 67th Corps (Wang Yizhe) held first, reinforced by the Central Army’s 17th Army (Xu Tingyao) with the 2nd Division (Huang Jie), 25th Division (Guan Linzheng), and 83rd Division (Liu Kan); - Lengkou: 32nd Army (Shang Zhen), including the 139th Division; - Jielingkou: Northeast Army’s 53rd Corps (Wan Fulin) and others. Hampered by inferior equipment and coordination, the Chinese forces eventually withdrew, and the Tanggu Truce was signed on 31 May. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.
