atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1933年3月5日上午11时，日军先头部队占领滦平县城（喀喇河屯，今滦河镇）。
summary.en: At eleven in the morning on 5 March 1933 Japanese advance troops took the Luanping county town of Karahotun.

fields.name: 滦平失守 Fall of Luanping
fields.summary: 1933年3月5日上午11时，日军先头部队占领滦平县城（喀喇河屯，今滦河镇）。 At eleven in the morning on 5 March 1933 Japanese advance troops took the Luanping county town of Karahotun.
fields.description: 1933年3月4日日军占领承德后，即沿平热大道向古北口方向追击。3月5日上午11时，日军先头部队占领滦平县城喀喇河屯（今承德市双滦区滦河镇）。汤玉麟率省政府机关先退滦平、再退丰宁。中国军队在滦平青石梁、两间房、巴克什营一带构筑工事，3月5日起在青石梁阻击日军，打响古北口长城抗战第一枪，激战4天4夜，击落日军轰炸机4架，毙伤日军千余人。3月10日日军向古北口与金山岭一线发起进攻。日期取网信滦平、双滦事地方史与《热河沦陷与热河抗战》。 After taking Chengde on 4 March 1933 the Japanese pursued along the Beiping–Rehe road toward Gubeikou. At eleven in the morning on 5 March Japanese advance troops occupied the Luanping county town of Karahotun (modern Luanhe town, Shuangluan district, Chengde). Governor Tang Yulin withdrew first to Luanping and then to Fengning. Chinese troops built positions at Qingshiliang, Liangjianfang and Bakeshiying in Luanping and from 5 March fought a blocking action at Qingshiliang that opened the Gubeikou fighting on the Great Wall: four days and nights of combat, four Japanese bombers shot down and over a thousand Japanese killed or wounded. On 10 March the Japanese attacked the Gubeikou–Jinshanling line. The date follows the Luanping and Shuangluan local histories and The Fall of Rehe and the Rehe Resistance.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1933年3月6日，日军攻占林西，热北防线崩溃。
summary.en: On 6 March 1933 the Japanese took Linxi and the northern Rehe defence line collapsed.

fields.name: 林西失守 Fall of Linxi
fields.summary: 1933年3月6日，日军攻占林西，热北防线崩溃。 On 6 March 1933 the Japanese took Linxi and the northern Rehe defence line collapsed.
fields.description: 1933年3月2日，日军进攻林东，东北军崔兴五旅投降；6日日军攻占林西，中国守军热北防线全线崩溃。另有3月4日林西被侵占之说，见研究笔记。日期据《中国人民抗日战争——热河》，异说据《热河沦陷 热河抗战》。 On 2 March 1933 the Japanese attacked Lindong and Cui Xingwu’s Northeastern Army brigade surrendered; on the 6th the Japanese took Linxi and the northern Rehe defence line collapsed. Some sources give 4 March.

summary.zh: 1933年3月8日，日军侵占围场。
summary.en: On 8 March 1933 the Japanese occupied Weichang.

fields.name: 围场失守 Fall of Weichang
fields.summary: 1933年3月8日，日军侵占围场。 On 8 March 1933 the Japanese occupied Weichang.
fields.description: 1933年3月8日，日军侵占围场，同日青龙（包括宽城）亦被侵占。孙殿英部在赤峰二道河子一线抵抗至3月8日下午，防线被日军突破后向围场转移。另有3月10日攻占围场之说，见研究笔记。日期据《热河沦陷 热河抗战》，异说据《热河战役》。 On 8 March 1933 the Japanese occupied Weichang, and Qinglong (including Kuancheng) fell the same day. Sun Dianying’s troops held the Erdaohezi line near Chifeng until the afternoon of the 8th, when the line was broken and they fell back toward Weichang. Some sources give 10 March.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 第29军宋哲元部在喜峰口以大刀夜袭日军，取得长城抗战中著名胜利。
summary.en: Song Zheyuan’s 29th Army raided Japanese camps at Xifengkou with broadswords, winning one of the best-known victories of the Great Wall campaign.

fields.name: 第29军与喜峰口战斗 29th Army at Xifengkou
fields.summary: 第29军宋哲元部在喜峰口以大刀夜袭日军，取得长城抗战中著名胜利。 Song Zheyuan’s 29th Army raided Japanese camps at Xifengkou with broadswords, winning one of the best-known victories of the Great Wall campaign.
fields.description: 1933 年 3 月 9 日，日军进攻喜峰口，第29军（军长宋哲元）第37师（冯治安）、第38师（张自忠）驰援。11 日夜，第37师第109旅旅长赵登禹、佟泽光等率部攀山绕袭日军营地，以大刀近战重创敌军。喜峰口战斗打破了日军不可战胜的形象，也让第29军声名大振。 日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 9 March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Xifengkou, and the 29th Army under Song Zheyuan rushed its 37th Division (Feng Zhi’an) and 38th Division (Zhang Zizhong) to defend it. On the night of 11 March, Zhao Dengyu, commander of the 37th Division’s 109th Brigade, and Tong Zeguang led troops over the mountains to raid Japanese camps, inflicting heavy losses in close combat with broadswords. The battle shattered the image of Japanese invincibility and made the 29th Army famous. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 第32军与冷口战斗 32nd Army at Lengkou
fields.place: 河北迁安冷口 Lengkou, Qian’an, Hebei
fields.summary: 第32军商震部在冷口抗击日军，反复争夺后于 4 月失守。 Shang Zhen’s 32nd Army fought the Japanese at Lengkou and lost the pass in April after repeated see-saw battles.
fields.description: 1933 年 3 月，日军进攻冷口，第32军（军长商震）第139师等部依托关隘抗击，双方反复争夺。4 月中旬冷口失守，中国军队退守滦河以西。冷口与喜峰口、古北口同为长城抗战的主要方向。 日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。 In March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Lengkou, where the 32nd Army under Shang Zhen, including the 139th Division, held the pass in repeated see-saw fighting. Lengkou fell in mid-April and the Chinese forces withdrew west of the Luan River. Lengkou was one of the main sectors of the Great Wall campaign alongside Xifengkou and Gubeikou. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 东北军第67军与中央军第17军在古北口、南天门一线抗击日军，伤亡惨重。
summary.en: The Northeast Army’s 67th Corps and the Central Army’s 17th Army fought the Japanese at Gubeikou and Nantianmen at heavy cost.

fields.name: 第17军与古北口战斗 17th Army at Gubeikou
fields.summary: 东北军第67军与中央军第17军在古北口、南天门一线抗击日军，伤亡惨重。 The Northeast Army’s 67th Corps and the Central Army’s 17th Army fought the Japanese at Gubeikou and Nantianmen at heavy cost.
fields.description: 1933 年 3 月 10 日，日军进攻古北口，东北军第67军（王以哲）先守，中央军第17军（徐庭瑶）第25师（关麟征）、第2师（黄杰）、第83师（刘戡）等部陆续增援。双方在南天门一线反复争夺至 4 月下旬，中国军队伤亡惨重但仍迟滞了日军推进。古北口是长城抗战中战斗最激烈的方向之一。 日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 10 March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Gubeikou. The Northeast Army’s 67th Corps under Wang Yizhe held first, then the Central Army’s 17th Army under Xu Tingyao reinforced with the 25th Division (Guan Linzheng), 2nd Division (Huang Jie), and 83rd Division (Liu Kan). Fighting around Nantianmen continued into late April; Chinese casualties were heavy, but the defense delayed the Japanese advance. Gubeikou was one of the most bitterly contested sectors of the Great Wall campaign. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1933 年 3 月 16 日至 18 日，日军进攻罗文峪，第29军暂编第2师（刘汝明）依托关隘抗击，与喜峰口方向互为犄角。罗文峪战斗是长城抗战中第29军的另一处重要阵地。 日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。 From 16 to 18 March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Luowenyu, where the 29th Army’s Provisional 2nd Division under Liu Ruming held the pass and supported the Xifengkou sector. Luowenyu was another important position for the 29th Army in the Great Wall campaign. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 兴隆沦陷 Fall of Xinglong
fields.place: 热河兴隆（1933 年属河北，伪满划热河） Xinglong (Hebei in 1933, later attached to Rehe by Manchukuo)
fields.summary: 1933年4月21日，日军侵占兴隆县城，4月27日被萧之楚部克复。 On 21 April 1933 the Japanese occupied Xinglong; Xiao Zhichu's division retook it on 27 April.
fields.description: 兴隆县 1930 年 8 月由遵化县析置，属河北省；长城抗战期间为日军由承德南下、进出马兰峪与遵化通道上的要点。1933年4月21日，日军侵占兴隆县城。中国军队萧之楚部在兴隆以东的土城头、寿王坟、莺手营子一带与日军反复激战，4月27日克复兴隆县城，残敌百余人据县府顽抗，29日夜县府被焚。7月1日，伪满将兴隆划归热河省承德县，设伪兴隆办事处；1938年1月恢复伪兴隆县公署。日期取兴隆县人民政府《历史沿革》；《申报》1933年5月3日专电与郭廷以日志均记4月27日克复兴隆，可相印证；高思文《热河沦陷与热河抗战》记3月21日被占领，与4月27日克复说不能相合，异说并存。 Xinglong county was created in August 1930 out of Zunhua county and belonged to Hebei; during the Great Wall fighting it was a key point on the Japanese route south from Chengde toward Malanyu and Zunhua. On 21 April 1933 the Japanese occupied the county town. Xiao Zhichu's Chinese division fought repeated actions around Tuchengou, Shouwangfen and Yingshouyingzi east of Xinglong and retook the county town on 27 April; a hundred-odd Japanese held out in the county offices, which burned on the night of the 29th. On 1 July Manchukuo attached Xinglong to Chengde county in Rehe and set up a Xinglong office, and a puppet Xinglong county government was restored in January 1938. The date follows the Xinglong county government's official history; a Shenbao dispatch of 3 May 1933 and Guo Tingyi's chronological record both give the recapture on 27 April, which corroborates it. Gao Siwen's account gives 21 March for the occupation, which cannot be reconciled with the 27 April recapture, so both are recorded.

name.zh: 察哈尔民众抗日同盟军成立
name.en: Establishment of the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army

summary.zh: 冯玉祥（下野的西北军领袖）、吉鸿昌（原第22路军总指挥，中共秘密党员）、方振武等在张家口成立抗日同盟军，冯玉祥任总司令。
summary.en: Feng Yuxiang (retired Northwest Army leader), Ji Hongchang (former 22nd Route Army commander and secret CCP member), and Fang Zhenwu formed the Anti-Japanese Allied Army at Zhangjiakou, with Feng as commander-in-chief.

fields.name: 察哈尔民众抗日同盟军成立 Establishment of the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army
fields.place: 察哈尔张家口 Zhangjiakou, Chahar
fields.summary: 冯玉祥（下野的西北军领袖）、吉鸿昌（原第22路军总指挥，中共秘密党员）、方振武等在张家口成立抗日同盟军，冯玉祥任总司令。 Feng Yuxiang (retired Northwest Army leader), Ji Hongchang (former 22nd Route Army commander and secret CCP member), and Fang Zhenwu formed the Anti-Japanese Allied Army at Zhangjiakou, with Feng as commander-in-chief.
fields.description: 1933 年 5 月 26 日，冯玉祥、吉鸿昌、方振武等在张家口成立察哈尔民众抗日同盟军，号召武装抗日、收复失地。 三人当时的身份并不相同： - 冯玉祥 ：中原大战后下野的西北军领袖。1928 年曾任国民政府行政院副院长兼军政部长，1930 年反蒋失败后失去实权；1933 年无军政实职，被推举为同盟军总司令。 - 吉鸿昌 ：冯玉祥旧部、原西北军将领，曾任第22路军总指挥兼第30军军长。1931 年因不愿「剿共」被解除兵权、被迫出洋考察，1932 年回国并加入中国共产党；在同盟军任前敌总指挥兼第2军军长。 - 方振武 ：原国民军将领，曾任安徽省政府主席，反蒋被囚后于 1931 年获释；1933 年变卖财产组织抗日救国军北上，任同盟军北路前敌总司令。 同盟军在中共北方党组织推动与协助下组建，队伍一度发展到十万余人，北上收复康保、宝昌、沽源和多伦，但在日军与国民党当局的双重压力下于同年秋解散。 建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期、职务与人数取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 26 May 1933 Feng Yuxiang, Ji Hongchang, Fang Zhenwu, and others formed the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army at Zhangjiakou, calling for armed resistance and the recovery of lost territory. Their standing at the time differed: - Feng Yuxiang was the retired leader of the Northwest Army. He had served as vice president of the Executive Yuan and minister of military administration in 1928, but lost real power after his anti-Chiang coalition was defeated in 1930. Holding no military or government office in 1933, he was elected commander-in-chief of the Allied Army. - Ji Hongchang , a former Northwest Army general under Feng, had commanded the 22nd Route Army and the 30th Army. Relieved of command in 1931 for refusing to fight the Communists and sent abroad, he returned to China in 1932 and joined the Chinese Communist Party. In the Allied Army he served as front-line commander-in-chief and commander of the 2nd Army. - Fang Zhenwu , a former National Army general and governor of Anhui, had been imprisoned for opposing Chiang and released in 1931. In 1933 he sold his property to raise the Anti-Japanese National Salvation Army and became the Allied Army’s northern front commander. Organized with the encouragement and help of the CCP’s northern organization, the army grew to more than 100,000 men and recovered Kangbao, Baochang, Guyuan, and Duolun before being disbanded that autumn under pressure from both Japan and the Nationalist government. An organizational event with no separate route; dates, titles, and troop numbers follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 中日签订《塘沽协定》，中国默认日军对东北、热河的控制，冀东被划为非武装区。
summary.en: China and Japan signed the Tanggu Truce, tacitly accepting Japanese control of the Northeast and Rehe and creating a demilitarized zone in eastern Hebei.

fields.name: 《塘沽协定》 Tanggu Truce
fields.summary: 中日签订《塘沽协定》，中国默认日军对东北、热河的控制，冀东被划为非武装区。 China and Japan signed the Tanggu Truce, tacitly accepting Japanese control of the Northeast and Rehe and creating a demilitarized zone in eastern Hebei.
fields.description: 1933 年 5 月 31 日，中国代表熊斌与日本代表冈村宁次在塘沽签订停战协定。协定规定中国军队撤至延庆、昌平、高丽营、顺义、通州、香河、宝坻、林亭口、宁河、芦台一线以西以南，冀东划为非武装区。中国实际上默认了日本对东北和热河的控制。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 31 May 1933 Chinese representative Xiong Bin and Japanese representative Okamura Yasuji signed a truce at Tanggu. Chinese troops were to withdraw west and south of a line through Yanqing, Changping, Gaoliying, Shunyi, Tongzhou, Xianghe, Baodi, Lintingkou, Ninghe, and Lutai, and eastern Hebei became a demilitarized zone. China thus tacitly accepted Japanese control of the Northeast and Rehe. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

place.zh: 察哈尔多伦（今属内蒙古）

summary.zh: 察哈尔抗日同盟军北路前敌总司令方振武、总指挥吉鸿昌率部收复多伦，为九一八事变后中国军队首次收复失地。
summary.en: The northern front of the Chahar Anti-Japanese Allied Army, under Fang Zhenwu and Ji Hongchang, retook Duolun — the first recovery of lost territory by Chinese forces after the Mukden Incident.

fields.name: 收复多伦 Recapture of Duolun
fields.place: 察哈尔多伦（今属内蒙古） Duolun, Chahar (now Inner Mongolia)
fields.summary: 察哈尔抗日同盟军北路前敌总司令方振武、总指挥吉鸿昌率部收复多伦，为九一八事变后中国军队首次收复失地。 The northern front of the Chahar Anti-Japanese Allied Army, under Fang Zhenwu and Ji Hongchang, retook Duolun — the first recovery of lost territory by Chinese forces after the Mukden Incident.
fields.description: 1933 年 7 月，察哈尔民众抗日同盟军北路前敌总司令方振武、总指挥吉鸿昌率部围攻多伦，经数日激战于 7 月 12 日收复该城。这是九一八事变后中国军队首次从日军及其伪军手中收复失地，在舆论上引起很大反响。 吉鸿昌当时是原西北军将领、第22路军前总指挥，1932 年加入中国共产党，在同盟军任前敌总指挥兼第2军军长。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 In July 1933 the northern front of the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army, commanded by Fang Zhenwu and Ji Hongchang, besieged Duolun and retook the town on 12 July after several days of fighting. It was the first recovery of lost territory from Japanese and puppet forces after the Mukden Incident and caused a sensation in public opinion. Ji Hongchang was a former Northwest Army general and former commander of the 22nd Route Army; he joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1932 and served as the Allied Army’s front-line commander-in-chief and commander of the 2nd Army. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.zh: 东北人民革命军第一军独立师成立

summary.zh: 1933年9月18日，南满游击队改编为东北人民革命军第一军独立师，杨靖宇任师长兼政委，是「人民革命军」番号的开始。
summary.en: On 18 September 1933 the South Manchurian guerrillas became the 1st Independent Division of the Northeast People’s Revolutionary Army under Yang Jingyu — the first use of the new designation.

fields.name: 东北人民革命军第一军独立师成立 Formation of the 1st Independent Division
fields.place: 吉林磐石玻璃河套 Bolihetao, Panshi, Jilin
fields.summary: 1933年9月18日，南满游击队改编为东北人民革命军第一军独立师，杨靖宇任师长兼政委，是「人民革命军」番号的开始。 On 18 September 1933 the South Manchurian guerrillas became the 1st Independent Division of the Northeast People’s Revolutionary Army under Yang Jingyu — the first use of the new designation.
fields.description: 1933 年 7 月 1 日，中共满洲省委在《给磐石中心县委及南满赤色游击队的信》中提出，将中国工农红军第三十二军南满游击队改为「东北人民革命军第一军」的一个师。9 月 18 日（九一八两周年），独立师在磐石游击根据地玻璃河套猪腰子岭成立，发表《东北人民革命军第一军第一独立师成立宣言》《东北人民革命军政纲》《东北人民革命军暂行规则》《告反日义勇军战士兄弟书》。杨靖宇任师长兼政委，李红光任参谋长，宋铁岩任政治部主任，全师 300 余人，辖第一、第三两个团及政治保安连、少年营。成立宣言声明愿在「不投降、不卖国、反日到底」三项条件下同任何反日武装结成同盟——番号从「红军」改为「人民革命军」，本身就是统一战线信号。1934 年 11 月 7 日，第一军在临江四道岔正式成立，杨靖宇任军长兼政委。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 On 1 July 1933 the Manchurian Provincial Committee proposed in a letter to the Panshi county committee and the South Manchurian guerrillas that the 32nd Red Army’s South Manchurian guerrillas become a division of the “Northeast People’s Revolutionary Army”. On 18 September, the second anniversary of the Mukden Incident, the independent division was formed at Bolihetao in the Panshi base, issuing its founding declaration, political programme, provisional regulations and an open letter to the volunteer fighters. Yang Jingyu was commander and commissar, Li Hongguang chief of staff and Song Tieyan political director; the division had over 300 men in the 1st and 3rd Regiments plus a political security company and a youth battalion. The declaration offered alliance with any anti-Japanese force on three conditions — no surrender, no treason, fight Japan to the end. The change of name from “Red Army” to “People’s Revolutionary Army” was itself a signal of the united front. The 1st Army proper was formed at Sidaocha in Linjiang on 7 November 1934 under Yang. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

fields.summary: 第十九路军在福州另立政府，次年失败。 The 19th Route Army set up a separate government at Fuzhou, which collapsed the following year.
fields.description: 1933 年 11 月 20 日，第十九路军将领蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴等在福州发动福建事变，成立“中华共和国人民革命政府”，不久在南京政府军事压力下失败。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 20 November 1933 Jiang Guangnai, Cai Tingkai, and other 19th Route Army commanders launched the Fujian Incident at Fuzhou and established the “People’s Revolutionary Government of the Chinese Republic,” which soon collapsed under military pressure from Nanjing. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.summary: 蒋介石在南昌发起新生活运动，以“礼义廉耻”整饬社会风气。 Chiang Kai-shek launched the New Life Movement in Nanchang, promoting “propriety, righteousness, honesty, and shame” to reform social habits.
fields.description: 1934 年 2 月，蒋介石在南昌发起新生活运动，提倡“礼义廉耻”，要求生活军事化、生产化、艺术化，试图以道德教化整饬社会。运动持续到抗战时期，实际效果有限。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In February 1934 Chiang Kai-shek launched the New Life Movement in Nanchang, promoting “propriety, righteousness, honesty, and shame” and calling for a militarized, productive, and artistic daily life. The movement continued into the war years with limited practical effect. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1934 年 3 月 1 日，溥仪在长春称“满洲帝国皇帝”，改元“康德”。伪满政权在日本关东军控制下进一步完善殖民统治机构，但始终未获中国政府与国际社会普遍承认。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 1 March 1934 Puyi was enthroned as “Emperor of Manchukuo” in Changchun and adopted the era name Kangde. Under Kwantung Army control the puppet state further developed its colonial institutions, but it was never widely recognized by the Chinese government or the international community. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 天羽声明 Amau Statement
fields.summary: 日本外务省发表天羽声明，反对列强援助中国，暴露独占中国的意图。 Japan’s Foreign Ministry issued the Amau Statement, opposing foreign aid to China and revealing its aim of monopolizing China.
fields.description: 1934 年 4 月 17 日，日本外务省情报部长天羽英二发表非正式声明，称日本对东亚有特殊责任，反对列强向中国提供武器、借款或技术援助。声明被中国与英美等国视为“亚洲门罗主义”，加剧了华北危机前的紧张局势。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 17 April 1934 Amau Eiji, spokesman of Japan’s Foreign Ministry, issued an informal statement claiming a special Japanese responsibility in East Asia and opposing foreign arms, loans, or technical aid to China. China, Britain, and the United States saw it as an “Asian Monroe Doctrine,” heightening tensions before the North China crisis. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 藏本英明事件 Kuramoto Incident
fields.summary: 日本驻南京副领事藏本英明失踪，日方借机陈兵施压，数日后其被发现在紫金山隐居。 A Japanese vice-consul in Nanjing disappeared; Japan massed warships as a pretext, but he was found days later hiding in the Zijin Mountains.
fields.description: 1934 年 6 月 9 日，日本驻南京总领事馆副领事藏本英明失踪。日本方面宣称其被中国方面绑架，调集军舰施压。6 月 13 日，藏本在南京紫金山被发现，自称因精神苦闷出走，日方的借口随之破产。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 9 June 1934 Kuramoto, a vice-consul at the Japanese consulate in Nanjing, disappeared. Japan claimed he had been kidnapped by the Chinese side and massed warships as pressure. On 13 June he was found in the Zijin Mountains outside Nanjing, saying he had left because of mental distress, and the Japanese pretext collapsed. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.summary: 1934年9月28日，东北民众自卫军司令邓铁梅在奉天伪陆军监狱被秘密杀害，年42岁。 On 28 September 1934 Deng Tiemei, commander of the Northeast People’s Self-Defence Army, was secretly killed in the puppet army prison at Mukden; he was 42.
fields.description: 1931 年 10 月创建东北民众自卫军后，邓铁梅部在安东、凤城、岫岩、庄河一带（「三角抗区」）作战，1932 年 3 月被东北民众抗日救国会编为第二十八路军，至 8 月作战近百次，部队最多时 1.5 万余人。1932 年底起，日伪军连续四次大规模「讨伐」，自卫军被迫化整为零。1934 年 5 月，邓铁梅患痢疾，秘密到凤城县小蔡家沟张家堡子亲属家养病；5 月 30 日夜，被叛徒沈廷辅率伪便衣暗杀队叫开房门捕获。邓铁梅被押至奉天伪陆军监狱，日伪以高官厚禄诱降，他题扇「五尺身躯何足惜，四省失土几时收」。1934 年 9 月 28 日夜被秘密杀害，年 42 岁（生年 1892，一说 1893）。1935 年《八一宣言》称其为「为救国而捐躯的民族英雄」；2014 年列入第一批著名抗日英烈名录。本事件不绘路线。 After founding the Northeast People’s Self-Defence Army in October 1931, Deng Tiemei operated in the Andong–Fengcheng–Xiuyan–Zhuanghe “triangle”, was designated the 28th Route Army by the Northeast People’s Anti-Japanese National Salvation Association in March 1932, and fought nearly a hundred actions by August, his force peaking at over 15,000. From late 1932 four large Japanese “punitive campaigns” forced the army to disperse. In May 1934 Deng fell ill with dysentery and went secretly to relatives at Zhangjiabuzi in Xiaocaijiaogou, Fengcheng county; on the night of 30 May the traitor Shen Tingfu brought a plain-clothes assassination squad to his door and seized him. Taken to the puppet army prison at Mukden, he refused high office and wrote on a fan: “What matters a five-foot body; when will the four provinces’ lost land be recovered?” He was secretly killed on the night of 28 September 1934, aged 42 (born 1892, some sources say 1893). The August 1935 declaration of the CCP called him “a national hero who gave his life to save the country”, and in 2014 he was entered in the first list of famous anti-Japanese martyrs. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1934年11月7日，东北人民革命军第一军在临江四道岔成立，杨靖宇任军长兼政委。
summary.en: On 7 November 1934 the 1st Army of the Northeast People’s Revolutionary Army was formed at Sidaocha in Linjiang under Yang Jingyu.

fields.name: 东北人民革命军第一军成立 Formation of the 1st Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army
fields.place: 吉林临江四道岔 Sidaocha, Linjiang, Jilin
fields.summary: 1934年11月7日，东北人民革命军第一军在临江四道岔成立，杨靖宇任军长兼政委。 On 7 November 1934 the 1st Army of the Northeast People’s Revolutionary Army was formed at Sidaocha in Linjiang under Yang Jingyu.
fields.description: 1933 年 9 月 18 日独立师成立后，经三源浦、凉水河子、八道江等战斗，南满游击区扩大，各路抗日军开始主动接受人民革命军领导。1934 年 11 月 5 日，中共南满第一次代表大会在临江四道岔召开，32 名代表一致通过杨靖宇关于建立东北人民革命军第一军的提议；11 月 7 日第一军正式成立。杨靖宇任军长兼政委，下设第一、第二师和教导团，全军 800 余人（另有 3000 人说，系 1936 年扩编后数字）。第一军的编制、政纲与纪律条例，成为此后各军建军的模板。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 After the independent division was formed on 18 September 1933, victories at Sanyuanpu, Liangshuihezi and Badaojiang expanded the South Manchurian base, and other anti-Japanese forces began to accept the People’s Revolutionary Army’s leadership. On 5 November 1934 the first South Manchurian party congress met at Sidaocha in Linjiang; its 32 delegates unanimously approved Yang Jingyu’s proposal to form the 1st Army, which was established on the 7th. Yang was commander and commissar, with the 1st and 2nd Divisions and a training regiment, over 800 men (a figure of 3,000 refers to the expanded army of 1936). Its organisation, programme and discipline code became the template for the other armies. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

name.zh: 东北抗日同盟军第四军成立
name.en: Formation of the 4th Army of the Anti-Japanese Allied Army

summary.zh: 1934年12月，东北人民抗日革命军与密山游击队合并，正式定名为东北抗日同盟军第四军，李延禄任军长。
summary.en: In December 1934 the Northeast People’s Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Army and the Mishan guerrillas were merged and formally named the 4th Army of the Anti-Japanese Allied Army under Li Yanlu.

fields.name: 东北抗日同盟军第四军成立 Formation of the 4th Army of the Anti-Japanese Allied Army
fields.summary: 1934年12月，东北人民抗日革命军与密山游击队合并，正式定名为东北抗日同盟军第四军，李延禄任军长。 In December 1934 the Northeast People’s Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Army and the Mishan guerrillas were merged and formally named the 4th Army of the Anti-Japanese Allied Army under Li Yanlu.
fields.description: 第四军的前身是救国军补充团。1933 年 1 月 4 日，李延禄率补充团在穆棱五河林改编为抗日游击总队；7 月改称东北人民抗日革命军，李延禄任军长。1934 年 3 月 20 日，中共密山县委在哈达河沟里建立密山反日游击队。1934 年 9 月 25 日，中共驻共产国际代表团派吴平（杨松）参加密山县委扩大会议，决定将密山游击队与人民革命军合并，组成东北抗日同盟军总司令部，李延禄任总司令；12 月，在吉东特委统一部署下正式定名为东北抗日同盟军第四军，军长李延禄，政治部主任何忠国，参谋长胡伦，辖 3 个团及独立营，共 230 余人（一说 231 人）。番号用「同盟军」而不用「人民革命军」，是为与宁安的东北反日联合军第五军、东南满的人民革命军第一、二军相呼应。1936 年 3 月，第四军改编为东北抗日联军第四军。日期说明：正式定名在 1934 年 12 月，具体日期待考，本事件取 12 月 1 日；9 月 25 日的县委扩大会议是合并的决策日。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 The 4th Army grew out of the National Salvation Army’s supplementary regiment. On 4 January 1933 Li Yanlu reorganised it at Wuhelin in Muling as a guerrilla group, and in July it became the Northeast People’s Anti-Japanese Revolutionary Army under Li. On 20 March 1934 the Mishan county committee formed the Mishan anti-Japanese guerrillas at Hadа́he. On 25 September 1934 Wu Ping (Yang Song), sent by the CCP delegation to the Comintern, attended an enlarged Mishan county committee meeting which decided to merge the guerrillas with the revolutionary army into an Anti-Japanese Allied Army headquarters under Li Yanlu; in December, under the Jidong committee, it was formally named the 4th Army of the Anti-Japanese Allied Army, with Li as commander, He Zhongguo as political director and Hu Lun as chief of staff — three regiments and an independent battalion, over 230 men (one source says 231). The title “Allied Army” rather than “People’s Revolutionary Army” was chosen to match the 5th Army at Ning’an and the 1st and 2nd Armies in the south-east. In March 1936 it became the United Army’s 4th Army. The formal naming fell in December 1934 but the exact day is unknown; this entry uses 1 December, while 25 September marks the decision to merge. No route is drawn.

Negotiations followed at Datan and produced an oral accord in February. A military event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.zh: 东北人民革命军第三军成立
name.en: Formation of the 3rd Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army

summary.zh: 1935年1月28日，东北人民革命军第三军在珠河成立，赵尚志任军长。
summary.en: On 28 January 1935 the 3rd Army of the Northeast People’s Revolutionary Army was formed at Zhuhe under Zhao Shangzhi.

fields.name: 东北人民革命军第三军成立 Formation of the 3rd Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army
fields.summary: 1935年1月28日，东北人民革命军第三军在珠河成立，赵尚志任军长。 On 28 January 1935 the 3rd Army of the Northeast People’s Revolutionary Army was formed at Zhuhe under Zhao Shangzhi.
fields.description: 第三军前身为 1933 年 10 月赵尚志创建的珠河东北反日游击队，1934 年 6 月扩编为东北反日游击队哈东支队，赵尚志任司令。1935 年 1 月 28 日，哈东支队在珠河改编为东北人民革命军第三军，赵尚志任军长，冯仲云任政治部主任，全军 500 余人，后扩至 6 个师。第三军在珠河、方正、延寿、宾县一带活动，与李延禄第四军、汤原游击队配合，是北满抗日的核心力量。1936 年 8 月改编为东北抗日联军第三军，赵尚志仍任军长，李兆麟任政治部主任。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 The 3rd Army grew out of the Zhuhe guerrilla band Zhao Shangzhi founded in October 1933, which became the Hadong detachment of the Anti-Japanese guerrillas in June 1934 with Zhao as commander. On 28 January 1935 the detachment was reorganised at Zhuhe as the 3rd Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army, with Zhao as commander and Feng Zhongyun as political director, over 500 men rising later to six divisions. It operated around Zhuhe, Fangzheng, Yanshou and Binxian alongside Li Yanlu’s 4th Army and the Tangyuan guerrillas, and was the core of the North Manchurian resistance. In August 1936 it became the United Army’s 3rd Army, still under Zhao with Li Zhaolin as political director. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

fields.name: 大滩口约 Datan Oral Accord
fields.place: 察哈尔沽源大滩 Datan, Guyuan, Chahar
fields.summary: 中方与日方在大滩达成口约，中国军队撤出察东，日军获得自由行动空间。 China and Japan reached an oral accord at Datan: Chinese troops withdrew from eastern Chahar and Japanese forces gained freedom of movement.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 2 日，中方与日方在察哈尔沽源大滩达成口约，中国军队撤出察东，日军获得自由行动空间。这是中日双方共同的行为，但中国处于被迫接受的一方，为同年张北事件与秦土协定埋下伏笔。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 2 February 1935 China and Japan reached an oral accord at Datan in Guyuan, Chahar: Chinese troops withdrew from eastern Chahar and Japanese forces gained freedom of movement. It was a bilateral act, but China was forced to accept, and it set the stage for the Zhangbei Incident and the Qin-Doihara Agreement later that year. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.zh: 东北反日联合军第五军成立
name.en: Formation of the 5th Army of the Anti-Japanese Allied Army

summary.zh: 1935年2月10日，绥宁反日同盟军改编为东北反日联合军第五军，周保中任军长，全军900余人。
summary.en: On 10 February 1935 the Suining Anti-Japanese Allied Army became the 5th Army of the Northeast Anti-Japanese Allied Army under Zhou Baozhong, some 900 strong.

fields.name: 东北反日联合军第五军成立 Formation of the 5th Army of the Anti-Japanese Allied Army
fields.summary: 1935年2月10日，绥宁反日同盟军改编为东北反日联合军第五军，周保中任军长，全军900余人。 On 10 February 1935 the Suining Anti-Japanese Allied Army became the 5th Army of the Northeast Anti-Japanese Allied Army under Zhou Baozhong, some 900 strong.
fields.description: 第五军前身为 1934 年 2 月周保中在宁安组建的绥宁反日同盟军：以救国军边区军第一、三连和宁安工农义务队为基干，联合柴世荣、傅显明、王汝起、王毓峰等部及八道河子农民自卫队。1935 年 1 月，中共满洲省委吉东局、宁安县委与同盟军党委决定改编；2 月 10 日，东北反日联合军第五军在宁安正式成立，周保中任军长，柴世荣任副军长，胡仁任政治部主任，张建东任参谋长，全军 936 人，辖 2 个师 7 个团。注意番号：第五军当时称「东北反日联合军第五军」，不称「人民革命军」；1936 年 2 月才按《八一宣言》改称东北抗日联军第五军。第五军是吉东抗日的骨干，1937 年 10 月编入第二路军。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 The 5th Army began as the Suining Anti-Japanese Allied Army, formed by Zhou Baozhong at Ning’an in February 1934 on the basis of the National Salvation Army’s 1st and 3rd Border Companies and the Ning’an workers’ volunteer corps, joined by the units of Chai Shirong, Fu Xianming, Wang Ruqi and Wang Yufeng and the Badaohezi peasant self-defence force. In January 1935 the Jidong bureau, the Ning’an county committee and the army’s party committee decided on reorganisation; on 10 February the 5th Army of the Northeast Anti-Japanese Allied Army was formally established at Ning’an under Zhou Baozhong, with Chai Shirong as deputy, Hu Ren as political director and Zhang Jiandong as chief of staff — 936 men in two divisions and seven regiments. Note the designation: it was the “Anti-Japanese Allied Army”, not the “People’s Revolutionary Army”, and only became the United Army’s 5th Army in February 1936 under the August First Declaration. It was the backbone of the Jidong resistance and joined the 2nd Route Army in October 1937. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 蒋介石在贵阳发起国民经济建设运动，推动交通、工矿与农村建设。
summary.en: Chiang Kai-shek launched the National Economic Construction Movement in Guiyang to promote transport, industry, mining, and rural construction.

fields.name: 国民经济建设运动 National Economic Construction Movement
fields.summary: 蒋介石在贵阳发起国民经济建设运动，推动交通、工矿与农村建设。 Chiang Kai-shek launched the National Economic Construction Movement in Guiyang to promote transport, industry, mining, and rural construction.
fields.description: 1935 年 4 月，蒋介石在贵阳发起国民经济建设运动，号召“尽人力、辟地利、均供求、畅流通”，推动交通、工矿、农村合作与国防经济建设。该运动与法币改革同为战前经济准备的一部分。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In April 1935 Chiang Kai-shek launched the National Economic Construction Movement in Guiyang, calling for mobilizing labor, developing resources, balancing supply and demand, and improving distribution. It promoted transport, industry, mining, rural cooperatives, and defense-related construction, alongside the currency reform as part of prewar economic preparation. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.zh: 东北人民革命军第二军成立
name.en: Formation of the 2nd Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army

summary.zh: 1935年5月30日，东北人民革命军第二军军部在安图车厂子成立，王德泰任军长，魏拯民任政委。
summary.en: On 30 May 1935 the 2nd Army headquarters was formed at Chechangzi in Antu under Wang Detai, with Wei Zhengmin as commissar.

fields.name: 东北人民革命军第二军成立 Formation of the 2nd Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army
fields.place: 吉林安图车厂子 Chechangzi, Antu, Jilin
fields.summary: 1935年5月30日，东北人民革命军第二军军部在安图车厂子成立，王德泰任军长，魏拯民任政委。 On 30 May 1935 the 2nd Army headquarters was formed at Chechangzi in Antu under Wang Detai, with Wei Zhengmin as commissar.
fields.description: 第二军前身为 1934 年 3 月成立的东北人民革命军第二军第一独立师（师长朱镇、政委王德泰），全师 900 余人。1935 年 3 月 21 日，东满特委在汪清腰营沟召开独立师联席会议调整干部；5 月 30 日，根据中共满洲省委 1934 年 10 月 20 日的指示，东满特委与独立师师部发表《东北人民革命军第二军军部正式成立宣言》，第二军在安图车厂子成立。王德泰任军长，魏拯民任政委，刘汉兴任参谋长，李学忠任政治部主任，下辖 4 个团、1 个游击大队，全军 1200 余人。第二军活动于延吉、珲春、和龙、汪清、安图、蛟河、敦化等地，是东满抗日的主力。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 The 2nd Army began as the 1st Independent Division of the 2nd Army, formed in March 1934 at Sandaowan in Yanji under Zhu Zhen and political commissar Wang Detai, with over 900 men. On 21 March 1935 the East Manchurian committee adjusted its cadres at Yaoyinggou in Wangqing; on 30 May, acting on a Manchurian Provincial Committee instruction of 20 October 1934, the committee and divisional headquarters issued the declaration formally establishing the 2nd Army at Chechangzi in Antu. Wang Detai was commander, Wei Zhengmin commissar, Liu Hanxing chief of staff and Li Xuezhong political director, with four regiments and a guerrilla battalion, over 1,200 men. It operated in Yanji, Hunchun, Helong, Wangqing, Antu, Jiaohe and Dunhua and was the main force in eastern Manchuria. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 日本特务在张北被中国守军盘查，日方借机提出交涉。
summary.en: Japanese agents were stopped and questioned by Chinese guards at Zhangbei, and Japan used the incident to demand concessions.

fields.name: 张北事件 Zhangbei Incident
fields.summary: 日本特务在张北被中国守军盘查，日方借机提出交涉。 Japanese agents were stopped and questioned by Chinese guards at Zhangbei, and Japan used the incident to demand concessions.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 5 日，日本特务在张北被中国守军盘查，日方借机提出交涉，要求撤换有关人员、撤退察哈尔省境内国民党军与党部，并取缔抗日活动。6 月 27 日秦德纯与土肥原贤二签订“秦土协定”。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 5 June 1935 Japanese agents were stopped and questioned by Chinese guards at Zhangbei. Japan used the incident to demand the replacement of the officers involved, the withdrawal of Nationalist troops and party offices from Chahar, and the suppression of anti-Japanese activities. On 27 June Qin Dechun and Doihara Kenji signed the Qin-Doihara Agreement. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: Japan used Sun Yongqin’s entry into the demilitarized zone east of the Luan River and the killing of Hu Bai as pretexts to press the Beiping Military Council and move troops.

fields.name: 河北事件 Hebei Incident
fields.summary: 日军以孙永勤部进入滦东“非武装区”和胡白被杀为借口，向北平军分会提出交涉并调兵施压。 Japan used Sun Yongqin’s entry into the demilitarized zone east of the Luan River and the killing of Hu Bai as pretexts to press the Beiping Military Council and move troops.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 至 6 月，日军以孙永勤部进入滦东“非武装区”和胡白被杀事件为借口，向北平军分会代委员长何应钦提出交涉，并从东北调兵入关施压。日方要求撤换河北省军政人员、撤出中央军与国民党党部。7 月 6 日何应钦复函接受，形成“何梅协定”。 外交/军事事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In May and June 1935 Japan used Sun Yongqin’s entry into the demilitarized zone east of the Luan River and the killing of Hu Bai as pretexts to press He Yingqin, acting chairman of the Beiping Military Council, and moved troops from the Northeast through the Great Wall. Japan demanded the replacement of Hebei officials and the withdrawal of Central Army units and Nationalist Party offices. He Yingqin’s reply of 6 July accepted these demands, producing the He-Umezu Agreement. A diplomatic and military event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 秦土协定 Qin-Doihara Agreement
fields.summary: 秦德纯与土肥原贤二签订协定，中国同意撤军、撤换人员并取缔抗日活动。 Qin Dechun and Doihara Kenji signed an agreement under which China withdrew troops and officials and suppressed anti-Japanese activities in Chahar.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 27 日，秦德纯与土肥原贤二在北平签订协定，中国方面同意撤换有关人员、撤退察哈尔省境内国民党军与党部，并取缔抗日活动。察哈尔主权进一步受损。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 27 June 1935 Qin Dechun and Doihara Kenji signed an agreement in Beiping: China replaced the officials involved, withdrew Nationalist troops and party offices from Chahar, and suppressed anti-Japanese activities. Chahar’s sovereignty was further eroded. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 何梅协定 He-Umezu Agreement
fields.summary: 何应钦复函梅津美治郎，接受日方要求，中央军与国民党党部退出河北。 He Yingqin replied to Umezu Yoshijiro, accepting Japanese demands and withdrawing Central Army units and party offices from Hebei.
fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 6 日，北平军分会代委员长何应钦复函日本华北驻屯军司令梅津美治郎，实质上接受日方要求：中央军与国民党党部退出河北，撤换有关军政人员。此即“何梅协定”，中国在华北的主权进一步受损。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 6 July 1935 He Yingqin, acting chairman of the Beiping Military Council, replied to Umezu Yoshijiro, commander of the Japanese garrison in North China, effectively accepting Japanese demands: Central Army units and Nationalist Party offices withdrew from Hebei and officials were replaced. This is known as the He-Umezu Agreement, which further eroded Chinese sovereignty in North China. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 苗可秀牺牲 Death of Miao Kexiu
fields.summary: 1935年7月25日，中国少年铁血军总司令苗可秀在凤城就义，年30岁。 On 25 July 1935 Miao Kexiu, commander of the Chinese Youth Iron-Blood Army, was executed at Fengcheng; he was 30.
fields.description: 苗可秀 1906 年生于本溪，东北大学国文系学生，九一八后流亡北平，1932 年春受东北民众抗日救国会派遣回到辽东，任邓铁梅部东北民众自卫军总参议。1934 年春，鉴于义勇军目标过大，苗可秀与赵同、赵伟、白君实等在岫岩南三道虎岭成立中国少年铁血军，任总司令，以「用黑铁赤血精神，采全民之革命手段，收复东北」为宗旨。1935 年 6 月 13 日夜，苗可秀率部由凤城渡大洋河向岫岩转移，在羊角沟遭日伪军袭击，突围时臀部负伤，隐蔽养伤时因医生被捕招供而落入敌手。在凤城日军警察署地下室，他拒绝诱降，托日本翻译前山寄出家书，为儿子取名「苗抗生」，并写下「正义千秋」。1935 年 7 月 25 日在凤城就义，年 30 岁（一说 29）。本事件不绘路线。 Miao Kexiu, born at Benxi in 1906 and a student of Chinese literature at Northeastern University, went into exile in Beiping after the Mukden Incident and returned to eastern Liaoning in spring 1932 on the orders of the Northeast People’s Anti-Japanese National Salvation Association as chief of staff to Deng Tiemei. In spring 1934, judging the volunteer armies too conspicuous, Miao with Zhao Tong, Zhao Wei and Bai Junshi founded the Chinese Youth Iron-Blood Army at Sandaohuling in Xiuyan, with the aim of “recovering the Northeast by the iron and blood spirit and the revolutionary means of the whole people”. On the night of 13 June 1935, moving from Fengcheng across the Dayang River toward Xiuyan, he was ambushed at Yangjiaogou, wounded in the hip during the breakout, and captured while recovering after the doctor treating him was arrested and gave him away. In the basement of the Japanese police station at Fengcheng he refused to surrender, asked the Japanese interpreter Maeyama to post his letters home, named his son “Miao Kangsheng” (Resist Japan), and wrote “Justice for a thousand years”. He was executed at Fengcheng on 25 July 1935, aged 30 (some sources say 29). No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1935年8月1日，中共驻共产国际代表团起草《为抗日救国告全体同胞书》，提出停止内战、组织国防政府与抗日联军。
summary.en: On 1 August 1935 the CCP delegation to the Comintern drafted the declaration calling for an end to civil war and a national defence government and anti-Japanese united army.

fields.name: 《八一宣言》 The August First Declaration
fields.summary: 1935年8月1日，中共驻共产国际代表团起草《为抗日救国告全体同胞书》，提出停止内战、组织国防政府与抗日联军。 On 1 August 1935 the CCP delegation to the Comintern drafted the declaration calling for an end to civil war and a national defence government and anti-Japanese united army.
fields.description: 1935 年七八月间共产国际七大在莫斯科召开，确定建立广泛的反法西斯统一战线。根据华北事变后的形势与七大精神，中共驻共产国际代表团起草《中国苏维埃政府、中国共产党中央为抗日救国告全体同胞书》。宣言呼吁无论各党派、各界同胞、各军队过去有何政见不同与敌对行动，都应「兄弟阋墙，外御其侮」，停止内战，集中一切国力抗日；倡议由各党派、团体、名流学者与地方军政机关谈判成立国防政府，在国防政府领导下组织统一的抗日联军，并提出抗日救国十大纲领。文件标注日期为 1935 年 8 月 1 日，10 月 1 日在巴黎出版的《救国报》上全文发表（另有 10 月 3 日说），随后传入北平、上海。对东北而言，这份宣言是 1936 年 2 月《东北抗日联军统一军队建制宣言》的直接政策来源。本事件为政策文件，日期取文件标注日；起草于莫斯科，发表于巴黎。本事件不绘路线。 The Seventh Comintern Congress met in Moscow in July and August 1935 and adopted a broad anti-fascist united front. In the light of the North China crisis and the congress, the CCP delegation drafted the “Declaration of the Chinese Soviet Government and the CCP Central Committee to All Compatriots on Resisting Japan and Saving the Nation”. It called on all parties, citizens and armies, whatever their past differences or hostilities, to “bury the quarrel at home and resist the enemy at the gate”, to stop the civil war and concentrate the nation’s strength against Japan. It proposed negotiations for a national defence government and, under it, a unified anti-Japanese united army, and set out a ten-point programme. The document is dated 1 August 1935 and was published in full in the Paris-edition Gujiu Bao on 1 October (some sources say 3 October), then smuggled into Beiping and Shanghai. For Manchuria it was the direct policy source of the February 1936 declaration unifying the United Army. The entry is dated by the document itself; it was drafted in Moscow and published in Paris. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 广田三原则提出 Hirota’s Three Principles
fields.summary: 日本内阁决定“广田三原则”，要求中国取缔排日、承认伪满、共同防共。 The Japanese cabinet adopted “Hirota’s Three Principles,” demanding an end to anti-Japanese activity, recognition of Manchukuo and joint anti-communism.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 4 日，日本冈田启介内阁决定《外、陆、海三相关于对华政策的谅解》，即“广田三原则”：中国取缔排日言行并摆脱对欧美依赖、事实上默认伪满洲国、在邻近外蒙地区与日本合作防共。10 月 7 日，广田弘毅向中国驻日大使蒋作宾提出。中方未接受，交涉无果。日期为阁议决定日，待页码级核对。 On 4 October 1935 the Japanese cabinet of Okada Keisuke adopted the “Understanding of the Foreign, Army and Navy Ministers on Policy toward China,” known as Hirota’s Three Principles: China should suppress anti-Japanese words and deeds and abandon reliance on the Western powers; tacitly accept Manchukuo; and cooperate with Japan against communism in areas bordering Outer Mongolia. Foreign Minister Hirota Kōki presented them to Chinese ambassador Jiang Zuobin on 7 October. China did not accept them and the talks failed. The date is that of the cabinet decision and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 法币改革 Currency Reform
fields.summary: 国民政府实行法币政策，统一货币、稳定金融，为抗战经济动员奠定基础。 The Nationalist government introduced the fabi currency, unifying the monetary system and stabilizing finance for wartime mobilization.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 3 日，国民政府财政部宣布法币政策，白银收归国有，以中央、中国、交通等银行发行的钞票为法币，统一货币、稳定金融。法币改革为抗战时期的财政与军费动员提供了基础。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 3 November 1935 the Ministry of Finance announced the fabi reform: silver was nationalized and notes issued by the Central Bank of China, Bank of China, Bank of Communications, and others became legal tender. The reform unified the currency and stabilized finance, providing a basis for wartime fiscal and military mobilization. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.summary: 1935 年 11 月 13 日，中共中央发表宣言，提出红军愿同一切抗日反蒋的武装队伍联合。 On 13 November 1935 the CCP Central Committee declared that the Red Army would unite with all anti-Japanese forces.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 13 日，中共中央在陕北瓦窑堡发表《为日本帝国主义并吞华北及蒋介石出卖华北出卖中国宣言》，指出华北事变后民族危机空前严重，提出红军愿同「一切抗日反蒋的中国人民与武装队伍」联合起来反对日本帝国主义。11 月 28 日，中共中央又以中华苏维埃共和国中央政府、中国工农红军革命军事委员会名义发表《抗日救国宣言》，把《八一宣言》提出的抗日救国十项方针发展为十大纲领。这两个宣言与 12 月瓦窑堡会议直接衔接，是从「抗日反蒋」向更广泛统一战线过渡的公开文件。本事件为政策文件，不绘路线。 On 13 November 1935 the CCP Central Committee at Wayaobao issued a declaration on Japan’s annexation of North China and Chiang Kai-shek’s selling-out of the north, stating that the Red Army would unite with all Chinese and armed forces that opposed Japan and Chiang. On 28 November the Chinese Soviet government and the Red Army Revolutionary Military Commission issued a second declaration on resisting Japan and saving the nation, expanding the ten-point programme of the August First Declaration. Together they led directly into the Wayaobao Conference of December. No route is drawn.

fields.summary: 殷汝耕在通州成立冀东防共自治委员会，冀东二十二县脱离南京管辖。 Yin Rugeng set up the East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Council at Tongzhou, detaching 22 counties from Nanjing’s authority.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 25 日，殷汝耕在通州成立“冀东防共自治委员会”，宣布冀东二十二县“自治”，实际处于日本控制之下。此举是华北自治运动的高潮，直接引发一二·九运动。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 25 November 1935 Yin Rugeng established the “East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Council” at Tongzhou, declaring 22 counties of eastern Hebei “autonomous” under de facto Japanese control. It marked the peak of the North China autonomy movement and directly triggered the December Ninth Movement. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

The movement spread nationwide and became an important backdrop to the formation of the anti-Japanese united front. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.summary: 北平学生举行更大规模游行，抗议冀察政务委员会成立，运动扩展至全国。 Students in Beiping held an even larger demonstration against the Hebei-Chahar Political Council, and the movement spread nationwide.
fields.description: 1935 年 12 月 16 日，北平学生万余人举行游行，抗议冀察政务委员会成立，遭到军警镇压。运动迅速扩展到天津、上海、南京、广州等地，成为全国抗日救亡运动的新高潮，也为抗日民族统一战线的形成准备了群众基础。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 16 December 1935 more than ten thousand students marched in Beiping against the Hebei-Chahar Political Council and were suppressed by police. The movement quickly spread to Tianjin, Shanghai, Nanjing, Guangzhou, and elsewhere, becoming a new high point of national salvation activity and preparing popular ground for the anti-Japanese united front. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 1935 年 12 月 17—25 日，中共中央政治局在瓦窑堡召开扩大会议，确立抗日民族统一战线策略。

fields.name: 瓦窑堡会议 Wayaobao Conference
fields.summary: 1935 年 12 月 17—25 日，中共中央政治局在瓦窑堡召开扩大会议，确立抗日民族统一战线策略。 From 17 to 25 December 1935 the CCP Politburo met at Wayaobao and adopted the anti-Japanese national united front.
fields.description: 1935 年 12 月 17 日至 25 日，中共中央政治局在陕北安定县（今子长）瓦窑堡召开扩大会议。张闻天作政治形势与策略报告，张浩（林育英）传达共产国际七大精神。会议通过《关于目前政治形势与党的任务决议》和《关于军事战略问题的决议》，确定建立最广泛的抗日民族统一战线，批判党内「左」倾关门主义，并把「工农共和国」改为「人民共和国」。12 月 27 日，毛泽东在党的活动分子会议上作《论反对日本帝国主义的策略》报告，系统阐述统一战线的理论与策略。瓦窑堡会议解决了遵义会议未及解决的政治路线问题，是党从土地革命战争向民族革命战争转变的关键会议。本事件为会议，不绘路线。 From 17 to 25 December 1935 the CCP Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Wayaobao in northern Shaanxi. Zhang Wentian reported on the political situation and strategy, and Zhang Hao (Lin Yuying) conveyed the Seventh Comintern Congress line. The meeting adopted resolutions on the political situation and on military strategy, established the broadest anti-Japanese national united front, criticised “Left” closed-doorism, and changed “workers’ and peasants’ republic” to “people’s republic”. On 27 December Mao Zedong delivered “On Tactics against Japanese Imperialism”, setting out the theory and tactics of the united front. The conference resolved the political line left open by the Zunyi Conference and marked the turn from agrarian revolution to national revolutionary war. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 日本策动华北五省“自治”，南京国民政府被迫设立半独立性质的冀察政务委员会。
summary.en: Japan promoted “autonomy” in five North China provinces, forcing Nanjing to create the semi-autonomous Hebei-Chahar Political Council.

fields.name: 华北自治运动与冀察政务委员会成立 North China Autonomy Movement and the Hebei-Chahar Political Council
fields.summary: 日本策动华北五省“自治”，南京国民政府被迫设立半独立性质的冀察政务委员会。 Japan promoted “autonomy” in five North China provinces, forcing Nanjing to create the semi-autonomous Hebei-Chahar Political Council.
fields.description: 1935 年秋，日本策动华北五省“自治运动”，扶植殷汝耕在通州成立“冀东防共自治委员会”。南京国民政府在日本压力下于 12 月 18 日设立冀察政务委员会，由宋哲元任委员长，华北出现半独立局面。此举直接引发了一二·九与一二·一六运动。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 In autumn 1935 Japan promoted an “autonomy movement” across five North China provinces and sponsored Yin Rugeng’s “East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Council” at Tongzhou. Under Japanese pressure Nanjing established the Hebei-Chahar Political Council on 18 December, chaired by Song Zheyuan, leaving North China semi-autonomous. The move directly triggered the December Ninth and December Sixteenth movements. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

name.zh: 中共满洲省委撤销、四省委分设
name.en: Abolition of the Manchurian Provincial Committee

summary.zh: 1936年1月，中共满洲省委撤销，按游击区改设南满、东满、吉东、北满四个省委和哈尔滨特委，抗联各军失去统一领导。
summary.en: In January 1936 the Manchurian Provincial Committee was abolished and replaced by four regional committees plus a Harbin committee, leaving the United Army without unified leadership.

fields.name: 中共满洲省委撤销、四省委分设 Abolition of the Manchurian Provincial Committee
fields.place: 黑龙江哈尔滨 Harbin, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1936年1月，中共满洲省委撤销，按游击区改设南满、东满、吉东、北满四个省委和哈尔滨特委，抗联各军失去统一领导。 In January 1936 the Manchurian Provincial Committee was abolished and replaced by four regional committees plus a Harbin committee, leaving the United Army without unified leadership.
fields.description: 1934 年下半年以后，中共中央上海局遭破坏、红军主力长征，中共满洲省委与中央的联系中断；从 1935 年夏起，东北党组织与抗日武装改由中共驻共产国际代表团直接领导。1935 年 11 月，中共驻共产国际代表团决定撤销满洲省委，以四大游击区为中心改建南满、东满、吉东、北满四个省委及哈尔滨、哈东两个特委。1936 年 1 月初，代表团派韩守魁到东北传达；1 月 9 日，满洲省委被撤销，哈尔滨特委成立。同年 6 月，省委代表小骆向各地党部发出正式取消通知。实际成立情况：南满省委 1936 年 7 月（河里会议，魏拯民任书记）、北满临时省委 1936 年 9 月 18 日（汤原帽儿山，赵尚志任执委主席）、吉东省委 1937 年 3 月（依兰四道河子，宋一夫任书记）；东满省委未正式成立。这一改变加强了各游击区的独立领导，也使东北党组织与抗联各军失去像满洲省委那样的统一领导，只能由远在莫斯科、并不了解实情的代表团遥控，给后来的路线争论与组织处理埋下伏笔。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 After the Shanghai bureau of the Central Committee was destroyed in the second half of 1934 and the Red Army began its Long March, the Manchurian Provincial Committee lost contact with the centre; from summer 1935 the Manchurian party and resistance forces were directed by the CCP delegation to the Comintern. In November 1935 the delegation decided to abolish the provincial committee and replace it with four regional committees — South, East, Jidong and North Manchurian — plus Harbin and Hadong committees. In early January 1936 Han Shoukui was sent to convey the decision; on 9 January the provincial committee was abolished and the Harbin committee formed, and in June its representative “Xiao Luo” issued the formal notice of dissolution. In practice the South Manchurian committee was formed in July 1936 at the Heli conference under Wei Zhengmin, the North Manchurian provisional committee on 18 September 1936 at Mao’er Mountain in Tangyuan under Zhao Shangzhi, and the Jidong committee in March 1937 at Sidaohezi in Yilan under Song Yifu; the East Manchurian committee was never formally established. The change strengthened regional initiative but deprived the party and the armies of unified leadership, leaving them directed from distant Moscow by a delegation ignorant of local conditions — a root of later disputes and disciplinary purges. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.zh: 东北民众反日联合军总司令部成立
name.en: Founding of the Northeast People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army headquarters

summary.zh: 1936年1月28日，北满各抗日部队在汤原吉兴沟开会，成立东北民众反日联合军总司令部，赵尚志任总司令。
summary.en: On 28 January 1936 the North Manchurian resistance forces met at Jixinggou in Tangyuan and formed a joint headquarters under Zhao Shangzhi.

fields.name: 东北民众反日联合军总司令部成立 Founding of the Northeast People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army headquarters
fields.place: 黑龙江汤原吉兴沟 Jixinggou, Tangyuan, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1936年1月28日，北满各抗日部队在汤原吉兴沟开会，成立东北民众反日联合军总司令部，赵尚志任总司令。 On 28 January 1936 the North Manchurian resistance forces met at Jixinggou in Tangyuan and formed a joint headquarters under Zhao Shangzhi.
fields.description: 1936 年 1 月 26 日起，赵尚志、李延禄、张寿篯（李兆麟）、夏云杰、李华堂、谢文东、冯治纲、张传福等北满抗日部队领导人，在汤原吉兴沟（又作吉星沟、吉光沟）一带密营举行东北反日联合军军政扩大会议。1 月 28 日，会议决定成立东北民众反日联合军总司令部（后改称北满抗日联军总司令部），推赵尚志为总司令，李华堂为副总司令，张寿篯为总政治部主任；通过《东北民众反日联合军军政扩大联席会议决议》，决定成立东北反日联军临时政府，公布成立宣言、施政纲领与对日宣战通牒，并决定创办东北抗日联军政治军事学校。总司令部实际只辖北满第三、第四、第六军及谢文东、李华堂部，不包括第一、二、五、七军，1937 年北满临时省委曾专函说明这一点。这次会议为 2 月 20 日《东北抗日联军统一军队建制宣言》作了组织准备。日期异说：会议自 1 月 26 日起、1 月 28～29 日举行；本事件取 1 月 28 日（成立日）。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 From 26 January 1936 Zhao Shangzhi, Li Yanlu, Zhang Shouqian (Li Zhaolin), Xia Yunjie, Li Huatang, Xie Wendong, Feng Zhigang and Zhang Chuanfu met at secret camps around Jixinggou in Tangyuan for an enlarged military-political conference of the North Manchurian anti-Japanese forces. On 28 January they decided to form the Northeast People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army headquarters (later the North Manchurian United Army headquarters), with Zhao Shangzhi as commander-in-chief, Li Huatang as deputy and Zhang Shouqian as head of the political department; they adopted a resolution, decided to set up a provisional government, issued a manifesto, programme and declaration of war, and founded a military-political school. The headquarters in fact covered only the North Manchurian 3rd, 4th and 6th Armies and the forces of Xie Wendong and Li Huatang, not the 1st, 2nd, 5th and 7th Armies — a point the North Manchurian provisional committee made explicit in 1937. The meeting prepared the way for the 20 February declaration unifying the United Army. The conference ran from 26 January and sat on 28–29 January; this entry uses the 28th, the day of the headquarters’ formation. No route is drawn.

name.zh: 东北人民革命军第六军成立
name.en: Formation of the 6th Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army

summary.zh: 1936年1月30日，汤原反日游击总队改编为东北人民革命军第六军，夏云杰任军长，全军1000余人。
summary.en: On 30 January 1936 the Tangyuan guerrillas became the 6th Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army under Xia Yunjie, over 1,000 strong.

fields.name: 东北人民革命军第六军成立 Formation of the 6th Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army
fields.summary: 1936年1月30日，汤原反日游击总队改编为东北人民革命军第六军，夏云杰任军长，全军1000余人。 On 30 January 1936 the Tangyuan guerrillas became the 6th Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army under Xia Yunjie, over 1,000 strong.
fields.description: 第六军前身为 1932 年 10 月成立、几经挫折后于 1933 年 11 月重建的汤原反日游击队，1934 年 10 月扩编为汤原反日游击总队（总队长戴鸿宾、政委夏云杰）。1935 年 12 月，赵尚志率第三军军部到汤原，帮助游击总队改编。1936 年 1 月 30 日，汤原反日游击总队改编为东北人民革命军第六军，夏云杰任军长，李兆麟任代理政治部主任，冯治纲任参谋长，辖 4 个团，1000 余人。第六军以汤原为根据地，活动于汤旺河、萝北、绥滨等十余县，创建后方基地与军政学校，被称为「下江人民的子弟兵」。1936 年 9 月改编为东北抗日联军第六军，扩至 8 个团 1500 余人。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 The 6th Army began as the Tangyuan anti-Japanese guerrillas founded in October 1932, rebuilt in November 1933 and expanded into the Tangyuan guerrilla corps in October 1934 under Dai Hongbin with Xia Yunjie as commissar. In December 1935 Zhao Shangzhi brought the 3rd Army headquarters to Tangyuan to help reorganise it, and on 30 January 1936 the corps became the 6th Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army under Xia Yunjie, with Li Zhaolin as acting political director and Feng Zhigang as chief of staff — four regiments and over 1,000 men. Based at Tangyuan, it operated in the Tangwang River area, Luobei and Suibin and built a rear base and a military-political school, earning the name “the sons of the lower Songhua”. In September 1936 it became the United Army’s 6th Army with eight regiments and over 1,500 men. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

name.zh: 东北抗日联军统一建制
name.en: Founding of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army

summary.zh: 1936年2月20日，杨靖宇、赵尚志等发表《东北抗日联军统一军队建制宣言》，各抗日武装统一改称东北抗日联军。
summary.en: On 20 February 1936 Yang Jingyu, Zhao Shangzhi and others issued the declaration unifying the anti-Japanese forces as the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army.

fields.name: 东北抗日联军统一建制 Founding of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army
fields.summary: 1936年2月20日，杨靖宇、赵尚志等发表《东北抗日联军统一军队建制宣言》，各抗日武装统一改称东北抗日联军。 On 20 February 1936 Yang Jingyu, Zhao Shangzhi and others issued the declaration unifying the anti-Japanese forces as the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army.
fields.description: 九一八事变后，东北抗日武装经历义勇军（1931—1933）、反日游击队与东北人民革命军（1933—1936）两个阶段。1936 年 1 月 28 日，东北反日联合军军政联席会议在黑龙江汤原举行；2 月 20 日，以杨靖宇、王德泰、赵尚志、李延禄、周保中、谢文东及汤原、海伦游击队名义，发表《东北抗日联军统一军队建制宣言》，将东北人民革命军、反日联合军、反日游击队一律改称东北抗日联军。至 1937 年秋编成 11 个军，鼎盛时约 3 万至 4 万人（各说不一）；1936 年 7 月编成第一路军（杨靖宇），1937 年 10 月编成第二路军（周保中），1939 年 5 月编成第三路军（李兆麟）。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 After the Mukden Incident the anti-Japanese forces of the Northeast passed through the volunteer stage (1931–1933) and the guerrilla and People’s Revolutionary Army stage (1933–1936). On 28 January 1936 a joint military-political conference of the anti-Japanese forces met at Tangyuan in Heilongjiang; on 20 February, in the name of Yang Jingyu, Wang Detai, Zhao Shangzhi, Li Yanlu, Zhou Baozhong, Xie Wendong and the Tangyuan and Hailun guerrillas, the declaration unifying the army was issued, renaming the People’s Revolutionary Army, the Anti-Japanese Allied Army and the guerrillas as the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army. By autumn 1937 it fielded 11 armies and 30,000 to 40,000 men at its height (accounts differ); the 1st Route Army was formed in July 1936 under Yang Jingyu, the 2nd in October 1937 under Zhou Baozhong and the 3rd in May 1939 under Li Zhaolin. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.zh: 周恩来与张学良延安会谈
name.en: Zhou Enlai–Zhang Xueliang talks at Yan’an

summary.zh: 1936 年 4 月 9 日，周恩来与张学良在肤施（延安）秘密会谈，达成停止内战、共同抗日共识。
summary.en: On 9 April 1936 Zhou Enlai and Zhang Xueliang met secretly at Fushi (Yan’an) and agreed to stop the civil war and resist Japan together.

fields.name: 周恩来与张学良延安会谈 Zhou Enlai–Zhang Xueliang talks at Yan’an
fields.summary: 1936 年 4 月 9 日，周恩来与张学良在肤施（延安）秘密会谈，达成停止内战、共同抗日共识。 On 9 April 1936 Zhou Enlai and Zhang Xueliang met secretly at Fushi (Yan’an) and agreed to stop the civil war and resist Japan together.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 9 日晚，周恩来代表中共中央，与李克农等由瓦窑堡经川口进入东北军防地肤施（今延安），在桥儿沟天主教堂与张学良秘密会谈，至次日凌晨结束。张学良接受中共停止内战、共同抗日的主张，并提出争取蒋介石抗日的意见；双方商定红军与东北军互不侵犯、互派代表、通商等事项。这次会谈是土地革命时期中共核心领导成员与国民党地方高级将领的首次直接对话，为西北联合与西安事变和平解决准备了条件。4 月 7 日由瓦窑堡出发，4 月 9 日会谈。 On the night of 9 April 1936 Zhou Enlai, representing the CCP Central Committee, entered the Northeast Army’s lines at Fushi (present-day Yan’an) with Li Kenong and others and met Zhang Xueliang secretly in the Qiaoergou Catholic church until the early hours. Zhang accepted the Communist proposal to stop the civil war and resist Japan, and argued for drawing Chiang Kai-shek into the front. The two sides agreed on non-aggression between the Red Army and the Northeast Army, mutual representatives and trade. It was the first direct contact between a core CCP leader and a senior Nationalist regional commander during the land revolution, preparing the way for the northwest alliance and the peaceful settlement of the Xi’an Incident.

fields.name: 两广事变 Liangguang Incident
fields.summary: 陈济棠、李宗仁等以“北上抗日”为号召反蒋，事变后和平解决。 Chen Jitang and Li Zongren moved against Chiang Kai-shek under the banner of “marching north to resist Japan”; the incident was resolved peacefully.
fields.description: 1936 年 6 月，广东陈济棠与广西李宗仁、白崇禧联合反蒋，组织“抗日救国军”北上，史称两广事变。蒋介石分化瓦解，陈济棠部将余汉谋倒戈，7 月陈济棠下野，事变和平解决，两广重归南京国民政府统辖。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 In June 1936 Chen Jitang of Guangdong joined Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi of Guangxi against Chiang Kai-shek, forming a “Anti-Japanese National Salvation Army” and marching north; the episode is known as the Liangguang Incident. Chiang undermined the coalition, Chen’s subordinate Yu Hanmou defected, and Chen stepped down in July. The incident ended peacefully and the two provinces returned to Nanjing’s authority. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 东北抗联第一路军成立 Formation of the 1st Route Army
fields.place: 吉林金川河里（今辉南） Heli, Jinchuan (modern Huinan), Jilin
fields.summary: 1936年7月，杨靖宇、魏拯民在金川河里召开联席会议，将抗联第一、第二军合编为东北抗日联军第一路军。 In July 1936 Yang Jingyu and Wei Zhengmin met at Heli in Jinchuan and merged the 1st and 2nd Armies into the 1st Route Army.
fields.description: 1936 年 6 月，抗联第二军政委魏拯民率一个连到达金川县河里地区，与第一军军长杨靖宇会师。7 月初，中共南满第二次代表大会在河里密营召开，正式宣布东北人民革命军第一军改编为东北抗日联军第一军，杨靖宇任军长兼政委；接着召开南满、东满特委及第一、第二军领导干部联席会议（「河里会议」），决定将两军合编为东北抗日联军第一路军，成立总司令部：总司令兼政委杨靖宇，副总司令王德泰，总政治部主任魏拯民，参谋长安光勋；下辖第一、第二军共 6 个师，1937 年初统计约 1.5 万人（一说 5000 人）。会议同时决定东、南满两个特委合并为中共南满省委（亦称东南满省委），魏拯民任书记。日期取 7 月初，确切日期待考。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 In June 1936 Wei Zhengmin, political commissar of the 2nd Army, reached the Heli area of Jinchuan county with one company and joined Yang Jingyu, commander of the 1st Army. In early July the second South Manchurian party congress met at the Heli base and formally renamed the 1st Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army as the 1st Army of the United Army, with Yang as commander and commissar; a joint meeting of the South and East Manchurian committees and the two armies’ leaders — the “Heli conference” — then merged them into the 1st Route Army with a general headquarters: Yang Jingyu as commander and commissar, Wang Detai as deputy, Wei Zhengmin as head of the political department and An Guangxun as chief of staff, commanding six divisions in two armies, some 15,000 men by early 1937 (another account says 5,000). The meeting also merged the two committees into the South Manchurian (South-East Manchurian) provincial committee under Wei. The date is given as early July; the exact day is unknown. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

fields.name: 摩天岭战斗 The Motianling battle
fields.place: 辽宁本溪摩天岭 Motianling, Benxi, Liaoning
fields.summary: 1936年7月15日，抗联第一军第一师西征回撤途中在摩天岭伏击日军连山关守备队，歼今田大尉以下约50人，师参谋长李敏焕牺牲。 On 15 July 1936 the 1st Division of the 1st Army, withdrawing from its westward expedition, ambushed the Japanese Lianshanguan garrison at Motianling, killing Lieutenant Imada and about fifty men; chief of staff Li Minhuan was killed.
fields.description: 1936 年 6 月，杨靖宇在草河掌密营召开师以上干部会议，决定抗联第一军第一师西征，试图打通与关内红军的联系。6 月 28 日，一师政治部主任宋铁岩、师长程斌、参谋长李敏焕率师部、保卫连、少年营和第三团 300 余人自本溪蒲石河出发。西征在辽阳、岫岩一带受挫，7 月 8 日决定分三路撤回本溪。7 月 15 日上午，程斌、李敏焕所率师部 70 余人撤至辽阳与本溪交界的摩天岭，与尾追的日军连山关守备队第二中队遭遇，抢占制高点「对面炕」山梁伏击，歼今田大尉以下约 50 人，仅 1 名翻译逃脱。随后 1000 余名日伪军赶到，将一师包围；激战至下午 4 时，李敏焕接替牺牲的机枪手射击时胸部中弹牺牲，年 23 岁。当晚部队在群众引导下突围，7 月中旬返回蒲石河。战果异说：毙敌 48 人（中国军网）、50 余人（《辽宁日报》2020）、80 余人（人民网转《辽宁日报》2014）。本事件为伏击战，不绘路线。 In June 1936 Yang Jingyu held a conference of divisional commanders at the Caohezhang base and ordered the 1st Division of the 1st Army westward to link up with the Red Army inside the Great Wall. On 28 June Song Tieyan, the division’s political director, commander Cheng Bin and chief of staff Li Minhuan set out from Pushihe in Benxi with over 300 men of the headquarters, guard company, youth battalion and 3rd Regiment. The expedition stalled around Liaoyang and Xiuyan, and on 8 July it split into three columns to withdraw. On the morning of 15 July Cheng and Li’s party of seventy-odd reached Motianling on the Liaoyang–Benxi border and ran into the pursuing 2nd Company of the Lianshanguan garrison; they seized the “Duimiankang” ridge and ambushed it, killing Lieutenant Imada and about fifty men, with only an interpreter escaping. Over 1,000 Japanese and puppet troops then arrived and surrounded the division; at about four in the afternoon Li Minhuan, firing a machine gun in place of a fallen gunner, was shot in the chest and killed, aged 23. The survivors slipped out that night and returned to Pushihe in mid-July. Casualty figures differ: 48 killed (China Military Online), over 50 (Liaoning Daily, 2020), over 80 (People’s Daily Online reprinting Liaoning Daily, 2014). No route is drawn.

fields.name: 赵一曼牺牲 Execution of Zhao Yiman
fields.place: 吉林珠河（今尚志） Zhuhe (modern Shangzhi), Jilin
fields.summary: 1936年8月2日，东北人民革命军第三军一师二团政委赵一曼在珠河县小北门就义，年31岁。 On 2 August 1936 Zhao Yiman, political commissar of a regiment of the 3rd Army, was executed at the lesser north gate of Zhuhe; she was 31.
fields.description: 赵一曼原名李坤泰，1905 年生于四川宜宾，1926 年转入中国共产党，曾在黄埔军校武汉分校、莫斯科中山大学学习。九一八事变后被派往东北，任满洲总工会秘书、组织部长、哈尔滨总工会代理书记；1934 年 7 月任中共珠河中心县委委员，1935 年秋兼任东北人民革命军第三军一师二团政治委员。1935 年 11 月，在珠河县第三区春秋岭（一说小西北沟）战斗中为掩护部队突围身负重伤，养伤时被俘；在伪满哈尔滨警察厅受酷刑九月余，1936 年 6 月 28 日在看守董宪勋、护士韩勇义帮助下逃出医院，30 日再度被捕。1936 年 8 月 2 日在珠河县小北门就义，年 31 岁。押解途中给七岁儿子写下遗书：「母亲不用千言万语来教育你，就用实行来教育你。」本事件不绘路线。 Zhao Yiman, born Li Kuntai in Yibin, Sichuan, in 1905, joined the Communist Party in 1926 and studied at the Wuhan branch of the Whampoa Military Academy and at Sun Yat-sen University in Moscow. After the Mukden Incident she was sent to the Northeast, serving as secretary and organisation chief of the Manchurian trade union council and acting secretary of the Harbin council; in July 1934 she joined the Zhuhe county committee, and in autumn 1935 became political commissar of the 2nd Regiment, 1st Division, 3rd Army of the Northeast People’s Revolutionary Army. In November 1935 she was badly wounded covering a breakout at Chunqiuling (some accounts say Xiaoxibeigou) in the third district of Zhuhe and captured while recovering; tortured for over nine months at the puppet Harbin police headquarters, she escaped on 28 June 1936 with the help of the guard Dong Xianxun and the nurse Han Yongyi, and was retaken on the 30th. She was executed at the lesser north gate of Zhuhe on 2 August 1936, aged 31, having written on the way to her seven-year-old son: “I need not preach to you at length; I teach you by what I do.” No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1936 年 8 月 25 日，中共中央致书国民党，倡议在抗日目标下实行第二次国共合作。
summary.en: On 25 August 1936 the CCP Central Committee wrote to the Kuomintang proposing a second united front against Japan.

fields.name: 中共中央《中国共产党致中国国民党书》 CCP letter to the Kuomintang, August 1936
fields.summary: 1936 年 8 月 25 日，中共中央致书国民党，倡议在抗日目标下实行第二次国共合作。 On 25 August 1936 the CCP Central Committee wrote to the Kuomintang proposing a second united front against Japan.
fields.description: 1936 年 8 月 25 日，中共中央在保安发出《中国共产党致中国国民党书》，倡议在抗日的大目标下，国共两党实行第二次合作。信中承认蒋介石在国民党五届二中全会上对「和平的绝望时期」和「牺牲的最后关头」的解释较过去有若干进步，同时指出仍不能满足全国人民要求；郑重申明赞助建立统一的民主共和国、召集普选国会、拥护全国统一的国防政府，并表示愿派全权代表与国民党代表谈判，订立抗日救国具体协定。这是中共中央第一次发表主张实行第二次国共合作的正式文件。本事件为政策文件，不绘路线。 On 25 August 1936 the CCP Central Committee at Bao’an issued “The Chinese Communist Party’s Letter to the Chinese Kuomintang”, proposing a second KMT–CCP cooperation for resistance. It acknowledged some progress in Chiang Kai-shek’s remarks at the KMT Second Plenum on the “last moment of peace” and the “final moment of sacrifice”, while saying they still fell short of national demands. The letter endorsed a unified democratic republic, a popularly elected national assembly and a national defence government, and offered to send plenipotentiaries to conclude a concrete anti-Japanese agreement. It was the Central Committee’s first formal document advocating the second united front. No route is drawn.

name.en: CCP directive on pressuring Chiang to resist Japan

summary.zh: 1936 年 9 月 1 日，中共中央发出党内指示，将「抗日反蒋」改为「逼蒋抗日」。
summary.en: On 1 September 1936 the CCP Central Committee replaced “resist Japan and oppose Chiang” with “pressure Chiang to resist Japan”.

fields.name: 中共中央《关于逼蒋抗日问题的指示》 CCP directive on pressuring Chiang to resist Japan
fields.summary: 1936 年 9 月 1 日，中共中央发出党内指示，将「抗日反蒋」改为「逼蒋抗日」。 On 1 September 1936 the CCP Central Committee replaced “resist Japan and oppose Chiang” with “pressure Chiang to resist Japan”.
fields.description: 1936 年 9 月 1 日，中共中央向党内发出《关于逼蒋抗日问题的指示》，指出当前中国的主要敌人是日本帝国主义，把日本帝国主义与蒋介石同等看待是错误的，「抗日反蒋」的口号也是不适当的；总方针应是「逼蒋抗日」，即一方面继续揭露蒋介石对日妥协退让的言行，另一方面向他提议建立抗日统一战线、举行两党谈判、订立抗日协定，同时不放弃联合各派抗日力量。9 月 17 日，中共中央又发出《关于抗日救亡运动的新形势与民主共和国的决议》。这一转变是西安事变前党的统一战线政策的重大调整。本事件为政策文件，不绘路线。 On 1 September 1936 the CCP Central Committee issued an internal directive on pressuring Chiang Kai-shek to resist Japan. It stated that Japan was the principal enemy, that equating Japan with Chiang was wrong, and that the slogan “resist Japan and oppose Chiang” was no longer appropriate. The general line was to “pressure Chiang to resist Japan”: continue exposing his concessions to Japan while proposing a united front, negotiations and an anti-Japanese agreement, without giving up unity with other anti-Japanese forces. On 17 September the Central Committee issued a further resolution on the new situation and a democratic republic. The shift was a major adjustment before the Xi’an Incident. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1936年11月7日，抗联第一路军副总司令兼第二军军长王德泰在抚松小汤河战斗中牺牲，年29岁。

fields.name: 王德泰牺牲 Death of Wang Detai
fields.place: 吉林抚松小汤河（今白山江源） Xiaotanghe, Fusong (modern Jiangyuan, Baishan), Jilin
fields.summary: 1936年11月7日，抗联第一路军副总司令兼第二军军长王德泰在抚松小汤河战斗中牺牲，年29岁。 On 7 November 1936 Wang Detai, deputy commander of the 1st Route Army and commander of the 2nd Army, was killed at Xiaotanghe in Fusong; he was 29.
fields.description: 王德泰 1907 年生于辽宁盖平（一说营口），九一八后参加延吉抗日游击队，1934 年任东北人民革命军第二军独立师政委，1935 年 5 月任第二军军长。1936 年 3 月第二军改编为东北抗日联军第二军，仍任军长；7 月第一路军成立，任副总司令兼第二军军长、中共南满省委委员。1936 年 11 月初，王德泰率第四师两个团及第六师一部在临江大阳岔解除伪军两个连武装，随后到抚松、濛江交界的小汤河村召开二军干部会议。11 月 7 日拂晓，日伪军 600 余人自抚松、濛江两地来袭，抢占小汤河南山制高点。王德泰指挥 200 余人分守东西山头，并派一个连绕到敌后夹击，战至下午 3 时毙伤敌 60 至 70 人，追击时中弹牺牲，年 29 岁。日期异说：吉林省人民政府、抗联大事年表、吉林日报均记 11 月 7 日；中华英烈网与部分资料记 11 月 25 日。本事件取 11 月 7 日，并存异说。本事件不绘路线。 Wang Detai, born in 1907 at Gaiping (some sources say Yingkou) in Liaoning, joined the Yanji guerrillas after the Mukden Incident, became political commissar of the 2nd Army’s independent division in 1934 and its commander in May 1935. When the 2nd Army became the United Army’s 2nd Army in March 1936 he remained its commander, and in July he became deputy commander of the 1st Route Army while retaining the 2nd Army and a seat on the South Manchurian provincial committee. In early November 1936 he disarmed two puppet companies at Dayangcha in Linjiang and then went to Xiaotanghe on the Fusong–Mengjiang border for a corps conference. At dawn on 7 November over 600 Japanese and puppet troops attacked from Fusong and Mengjiang and seized the high ground south of the village; Wang deployed some 200 men on the east and west hills and sent a company round the enemy’s rear, and after fighting until three in the afternoon with 60 to 70 enemy casualties he was shot dead while pursuing, aged 29. The date is disputed: the Jilin provincial government, the United Army chronology and Jilin Daily give 7 November, while the China Martyrs network and some other accounts give 25 November; this entry follows 7 November and notes the variant. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 日军策动伪蒙军进攻绥远 Japanese-Backed Mengjiang Invasion of Suiyuan
fields.summary: 日本关东军策动伪蒙军自商都进攻绥远，傅作义部奋起抵抗。 The Kwantung Army directed Mengjiang forces from Shangdu against Suiyuan, where Fu Zuoyi’s troops resisted.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月，日本关东军策动德王所属伪蒙军自商都一带西进，进攻绥远东部。绥远省主席傅作义率晋绥军迎战，先后取得红格尔图与百灵庙战斗的胜利。绥远抗战得到全国各界慰问与支援，成为西安事变前抗日情绪高涨的重要背景。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 In November 1936 the Kwantung Army directed Prince De’s Mengjiang forces westward from the Shangdu area against eastern Suiyuan. Suiyuan chairman Fu Zuoyi led Shanxi-Suiyuan troops to meet them and won the battles of Honggeertu and Bailingmiao. The Suiyuan campaign drew nationwide support and helped raise anti-Japanese sentiment before the Xi’an Incident. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 红格尔图战斗 Battle of Honggeertu
fields.place: 绥远红格尔图 Honggeertu, Suiyuan
fields.summary: 傅作义部在红格尔图击退伪蒙军进攻，绥远抗战由此展开。 Fu Zuoyi’s forces repelled the Mengjiang attack at Honggeertu, opening the Suiyuan campaign.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 15 日，伪蒙军在日本顾问指挥下进攻红格尔图。傅作义部骑兵与守军协同反击，经数日激战将其击退，毙伤俘敌数百人。红格尔图战斗是绥远抗战的首场胜利，为随后收复百灵庙创造了条件。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 15 November 1936 Mengjiang troops under Japanese advisers attacked Honggeertu. Fu Zuoyi’s cavalry and garrison counterattacked and, after several days of fighting, drove them back with hundreds of casualties and prisoners. The victory at Honggeertu opened the Suiyuan campaign and paved the way for the recovery of Bailingmiao. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 百灵庙大捷 Victory at Bailingmiao
fields.summary: 傅作义部奇袭百灵庙，取得绥远抗战决定性胜利，全国慰问运动高涨。 Fu Zuoyi’s surprise attack on Bailingmiao won a decisive victory in the Suiyuan campaign and triggered nationwide support.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 23 日夜，傅作义部在严寒中长途奔袭百灵庙，经一夜激战于 24 日攻克该地，歼灭伪蒙军一部并缴获大量物资。百灵庙大捷震动全国，各界纷纷组织慰问与捐款，成为绥远抗战的标志性胜利。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On the night of 23 November 1936 Fu Zuoyi’s troops marched through severe cold to surprise Bailingmiao and, after a night of fighting, took it on 24 November, destroying part of the Mengjiang force and capturing large quantities of supplies. The victory caused a national sensation, with organizations across the country sending condolences and donations, and became the emblematic success of the Suiyuan campaign. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 七君子事件 Seven Gentlemen Incident
fields.summary: 沈钧儒等七位救国会领袖在上海被捕，引发全国抗议。 Seven leaders of the National Salvation Association, including Shen Junru, were arrested in Shanghai, prompting nationwide protests.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 23 日，南京国民政府以“危害民国”罪名在上海逮捕沈钧儒、章乃器、邹韬奋、李公朴、沙千里、史良、王造时七位救国会领袖，史称“七君子事件”。事件激起全国各界抗议，进一步推动了抗日救亡运动。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 23 November 1936 the Nanjing government arrested seven leaders of the National Salvation Association in Shanghai—Shen Junru, Zhang Naiqi, Zou Taofen, Li Gongpu, Sha Qianli, Shi Liang, and Wang Zaoshi—on charges of “endangering the Republic.” Known as the Seven Gentlemen Incident, the arrests provoked nationwide protests and further strengthened the national salvation movement. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 夏云杰牺牲 Death of Xia Yunjie
fields.place: 黑龙江汤原丁大千屯 Dingdaqian, Tangyuan, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1936年11月26日，抗联第六军军长夏云杰在汤原遭伏击重伤后牺牲，年33岁。 On 26 November 1936 Xia Yunjie, commander of the 6th Army, died of wounds after being ambushed at Tangyuan; he was 33.
fields.description: 夏云杰 1903 年生于山东沂水，1926 年闯关东到汤原，1932 年参加抗日，后任汤原反日游击总队政委。1936 年 1 月汤原游击总队改编为东北人民革命军第六军，任军长；9 月改编为东北抗日联军第六军，部队扩至 8 个团 1500 余人，并当选中共北满临时省委委员。1936 年 10 月起，日伪军对汤原根据地大「讨伐」。夏云杰决定主力远征佛山（今嘉荫），在筹备给养时于 11 月 20 日（一说 21 日）在汤原丁大千屯遭伪治安队伏击，身负重伤，因无药医治于 26 日牺牲，年 33 岁。临终前嘱咐战友、妻子和女儿「精诚团结，把抗日民族解放斗争进行到底」。本事件不绘路线。 Xia Yunjie, born at Yishui in Shandong in 1903, went to Tangyuan in 1926, joined the resistance in 1932 and became political commissar of the Tangyuan guerrilla group. In January 1936 the group became the 6th Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army under his command, and in September it was renamed the United Army’s 6th Army with eight regiments and over 1,500 men; he was also elected to the North Manchurian provisional provincial committee. From October 1936 the Japanese campaigned against the Tangyuan base. Xia decided to take the main force to Fushan (modern Jiayin) and, while gathering supplies, was ambushed by puppet police at Dingdaqian on 20 (some say 21) November and mortally wounded; without medicine he died on the 26th, aged 33. He told his comrades, wife and daughter to stay united and carry the struggle through. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 西安事变 Xi’an Incident
fields.summary: 张学良、杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，促成停止内战、联共抗日的转折。 Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, leading to a turn toward ending the civil war and resisting Japan.
fields.description: 1936 年 12 月 12 日，东北军将领张学良与第十七路军将领杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，要求停止内战、一致抗日。经多方斡旋，事变和平解决，为抗日民族统一战线的形成创造了条件。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 12 December 1936, Zhang Xueliang of the Northeast Army and Yang Hucheng of the 17th Route Army detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, demanding an end to the civil war and united resistance against Japan. The incident was resolved peacefully, helping pave the way for the anti-Japanese united front. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 周恩来赴西安调停 Zhou Enlai goes to Xi’an to mediate
fields.summary: 西安事变后，中共中央派周恩来等赴西安，主张和平解决、逼蒋抗日。 After the Xi’an Incident the CCP sent Zhou Enlai to Xi’an to work for a peaceful settlement and a united front against Japan.
fields.description: 1936 年 12 月 12 日西安事变爆发后，张学良电告中共中央。中共中央决定派周恩来、秦邦宪、叶剑英等赴西安。12 月 17 日，周恩来等乘张学良专机飞抵西安，当晚与张学良长谈，次日会见杨虎城，分析对蒋介石的不同处置会导致截然不同的前途，力主在蒋介石答应停止内战、一致抗日的条件下和平解决。随后周恩来与宋子文、宋美龄等谈判，推动事变和平解决，为第二次国共合作创造了前提。12 月 15 日由保安出发，经延安于 17 日抵西安。 After the Xi’an Incident broke out on 12 December 1936, Zhang Xueliang telegraphed the CCP Central Committee. The Central Committee sent Zhou Enlai, Qin Bangxian and Ye Jianying to Xi’an. Zhou flew in on Zhang’s aircraft on 17 December, talked with Zhang that night and met Yang Hucheng the next day, arguing that different ways of handling Chiang would lead to radically different outcomes and pressing for a peaceful settlement on condition that Chiang stop the civil war and resist Japan. Zhou then negotiated with T. V. Soong and Song Meiling, helping to bring the incident to a peaceful close and creating the precondition for the second KMT–CCP united front.

fields.name: 中共中央领导机关由保安迁驻延安 CCP Central Committee moves from Bao’an to Yan’an
fields.summary: 1937 年 1 月 13 日，中共中央领导机关由保安迁驻延安，延安成为抗战时期中共中央所在地。 On 13 January 1937 the CCP Central Committee moved from Bao’an to Yan’an, which became its headquarters during the war.
fields.description: 1937 年 1 月 13 日，中共中央领导机关由保安（今志丹）迁驻延安。此后至 1947 年 3 月，延安一直是中共中央所在地，也是敌后抗战的政治指导中心。中央机关先驻凤凰山麓，1938 年 11 月后移驻杨家岭，1943 年起部分领导人迁往枣园。中共中央在延安期间召开瓦窑堡会议之后的多次重要会议，创办抗日军政大学、中央党校等，形成延安整风与大生产运动的中心。本事件为组织迁移，线路见 ccp 层「保安—延安」。 On 13 January 1937 the CCP Central Committee moved from Bao’an (present-day Zhidan) to Yan’an. Until March 1947 Yan’an remained the seat of the Central Committee and the political directing centre of the resistance behind Japanese lines. The offices first stood at the foot of Fenghuang Mountain, moved to Yangjialing after November 1938, and from 1943 some leaders worked at Zaoyuan. During the Yan’an years the Party held numerous important meetings, founded the Anti-Japanese Military and Political University and the Central Party School, and made the city the centre of the rectification movement and the great production campaign.

summary.zh: 1937年1月28日，抗联第五军副军长柴世荣率800余人在刁翎大盘道伏击日军爬犁队，歼敌360余人。
summary.en: On 28 January 1937 Chai Shirong’s 800 men of the 5th Army ambushed a Japanese sledge convoy at Dapandao near Diaoling, wiping out over 360 troops.

fields.name: 大盘道伏击战 The Dapandao ambush
fields.place: 吉林勃利刁翎（今林口）大盘道 Dapandao, Diaoling, Boli (modern Linkou), Jilin
fields.summary: 1937年1月28日，抗联第五军副军长柴世荣率800余人在刁翎大盘道伏击日军爬犁队，歼敌360余人。 On 28 January 1937 Chai Shirong’s 800 men of the 5th Army ambushed a Japanese sledge convoy at Dapandao near Diaoling, wiping out over 360 troops.
fields.description: 1937 年 1 月下旬，驻后刁翎日军 300 余人强征爬犁 200 余张，准备撤往林口。当地抗日救国会将日军 1 月 28 日出发的情报送给抗联第五军。副军长柴世荣判断：300 余人只需七八十张爬犁，征 200 张说明还押运大量军用物资、行动必然笨重，遂决定在大盘道设伏。1 月 27 日夜，第五军第二师第五团、军部警卫营、青年义勇军和妇女团共 800 余人自徐家屯出发，28 日凌晨进入阵地：五团与警卫营伏于大道两侧，青年义勇军与妇女团守北山断敌退路。28 日午后 1 时，日军爬犁队进入伏击圈，激战至下午 4 时，日军 360 余人被歼（一说 300 余人），生俘 28 人，缴获全部武器弹药与 200 余张爬犁的军需物资。此役使驻刁翎日伪军一度不敢出扰。地名说明：刁翎在 1939 年设林口县前属勃利县（一说依兰县），本事件写「勃利刁翎」。本事件为伏击战，不绘路线。 In late January 1937 over 300 Japanese troops at Hou Diaoling requisitioned more than 200 sledges to move to Linkou. The local anti-Japanese national salvation association passed word to the 5th Army that they would leave on 28 January. Deputy commander Chai Shirong reasoned that 300 men needed only seventy or eighty sledges, so 200 meant heavy supplies and slow movement, and decided to ambush them at Dapandao. On the night of 27 January over 800 men — the 5th Regiment of the 2nd Division, the headquarters guard battalion, the Youth Volunteers and the Women’s Regiment — moved from Xujiatun and took up positions before dawn on the 28th, with the 5th Regiment and guard battalion along the road and the volunteers and women on the northern hill to cut off retreat. At about one in the afternoon the convoy entered the trap; by four o’clock over 360 Japanese (another account says over 300) had been killed and 28 captured, with all weapons and some 200 sledge-loads of supplies taken. The action kept the Diaoling garrison from venturing out for a time. Diaoling belonged to Boli county before Linkou was created in 1939 (some sources say Yilan), hence “Diaoling, Boli”. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 中共中央致电国民党五届三中全会 CCP telegram to the KMT Third Plenum
fields.summary: 1937 年 2 月 10 日，中共中央致电国民党五届三中全会，提出五项要求与四项保证。 On 10 February 1937 the CCP Central Committee sent the KMT Third Plenum five demands and four pledges.
fields.description: 1937 年 2 月 10 日，中共中央致电国民党五届三中全会，提出五项要求：停止内战、一致对外；保障言论、集会、结社自由，释放一切政治犯；召开各党各派各界各军代表会议，集中全国人才共同救国；迅速完成对日作战的一切准备；改善人民生活。同时提出四项保证：停止武力推翻国民党政府的方针；工农政府改名为中华民国特区政府，红军改名为国民革命军；特区实行彻底民主制度；停止没收地主土地的政策。这是西安事变后中共推动国共合作的具体方案，为杭州、庐山谈判的基础。本事件为政策文件，不绘路线。 On 10 February 1937 the CCP Central Committee telegraphed the KMT Third Plenum with five demands — stop the civil war and unite against Japan; guarantee freedoms of speech, assembly and association and release political prisoners; convene a conference of all parties, groups, sectors and armies; complete preparations for war with Japan; improve living standards — and four pledges: abandon the policy of overthrowing the National Government by force; rename the workers’ and peasants’ government the Special Region government and the Red Army the National Revolutionary Army; introduce full democracy in the Special Region; and stop confiscating landlords’ land. The telegram became the basis for the Hangzhou and Lushan negotiations. No route is drawn.
