fields.name: 陈荣久牺牲 Death of Chen Rongjiu
fields.place: 吉林饶河小南河天津班 Tianjinban, Xiaonanhe, Raohe, Jilin
fields.summary: 1937年3月6日，抗联第七军军长陈荣久在饶河天津班掩护部队突围时牺牲，年33岁。 On 6 March 1937 Chen Rongjiu, commander of the 7th Army, was killed covering a breakout at Tianjinban in Raohe; he was 33.
fields.description: 陈荣久 1904 年生于宁安东京城，九一八后参加救国军，1933 年加入中国共产党，1934 年赴莫斯科东方大学学习。1936 年回国后以东北人民革命军第四军第二师为基础组建东北抗日联军第七军，11 月 15 日在饶河抱马顶子宣布成立，任军长兼第一师师长。1937 年春，日伪军对虎林、饶河游击区发动春季「讨伐」。3 月 6 日，陈荣久率 150 余人在饶河县小南河天津班一带活动，因叛徒出卖被 300 余名日军与伪警察包围，激战 3 个多小时，毙伤敌数十人（一说毙日军饶河参事官大穗久雄以下 40 余人），掩护部队突围时中弹牺牲，年 33 岁。第七军随后在抱马顶子召开代表会议，由崔石泉代理军长。本事件不绘路线。 Chen Rongjiu, born at Dongjingcheng in Ning’an in 1904, joined the National Salvation Army after the Mukden Incident, joined the Communist Party in 1933 and studied at the Oriental University in Moscow in 1934. Returning in 1936 he built the 7th Army on the basis of the 2nd Division of the 4th Army and proclaimed it at Baomadingzi in Raohe on 15 November, commanding it and its 1st Division. In spring 1937 the Japanese campaigned in the Hulin–Raohe area. On 6 March Chen was at Tianjinban on the Xiaonan River with over 150 men when, betrayed, he was surrounded by more than 300 Japanese and puppet police; after over three hours of fighting with dozens of enemy casualties (one account says over forty including the Raohe adviser Ōtsubo Hisao) he was shot dead covering the breakout, aged 33. The 7th Army meeting at Baomadingzi then made Cui Shiquan acting commander. No route is drawn.

place.zh: 黑龙江通北（今北安）冰趟子

summary.zh: 1937年3月7日，赵尚志率抗联第三军300余人在通北冰趟子伏击日伪军800余人，毙伤300余人，自己牺牲7人。
summary.en: On 7 March 1937 Zhao Shangzhi’s 300 men ambushed over 800 Japanese and puppet troops at Bingtangzi in Tongbei, killing or wounding more than 300 for the loss of seven.

fields.name: 冰趟子战斗 The Bingtangzi ambush
fields.place: 黑龙江通北（今北安）冰趟子 Bingtangzi, Tongbei (modern Bei’an), Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1937年3月7日，赵尚志率抗联第三军300余人在通北冰趟子伏击日伪军800余人，毙伤300余人，自己牺牲7人。 On 7 March 1937 Zhao Shangzhi’s 300 men ambushed over 800 Japanese and puppet troops at Bingtangzi in Tongbei, killing or wounding more than 300 for the loss of seven.
fields.description: 1936 年下半年起，日军对松花江下游抗联大举「讨伐」。1937 年 2 月，抗联第三军军长赵尚志率 300 余人西征，进至海伦、通北交界山区，前有各县讨伐队阻截、后有日伪军追击。赵尚志先在通北东山一处山路狭窄、两侧树林茂密处设伏，毙伤尾追之敌 30 余人；随后转至通北县城东的「冰趟子」。此处有 4 座伐木工人木营，车道北为山泉结成的冰甸子，车道南是长满杂木的小山。3 月 7 日，日军竹内部队守田大尉及伪军 800 余人进入伏击圈，在冰面上站立不稳，队形大乱，连续三次进攻均被击退；一股日军一度占领左侧木营，被少年连夺回。战至夜间气温骤降，日军枪栓冻住、趴卧冰上冻伤严重，撤退时又在沟口被截击。战果：毙伤日伪军 300 余人，其中毙 200 余人（含守田大尉等 7 名军官），抗联牺牲 7 人；另一说毙 200 余人、冻伤 100 余人。此役为抗联第三军成立以来对日作战的最大一次胜利。本事件为伏击战，不绘路线。 From the second half of 1936 the Japanese mounted a large “punitive campaign” against the United Army in the lower Songhua valley. In February 1937 Zhao Shangzhi, commander of the 3rd Army, led some 300 men west, reaching the mountains between Hailun and Tongbei with county punitive units ahead and Japanese and puppet troops behind. Zhao first ambushed the pursuers in a narrow, wooded defile east of Tongbei, killing or wounding over thirty, then moved to Bingtangzi east of the county town — four timber workers’ cabins, a sheet of spring ice north of the track and a scrub-covered hill to the south. On 7 March more than 800 Japanese under Lieutenant Osada (Hattori’s unit) and puppet troops entered the trap, lost their footing and formation on the ice, and were thrown back three times; a party that briefly took the left-hand cabin was driven out by the Young Soldiers’ Company. As the night temperature fell the Japanese bolts froze and the wounded froze on the ice, and the retreating column was again cut up at the mouth of the gully. More than 300 were killed or wounded, including over 200 dead and seven officers such as Lieutenant Osada, against seven United Army dead; another account gives over 200 dead and 100 frostbitten. It was the 3rd Army’s greatest victory over the Japanese to that date. This was an ambush; no route is drawn.

name.zh: 周恩来与蒋介石杭州会谈
name.en: Zhou Enlai–Chiang Kai-shek talks at Hangzhou

summary.zh: 1937 年 3 月 26 日，周恩来在杭州与蒋介石会谈，双方就国共合作达成初步共识。
summary.en: On 26 March 1937 Zhou Enlai met Chiang Kai-shek at Hangzhou and reached a preliminary understanding on cooperation.

fields.name: 周恩来与蒋介石杭州会谈 Zhou Enlai–Chiang Kai-shek talks at Hangzhou
fields.summary: 1937 年 3 月 26 日，周恩来在杭州与蒋介石会谈，双方就国共合作达成初步共识。 On 26 March 1937 Zhou Enlai met Chiang Kai-shek at Hangzhou and reached a preliminary understanding on cooperation.
fields.description: 1937 年 3 月下旬，周恩来、潘汉年在张冲陪同下经上海到杭州。3 月 26 日，蒋介石在西湖澄庐接见周恩来。周恩来重申中共对国共合作的立场，提出六项具体要求：陕甘宁边区为完整行政区、红军改编后人数须达四万余人、三个师之上设总部、国民党不派副佐及政训人员、红军学校办完本期、红军防地须增加。蒋介石表示这些「容易解决」，并同意由中共起草共同纲领，但强调「不要提与国民党合作，只与他本人合作」。会谈达成初步共识，为庐山谈判与第二次国共合作打下基础。 In late March 1937 Zhou Enlai and Pan Hannian travelled via Shanghai to Hangzhou. On 26 March Chiang Kai-shek received Zhou at Chenglu by West Lake. Zhou restated the CCP position and made six concrete requests: the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region to remain an integral administrative area; the Red Army to number over 40,000 after reorganisation; a general headquarters above the three divisions; no KMT deputy commanders or political training staff; the Red Army school to finish its current course; and additional garrison areas. Chiang called these “easy to settle” and agreed that the CCP should draft a common programme, while insisting that cooperation be with him personally rather than with the Kuomintang. The talks produced a preliminary understanding and prepared the Lushan negotiations.

summary.zh: 1937 年 5 月 2—14 日，中国共产党全国代表会议在延安召开，确定新形势下的任务。

fields.name: 中国共产党全国代表会议（苏区代表会议） National Party Conference at Yan’an (Soviet Area Conference)
fields.summary: 1937 年 5 月 2—14 日，中国共产党全国代表会议在延安召开，确定新形势下的任务。 From 2 to 14 May 1937 the CCP National Party Conference met at Yan’an and set the Party’s tasks in the new situation.
fields.description: 1937 年 5 月 2 日至 14 日，中国共产党全国代表会议（又称苏区代表会议）在延安召开。毛泽东作《中国共产党在抗日时期的任务》的报告和《为争取千百万群众进入抗日民族统一战线而斗争》的结论。会议批准遵义会议以来党中央的正确路线，分析华北事变后的形势，确定巩固和平、争取民主、实现抗战的任务，强调在统一战线中坚持无产阶级领导权。这次会议为即将到来的全面抗战作了政治上和组织上的准备。5 月 17 日起，中共中央又召开白区工作会议。本事件为会议，不绘路线。 From 2 to 14 May 1937 the CCP National Party Conference, also known as the Soviet Area Conference, met at Yan’an. Mao Zedong delivered “The Tasks of the Chinese Communist Party in the Period of Resistance to Japan” and the concluding speech “Win the Millions for the Anti-Japanese National United Front”. The conference endorsed the Central Committee’s line since the Zunyi Conference, analysed the situation after the North China crisis, set the tasks of consolidating peace, winning democracy and achieving resistance, and stressed proletarian leadership within the united front. It prepared the Party politically and organisationally for full-scale war. A conference on Party work in white areas followed from 17 May. No route is drawn.

fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 7 日夜，日军在北平西南卢沟桥附近演习，借口士兵失踪要求进入宛平城搜查，遭拒后发动进攻。中国守军第二十九军奋起抵抗，战事迅速扩大。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On the night of 7 July 1937, Japanese troops on exercise near the Marco Polo Bridge demanded entry into Wanping to search for a missing soldier. After being refused, they attacked. The Chinese 29th Army resisted, and the fighting quickly escalated. This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 中共中央《为日军进攻卢沟桥通电》 CCP telegram on the Japanese attack at Lugouqiao
fields.summary: 卢沟桥事变次日，中共中央发出通电，号召全民族抗战、国共两党亲密合作。 The day after the Lugouqiao Incident the CCP called for nationwide resistance and close KMT–CCP cooperation.
fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 8 日，中共中央发出《中国共产党为日军进攻卢沟桥通电》，指出「平津危急！华北危急！中华民族危急！只有全民族实行抗战，才是我们的出路」，号召全国同胞、政府与军队团结起来，筑成民族统一战线的坚固长城，抵抗日寇的侵掠，并呼吁国共两党亲密合作抵抗日寇的新进攻。同日，毛泽东、朱德、彭德怀等红军领导人致电蒋介石，要求全国总动员，表示红军将士愿在委员长领导下为国效命。本事件为政策文件，不绘路线。 On 8 July 1937 the CCP Central Committee issued a telegram on the Japanese attack at Lugouqiao, declaring that “Pingjin is in danger! North China is in danger! The Chinese nation is in danger! Only nationwide resistance is our way out.” It called on compatriots, government and army to build the great wall of the national united front and resist the invaders, and urged close KMT–CCP cooperation. The same day Mao Zedong, Zhu De, Peng Dehuai and other Red Army leaders telegraphed Chiang Kai-shek, calling for national mobilisation and offering to serve under his command. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1937 年 7 月 15 日，周恩来等在庐山向蒋介石提交《中共中央为公布国共合作宣言》。
summary.en: On 15 July 1937 Zhou Enlai and colleagues submitted the CCP declaration of cooperation to Chiang Kai-shek at Lushan.

fields.name: 中共代表团向蒋介石提交《中共中央为公布国共合作宣言》 CCP delegation submits the declaration of cooperation to Chiang Kai-shek at Lushan
fields.summary: 1937 年 7 月 15 日，周恩来等在庐山向蒋介石提交《中共中央为公布国共合作宣言》。 On 15 July 1937 Zhou Enlai and colleagues submitted the CCP declaration of cooperation to Chiang Kai-shek at Lushan.
fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 13 日，周恩来、秦邦宪、林伯渠到达庐山。7 月 15 日，中共代表向蒋介石提交周恩来起草的《中共中央为公布国共合作宣言》。宣言以团结抗日、实行民主政治为主旨，提出三项基本要求：争取中华民族独立自由与解放；实现民权政治，召开国民大会、制定宪法；实现中国人民的幸福与愉快生活。同时重申四项保证：为孙中山三民主义彻底实现而奋斗；取消推翻国民党政权的暴动政策及赤化运动，停止暴力没收地主土地；取消苏维埃政府，实行民主政治；取消红军名义及番号，改编为国民革命军。蒋介石未立即公布，7 月 17 日双方继续谈判。宣言于 9 月 22 日由国民党中央通讯社发表。 Zhou Enlai, Qin Bangxian and Lin Boqu reached Lushan on 13 July 1937. On 15 July the CCP delegates submitted to Chiang Kai-shek the declaration drafted by Zhou, “The CCP Central Committee’s Declaration on Cooperation with the Kuomintang”. It set out three basic demands — national independence and liberation, democratic government with a national assembly and constitution, and a better life for the people — and repeated four pledges: to strive for Sun Yat-sen’s Three People’s Principles; to abandon armed overthrow of the National Government, “red” expansion and violent land confiscation; to abolish the Soviet government and introduce democracy; and to abolish the Red Army name and reorganise it as the National Revolutionary Army. Chiang did not publish it at once and talks continued on 17 July; the KMT Central News Agency finally issued it on 22 September.

fields.name: 庐山谈话 Lushan Statement
fields.summary: 蒋介石发表庐山谈话，表示“地无分南北，年无分老幼，皆有守土抗战之责任”。 Chiang Kai-shek’s Lushan statement declared that “regardless of north or south, young or old, everyone has the duty to defend the land and resist.”
fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 17 日，蒋介石在庐山发表谈话，提出解决卢沟桥事变的四项立场，并表示“如果战端一开，那就是地无分南北，年无分老幼，无论何人，皆有守土抗战之责任”。这被视为国民政府走向全面抗战的重要表态。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 17 July 1937 Chiang Kai-shek issued the Lushan Statement, setting out four conditions for settling the Marco Polo Bridge Incident and declaring that “if war begins, then regardless of north or south, young or old, everyone has the duty to defend the land and resist.” It is regarded as a key statement of the Nationalist government’s turn toward full-scale resistance. The date follows the Hebei war history and the Chinese war history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 29 日至 30 日，日军第 20 师团等部进攻天津，中国第 38 师等部抵抗后撤离。7 月 30 日天津沦陷，日军控制海河与天津港。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 29 to 30 July 1937 the Japanese 20th Division and other units attacked Tianjin. summary.zh: 抗战爆发后，沿海工厂大规模内迁四川、云南、贵州、陕西等地。
summary.en: After the war began, coastal factories were moved on a large scale to Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Shaanxi, and other interior provinces.

fields.name: 工厂西迁 Relocation of Industry to the Interior
fields.summary: 抗战爆发后，沿海工厂大规模内迁四川、云南、贵州、陕西等地。 After the war began, coastal factories were moved on a large scale to Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Shaanxi, and other interior provinces.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月起，国民政府组织沿海工厂内迁，600 余家工厂、大批设备与技术工人迁往四川、云南、贵州、陕西等地，成为大后方工业基础。内迁过程艰苦，但保存了抗战所需的军工与民用生产能力。 日期与数字取通行说法，待史料校订。 From August 1937 the Nationalist government organized the relocation of coastal industry. More than 600 factories, large quantities of equipment, and skilled workers moved to Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Shaanxi, and other interior provinces, forming the industrial base of the rear area. The process was arduous but preserved military and civilian production capacity for the war. Dates and figures follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 淞沪会战 Battle of Shanghai 八一三事变 August 13 Incident 淞沪抗战 Battle of Shanghai
fields.summary: 中日双方在上海投入重兵鏖战三个月，中国军队粉碎了日军速战速决的企图。 China and Japan poured troops into three months of fighting in Shanghai, thwarting Japan’s hope for a quick victory.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 13 日，淞沪会战爆发。中国军队先后投入数十万兵力，与日军在上海市区及周边反复争夺。11 月，中国军队西撤，上海沦陷，但会战打破了日军“三个月灭亡中国”的计划。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与战果表述待史料校订。 The Battle of Shanghai began on 13 August 1937. Hundreds of thousands of Chinese troops fought Japanese forces in and around the city. In November the Chinese army withdrew west and Shanghai fell, but the battle shattered Japan’s plan to conquer China in three months. This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and assessments await historical review.

name.en: First Japanese Air Raid on Suzhou

summary.zh: 1937年8月16日，日军航空队两批24架次首次轰炸苏州城，死伤500余人。
summary.en: On 16 August 1937 two waves of 24 Japanese aircraft bombed Suzhou for the first time, killing and wounding more than 500 people.

fields.name: 日机首炸苏州 First Japanese Air Raid on Suzhou
fields.summary: 1937年8月16日，日军航空队两批24架次首次轰炸苏州城，死伤500余人。 On 16 August 1937 two waves of 24 Japanese aircraft bombed Suzhou for the first time, killing and wounding more than 500 people.
fields.description: 淞沪会战爆发后，日军航空队对苏州实施持续轰炸。8月16日，日机两批24架次首炸阊门外兵营和城内道前街、西善长巷、学士街一带，死伤500余人；至11月15日，苏州城区共受弹4200余颗，街市、房舍、学校、医院、工厂破坏严重。此为日军航空队对平民城市的无差别轰炸，不绘制地面路线。日期据《苏州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 After the Battle of Shanghai began, Japanese aircraft bombed Suzhou repeatedly. On 16 August 1937 two waves of 24 aircraft hit the barracks outside Changmen and the Daqian Street, Xishanchang Lane and Xueshi Street areas, killing and wounding more than 500 people; by 15 November the city had received more than 4,200 bombs. This was an indiscriminate air raid on a civilian city, so no ground route is drawn. The date follows the Suzhou chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 察哈尔派遣兵团设司令部于多伦

summary.zh: 1937年8月17日，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团在多伦设立战斗司令部，东条英机任司令官。
summary.en: On 17 August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Detachment established its battle headquarters at Dolon under Lt. Gen. Tojo Hideki.

fields.name: 察哈尔派遣兵团设司令部于多伦 Chahar Detachment Headquarters at Dolon
fields.summary: 1937年8月17日，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团在多伦设立战斗司令部，东条英机任司令官。 On 17 August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Detachment established its battle headquarters at Dolon under Lt. Gen. Tojo Hideki.
fields.description: 1937年8月9日日本参谋本部决定察哈尔作战，8月14日关东军编成察哈尔派遣兵团，以东条英机中将为司令官；17日在多伦设立战斗司令部，19日移至张北。兵团下辖独立混成第1、第2旅团、混成第15旅团及堤支队、大泉支队等部，自多伦、沽源、张北一线向张家口进攻。该事件为指挥机构设立，不绘制进攻路线。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与维基百科《察哈尔派遣兵团》。 On 9 August 1937 the Japanese General Staff decided on the Chahar operation. The Kwantung Army formed the Chahar Detachment on 14 August under Lt. Gen. Tojo Hideki, and on the 17th established its battle headquarters at Dolon, moving to Zhangbei on the 19th. The force comprised the 1st and 2nd Independent Mixed Brigades, the 15th Mixed Brigade, and the Tsutsumi and Oizumi detachments, advancing on Zhangjiakou from Dolon, Guyuan and Zhangbei. No advance route is drawn for a headquarters event.

summary.en: On 20 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade sortied from Zhangbei and broke the Great Wall line.

fields.name: 张北战斗 Battle of Zhangbei
fields.summary: 1937年8月20日，日军混成第2旅团自张北出击，突破长城线。 On 20 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade sortied from Zhangbei and broke the Great Wall line.
fields.description: 1937年8月，中国第29军第143师曾于8月20日攻占张北城外围玻璃彩村等要点，但日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团主力已集结张北。20日夜，日军混成第2旅团自张北二台出发，突破长城防御，占领神威台；中国军队于21日夜退守神威台，23日午夜神威台失陷。张北自1935年《秦土协定》后已为日军控制，本事件记日军自张北出击，不记“张北沦陷”。日期据《南口战役》与《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿。 In August 1937 the Chinese 143rd Division briefly took the glass-factory village outside Zhangbei on the 20th, but the Japanese Chahar Detachment had already concentrated at Zhangbei. On the night of the 20th the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade advanced from Er’tai, broke the Great Wall line and took Shenweitei; the Chinese fell back on the night of the 21st, and Shenweitei fell at midnight on the 23rd. Zhangbei had been under Japanese control since the 1935 Qin-Doihara agreement, so this entry records the Japanese sortie from Zhangbei, not a “fall of Zhangbei.”

summary.zh: 中共中央在洛川冯家村召开政治局扩大会议，确定八路军「独立自主的山地游击战」方针。
summary.en: The CCP Central Committee met at Fengjiacun, Luochuan, and set the Eighth Route Army’s strategy of “independent mountain guerrilla warfare.”

fields.name: 洛川会议 Luochuan Conference 中共中央政治局扩大会议 Enlarged Politburo Meeting
fields.place: 陕西洛川冯家村 Fengjiacun, Luochuan, Shaanxi
fields.summary: 中共中央在洛川冯家村召开政治局扩大会议，确定八路军「独立自主的山地游击战」方针。 The CCP Central Committee met at Fengjiacun, Luochuan, and set the Eighth Route Army’s strategy of “independent mountain guerrilla warfare.”
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 22 日至 25 日，中共中央在陕北洛川冯家村召开政治局扩大会议。会议通过《抗日救国十大纲领》和《关于目前形势与党的任务的决定》，确定红军改编后的战略方针为「独立自主的山地游击战」，包括在有利条件下集中兵力消灭敌人兵团和在平原发展游击战争，但着重于山地；作战原则是「分散以发动群众，集中以消灭敌人，打得赢就打，打不赢就走」。会议同时强调抗日民族统一战线中的独立自主原则，决定红军主力出动，并留一部分保卫陕甘宁边区。 会上对游击战与运动战的主次仍有不同意见，因部队急于出动未及充分讨论；方针表述以《毛泽东选集》第二卷所收《为动员一切力量争取抗战胜利而斗争》及中央档案馆藏件为准。会议地点在冯家村，不在洛川县城。 From 22 to 25 August 1937 the CCP Central Committee held an enlarged Politburo meeting at Fengjiacun, Luochuan, northern Shaanxi. It adopted the Ten-Point Program for Resisting Japan and the Resolution on the Present Situation and the Party’s Tasks, and fixed the Red Army’s post-reorganization strategy as “independent mountain guerrilla warfare,” including concentrating forces to destroy enemy formations under favourable conditions and developing guerrilla warfare on the plains, but with emphasis on the mountains. The operational principle was “disperse to mobilize the people, concentrate to destroy the enemy; fight if you can win, move away if you cannot.” The meeting also stressed independence within the united front, decided that the main Red Army forces would go to the front, and left part of the force to defend the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region. Views on the balance between guerrilla and mobile warfare still differed and were not fully debated because the troops had to move; the wording follows “Struggle to Mobilize All Forces for Victory in the War of Resistance” in Selected Works of Mao Zedong, vol. 2, and documents held by the Central Archives. The venue was Fengjiacun, not Luochuan county town.

name.zh: 日军在吴淞口、川沙口登陆
name.en: Japanese landings at Wusong and Chuansha

summary.zh: 1937 年 8 月 23 日，日本上海派遣军第 3、第 11 师团在吴淞口、川沙口一带登陆，淞沪会战扩大。
summary.en: On 23 August 1937 the Japanese Shanghai Expeditionary Army’s 3rd and 11th divisions landed at Wusong and Chuansha, widening the Battle of Shanghai.

fields.name: 日军在吴淞口、川沙口登陆 Japanese landings at Wusong and Chuansha
fields.summary: 1937 年 8 月 23 日，日本上海派遣军第 3、第 11 师团在吴淞口、川沙口一带登陆，淞沪会战扩大。 On 23 August 1937 the Japanese Shanghai Expeditionary Army’s 3rd and 11th divisions landed at Wusong and Chuansha, widening the Battle of Shanghai.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 13 日淞沪会战爆发后，日本组建上海派遣军，由松井石根任司令官。8 月 23 日，第 3 师团和第 11 师团在吴淞口、川沙口一带强行登陆，企图迂回中国守军侧后，攻占罗店、宝山，打通通往上海市区的通道。中国第 9 集团军等部在吴淞、宝山、罗店一线顽强抗击，罗店争夺战尤为激烈。日军此后不断增兵，至 11 月 5 日又在金山卫登陆，中国守军侧后受威胁，淞沪会战转入撤退。日期、部队与登陆点取通行说法，具体滩头位置待考。 After the Battle of Shanghai began on 13 August 1937, Japan formed the Shanghai Expeditionary Army under Matsui Iwane. On 23 August its 3rd and 11th divisions forced landings at Wusong and Chuansha, seeking to turn the Chinese flank, take Luodian and Baoshan and open the way into Shanghai. Chinese 9th Group Army units fought back along the Wusong–Baoshan–Luodian line, with particularly bitter fighting at Luodian. Japan kept reinforcing, and after another landing at Jinshanwei on 5 November the Chinese flank was threatened and the battle turned into a withdrawal. Dates, units and landing points follow conventional accounts; the exact beaches await verification.

summary.zh: 1937年8月24日，日军混成第2旅团攻占万全。
summary.en: On 24 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade captured Wanquan.

fields.name: 万全沦陷 Fall of Wanquan
fields.summary: 1937年8月24日，日军混成第2旅团攻占万全。 On 24 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade captured Wanquan.
fields.description: 1937年8月22日，日军混成第2旅团进攻旧万全，中国第143师抵抗后于23日退守张家口西南、平绥线上的孔家庄一线。24日晨，日军攻占万全县城，随即以步兵一联队、炮兵一营沿公路直趋张家口。日期据《张家口政协·烽火年代》与《南口战役》，两源一致。 On 22 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade attacked old Wanquan; the Chinese 143rd Division resisted and on the 23rd fell back on the Kongjiazhuang high ground southwest of Zhangjiakou. At dawn on the 24th the Japanese took Wanquan and pushed an infantry regiment and artillery battalion down the road toward Zhangjiakou. Both cited accounts give 24 August.

summary.zh: 红军主力改编为国民革命军第八路军，下辖第115、第120、第129师。

fields.name: 八路军成立 Establishment of the Eighth Route Army
fields.summary: 红军主力改编为国民革命军第八路军，下辖第115、第120、第129师。 The main Red Army forces were reorganized as the Eighth Route Army, with the 115th, 120th, and 129th divisions.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 22 日，国民政府军事委员会宣布红军主力改编为国民革命军第八路军；8 月 25 日，中共中央军委发布改编命令，朱德任总指挥，彭德怀任副总指挥，叶剑英任参谋长，左权任副参谋长，任弼时任政治部主任，邓小平任副主任，下辖第115、第120、第129 师。红军总部在陕西泾阳云阳镇完成改编，各师自 8 月下旬起陆续誓师东渡黄河，开赴山西抗日前线。 改编日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 22 August 1937 the National Government’s Military Commission announced the reorganization of the main Red Army forces into the Eighth Route Army; on 25 August the Central Military Commission issued the reorganization order, with Zhu De as commander, Peng Dehuai as deputy commander, Ye Jianying as chief of staff, Zuo Quan as deputy chief of staff, Ren Bishi as director of the Political Department and Deng Xiaoping as deputy director, under the 115th, 120th, and 129th divisions. The Red Army headquarters completed the reorganization at Yunyang, Jingyang, Shaanxi, and from late August the divisions crossed the Yellow River toward Shanxi. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 日本海军封锁中国海岸 Japanese Naval Blockade of the China Coast
fields.place: 上海吴淞口外 Off Wusong, Shanghai
fields.summary: 日本海军宣布封锁中国中部沿海，切断中国海上补给。 The Japanese navy declared a blockade of China’s central coast, cutting maritime supply lines.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 25 日，日本海军第三舰队宣布封锁上海至汕头之间的中国海岸，禁止中国船只航行，随后将封锁范围扩大至中国全部沿海。封锁与日军占领沿海港口相配合，切断了中国经海路输入军需物资的主要通道。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 25 August 1937 the Japanese 3rd Fleet declared a blockade of the Chinese coast between Shanghai and Shantou, barring Chinese shipping; the blockade was later extended to the entire Chinese coast. Together with the seizure of coastal ports, it cut China’s main maritime route for importing military supplies. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 日军进抵独石口以西 Japanese Advance West of Dushikou
fields.place: 察哈尔独石口 Dushikou, Chahar
fields.summary: 1937年8月26日，日军大泉支队自沽源南进，占领独石口以西三间房。 On 26 August 1937 the Japanese Oizumi detachment advanced south from Guyuan and took Sanjianfang west of Dushikou.
fields.description: 1937年8月13日，日军大泉支队抵达沽源，随后沿独石口、赤城、龙关一线南进，企图抢占宣化、截断平绥铁路。中国第17军高桂滋部在宁强堡—赤城—龙关一线防御，未能阻止日军。8月26日，大泉支队占领独石口以西之三间房。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》。 The Japanese Oizumi detachment reached Guyuan on 13 August 1937 and advanced south through Dushikou, Chicheng and Longguan to seize Xuanhua and cut the Beiping–Suiyuan railway. Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps defended the Ningqiangpu–Chicheng–Longguan line but could not stop it. On 26 August the detachment took Sanjianfang west of Dushikou.

fields.name: 张家口沦陷 Fall of Zhangjiakou
fields.place: 察哈尔张家口 Zhangjiakou, Chahar
fields.summary: 日军察哈尔派遣兵团占领张家口，控制平绥线东段。 The Japanese Chahar Expeditionary Force captured Zhangjiakou, controlling the eastern section of the Peiping–Suiyuan railway.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团沿平绥线西进，配合南口作战。8 月 27 日，日军占领张家口，中国守军撤退。张家口沦陷使日军控制察哈尔东部，并为进攻大同打开通路。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Expeditionary Force advanced west along the Peiping–Suiyuan railway in support of the Nankou operation. On 27 August it captured Zhangjiakou and the Chinese defenders withdrew. The fall of Zhangjiakou gave Japan control of eastern Chahar and opened the route toward Datong. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 怀来沦陷 Fall of Huailai
fields.summary: 1937年8月27日，日军第5师团占领怀来。 On 27 August 1937 the Japanese 5th Division occupied Huailai.
fields.description: 1937年8月25日南口失守后，中国守军于26日退守怀来；日军第5师团与独立混成第11旅团分两路追击，26日占领怀来、27日占领延庆（一说27日占怀来）。怀来失守后，平绥铁路东段被日军打通。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》；后者记27日怀来失陷。 After Nankou fell on 25 August 1937 the Chinese withdrew to Huailai on the 26th. The Japanese 5th Division and 11th Independent Mixed Brigade pursued in two columns, taking Huailai and Yanqing on 26–27 August (one account gives 27 August for Huailai). The fall of Huailai opened the eastern Beiping–Suiyuan railway.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1937年8月27日，日军独立混成第11旅团占领延庆。
summary.en: On 27 August 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Mixed Brigade occupied Yanqing.

fields.name: 延庆沦陷 Fall of Yanqing
fields.summary: 1937年8月27日，日军独立混成第11旅团占领延庆。 On 27 August 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Mixed Brigade occupied Yanqing.
fields.description: 1937年8月27日，日军独立混成第11旅团在占领居庸关后进攻延庆，当日占领延庆；中国第17军高桂滋部在延庆与日军激战后向桑干河右岸撤退。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿，两源一致。 On 27 August 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Mixed Brigade, after taking Juyongguan, attacked and occupied Yanqing. Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps fought at Yanqing and then withdrew to the south bank of the Sanggan River. Both cited accounts give 27 August.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1937年8月27日，日军大泉支队攻占赤城。
summary.en: On 27 August 1937 the Japanese Oizumi detachment captured Chicheng.

fields.name: 赤城沦陷 Fall of Chicheng
fields.summary: 1937年8月27日，日军大泉支队攻占赤城。 On 27 August 1937 the Japanese Oizumi detachment captured Chicheng.
fields.description: 1937年8月，日军大泉支队自沽源经独石口南下，连陷龙关、赤城，企图抢占宣化。8月27日攻占赤城，28日攻占宣化。赤城失守后，中国第17军高桂滋部向桑干河右岸撤退。日期据澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》与《张家口政协·烽火年代》。 In August 1937 the Japanese Oizumi detachment advanced south from Guyuan through Dushikou, took Longguan and Chicheng, and drove on Xuanhua. Chicheng fell on 27 August and Xuanhua on the 28th. Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps then withdrew to the south bank of the Sanggan River.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1937年8月28日，日军攻占宣化。
summary.en: On 28 August 1937 the Japanese captured Xuanhua.

fields.name: 宣化沦陷 Fall of Xuanhua
fields.summary: 1937年8月28日，日军攻占宣化。 On 28 August 1937 the Japanese captured Xuanhua.
fields.description: 1937年8月27日张家口失陷后，日军大泉支队自赤城、龙关方向南下，28日攻占宣化，与由张家口东进的混成第2旅会合；29日日军第5师亦进至宣化。宣化失守后，日军控制张家口以南整个平绥路东段。日期据澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》与《南口战役》；《中国抗日战争全史》记27日占宣化，正文并列。 After Zhangjiakou fell on 27 August 1937, the Japanese Oizumi detachment came south from Chicheng and Longguan and took Xuanhua on the 28th, joining the 2nd Mixed Brigade advancing east from Zhangjiakou; the 5th Division reached Xuanhua on the 29th. The Japanese thus controlled the entire eastern Beiping–Suiyuan railway south of Zhangjiakou. The campaign history gives 27 August; that variant is noted.

summary.en: On 29 August 1937 the Japanese 1st Independent Mixed Brigade occupied Chaigoubu.

fields.name: 柴沟堡沦陷 Fall of Chaigoubu
fields.place: 察哈尔柴沟堡 Chaigoubu, Chahar
fields.summary: 1937年8月29日，日军独立混成第1旅团占领柴沟堡。 On 29 August 1937 the Japanese 1st Independent Mixed Brigade occupied Chaigoubu.
fields.description: 1937年8月29日，日军独立混成第1旅团占领张家口以西的柴沟堡，切断平绥铁路西段；中国第2战区防守平绥路的部队分头向天镇、蔚县方向撤退。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿；中国日报网《我所亲历的怀安两大惨案》记8月28日日军侵占柴沟堡，正文并列。 On 29 August 1937 the Japanese 1st Independent Mixed Brigade took Chaigoubu west of Zhangjiakou, cutting the western Beiping–Suiyuan railway; the Chinese Second War Zone forces withdrew toward Tianzhen and Yu County. The China Daily account gives 28 August for Chaigoubu; that variant is noted.

fields.name: 第74军组建 Formation of the 74th Army
fields.place: 上海（淞沪战场） Shanghai (Songhu front)
fields.summary: 第74军在淞沪战场以第51、第58师为基干组建，后成为正面战场主力。 The 74th Army was formed on the Songhu battlefield around the 51st and 58th Divisions and became a mainstay of the frontal war.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月，第74军在淞沪战场以第51师、第58师为基干组建，俞济时任军长。此后参加南京保卫战、兰封会战、万家岭战斗、上高会战、常德会战与湘西会战，被称为“抗日铁军”。 建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期与番号沿革待史料校订。 In September 1937 the 74th Army was formed on the Songhu battlefield around the 51st and 58th Divisions, with Yu Jishi as commander. It later fought at Nanjing, Lanfeng, Wanjialing, Shanggao, Changde, and Xiangxi, and became known as the “iron army” of the resistance. An organizational event with no separate route; dates and order of battle await historical review.

name.en: Sichuan Troops March Out to Resist Japan

summary.zh: 川军各部自四川分批出川，开赴山西、淞沪等抗日前线。
summary.en: Sichuan units left the province in successive waves for the Shanxi and Shanghai fronts.

fields.name: 川军出川抗战 Sichuan Troops March Out to Resist Japan
fields.summary: 川军各部自四川分批出川，开赴山西、淞沪等抗日前线。 Sichuan units left the province in successive waves for the Shanxi and Shanghai fronts.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月起，川军各部陆续出川抗战。第22集团军（邓锡侯、孙震部）经川陕公路北上，开赴山西第二战区；第20军（杨森部）经长江东下，开赴淞沪战场。川军装备简陋，但作战顽强，伤亡惨重。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 From September 1937 Sichuan units left the province in successive waves. The 22nd Group Army under Deng Xihou and Sun Zhen moved north via the Sichuan–Shaanxi road to the 2nd War Zone in Shanxi, while the 20th Army under Yang Sen moved east along the Yangtze to the Shanghai front. Poorly equipped but tenacious, the Sichuan troops suffered heavy casualties. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: The Guangxi 21st Group Army left Guangxi via Wuhan and Xuzhou for the Shanghai front.

fields.name: 桂军出桂抗战 Guangxi Troops March Out to Resist Japan
fields.summary: 桂军第21集团军自广西出发，经武汉、徐州开赴淞沪战场。 The Guangxi 21st Group Army left Guangxi via Wuhan and Xuzhou for the Shanghai front.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月，桂军第21集团军（廖磊部）自桂林、柳州出发，经武汉、徐州开赴淞沪，10 月参加蕴藻浜反击战。桂军作战勇猛，但在日军优势火力下伤亡惨重。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In September 1937 the Guangxi 21st Group Army under Liao Lei left Guilin and Liuzhou via Wuhan and Xuzhou for Shanghai, and in October fought in the Yunzaobang counterattack. The Guangxi troops fought bravely but suffered heavy losses under Japanese firepower. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1937年9月3日，日舰炮击厦门，屿仔尾炮台击沉日舰若竹号。
summary.en: On 3 September 1937 Japanese warships shelled Xiamen; the Yuzaiwei battery sank the Japanese destroyer Waketake.

fields.name: 厦门炮战 Naval Engagement off Xiamen
fields.summary: 1937年9月3日，日舰炮击厦门，屿仔尾炮台击沉日舰若竹号。 On 3 September 1937 Japanese warships shelled Xiamen; the Yuzaiwei battery sank the Japanese destroyer Waketake.
fields.description: 9月3日凌晨4时3分，日本海军驱逐舰「羽风」「若竹」号等3艘入侵厦门与海澄交界海域，向白石头炮台及曾厝垵海军飞机场发炮轰击，猛攻胡里山总台。驻守屿仔尾南炮台部队立即开炮迎击，开炮3发，两中若竹号艏艉；羽风等二舰遁逃，若竹舰沉没海中。此为海战，不绘地面路线。 At 4:03 a.m. on 3 September three Japanese destroyers, including Hagikaze and Waketake, entered the waters between Xiamen and Haicheng and shelled the Baishitou battery, the Zengcuoan naval airfield and the Huli Shan main fort. The Yuzaiwei battery opened fire with three rounds, hitting Waketake fore and aft; the other two ships fled and Waketake sank. As a naval engagement, it is not drawn as a ground route.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1937年9月9日，日军攻占阳高县城。
summary.en: On 9 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Yanggao.

fields.name: 阳高沦陷 Fall of Yanggao
fields.summary: 1937年9月9日，日军攻占阳高县城。 On 9 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Yanggao.
fields.description: 9月初，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团突破天镇盘山防线，9月8日围攻阳高。守军第61军第414团据城抵抗，9日拂晓日军由东南城墙登城，阳高失守，守军由南门撤退。城破后日军在瓮城屠杀欢迎民众及青壮年五百余人。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（阳高县政协稿）与《太原会战》逐日记载。 In early September the Kwantung Army’s Chahar force broke the Panshan line at Tianzhen and besieged Yanggao on 8 September. The 414th Regiment of the 61st Corps held the town until Japanese troops mounted the southeast wall at dawn on the 9th; Yanggao fell and the defenders withdrew through the south gate. After the capture the Japanese massacred more than 500 people in the barbican. Dates follow the Shanxi county gazetteer compilation and the day-by-day Taoyuan campaign account.

fields.name: 第18集团军成立 Establishment of the 18th Group Army
fields.summary: 国民政府军事委员会将八路军改称第18集团军，朱德任总司令。 The Military Commission renamed the Eighth Route Army the 18th Group Army, with Zhu De as commander-in-chief.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 11 日，国民政府军事委员会将国民革命军第八路军改称第18集团军，朱德任总司令，彭德怀任副总司令。因八路军番号已深入民心，中共方面和民间仍多沿用“八路军”名称，作战序列与指挥关系不变。 日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 11 September 1937 the National Government’s Military Commission renamed the Eighth Route Army the 18th Group Army, with Zhu De as commander-in-chief and Peng Dehuai as deputy commander-in-chief. Because the name “Eighth Route Army” had already taken root, the Chinese Communist side and the public continued to use it; the order of battle and command relationships were unchanged. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
fields.entities: 国民党军正面战场 KMT Frontline Forces 八路军 Eighth Route Army

summary.zh: 1937年9月11日，日军第5师团骑兵第5联队占领蔚县。
summary.en: On 11 September 1937 the 5th Cavalry Regiment of the Japanese 5th Division occupied Yu County.

fields.name: 蔚县沦陷 Fall of Yu County
fields.place: 察哈尔蔚县 Yu County, Chahar
fields.summary: 1937年9月11日，日军第5师团骑兵第5联队占领蔚县。 On 11 September 1937 the 5th Cavalry Regiment of the Japanese 5th Division occupied Yu County.
fields.description: 1937年9月6日，日军第5师团自宣化、新保安、怀来分三路南下，进攻蔚县；中国第68军刘汝明部未与日军接触即行后撤。9月11日，日军骑兵第5联队占领蔚县；随后第5师团经蔚县、广灵向灵丘方向进攻。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《每日新闻社：日军侵华记录（八）》，两者均记9月11日。 On 6 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division advanced south from Xuanhua, Xinbao’an and Huailai against Yu County; Liu Ruming’s 68th Corps withdrew without contact. On 11 September the 5th Cavalry Regiment occupied Yu County, and the 5th Division then moved through Yu County and Guangling toward Lingqiu. Both cited accounts give 11 September.

summary.zh: 1937年9月12日，日军攻占天镇县城。
summary.en: On 12 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Tianzhen.

fields.name: 天镇沦陷 Fall of Tianzhen
fields.summary: 1937年9月12日，日军攻占天镇县城。 On 12 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Tianzhen.
fields.description: 日军自9月3日起进攻天镇盘山防线，守军第61军苦战。9月7日守军主力后撤，仅留第399团守城；9月11日夜守军突围，12日天镇县城失守。天镇是晋北门户，失守后日军直趋大同。天镇日期另有9月11日说（《太原会战》逐日条记“九月十一日占领天镇县城”），此处取各县政协稿与同文正文的9月12日。 Japanese forces attacked the Panshan line at Tianzhen from 3 September. The 61st Corps’ main force withdrew on the 7th, leaving the 399th Regiment in the town; the garrison broke out on the night of the 11th and Tianzhen fell on the 12th, opening the road to Datong. One day-by-day account gives 11 September for the town’s capture; this entry follows the county gazetteer compilation and the same account’s narrative of the 12th.

fields.summary: 日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团占领大同，随后沿同蒲路南下。 The Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar expeditionary force took Datong and moved south along the Tongpu railway.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 13 日日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团占领大同，晋北门户洞开；日军随后沿同蒲路南下，10 月 13 日猛攻忻口。 On 13 September 1937 the Kwantung Army’s Chahar force took Datong, opening northern Shanxi; the Japanese then moved south along the Tongpu railway and attacked Xinkou on 13 October.

name.en: Appeal to the League of Nations

summary.zh: 中国向国际联盟申诉日本侵略，援引盟约第十七条。
summary.en: China appealed to the League of Nations against Japanese aggression under Article 17 of the Covenant.

fields.name: 国联申诉 Appeal to the League of Nations
fields.summary: 中国向国际联盟申诉日本侵略，援引盟约第十七条。 China appealed to the League of Nations against Japanese aggression under Article 17 of the Covenant.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 13 日，中国向国际联盟申诉日本侵略，援引盟约第十七条，要求制裁。国联随后通过谴责日本、支持中国的决议，但缺乏强制力，未采取实际行动。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 13 September 1937 China appealed to the League of Nations against Japanese aggression under Article 17 of the Covenant and sought sanctions. The League adopted resolutions condemning Japan and supporting China, but they lacked enforcement and produced no practical action. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1937年9月14日，日军未经战斗占领怀仁县城。
summary.en: On 14 September 1937 Japanese forces occupied Huairen without a fight.

fields.name: 怀仁沦陷 Fall of Huairen
fields.summary: 1937年9月14日，日军未经战斗占领怀仁县城。 On 14 September 1937 Japanese forces occupied Huairen without a fight.
fields.description: 9月13日大同失守后，怀仁守军与县政府弃城南撤。9月14日，当地士绅出城迎接，日军独立混成第15旅团未发一枪占领怀仁县城。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（怀仁县政协稿）与《太原会战》逐日记载。 After Datong fell on 13 September, the garrison and county government at Huairen withdrew south. On the 14th local gentry went out to welcome the Japanese, and the Independent Mixed 15th Brigade occupied the town without firing a shot. Dates follow the county gazetteer compilation and the day-by-day Taoyuan campaign account.

summary.zh: 1937年9月14日，日军第5师团攻占广灵县城。
summary.en: On 14 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division captured Guangling.

fields.name: 广灵沦陷 Fall of Guangling
fields.summary: 1937年9月14日，日军第5师团攻占广灵县城。 On 14 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division captured Guangling.
fields.description: 9月13日，日军第5师团第21旅团进攻广灵洗马庄一带，中国军队第73师防线被突破，师长刘奉滨负伤。9月14日广灵县城失守，第73师向平型关转进。此后八路军杨成武支队曾在月内四次收复县城，11月初日军再次侵占并长期盘踞。日期据《太原会战》逐日记载与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（广灵县政协稿）。 On 13 September the Japanese 5th Division’s 21st Brigade attacked the Chinese 73rd Division’s line at Ximazhuang and broke it, wounding divisional commander Liu Fengbin. Guangling fell on the 14th and the 73rd Division retired toward Pingxingguan. Yang Chengwu’s detachment retook the town four times within a month before the Japanese reoccupied it in early November. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年9月15日，日军第14师团渡过永定河，占领永清。
summary.en: On 15 September 1937 the Japanese 14th Division crossed the Yongding River and occupied Yongqing.

fields.name: 永清沦陷 Fall of Yongqing
fields.summary: 1937年9月15日，日军第14师团渡过永定河，占领永清。 On 15 September 1937 the Japanese 14th Division crossed the Yongding River and occupied Yongqing.
fields.description: 1937年9月14日，日军第一军由北平分三路南犯，第14、第6师团分别在永清、固安渡过永定河。15日，日军第14师团渡过永定河，占领固安和永清，向涿县松林店方向推进。永清失守使平汉线北段中国守军右翼暴露。日期据《保定战役》与《第三编 发动全面侵华战争（二）进攻华北，太原作战（3）》。 On 14 September 1937 the Japanese First Army advanced south from Beiping in three columns, with the 14th and 6th Divisions crossing the Yongding River at Yongqing and Gu’an. On the 15th the 14th Division crossed and occupied Gu’an and Yongqing, then drove toward Songlindian in Zhuo County, exposing the right flank of the Chinese defenders on the northern Pinghan railway.

summary.zh: 1937年9月15日，日军渡过永定河占领固安，守军第91师血战后撤退。
summary.en: On 15 September 1937 the Japanese crossed the Yongding River and took Gu’an after the 91st Division’s bloody resistance.

fields.name: 固安沦陷 Fall of Gu’an
fields.summary: 1937年9月15日，日军渡过永定河占领固安，守军第91师血战后撤退。 On 15 September 1937 the Japanese crossed the Yongding River and took Gu’an after the 91st Division’s bloody resistance.
fields.description: 1937年9月14日，日军在35架飞机、45辆坦克配合下强渡永定河，进攻固安。冯占海第91师在固安县城及永定河沿岸坚守，数次将日军打回对岸。15日日军第14师团渡过永定河占领固安，固安城巷战至17日陷落，第91师伤亡6000余人。日期取日军渡河占领日，城陷日另有9月17日之说。日期据《保定战役》《血战固安》与《河北固安：浴血抗击牺牲多》。 On 14 September 1937 the Japanese attacked Gu’an, forcing the Yongding River with 35 aircraft and 45 tanks. Feng Zhanhai’s 91st Division held the county town and the river bank, several times driving the Japanese back. On the 15th the Japanese 14th Division crossed and occupied Gu’an; street fighting continued until the town fell on the 17th, with the 91st Division losing over 6,000 men. The date used here is the crossing and occupation day; some accounts give 17 September for the town’s fall.

summary.zh: 1937年9月16日午夜，日军由大同经瓮城口峪进入浑源县城。
summary.en: At midnight on 16 September 1937 the Japanese entered Hunyuan from Datong via Wengcheng Pass.

fields.name: 浑源沦陷 Fall of Hunyuan
fields.summary: 1937年9月16日午夜，日军由大同经瓮城口峪进入浑源县城。 At midnight on 16 September 1937 the Japanese entered Hunyuan from Datong via Wengcheng Pass.
fields.description: 1937年9月16日午夜，日军由大同经瓮城口峪直趋浑源，先向城内轰炮，见无反应，从西门入城。翌晨八时，日军开始洗劫商号、住户，奸淫妇女，拉丁抓夫。浑源失守使晋北内长城线侧翼暴露。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》与《山西：全国抗战的桥头堡》。 At midnight on 16 September 1937 the Japanese advanced on Hunyuan from Datong through Wengcheng Pass, shelled the town and, meeting no response, entered through the west gate. The next morning they looted shops and homes, raped women and seized labourers. The fall of Hunyuan exposed the flank of the Inner Great Wall line in northern Shanxi.

summary.zh: 1937年9月16日，日军侵占房山县城。
summary.en: On 16 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Fangshan.

fields.name: 房山沦陷 Fall of Fangshan
fields.summary: 1937年9月16日，日军侵占房山县城。 On 16 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Fangshan.
fields.description: 1937年9月14日，日军华北方面军第一集团军分三路向平汉线北段进攻。15日，日军飞机轰炸房山县城；16日，日军攻破孙连仲第26路军房山西南阵地，侵占房山城。日军入城后在二站村天主教堂一次杀害逃难百姓80余人。日期据《房山革命史概要》与北京市房山区人民政府《包森创建房山抗日根据地》。 On 14 September 1937 the Japanese First Army Group attacked the northern Pinghan railway in three columns. On the 15th Japanese aircraft bombed Fangshan, and on the 16th the Japanese broke Sun Lianzhong’s 26th Route Army positions south-west of the county town and occupied Fangshan. After entering, they killed over 80 refugees sheltering in the Erzhan village Catholic church.

summary.zh: 1937年9月16日，日军侵占良乡城。
summary.en: On 16 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Liangxiang.

fields.name: 良乡沦陷 Fall of Liangxiang
fields.summary: 1937年9月16日，日军侵占良乡城。 On 16 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Liangxiang.
fields.description: 1937年7月26日，小股日军已侵入良乡东关及梅花庄、苏庄一带。8月17日夜，中国军队从琉璃河方向摸上良乡城，杀死日军数十人，次日日军报复杀害百姓十余人。9月16日，日军攻占良乡城，与房山城同日失守。日期据《房山革命史概要》与《北京档案》《房山在抗日战争中建立的几个第一》。 On 26 July 1937 a small Japanese force had already entered Liangxiang’s east suburb and the Meihuazhuang and Suzhuang areas. On the night of 17 August Chinese troops came from Liulihe, scaled the town wall and killed dozens of Japanese; the Japanese retaliated the next day by killing more than ten civilians. On 16 September the Japanese took Liangxiang, the same day as Fangshan.

summary.zh: 1937年9月17日，日军独立步兵第11联队占领丰镇。
summary.en: On 17 September 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment occupied Fengzhen.

fields.name: 丰镇沦陷 Fall of Fengzhen
fields.summary: 1937年9月17日，日军独立步兵第11联队占领丰镇。 On 17 September 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment occupied Fengzhen.
fields.description: 1937年9月13日日军占领大同后，独立步兵第11联队沿平绥路向北推进，17日占领丰镇。丰镇为大同以北的平绥线要地，失守后日军打开进攻集宁、归绥的通道。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》；《内蒙古区情网》记9月23日占丰镇县城，正文并列。 After taking Datong on 13 September 1937, the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment advanced north along the Beiping–Suiyuan railway and took Fengzhen on the 17th. Fengzhen was the key railway town north of Datong; its fall opened the way to Jining and Guisui. The Inner Mongolia gazetteer gives 23 September for the county town; that variant is noted.

summary.zh: 1937年9月17日，日军侵占琉璃河。
summary.en: On 17 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Liulihe.

fields.name: 琉璃河沦陷 Fall of Liulihe
fields.summary: 1937年9月17日，日军侵占琉璃河。 On 17 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Liulihe.
fields.description: 1937年9月14日，日军第20师团由正面向琉璃河、涿县进攻。16日，日军攻破孙连仲部窦店据点并向琉璃河主阵地进攻，中国守军第27师顽强抵抗后退往涿县。17日，日军侵占琉璃河。日期据澎湃新闻/方志河北《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》与《中华民族抗日编年（1937年9月）》。 On 14 September 1937 the Japanese 20th Division attacked Liulihe and Zhuo County frontally. On the 16th the Japanese took the Douidian strongpoint and attacked the main Liulihe positions; the Chinese 27th Division resisted stubbornly before falling back to Zhuo County. On the 17th the Japanese occupied Liulihe.

summary.zh: 1937年9月18日，日军第20师团攻占涿州。
summary.en: On 18 September 1937 the Japanese 20th Division captured Zhuozhou.

fields.name: 涿州沦陷 Fall of Zhuozhou
fields.summary: 1937年9月18日，日军第20师团攻占涿州。 On 18 September 1937 the Japanese 20th Division captured Zhuozhou.
fields.description: 1937年9月14日，日军第一军由北平分三路南犯，第20师团由正面向琉璃河、涿县进攻。中国守军第26路军等在房山、良乡、涿县一线坚守近一个月。18日，日军第20师团攻占涿州，中国守军南撤，平汉线北段门户洞开。日期据《保定战役》与《第三编 发动全面侵华战争（二）进攻华北，太原作战（3）》。 On 14 September 1937 the Japanese First Army advanced south from Beiping in three columns, with the 20th Division attacking Liulihe and Zhuo County frontally. Chinese troops of the 26th Route Army held the Fangshan–Liangxiang–Zhuo County line for nearly a month. On the 18th the 20th Division captured Zhuozhou and the Chinese withdrew, opening the northern Pinghan railway.

summary.zh: 1937年9月18日，日军飞机轰炸山阴后，地方绅商出迎，山阴县城沦陷。
summary.en: On 18 September 1937, after Japanese aircraft bombed Shanyin, local notables welcomed the Japanese and the county town fell.

fields.name: 山阴沦陷 Fall of Shanyin
fields.summary: 1937年9月18日，日军飞机轰炸山阴后，地方绅商出迎，山阴县城沦陷。 On 18 September 1937, after Japanese aircraft bombed Shanyin, local notables welcomed the Japanese and the county town fell.
fields.description: 1937年9月17日，日军飞机轰炸山阴。18日，“大顺泰”酒坊掌柜魏青龙等人及美国牧师爱施娘率众出迎日军，山阴县城遂告沦陷。山阴失守使同蒲线北段与雁门关之间的联系被切断。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》与《山西：全国抗战的桥头堡》。 On 17 September 1937 Japanese aircraft bombed Shanyin. On the 18th Wei Qinglong, manager of the Dashuntai distillery, and the American missionary Aishiniang led a group out to welcome the Japanese, and the county town fell. The loss of Shanyin cut the link between the northern Tongpu railway and Yanmen Pass.

summary.zh: 1937年9月19日，日军混成第1旅团占领左云县城。
summary.en: On 19 September 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Zuoyun.

fields.name: 左云沦陷 Fall of Zuoyun
fields.summary: 1937年9月19日，日军混成第1旅团占领左云县城。 On 19 September 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Zuoyun.
fields.description: 9月17日，骑兵军孙长胜部数百人入左云守城，当晚日军攻城因雨停止。18日黄昏守军撤走，19日上午日军入城，随即屠杀居民287人。日期取《太原会战》逐日条“九月十九日……侵占左云”；《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》记18日黄昏守军撤走、次日入城，与此一致。 On 17 September several hundred men of Sun Changsheng’s cavalry entered Zuoyun; the Japanese attack that night was halted by rain. The defenders withdrew at dusk on the 18th and the Japanese entered on the morning of the 19th, then massacred 287 residents. The date follows the day-by-day campaign account, consistent with the county gazetteer compilation’s account of the defenders’ withdrawal on the 18th.

summary.zh: 1937年9月19日，日军河村支队占领兴和。
summary.en: On 19 September 1937 the Japanese Kawamura detachment occupied Xinghe.

fields.name: 兴和沦陷 Fall of Xinghe
fields.summary: 1937年9月19日，日军河村支队占领兴和。 On 19 September 1937 the Japanese Kawamura detachment occupied Xinghe.
fields.description: 1937年9月6日，日军独立混成第1旅团河村支队占领南壕堑，掩护兵团右侧；19日占领兴和，随后向凉城（宁远）方向推进，24日与自右玉方向进攻的松井支队会合，攻克隆城。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》；《内蒙古区情网》记9月17日日军入侵兴和，正文并列。 On 6 September 1937 the Kawamura detachment of the Japanese 1st Independent Mixed Brigade took Nanhaojian to cover the army’s right flank; on the 19th it took Xinghe and advanced toward Liangcheng (Ningyuan), joining the Matsui detachment from Youyu on the 24th to capture the town. The Inner Mongolia gazetteer gives 17 September for the Japanese entry into Xinghe; that variant is noted.

summary.zh: 日军第 5 师团占领灵丘，随即南下进攻平型关。
summary.en: The Japanese 5th Division took Lingqiu and moved south against Pingxingguan.

fields.name: 日军占领灵丘 Japanese capture of Lingqiu
fields.place: 山西灵丘县城 Lingqiu county town, Shanxi
fields.summary: 日军第 5 师团占领灵丘，随即南下进攻平型关。 The Japanese 5th Division took Lingqiu and moved south against Pingxingguan.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 20 日日军第 5 师团占领灵丘县城，随后沿灵丘—平型关大道南下；9 月 25 日八路军第 115 师在乔沟伏击其辎重部队，平型关战斗爆发。 On 20 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division took Lingqiu county town and moved south along the Lingqiu–Pingxingguan road; on 25 September the 115th Division ambushed its supply column at Qiaogou.

fields.name: 应县沦陷 Fall of Yingxian
fields.summary: 1937年9月20日，日军一部由大同开到应县，地方绅商迎入城内。 On 20 September 1937 a Japanese force came from Datong to Yingxian and local notables welcomed it into the town.
fields.description: 1937年9月20日，日军一部由大同开到应县，张退庵及留日学生田汝弼、高雅斋等人组织维持会，手执太阳旗到西门外迎接日军入城。应县失守后，晋北各县维持会相继成立。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》与《山西：全国抗战的桥头堡》。 On 20 September 1937 a Japanese force came from Datong to Yingxian. Zhang Tui’an and returned students Tian Rubi and Gao Yazhai organised a maintenance committee and welcomed the Japanese at the west gate with Japanese flags. After Yingxian fell, maintenance committees were set up across northern Shanxi.

fields.name: 右玉沦陷 Fall of Youyu
fields.summary: 1937年9月20日，日军逼近右玉，地方绅商迎入，日军穿城而过进攻凉城、绥远。 On 20 September 1937 the Japanese approached Youyu, were welcomed by local notables, and passed through toward Liangcheng and Suiyuan.
fields.description: 1937年9月20日，日军逼近右玉县城，守军赵承绶骑兵军一个营随县政府撤往西山。商会会长刘根玉、高小校长樊瑞武等派李岐山、关云山等十余人打日本国旗迎接日军入城。日军穿城而过，进攻凉城、绥远，只留一个宣抚班。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》与《山西：全国抗战的桥头堡》。 On 20 September 1937 the Japanese approached Youyu. A battalion of Zhao Chengshou’s cavalry corps withdrew with the county government to the western hills. Chamber of commerce chairman Liu Genyu and school principal Fan Ruiwu sent Li Qishan, Guan Yunshan and others with Japanese flags to welcome the Japanese, who passed through the town toward Liangcheng and Suiyuan, leaving only a propaganda unit.

name.en: Publication of the CCP declaration on KMT–CCP cooperation

summary.zh: 1937 年 9 月 22 日，国民党中央通讯社发表中共合作宣言；次日蒋介石谈话，第二次国共合作正式形成。
summary.en: On 22 September 1937 the KMT news agency published the CCP declaration; Chiang’s statement the next day marked the formal formation of the second united front.

fields.name: 《中共中央为公布国共合作宣言》发表 Publication of the CCP declaration on KMT–CCP cooperation
fields.summary: 1937 年 9 月 22 日，国民党中央通讯社发表中共合作宣言；次日蒋介石谈话，第二次国共合作正式形成。 On 22 September 1937 the KMT news agency published the CCP declaration; Chiang’s statement the next day marked the formal formation of the second united front.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 22 日，在中共中央多次催促下，国民党中央通讯社发表延搁两个多月的《中共中央为公布国共合作宣言》。9 月 23 日，蒋介石发表《对中国共产党宣言的谈话》，指出团结御侮的必要，事实上承认了中国共产党的合法地位。以宣言和蒋介石谈话的发表为标志，国共两党第二次合作正式形成，以国共合作为基础的抗日民族统一战线建立。宣言与谈话并未解决两党合作的组织形式与共同纲领问题，这成为此后摩擦的来源之一。本事件为政治文件发表，不绘路线。 On 22 September 1937, after repeated CCP urgings, the Kuomintang Central News Agency published the CCP declaration on cooperation that had been held back for more than two months. On 23 September Chiang Kai-shek issued a statement on the declaration, stressing the need for unity against aggression and in effect recognising the CCP’s legal status. The declaration and Chiang’s statement marked the formal formation of the second KMT–CCP united front. The two sides still lacked a joint organisational form and a common programme, which became a source of later friction. No route is drawn.

fields.summary: 日军第 1 军沿平汉线南下，占领保定。 The Japanese 1st Army advanced south along the Peiping–Hankou railway and captured Baoding.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月，日军第 1 军沿平汉线南下，中国守军在第 2 战区节节抵抗。9 月 24 日，日军占领保定，随后继续向石家庄推进。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1937 the Japanese 1st Army advanced south along the Peiping–Hankou railway against Chinese 2nd War Zone troops. On 24 September it captured Baoding and continued toward Shijiazhuang. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 沧州沦陷 Fall of Cangzhou
fields.summary: 1937年9月24日，日军攻占沧州。 On 24 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Cangzhou.
fields.description: 9月，日军沿津浦铁路南犯。9月24日，日军攻占沧州。沧州是津浦线北段重镇，失守后日军继续南犯德州、济南。日期据《河北抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 In September Japanese forces advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway and captured Cangzhou on 24 September. A key town on the northern section of the line, its fall opened the way south toward Dezhou and Jinan. The date follows the Hebei war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 集宁沦陷 Fall of Jining
fields.summary: 1937年9月24日，日军占领集宁（平地泉）。 On 24 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Jining (Pingdiquan).
fields.description: 1937年9月24日，日军独立步兵第11联队占领绥东重镇平地泉（今集宁）。集宁守备司令曾延毅临阵脱逃，守军崩溃。集宁失守后，日军打开西进归绥的门户。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》；《内蒙古区情网》记9月27日占集宁，正文并列。 On 24 September 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment took Pingdiquan (modern Jining), the key town of eastern Suiyuan. The garrison commander Zeng Yanyi fled and the defence collapsed. The fall of Jining opened the way west to Guisui. The Inner Mongolia gazetteer gives 27 September; that variant is noted.

summary.en: On 24 September 1937 the Japanese captured Liangcheng (Ningyuan).

fields.name: 凉城沦陷 Fall of Liangcheng
fields.summary: 1937年9月24日，日军攻占凉城（宁远）。 On 24 September 1937 the Japanese captured Liangcheng (Ningyuan).
fields.description: 1937年9月19日日军占领兴和后，河村支队向凉城（宁远）方向推进；24日与自右玉方向进攻的松井支队会合，攻克隆城。凉城失守后，日军从东南方向逼近归绥。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》，两源一致。 After taking Xinghe on 19 September 1937, the Kawamura detachment advanced toward Liangcheng (Ningyuan); on the 24th it joined the Matsui detachment from Youyu and captured the town. The fall of Liangcheng brought the Japanese toward Guisui from the southeast. Both cited accounts give 24 September.

fields.summary: 八路军第115师在平型关东北伏击日军，取得全面抗战初期的重要胜利。 The 115th Division ambushed Japanese forces northeast of Pingxingguan, an important early victory of the full-scale war.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 25 日，八路军第115师（师长林彪、副师长聂荣臻）在山西灵丘平型关东北的乔沟一带伏击日军第5师团第21旅团一部及辎重部队，毙伤日军一部，击毁汽车、马车多辆，取得全面抗战初期中国军队主动出击的重要胜利。此战打破了“日军不可战胜”的神话，也提高了八路军在华北的声威。 参战兵力与战果各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 On 25 September 1937 the 115th Division (commander Lin Biao, deputy commander Nie Rongzhen) ambushed a detachment of the Japanese 5th Division’s 21st Brigade and its supply train in the Qiaogou area northeast of Pingxingguan, Lingqiu, Shanxi, inflicting casualties and destroying trucks and carts. It was an important early victory won by Chinese forces taking the initiative, and it raised the Eighth Route Army’s prestige in North China. Force sizes and results vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Fall of Shuoxian and the Shuoxian Massacre

summary.zh: 1937年9月28日，日军攻破朔县县城，随后屠杀居民约三千人。
summary.en: On 28 September 1937 Japanese forces broke into Shuoxian and massacred some 3,000 residents.

fields.name: 朔县沦陷与朔县屠城 Fall of Shuoxian and the Shuoxian Massacre
fields.summary: 1937年9月28日，日军攻破朔县县城，随后屠杀居民约三千人。 On 28 September 1937 Japanese forces broke into Shuoxian and massacred some 3,000 residents.
fields.description: 9月27日傍晚，日军独立混成第1旅团进入朔县川。守军东北军何柱国部一个连与县长郭同仁、公安局长白生成率军民堵门守城。28日晨日军分两路包围县城，9时许以坦克破门，随即展开屠杀，持续三日，约三千人遇害，县长郭同仁殉难，是为“九二八惨案”。日期据《太原会战》逐日条“九月二十八日……占领朔县”与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（朔县政协稿）。 On the evening of 27 September the Japanese Independent Mixed 1st Brigade entered the Shuoxian basin. A company of He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army, county magistrate Guo Tongren and police chief Bai Shengcheng led civilians in barricading the gates. At dawn on the 28th the Japanese encircled the town and broke in with tanks around 9 a.m., beginning a three-day massacre in which about 3,000 people died and magistrate Guo was killed. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年9月29日，日军混成第15旅团占领繁峙县城。
summary.en: On 29 September 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade occupied Fanshi.

fields.name: 繁峙沦陷 Fall of Fanshi
fields.summary: 1937年9月29日，日军混成第15旅团占领繁峙县城。 On 29 September 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade occupied Fanshi.
fields.description: 9月28日，日军混成第15旅团攻占茹越口，中国守军第203旅旅长梁鉴堂力战殉国，日军越铁角岭南下。9月29日繁峙县城失守，平型关守军侧后受到威胁，第二战区随即下令全线后撤。日期据《太原会战》逐日记载与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（繁峙县政协、县志办稿）。 On 28 September the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade took Ruyuekou after killing Brig. Liang Jiantang of the 203rd Brigade, then crossed Tiejiaoling. Fanshi fell on the 29th, threatening the rear of the Pingxingguan defenders and prompting the Second War Zone to order a general withdrawal. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年9月30日，日军混成第15旅团占领代县县城。
summary.en: On 30 September 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade occupied Daixian.

fields.name: 代县沦陷 Fall of Daixian
fields.summary: 1937年9月30日，日军混成第15旅团占领代县县城。 On 30 September 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade occupied Daixian.
fields.description: 9月30日，日军由繁峙向代县进犯，晋绥军抵抗约半小时即退，日军当晚占领代县城。次日地方商会出面成立“代县治安维持会”。日期据《太原会战》逐日条“九月三十日……占领代县”与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（代县政协稿）。 On 30 September Japanese troops advanced from Fanshi toward Daixian; the Shanxi garrison resisted for about half an hour before withdrawing and the town fell that evening. The local chamber of commerce set up a “maintenance committee” the next day. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年10月2日，日军混成第1旅团占领宁武县城，随后屠杀居民两千余人。
summary.en: On 2 October 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Ningwu and massacred more than 2,000 residents.

fields.name: 宁武沦陷 Fall of Ningwu
fields.summary: 1937年10月2日，日军混成第1旅团占领宁武县城，随后屠杀居民两千余人。 On 2 October 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Ningwu and massacred more than 2,000 residents.
fields.description: 10月2日，日军由朔县进攻宁武，晚九时占领县城。日军诱骗外逃群众回城，随后集中屠杀，遇害者两千二百余人。10月13日八路军第120师袭击县城，日军连夜撤离；1938年日军再次入侵。日期据《太原会战》逐日条与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（宁武县政协稿）。 On 2 October Japanese troops advanced from Shuoxian and took Ningwu at 9 p.m. They lured fleeing residents back and then massacred more than 2,200 people. On 13 October the 120th Division attacked the town and the Japanese withdrew overnight; they invaded again in 1938. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年10月5日，日军第10师团攻占德州。
summary.en: On 5 October 1937 the Japanese 10th Division captured Dezhou.

fields.name: 德州沦陷 Fall of Dezhou
fields.summary: 1937年10月5日，日军第10师团攻占德州。 On 5 October 1937 the Japanese 10th Division captured Dezhou.
fields.description: 9月30日，日军第10师团沿津浦路侵入山东。10月3日进攻德州，中国守军第3集团军抵抗；10月5日德州沦陷。日军占领后掠夺资源、强征劳工，德州成为津浦路北段重要据点。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军进攻山东》，待页码级核对。 On 30 September the Japanese 10th Division entered Shandong along the Tianjin–Pukou railway. It attacked Dezhou on 3 October against resistance by the Chinese 3rd Group Army, and the city fell on 5 October. Japanese forces then plundered resources and conscripted labour, making Dezhou a key point on the northern section of the railway. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the provincial party history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 定县沦陷 Fall of Dingxian
fields.summary: 1937年10月8日，日军攻占定县。 On 8 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Dingxian.
fields.description: 10月，日军沿平汉铁路南犯。10月8日，日军攻占定县。定县是平汉线中段重镇，失守后日军继续南犯石家庄。日期据《中国抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 In October Japanese forces advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and captured Dingxian on 8 October. A key town on the central section of the line, its fall opened the way south toward Shijiazhuang. The date follows the Chinese war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 8 October 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade captured Guoxian.

fields.name: 崞县沦陷 Fall of Guoxian
fields.place: 山西崞县 Guoxian (now Guoyang, Yuanping), Shanxi
fields.summary: 1937年10月8日，日军混成第2旅团攻占崞县县城。 On 8 October 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade captured Guoxian.
fields.description: 10月1日起，日军混成第2旅团由代县南下进攻崞县，第19军王靖国部苦战一周。10月8日晨守军撤出，崞县失守，团长刘良相、石成文阵亡，日军入城后屠杀居民与伤兵两千五百余人。崞县即今原平市崞阳镇，与南面的原平镇为忻口以北两处要点。日期据《太原会战》逐日条与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（原平县政协稿）。 From 1 October the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade advanced south from Daixian against Guoxian, where Wang Jingguo’s 19th Corps fought for a week. The defenders withdrew on the morning of the 8th; colonels Liu Liangxiang and Shi Chengwen were killed and the Japanese massacred more than 2,500 residents and wounded. Guoxian is today’s Guoyang town in Yuanping. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年10月8日，日军攻占正定，随后制造正定惨案。
summary.en: On 8 October 1937 the Japanese captured Zhengding and then carried out the Zhengding massacre.

fields.name: 正定沦陷 Fall of Zhengding
fields.summary: 1937年10月8日，日军攻占正定，随后制造正定惨案。 On 8 October 1937 the Japanese captured Zhengding and then carried out the Zhengding massacre.
fields.description: 1937年10月7日，日军开始进攻正定县城，中国守军顽强抵抗。8日，日军攻占正定城，登上正定北门城楼；入城后屠杀平民，制造正定惨案。正定失守后，日军直逼石家庄。日期据《正定惨案》与当时《朝日新闻》报道。 On 7 October 1937 the Japanese began attacking Zhengding, meeting stubborn resistance. On the 8th they took the city and raised their flag on the north gate, then massacred civilians in what became known as the Zhengding massacre. The fall of Zhengding opened the way to Shijiazhuang.

summary.zh: 日军占领石家庄，控制平汉、正太两铁路交会点。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Shijiazhuang, controlling the junction of the Peiping–Hankou and Zhengding–Taiyuan railways.

fields.name: 石家庄沦陷 Fall of Shijiazhuang
fields.summary: 日军占领石家庄，控制平汉、正太两铁路交会点。 Japanese forces captured Shijiazhuang, controlling the junction of the Peiping–Hankou and Zhengding–Taiyuan railways.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军第 1 军沿平汉线继续南下。10 月 10 日，日军占领石家庄，控制平汉、正太两铁路交会点，为沿正太线西攻娘子关、太原创造条件。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1937 the Japanese 1st Army continued south along the Peiping–Hankou railway. On 10 October it captured Shijiazhuang, the junction of the Peiping–Hankou and Zhengding–Taiyuan railways, creating conditions for the westward drive along the Zhengding–Taiyuan line toward Niangziguan and Taiyuan. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 原平沦陷 Fall of Yuanping
fields.place: 山西崞县原平镇 Yuanping, Shanxi
fields.summary: 1937年10月10日，日军混成第15旅团攻占原平镇，守军第196旅几乎全部殉国。 On 10 October 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade captured Yuanping; the Chinese 196th Brigade was almost annihilated.
fields.description: 10月4日，日军混成第15旅团绕过崞县进攻原平，第34军第196旅旅长姜玉贞率部死守。原平掩护忻口布防，守军完成任务后于10日夜至11日晨突围，姜玉贞中弹殉国，全旅四千余人大部阵亡。日期取《太原会战》逐日条“十月十日……攻占原平”；姜玉贞突围殉国在11日，两说并不矛盾。 On 4 October the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade bypassed Guoxian and attacked Yuanping, defended by Brig. Jiang Yuzhen’s 196th Brigade of the 34th Corps. Covering the deployment at Xinkou, the brigade broke out on the night of the 10th; Jiang was mortally wounded and most of his 4,000 men died. The capture date follows the day-by-day campaign account; Jiang’s death during the breakout on the 11th is consistent with it.

name.zh: 东北抗联第二路军成立

place.zh: 吉林依兰四道河子（今林口）

summary.zh: 1937年10月10日，吉东省委在依兰四道河子宣布东北抗日联军第二路军成立，周保中任总指挥。
summary.en: On 10 October 1937 the Jilin-Dongman party committee proclaimed the 2nd Route Army at Sidaohezi in Yilan, with Zhou Baozhong as commander.

fields.name: 东北抗联第二路军成立 Formation of the 2nd Route Army
fields.place: 吉林依兰四道河子（今林口） Sidaohezi, Yilan (modern Linkou), Jilin
fields.summary: 1937年10月10日，吉东省委在依兰四道河子宣布东北抗日联军第二路军成立，周保中任总指挥。 On 10 October 1937 the Jilin-Dongman party committee proclaimed the 2nd Route Army at Sidaohezi in Yilan, with Zhou Baozhong as commander.
fields.description: 1937 年 3 月，中共吉东省委在依兰四道河子成立。为统一吉东地区抗联各军的指挥，9 月 29 日周保中在四道河子密营主持召开省委常委工作会议，决定以第四、第五、第七、第八、第十军为基础，联合姚振山部义勇军与王荫武部救世军，成立东北抗日联军第二路军，周保中任总指挥，崔石泉任参谋长，赵尚志任副总指挥。10 月 10 日，以第五军名义发表《通告》，宣布第二路军正式成立，活动区域包括中东路哈绥线两侧、牡丹江流域、方正以下松花江右岸与乌苏里江左岸，共约 20 余县。1938 年 1 月，周保中在饶河主持召开下江特委扩大会议，整顿第七军并调整各师团干部，与 10 月成立事不同，不应混为一谈。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 The Jilin-Dongman provincial committee was formed at Sidaohezi in Yilan in March 1937. To unify command in the east, Zhou Baozhong convened a standing-committee meeting at the Sidaohezi base on 29 September and decided to build the 2nd Route Army on the 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th and 10th Armies together with Yao Zhenshan’s volunteers and Wang Yinwu’s Salvation Army, with Zhou as commander, Cui Shiquan as chief of staff and Zhao Shangzhi as deputy. On 10 October a proclamation issued in the name of the 5th Army announced the army’s formation, covering both sides of the Harbin–Suifenhe railway, the Mudan valley, the right bank of the Songhua below Fangzheng and the left bank of the Ussuri — some twenty counties. In January 1938 Zhou held the lower-Songhua special committee meeting at Raohe to reorganise the 7th Army, a separate affair that should not be confused with the October formation. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

name.zh: 川军第22集团军参加娘子关战斗

summary.zh: 川军第22集团军自四川北上，在娘子关一线参加保卫战。
summary.en: The Sichuan 22nd Group Army marched north and fought in the defense of Niangziguan.

fields.name: 川军第22集团军参加娘子关战斗 22nd Group Army at Niangziguan
fields.summary: 川军第22集团军自四川北上，在娘子关一线参加保卫战。 The Sichuan 22nd Group Army marched north and fought in the defense of Niangziguan.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，川军第22集团军经宝鸡、西安北上，在娘子关一线参加对日作战。川军装备低劣、补给困难，仍以重大伤亡迟滞日军。此后该部转赴山东，参加滕县保卫战。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In October 1937 the Sichuan 22nd Group Army moved north via Baoji and Xi’an and fought the Japanese at Niangziguan. Poorly equipped and badly supplied, it still delayed the Japanese at great cost. The army then moved to Shandong and fought in the defense of Tengxian. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Japanese Occupation of Jingxing Coal Mines

summary.zh: 1937年10月11日，日军侵占井陉煤矿，改设“兴中公司井陉采炭所”。
summary.en: On 11 October 1937 the Japanese seized the Jingxing coal mines and renamed them the Xingzhong Company Jingxing colliery.

fields.name: 井陉煤矿被日军占领 Japanese Occupation of Jingxing Coal Mines
fields.summary: 1937年10月11日，日军侵占井陉煤矿，改设“兴中公司井陉采炭所”。 On 11 October 1937 the Japanese seized the Jingxing coal mines and renamed them the Xingzhong Company Jingxing colliery.
fields.description: 1937年10月10日日军攻占石家庄后，随即重兵控制井陉煤矿。10月11日，日军侵占井陉煤矿，改名为“兴中公司井陉采炭所”，1938年5月又吞并正丰煤矿。日军在矿区周围挖壕沟、筑碉堡、架电网，残酷压榨矿工，留下南大沟万人坑。日期据石家庄市井陉矿区人民政府《历史沿革》与《井陉矿区南大沟万人坑》。 After taking Shijiazhuang on 10 October 1937 the Japanese moved troops to control the Jingxing coal mines. On the 11th they seized the mines and renamed them the Xingzhong Company Jingxing colliery; in May 1938 they absorbed the Zhengfeng mine as well. The Japanese dug trenches, built blockhouses and strung electrified wire around the mining area, brutally exploiting the miners and leaving the Nandagou mass grave.

summary.zh: 中国军队在忻口阻击日军，激战近一个月，忻口最终失守，太原随后沦陷。
summary.en: Chinese forces blocked the Japanese at Xinkou for nearly a month before the position fell and Taiyuan was lost.

fields.name: 忻口会战 Battle of Xinkou 忻口战役 Xinkou Campaign
fields.summary: 中国军队在忻口阻击日军，激战近一个月，忻口最终失守，太原随后沦陷。 Chinese forces blocked the Japanese at Xinkou for nearly a month before the position fell and Taiyuan was lost.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军第五师团等部沿同蒲铁路南下，进攻忻口。中国第二战区部队在卫立煌指挥下依托阵地顽强抵抗，双方在忻口一线激战。日军久攻不下，后因娘子关失守、中国军队侧后受威胁，中国军队于 11 月 2 日撤退，太原于 11 月 8 日失守。此役是太原会战的重要组成部分。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In October 1937, Japanese forces including the 5th Division advanced south along the Datong–Pukou railway and attacked Xinkou. Chinese troops of the Second War Zone, commanded by Wei Lihuang, resisted stubbornly from prepared positions in fierce fighting around Xinkou. Unable to break through quickly, the Japanese exploited the fall of Niangziguan and threatened the Chinese flank and rear; Chinese forces withdrew on 2 November, and Taiyuan fell on 8 November. The battle was an important part of the Taiyuan campaign. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.place: 绥远归绥（今呼和浩特） Guisui (present-day Hohhot), Suiyuan
fields.summary: 日军占领绥远省会归绥。 Japanese forces captured Guisui, the capital of Suiyuan.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团沿平绥线西进，进攻绥远。10 月 14 日，日军占领归绥（今呼和浩特），中国守军撤退。归绥沦陷使日军控制绥远东部，随后进攻包头。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Expeditionary Force advanced west along the Peiping–Suiyuan railway into Suiyuan. On 14 October it captured Guisui (present-day Hohhot) and the Chinese defenders withdrew. The fall of Guisui gave Japan control of eastern Suiyuan and opened the way to Baotou. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: First Japanese Air Raid on Guilin

summary.zh: 1937年10月15日，日机首次轰炸桂林，死伤500余人。
summary.en: On 15 October 1937 Japanese aircraft bombed Guilin for the first time, causing over 500 casualties.

fields.name: 日军首次轰炸桂林 First Japanese Air Raid on Guilin
fields.summary: 1937年10月15日，日机首次轰炸桂林，死伤500余人。 On 15 October 1937 Japanese aircraft bombed Guilin for the first time, causing over 500 casualties.
fields.description: 1937年10月15日上午11时35分，日军重轰炸机中队飞抵桂林轰炸，在城郊投弹40余枚、城内落8弹，炸毁民房39所，死市民53人、伤200人，附郊9处被炸，合计死伤500余人（另有700余人之说）。日期据《飞虎队桂林秧塘机场抗战纪事》与《论日军对桂林的轰炸》。 At 11:35 a.m. on 15 October 1937 a Japanese heavy bomber squadron raided Guilin, dropping over 40 bombs in the suburbs and eight in the city, destroying 39 houses, killing 53 civilians and wounding 200, with nine suburban villages also hit; total casualties exceeded 500 (some accounts say 700).

fields.summary: 1937年10月16日，日军占领萨拉齐县城，制造萨拉齐惨案。 On 16 October 1937 the Japanese occupied Salaqi and carried out the Salaqi massacre.
fields.description: 1937年10月14日归绥失陷后，日军沿平包铁路西进，16日上午进犯萨拉齐县城，不到两小时内屠杀居民70人；同日又在公积板村杀害村民41人。17日日军占领包头。日期据《内蒙古区情网》、浙江在线《10月16日》与《日军进犯包头途中的两起大屠杀》，三源一致。 After Guisui fell on 14 October 1937 the Japanese advanced west along the Beiping–Baotou railway. On the morning of the 16th they entered Salaqi and killed 70 residents in less than two hours, then killed 41 villagers at Gongjiban; Baotou fell on the 17th. Three cited accounts agree on 16 October.

fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，八路军第120师第358旅第716团在山西代县雁门关以南的黑石头沟地区连续两次设伏，袭击日军往返于大同、忻口之间的汽车运输队，一度切断日军补给线，配合了正面战场的忻口防御作战。 参战部队、日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1937 the 716th Regiment of the 358th Brigade, 120th Division, set ambushes twice in the Heishitougou area south of Yanmenguan, Daixian, Shanxi, attacking Japanese truck convoys between Datong and Xinkou. The attacks temporarily cut the Japanese supply line and supported the Xinkou defense on the regular front. Units, dates, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The 769th Regiment of the 129th Division raided Yangmingbao airfield at night, destroying or damaging 24 Japanese aircraft.

fields.name: 夜袭阳明堡 Night Raid on Yangmingbao 阳明堡战斗 Battle of Yangmingbao
fields.place: 山西代县阳明堡 Yangmingbao, Daixian, Shanxi
fields.summary: 八路军第129师第769团夜袭阳明堡机场，毁伤日军飞机 24 架。 The 769th Regiment of the 129th Division raided Yangmingbao airfield at night, destroying or damaging 24 Japanese aircraft.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月 19 日夜，八路军第129师第769团（团长陈锡联）突袭山西代县阳明堡日军机场，毁伤飞机 24 架，歼灭机场警卫分队百余人，打击了日军在忻口方向的空中支援。 日期、战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On the night of 19 October 1937 the 769th Regiment of the 129th Division (commander Chen Xilian) raided the Japanese airfield at Yangmingbao, Daixian, Shanxi, destroying or damaging 24 aircraft and killing more than a hundred airfield guards, thereby reducing Japanese air support for the Xinkou front. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 八路军第129师第386旅在七亘村连续两次重叠设伏，打击日军辎重部队。
summary.en: The 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed Japanese supply troops twice at the same spot near Qigencun.

fields.name: 七亘村伏击战 Ambush at Qigencun 七亘大捷 Qigen Victory
fields.place: 山西平定七亘村 Qigencun, Pingding, Shanxi
fields.summary: 八路军第129师第386旅在七亘村连续两次重叠设伏，打击日军辎重部队。 The 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed Japanese supply troops twice at the same spot near Qigencun.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月 26 日和 28 日，八路军第129师第386旅第772团在山西平定县七亘村连续两次设伏，袭击向平定方向运送物资的日军第20师团辎重部队，毙伤日军数百人。刘伯承将这种在同一地点重复设伏的战法称为“重叠设伏”。 日期、番号与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 26 and 28 October 1937 the 772nd Regiment of the 386th Brigade, 129th Division, ambushed Japanese 20th Division supply troops carrying matériel toward Pingding at Qigencun, Shanxi, inflicting several hundred casualties. Liu Bocheng called this repeated ambush at the same site “overlapping ambush.” Dates, unit designations, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 娘子关失守 Fall of Niangziguan
fields.place: 山西平定娘子关 Niangziguan, Pingding, Shanxi
fields.summary: 日军第 20 师团等部攻占娘子关，打开晋东门户。 The Japanese 20th Division and other units captured Niangziguan, opening the eastern gateway to Shanxi.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军第 20 师团等部沿正太线西进，进攻娘子关。中国军队第 26 路军、第 27 路军等部在娘子关、旧关一带顽强抵抗。10 月 26 日，娘子关失守，日军随后西进太原。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division and other units advanced west along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway against Niangziguan. Chinese 26th and 27th Route Army troops resisted stubbornly at Niangziguan and Jiuguan. Niangziguan fell on 26 October and the Japanese advanced west toward Taiyuan. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月26日，日军在料罗湾登陆，进攻金门县城。
summary.en: On 26 October 1937 Japanese forces landed at Liaoluo Bay and attacked the Kinmen county town.

fields.name: 金门料罗湾登陆 Landing at Liaoluo Bay, Kinmen
fields.place: 福建金门料罗湾 Liaoluo Bay, Kinmen, Fujian
fields.summary: 1937年10月26日，日军在料罗湾登陆，进攻金门县城。 On 26 October 1937 Japanese forces landed at Liaoluo Bay and attacked the Kinmen county town.
fields.description: 10月26日12时，日军攻占金门县城。日军在料罗湾登陆后向金门城推进，金门县长邝汉未待日军登陆即擅离职守，率家属和公务人员先逃往大嶝岛，然后转逃漳州。日期据《泉州抗日战争大事记》与《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 At noon on 26 October Japanese forces captured the Kinmen county town. After landing at Liaoluo Bay they advanced on the town; county magistrate Kuang Han abandoned his post before the landing, fleeing with his family and staff first to Dadeng island and then to Zhangzhou. The date follows the Quanzhou and Zhangzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月26日，金门县城沦陷。
summary.en: On 26 October 1937 the Kinmen county town fell.

fields.name: 金门沦陷 Fall of Kinmen
fields.place: 福建金门城 Kinmen town, Fujian
fields.summary: 1937年10月26日，金门县城沦陷。 On 26 October 1937 the Kinmen county town fell.
fields.description: 10月26日，日军攻占金门县城，金门沦陷。金门县政府退至大嶝岛，改设办事处。金门是福建最早沦陷的县份之一。日期据《泉州抗日战争大事记》与《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 26 October Japanese forces captured the Kinmen county town and Kinmen fell. The county government withdrew to Dadeng island and set up an office there. Kinmen was one of the earliest counties in Fujian to fall. The date follows the Quanzhou and Zhangzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月26日夜，第88师524团1营420余人进驻四行仓库，孤军坚守四昼夜。
summary.en: On the night of 26 October 1937 over 420 men of the 88th Division's 524th Regiment entered the Sihang Warehouse and held it alone for four days and nights.

fields.name: 四行仓库保卫战 Defence of the Sihang Warehouse
fields.place: 上海四行仓库 Sihang Warehouse, Shanghai
fields.summary: 1937年10月26日夜，第88师524团1营420余人进驻四行仓库，孤军坚守四昼夜。 On the night of 26 October 1937 over 420 men of the 88th Division's 524th Regiment entered the Sihang Warehouse and held it alone for four days and nights.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月 26 日大场失守，苏州河以北防线瓦解，中国军队主力西撤。为向即将召开的九国公约会议显示抗战决心，第88师师长孙元良决定留一个加强营守闸北，由第262旅524团中校团附谢晋元、营长杨瑞符率 420 余人于 10 月 26 日深夜进驻苏州河北岸的四行仓库；为迷惑日军，对外统一宣称守军 800 人，故称「八百壮士」。10 月 27 日晨日军进攻，孤军依托钢筋混凝土仓库与租界仅一河之隔的位置，日军顾忌炮弹落入公共租界不敢用重炮；激战四昼夜，打退十余次进攻。28 日拂晓，日军偷袭仓库，士兵陈树生身缚手榴弹自五楼跃下与敌同归于尽。29 日清晨，女童子军杨惠敏送来的国旗在仓库楼顶升起。10 月 31 日凌晨，孤军奉命撤入公共租界。本事件为城市据点防御战，不绘路线。 On 26 October 1937 Dachang fell and the Chinese line north of Suzhou Creek collapsed; the main force withdrew west. To show resolve on the eve of the Nine-Power Conference, the 88th Division commander Sun Yuanliang left one reinforced battalion in Zhabei: more than 420 men of the 262nd Brigade, 524th Regiment, under the regimental executive officer Xie Jinyuan and battalion commander Yang Ruifu, entered the Sihang Warehouse on the north bank of Suzhou Creek late that night. To deceive the Japanese they claimed 800 defenders, hence the “800 Heroes”. The Japanese attacked on the morning of the 27th; holding a reinforced-concrete warehouse separated from the International Settlement only by the creek, the defenders benefited from the Japanese reluctance to use heavy guns across the boundary, and beat off more than ten assaults over four days and nights. At dawn on the 28th, when Japanese troops broke in, Private Chen Shusheng jumped from the fifth floor with grenades strapped to him and died with them. On the morning of the 29th a Chinese flag brought by the girl scout Yang Huimin was raised over the warehouse. Before dawn on 31 October the survivors were ordered to withdraw into the International Settlement. This was an urban strongpoint defence; no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1937年10月29日，日军第20师团侵占平定县城。
summary.en: On 29 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Pingding.

fields.name: 平定沦陷 Fall of Pingding
fields.summary: 1937年10月29日，日军第20师团侵占平定县城。 On 29 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Pingding.
fields.description: 10月26日娘子关失守后，日军第20师团沿正太线西追。平定县长及公务人员先期弃城，守军炸毁阳泉五渡铁路桥后西撤。10月29日夜十时许日军先头部队进入平定城，翌日大队开进，30日占领阳泉。日期据《太原会战》逐日条“十月二十九日……侵占平定县城”与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（平定县政协稿）。 After Niangziguan fell on 26 October, the Japanese 20th Division pursued west along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway. The Pingding magistrate and officials had fled and the garrison withdrew after blowing up the Wudu railway bridge at Yangquan. Japanese advance troops entered Pingding around 10 p.m. on the 29th, the main body followed next morning, and Yangquan was occupied on the 30th. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年10月30日，日军第20师团占领阳泉镇。
summary.en: On 30 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Yangquan.

fields.name: 阳泉沦陷 Fall of Yangquan
fields.place: 山西平定阳泉镇 Yangquan, Shanxi
fields.summary: 1937年10月30日，日军第20师团占领阳泉镇。 On 30 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Yangquan.
fields.description: 阳泉时为平定县属镇，是正太铁路与煤矿枢纽。娘子关失守后，日军第20师团以两纵队向阳泉平原追击，10月30日占领阳泉，随后西犯寿阳、榆次。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（平定县政协稿）与《抗日战争中的阳泉》。 Yangquan was then a town in Pingding county and a hub of the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway and coal mines. After Niangziguan fell, the Japanese 20th Division pursued in two columns onto the Yangquan plain and occupied the town on 30 October before advancing on Shouyang and Yuci. Dates follow the county gazetteer compilation and the Shanxi war-resistance account of Yangquan.

fields.place: 上海胶州路孤军营 Jiaozhou Road camp, Shanghai
fields.summary: 1937年10月31日凌晨，四行孤军撤入公共租界，被缴械羁留胶州路孤军营近四年。 Before dawn on 31 October 1937 the Sihang defenders withdrew into the International Settlement, were disarmed and interned at Jiaozhou Road for nearly four years.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月 31 日凌晨，谢晋元率四行孤军 377 人奉命撤出仓库，经新垃圾桥（西藏路桥）进入公共租界，沿途市民夹道迎送。日军指挥官松井石根要求英方缴械并限制其自由，租界当局屈服：英军解除孤军武装，将其羁留于胶州路兵营（孤军营），四周铁丝网，门外由白俄士兵站岗。孤军营内，谢晋元组织官兵出操训练、学习文化、开办肥皂与线袜生产自给。1938 年 8 月 11 日孤军升旗遭租界当局与白俄士兵干涉，4 人死亡、百余人受伤；13 日谢晋元等 16 名军官被强行带离软禁，官兵绝食抗争。1941 年 4 月 24 日，谢晋元被汪伪收买的士兵刺杀，年 37 岁。本事件为租界羁留，不绘路线。 Before dawn on 31 October 1937 Xie Jinyuan led the 377 survivors out of the warehouse across the Xizang Road Bridge into the International Settlement, cheered by crowds along the way. The Japanese commander Matsui Iwane demanded that the British disarm them and restrict their freedom, and the settlement authorities complied: the men were disarmed and interned in the Jiaozhou Road barracks, surrounded by barbed wire and guarded by White Russian soldiers. Inside, Xie organised drill, schooling and small soap and sock workshops for self-support. On 11 August 1938 a flag-raising was broken up by the settlement authorities and White Russian guards, leaving four dead and over a hundred wounded; on the 13th Xie and 15 other officers were forcibly removed and placed under house arrest, and the men went on hunger strike. On 24 April 1941 Xie was assassinated by soldiers bought by the Wang Jingwei regime; he was 37. This was an internment in the concession; no route is drawn.

summary.en: On 2 November 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Shouyang.

fields.name: 寿阳沦陷 Fall of Shouyang
fields.summary: 1937年11月2日，日军第20师团占领寿阳县城。 On 2 November 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Shouyang.
fields.description: 日军第20师团自平定、阳泉西进，击退川军第41军阻击后于11月2日占领寿阳，随即逼近榆次、太原。八路军第115师、第129师先后在广阳伏击日军。寿阳日期取《太原会战》逐日条“十一月二日占寿阳”与《娘子关战役》所记同一日期；《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》寿阳县稿则记10月30日占领县城，异说并存，本条目从多数记载。 The Japanese 20th Division advanced west from Pingding and Yangquan, brushed aside the Sichuan 41st Corps and took Shouyang on 2 November, closing on Yuci and Taiyuan. The 115th and 129th Divisions ambushed Japanese columns at Guangyang. The date follows the day-by-day campaign account and the Niangziguan campaign account; the county gazetteer compilation gives 30 October as a variant, noted here.
