name.en: Air Defense and Relief in Chongqing

summary.zh: 重庆军民在长期轰炸下组织防空、疏散、救火与救济，坚持战时首都的运转。
summary.en: Under prolonged bombing, Chongqing’s soldiers and civilians organized air defense, evacuation, firefighting, and relief to keep the wartime capital functioning.

fields.name: 重庆防空与救灾 Air Defense and Relief in Chongqing
fields.summary: 重庆军民在长期轰炸下组织防空、疏散、救火与救济，坚持战时首都的运转。 Under prolonged bombing, Chongqing’s soldiers and civilians organized air defense, evacuation, firefighting, and relief to keep the wartime capital functioning.
fields.description: 1938 年至 1943 年，重庆在日军长期轰炸下建立防空警报、防空洞与疏散体系，组织消防、医疗与难民救济。1941 年 6 月 5 日大隧道惨案后，各界展开救援与善后。重庆军民在轰炸中坚持抗战，维持战时首都的运转。 政治/社会事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 From 1938 to 1943 Chongqing built air-raid warning, shelter, and evacuation systems under prolonged Japanese bombing, and organized firefighting, medical care, and refugee relief. After the Daxuidao tunnel disaster of 5 June 1941, relief and recovery efforts were undertaken. Soldiers and civilians persisted through the bombing and kept the wartime capital functioning. A political and social event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1938年2月18日，日军在余杭乔司镇连续烧杀3天，杀害平民1300余人。
summary.en: From 18 February 1938 Japanese troops burned and killed in Qiaosi, Yuhang, for three days, killing more than 1,300 civilians.

fields.name: 乔司惨案 Qiaosi Massacre
fields.place: 浙江杭县乔司 Qiaosi, Hang county, Zhejiang
fields.summary: 1938年2月18日，日军在余杭乔司镇连续烧杀3天，杀害平民1300余人。 From 18 February 1938 Japanese troops burned and killed in Qiaosi, Yuhang, for three days, killing more than 1,300 civilians.
fields.description: 2月18日，日军疯狂屠杀余杭乔司镇居民，施放火枪烧房子，用步枪和机枪扫射群众。日军连续烧杀3天，被害平民达1300余人，烧毁房屋7000余间，整个乔司镇成为一片废墟。事后人们收集遗骸建公墓，立碑为「戊寅公墓」，俗称「千人坑」。惨案不绘路线。 On 18 February Japanese troops massacred residents of Qiaosi in Yuhang, setting houses on fire and machine-gunning civilians. The killing and burning continued for three days: more than 1,300 civilians died and over 7,000 houses were destroyed, leaving the town in ruins. Survivors later collected the remains and built the Wuyin cemetery, known locally as the "thousand-person pit". The massacre is not drawn as a route.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1938年2月18日，日军第14师团占领获嘉。
summary.en: On 18 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Huojia.

fields.name: 获嘉沦陷 Fall of Huojia
fields.summary: 1938年2月18日，日军第14师团占领获嘉。 On 18 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Huojia.
fields.description: 新乡失守后，日军沿道清铁路继续西犯，18日占领获嘉，随后陷修武、焦作。获嘉是日军从新乡西进焦作、济源的中间节点。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》，两源一致。 After Xinxiang fell, the Japanese pushed west along the Daoqing railway, occupying Huojia on 18 February before taking Xiuwu and Jiaozuo. Huojia was the intermediate point on the Japanese advance from Xinxiang toward Jiaozuo and Jiyuan. Both sources agree on the date.

summary.zh: 1938年2月18日，日军坂西联队攻陷修武县城。
summary.en: On 18 February 1938 the Japanese Sakanishi regiment captured Xiuwu.

fields.name: 修武沦陷 Fall of Xiuwu
fields.summary: 1938年2月18日，日军坂西联队攻陷修武县城。 On 18 February 1938 the Japanese Sakanishi regiment captured Xiuwu.
fields.description: 1938年2月18日午后八时三十分，日军坂西联队攻陷修武县城，随后与县城以北的酒井部队继续西进，进犯焦作镇。修武失守使道清铁路西段门户洞开。日期据《河南惨案》与《沦陷时期日军对焦作煤矿的霸占掠夺》；郭廷以《中华民国史事日志》记2月19日陷修武，异说并存。 At about 8:30 p.m. on 18 February 1938 the Japanese Sakanishi regiment captured Xiuwu, then advanced west with the Sakai unit north of the county town toward Jiaozuo. The fall of Xiuwu opened the western Daqing railway. Guo Tingyi’s chronology gives 19 February.

summary.zh: 1938年2月19日，日军第14师团占领焦作。
summary.en: On 19 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Jiaozuo.

fields.name: 焦作沦陷 Fall of Jiaozuo
fields.summary: 1938年2月19日，日军第14师团占领焦作。 On 19 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Jiaozuo.
fields.description: 1938年2月18日日军陷修武，19日占领焦作。焦作煤矿与道清铁路由此落入日军之手，成为其掠夺煤炭、运输军用物资的基地。此后八路军第129师第386旅、第115师第344旅及道清游击支队在焦作地区六破道清铁路。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《焦作日报》抗战专题。 The Japanese took Xiuwu on 18 February 1938 and Jiaozuo on the 19th. The Jiaozuo coal mines and the Daoqing railway thus fell into Japanese hands, becoming a base for coal extraction and military transport. The 129th and 115th Divisions and the Daoqing guerrilla detachment subsequently sabotaged the railway six times.

summary.zh: 1938年2月20日，日军第108师团攻占长治。
summary.en: On 20 February 1938 the Japanese 108th Division captured Changzhi.

fields.name: 长治沦陷 Fall of Changzhi
fields.summary: 1938年2月20日，日军第108师团攻占长治。 On 20 February 1938 the Japanese 108th Division captured Changzhi.
fields.description: 1938年2月，日军第1军向晋南、晋西发动攻势。平汉线日军第108师团第104旅团（苫米地旅团）由东阳关突破川军第47军防线，2月20日攻占长治，随后沿临屯公路西进，威胁临汾。日期据《第三军在太行山对日游击作战》与《陈赓大将的这个神来之笔》所引战史，均记2月20日进占长治。 In February 1938 the Japanese First Army attacked southern and western Shanxi. The 108th Division’s 104th Brigade (Tomekichi brigade) broke through the Sichuan 47th Corps at Dongyangguan and captured Changzhi on 20 February, then advanced west along the Linfen–Tunliu road toward Linfen. Both cited accounts give 20 February for the capture.

summary.zh: 1938年2月20日正午，日军占领博爱（清化镇）。
summary.en: At noon on 20 February 1938 the Japanese occupied Bo’ai (Qinghua).

fields.name: 博爱沦陷 Fall of Bo’ai
fields.summary: 1938年2月20日正午，日军占领博爱（清化镇）。 At noon on 20 February 1938 the Japanese occupied Bo’ai (Qinghua).
fields.description: 1938年2月20日正午，日军土肥原第14师团远山登步兵第50联队、今田俊夫战车队占领博爱（清化镇）；十四时，石黑、森田、东乡等部相继入城。博爱是道清铁路终点站，失守后日军控制豫北煤炭外运枢纽。日期据《河南惨案》与《日军在博爱（清化镇）实施的三项计划》。 At noon on 20 February 1938 the Toyama Noboru 50th Infantry Regiment and Imada Toshio tank unit of the Japanese 14th Division under Doihara occupied Bo’ai (Qinghua); by 2 p.m. the Ishiguro, Morita and Tōgō units had also entered. Bo’ai was the terminus of the Daqing railway, and its fall gave Japan the coal-export hub of northern Henan.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1938年2月22日，日军道清线部队攻陷沁阳。
summary.en: On 22 February 1938 the Japanese Daqing railway force captured Qinyang.

fields.name: 沁阳沦陷 Fall of Qinyang
fields.summary: 1938年2月22日，日军道清线部队攻陷沁阳。 On 22 February 1938 the Japanese Daqing railway force captured Qinyang.
fields.description: 1938年2月22日，日军道清线部队攻陷沁阳、孟县。沁阳为豫北重镇，失守后日军继续西犯济源、南犯孟县。日期据郭廷以《中华民国史事日志》与《河南惨案》；后者只记2月20日至3月5日“相继攻陷博爱、沁阳、武陟、孟县、温县”，未列逐日。 On 22 February 1938 the Japanese force along the Daqing railway captured Qinyang and Mengxian. Qinyang was a key town of northern Henan; after its fall the Japanese continued west toward Jiyuan and south toward Mengxian. The date follows Guo Tingyi’s chronology and the Henan atrocity compilation; the latter gives only a 20 February–5 March range.

summary.zh: 1938年2月22日，日军攻陷孟县。
summary.en: On 22 February 1938 the Japanese captured Mengxian.

fields.name: 孟县沦陷 Fall of Mengxian
fields.summary: 1938年2月22日，日军攻陷孟县。 On 22 February 1938 the Japanese captured Mengxian.
fields.description: 1938年2月22日，日军攻陷孟县。孟县位于黄河北岸，失守后日军控制黄河渡口，威胁豫西。日期据郭廷以《中华民国史事日志》与红色文化网《有组织VS没组织》。 On 22 February 1938 the Japanese captured Mengxian on the north bank of the Yellow River, gaining control of the river crossings and threatening western Henan. The date follows Guo Tingyi’s chronology and the Hongse Wenhua network account.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.zh: 苏联航空志愿队奇袭松山机场
name.en: Soviet Volunteer Air Group Raids Songshan Airfield

summary.zh: 1938年2月23日，苏联航空志愿队与中国空军联合奇袭日军台北松山机场，炸毁日机40余架。
summary.en: On 23 February 1938 the Soviet volunteer air group and Chinese Air Force raided the Japanese Songshan airfield in Taipei, destroying over 40 aircraft.

fields.name: 苏联航空志愿队奇袭松山机场 Soviet Volunteer Air Group Raids Songshan Airfield
fields.place: 台湾台北松山 Songshan, Taipei, Taiwan
fields.summary: 1938年2月23日，苏联航空志愿队与中国空军联合奇袭日军台北松山机场，炸毁日机40余架。 On 23 February 1938 the Soviet volunteer air group and Chinese Air Force raided the Japanese Songshan airfield in Taipei, destroying over 40 aircraft.
fields.description: 1938年2月23日凌晨，为纪念苏联红军节，苏联航空志愿队顾问雷恰戈夫指挥驻南昌的12架CB轰炸机与驻汉口的28架CB轰炸机分两路奇袭日军台北松山机场。机群严格保密航线，中国地勤亦不知目标；共投弹280枚，炸毁日机40余架、兵营10座、机库3座，焚毁可供用3年的燃料储备，松山机场一度瘫痪。此后苏联轰炸机群又飞越九州，对长崎、福冈等地投弹并散发反战传单。苏联航空志愿队1937年10月首批来华，至1941年初撤出，先后有2000余人来华、200余人牺牲；因苏日未宣战，其参战长期保密，飞机涂中国空军机徽、人员用假名。空袭行动，不绘路线。 Before dawn on 23 February 1938, to mark Red Army Day, the Soviet air adviser Rychagov sent 12 SB bombers from Nanchang and 28 from Hankou in two waves against the Japanese airfield at Songshan, Taipei. The route was kept secret even from Chinese ground staff; 280 bombs were dropped, more than 40 Japanese aircraft, 10 barracks and 3 hangars were destroyed, fuel sufficient for three years was burned, and the airfield was temporarily paralysed. Soviet bombers later flew over Kyushu to bomb Nagasaki and Fukuoka and drop anti-war leaflets. The Soviet volunteer air group first arrived in October 1937 and withdrew in early 1941; over 2,000 personnel served and more than 200 died. Because the USSR and Japan were not at war, its participation was kept secret, with Chinese insignia on the aircraft and pseudonyms for the airmen. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1938年2月25日，日军第14师团酒井支队攻陷济源。
summary.en: On 25 February 1938 the Sakai detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Jiyuan.

fields.name: 济源沦陷 Fall of Jiyuan
fields.summary: 1938年2月25日，日军第14师团酒井支队攻陷济源。 On 25 February 1938 the Sakai detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Jiyuan.
fields.description: 1938年2月22日日军突破沁河防线，攻占沁阳、孟县；23日攻击济源，25日济源城陷。万福麟部退往山西晋城、阳城，宋哲元第一集团军总部退入济源王屋山。济源陷落后，豫北几乎全部被日军占领。济源党史记2月21日日军进逼、县长弃城，2月25日城陷，与《1938年河南历史大事记》一致。 On 22 February 1938 the Japanese broke the Qin River line and took Qinyang and Mengxian; they attacked Jiyuan on the 23rd and took the city on the 25th. Wan Fulin withdrew toward Jincheng and Yangcheng in Shanxi, while Song Zheyuan’s First Group Army headquarters retreated into the Wangwu Mountains. With Jiyuan’s fall almost all of northern Henan was occupied.

summary.zh: 1938年2月26日，日军第一次占领晋城。
summary.en: On 26 February 1938 Japanese forces occupied Jincheng for the first time.

fields.name: 晋城沦陷 Fall of Jincheng
fields.summary: 1938年2月26日，日军第一次占领晋城。 On 26 February 1938 Japanese forces occupied Jincheng for the first time.
fields.description: 2月20日日军飞机轰炸高平。日军第108师团等部由长治南下，2月26日第一次占领晋城。八路军与决死队随后发起反九路围攻，4月23日收复晋城。此后日军又四次侵占晋城。日期据《日军先后五次侵占晋城》与《晋东南1938年战役》。 Japanese aircraft bombed Gaoping on 20 February. The 108th Division and other units moved south from Changzhi and occupied Jincheng for the first time on 26 February. The Eighth Route Army and the Sacrifice League then launched a counter-offensive against the nine-route encirclement and recovered the town on 23 April; the Japanese occupied it four more times. Dates follow the Jincheng occupation account and the 1938 southeastern Shanxi campaign article.

summary.zh: 1938年2月28日，日军占领临汾县城。
summary.en: On 28 February 1938 Japanese forces captured Linfen.

fields.name: 临汾沦陷 Fall of Linfen
fields.summary: 1938年2月28日，日军占领临汾县城。 On 28 February 1938 Japanese forces captured Linfen.
fields.description: 1938年2月中旬，日军第1军集结兵力向晋南、晋西进犯。2月28日，日军经洪洞曲亭镇进犯临汾县城，守军决死三纵队第九总队退往浮山，临汾失守。第二战区司令长官部此前已由临汾西移。临汾日期另有2月27日说（大同市政府纪念报道），此处取临汾各县沦陷概况与当时照片说明的2月28日。 In mid-February 1938 the Japanese First Army massed troops for an offensive into southern and western Shanxi. On 28 February Japanese troops advanced on Linfen via Quting in Hongtong; the Sacrifice League’s 9th Regiment withdrew to Fushan and the county town fell. The Second War Zone headquarters had already moved west from Linfen. A Datong municipal account gives 27 February as a variant; this entry follows the Linfen county survey and a contemporary photograph caption.

summary.en: On 4 March 1938 Japanese troops massacred more than 300 refugees at Wuchaomiao in Fuyang.

fields.name: 午朝庙惨案 Wuchaomiao Massacre
fields.place: 浙江富阳午朝庙 Wuchaomiao, Fuyang, Zhejiang
fields.summary: 1938年3月4日，日军在富阳午朝庙屠杀难民300余人。 On 4 March 1938 Japanese troops massacred more than 300 refugees at Wuchaomiao in Fuyang.
fields.description: 3月4日，日军包围富阳受降乡东坞山村后的午朝庙，将在那里避难的300余难民集中起来，分年龄将各人的拇指连拴在一起，令其下跪，然后架起机枪扫射。此次屠杀后的幸存者仅5—6人。惨案不绘路线。 On 4 March Japanese troops surrounded Wuchaomiao behind Dongwu village in Fuyang's Shouxiang township, gathered more than 300 refugees, tied their thumbs together by age group, forced them to kneel and machine-gunned them. Only five or six survived. The massacre is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Establishment of the Puppet Shandong Provincial Government

summary.zh: 1938年3月5日，伪山东省公署在济南成立。
summary.en: On 5 March 1938 the puppet Shandong provincial government was established in Jinan.

fields.name: 伪山东省公署成立 Establishment of the Puppet Shandong Provincial Government
fields.summary: 1938年3月5日，伪山东省公署在济南成立。 On 5 March 1938 the puppet Shandong provincial government was established in Jinan.
fields.description: 3月5日，伪山东省公署在济南成立，马良任伪省长；1939年1月唐仰杜接任，1943年8月改为伪山东省政府，1945年2月杨毓珣出任最后一任伪省长。伪政权是日军控制山东的统治工具。政治事件，不绘路线。 On 5 March the puppet Shandong provincial government was established in Jinan with Ma Liang as governor. Tang Yangdu succeeded him in January 1939; the body became the puppet Shandong provincial government in August 1943, and Yang Yuxun became its last governor in February 1945. The puppet regime was a tool of Japanese control. This political event is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1938年3月5日，日军侵占运城。
summary.en: On 5 March 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yuncheng.

fields.name: 运城沦陷 Fall of Yuncheng
fields.summary: 1938年3月5日，日军侵占运城。 On 5 March 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yuncheng.
fields.description: 1938年3月初，日军沿同蒲线南下并自豫北入晋，3月5日侵占运城。随后3月6日陷曲沃、禹门口，3月7日侵占永济，3月8日陷芮城，进抵黄河风陵渡，与潼关隔河对峙。运城日军番号有异说：一记第14师团酒井支队，一记第108师团自博爱入晋，本条目只记“日军第1军一部”。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1938年3月）》与黄力民《旧日本宪兵规制与侵华日军宪兵组织沿革》。 In early March 1938 Japanese forces advanced south along the Tongpu railway and entered Shanxi from northern Henan, occupying Yuncheng on 5 March. Quwo and Yumenkou fell on the 6th, Yongji on the 7th and Ruicheng on the 8th, bringing the Japanese to the Fenglingdu crossing opposite Tongguan. Sources differ on the unit (the 14th Division’s Sakai detachment or the 108th Division from Bo’ai), so this entry says only “part of the Japanese First Army.” Dates follow the March 1938 chronology and Huang Limin’s study of Japanese military police organization.

fields.name: 温县沦陷 Fall of Wenxian
fields.summary: 1938年3月5日，日军侵占温县县城。 On 5 March 1938 the Japanese occupied Wenxian.
fields.description: 1938年2月28日，日军进入温县境域；3月5日，侵占温县县城。日军侵占温县后，在维持会协助下强征青年妇女300名充当慰安妇，并大肆奸淫烧杀。日期据《日军对手无寸铁的村民进行野蛮屠杀》与《1938年河南历史大事记》。 On 28 February 1938 the Japanese entered Wenxian; on 5 March they occupied the county town. After the occupation, with the help of the maintenance committee, they forced 300 young women into comfort stations and carried out widespread rape, arson and killing.

fields.summary: 1938年3月7日，日本海军陆战队占领威海卫。 On 7 March 1938 Japanese marines occupied Weihaiwei.
fields.description: 3月7日下午，日本海军陆战队500多人在军舰、飞机护卫下占领威海卫。威海卫是北洋海军基地，沦陷后成为日军控制胶东东端的据点。日期据威海市档案馆，待页码级核对。 On the afternoon of 7 March more than 500 Japanese marines, escorted by warships and aircraft, occupied Weihaiwei. The former Beiyang naval base became a Japanese strongpoint at the eastern tip of Jiaodong. The date follows the Weihai municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1938 年 3 月，川军第22集团军第41军王铭章部在滕县死守，与日军第10师团激战。滕县于 3 月 17 日陷落，王铭章殉国，但川军的抵抗为台儿庄会战争取了部署时间。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In March 1938 the 41st Army of the Sichuan 22nd Group Army, under Wang Mingzhang, held Tengxian against the Japanese 10th Division. The town fell on 17 March and Wang was killed, but the resistance bought time for the Chinese deployment at Taierzhuang. fields.description: 1938 年 3 月至 4 月，中国军队在第五战区司令长官李宗仁指挥下，于山东台儿庄地区与日军第十师团等部激战，最终取得台儿庄大捷。此役是徐州会战的重要组成部分。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，待史料校订。 From March to April 1938, Chinese forces under Li Zongren, commander of the Fifth War Zone, fought Japanese units including the 10th Division at Taierzhuang in Shandong, winning a major victory. The battle was an important part of the Xuzhou campaign. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: The 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed part of the Japanese 108th Division at Shentouling.

fields.name: 神头岭伏击战 Ambush at Shentouling 神头岭战斗 Battle of Shentouling
fields.place: 山西潞城神头岭 Shentouling, Lucheng, Shanxi
fields.summary: 八路军第129师第386旅在神头岭伏击日军第108师团一部。 The 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed part of the Japanese 108th Division at Shentouling.
fields.description: 1938 年 3 月 16 日，八路军第129师第386旅在山西潞城神头岭设伏，袭击由潞城出援的日军第108师团一部，毙伤日军千余人，缴获大批军用物资。此战与响堂铺、长乐村等战斗共同粉碎了日军对晋东南的九路围攻。 战果数字为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 16 March 1938 the 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed part of the Japanese 108th Division as it moved out from Lucheng at Shentouling, Shanxi, inflicting over a thousand casualties and capturing large quantities of supplies. Together with the battles at Xiangtangpu and Changlecun, it helped break the Japanese nine-route offensive in southeastern Shanxi. Casualty figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Landing at Yaogang and Fall of Nantong

summary.zh: 1938年3月17日，日军约5000人在南通姚港登陆，当日南通城沦陷。
summary.en: On 17 March 1938 about 5,000 Japanese troops landed at Yaogang near Nantong; the city fell the same day.

fields.name: 姚港登陆、南通沦陷 Landing at Yaogang and Fall of Nantong
fields.place: 江苏南通姚港 Yaogang, Nantong, Jiangsu
fields.summary: 1938年3月17日，日军约5000人在南通姚港登陆，当日南通城沦陷。 On 17 March 1938 about 5,000 Japanese troops landed at Yaogang near Nantong; the city fell the same day.
fields.description: 1938年3月17日，日军约5000人在南通城郊姚港附近登陆，国民党部队未作有效抵抗即弃城而走，南通城当日沦陷。日军随后沿公路进犯如皋、海门、东台。日期据南通市志办、南通史志办，两源一致。 On 17 March 1938 about 5,000 Japanese troops landed near Yaogang outside Nantong. Nationalist units withdrew without effective resistance and the city fell the same day. Japanese forces then advanced along the roads toward Rugao, Haimen and Dongtai. Two Nantong chronicles agree on the date.

fields.name: 滕县沦陷 Fall of Tengxian
fields.summary: 1938年3月17日，日军攻占滕县。 On 17 March 1938 Japanese forces captured Tengxian.
fields.description: 3月中旬，日军第10师团濑谷支队进攻滕县，中国守军第22集团军第122师等部顽强抵抗；3月17日下午，日军步兵第10联队完全占领滕县。滕县保卫战为台儿庄战役争取了时间。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与台儿庄战役史料，待页码级核对。 In mid-March the Japanese 10th Division's Segawa detachment attacked Tengxian, defended stubbornly by the Chinese 122nd Division of the 22nd Group Army. On the afternoon of 17 March the Japanese 10th Infantry Regiment completed the occupation of Tengxian. The defence bought time for the Battle of Taierzhuang. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and Taierzhuang sources and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 临城沦陷 Fall of Lincheng
fields.place: 山东滕县临城 Lincheng, Tengxian, Shandong
fields.summary: 1938年3月17日，日军攻陷临城。 On 17 March 1938 Japanese forces captured Lincheng.
fields.description: 3月17日，日军步兵第63联队以30余辆战车及空军优势猛攻官桥阵地，官桥、临城相继失守。临城（今薛城）是津浦铁路与临枣支线交会处，为日军南下峄县、台儿庄的要点。日期据台儿庄战役史料，待页码级核对。 On 17 March the Japanese 63rd Infantry Regiment, with more than 30 tanks and air support, attacked the Guanqiao positions; Guanqiao and Lincheng fell in succession. Lincheng (now Xuecheng) was the junction of the Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Lincheng–Zaozhuang branch, a key point for the advance on Yixian and Taierzhuang. The date follows Taierzhuang campaign sources and awaits page-level verification.

The county was at the heart of the Taierzhuang campaign; from there Japanese forces moved south on Taierzhuang. The date follows Taierzhuang campaign sources and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 3月18日，日军占领枣庄，抢占中兴煤矿，屠杀百姓，并在关键设施部署兵力。枣庄是鲁南煤海，沦陷后成为日军掠夺煤炭的据点。日期据枣庄地方史与台儿庄战役史料，待页码级核对。 On 18 March Japanese forces occupied Zaozhuang, seized the Zhongxing coal mines, massacred civilians and garrisoned key installations. Zaozhuang was the coal centre of southern Shandong and became a base for Japanese coal extraction. The date follows Zaozhuang local history and Taierzhuang campaign sources and awaits page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

place.zh: 吉林宝清小孤山（今十二烈士山）
place.en: Xiaogushan, Baoqing (modern Twelve Martyrs’ Mountain), Jilin

summary.zh: 1938年3月18日，抗联第五军三师八团一连在小孤山阻击400余名日伪军，12人牺牲，掩护了二路军总部与密营。
summary.en: On 18 March 1938 the 1st Company of the 8th Regiment, 5th Army, held a hill at Baoqing against over 400 Japanese and puppet troops; twelve died, covering the 2nd Route Army headquarters and its base.

fields.name: 十二烈士山战斗 The Twelve Martyrs’ Mountain
fields.place: 吉林宝清小孤山（今十二烈士山） Xiaogushan, Baoqing (modern Twelve Martyrs’ Mountain), Jilin
fields.summary: 1938年3月18日，抗联第五军三师八团一连在小孤山阻击400余名日伪军，12人牺牲，掩护了二路军总部与密营。 On 18 March 1938 the 1st Company of the 8th Regiment, 5th Army, held a hill at Baoqing against over 400 Japanese and puppet troops; twelve died, covering the 2nd Route Army headquarters and its base.
fields.description: 1938 年春，日伪军对三江地区抗联发动「聚歼」式大讨伐。吉东省委、抗联第二路军总指挥部与第五军第三师密营设在宝清西部兰棒山北麓李炮营，头道卡子设在宝清西沟大尖子西北坡，由第五军三师八团一连「炮手连」驻守。3 月 18 日拂晓，连长李海峰、指导员班路遗率 13 名战士与总部交通副官张凤春等，为不暴露进山通道，放弃撤退，抢占小孤山，以雪垒、岩石抗击伪兴安军骑兵 300 余人、日军骑兵 100 余人。自清晨战至黄昏，打退多次冲锋；李海峰双腿负伤后仍卧雪射击，最后拉响手榴弹与敌同归于尽。此役 12 人牺牲：李海峰、班路遗、朱雨亭、魏希林、陈凤山、李芳邻、夏魁武、王仁志、张全富、杨德才、王发、李才；张凤春等 4 人携文件突围。战果：击毙日军 25 人、重伤 10 人，击毙伪兴安军 70 余人、重伤 20 余人，打死军马 90 余匹；另有「毙伤日伪军 100 余人」「60 余人」等不同统计。第二路军党委将小孤山改名「十二烈士山」，周保中撰《宝清县烈士山十二烈士苦战记》印发全军。本事件不绘路线。 In spring 1938 the Japanese launched a “concentrate and annihilate” campaign against the United Army in the Sanjiang region. The Jilin-Dongman party committee, the 2nd Route Army headquarters and the 5th Army’s 3rd Division kept their base at Lipoying north of Lanbang Mountain in western Baoqing, with the first checkpoint on the north-west slope of Dajianzi held by the “marksmen company” — the 1st Company of the 8th Regiment. At dawn on 18 March, rather than reveal the approach to the base, company commander Li Haifeng and political instructor Ban Luyi with thirteen men and the headquarters courier Zhang Fengchun seized the nearby hill and, behind snow walls and rocks, faced some 300 puppet Xing’an cavalry and 100 Japanese cavalry. They fought from morning to dusk, beating back repeated charges; both of Li’s legs were shattered, and he kept firing from the snow until he pulled the pin on his last grenade. Twelve died — Li Haifeng, Ban Luyi, Zhu Yuting, Wei Xilin, Chen Fengshan, Li Fanglin, Xia Kuiwu, Wang Renzhi, Zhang Quanfu, Yang Decai, Wang Fa and Li Cai — while Zhang Fengchun and three others got out with the dispatches. The toll was 25 Japanese killed and 10 seriously wounded, over 70 puppet troops killed and over 20 wounded, and more than 90 horses killed; other accounts give “over 100” or “over 60” Japanese and puppet casualties. The 2nd Route Army party committee renamed the hill “Twelve Martyrs’ Mountain”, and Zhou Baozhong’s account of the fight was printed for the whole army. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1938年3月19日，日军侵占如皋城。
summary.en: On 19 March 1938 Japanese forces occupied Rugao.

fields.name: 如皋沦陷 Fall of Rugao
fields.summary: 1938年3月19日，日军侵占如皋城。 On 19 March 1938 Japanese forces occupied Rugao.
fields.description: 3月19日中午，日军在飞机大炮掩护下进入如皋城，四处搜捕抢掠，焚毁南门吊桥至地藏庙间房屋，明代大觉庵200余间全毁。日期据南通市志办、南通史志办，两源一致。 At noon on 19 March Japanese troops entered Rugao under air and artillery cover, searching and looting. They burned the houses between the south gate drawbridge and Dizang Temple, including more than 200 rooms of the Ming-era Dajue Nunnery. Two Nantong chronicles agree on the date.

summary.en: On 21 March 1938 Japanese forces attacked Haimen and occupied Maozhen, Sanchang, Qinglonggang and Sijiaba.

fields.name: 海门沦陷 Fall of Haimen
fields.summary: 1938年3月21日，日军进犯海门，占领茅镇、三厂、青龙港、四甲坝。 On 21 March 1938 Japanese forces attacked Haimen and occupied Maozhen, Sanchang, Qinglonggang and Sijiaba.
fields.description: 3月21日清晨，日军5000余人由南通沿公路进犯海门，先后占领海门县治茅镇及三厂、青龙港、四甲坝等地，国民党海门县政府退驻江家镇。日期据南通史志办与《日军肆虐海门纪略》。 At dawn on 21 March more than 5,000 Japanese troops advanced from Nantong along the road into Haimen, occupying the county seat of Maozhen as well as Sanchang, Qinglonggang and Sijiaba. The Nationalist county government retreated to Jiangjia town. The date follows the Nantong chronicle and the Haimen account.

summary.zh: 1938年3月25日，日军川上部侵占东台城。
summary.en: On 25 March 1938 the Japanese Kawakami unit occupied Dongtai.

fields.name: 东台沦陷 Fall of Dongtai
fields.summary: 1938年3月25日，日军川上部侵占东台城。 On 25 March 1938 the Japanese Kawakami unit occupied Dongtai.
fields.description: 3月25日，日军川上部侵占东台城，烧杀抢掠，魁星楼遭炮击，东台城首次沦陷。此前南通沦陷后，万余难民逃入东台。日期据《东台抗战大事记》与中共江苏地方简史。 On 25 March the Japanese Kawakami unit occupied Dongtai, burning, killing and looting; the Kuixing Tower was shelled. This was the city's first fall. After Nantong fell, more than 10,000 refugees had fled to Dongtai. The date follows the Dongtai chronicle and the provincial party history.

summary.zh: 1938年3月26日，日军对龙溪沿岸村镇烧杀，焚毁近150个村庄。
summary.en: On 26 March 1938 Japanese troops burned and killed along the Longxi, destroying nearly 150 villages.

fields.name: 龙溪惨案 Longxi Massacre
fields.summary: 1938年3月26日，日军对龙溪沿岸村镇烧杀，焚毁近150个村庄。 On 26 March 1938 Japanese troops burned and killed along the Longxi, destroying nearly 150 villages.
fields.description: 3月26日，1000多名日军对龙溪沿岸村镇进行烧杀。龙溪南段与京杭大运河相接，北段通往吴兴汇入太湖，是日军运送军火物资的要道。日军为确保杭湖水道安全，制造了火烧百里龙溪的惨案：120里龙溪两岸近150个村庄成为火海，仅德清境内就有110个村被烧毁、7700多间房舍被焚、580余人死亡。惨案不绘路线。 On 26 March more than 1,000 Japanese troops burned and killed along the Longxi. Its southern section joined the Grand Canal and its northern section ran to Wuxing and Taihu, making it a key route for Japanese military supplies. To secure the Hangzhou–Huzhou waterway, Japanese troops burned nearly 150 villages along 120 li of the Longxi; in Deqing alone 110 villages, more than 7,700 houses and over 580 people were destroyed or killed. The massacre is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Establishment of the Reformed Government of the Republic of China

summary.zh: 日本在南京扶植成立伪中华民国维新政府。
summary.en: Japan established the puppet Reformed Government of the Republic of China in Nanjing.

fields.name: 伪中华民国维新政府成立 Establishment of the Reformed Government of the Republic of China
fields.summary: 日本在南京扶植成立伪中华民国维新政府。 Japan established the puppet Reformed Government of the Republic of China in Nanjing.
fields.description: 1938 年 3 月 28 日，日本在南京扶植成立伪中华民国维新政府，以梁鸿志为首，管辖华中日占区。伪维新政府与北平伪临时政府并立，均受日军控制。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 28 March 1938 Japan installed the puppet Reformed Government of the Republic of China in Nanjing under Liang Hongzhi to administer the Japanese-occupied areas of Central China. It coexisted with the Beiping provisional regime and was likewise controlled by the Japanese military. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.place: 河北涉县响堂铺 Xiangtangpu, Shexian, Hebei

fields.description: 1938 年 3 月 31 日，八路军第129师在河北涉县响堂铺伏击日军第108师团运输车队，焚毁汽车 180 余辆，毙伤日军数百人，是晋东南反九路围攻中的重要战斗。 日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 31 March 1938 the 129th Division ambushed a supply convoy of the Japanese 108th Division at Xiangtangpu, Shexian, Hebei, burning more than 180 trucks and inflicting several hundred casualties. It was an important action in the counter-offensive against the nine-route encirclement in southeastern Shanxi. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年3月31日，加拿大医生白求恩率加美医疗队抵达延安，随后赴晋察冀边区从事战地医疗。
summary.en: On 31 March 1938 the Canadian doctor Norman Bethune reached Yan'an with the Canada–US medical team and then went to the Jin-Cha-Ji border region for front-line medicine.

fields.name: 白求恩抵达延安 Bethune Reaches Yan'an
fields.summary: 1938年3月31日，加拿大医生白求恩率加美医疗队抵达延安，随后赴晋察冀边区从事战地医疗。 On 31 March 1938 the Canadian doctor Norman Bethune reached Yan'an with the Canada–US medical team and then went to the Jin-Cha-Ji border region for front-line medicine.
fields.description: 1937 年底，白求恩受加拿大共产党与美国共产党派遣，在纽约组建加美医疗队（队员包括加拿大护士琼·尤恩），并得到保卫中国同盟的募捐支持。1938 年 1 月，医疗队携带药品与手术器械从温哥华乘船来华，1 月下旬抵武汉，与中国红十字会救护委员会总干事林可胜接洽；白求恩拒绝留在国民政府辖区工作，决定北上。经周恩来安排，2 月 22 日离开武汉，经河南、陕西辗转，3 月 31 日抵达延安；4 月 1 日毛泽东会见白求恩。5 月，白求恩率医护人员赴晋察冀边区，任军区卫生顾问，组建战地医疗队、创办卫生学校，1939 年 11 月 12 日因手术感染逝世。本事件不绘路线。 Late in 1937 Bethune was sent by the Canadian and American Communist Parties, formed the Canada–US medical team in New York (with the Canadian nurse Jean Ewen) and received fundraising support from the China Defence League. In January 1938 the team sailed from Vancouver with medicines and surgical instruments, reached Wuhan in late January and contacted Lin Kesheng of the Chinese Red Cross medical relief corps; Bethune refused to work in Nationalist-held territory and decided to go north. Arranged by Zhou Enlai, the team left Wuhan on 22 February, travelled through Henan and Shaanxi and reached Yan'an on 31 March; Mao Zedong received Bethune on 1 April. In May he went with medical staff to the Jin-Cha-Ji border region as medical adviser, organised front-line medical teams and a health school, and died of an infected wound on 12 November 1939. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 晋冀鲁豫根据地 Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu base area
fields.summary: 第129师在晋东南开辟晋冀鲁豫根据地，形成太行、太岳、冀南三大区。 The 129th Division opened the Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu base area in southeastern Shanxi, later divided into the Taihang, Taiyue, and southern Hebei regions.
fields.description: 1938 年 4 月，八路军第129师在师长刘伯承、政治委员邓小平率领下，粉碎日军对晋东南的九路围攻后，依托太行山地区开辟晋冀鲁豫抗日根据地，随后发展为太行、太岳、冀南等区，成为华北敌后面积最大、人口最多的根据地之一。 成立时间与辖区范围各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 In April 1938 the 129th Division, under commander Liu Bocheng and political commissar Deng Xiaoping, broke the Japanese nine-route offensive in southeastern Shanxi and opened the Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu base area in the Taihang Mountains. It later grew into the Taihang, Taiyue, and southern Hebei regions and became one of the largest and most populous base areas behind enemy lines in North China. Founding dates and territorial extent vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1938 年 3 月至 4 月，国民党临时全国代表大会在武汉召开，蒋介石任总裁，通过《抗战建国纲领》，提出抗战与建国并行的方针，涉及外交、军事、政治、经济、教育等方面。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 From March to April 1938 the Kuomintang held an extraordinary national congress in Wuhan, elected Chiang Kai-shek as party leader, and adopted the Program of Resistance and National Reconstruction, which set out parallel goals of resistance and reconstruction in foreign policy, military affairs, politics, economy, and education. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces carried out a “three-all” campaign on Sanzao Island, massacring residents and burning villages.

fields.name: 三灶岛大屠杀 Sanzao Island Massacre
fields.place: 广东三灶岛 Sanzao Island, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军在三灶岛实施“三光”政策，屠杀居民、焚毁村庄。 Japanese forces carried out a “three-all” campaign on Sanzao Island, massacring residents and burning villages.
fields.description: 1938 年 4 月 12 日起，日军在三灶岛展开屠杀，实行“三光”政策。据珠海地方志，岛上 36 个村庄被毁、3264 间房屋和 164 艘渔船被焚；机场建成后，又秘密杀害修建机场的朝鲜籍与中国民工 3000 余人。具体死难人数待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。 From 12 April 1938 Japanese forces carried out a massacre on Sanzao Island under a “three-all” policy. According to Zhuhai local gazetteers, 36 villages were destroyed and 3,264 houses and 164 fishing boats burned; after the airfield was completed, more than 3,000 Korean and Chinese laborers who had built it were secretly killed. The exact death toll awaits page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

It was the decisive battle in breaking the Japanese nine-route offensive in southeastern Shanxi. Casualty figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Directive on Guerrilla Warfare on the Plains

summary.zh: 毛泽东、张闻天、刘少奇致电八路军，提出在河北、山东平原大力发展游击战争。
summary.en: Mao Zedong, Zhang Wentian, and Liu Shaoqi instructed the Eighth Route Army to develop guerrilla warfare widely on the Hebei and Shandong plains.

fields.name: 《关于平原游击战的指示》 Directive on Guerrilla Warfare on the Plains 四月二十一日指示 Directive of 21 April
fields.summary: 毛泽东、张闻天、刘少奇致电八路军，提出在河北、山东平原大力发展游击战争。 Mao Zedong, Zhang Wentian, and Liu Shaoqi instructed the Eighth Route Army to develop guerrilla warfare widely on the Hebei and Shandong plains.
fields.description: 1938 年 4 月 21 日，毛泽东、张闻天、刘少奇致电朱德、彭德怀、刘伯承、徐向前、邓小平等，指出根据抗战以来的经验，在河北、山东平原地区广大地发展游击战争是可能的；党和八路军应坚决采取尽量广大发展游击战争的方针，在平原划分游击军区、成立游击司令部，广泛组织不脱离生产的自卫军，并在收复地区建立抗日民主政权。这一指示把洛川会议提出的「在平原发展游击战争」由原则变为具体部署，随后第129师等部向冀南、冀中、冀东和山东平原展开。 电报文本以中央档案馆藏件为准；受电人名单各书略有出入。 On 21 April 1938 Mao Zedong, Zhang Wentian, and Liu Shaoqi telegraphed Zhu De, Peng Dehuai, Liu Bocheng, Xu Xiangqian, Deng Xiaoping, and others, stating that experience since the war began showed guerrilla warfare could be developed widely on the Hebei and Shandong plains. The Party and the Eighth Route Army were to adopt a policy of the widest possible guerrilla development: divide the plains into guerrilla military regions, set up guerrilla headquarters, organize broad unarmed self-defence corps, and establish anti-Japanese democratic governments in recovered areas. The directive turned the Luochuan Conference’s principle of “developing guerrilla warfare on the plains” into a concrete deployment; the 129th Division and other forces then moved into southern and central Hebei, eastern Hebei, and the Shandong plain. The text follows the document held by the Central Archives; recipient lists vary slightly between accounts.

summary.zh: 1938年4月21日，日军占领临沂。
summary.en: On 21 April 1938 Japanese forces occupied Linyi.

fields.name: 临沂沦陷 Fall of Linyi
fields.summary: 1938年4月21日，日军占领临沂。 On 21 April 1938 Japanese forces occupied Linyi.
fields.description: 3月至4月，中国军队在临沂与日军第5师团激战，取得临沂阻击战胜利。4月21日，由于台儿庄战役吃紧，张自忠、庞炳勋两军相继撤离，临沂遂被日军占领。日军进城后屠杀平民2840余人。日期据临沂市政府与《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 From March to April Chinese forces fought the Japanese 5th Division at Linyi and won the Linyi blocking battle. On 21 April, as the Taierzhuang front became critical, the armies of Zhang Zizhong and Pang Bingxun withdrew and Linyi was occupied. Japanese troops killed more than 2,840 civilians after entering the city. The date follows the Linyi municipal government and the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1938 年 4 月，滇军第60军抵达徐州后投入禹王山战斗，与日军第5、第10师团激战近一个月，伤亡惨重但守住了阵地，为徐州会战主力转移争取了时间。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In April 1938 the Yunnan 60th Army reached Xuzhou and fought at Yuwangshan against the Japanese 5th and 10th Divisions for nearly a month. Though badly mauled, it held its positions and bought time for the main forces to withdraw from the Xuzhou campaign. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: The 129th Division Marches into Southern Hebei

summary.zh: 徐向前率第129师路东纵队由辽县出发，穿越平汉铁路进入冀南平原。
summary.en: Xu Xiangqian led the 129th Division’s east-of-railway column from Liaoxian across the Pinghan railway into the southern Hebei plain.

fields.name: 第129师挺进冀南 The 129th Division Marches into Southern Hebei 路东纵队挺进冀南 East-of-Railway Column Advance
fields.summary: 徐向前率第129师路东纵队由辽县出发，穿越平汉铁路进入冀南平原。 Xu Xiangqian led the 129th Division’s east-of-railway column from Liaoxian across the Pinghan railway into the southern Hebei plain.
fields.description: 1938 年 4 月 21 日平原游击战指示下达后，第129师决定以平汉铁路为界编成左右两路纵队：徐向前率第769团、第115师第689团及曾国华支队组成路东纵队，向冀南挺进；陈赓率第386旅主力组成路西纵队，向邢台、沙河一带展开。4 月 26 日路东纵队从辽县出发，穿越平汉铁路日军封锁线，5 月上旬到达南宫，与陈再道、宋任穷率领的东进纵队会合，随后发起威县战斗，冀南平原根据地初步形成。徐向前在冀南提出依托民众的「人山」思想，回答平原无山如何坚持游击战的问题。 到达南宫的日期各书记为 5 月 2 日、4 日或 7 日，此处取「5 月上旬」，待页码级核对。 After the directive of 21 April 1938, the 129th Division divided its main force into two columns along the Pinghan railway. Xu Xiangqian led the east-of-railway column—the 769th Regiment, the 115th Division’s 689th Regiment, and the Zeng Guohua detachment—toward southern Hebei, while Chen Geng led the 386th Brigade west of the railway toward Xingtai and Shahe. The eastern column left Liaoxian on 26 April, crossed the Japanese blockade along the Pinghan railway, and reached Nangong in early May, joining Chen Zaidao’s and Song Renqiong’s Eastern Advance Column. It then attacked Weixian county town, and a base area on the southern Hebei plain began to take shape. At Nangong, Xu Xiangqian advanced the idea of a “mountain of people,” answering how guerrilla warfare could be sustained where there were no mountains. Accounts give 2, 4, or 7 May for the arrival at Nangong; this entry uses “early May” pending page-level verification.

fields.name: 盐城沦陷 Fall of Yancheng
fields.summary: 1938年4月26日，日军占领盐城，焚城七天七夜。 On 26 April 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yancheng and burned the city for seven days and nights.
fields.description: 4月26日，日军占领盐城，焚城七天七夜，造成盐城历史上空前浩劫；第一次侵占时烧毁房屋4.5万间，红十字会收埋尸体480余具。日期据中共江苏地方简史与盐城市史志网。 On 26 April Japanese forces took Yancheng and burned it for seven days and nights, an unprecedented disaster in the city's history. During the first occupation 45,000 houses were burned and the Red Cross buried more than 480 bodies. The date follows the provincial party history and the Yancheng gazetteer website.

fields.summary: 1938年5月7日，日军攻占阜宁城，实行「三光」。 On 7 May 1938 Japanese forces captured Funing and carried out a "three-all" campaign.
fields.description: 5月7日，日军攻占阜宁城，疯狂实行「三光」政策，先将守军未及撤走的伤员全部杀害，又在城内城外及附近村庄烧杀淫掠。日期据中共江苏地方简史与《日寇暴行录》。 On 7 May Japanese forces took Funing and carried out a "three-all" policy: they first killed the wounded soldiers left behind, then burned, killed and raped in the city and nearby villages. The date follows the provincial party history and the atrocity record.

summary.en: On 9 May 1938 Mengcheng fell.

fields.name: 蒙城沦陷 Fall of Mengcheng
fields.summary: 1938年5月9日，蒙城失陷。 On 9 May 1938 Mengcheng fell.
fields.description: 5月7日，日军第13师团在飞机配合下猛攻蒙城，国民党第48军第173师一个团守军激烈抵抗；5月9日蒙城失陷，第173师副师长周元及以下官兵近3000人壮烈牺牲。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 7 May the Japanese 13th Division, supported by aircraft, attacked Mengcheng; a regiment of the Chinese 173rd Division, 48th Army, resisted fiercely. Mengcheng fell on 9 May, and Major General Zhou Yuan, deputy commander of the 173rd Division, and nearly 3,000 officers and men died. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 日军登陆厦门 Japanese Landing at Xiamen
fields.place: 福建厦门五通 Wutong, Xiamen, Fujian
fields.summary: 日军海军陆战队在厦门五通登陆，厦门保卫战开始。 Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Wutong on Xiamen Island, beginning the battle for Xiamen.
fields.description: 1938 年 5 月 10 日凌晨，日军以航母舰载机、军舰炮火掩护，海军陆战队在厦门东北五通一带登陆。中国守军第 75 师守备队、壮丁队和保安警察抵抗，厦门保卫战展开。日期与登陆点据厦门市档案馆藏电报，待页码级核对。 Before dawn on 10 May 1938, covered by carrier aircraft and naval gunfire, Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Wutong in northeastern Xiamen. Chinese 75th Division garrison troops, militia and police resisted, opening the battle for Xiamen. The date and landing site follow a telegram held by the Xiamen Municipal Archives and await page-level verification.

summary.en: On 12 May 1938 the Japanese 13th Division of the Central China Expeditionary Army occupied Yongcheng.

fields.name: 永城沦陷 Fall of Yongcheng
fields.summary: 1938年5月12日，日军华中派遣军第13师团占领永城。 On 12 May 1938 the Japanese 13th Division of the Central China Expeditionary Army occupied Yongcheng.
fields.description: 徐州会战期间，日军华中派遣军第9、第13师团沿涡河、北淝河北进，5月9日占蒙城，12日占永城，13日占夏邑。永城、夏邑失守后，第13师团继续北上，经韩道口突袭黄口，切断陇海路，从西面包围徐州。永城城陷日期，《1938年河南历史大事记》记5月12日，《河南的抗战历程》记5月13日，正文并列。 During the Xuzhou campaign the Japanese 9th and 13th Divisions advanced north along the Guo and Bei Fei rivers, taking Mengcheng on 9 May, Yongcheng on the 12th and Xiayi on the 13th. The 13th Division then drove north via Handao to Huangkou, cut the Longhai railway and closed on Xuzhou from the west. The 1938 Henan chronology gives 12 May; the Henan campaign history gives 13 May.

fields.summary: 厦门保卫战持续三昼夜，厦门全岛沦陷。 After three days of fighting, the whole of Xiamen Island fell to Japanese forces.
fields.description: 1938 年 5 月 10 日至 13 日，日军在厦门岛逐次推进，中国守军因兵力悬殊撤退。5 月 13 日傍晚，日军控制厦门全岛，厦门沦陷。日期据厦门市档案馆藏档案与地方志，待页码级核对。 From 10 to 13 May 1938 Japanese forces advanced across Xiamen Island; the outnumbered Chinese garrison withdrew. fields.name: 日军占领菏泽 Japanese capture of Heze
fields.summary: 日军第 14 师团渡黄河南下占领菏泽。 The Japanese 14th Division crossed the Yellow River and took Heze.
fields.description: 1938 年 5 月，日军第 14 师团（土肥原贤二）自濮阳渡黄河南下，5 月 14 日占领菏泽，随后向兰封、开封推进，引发兰封会战。 In May 1938 the Japanese 14th Division under Tsuchihashi (Dohihara’s 14th) crossed the Yellow River at Puyang and took Heze on 14 May, then pushed towards Lanfeng and Kaifeng, bringing on the Lanfeng battle.

summary.zh: 1938年5月14日，合肥沦陷。
summary.en: On 14 May 1938 Hefei fell.

fields.name: 合肥沦陷 Fall of Hefei
fields.summary: 1938年5月14日，合肥沦陷。 On 14 May 1938 Hefei fell.
fields.description: 5月13日，日军坂井支队2000余人由东南方向进攻合肥，驻防的国民党第26集团军徐源泉部防守不力，一触即溃；14日晨日军进入合肥。此后日军沿合安公路南下进攻安庆。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。 On 13 May more than 2,000 troops of the Japanese Sakai detachment attacked Hefei from the southeast; the defending 26th Group Army under Xu Yuanquan collapsed quickly, and Japanese troops entered the city on the morning of 14 May. They then advanced south along the Hefei–Anqing road toward Anqing. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 14 May 1938 Japanese forces broke into Jinxiang and carried out the Jinxiang massacre.

fields.name: 金乡沦陷 Fall of Jinxiang
fields.summary: 1938年5月14日，日军攻破金乡城，制造金乡惨案。 On 14 May 1938 Japanese forces broke into Jinxiang and carried out the Jinxiang massacre.
fields.description: 5月11日起，日军飞机连续轰炸金乡县城；5月13日至14日，日军在城郊王楼、大义等村屠杀平民；5月14日破城后，对未撤离的3000余名居民进行屠杀。金乡惨案是徐州会战期间日军在鲁西南的重大暴行。日期据《金乡惨案》，待页码级核对。 From 11 May Japanese aircraft repeatedly bombed Jinxiang. On 13–14 May Japanese troops massacred civilians in Wanglou, Dayi and other suburban villages; after breaking into the city on 14 May they killed more than 3,000 residents who had not fled. The Jinxiang massacre was a major atrocity in southwestern Shandong during the Xuzhou campaign. The date follows the Jinxiang massacre account and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 徐州沦陷 Fall of Xuzhou
fields.summary: 徐州会战后期中国军队突围，日军占领徐州。 At the end of the Battle of Xuzhou the Chinese forces broke out and Japanese troops occupied the city.
fields.description: 1938 年 5 月，日军南北夹击徐州。中国第五战区部队在完成台儿庄作战后逐次转移。5 月 19 日，日军占领徐州，陇海、津浦两铁路交会点失守。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1938 Japanese forces attacked Xuzhou from north and south. After the Taierzhuang fighting, Chinese 5th War Zone troops withdrew in stages. On 19 May the Japanese occupied Xuzhou, seizing the junction of the Longhai and Jin-Pu railways. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

A key town on the southern section of the Tianjin–Pukou railway, it was used by Japanese forces to advance north toward Xuzhou. summary.zh: 中国军队围攻兰封日军第 14 师团，因日军增援与协同问题未能全歼，最终撤退。
summary.en: Chinese forces besieged the Japanese 14th Division at Lanfeng; Japanese reinforcements and coordination problems prevented a full encirclement, and the Chinese withdrew.

fields.name: 兰封会战 Battle of Lanfeng 兰封战役 Lanfeng Campaign
fields.place: 河南兰封（今兰考） Lanfeng (now Lankao), Henan
fields.summary: 中国军队围攻兰封日军第 14 师团，因日军增援与协同问题未能全歼，最终撤退。 Chinese forces besieged the Japanese 14th Division at Lanfeng; Japanese reinforcements and coordination problems prevented a full encirclement, and the Chinese withdrew.
fields.description: 1938 年 5 月，徐州会战后期，中国军队在兰封地区围攻日军第 14 师团。中国军队一度收复兰封，但日军增援逼近，中国军队侧背受威胁，被迫撤退。此役是徐州会战的重要组成部分，也暴露了指挥协同与装备差距。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1938, late in the Xuzhou campaign, Chinese forces besieged the Japanese 14th Division around Lanfeng. Chinese troops briefly recovered Lanfeng, but as Japanese reinforcements approached and threatened their flank and rear, they were forced to withdraw. The battle was an important part of the Xuzhou campaign and exposed gaps in command coordination and equipment. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.summary: 1938年5月24日，砀山沦陷。 On 24 May 1938 Dangshan fell.
fields.description: 5月24日，砀山沦陷。砀山位于徐州以西、陇海铁路沿线，是日军切断陇海线、阻止中国军队西撤的要点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 Dangshan fell on 24 May. West of Xuzhou on the Longhai railway, it was a key point for cutting the railway and blocking the Chinese withdrawal. summary.zh: 1938 年 5 月 26 日至 6 月 3 日，毛泽东在延安作《论持久战》讲演，系统阐述持久抗战方针。
summary.en: From 26 May to 3 June 1938 Mao Zedong lectured at Yan’an on protracted war, setting out the strategy of prolonged resistance.

fields.name: 毛泽东《论持久战》讲演 Mao Zedong’s lectures “On Protracted War”
fields.summary: 1938 年 5 月 26 日至 6 月 3 日，毛泽东在延安作《论持久战》讲演，系统阐述持久抗战方针。 From 26 May to 3 June 1938 Mao Zedong lectured at Yan’an on protracted war, setting out the strategy of prolonged resistance.
fields.description: 1938 年 5 月 26 日至 6 月 3 日，毛泽东在延安抗日战争研究会作《论持久战》讲演。讲演分析中日双方的基本特点，批驳「亡国论」和「速胜论」，指出抗日战争是持久战，将经历战略防御、战略相持、战略反攻三个阶段；强调「兵民是胜利之本」，战争的伟力之最深厚的根源存在于民众之中；明确八路军的战略方针是「基本的是游击战，但不放松有利条件下的运动战」。讲演收入《毛泽东选集》第二卷，是中国共产党指导全国抗战的纲领性文献。本事件为理论讲演，不绘路线。 From 26 May to 3 June 1938 Mao Zedong lectured to the Yan’an Society for the Study of the War of Resistance on protracted war. He analysed the strengths and weaknesses of both sides, rejected both the “national subjugation” and “quick victory” views, and argued that the war would pass through strategic defence, strategic stalemate and strategic counter-offensive. He stressed that “the army and the people are the foundation of victory” and that the deepest source of the war’s power lay among the masses, and defined the Eighth Route Army’s strategy as guerrilla warfare as the basic form, without abandoning mobile warfare under favourable conditions. The lectures, published in Selected Works of Mao Zedong vol. 2, became a programmatic text for the national resistance.

fields.name: 广州“五二八”大轰炸 Guangzhou Bombing of 28 May
fields.summary: 1938年5月28日，日机71架狂炸广州，炸死市民600余人、炸伤近千人。 On 28 May 1938 seventy-one Japanese aircraft bombed Guangzhou, killing over 600 civilians and wounding nearly 1,000.
fields.description: 1938年5月28日，日机71架狂袭广州，投弹150多枚，当场炸死600多人、炸伤近1000人。5月28日至30日，日机先后6批100多架次连续狂炸广州市区，炸死市民1500多人、炸伤1800多人，炸毁房屋900多间。日期据中国新闻网《档案显示日军轰炸广州密度仅次重庆》与《日军在广东的暴行（二）》。 On 28 May 1938 seventy-one Japanese aircraft raided Guangzhou, dropping over 150 bombs and killing more than 600 people and wounding nearly 1,000 on the spot. From 28 to 30 May six waves of over 100 sorties bombed the city, killing over 1,500 civilians, wounding over 1,800 and destroying more than 900 houses.

summary.zh: 1938年5月29日，日军第16师团占领商丘（归德）。
summary.en: On 29 May 1938 the Japanese 16th Division occupied Shangqiu (Guide).

fields.name: 商丘沦陷 Fall of Shangqiu
fields.summary: 1938年5月29日，日军第16师团占领商丘（归德）。 On 29 May 1938 the Japanese 16th Division occupied Shangqiu (Guide).
fields.description: 1938年5月25日日军第16师团自砀山进逼虞城、商丘，26日虞城失守。第一战区司令长官程潜令黄杰等部死守商丘，黄杰临阵脱逃，29日凌晨商丘“不战自退”，日军占领商丘。商丘失守使兰封附近中国军队侧背受敌，战局逆转。城陷日期，《1938年河南历史大事记》记5月29日，《河南的抗战历程》记5月28日，正文并列。 On 25 May 1938 the Japanese 16th Division advanced from Dangshan toward Yucheng and Shangqiu; Yucheng fell on the 26th. Cheng Qian ordered Huang Jie to hold Shangqiu to the death, but Huang fled, and the city was abandoned without a fight in the early hours of the 29th. The loss exposed the Chinese forces around Lanfeng and reversed the campaign. The 1938 Henan chronology gives 29 May; the Henan campaign history gives 28 May.

fields.description: 5月30日，涡阳沦陷；次日亳县沦陷。日军第13师团等部由蒙城西犯，企图切断中国军队经皖北西撤的通道。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 Guoyang fell on 30 May and Boxian the next day. As the gateway to northern Anhui, it was occupied as Japanese forces continued westward in pursuit of Chinese troops. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 第58军成立 Formation of the 58th Army
fields.summary: 滇军第58军在云南成立，孙渡任军长，随后开赴赣北。 The Yunnan 58th Army was formed with Sun Du as commander and soon moved to northern Jiangxi.
fields.description: 1938 年 6 月，为加强武汉会战兵力，滇军以 6 个团及常备训练团队在云南编成第58军，孙渡任军长。该军随后开赴赣北，隶属第9战区，参加南昌会战、长沙会战等。 建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期与番号沿革待史料校订。 In June 1938, to strengthen the forces for the Battle of Wuhan, the Yunnan military formed the 58th Army in Yunnan from six regiments and a standing training unit, with Sun Du as commander. It then moved to northern Jiangxi under the 9th War Zone and fought in the Nanchang and Changsha campaigns. An organizational event with no separate route; dates and order of battle await historical review.

fields.summary: 1938年6月3日，日军第16师团攻占杞县。 On 3 June 1938 the Japanese 16th Division captured Qi County (Qixian).
fields.description: 1938年5月底至6月初，日军第16师团一部连陷民权、宁陵、睢县、杞县，企图由杞县直指开封、郑州。6月3日，杞县、通许、陈留为日军第16师团攻占。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《河南的抗战历程》记6月1日起先后占领杞县、通许、尉氏、太康，未逐日。 From late May to early June 1938 elements of the Japanese 16th Division took Minquan, Ningling, Suixian and Qixian, aiming from Qixian at Kaifeng and Zhengzhou. On 3 June the 16th Division captured Qixian, Tongxu and Chenliu. The 1938 Henan chronology gives the day; the Henan campaign history says only that Qixian, Tongxu, Weishi and Taikang were taken from 1 June.

fields.name: 通许沦陷 Fall of Tongxu

fields.name: 尉氏沦陷 Fall of Weishi
fields.summary: 1938年6月4日，日军第16师团一部攻占尉氏。 On 4 June 1938 a detachment of the Japanese 16th Division captured Weishi.
fields.description: 1938年6月4日，日军第16师团一部攻占尉氏、扶沟，锋镝西指，企图迂回郑州。尉氏失守与同日花园口决堤前的豫东溃败相衔接。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《河南的抗战历程》记6月1日起先后占领尉氏等地。 On 4 June 1938 a detachment of the Japanese 16th Division captured Weishi and Fugou and turned west in an attempt to outflank Zhengzhou. The loss of Weishi formed part of the collapse in eastern Henan immediately before the Huayuankou levee breach. The 1938 Henan chronology gives the day; the Henan campaign history gives only early June.

fields.summary: 兰封会战后期日军占领开封。 The Japanese took Kaifeng in the later phase of the Lanfeng battle.
fields.description: 兰封会战后期，中国军队围攻土肥原第 14 师团未果，日军增援抵达，6 月 6 日占领开封，中国军队退守郑州以东，随后有花园口决堤。 In the later phase of the Lanfeng battle the Chinese army failed to destroy Dohihara’s 14th Division; Japanese reinforcements arrived and took Kaifeng on 6 June, the Chinese withdrawing east of Zhengzhou before the Huayuankou breach.

name.zh: 八路军第四纵队挺进冀东
name.en: The Fourth Column Marches into Eastern Hebei

summary.zh: 宋时轮、邓华率八路军第四纵队由平西挺进冀东，策应冀东抗日暴动。
summary.en: Song Shilun and Deng Hua led the Fourth Column from Pingxi into eastern Hebei to support the Jidong uprising.

fields.name: 八路军第四纵队挺进冀东 The Fourth Column Marches into Eastern Hebei 四纵东进 Fourth Column Eastward Advance
fields.place: 河北蓟县（今属天津） Jixian, Hebei (now Tianjin)
fields.summary: 宋时轮、邓华率八路军第四纵队由平西挺进冀东，策应冀东抗日暴动。 Song Shilun and Deng Hua led the Fourth Column from Pingxi into eastern Hebei to support the Jidong uprising.
fields.description: 1938 年 6 月，八路军第四纵队（司令员宋时轮、政治委员邓华）约 5000 人由平西斋堂出发，穿越平绥铁路和潮白河，挺进冀东，策应中共冀热边特委领导的冀东抗日暴动。7 月暴动遍及 20 余县，第四纵队与冀东抗日联军一度攻克多座县城，8 月在遵化铁厂会师；9 月后因日军大举“围剿”，主力西撤平西，冀东抗战转入游击坚持。1939 年 2 月 7 日，以第四纵队为基础在平西成立八路军冀热察挺进军，萧克任司令员，第四纵队番号撤销；该部此后转战平西、平北、冀东，未进入山东。 参战兵力与日期细节各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 In June 1938 the Fourth Column (commander Song Shilun, political commissar Deng Hua), about 5,000 strong, set out from Zhaitang in Pingxi, crossed the Beiping–Suiyuan railway and the Chaobai River, and entered eastern Hebei to support the Jidong anti-Japanese uprising led by the CCP Jirebian Special Committee. In July the uprising spread across more than 20 counties; the column and the Jidong Anti-Japanese United Army captured several county towns and met at Tiechang, Zunhua, in August. After September, under heavy Japanese pressure, the main force withdrew west to Pingxi and the struggle in Jidong shifted to guerrilla resistance. On 7 February 1939 the Jirecha Advance Army was formed at Pingxi on the Fourth Column’s basis under Xiao Ke, and the Fourth Column’s designation was abolished; the force subsequently operated in Pingxi, Pingbei, and Jidong and never entered Shandong. Force sizes and dates vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 国民政府为阻日军西进，在郑州花园口炸开黄河大堤，造成严重水灾。
summary.en: The Nationalist government breached the Yellow River dike at Huayuankou to stop the Japanese advance, causing severe flooding.

fields.name: 花园口决堤 Huayuankou Breach
fields.summary: 国民政府为阻日军西进，在郑州花园口炸开黄河大堤，造成严重水灾。 The Nationalist government breached the Yellow River dike at Huayuankou to stop the Japanese advance, causing severe flooding.
fields.description: 1938 年 6 月，国民政府军事当局为阻止日军沿陇海路西进，在郑州花园口炸开黄河大堤，形成黄泛区。此举迟滞了日军进攻，但也造成豫皖苏大量平民伤亡与流离失所。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In June 1938 the Nationalist military authorities breached the Yellow River dike at Huayuankou near Zhengzhou to stop the Japanese advance along the Longhai railway, creating the Yellow River flood zone. The move delayed the Japanese but caused heavy civilian casualties and displacement in Henan, Anhui, and Jiangsu. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 中牟沦陷 Fall of Zhongmou
fields.summary: 1938年6月9日，日军第14师团攻占中牟，进逼郑州。 On 9 June 1938 the Japanese 14th Division captured Zhongmou and closed on Zhengzhou.
fields.description: 开封沦陷后，日军第14师团于6月9日攻占中牟，进逼郑州；同日国民政府扒开花园口黄河大堤，以水代兵阻止日军西进。中牟失守是花园口决堤的直接背景之一。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《河南的抗战历程》。 After Kaifeng fell, the Japanese 14th Division captured Zhongmou on 9 June 1938 and closed on Zhengzhou. On the same day the Chinese government breached the Yellow River levee at Huayuankou to stop the Japanese advance. The fall of Zhongmou was one of the immediate circumstances behind the breach. Both cited accounts give 9 June.

fields.summary: 日军波田支队等部攻占安庆，武汉会战开始。 Japanese forces including the Bohati Detachment captured Anqing, opening the Battle of Wuhan.
fields.description: 1938 年 6 月 12 日，日军波田支队在海军配合下攻占安庆，武汉会战拉开序幕。安庆是长江中游重要港口，失守后日军沿长江北岸西进。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 12 June 1938 the Japanese Bohati Detachment, supported by the navy, captured Anqing, opening the Battle of Wuhan. Anqing was an important port on the middle Yangtze; after its fall the Japanese advanced west along the north bank. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年6月14日，宋庆龄在香港发起成立保卫中国同盟，向国际社会募集医药救济物资支援中国抗战。
summary.en: On 14 June 1938 Song Qingling founded the China Defence League in Hong Kong to channel international medical and relief aid to China.

fields.name: 保卫中国同盟成立 China Defence League Founded
fields.summary: 1938年6月14日，宋庆龄在香港发起成立保卫中国同盟，向国际社会募集医药救济物资支援中国抗战。 On 14 June 1938 Song Qingling founded the China Defence League in Hong Kong to channel international medical and relief aid to China.
fields.description: 1938年6月14日，保卫中国同盟（China Defence League）在香港九龙宋庆龄寓所成立，宋庆龄任中央委员会主席，宋子文任会长，廖承志任秘书长，香港医务总监司徒永觉的夫人克拉克任名誉秘书，香港大学教授诺曼·法朗士任名誉司库，爱泼斯坦、贝特兰主管宣传；中央委员还包括孙科、冯玉祥以及印度国大党领袖尼赫鲁、美国议员罗伯逊等。成立宣言提出两项任务：鼓励全世界爱好和平民主人士以医药、救济物资供应中国；集中力量密切配合以加强效果。保盟成为捐赠者与中国抗战前线之间的桥梁，向敌后根据地输送药品器械，出版《保卫中国同盟新闻通讯》，并支持中国工业合作运动。1941年12月香港沦陷后，保盟迁往重庆继续活动。本事件不绘路线。 On 14 June 1938 the China Defence League was founded at Song Qingling’s Kowloon residence in Hong Kong. Song Qingling chaired its central committee, Song Ziwen (T. V. Soong) was president, Liao Chengzhi secretary-general, Mrs Hilda Clark (wife of the Hong Kong medical director) honorary secretary, Norman France of Hong Kong University honorary treasurer, with Epstein and Bertram in charge of publicity; the committee also included Sun Fo, Feng Yuxiang, Nehru and the American congressman Robertson. Its founding manifesto set two tasks: to encourage all peace-loving and democratic people to supply China with medical and relief materials, and to concentrate and coordinate that effort. The League became a bridge between donors and China’s front lines, sending medicines and equipment to the base areas, publishing the China Defence League Newsletter and supporting the industrial cooperative movement. After Hong Kong fell in December 1941 it moved to Chongqing. No route is drawn.

fields.summary: 1938年6月19日，潜山沦陷。 On 19 June 1938 Qianshan fell.
fields.description: 6月18日，日军坂井支队进攻潜山，国民党川军第146、147师奉命阻击，激战后向山区撤退，日军于次日占领潜山。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 18 June the Japanese Sakai detachment attacked Qianshan. The Sichuan 146th and 147th Divisions fought a delaying action and withdrew into the mountains; the Japanese occupied Qianshan the next day. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Establishment of the Puppet Zhejiang Government

summary.zh: 1938年6月19日，伪浙江省暨杭州市政府成立。
summary.en: On 19 June 1938 the puppet Zhejiang provincial and Hangzhou municipal governments were established.

fields.name: 伪浙江省政府成立 Establishment of the Puppet Zhejiang Government
fields.summary: 1938年6月19日，伪浙江省暨杭州市政府成立。 On 19 June 1938 the puppet Zhejiang provincial and Hangzhou municipal governments were established.
fields.description: 6月19日，日军扶植的伪浙江省暨杭州市政府成立。日军占领浙江后，在沦陷区扶植伪政权，作为「以华制华」的傀儡。1938年1月，日军先建立伪杭州市治安维持会，后改为伪杭州市自治会，6月由伪杭州市政府接收。政治事件，不绘路线。 On 19 June the Japanese-sponsored puppet Zhejiang provincial and Hangzhou municipal governments were established. After occupying Zhejiang, Japan set up puppet regimes in the occupied areas as instruments of "using Chinese to control Chinese". A puppet Hangzhou maintenance association was created in January 1938, later replaced by a puppet self-government association and taken over by the puppet municipal government in June. This political event is not drawn as a route.

fields.description: 1938 年 6 月 20 日，日军舰艇、飞机轰炸南澳；21 日凌晨 3 时，日本海军陆战队 300 余人从钱澳、长尾山一带登陆，分四路进攻隆澳。中国守军保安营稍作抵抗后撤退。日期据汕头市档案馆，待页码级核对。 On 20 June 1938 Japanese warships and aircraft bombed Nan’ao; at 03:00 on 21 June more than 300 Japanese naval landing troops came ashore at Qian’ao and Changweishan and attacked Long’ao by four routes. The Chinese security battalion resisted briefly and withdrew. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 南澳沦陷 Fall of Nan’ao
fields.place: 广东南澳隆澳 Long’ao, Nan’ao, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军占领南澳全岛，这是潮汕第一个沦陷的县。 Japanese forces occupied all of Nan’ao, the first county in the Chaoshan region to fall.
fields.description: 1938 年 6 月 21 日日军登陆后，长驱直入占领县城隆澳，至 6 月 23 日控制南澳全岛。这是潮汕第一个沦陷的县。7 月 17 日中国义勇军一度收复南澳，7 月 20 日后日军反扑，8 月初南澳再陷。日期据汕头市档案馆，待页码级核对。 After landing on 21 June 1938, Japanese forces advanced unopposed into Long’ao and by 23 June controlled all of Nan’ao, the first county in the Chaoshan region to fall. Chinese volunteers briefly recovered the island on 17 July, but Japanese forces counterattacked after 20 July and Nan’ao fell again in early August. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 26 June 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment captured the Madang fortress.

fields.name: 马当要塞失守 Fall of the Madang Fortress
fields.place: 江西彭泽马当 Madang, Pengze, Jiangxi
fields.summary: 1938年6月26日，日军波田支队攻占马当要塞。 On 26 June 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment captured the Madang fortress.
fields.description: 马当要塞位于江西彭泽县长江弯道，江面狭窄，是武汉会战前长江下游的重要封锁线。6月23日起，日军波田支队在巡洋舰、驱逐舰支援下猛攻马当；6月26日马当要塞失守，长江封锁线被突破。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与《抗战实录丨马当要塞失陷记》，待页码级核对。 The Madang fortress stood on a narrow bend of the Yangtze in Pengze county, Jiangxi, and was a key blocking position on the lower Yangtze before the Wuhan campaign. From 23 June the Japanese Wada detachment, supported by cruisers and destroyers, attacked Madang; the fortress fell on 26 June and the river blockade was broken. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the Madang account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 29 June 1938 Pengze fell.

fields.summary: 1938年6月29日，彭泽沦陷。 On 29 June 1938 Pengze fell.
fields.description: 马当要塞失守后，日军波田支队沿长江南岸西进，6月29日攻占彭泽县城。彭泽是马当要塞的后方依托，失守后日军直逼湖口。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与《抗战实录丨马当要塞失陷记》，待页码级核对。 After Madang fell, the Japanese Wada detachment advanced west along the south bank of the Yangtze and captured Pengze on 29 June. Pengze was the rear support of the Madang fortress; its fall opened the way to Hukou. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the Madang account and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1938年6月30日，太湖沦陷。 On 30 June 1938 Taihu fell.
fields.description: 6月30日，太湖沦陷。日军沿大别山南麓西进，配合长江方向进攻武汉。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 Taihu fell on 30 June. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 7月4日，日军攻占湖口。湖口位于鄱阳湖入长江口，是九江的东面屏障；失守后日军沿江直逼九江。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与《抗战实录丨马当要塞失陷记》，待页码级核对。 On 4 July Japanese forces captured Hukou. At the mouth of Poyang Lake where it joins the Yangtze, Hukou was the eastern shield of Jiujiang; its fall opened the river route to Jiujiang. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the Madang account and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 国民参政会成立 Establishment of the People’s Political Council
fields.summary: 国民参政会在汉口成立，成为战时民意咨询机构。 The People’s Political Council was established in Hankou as a wartime advisory body representing public opinion.
fields.description: 1938 年 7 月 6 日，国民参政会第一届第一次会议在汉口召开，容纳各党派与无党派人士，成为战时民意咨询机构。它没有立法权，但为各派参与政治提供了渠道。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 6 July 1938 the first session of the People’s Political Council opened in Hankou, bringing together party and non-party figures as a wartime advisory body. It had no legislative power but provided a channel for various groups to participate in politics. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 楼山镇战斗 The battle of Loushan
fields.place: 吉林苇河楼山镇（今尚志） Loushan, Weihe (modern Shangzhi), Jilin
fields.summary: 1938年7月12日，抗联第二路军第四、第五军西征部队攻占苇河县楼山镇，随后遭日伪军重兵追击。 On 12 July 1938 the 4th and 5th Armies of the 2nd Route Army, on their westward expedition, stormed Loushan in Weihe county and were then pursued by strong Japanese forces.
fields.description: 1938 年 5 月，中共吉东省委决定抗联第二路军第四、第五军主力西征，向五常、舒兰一带转移，试图打通与东南满第一路军和关内八路军的联系。7 月 2 日，西征部队 680 余人自刁翎出发，袭击牡丹江岸三道通，越过老爷岭，穿行三百里荒无人烟的深山密林，8 日进入苇河县境。7 月 12 日拂晓，第四军军长李延平、副军长王光宇率部突袭苇河县东北的楼山镇，将守敌分割包围，激战数小时占领该镇，随后召开群众大会宣传抗日。战果各说不一：俘虏伪森林警察中队长以下 40 余人（《中国抗日战争史》）；毙伤俘日伪军 140 余人，缴机枪 2 挺、步枪百余支、子弹万余发（《解放军报》）；俘敌中队长以下六七人，缴机枪 2 挺、步枪近百支、弹药四万发以上（《黑龙江日报》）。楼山镇失守后，日军从中东路沿线及延寿、方正调兵追击。西征部队分兵：第五军一部东返，第四军主力和第五军第一、第二师继续西进，8 月进入五常山区，损失惨重；第五军第一师东返途中于 10 月在乌斯浑河遭袭，即八女投江。本事件不绘路线。 In May 1938 the Jilin-Dongman party committee ordered the 4th and 5th Armies of the 2nd Route Army to march west toward Wuchang and Shulan, to link up with the 1st Route Army in the south-east and with the Eighth Route Army inside the Great Wall. On 2 July some 680 men set out from Diaoling, attacked SandaoTong on the Mudan River, crossed the Laoye ridge and marched 300 li through uninhabited forest, entering Weihe county on the 8th. At dawn on 12 July Li Yanping, commander of the 4th Army, and his deputy Wang Guangyu stormed Loushan north-east of Weihe, split and surrounded the garrison and took the town after several hours, then held a mass meeting. Results differ: over forty puppet forest police including their squadron commander captured (History of the War of Resistance); 140-odd Japanese and puppet troops killed, wounded or captured with two machine guns and over a hundred rifles (PLA Daily); six or seven captured and about a hundred rifles with 40,000 rounds (Heilongjiang Daily). After the town fell the Japanese brought troops from the Chinese Eastern Railway line and from Yanshou and Fangzheng. The expedition split: part of the 5th Army turned back, while the 4th Army and the 5th Army’s 1st and 2nd Divisions pushed on into the Wuchang mountains in August and suffered heavy losses; the 5th Army’s 1st Division was ambushed at the Wusihun River in October — the eight women. No route is drawn.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Jiujiang, widening the outer operations of the Battle of Wuhan.

fields.name: 九江沦陷 Fall of Jiujiang
fields.summary: 日军攻占九江，武汉会战外围作战扩大。 Japanese forces captured Jiujiang, widening the outer operations of the Battle of Wuhan.
fields.description: 1938 年 7 月 26 日，日军第 106 师团等部攻占九江，中国守军退守庐山、瑞昌一线。九江沦陷后，日军沿南浔铁路南下，武汉会战进入激烈阶段。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 26 July 1938 the Japanese 106th Division and other units captured Jiujiang; Chinese defenders fell back to Lushan and Ruichang. After the fall of Jiujiang the Japanese advanced south along the Nanxun railway and the Battle of Wuhan entered its intense phase. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 小池口失守 Fall of Xiaochikou
fields.place: 湖北黄梅小池口 Xiaochikou, Huangmei, Hubei
fields.summary: 1938年7月26日，日军第3师团在小池口登陆，占领小池口。 On 26 July 1938 the Japanese 3rd Division landed at and captured Xiaochikou.
fields.description: 1938年7月，日军第3师团在海军掩护下于小池口登陆，中国守军刘汝明部多次击退日军进攻，但阵地被飞机、舰炮炸毁，26日小池口失守。小池口失守后，日军打开沿长江北岸西进黄梅的通道。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 In July 1938 the Japanese 3rd Division landed at Xiaochikou under naval cover. Liu Ruming’s troops beat off several assaults, but the positions were destroyed by air and naval gunfire, and Xiaochikou fell on the 26th. Its loss opened the way west along the north bank of the Yangtze toward Huangmei.

fields.description: 8月2日，宿松沦陷。宿松是皖鄂交界门户，日军占领后继续西进黄梅、九江。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 Susong fell on 2 August. At the Anhui–Hubei border, it was occupied as Japanese forces continued west toward Huangmei and Jiujiang. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 黄梅沦陷 Fall of Huangmei
fields.summary: 1938年8月2日，日军第6师团攻占黄梅县城。 On 2 August 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured Huangmei.
fields.description: 1938年8月2日，日军第6师团自小池口、宿松方向进攻黄梅，出动20余架飞机轰炸县城11次，当晚从北门攻入，黄梅县城失守。黄梅失守后，长江沿岸战事进入湖北境内。日期据《武汉会战概述》与人民网《武汉会战和广州作战》。 On 2 August 1938 the Japanese 6th Division attacked Huangmei from Xiaochikou and Susong, bombing the town eleven times with more than twenty aircraft and entering through the north gate that evening. Its fall brought the Yangtze campaign into Hubei proper.

name.zh: 中国工业合作协会成立

summary.zh: 1938年8月5日，中国工业合作协会在汉口成立，以工业合作社组织后方生产支援抗战。
summary.en: On 5 August 1938 the Chinese Industrial Cooperatives association was founded in Hankou to organise wartime production through cooperatives.

fields.name: 中国工业合作协会成立 Chinese Industrial Cooperatives Founded
fields.summary: 1938年8月5日，中国工业合作协会在汉口成立，以工业合作社组织后方生产支援抗战。 On 5 August 1938 the Chinese Industrial Cooperatives association was founded in Hankou to organise wartime production through cooperatives.
fields.description: 抗战爆发后沿海工业大部沦陷，后方军需民用物资匮乏，数百万工人与难民失业流离。新西兰友人路易·艾黎与美国记者埃德加·斯诺、海伦·斯诺等提出「以工业合作社组织后方生产」的方案，1938年4月在上海成立工业合作社促进委员会，5月通过艾黎起草的发展计划（拟建3万个合作社）。1938年8月5日，中国工业合作协会在汉口正式成立，宋美龄任名誉理事长，孔祥熙任理事长，林伯渠、董必武、邓颖超、沈钧儒、黄炎培等任理事；年底迁重庆。1939年1月在香港成立工合促进会，宋庆龄任名誉主席；7月成立国际促进委员会，何明华主教任主席。工合在宝鸡、赣州、延安等地设事务所，组织难民与失业工人生产军需民用物资，被称为战时经济领域的民间国际合作。本事件不绘路线。 After the war began most coastal industry was lost, supplies in the interior ran short and millions of workers and refugees were displaced. The New Zealander Rewi Alley, with the American journalists Edgar and Helen Snow, proposed organising production through industrial cooperatives; a promotion committee was set up in Shanghai in April 1938 and in May adopted Alley’s plan for 30,000 cooperatives. On 5 August 1938 the Chinese Industrial Cooperatives association was formally founded in Hankou, with Song Meiling as honorary chair, H. H. Kung as chairman and Lin Boqu, Dong Biwu, Deng Yingchao, Shen Junru and Huang Yanpei among the directors; it moved to Chongqing at the end of the year. A Hong Kong promotion committee was formed in January 1939 with Song Qingling as honorary chair, and an international committee followed in July under Bishop R. O. Hall. Gung Ho ran offices in Baoji, Ganzhou and Yan’an, organising refugees and unemployed workers to produce military and civilian goods. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1938年8月11日起，日军连续八次大规模轰炸武汉，民众死伤4700余人。
summary.en: From 11 August 1938 the Japanese carried out eight large-scale raids on Wuhan, killing and wounding over 4,700 civilians.

fields.name: 武汉大轰炸 Great Bombing of Wuhan
fields.summary: 1938年8月11日起，日军连续八次大规模轰炸武汉，民众死伤4700余人。 From 11 August 1938 the Japanese carried out eight large-scale raids on Wuhan, killing and wounding over 4,700 civilians.
fields.description: 1938年8月11日至9月17日，日军飞机8次对武汉进行大规模轰炸，共投弹1180余枚，致民众死伤4700余人，炸毁、烧毁房屋3200余栋（间）。8月11日大批日机集中轰炸武昌、汉阳，800余名市民死亡，华中大学遭到严重破坏。日期据《武汉大轰炸》与湖北省档案馆《日军轰炸武汉纪实》。 Between 11 August and 17 September 1938 Japanese aircraft made eight large raids on Wuhan, dropping over 1,180 bombs, killing and wounding more than 4,700 civilians and destroying over 3,200 buildings. On 11 August Japanese aircraft concentrated on Wuchang and Hanyang, killing over 800 civilians and severely damaging Huazhong University.

fields.name: 永济失陷 Fall of Yongji
fields.summary: 1938年8月17日，日军第20师团攻陷永济，守军500余人殉国。 On 17 August 1938 the Japanese 20th Division took Yongji after the battle of Yongji; more than 500 Chinese soldiers died.
fields.description: 1938年3月6日，日军第20师团沿同蒲铁路南犯，占领永济。5月，第38军第177师等部东渡黄河，收复永济等晋西南十余县并夺回风陵渡。8月8日，驻运城日军第20师团以约一个旅团兵力，配炮兵4个中队、坦克3个中队及飞机十余架，分三路进攻永济，永济保卫战开始。8月15日，日军由汉奸带路迂回攻占万固寺，教导团夺回；第三营在西姚温村遭日军重兵包围，营长张希文以下几乎全部殉国。8月17日，日军从东、南、北三面包围永济城（西面为黄河），下午5时许在坦克大炮掩护下冲入城内，巷战后6时许永济失陷，守军500余人殉国。此后教导团在韩阳镇坚守十余日，9月初撤出。日期取华商报、凤凰卫视口述史与《山西抗战大事记》。 On 6 March 1938 the Japanese 20th Division advanced south along the Tongguan–Pukou railway and occupied Yongji. In May the Chinese 177th Division of the 38th Army and other units crossed the Yellow River eastward, recovered Yongji and more than ten other counties in south-western Shanxi and retook Fenglingdu. On 8 August the Japanese 20th Division at Yuncheng attacked Yongji in three columns with about a brigade, four artillery batteries, three tank companies and more than ten aircraft, opening the battle of Yongji. On 15 August the Japanese, guided by a collaborator, worked round and took Wangu Temple; the training regiment retook it, but the 3rd Battalion was surrounded at Xiyaowen village and almost annihilated, its commander Zhang Xiwen among the dead. On 17 August the Japanese closed in on Yongji from east, south and north (the Yellow River lay to the west), broke into the town under tank and artillery cover at about five in the afternoon, and after street fighting the town fell at about six; more than 500 Chinese soldiers died. The training regiment then held Hanyangzhen for over ten days before withdrawing in early September. The date follows the Huashang Daily, Phoenix Television oral history and the Shanxi war chronology.

summary.zh: 1938年8月20日，星子沦陷。
summary.en: On 20 August 1938 Xingzi fell.

fields.name: 星子沦陷 Fall of Xingzi
fields.summary: 1938年8月20日，星子沦陷。 On 20 August 1938 Xingzi fell.
fields.description: 8月，日军第101师团等部沿鄱阳湖西岸南犯，8月20日攻占星子县城。星子是庐山南麓、鄱阳湖西岸的要点，失守后日军向德安方向推进。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与央广网江西抗战专题，待页码级核对。 In August the Japanese 101st Division and other units advanced south along the western shore of Poyang Lake and captured Xingzi on 20 August. Xingzi was a key point south of Mount Lu on the lake's western shore; its fall opened the advance toward De'an. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the CNR Jiangxi campaign feature and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 瑞昌沦陷 Fall of Ruichang
fields.summary: 1938年8月24日，瑞昌沦陷。 On 24 August 1938 Ruichang fell.
fields.description: 8月24日，日军攻占瑞昌。瑞昌位于九江以西、幕阜山东北麓，是日军由赣北迂回武汉的通道。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与央广网江西抗战专题，待页码级核对。 On 24 August Japanese forces captured Ruichang. West of Jiujiang on the northeastern slope of the Mufu Mountains, Ruichang was a corridor for the Japanese flanking move toward Wuhan through northern Jiangxi. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the CNR Jiangxi campaign feature and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年8月28日，六安失陷。
summary.en: On 28 August 1938 Lu'an fell.

fields.name: 六安沦陷 Fall of Lu'an
fields.summary: 1938年8月28日，六安失陷。 On 28 August 1938 Lu'an fell.
fields.description: 8月26日，日军第10师团进攻六安，与国民党守军第51军第113、114师激战；至28日，守军撤至淠河西岸，六安失陷。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。 On 26 August the Japanese 10th Division attacked Lu'an and fought a fierce battle with the Chinese 113th and 114th Divisions of the 51st Army. By 28 August the defenders withdrew west of the Pi River and Lu'an fell. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 29 August 1938 Huoshan fell.

fields.name: 霍山沦陷 Fall of Huoshan
fields.summary: 1938年8月29日，霍山失陷。 On 29 August 1938 Huoshan fell.
fields.description: 8月27日，日军第13师团由舒城进犯霍山，国民党安徽省保安五团、第71军在第七十七军支援下与日军激战；至29日，日军在飞机掩护下攻入城内，霍山失陷。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。 On 27 August the Japanese 13th Division advanced from Shucheng toward Huoshan. The Anhui 5th Security Regiment and the 71st Army, supported by the 77th Army, fought back; on 29 August Japanese troops entered the town under air cover and Huoshan fell. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 第58军抵赣北 58th Army Reaches Northern Jiangxi
fields.summary: 第58军自云南经贵阳、长沙开赴赣北，参加第9战区作战。 The 58th Army moved from Yunnan via Guiyang and Changsha to northern Jiangxi for operations in the 9th War Zone.
fields.description: 1938 年 9 月，第58军自云南经贵阳、长沙开赴赣北，隶属第9战区。此后长期转战赣北、湘北，参加南昌会战、长沙会战与赣北游击作战。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In September 1938 the 58th Army moved from Yunnan via Guiyang and Changsha to northern Jiangxi under the 9th War Zone. It then fought for years in northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan, taking part in the Nanchang and Changsha campaigns and guerrilla operations. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: On 6 September 1938 the Segu detachment of the Japanese 10th Division occupied Gushi.

fields.name: 固始沦陷 Fall of Gushi
fields.summary: 1938年9月6日，日军第10师团濑谷支队占领固始。 On 6 September 1938 the Segu detachment of the Japanese 10th Division occupied Gushi.
fields.description: 武汉会战期间，日军第10师团濑谷支队自安徽叶家集北犯，9月6日晨与第59军激战，当夜占领固始。固始失守后，日军主力沿固潢公路西犯潢川。固始城陷日期，《1938年河南历史大事记》与潢川新闻网均记9月6日；《河南的抗战历程》把固始列入10月12日一并攻克，与逐日记载不符，正文并列。 During the Wuhan campaign the Segu detachment of the Japanese 10th Division advanced north from Yejiaji in Anhui, fought the 59th Corps on the morning of 6 September 1938 and occupied Gushi that night. The main force then drove west along the Gushi–Huangchuan road. The 1938 Henan chronology and the Huangchuan county history both give 6 September; the Henan campaign history groups Gushi with the 12 October captures, which conflicts with the daily record.

fields.name: 广济沦陷 Fall of Guangji
fields.summary: 1938年9月6日，日军第6师团攻占广济（梅川）。 On 6 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured Guangji (Meichuan).
fields.description: 1938年8月30日日军第6师团向广济进攻，9月6日突破田家寨、笔架山阵地，中国第4兵团当夜弃守广济（梅川）。《武汉会战概述》记9月17日广济、武穴相继沦陷，与逐日战史相差，正文并列。日期取《小界岭战役》与《中华民族抗日编年》9月6日。 On 30 August 1938 the Japanese 6th Division attacked Guangji; on 6 September it broke the Tianjiazhai and Bijiaoshan positions, and the Chinese 4th Army Group abandoned Guangji (Meichuan) that night. The Hubei campaign overview gives 17 September; that variant is noted.

fields.summary: 日军第 2 军自六安西进占领商城。 The Japanese 2nd Army advanced west from Lu’an and took Shangcheng.
fields.description: 1938 年 8 月底日军第 2 军自合肥、六安西进，沿大别山北麓进攻商城、潢川，9 月 16 日占领商城，随后转攻潢川、罗山，配合武汉会战。 In late August 1938 the Japanese 2nd Army advanced west from Hefei and Lu’an along the northern foot of the Dabie mountains against Shangcheng and Huangchuan, taking Shangcheng on 16 September and then turning on Huangchuan and Luoshan in support of the Wuhan campaign.

summary.zh: 1938年9月16日，日军第6师团、海军陆战队攻占武穴。
summary.en: On 16 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division and naval landing troops captured Wuxue.

fields.name: 武穴沦陷 Fall of Wuxue
fields.place: 湖北广济武穴 Wuxue, Guangji, Hubei
fields.summary: 1938年9月16日，日军第6师团、海军陆战队攻占武穴。 On 16 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division and naval landing troops captured Wuxue.
fields.description: 1938年9月16日日军第6师团、海军陆战队攻占武穴。武穴为长江北岸重要港口，失守后日军完成对田家镇要塞的合围。《武汉会战概述》记9月17日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 On 16 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division and naval landing troops took Wuxue, the key port on the north bank of the Yangtze. Its fall completed the encirclement of the Tianjiazhen fortress. The Hubei campaign overview gives 17 September; that variant is noted.

name.zh: 印度援华医疗队抵广州
name.en: Indian Medical Mission Arrives in Guangzhou

summary.zh: 1938年9月17日，印度援华医疗队五名医生抵达广州，宋庆龄、何香凝到码头迎接。
summary.en: On 17 September 1938 the five doctors of the Indian Medical Mission reached Guangzhou and were welcomed at the docks by Song Qingling and He Xiangning.

fields.name: 印度援华医疗队抵广州 Indian Medical Mission Arrives in Guangzhou
fields.summary: 1938年9月17日，印度援华医疗队五名医生抵达广州，宋庆龄、何香凝到码头迎接。 On 17 September 1938 the five doctors of the Indian Medical Mission reached Guangzhou and were welcomed at the docks by Song Qingling and He Xiangning.
fields.description: 1937 年底，印度国大党通过尼赫鲁发起的派遣医疗队援华决议。1938 年 8 月下旬公布五名队员名单：队长爱德（M. M. Atal）、副队长卓克（M. R. Cholkar）、巴苏（B. K. Basu）、木克吉（D. Mukerji）、柯棣尼斯（D. S. Kotnis，中文名柯棣华）。9 月 1 日，医疗队携带两辆救护车、55 箱医药器械自孟买启程，9 月 14 日抵香港，9 月 17 日抵广州，宋庆龄、何香凝及广州各界两千余人到码头迎接。9 月底抵汉口，被中国红十字会编为第 15 救护队（抵汉口日期有 9-29、9-30 两说），在汉口后方医院救治伤兵；叶剑英、周恩来先后会见。1939 年 1 月离重庆北上，2 月 12 日抵延安，随后赴晋察冀。柯棣华任白求恩国际和平医院院长，1942 年 12 月 9 日病逝。本事件不绘路线。 Late in 1937 the Indian National Congress, at Nehru's initiative, resolved to send a medical mission to China. In late August 1938 the five members were announced: M. M. Atal (leader), M. R. Cholkar, B. K. Basu, D. Mukerji and D. S. Kotnis. On 1 September the mission sailed from Bombay with two ambulances and 55 cases of medical equipment, reached Hong Kong on the 14th and Guangzhou on the 17th, where Song Qingling, He Xiangning and more than 2,000 people welcomed them at the docks. They reached Hankou at the end of September and were assigned to the Chinese Red Cross relief corps as No. 15 ambulance unit (accounts give 29 or 30 September), treating wounded soldiers in a rear hospital; Ye Jianying and Zhou Enlai received them. They left Chongqing in January 1939, reached Yan'an on 12 February and went on to the Jin-Cha-Ji border region. Kotnis headed the Bethune International Peace Hospital and died on 9 December 1942. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1938年9月18日，日军第10师团攻陷潢川。
summary.en: On 18 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division captured Huangchuan.

fields.name: 潢川沦陷 Fall of Huangchuan
fields.summary: 1938年9月18日，日军第10师团攻陷潢川。 On 18 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division captured Huangchuan.
fields.description: 1938年9月6日固始失守后，日军第10师团于7日西犯潢川。第五战区第27军团军团长兼第59军军长张自忠亲临阵地，指挥第38师阻击日军，巷战肉搏、迭行逆袭，日军伤亡惨重，但第59军伤亡亦重，18日潢川陷落。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与潢川新闻网（记9月7日西犯）。 After Gushi fell on 6 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division attacked Huangchuan on the 7th. Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 27th Army and the 59th Corps, directed the 38th Division in street fighting and counterattacks, inflicting heavy losses, but the 59th Corps was also badly mauled and Huangchuan fell on the 18th. The 1938 Henan chronology gives the fall; the Huangchuan county history gives the start of the attack on 7 September.

summary.zh: 1938年9月20日，日军第10师团占领光山。
summary.en: On 20 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division occupied Guangshan.

fields.name: 光山沦陷 Fall of Guangshan
fields.summary: 1938年9月20日，日军第10师团占领光山。 On 20 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division occupied Guangshan.
fields.description: 1938年9月18日潢川失守后，日军第10师团继续西犯，20日光山失守。光山位于潢川与罗山之间，失守后日军打开了沿信潢公路西进信阳的通道。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《河南的抗战历程》把光山列入10月12日一并攻克，正文并列。 After Huangchuan fell on 18 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division pushed west and took Guangshan on the 20th. Lying between Huangchuan and Luoshan, Guangshan opened the way along the Xinyang–Huangchuan road toward Xinyang. The 1938 Henan chronology gives 20 September; the Henan campaign history groups Guangshan with the 12 October captures.

summary.zh: 1938年9月22日，日军第10师团占领罗山。
summary.en: On 22 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division occupied Luoshan.

fields.name: 罗山沦陷 Fall of Luoshan
fields.summary: 1938年9月22日，日军第10师团占领罗山。 On 22 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division occupied Luoshan.
fields.description: 1938年9月22日，日军第10师团由潢川西犯罗山，经竹竿铺一战占领罗山。罗山是信阳以东最后一座县城，失守后日军直逼信阳。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《河南的抗战历程》把罗山列入10月12日一并攻克，正文并列。 On 22 September 1938 the Japanese 10th Division advanced west from Huangchuan and took Luoshan after the fight at Zhuganpu. Luoshan was the last county town east of Xinyang; its fall brought the Japanese to the gates of Xinyang. The 1938 Henan chronology gives 22 September; the Henan campaign history groups Luoshan with the 12 October captures.
