summary.zh: 1938年9月24日，日军波田支队、第9师团攻占富池口。
summary.en: On 24 September 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division captured Fuchikou.

fields.name: 富池口失守 Fall of Fuchikou
fields.place: 湖北阳新富池口 Fuchikou, Yangxin, Hubei
fields.summary: 1938年9月24日，日军波田支队、第9师团攻占富池口。 On 24 September 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division captured Fuchikou.
fields.description: 1938年9月15日起，日军波田支队与第9师团进攻富池口，中国第54军第18师顽强抵抗，日军施放毒气，24日富池口失守。富池口与田家镇夹江对峙，失守后武汉长江门户洞开。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 From 15 September 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division attacked Fuchikou. The Chinese 18th Division of the 54th Corps resisted stubbornly, but the Japanese used poison gas and took Fuchikou on the 24th. Fuchikou faced Tianjiazhen across the Yangtze; its loss opened the river gate to Wuhan.

summary.zh: 第74军等部在万家岭重创日军第106师团。
summary.en: The 74th Army and other units mauled the Japanese 106th Division at Wanjialing.

fields.name: 万家岭大捷 Wanjialing Victory
fields.place: 江西德安万家岭 Wanjialing, De’an, Jiangxi
fields.summary: 第74军等部在万家岭重创日军第106师团。 The 74th Army and other units mauled the Japanese 106th Division at Wanjialing.
fields.description: 1938 年 9 至 10 月，武汉会战期间，第74军等部在江西德安万家岭地区包围日军第106师团，经激战重创该部。万家岭大捷是武汉会战中的重要胜利，也使第74军声名大振。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In September and October 1938, during the Battle of Wuhan, the 74th Army and other units encircled and mauled the Japanese 106th Division at Wanjialing in De’an, Jiangxi. The victory was an important success in the Wuhan campaign and made the 74th Army famous. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: First Japanese Air Raid on Kunming

summary.zh: 1938年9月28日，日机9架首次空袭昆明，死伤150余人。
summary.en: On 28 September 1938 nine Japanese bombers raided Kunming for the first time, killing and wounding over 150 people.

fields.name: 日军首次轰炸昆明 First Japanese Air Raid on Kunming
fields.summary: 1938年9月28日，日机9架首次空袭昆明，死伤150余人。 On 28 September 1938 nine Japanese bombers raided Kunming for the first time, killing and wounding over 150 people.
fields.description: 1938年9月28日上午，日机9架经广西闯入云南，空袭昆明，投弹103枚，重点轰炸巫家坝机场及西门外潘家湾、凤翥街一带，死伤150余人。此后日军对昆明持续轰炸，1940年至1941年达到高潮。日期据《日军轰炸昆明，酿造多起惨案》与云南省档案局《日寇对昆明的空袭》。 On the morning of 28 September 1938 nine Japanese bombers entered Yunnan from Guangxi and raided Kunming, dropping 103 bombs, mainly on Wujiaba airfield and the Panjiawan and Fengzhu Street areas west of the city, killing and wounding over 150 people. Raids continued and peaked in 1940–1941.

summary.zh: 1938年9月29日，日军第6师团攻陷田家镇要塞。
summary.en: On 29 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured the Tianjiazhen fortress.

fields.name: 田家镇要塞失守 Fall of Tianjiazhen Fortress
fields.place: 湖北广济田家镇 Tianjiazhen, Guangji, Hubei
fields.summary: 1938年9月29日，日军第6师团攻陷田家镇要塞。 On 29 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured the Tianjiazhen fortress.
fields.description: 1938年9月18日起，日军第6师团今村支队进攻田家镇要塞北区，中国第2军第57师等部死守，日军以飞机、重炮和毒气猛攻，29日田家镇中心阵地失守。田家镇为武汉东面门户，失守后长江沿岸战事迅速逼近武汉。日期据《武汉会战概述》与人民网。 From 18 September 1938 the Japanese 6th Division’s Imamura detachment attacked the northern sector of the Tianjiazhen fortress. The Chinese 57th Division and others held on under air, artillery and gas attack until the central position fell on the 29th. Tianjiazhen was the eastern gate of Wuhan, and its loss brought the campaign rapidly toward the city.

summary.zh: 1938 年 9 月 29 日至 11 月 6 日，中共扩大的六届六中全会在延安召开，提出「马克思主义中国化」。
summary.en: From 29 September to 6 November 1938 the enlarged Sixth Plenum met at Yan’an and raised the task of “Sinicising Marxism”.

fields.name: 中共扩大的六届六中全会 Enlarged Sixth Plenum of the Sixth Central Committee
fields.summary: 1938 年 9 月 29 日至 11 月 6 日，中共扩大的六届六中全会在延安召开，提出「马克思主义中国化」。 From 29 September to 6 November 1938 the enlarged Sixth Plenum met at Yan’an and raised the task of “Sinicising Marxism”.
fields.description: 1938 年 9 月 29 日至 11 月 6 日，中共扩大的六届六中全会在延安桥儿沟天主教堂召开，是六大以来出席人数最多的一次中央全会。王稼祥传达共产国际指示，确认中共中央政治路线正确、领导机关要以毛泽东为首解决统一领导问题。毛泽东作《论新阶段》政治报告，首次提出「马克思主义中国化」的命题，强调统一战线中的独立自主原则，重申「个人服从组织、少数服从多数、下级服从上级、全党服从中央」的纪律。全会基本纠正王明右倾错误，决定撤销长江局，设立南方局和中原局。毛泽东后来称六届六中全会是「决定中国之命运的」会议。本事件为会议，不绘路线。 From 29 September to 6 November 1938 the enlarged Sixth Plenum of the Sixth Central Committee met in the Qiaoergou Catholic church at Yan’an, with more attendees than any central plenum since the Sixth Congress. Wang Jiaxiang conveyed the Comintern’s confirmation that the CCP’s political line was correct and that the leadership should be unified around Mao Zedong. Mao’s report “On the New Stage” first raised the task of “Sinicising Marxism”, stressed independence within the united front, and restated the discipline of the individual subordinating to the organisation, the minority to the majority, the lower level to the higher, and the whole Party to the Central Committee. The plenum largely corrected Wang Ming’s rightist errors and decided to abolish the Yangtze River Bureau and set up the South and Central China bureaux. Mao later called it the meeting that “decided China’s fate”.

fields.name: 第5军组建 Formation of the 5th Army
fields.summary: 中国第一支机械化军在广西全州整编成军，杜聿明任军长。 China’s first mechanized army was assembled at Quanzhou, Guangxi, with Du Yuming as commander.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月，第5军在广西全州整编成军，辖第200师、新编第22师、荣誉第1师，杜聿明任军长，是中国第一支机械化部队。1939 年参加桂南会战、主攻昆仑关；1942 年作为远征军先头部队入缅。 建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期与番号沿革待史料校订。 In October 1938 the 5th Army was assembled at Quanzhou, Guangxi, with the 200th Division, New 22nd Division, and Honorary 1st Division under Du Yuming. It was China’s first mechanized army. In 1939 it fought in the Guangxi campaign and led the attack on Kunlun Pass; in 1942 it entered Burma as the spearhead of the Chinese Expeditionary Force. An organizational event with no separate route; dates and order of battle await historical review.

fields.description: 1938 年 10 月，滇军第184师、新编第12师在湖南长沙编成新3军，隶属第30军团。11 月在湖北崇阳作战失利，此后转战赣北、湘北，隶属第9战区。 建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期与番号沿革待史料校订。 In October 1938 the Yunnan 184th and New 12th Divisions formed the New 3rd Army at Changsha under the 30th Army Corps. It suffered a defeat at Chongyang in Hubei in November and then fought in northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan under the 9th War Zone. An organizational event with no separate route; dates and order of battle await historical review.

fields.name: 半壁山失守 Fall of Banbishan
fields.place: 湖北阳新半壁山 Banbishan, Yangxin, Hubei
fields.summary: 1938年10月4日，日军攻占半壁山，田家镇—富池口—半壁山要塞群全部陷落。 On 4 October 1938 the Japanese captured Banbishan, completing the fall of the Tianjiazhen–Fuchikou–Banbishan fortress group.
fields.description: 田家镇失守后，日军第9师团进攻长江南岸半壁山。10月4日，日军以80余架飞机轰炸并强渡登陆，中国守军第193师第1124团几乎全部战死，半壁山失守。田家镇—富池口—半壁山要塞群全部陷落。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 After Tianjiazhen fell, the Japanese 9th Division attacked Banbishan on the south bank. On 4 October, after bombing with more than eighty aircraft, the Japanese landed and overran the position; the Chinese 1124th Regiment was almost wiped out. The Tianjiazhen–Fuchikou–Banbishan fortress group was now entirely lost.

fields.name: 蕲春沦陷 Fall of Qichun
fields.summary: 1938年10月8日，日军第6师团攻占蕲春（蕲州）。 On 8 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured Qichun (Qizhou).
fields.description: 1938年10月8日日军第6师团攻占蕲春（蕲州）。蕲春为田家镇以西沿江要地，失守后日军沿江西进浠水、黄冈。《武汉会战概述》记10月10日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《武汉会战概述》。 On 8 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division took Qichun (Qizhou), the riverside town west of Tianjiazhen. Its fall opened the advance west through Xishui and Huanggang. The Hubei campaign overview gives 10 October; that variant is noted.

fields.name: 第12集团军防守广州 12th Group Army Defends Guangzhou
fields.summary: 日军第21军在大亚湾登陆后进攻广州，第12集团军在增城、广州外围抵抗，广州于 10 月 21 日失守。 After landing at Daya Bay the Japanese 21st Army advanced on Guangzhou; the 12th Group Army resisted around Zengcheng and the city fell on 21 October.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 12 日，日军第21军在大亚湾登陆，沿广九铁路进攻广州。第12集团军（总司令余汉谋）在增城、广州外围抵抗，但兵力分散、准备不足，广州于 10 月 21 日失守。 日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 12 October 1938 the Japanese 21st Army landed at Daya Bay and advanced on Guangzhou along the Kowloon–Canton railway. The 12th Group Army under Yu Hanmou resisted around Zengcheng and the city’s outskirts, but with dispersed forces and insufficient preparation, Guangzhou fell on 21 October. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 日军登陆平海、稔山 Japanese Landing at Pinghai and Renshan
fields.place: 广东惠阳平海、稔山 Pinghai and Renshan, Huiyang, Guangdong

fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 12 日凌晨，日军第 104 师团在大亚湾右面、平海碧甲（毕甲）玻璃沙厂北面海岸登陆，当天占平海，13 日占稔山、吉隆，随后向平山、惠州南面推进。登陆点据《广州战役》与惠州地方史，待页码级核对。 Before dawn on 12 October 1938 the Japanese 104th Division landed on the right flank of Dayawan, on the coast north of the Biji glassworks at Pinghai. It took Pinghai the same day and Renshan and Jilong on 13 October, then advanced toward Pingshan and the south of Huizhou. The landing site follows Guangzhou campaign and Huizhou local histories and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 日军登陆盐灶背 Japanese Landing at Yanzaobei
fields.place: 广东惠阳盐灶背 Yanzaobei, Huiyang, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军及川支队在盐灶背南岸登陆。 The Japanese Oikawa Detachment landed on the south bank at Yanzaobei.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 12 日凌晨，日军及川支队在大亚湾盐灶背南岸登陆，随后经稔山、平山方向配合主力进攻惠州。登陆点据《广州战役》与惠州地方史，待页码级核对。 Before dawn on 12 October 1938 the Japanese Oikawa Detachment landed on the south bank at Yanzaobei in Dayawan and advanced via Renshan and Pingshan in support of the main attack on Huizhou. The landing site follows Guangzhou campaign and Huizhou local histories and awaits page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: Japanese Landing at Aotou and Xiachong

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团主力在澳头以东马涌至霞涌以西桂米涌海滩登陆。
summary.en: The main force of the Japanese 18th Division landed on the beach from Mayong east of Aotou to Guimiyong west of Xiachong.

fields.name: 日军登陆澳头、霞涌 Japanese Landing at Aotou and Xiachong
fields.place: 广东惠阳澳头、霞涌 Aotou and Xiachong, Huiyang, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团主力在澳头以东马涌至霞涌以西桂米涌海滩登陆。 The main force of the Japanese 18th Division landed on the beach from Mayong east of Aotou to Guimiyong west of Xiachong.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 12 日凌晨 2 时 45 分，日军第 18 师团主力在大亚湾中路、澳头圩以东 5 公里的马涌至霞涌墟以西桂米涌之间七八公里长的沙滩登陆；一部在澳头西南约 5 公里的倒装湾小桂登陆。当天进攻淡水，13 日占淡水。登陆点据《广州战役》与惠州地方史，待页码级核对。 At 02:45 on 12 October 1938 the main force of the Japanese 18th Division landed on the 7–8 km beach between Mayong, 5 km east of Aotou, and Guimiyong, west of Xiachong, in the central Dayawan sector; another element landed at Xiaogui in Daozhuang Bay about 5 km southwest of Aotou. It attacked Danshui that day and took it on 13 October. The landing sites follow Guangzhou campaign and Huizhou local histories and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1938年10月12日，日军第3、第10师团攻占信阳。
summary.en: On 12 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions captured Xinyang.

fields.name: 信阳沦陷 Fall of Xinyang
fields.summary: 1938年10月12日，日军第3、第10师团攻占信阳。 On 12 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions captured Xinyang.
fields.description: 1938年10月2日，日军第3、第10师团合攻信阳；11日胡宗南、孙连仲两部在柳林镇附近夹击日军第10师团，歼敌2000余人；12日胡宗南部因伤亡甚重放弃信阳。信阳失守后，日军完全控制豫南，与豫东、皖西连成一片，形成合围武汉之势。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《河南的抗战历程》。 On 2 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions attacked Xinyang. On the 11th Hu Zongnan and Sun Lianzhong’s forces ambushed the 10th Division near Liulin, killing more than 2,000, but on the 12th Hu’s badly mauled troops abandoned Xinyang. Its fall gave the Japanese full control of southern Henan and linked them with eastern Henan and western Anhui in the encirclement of Wuhan.

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团占领淡水。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division occupied Danshui.

fields.name: 淡水沦陷 Fall of Danshui
fields.place: 广东惠阳淡水 Danshui, Huiyang, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团占领淡水。 The Japanese 18th Division occupied Danshui.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 12 日日军在澳头、霞涌登陆后，经新桥、分墩、大径进攻淡水；13 日凌晨占领淡水城。中国守军第 151 师一部抵抗后向惠州方向撤退。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。 After landing at Aotou and Xiachong on 12 October 1938, Japanese forces advanced on Danshui via Xinqiao, Fendun and Dajing and occupied the town in the early hours of 13 October. Part of the Chinese 151st Division resisted and then withdrew toward Huizhou. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 18、第 104 师团攻占惠州。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th and 104th Divisions captured Huizhou.

fields.name: 惠州沦陷 Fall of Huizhou
fields.summary: 日军第 18、第 104 师团攻占惠州。 The Japanese 18th and 104th Divisions captured Huizhou.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 13 日日军自淡水、澳头、稔山三路进攻惠州，14 日占领横沥并进至惠州南郊。14 日黄昏日军攻城，中国守军第 151 师稍作抵抗后撤退，15 日惠州失陷。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。 On 13 October 1938 Japanese forces advanced on Huizhou from Danshui, Aotou and Renshan by three routes, took Hengli on 14 October and reached the southern outskirts. At dusk on 14 October they attacked the city; the Chinese 151st Division resisted briefly and withdrew, and Huizhou fell on 15 October. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Boluo and pushed on toward Zengcheng.

fields.name: 博罗沦陷 Fall of Boluo
fields.summary: 日军攻占博罗，主力向增城突进。 Japanese forces captured Boluo and pushed on toward Zengcheng.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 16 日，日军攻占博罗，随后主力沿增博公路向增城突进；及川支队由惠州向广州作大迂回。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。 On 16 October 1938 Japanese forces captured Boluo and then pushed along the Boluo–Zengcheng road toward Zengcheng, while the Oikawa Detachment made a wide flanking move from Huizhou toward Guangzhou. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 浠水沦陷 Fall of Xishui
fields.summary: 1938年10月17日，日军第6师团攻占浠水县城。 On 17 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division captured Xishui.
fields.description: 1938年10月17日日军第6师团攻占浠水县城，随后向巴河、团风、黄陂推进。《武汉会战概述》记10月19/21日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《武汉会战概述》。 On 17 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division took Xishui and advanced toward Bahe, Tuanfeng and Huangpi. The Hubei campaign overview gives 19/21 October; that variant is noted.

summary.zh: 1938年10月18日，日军波田支队攻占阳新。
summary.en: On 18 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment captured Yangxin.

fields.name: 阳新沦陷 Fall of Yangxin
fields.summary: 1938年10月18日，日军波田支队攻占阳新。 On 18 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment captured Yangxin.
fields.description: 1938年10月18日日军波田支队攻占阳新。阳新为鄂东南门户，失守后日军分兵北趋大冶、鄂城，西攻咸宁。《中国抗日战争全史》记10月22日阳新、大冶、鄂城相继失守，正文并列。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 On 18 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment took Yangxin, the gateway to southeastern Hubei. The Japanese then drove north toward Daye and Echeng and west toward Xianning. The campaign history gives 22 October for Yangxin, Daye and Echeng; that variant is noted.

summary.en: On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division captured Daye.

fields.name: 大冶沦陷 Fall of Daye
fields.summary: 1938年10月19日，日军波田支队、第9师团攻占大冶。 On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division captured Daye.
fields.description: 1938年10月19日日军波田支队、第9师团攻占大冶。大冶铁矿为日军重要掠夺目标，失守后日军继续北趋鄂城、黄石港。《小界岭战役》记10月22日，正文并列。日期据《武汉会战概述》与《小界岭战役》。 On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division took Daye, whose iron mines were an important Japanese prize. The Japanese then moved north toward Echeng and Huangshigang. The Xiaojieling account gives 22 October; that variant is noted.

summary.en: On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division captured Echeng.

fields.name: 鄂城沦陷 Fall of Echeng
fields.summary: 1938年10月19日，日军波田支队、第9师团攻占鄂城。 On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division captured Echeng.
fields.description: 1938年10月19日日军波田支队、第9师团攻占鄂城（今鄂州）。鄂城为武昌东面屏障，失守后日军进抵葛店，逼近武昌。鄂州市档案记10月23日沦陷，正文并列。日期据《武汉会战概述》与鄂州市政府《1938年，不能忘却的鄂城记忆》。 On 19 October 1938 the Japanese Wada detachment and 9th Division took Echeng (modern Ezhou), the eastern shield of Wuchang. The Japanese then reached Gedian and closed on Wuchang. The Ezhou municipal archive gives 23 October; that variant is noted.

summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division captured Zengcheng.

fields.name: 增城沦陷 Fall of Zengcheng
fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团攻占增城。 The Japanese 18th Division captured Zengcheng.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 19 日日军第 18 师团到达增城，与中国守军激战；20 日突破第 186 师防线，10 时占领增城以西钟岗，14 时增城县城失守。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。 On 19 October 1938 the Japanese 18th Division reached Zengcheng and fought the Chinese defenders; on 20 October it broke the 186th Division’s line, took Zhonggang west of the county town at 10:00 and the county town itself at 14:00. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 20 October 1938 the Japanese captured Huangshigang.

fields.name: 黄石港沦陷 Fall of Huangshigang
fields.summary: 1938年10月20日，日军攻占黄石港。 On 20 October 1938 the Japanese captured Huangshigang.
fields.description: 1938年10月20日日军攻占黄石港，沿江向西攻击。此前中国第82、第93师在西塞山、道士洑、石灰窑一线阻击13昼夜，伤亡4300余人。日期据《武汉会战概述》与黄石市文旅局《抗战中的黄石阻击战》。 On 20 October 1938 the Japanese took Huangshigang and pushed west along the river. The Chinese 82nd and 93rd Divisions had held the Xisaishan–Daoshifu–Shihuiyao line for thirteen days, suffering more than 4,300 casualties.

name.en: Eight Women of the Wusihun River

place.zh: 吉林勃利刁翎（今黑龙江林口）乌斯浑河

summary.zh: 1938年10月20日，东北抗联第五军妇女团指导员冷云等8名女战士在乌斯浑河畔掩护部队突围，弹尽后投江殉国。
summary.en: On 20 October 1938 eight women of the 5th Army’s women’s regiment, led by Leng Yun, covered a breakout by the Wusihun River and drowned themselves when their ammunition ran out.

fields.name: 八女投江 Eight Women of the Wusihun River
fields.place: 吉林勃利刁翎（今黑龙江林口）乌斯浑河 Wusihun River, Diaoling (modern Linkou), Jilin
fields.summary: 1938年10月20日，东北抗联第五军妇女团指导员冷云等8名女战士在乌斯浑河畔掩护部队突围，弹尽后投江殉国。 On 20 October 1938 eight women of the 5th Army’s women’s regiment, led by Leng Yun, covered a breakout by the Wusihun River and drowned themselves when their ammunition ran out.
fields.description: 1938 年夏，东北抗联第四、第五军主力由依兰一带西征，妇女团随第五军第一师行动；8 月在苇河遭日伪军重兵围堵，第一师仅余百余人，被迫折返牡丹江下游刁翎地区。10 月 19 日夜，队伍抵乌斯浑河畔（今林口县刁翎镇三家子村西北），因河水暴涨露营，被特务告密；20 日拂晓，日伪军千余人包围。第五军妇女团政治指导员冷云率班长胡秀芝、杨贵珍，战士郭桂琴、黄桂清、王惠民、李凤善及第四军被服厂厂长安顺福共 8 人，主动从侧后开火吸引敌军，掩护主力突围。战至弹尽，8 人砸毁枪支，互相搀扶涉入乌斯浑河，全部殉国；冷云 23 岁，王惠民 13 岁。日期异说：黑龙江日报据林口县于春芳考证记为 10 月 20 日，新华社 2024 年报道作 10 月上旬，解放军报 2025 年报道作 10 月下旬；本事件取 10 月 20 日。1939 年伪满始设林口县，此前该地属勃利县。本事件不绘路线。 In the summer of 1938 the main forces of the 4th and 5th Armies set out westward from the Yilan area, with the women’s regiment accompanying the 5th Army’s 1st Division; surrounded by strong Japanese and puppet forces at Weihe in August, the division was reduced to little more than a hundred men and turned back toward the Diaoling area on the lower Mudan River. On the night of 19 October the column reached the Wusihun River (north-west of Sanjiazi village, modern Diaoling, Linkou) and camped because the river was in flood; an informer betrayed them and over a thousand Japanese and puppet troops surrounded the camp at dawn on the 20th. Leng Yun, political instructor of the 5th Army’s women’s regiment, with squad leaders Hu Xiuzhi and Yang Guizhen, the soldiers Guo Guiqin, Huang Guiqing, Wang Huimin and Li Fengshan, and An Shunfu, head of the 4th Army’s clothing workshop — eight women in all — opened fire from the flank to draw the enemy and cover the breakout. When their ammunition ran out they smashed their rifles and, supporting each other, walked into the river and drowned. Leng Yun was 23, the youngest, Wang Huimin, 13. The date is disputed: the Heilongjiang Daily account based on Yu Chunfang’s research gives 20 October, a 2024 Xinhua report gives early October and a 2025 PLA Daily report late October; this entry follows 20 October. Linkou county was only created by the puppet state in 1939; before that the area belonged to Boli county. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 日军在广东大亚湾登陆后迅速推进，占领广州，华南门户失守。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at Daya Bay in Guangdong and quickly captured Guangzhou, opening the gateway to South China.

fields.name: 广州失守 Fall of Guangzhou
fields.summary: 日军在广东大亚湾登陆后迅速推进，占领广州，华南门户失守。 Japanese forces landed at Daya Bay in Guangdong and quickly captured Guangzhou, opening the gateway to South China.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月，日军在广东大亚湾登陆，沿公路向广州推进。10 月 21 日广州失守，中国南方重要港口与对外通道被日军控制。 本事件日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 In October 1938, Japanese forces landed at Daya Bay in Guangdong and advanced along roads toward Guangzhou. The city fell on 21 October, placing an important southern port and external supply route under Japanese control. Date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.summary: 日军第 104 师团占领从化，切断广州至韶关联系。 The Japanese 104th Division occupied Conghua, cutting the Guangzhou–Shaoguan link.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 21 日广州失守后，日军第 104 师团向广州以北推进，攻占太平场，23 日占领从化，企图切断广州至韶关的联系。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。 After the fall of Guangzhou on 21 October 1938, the Japanese 104th Division advanced north of the city, took Taipingchang and occupied Conghua on 23 October, aiming to cut the Guangzhou–Shaoguan link. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 虎门要塞沦陷 Fall of the Humen Forts
fields.place: 广东东莞虎门 Humen, Dongguan, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第 5 师团与海军攻占虎门要塞。 The Japanese 5th Division and navy captured the Humen forts.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 23 日，日军第 5 师团与海军配合攻占虎门要塞，控制珠江口。虎门失守后，日军沿珠江口西进，25 日占三水、26 日占佛山。日期据《广州战役》，待页码级核对。 On 23 October 1938 the Japanese 5th Division and navy captured the Humen forts and controlled the Pearl River estuary. After Humen fell, Japanese forces advanced west along the estuary, taking Sanshui on 25 October and Foshan on 26 October. The date follows the Guangzhou campaign history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 黄冈沦陷 Fall of Huanggang
fields.summary: 1938年10月23日，日军第6师团、第116师团攻占黄冈（黄州）。 On 23 October 1938 the Japanese 6th and 116th Divisions captured Huanggang (Huangzhou).
fields.description: 1938年10月23日日军第6师团、第116师团攻占黄冈（黄州）。黄冈为鄂东行政中心，失守后日军沿黄陂—汉口公路西进。《武汉会战概述》记10月22日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《武汉会战概述》。 On 23 October 1938 the Japanese 6th and 116th Divisions took Huanggang (Huangzhou), the administrative centre of eastern Hubei. The Japanese then advanced west along the Huangpi–Hankou road. The Hubei campaign overview gives 22 October; that variant is noted.

fields.description: 1938年10月23日日军攻占团风。团风为长江北岸渡口，失守后日军进逼阳逻、黄陂。《武汉会战概述》记10月20日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《武汉会战概述》。 On 23 October 1938 the Japanese took Tuanfeng, a ferry crossing on the north bank of the Yangtze, and closed on Yangluo and Huangpi. The Hubei campaign overview gives 20 October; that variant is noted.

fields.description: 1938年10月24日晚日军第6师团攻占黄陂，直抵汉口东北郊。黄陂失守后，武汉三镇已陷入东、北、南三面包围。日期据《武汉会战概述》与人民网《武汉会战和广州作战》。 On the night of 24 October 1938 the Japanese 6th Division took Huangpi and reached the northeastern outskirts of Hankou. With its fall Wuhan was encircled from east, north and south.

summary.zh: 武汉会战后日军占领武汉，抗日战争进入战略相持阶段。
summary.en: After the Battle of Wuhan, Japanese forces captured the city, and the war entered a phase of strategic stalemate.

fields.name: 武汉失守 Fall of Wuhan 武汉会战 Battle of Wuhan 武汉保卫战 Defense of Wuhan
fields.summary: 武汉会战后日军占领武汉，抗日战争进入战略相持阶段。 After the Battle of Wuhan, Japanese forces captured the city, and the war entered a phase of strategic stalemate.
fields.description: 1938 年 6 月起，日军沿长江南北进攻武汉。中国军队组织武汉会战，激战数月后于 10 月撤出。10 月 25 日武汉失守，国民政府机关此前已迁往重庆，抗日战争逐步进入战略相持阶段。 本事件为路线相关节点，日期与表述待史料校订。 From June 1938, Japanese forces advanced on Wuhan from both sides of the Yangtze. Chinese troops fought the Battle of Wuhan for months before withdrawing in October. Wuhan fell on 25 October; government organs had already moved to Chongqing, and the war gradually entered a phase of strategic stalemate. This event is linked to route segments; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 1938年10月25日，日军第13、第16师团越过大别山，攻占麻城。
summary.en: On 25 October 1938 the Japanese 13th and 16th Divisions crossed the Dabie Mountains and captured Macheng.

fields.name: 麻城沦陷 Fall of Macheng
fields.summary: 1938年10月25日，日军第13、第16师团越过大别山，攻占麻城。 On 25 October 1938 the Japanese 13th and 16th Divisions crossed the Dabie Mountains and captured Macheng.
fields.description: 1938年10月25日日军第13、第16师团越过大别山，攻占麻城。麻城为鄂东北重镇，失守后日军沿宋埠、黄安、河口镇向武汉推进。《武汉会战概述》记10月24日，正文并列。日期据《小界岭战役》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 On 25 October 1938 the Japanese 13th and 16th Divisions crossed the Dabie Mountains and took Macheng, the key town of northeastern Hubei. The Japanese then advanced via Songbu, Huang’an and Hekou toward Wuhan. The Hubei campaign overview gives 24 October; that variant is noted.

summary.zh: 日军占领佛山，控制广三铁路沿线。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Foshan and controlled the Guangzhou–Sanshui railway.

fields.name: 佛山沦陷 Fall of Foshan
fields.summary: 日军占领佛山，控制广三铁路沿线。 Japanese forces occupied Foshan and controlled the Guangzhou–Sanshui railway.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月 26 日，日军占领南海县澜石、佛山两镇，佛山沦陷。日军随后控制广三铁路沿线与珠江三角洲要点。日期据佛山地方史，待页码级核对。 On 26 October 1938 Japanese forces occupied Lanshi and Foshan in Nanhai county, and Foshan fell. Japan then controlled the Guangzhou–Sanshui railway and key points in the Pearl River Delta. The date follows Foshan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领顺德，控制珠江三角洲南部。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Shunde and controlled the southern Pearl River Delta.

fields.name: 顺德沦陷 Fall of Shunde
fields.summary: 日军占领顺德，控制珠江三角洲南部。 Japanese forces occupied Shunde and controlled the southern Pearl River Delta.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军向珠江三角洲推进，10 月 23 日进攻陈村，26 日前后占领顺德各属。顺德县治大良此后多次易手，1940 年 2 月 29 日再度沦陷。日期据顺德地方史，待页码级核对。 After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, Japanese forces advanced into the Pearl River Delta, attacking Chencun on 23 October and occupying Shunde’s towns around 26 October. The county seat Daliang changed hands repeatedly and fell again on 29 February 1940. The date follows Shunde local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军占领番禺，控制广州南部与珠江航道。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Panyu and controlled southern Guangzhou and the Pearl River channels.

fields.name: 番禺沦陷 Fall of Panyu
fields.summary: 日军占领番禺，控制广州南部与珠江航道。 Japanese forces occupied Panyu and controlled southern Guangzhou and the Pearl River channels.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军第 21 军一部占领番禺，控制广州南部与珠江航道。11 月日军在番禺沙湾、石楼等地“扫荡”。日期据广州战役与番禺地方史，待页码级核对。 After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, elements of the Japanese 21st Army occupied Panyu and controlled southern Guangzhou and the Pearl River channels. In November Japanese forces conducted sweeps at Shawan and Shilou in Panyu. The date follows Guangzhou campaign and Panyu local histories and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年10月27日，德安沦陷。
summary.en: On 27 October 1938 De'an fell.

fields.name: 德安沦陷 Fall of De'an
fields.summary: 1938年10月27日，德安沦陷。 On 27 October 1938 De'an fell.
fields.description: 10月27日，日军攻占德安。德安位于南浔铁路中段，是万家岭战役的核心地区；日军第106师团在万家岭遭中国军队重创后，主力仍于10月底攻占德安。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与央广网江西抗战专题，待页码级核对。 On 27 October Japanese forces captured De'an. On the central section of the Nanchang–Jiujiang railway, De'an was at the heart of the Wanjialing battle; the Japanese 106th Division was mauled at Wanjialing, but the main force still took De'an in late October. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the CNR Jiangxi campaign feature and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年10月27日，日军第16师团攻占黄安（今红安）。
summary.en: On 27 October 1938 the Japanese 16th Division captured Huang’an (modern Hong’an).

fields.name: 黄安沦陷 Fall of Huang’an
fields.summary: 1938年10月27日，日军第16师团攻占黄安（今红安）。 On 27 October 1938 the Japanese 16th Division captured Huang’an (modern Hong’an).
fields.description: 1938年10月27日日军第16师团笠井骑兵部队攻占黄安（今红安）。黄安为鄂东北门户，失守后日军进逼河口镇、黄陂。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与《抗战史记·武汉会战（下）》。 On 27 October 1938 the Japanese 16th Division’s Kasai cavalry unit took Huang’an (modern Hong’an), the gateway to northeastern Hubei, and closed on Hekou and Huangpi. Both cited accounts give 27 October.

summary.zh: 1938年10月28日，东流沦陷。
summary.en: On 28 October 1938 Dongliu fell.

fields.name: 东流沦陷 Fall of Dongliu
fields.summary: 1938年10月28日，东流沦陷。 On 28 October 1938 Dongliu fell.
fields.description: 10月28日，东流（今属东至县）与贵池同日沦陷。日军沿长江南岸西进，配合进攻武汉。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记（二）》，待页码级核对。 Dongliu (now part of Dongzhi county) fell on 28 October together with Guichi. Japanese forces advanced west along the south bank of the Yangtze in support of the Wuhan campaign. The date follows the second part of the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年10月28日，贵池沦陷。
summary.en: On 28 October 1938 Guichi fell.

fields.name: 贵池沦陷 Fall of Guichi
fields.summary: 1938年10月28日，贵池沦陷。 On 28 October 1938 Guichi fell.
fields.description: 10月28日，贵池沦陷。贵池位于长江南岸，是日军由安庆西进、控制皖江航道的重要据点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记（二）》，待页码级核对。 Guichi fell on 28 October. On the south bank of the Yangtze, it was an important base for the Japanese advance west from Anqing and for controlling the Anhui section of the river. The date follows the second part of the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立
name.en: Establishment of the Puppet Anhui Provincial Government

summary.zh: 1938年10月28日，伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立。
summary.en: On 28 October 1938 the puppet Anhui provincial government was established in Bengbu.

fields.name: 伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立 Establishment of the Puppet Anhui Provincial Government
fields.summary: 1938年10月28日，伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立。 On 28 October 1938 the puppet Anhui provincial government was established in Bengbu.
fields.description: 1938年6月12日，伪南京维新政府任命倪道烺为安徽省长；10月28日，伪安徽省政府在蚌埠正式成立。此后伪省府、伪省党部及日军特务机关均设蚌埠，蚌埠成为日军在安徽的统治中心。政治事件，不绘路线。 On 12 June 1938 the puppet Nanjing Reformed Government appointed Ni Daolang governor of Anhui; on 28 October the puppet provincial government was formally established in Bengbu. The puppet provincial government, party headquarters and Japanese special agency were all based there, making Bengbu the centre of Japanese rule in Anhui. This political event is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1938年10月29日，日军第27师团攻占咸宁县城。
summary.en: On 29 October 1938 the Japanese 27th Division captured Xianning.

fields.name: 咸宁沦陷 Fall of Xianning
fields.summary: 1938年10月29日，日军第27师团攻占咸宁县城。 On 29 October 1938 the Japanese 27th Division captured Xianning.
fields.description: 1938年10月29日日军第27师团攻占咸宁县城。咸宁为粤汉铁路要地，失守后日军沿铁路南下崇阳、通城，切断粤汉线。日期据咸宁日报《不容抹杀的滔天罪行》与维基百科《咸宁市》。 On 29 October 1938 the Japanese 27th Division took Xianning, a key point on the Canton–Hankou railway. The Japanese then moved south through Chongyang and Tongcheng, cutting the railway. Both cited accounts give 29 October.

summary.zh: 1938年10月30日，日军第3、第10师团攻占应城。
summary.en: On 30 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions captured Yingcheng.

fields.name: 应城沦陷 Fall of Yingcheng
fields.summary: 1938年10月30日，日军第3、第10师团攻占应城。 On 30 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions captured Yingcheng.
fields.description: 1938年10月30日日军第3、第10师团攻占应城。日军自应山、安陆、云梦、应城向汉阳、汉口迂回，应城失守后切断了中国第5战区向西撤退的通道。日期据《抗战史记·武汉会战（下）》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 On 30 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions took Yingcheng. Advancing via Yingshan, Anlu, Yunmeng and Yingcheng toward Hanyang and Hankou, the Japanese cut the Fifth War Zone’s westward withdrawal route.

summary.zh: 新3军在湖北崇阳作战失利，随后转往赣北。
summary.en: The New 3rd Army was defeated at Chongyang in Hubei and then moved to northern Jiangxi.

fields.name: 新3军参加崇阳战斗 New 3rd Army at Chongyang
fields.summary: 新3军在湖北崇阳作战失利，随后转往赣北。 The New 3rd Army was defeated at Chongyang in Hubei and then moved to northern Jiangxi.
fields.description: 1938 年 11 月，新3军在湖北崇阳地区与日军作战失利，随后转往赣北、湘北，隶属第9战区，参加后续长沙会战。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In November 1938 the New 3rd Army was defeated by Japanese forces around Chongyang in Hubei. It then moved to northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan under the 9th War Zone and fought in later Changsha campaigns. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日本提出建立“东亚新秩序”，公开否定九国公约体系。
summary.en: Japan proclaimed a “New Order in East Asia,” openly rejecting the Washington treaty system.

fields.name: 日本提出“东亚新秩序” Japan’s “New Order in East Asia”
fields.summary: 日本提出建立“东亚新秩序”，公开否定九国公约体系。 Japan proclaimed a “New Order in East Asia,” openly rejecting the Washington treaty system.
fields.description: 1938 年 11 月 3 日，日本近卫内阁发表第二次声明，提出建立“东亚新秩序”，声称日本、伪满、中国应相互结合，公开否定华盛顿体系下的门户开放原则。该声明为汪精卫投日后的对华政策定调。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 3 November 1938 the second Konoe cabinet issued a statement proclaiming a “New Order in East Asia,” asserting that Japan, Manchukuo and China should be closely linked and openly rejecting the Open Door principle of the Washington system. The statement set the framework for Japan’s China policy after Wang Jingwei’s defection. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年11月3日，日军第9师团一部占领嘉鱼县城。
summary.en: On 3 November 1938 a detachment of the Japanese 9th Division occupied Jiayu.

fields.name: 嘉鱼沦陷 Fall of Jiayu
fields.summary: 1938年11月3日，日军第9师团一部占领嘉鱼县城。 On 3 November 1938 a detachment of the Japanese 9th Division occupied Jiayu.
fields.description: 1938年11月1日，日军第9师团骑兵第9联队与步兵第19联队自鄂南进犯嘉鱼。11月2日，中国守军第55师炮兵第9团在五里牌、十井铺阻击两日，毙敌50余名，3日晚南撤，日军占领嘉鱼县城并随即建立伪政权。日军进城前四日曾派飞机轰炸县城，在龙潭山、凤凰山投弹20余枚。日期取《咸宁日报》市委党史研究室稿与《嘉鱼网》；《中华民族抗日编年》与观察者网记11月4日，异说并存。 On 1 November 1938 the Japanese 9th Division’s 9th Cavalry Regiment and 19th Infantry Regiment advanced on Jiayu from southern Hubei. On 2 November the Chinese 55th Division’s 9th Artillery Regiment fought a two-day delaying action at Wulipai and Shijingpu, killing over 50 Japanese, before withdrawing south on the night of the 3rd; the Japanese then occupied the county town and set up a puppet administration. Four days before entering, Japanese aircraft had bombed the town, dropping over 20 bombs on Longtan Hill and Fenghuang Hill. The Shanxi–Hubei party history office gives 3 November; the Chinese chronicle and Guancha give 4 November.

summary.zh: 1938年11月4日，日军第9师团攻占蒲圻县城。
summary.en: On 4 November 1938 the Japanese 9th Division captured Puqi.

fields.name: 蒲圻沦陷 Fall of Puqi
fields.summary: 1938年11月4日，日军第9师团攻占蒲圻县城。 On 4 November 1938 the Japanese 9th Division captured Puqi.
fields.description: 1938年10月28日，日军第9师团自贺胜桥沿粤汉铁路南犯，29日突破汀泗桥，30日占官塘驿，11月1日陷中伙铺。中国守军第128师王劲哉部在虎山、河龙滩一线顽强阻击，11月3日至4日在虎山与日军肉搏，全营大部殉国。4日，日军攻占蒲圻县城，中国守军于前一夜炸毁陆水河粤汉铁路桥后撤退。8日，羊楼洞失守，蒲圻全境沦陷。赤壁市史志办记为4日晚守军撤离、5日上午日军架浮桥入城；本批取4日。 On 28 October 1938 the Japanese 9th Division advanced south along the Canton–Hankou railway from Heshengqiao, breaking through Tiansi Bridge on the 29th, taking Guantangyi on the 30th and Zhonghuopu on 1 November. The Chinese 128th Division under Wang Jinzai fought stubbornly at Hushan and Helongtan; on 3–4 November its battalion at Hushan fought hand-to-hand and was largely wiped out. On the 4th the Japanese took Puqi, the Chinese having blown the Lunshui River railway bridge the night before. Yangloudong fell on the 8th, completing the occupation of the county. The Chibi local history office records the Chinese withdrawal on the night of the 4th and the Japanese pontoon entry on the morning of the 5th; this entry follows the 4th.

summary.zh: 1938年11月4日，日军铃木支队攻占通山县城。
summary.en: On 4 November 1938 the Japanese Suzuki detachment captured Tongshan.

fields.name: 通山沦陷 Fall of Tongshan
fields.summary: 1938年11月4日，日军铃木支队攻占通山县城。 On 4 November 1938 the Japanese Suzuki detachment captured Tongshan.
fields.description: 1938年10月26日日军攻入武汉后，一路经慈口、大畈南犯通山。10月31日，日军铃木支队（铃木春松）向通山县城发起进攻；11月4日通山县城沦陷。此前9、10月间，日机已六次轰炸通山县城，县城几成废墟，县政府被迫迁乡办公。日军占领后在县城至花桥、西坑、界首、大畈、慈口沿线和县城至寺下、南林桥一线设据点，并在南林桥设兵站。日期取《咸宁日报》市委党史研究室稿所引各县志与观察者网战史。 After taking Wuhan on 26 October 1938, one Japanese column advanced south on Tongshan via Cikou and Dafan. On 31 October the Suzuki (Suzuki Harumatsu) detachment attacked the county town, which fell on 4 November. Japanese aircraft had already bombed Tongshan six times in September and October, reducing much of the town to ruins and forcing the county government to relocate to the countryside. After occupation the Japanese established posts along the Tongshan–Huaqiao–Xikou–Jieshou–Dafan–Cikou line and the Tongshan–Sixia–Nanlinqiao line, with a supply station at Nanlinqiao.

fields.name: 崇阳沦陷 Fall of Chongyang
fields.summary: 1938年11月6日，日军第27师团攻占崇阳县城。 On 6 November 1938 the Japanese 27th Division captured Chongyang.
fields.description: 1938年11月6日13时，日军第27师团宫崎部队攻占崇阳县城。崇阳为武汉通长沙的公路要地，失守后日军继续南犯通城、岳阳。日期据咸宁日报《不容抹杀的滔天罪行》与崇阳县史志研究中心。 At 1 p.m. on 6 November 1938 the Japanese 27th Division’s Miyazaki unit took Chongyang, a key point on the Wuhan–Changsha road. The Japanese then pushed south toward Tongcheng and Yueyang. Both cited accounts give 6 November.

name.zh: 日本设立华北开发、华中振兴两会社
name.en: Establishment of the North China and Central China Development Companies

summary.zh: 日本设立华北开发、华中振兴两大会社，统制沦陷区经济。
summary.en: Japan established the North China and Central China development companies to control the occupied economies.

fields.name: 日本设立华北开发、华中振兴两会社 Establishment of the North China and Central China Development Companies
fields.summary: 日本设立华北开发、华中振兴两大会社，统制沦陷区经济。 Japan established the North China and Central China development companies to control the occupied economies.
fields.description: 1938 年 11 月 7 日，日本政府主导的华北开发株式会社与华中振兴株式会社先后成立（华北开发于同年 6 月设立、11 月召开总会；华中振兴 11 月 7 日在上海成立，日期有异说）。两社以“中日合办”名义统制华北、华中的交通、矿业、电力、通信等业，是日本掠夺沦陷区资源的核心机构。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 7 November 1938 the Japanese government’s North China Development Company and Central China Development Company were established (the North China company was incorporated in June and held its general meeting in November; the Central China company was founded in Shanghai on 7 November; dates vary). Under a “Sino-Japanese joint venture” formula they controlled transport, mining, electric power and communications in North and Central China and were central to Japan’s extraction of occupied resources. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年11月8日，日军第27师团宫崎部队攻占通城。
summary.en: On 8 November 1938 the Japanese 27th Division’s Miyazaki unit captured Tongcheng.

fields.name: 通城沦陷 Fall of Tongcheng
fields.summary: 1938年11月8日，日军第27师团宫崎部队攻占通城。 On 8 November 1938 the Japanese 27th Division’s Miyazaki unit captured Tongcheng.
fields.description: 1938年11月6日崇阳县城陷落后，日军第27师团留一部守崇阳，主力于7日由崇阳向通城追击，当晚突破石城一带防线。8日午后3时经桂口进攻大沙坪，当夜占领大沙坪，同日步兵第3联队宫崎富雄部队攻占通城县城。中国守军李仙洲部、甘丽初部在大沙坪一带布防，未能阻止日军。日期取《咸宁日报》市委党史研究室稿与《崇阳县史志研究中心》战局记述。 After Chongyang fell on 6 November 1938, the Japanese 27th Division left a garrison there and on the 7th pursued the Chinese towards Tongcheng, breaking the Shicheng line that night. At 3 p.m. on the 8th the Japanese attacked Dashaping via Guikou and took it that night, while the 3rd Infantry Regiment (Miyazaki Tomio) captured Tongcheng. Chinese forces under Li Xianzhou and Gan Lichu had deployed around Dashaping but could not hold. The 163.com account gives 9 November; this entry follows the two party-history sources.

summary.zh: 1938年11月15日，日军攻破聊城，范筑先殉国。
summary.en: On 15 November 1938 Japanese forces broke into Liaocheng; Fan Zhuxian died in the defence.

fields.name: 聊城沦陷 Fall of Liaocheng
fields.summary: 1938年11月15日，日军攻破聊城，范筑先殉国。 On 15 November 1938 Japanese forces broke into Liaocheng; Fan Zhuxian died in the defence.
fields.description: 11月14日至15日，日军分3路进犯鲁西北地区，聊城被围。范筑先率部与日军英勇战斗，终因敌众我寡，被日军攻破城门，范筑先等近700名将士壮烈殉国。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军进攻山东》，待页码级核对。 On 14–15 November Japanese forces advanced into northwestern Shandong in three columns and surrounded Liaocheng. Fan Zhuxian and his troops fought bravely but were overwhelmed; the gates were breached and Fan and nearly 700 officers and men died. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the provincial party history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: First Japanese Air Raid on Yan’an

summary.zh: 1938年11月20日，日机首次轰炸延安，此后至1941年共轰炸17次。
summary.en: On 20 November 1938 Japanese aircraft bombed Yan’an for the first time; by 1941 there had been seventeen raids.

fields.name: 日军首次轰炸延安 First Japanese Air Raid on Yan’an
fields.summary: 1938年11月20日，日机首次轰炸延安，此后至1941年共轰炸17次。 On 20 November 1938 Japanese aircraft bombed Yan’an for the first time; by 1941 there had been seventeen raids.
fields.description: 1938年11月20日中午，日机7架以梯次队形首次轰炸延安，此后21日再次轰炸。至1941年8月27日，日机先后轰炸延安17次，投弹1690枚，造成400余人死伤、1万余间房屋倒塌。日期据《不倒的宝塔》与《用史料还原日军轰炸延安真相》。 At midday on 20 November 1938 seven Japanese aircraft bombed Yan’an for the first time, and again on the 21st. By 27 August 1941 there had been seventeen raids, dropping 1,690 bombs, causing over 400 casualties and collapsing more than 10,000 rooms.

fields.name: 李延平牺牲 Death of Li Yanping
fields.place: 吉林珠河一面坡（今尚志）错草顶子 Cuocaodingzi near Yimianpo, Zhuhe (modern Shangzhi), Jilin
fields.summary: 1938年11月20日，抗联第四军军长李延平在珠河错草顶子宿营时被叛徒杀害，年35岁。 On 20 November 1938 Li Yanping, commander of the 4th Army, was murdered by traitors while encamped at Cuocaodingzi in Zhuhe; he was 35.
fields.description: 李延平 1903 年生于吉林延吉，1932 年参加王德林救国军，任补充团副官、作战参谋，1934 年加入中国共产党，同年冬赴莫斯科东方大学学习。1936 年回国后任东北抗日同盟军第四军代理军长兼第一师师长，1937 年 11 月任东北抗日联军第四军军长，率部在勃利、依兰、方正、宝清一带活动。1938 年 5 月起，第四、第五军主力西征五常、舒兰，试图打通与第十军和关内八路军的联系。西征部队损失惨重，7 月攻下楼山镇后分兵，李延平、王光宇率第四军主力和第五军第二师继续西进。10 月后部队仅余数十人，在五常、珠河一带坚持。11 月 20 日，李延平与副军长王光宇带 7 名战士在珠河县一面坡西南错草顶子宿营，队内彭子贵、冯国珍、苗喜春 3 人偷出李延平手枪，将李延平杀害、打伤王光宇后逃跑投敌。李延平年 35 岁。另一说：1938 年 10 月李延平在五常县南磨石顶子遭包围，身负重伤牺牲。本事件取 11 月 20 日，并存异说。本事件不绘路线。 Li Yanping, born at Yanji in Jilin in 1903, joined Wang Delin’s National Salvation Army in 1932 as an officer in the supplementary regiment, joined the Communist Party in 1934 and studied at the Oriental University in Moscow. Returning in 1936 he became acting commander of the 4th Army of the Northeast Anti-Japanese Allied Army and its 1st Division, and in November 1937 commander of the United Army’s 4th Army, operating around Boli, Yilan, Fangzheng and Baoqing. From May 1938 the 4th and 5th Armies marched west toward Wuchang and Shulan to link up with the 10th Army and the Eighth Route Army. The expedition suffered heavily; after taking Loushan in July it split, and Li and Wang Guangyu pushed on with the 4th Army and the 5th Army’s 2nd Division. By October only a few dozen men were left in the Wuchang–Zhuhe area. On 20 November Li and his deputy Wang Guangyu camped with seven men at Cuocaodingzi south-west of Yimianpo in Zhuhe county, where three of the party — Peng Zigui, Feng Guozhen and Miao Xichun — stole Li’s pistol, killed him and wounded Wang before deserting. Li was 35. Another account has him mortally wounded when surrounded at Moshidingzi in Wuchang in October 1938; this entry follows 20 November and notes the variant. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1938年11月22日，日军攻陷宿迁城（通行说法）。
summary.en: On 22 November 1938 Japanese forces captured Suqian (common account).

fields.name: 宿迁沦陷 Fall of Suqian
fields.summary: 1938年11月22日，日军攻陷宿迁城（通行说法）。 On 22 November 1938 Japanese forces captured Suqian (common account).
fields.description: 11月20日，日军约3000人在飞机、坦克配合下沿宿睢公路东犯，进攻宿迁；11月22日宿城陷落（通行说法），日军进城后屠杀居民，宿城惨案清理尸体4000余具。宿迁沦陷日期另有「11月下旬」说，正文并列。 On 20 November about 3,000 Japanese troops with aircraft and tanks advanced east along the Suqian–Suining road and attacked Suqian. The city fell on 22 November in the common account; Japanese troops then massacred residents, and more than 4,000 bodies were recovered after the Suqian massacre. Some sources say only "late November"; both are noted.

fields.name: 宝安（深圳）第一次沦陷 First Fall of Bao’an (Shenzhen)
fields.place: 广东宝安南头（今深圳） Nantou, Bao’an (present-day Shenzhen), Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第一次占领宝安南头、深圳镇。 Japanese forces occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town for the first time.
fields.description: 1938 年 11 月 22 日，日军在大鹏湾登陆，随后东路由盐田、龙岗、沙头角直扑深圳镇，西路自虎门在沙井、西乡登岸进攻南头。11 月 26 日，日军占领深圳镇与南头城。11 月 30 日中国军队收复深圳镇，12 月 2 日收复宝安。日期据《深圳通史》，待页码级核对。 On 22 November 1938 Japanese forces landed at Dapeng Bay; the eastern column advanced via Yantian, Longgang and Shatoujiao toward Shenzhen town, while the western column landed at Shajing and Xixiang from Humen and attacked Nantou. On 26 November Japanese troops occupied Shenzhen town and Nantou. Chinese forces recovered Shenzhen on 30 November and Bao’an on 2 December. The date follows the Shenzhen History and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 铜陵沦陷 Fall of Tongling
fields.summary: 1938年11月26日，铜陵沦陷。 On 26 November 1938 Tongling fell.
fields.description: 11月26日，日军攻陷铜陵；11月29日，日军宣布封锁长江。铜陵是皖江重要的铜矿和沿江据点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记（二）》，待页码级核对。 On 26 November Japanese forces took Tongling; on 29 November Japan announced the blockade of the Yangtze. Tongling was an important copper-mining and riverine base in Anhui. The date follows the second part of the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 桂林“一二·二”大轰炸 Guilin Bombing of 2 December
fields.summary: 1938年12月2日，日机21架轰炸桂林，市民死伤1000余人。 On 2 December 1938 twenty-one Japanese aircraft bombed Guilin, causing over 1,000 civilian casualties.
fields.description: 1938年12月2日，日机21架轰炸桂林，投弹70余枚，燃烧半天，市民死伤1000余人。1938年11月30日至12月底，日机四次大空袭桂林，共出动108架次、投弹300多枚，毁房3500多间，炸死炸伤平民近300人，万余人无家可归。日期据《空劫深重的1938年》与《论日军对桂林的轰炸》。 On 2 December 1938 twenty-one Japanese aircraft bombed Guilin, dropping over 70 bombs; fires burned for half a day and over 1,000 civilians were killed or wounded. Between 30 November and the end of December 1938 four large raids employed 108 sorties and over 300 bombs, destroying more than 3,500 houses, killing or wounding nearly 300 civilians and leaving over 10,000 homeless.

fields.name: 琼崖抗日独立队成立 Establishment of the Qiongya Independent Detachment

fields.summary: 琼崖红军游击队改编为抗日独立队，冯白驹任队长。 The Qiongya Red Army guerrillas were reorganized as an anti-Japanese independent detachment under Feng Baiju.
fields.description: 1938 年 12 月 5 日，琼崖工农红军游击队在海南琼山云龙改编为广东民众抗日自卫团第十四区独立队，冯白驹任队长。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为建军建制，不绘制行军路线。 On December 5, 1938, the Qiongya Workers’ and Peasants’ Red Army guerrillas were reorganized at Yunlong, Qiongshan, Hainan, as the Independent Detachment of the 14th District of the Guangdong People’s Anti-Japanese Self-Defense Corps, with Feng Baiju as commander. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. This is a force-formation event; no march route is drawn.

name.en: Establishment of the Kōain (Asia Development Board)

summary.zh: 日本设立兴亚院，统一管理在华占领区的政治、经济事务。
summary.en: Japan established the Kōain to centralize political and economic administration of its occupied areas in China.

fields.name: 兴亚院成立 Establishment of the Kōain (Asia Development Board)
fields.summary: 日本设立兴亚院，统一管理在华占领区的政治、经济事务。 Japan established the Kōain to centralize political and economic administration of its occupied areas in China.
fields.description: 1938 年 12 月 16 日，日本设立兴亚院，作为内阁直属机构，统一指导在华占领区的政治、经济和文化事务，并在北平、上海、汉口等地设联络部。兴亚院成立标志着日本对华殖民统治机构化。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 16 December 1938 Japan established the Kōain as a cabinet-level body to coordinate political, economic and cultural affairs in its occupied areas in China, with liaison offices in Beiping, Shanghai and Hankou. Its creation marked the institutionalization of Japan’s colonial rule in China. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年12月20日，吉林中国国民救国军总司令王德林在山东沂水病逝，年64岁。
summary.en: On 20 December 1938 Wang Delin, commander of the Jilin National Salvation Army, died of illness at Yishui in Shandong; he was 64.

fields.name: 王德林病逝 Death of Wang Delin
fields.summary: 1938年12月20日，吉林中国国民救国军总司令王德林在山东沂水病逝，年64岁。 On 20 December 1938 Wang Delin, commander of the Jilin National Salvation Army, died of illness at Yishui in Shandong; he was 64.
fields.description: 王德林 1874 年（一说 1875）生于山东沂水，早年闯关东，1917 年所部编为吉林军第一旅第三营，驻延吉，俗称「老三营」。1932 年 2 月 8 日在延吉小城子成立吉林中国国民救国军，任总司令，提出「不分党派，共同一致对外」；1933 年 1 月 13 日兵败退入苏联，经欧洲回国，奔走于上海、天津、郑州等地继续抗日救亡，并把在关内募得的 8000 元交给东北抗日部队。1937 年七七事变后回到山东沂水，组织地方抗日武装，出任光复军第二路指挥；1938 年 12 月 20 日因病情恶化在沂水去世，年 64 岁。1939 年 2 月 4 日，延安《解放》周刊发表悼念文章，称「丧失这位民族英雄，实乃我中华民族的一个损失」。本事件不绘路线。 Wang Delin was born at Yishui in Shandong in 1874 (some sources say 1875), went to Manchuria as a young man, and in 1917 his unit became the 3rd Battalion of the 1st Brigade of the Jilin Army, stationed at Yanji and known as the “old 3rd Battalion”. On 8 February 1932 he proclaimed the Jilin National Salvation Army at Xiaochengzi and called for unity across party lines; defeated in January 1933 he crossed into the Soviet Union, returned via Europe, worked for the resistance in Shanghai, Tianjin and Zhengzhou, and sent 8,000 silver dollars raised inside the Great Wall to the forces in the Northeast. After the war began in July 1937 he returned to Yishui in Shandong, raised a local force and commanded the 2nd Route of the Restoration Army; his condition worsened and he died at Yishui on 20 December 1938, aged 64. On 4 February 1939 the Yan’an journal Jiefang published an obituary calling the loss of “this national hero” a loss to the Chinese nation. No route is drawn.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 山东本地起义武装在沂水王庄整编为八路军山东纵队，统一指挥全省抗日武装。
summary.en: Shandong’s local uprising forces were reorganized at Wangzhuang, Yishui, as the Shandong Column, unifying the province’s anti-Japanese forces.

fields.name: 山东纵队成立 Establishment of the Shandong Column
fields.summary: 山东本地起义武装在沂水王庄整编为八路军山东纵队，统一指挥全省抗日武装。 Shandong’s local uprising forces were reorganized at Wangzhuang, Yishui, as the Shandong Column, unifying the province’s anti-Japanese forces.
fields.description: 1938 年 12 月 27 日，中共中央决定在山东沂水王庄成立八路军山东纵队，统一指挥山东各地共产党领导的抗日武装（鲁西、冀鲁边另成系统）。张经武任指挥，黎玉任政治委员，王建安任副指挥，王彬任参谋长，江华任政治部主任，下辖第二、第三、第四、第五、第六、第八、第九、第十二支队等 10 个支队又 3 个团，共 2.45 万余人。这支部队以山东各地抗日武装起义（徂徕山、天福山、黑铁山、牛头镇等）的基干队伍为基础编成，不是由八路军主力入鲁后组建；1938 年 6 月各地起义武装已统一使用「八路军山东人民抗日游击队」番号，12 月改称山东纵队。1942 年 8 月，山东纵队改为山东军区；1943 年 3 月，山东军区与第115师合并为新的山东军区。本事件为建军建制，不绘制行军路线。 成立日期、主官与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 27 December 1938 the CCP Central Committee decided to establish the Eighth Route Army’s Shandong Column at Wangzhuang, Yishui, to command the Communist-led anti-Japanese forces across Shandong (western Shandong and the Hebei-Shandong border area remained separate). Zhang Jingwu was commander, Li Yu political commissar, Wang Jian’an deputy commander, Wang Bin chief of staff, and Jiang Hua director of the political department, with ten detachments and three regiments—more than 24,500 men. The column was formed from the cadre units of Shandong’s local anti-Japanese uprisings (Culaishan, Tianfushan, Heitieshan, Niutouzhen, and others); it was not created by a main-force unit entering the province. In June 1938 the uprising forces had already adopted the designation “Eighth Route Army Shandong People’s Anti-Japanese Guerrillas,” renamed the Shandong Column in December. In August 1942 the column became the Shandong Military Region; in March 1943 that region merged with the 115th Division to form the new Shandong Military Region. This is a formation event and no march route is drawn. Dates, appointments, and force size follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年1月16日，日军八目联队攻占京山县城。
summary.en: On 16 January 1939 the Japanese Bamoku detachment captured Jingshan.

fields.name: 京山沦陷 Fall of Jingshan
fields.summary: 1939年1月16日，日军八目联队攻占京山县城。 On 16 January 1939 the Japanese Bamoku detachment captured Jingshan.
fields.description: 1938年11月4日，日军进占皂市，随后侵占京山罗店、宋河。1939年1月16日，日军八目联队自宋河出发，经天王寺进攻京山县城，中国守军第33集团军第38师樊伦山团力战不支，退往孙桥，京山县城沦陷。同月日军设维持会，袁子和任会长。18日，日军进攻孙桥，被樊团击毙200余人。日期取京山党史县志办调研报告与《京山抗战大事记》；郭廷以《中华民国史事日志》记1月18日陷京山，异说并存。 On 4 November 1938 the Japanese occupied Zaoshi and then Luodian and Songhe in Jingshan. On 16 January 1939 the Japanese Bamoku detachment advanced from Songhe via Tianwang Temple against the county town; the Chinese 38th Division’s Fan Lunshan regiment under the 33rd Army Group fought until it could no longer hold and fell back to Sunqiao, and Jingshan fell. A maintenance committee under Yuan Zihe was set up that month. On the 18th the Japanese attacked Sunqiao and lost over 200 men to Fan’s regiment. The Jingshan party-history office and the Jingshan chronicle give 16 January; Guo Tingyi’s chronological record gives 18 January.

name.en: Establishment of the CCP Southern Bureau

summary.zh: 1939 年 1 月 16 日，中共中央南方局在重庆正式成立，周恩来任书记。
summary.en: On 16 January 1939 the CCP Southern Bureau was formally established in Chongqing under Zhou Enlai.

fields.name: 中共中央南方局成立 Establishment of the CCP Southern Bureau
fields.summary: 1939 年 1 月 16 日，中共中央南方局在重庆正式成立，周恩来任书记。 On 16 January 1939 the CCP Southern Bureau was formally established in Chongqing under Zhou Enlai.
fields.description: 根据中共六届六中全会决定，1939 年 1 月 16 日，中共中央南方局在重庆正式成立，秘密设在八路军驻重庆办事处内。周恩来任书记，博古、凯丰、吴克坚、叶剑英、董必武为常委，分别负责组织、宣传、联络、《新华日报》和妇女等工作。南方局代表中央领导四川、云南、贵州、湖北、湖南、广东、广西、江苏、江西、福建及香港、澳门等地的党组织，并领导《新华日报》《群众》周刊等公开机构。南方局在国统区开展统战、文化、群众和情报工作，是抗战时期中共在国民党统治中心的重要领导机关。本事件为组织成立，线路见 ccp 层「延安—重庆」。 In accordance with the decision of the Sixth Plenum, the CCP Southern Bureau was formally established in Chongqing on 16 January 1939, secretly housed in the Eighth Route Army office. Zhou Enlai was secretary, with Qin Bangxian, Kai Feng, Wu Kejian, Ye Jianying and Dong Biwu as standing members responsible for organisation, propaganda, liaison, Xinhua Daily and women’s work. The Bureau led Party organisations in Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Hubei, Hunan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Fujian, Hong Kong and Macao, and directed public organs such as Xinhua Daily and Qunzhong. It conducted united-front, cultural, mass and intelligence work in Nationalist-held areas and was the CCP’s key leadership organ in the Nationalist capital.

name.en: Fifth Plenary Session of the Kuomintang

summary.zh: 国民党五届五中全会确定防共、限共方针，同时坚持抗战。
summary.en: The Kuomintang’s fifth plenary session adopted a policy of guarding against and limiting the Communists while continuing the war.

fields.name: 五届五中全会 Fifth Plenary Session of the Kuomintang
fields.summary: 国民党五届五中全会确定防共、限共方针，同时坚持抗战。 The Kuomintang’s fifth plenary session adopted a policy of guarding against and limiting the Communists while continuing the war.
fields.description: 1939 年 1 月，国民党五届五中全会在重庆召开，确定“溶共、防共、限共、反共”方针，设立防共委员会；同时仍表示坚持抗战。此后国共摩擦加剧，直至 1941 年皖南事变。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In January 1939 the Kuomintang’s fifth plenary session met in Chongqing and adopted a policy of “absorbing, guarding against, limiting, and opposing the Communists,” setting up an anti-Communist committee while still professing to continue the war. Kuomintang–Communist friction intensified, culminating in the Wannan Incident of 1941. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: The 120th Division Moves into Central Hebei

summary.zh: 贺龙、关向应率第120师主力到达冀中，与冀中军区会合。
summary.en: He Long and Guan Xiangying led the main force of the 120th Division into central Hebei and joined the Jizhong Military Region.

fields.name: 第120师挺进冀中 The 120th Division Moves into Central Hebei 120师东进冀中 120th Division Eastward Advance
fields.place: 河北河间惠伯口 Huibokou, Hejian, Hebei
fields.summary: 贺龙、关向应率第120师主力到达冀中，与冀中军区会合。 He Long and Guan Xiangying led the main force of the 120th Division into central Hebei and joined the Jizhong Military Region.
fields.description: 1938 年 12 月，八路军第120师主力在师长贺龙、政治委员关向应率领下由晋西北岚县出发，越过同蒲、平汉铁路封锁线，于 1939 年 1 月 25 日到达河北河间惠伯口，与冀中军区领导机关会合。随后成立冀中区总指挥部，贺龙任总指挥，统一指挥第120师和冀中军区部队，巩固冀中平原根据地。 行军日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1938 the main force of the 120th Division, under commander He Long and political commissar Guan Xiangying, set out from Lanxian in northwestern Shanxi, crossed the Tongpu and Pinghan railway blockade lines, and on 25 January 1939 reached Huibokou, Hejian, Hebei, joining the Jizhong Military Region headquarters. A Jizhong unified command was then formed under He Long to direct the 120th Division and local forces in consolidating the central Hebei plain base area. March dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 万县“二四”大轰炸 Wanxian Bombing of 4 February 1939
fields.summary: 1939年2月4日，日机18架轰炸万县市区，投弹100余枚。 On 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Wanxian, dropping over 100 bombs.
fields.description: 1939年2月4日，日机18架轰炸万县市区，投弹100余枚，死亡300余人（另说伤亡近千人）。万县为川东门户和长江航运要地，此后至1944年共遭日机58批次轰炸。日期据《抗战大后方侵华日军无差别轰炸重大惨案的时空分布考察》与《抗战时期万县人口伤亡和财产损失巨大》。 On 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Wanxian, dropping more than 100 bombs and killing over 300 (some accounts give nearly 1,000 casualties). Wanxian was the gateway to eastern Sichuan and a key Yangtze shipping point; by 1944 it suffered fifty-eight raids.

summary.zh: 1939年2月4日，日机18架轰炸贵阳，炸死597人。
summary.en: On 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Guiyang, killing 597.

fields.name: 贵阳“二四”大轰炸 Guiyang Bombing of 4 February 1939
fields.summary: 1939年2月4日，日机18架轰炸贵阳，炸死597人。 On 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Guiyang, killing 597.
fields.description: 1939年2月4日中午，日机18架从城东侵入贵阳，轮番轰炸以大十字为中心的繁华商业区，投弹129枚，炸死597人、炸伤1526人，毁房1326幢，2万余人无家可归。贵阳为不设防的后方城市，此次“二四”轰炸是其抗战期间最惨重的一次。日期据人民网与贵州省民政厅。 At noon on 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft entered Guiyang from the east and bombed the commercial district around the Great Cross in successive waves. They dropped 129 bombs, killing 597, wounding 1,526, destroying 1,326 buildings and leaving over 20,000 homeless. Guiyang was an undefended rear city; the “2/4” raid was its worst of the war.

place.zh: 海南琼山天尾港（今海口西北）
place.en: Tianwei Port, Qiongshan, Hainan (northwest of present-day Haikou)

summary.zh: 日军台湾混成旅团在琼山天尾港登陆，当日攻占海口、府城。
summary.en: The Japanese Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan and took Haikou and Fucheng the same day.

fields.name: 日军登陆海南岛 Japanese landing on Hainan Island
fields.place: 海南琼山天尾港（今海口西北） Tianwei Port, Qiongshan, Hainan (northwest of present-day Haikou)
fields.summary: 日军台湾混成旅团在琼山天尾港登陆，当日攻占海口、府城。 The Japanese Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan and took Haikou and Fucheng the same day.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 10 日凌晨，日军第21军台湾混成旅团数千人，在海军第5舰队 30 余艘舰艇、50 余架飞机掩护下，从海口西北的琼山县天尾港强行登陆；当日攻占府城、海口。岛上中国守军仅有保安第5旅等约 3900 人，抵抗后撤往定安山区。日军随后向文昌、定安、嘉积、儋县等沿海城镇推进，至 4 月完成首轮占领。日期、兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 Before dawn on 10 February 1939, several thousand troops of the Japanese 21st Army’s Taiwan Mixed Brigade, covered by more than 30 warships and 50 aircraft of the 5th Fleet, landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan, northwest of Haikou, and took Fucheng and Haikou that day. The Chinese defenders on the island, mainly the 5th Security Brigade, numbered only about 3,900 and withdrew to the Ding’an mountains after resisting. Japanese forces then pushed toward Wenchang, Ding’an, Jiaji and Xinzhou in Danxian, completing the first phase of occupation by April. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Haikou and Fucheng; the Qiongya defenders withdrew to the Ding’an mountains.

fields.name: 海口、府城失守 Fall of Haikou and Fucheng
fields.place: 海南海口、府城 Haikou and Fucheng, Hainan
fields.summary: 日军攻占海口、府城，琼崖守军撤往定安山区。 Japanese forces captured Haikou and Fucheng; the Qiongya defenders withdrew to the Ding’an mountains.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 10 日，日军登陆后分左右两翼进攻：右翼台湾步兵第一联队攻占府城，左翼第二联队攻占海口，秀英炮台守军曾开炮还击。守军保安第15团、第11团等因众寡悬殊撤退。海口、府城失守后，琼崖当局撤往定安山区。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 10 February 1939 the landing force attacked in two wings: the right wing, the 1st Taiwan Infantry Regiment, took Fucheng, while the left wing, the 2nd Regiment, took Haikou; the Xiuying battery returned fire. The defenders, including the 15th and 11th Security Regiments, withdrew after being heavily outnumbered. The Qiongya authorities then retreated into the Ding’an mountains. Dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 琼崖抗日独立队在潭口渡口阻击东进日军，打响琼崖抗战第一枪。
summary.en: The Qiongya Independent Corps blocked the Japanese advance at Tankou Ford, firing the first shots of the Qiongya resistance.

fields.name: 潭口阻击战 Battle of Tankou Ford
fields.place: 海南琼山潭口渡口 Tankou Ford, Qiongshan, Hainan
fields.summary: 琼崖抗日独立队在潭口渡口阻击东进日军，打响琼崖抗战第一枪。 The Qiongya Independent Corps blocked the Japanese advance at Tankou Ford, firing the first shots of the Qiongya resistance.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 10 日，日军一部自海口东渡南渡江向文昌推进，琼崖抗日独立队第一中队在潭口渡口阻击，激战至黄昏后撤出。这是中共领导的琼崖抗日武装对日军的首次正面阻击，被称为「琼崖抗战第一枪」。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 10 February 1939 a Japanese detachment crossed the Nandu River east of Haikou toward Wenchang. The 1st Company of the Qiongya Independent Corps blocked it at Tankou Ford and fought until dusk before withdrawing. It was the first direct engagement between the CCP-led Qiongya forces and the Japanese, known as the “first shot of the Qiongya resistance.” Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
fields.entities: 华南抗日游击队 South China Guerrillas

fields.place: 海南澄迈湾老城附近 Near Laocheng, Chengmai Bay, Hainan
fields.summary: 日军另部在澄迈湾东北角、老城附近登陆，配合海口作战。 A second Japanese force landed at the northeast corner of Chengmai Bay near Laocheng in support of the Haikou operation.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 10 日至 12 日，日军为策应海口、府城作战，另部在澄迈湾东北角、老城附近登陆，随后向金江、临高、福山方向推进。4 月 14 日占领澄迈县城金江。登陆点据人民网与海南史志网，具体滩头待页码级核对。 From 10 to 12 February 1939, to support the attack on Haikou and Fucheng, another Japanese force landed at the northeast corner of Chengmai Bay near Laocheng and advanced toward Jinjiang, Lingao and Fushan. It occupied Jinjiang, seat of Chengmai county, on 14 April. The landing site follows People’s Daily Online and Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 14 日拂晓，日本海军第5舰队载佐世保海军陆战队约 2500 人进入三亚湾，登陆后当日占领三亚、榆林，深夜占领崖城。日军随后在榆林、三亚设海军基地和航空场，控制海南南部。日期、兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 At dawn on 14 February 1939 the Japanese 5th Fleet carried about 2,500 Sasebo naval landing troops into Sanya Bay; they took Sanya and Yulin that day and Yacheng late that night. Japan subsequently established naval bases and airfields at Yulin and Sanya and controlled southern Hainan. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Yacheng fell on 15 February. Landing sites follow Hainan local history and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 定安沦陷 Fall of Ding’an
fields.summary: 日军自海口进攻定安，占领定安县城。 Japanese forces advanced from Haikou and occupied Ding’an county town.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 20 日，日军 700 余人以飞机、战车掩护，自海口猛攻定安县城。定安为国民党琼崖警备司令部驻地附近要地，失守后国民党军政机关退入山区。日期有 2 月 20 日、22 日诸说，待页码级核对。 On 20 February 1939 more than 700 Japanese troops, covered by aircraft and armoured vehicles, attacked Ding’an county town from Haikou. Ding’an was a key point near the Nationalist Qiongya garrison headquarters, whose offices withdrew into the mountains after its fall. Accounts differ between 20 and 22 February and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军自海口进攻文昌，占领文昌县城文城。
summary.en: Japanese forces advanced from Haikou and occupied Wencheng, seat of Wenchang county.

fields.name: 文昌沦陷 Fall of Wenchang
fields.place: 海南文昌文城 Wencheng, Wenchang, Hainan
fields.summary: 日军自海口进攻文昌，占领文昌县城文城。 Japanese forces advanced from Haikou and occupied Wencheng, seat of Wenchang county.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 22 日，日军 200 余人以战车、飞机掩护，自海口进攻文昌县城文城，当日占领；2 月 23 日进入清澜港。日期有 2 月 21 日、22 日诸说，待页码级核对。 On 22 February 1939 more than 200 Japanese troops, covered by armoured vehicles and aircraft, advanced from Haikou and occupied Wencheng, the seat of Wenchang county; they entered Qinglan port on 23 February. Accounts differ between 21 and 22 February and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军进入清澜港，控制文昌沿海。
summary.en: Japanese forces entered Qinglan port and controlled the Wenchang coast.

fields.name: 清澜港失守 Fall of Qinglan Port
fields.place: 海南文昌清澜港 Qinglan port, Wenchang, Hainan
fields.summary: 日军进入清澜港，控制文昌沿海。 Japanese forces entered Qinglan port and controlled the Wenchang coast.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 22 日日军占领文昌县城文城后，同部于 2 月 23 日进入清澜港。现有资料多写作“进入”，可能是自文城陆路推进，也可能是海上登陆，具体方式待页码级核对。清澜港失守后，日军控制文昌沿海与清澜湾。 After occupying Wencheng, seat of Wenchang county, on 22 February 1939, the same Japanese force entered Qinglan port on 23 February. Sources mostly say “entered”; it may have advanced overland from Wencheng or landed by sea, and the exact manner awaits page-level verification. The fall of Qinglan gave Japan control of the Wenchang coast and Qinglan Bay.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1939年2月23日，日机分批袭兰州，市区与黄河沿一带被炸。
summary.en: On 23 February 1939 Japanese aircraft attacked Lanzhou in waves, bombing the city and the Yellow River bank.

fields.name: 兰州“二二三”大轰炸 Lanzhou Bombing of 23 February
fields.summary: 1939年2月23日，日机分批袭兰州，市区与黄河沿一带被炸。 On 23 February 1939 Japanese aircraft attacked Lanzhou in waves, bombing the city and the Yellow River bank.
fields.description: 1939年2月23日，日机38架分三批袭兰（一说20架），投弹于市区和黄河沿一带，中山市场投弹最多，炸毁民房1000余间、死亡100余人，普照寺等古建筑被毁。中国空军与苏联志愿航空队升空拦截，击落日机多架。日期据《兰州上空共击落日机四十余架》与《抗战时期的兰州空战》。 On 23 February 1939 Japanese aircraft attacked Lanzhou in three waves (38 aircraft, some accounts say 20), bombing the city and the Yellow River bank. The Zhongshan market was hit hardest; over 1,000 houses were destroyed, more than 100 people died, and historic buildings including Puzhao Temple were ruined. Chinese and Soviet volunteer fighters intercepted and shot down several Japanese aircraft.

summary.zh: 1939年2月28日，日军占领连云港及云台山大桅尖。
summary.en: On 28 February 1939 Japanese forces occupied Lianyungang and the Dazhujian peak of Yuntai Mountain.

fields.name: 连云港失守 Fall of Lianyungang
fields.summary: 1939年2月28日，日军占领连云港及云台山大桅尖。 On 28 February 1939 Japanese forces occupied Lianyungang and the Dazhujian peak of Yuntai Mountain.
fields.description: 1939年2月27日，中国守军放弃连云港，2月28日日军占领连云港及云台山大桅尖；3月4日占领墟沟，连云地区全境沦陷。连云港保卫战自1938年5月开始，历时约289天。日期据《连云港保卫战》，待页码级核对。 On 27 February 1939 Chinese defenders abandoned Lianyungang; on 28 February Japanese forces occupied the port and the Dazhujian peak, and on 4 March they took Xugou, completing the occupation of the Lianyungang area. The defence had lasted about 289 days since May 1938. The date follows the Lianyungang campaign account and awaits page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: The 115th Division’s Main Force Enters Shandong

summary.zh: 陈光、罗荣桓率第115师师部及第686团由晋西挺进山东，首战樊坝。
summary.en: Chen Guang and Luo Ronghuan led the 115th Division headquarters and 686th Regiment from western Shanxi into Shandong, winning their first battle at Fanba.

fields.name: 第115师主力入鲁 The 115th Division’s Main Force Enters Shandong 东进支队挺进山东 Eastern Advance Detachment
fields.place: 山东鄄城、郓城一带 Juancheng–Yuncheng area, Shandong
fields.summary: 陈光、罗荣桓率第115师师部及第686团由晋西挺进山东，首战樊坝。 Chen Guang and Luo Ronghuan led the 115th Division headquarters and 686th Regiment from western Shanxi into Shandong, winning their first battle at Fanba.
fields.description: 1938 年 12 月 2 日，八路军总部命令第115师主力挺进山东。12 月 20 日，代师长陈光、政治委员罗荣桓率师部、师直属队和第343旅第686团组成东进支队，由晋西灵石出发，1939 年元旦到达晋东南黎城、屯留一带整训。2 月中旬继续东进，经河北涉县、磁县和河南林县、鹤壁、濮阳，3 月 1 日越过黄河进入山东鄄城，随后在郓城西北樊坝首战告捷，歼灭伪军 500 余人。师部留第686团第三营等在鲁西开辟根据地，主力继续东进，9 月进入鲁南抱犊崮山区。第115师入鲁后与山东纵队并肩作战，1943 年 3 月两部合并为新的山东军区。 进入山东的日期各书记为 3 月 1 日或 2 日，樊坝战斗为 3 月 3 日晚至 4 日，此处取 3 月 1 日至 4 日；待页码级核对。 On 2 December 1938 the Eighth Route Army headquarters ordered the 115th Division’s main force into Shandong. On 20 December acting commander Chen Guang and political commissar Luo Ronghuan formed the Eastern Advance Detachment from the division headquarters, its direct units, and the 686th Regiment of the 343rd Brigade, setting out from Lingshi in western Shanxi and reaching Licheng and Tunliu in southeastern Shanxi for training on New Year’s Day 1939. In mid-February it moved east through Shexian and Cixian in Hebei and Linxian, Hebi, and Puyang in Henan, crossed the Yellow River into Juancheng, Shandong, on 1 March, and won its first battle at Fanba northwest of Yuncheng, annihilating more than 500 puppet troops. The headquarters left the 686th Regiment’s 3rd Battalion and other units to open the western Shandong base while the main force continued east and entered the Baodugu mountains of southern Shandong in September. The 115th Division fought alongside the Shandong Column, and in March 1943 the two merged into the new Shandong Military Region. Accounts give 1 or 2 March for the entry into Shandong and 3–4 March for the Fanba battle; this entry uses 1–4 March pending page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年3月1日，日军一夜之间侵入淮阴城。
summary.en: On 1 March 1939 Japanese forces entered Huaiyin overnight.

fields.name: 淮阴沦陷 Fall of Huaiyin
fields.summary: 1939年3月1日，日军一夜之间侵入淮阴城。 On 1 March 1939 Japanese forces entered Huaiyin overnight.
fields.description: 1939年3月1日，由连云港沿盐河、由宿迁沿运河、由沭阳沿淮沭路三个方向的日军，一夜之间侵入淮阴城；淮安、涟水等地相继沦陷。国民党江苏省政府及第24集团军总部连夜撤离。日期据淮安地方史与中共江苏地方简史。 On 1 March 1939 Japanese columns from Lianyungang along the Yan River, from Suqian along the Grand Canal and from Shuyang along the Huaishu road entered Huaiyin overnight; Huaian and Lianshui fell soon after. The Nationalist Jiangsu provincial government and the 24th Group Army headquarters fled during the night. The date follows Huai'an local history and the provincial party history.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1939年3月4日，日军占领海州、新浦、连云港。
summary.en: On 4 March 1939 Japanese forces occupied Haizhou, Xinpu and Lianyungang.

fields.name: 海州、新浦沦陷 Fall of Haizhou and Xinpu
fields.summary: 1939年3月4日，日军占领海州、新浦、连云港。 On 4 March 1939 Japanese forces occupied Haizhou, Xinpu and Lianyungang.
fields.description: 3月4日上午，日军第114师团步兵1个大队、第21师团步兵1个大队及第5师团第212联队向海州城发起进攻，联合各路部队占领海州、新浦、连云港。海州地区全境沦陷后，日军在新浦设立海州特务机关。 On the morning of 4 March, one battalion of the Japanese 114th Division, one of the 21st Division and the 212th Regiment of the 5th Division attacked Haizhou and, together with other columns, occupied Haizhou, Xinpu and Lianyungang. After the area fell, the Japanese set up the Haizhou special agency in Xinpu.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1939年3月5日，日军自京山西南进攻，占领钟祥县城。
summary.en: On 5 March 1939 the Japanese attacked from south-west of Jingshan and occupied Zhongxiang.

fields.name: 钟祥沦陷 Fall of Zhongxiang
fields.summary: 1939年3月5日，日军自京山西南进攻，占领钟祥县城。 On 5 March 1939 the Japanese attacked from south-west of Jingshan and occupied Zhongxiang.
fields.description: 1939年3月1日，日机3架空袭钟祥县城，炸毁民房20余栋，炸死居民9人。3月3日，日军自京山西南猛扑钟祥。3月5日（农历正月十五），钟祥县城沦陷。日军进城后随即网罗汉奸组织“安陆治安维持总会”。钟祥扼汉水东岸，此后成为日军进攻鄂北、鄂西的前进基地。日期取《钟祥县志》与荆楚网地方党史稿；《1939年抗日战争大事记》记3月6日，异说并存。 On 1 March 1939 three Japanese aircraft raided Zhongxiang, destroying over 20 houses and killing nine civilians. On 3 March the Japanese struck at Zhongxiang from south-west of Jingshan, and on 5 March (the fifteenth of the first lunar month) the county town fell. The Japanese immediately organised a collaborationist “Anlu public order maintenance association”. Commanding the east bank of the Han River, Zhongxiang thereafter served as a forward base for Japanese operations in northern and western Hubei. The county gazetteer and the Jingchu network party-history account give 5 March; the 1939 chronicle gives 6 March.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 国民政府发起国民精神总动员，强调“国家至上、民族至上”。

fields.name: 国民精神总动员 National Spiritual Mobilization

fields.name: 永修沦陷 Fall of Yongxiu
fields.summary: 1939年3月22日，永修沦陷。 On 22 March 1939 Yongxiu fell.
fields.description: 3月20日，日军第11军强渡修河，突破中国军队修河防线；3月22日攻占永修。永修是南昌西北门户，失守后日军沿南浔铁路南下，直逼南昌。日期为通行说法，据《江西抗日战争史》与《南昌会战》，待页码级核对。 On 20 March the Japanese 11th Army crossed the Xiu River and broke the Chinese defence line; Yongxiu fell on 22 March. Northwest of Nanchang, Yongxiu was the city's gateway; its fall opened the Japanese advance south along the Nanchang–Jiujiang railway. The date is the common account, follows the Jiangxi war history and the Nanchang campaign, and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年4月13日，19架日机空袭蒙自城，死伤数百人，炸毁房屋近两千间。
summary.en: On 13 April 1939 nineteen Japanese aircraft bombed Mengzi, killing and wounding hundreds and destroying nearly 2,000 buildings.

fields.name: 蒙自“四一三”大轰炸 Bombing of Mengzi, 13 April 1939
fields.summary: 1939年4月13日，19架日机空袭蒙自城，死伤数百人，炸毁房屋近两千间。 On 13 April 1939 nineteen Japanese aircraft bombed Mengzi, killing and wounding hundreds and destroying nearly 2,000 buildings.
fields.description: 1939 年 4 月 13 日 15 时 30 分左右，19 架日机分 15 架、4 架两批，越法属安南经个旧窜入蒙自上空，先以机枪扫射，再投下 100—500 磅炸弹 164 枚、燃烧弹 2 枚，轰炸机场、火车站、县政府、学校与民居，历时近一小时。伤亡数字各说不一：《红河日报》系报道记炸死 173 人、炸伤 156 人，毁房 1944 间；《蒙自市志》口径为死 73 人、重伤 53 人、轻伤 103 人，毁屋 401 间、震坏 764 间。此后日军持续轰炸蒙自二十余次，直至 1942 年美国第14航空队进驻。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 At about 15:30 on 13 April 1939, nineteen Japanese aircraft in two waves of 15 and 4 crossed from French Indochina via Gejiu into the sky over Mengzi, strafed the town with machine guns and dropped 164 bombs of 100–500 lb plus two incendiaries on the airfield, railway station, county government, schools and houses for nearly an hour. Casualty figures differ: reports in the Honghe Daily group give 173 killed and 156 wounded with 1,944 houses destroyed, while the Mengzi gazetteer gives 73 killed, 53 seriously and 103 lightly wounded, 401 houses destroyed and 764 damaged. Japanese aircraft bombed Mengzi more than twenty times thereafter until the US 14th Air Force arrived in 1942. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

Jiaji was a transport hub in eastern Hainan; after its fall Japan used it as a base to control the Wanquan River valley and the Qiongdong–Lehui area. fields.summary: 日军川崎部队与海军陆战队在白马井登陆，随后占新英、新州。 The Japanese Kawasaki force and naval landing troops came ashore at Baimajing and then took Xinying and Xinzhou.
fields.description: 1939 年 4 月 16 日，台湾混成旅团川崎部队与坂垣大佐指挥的海军陆战队在海南岛西部、今洋浦港入口北岸白马井登陆；4 月 17 日占新英港，4 月 18 日占儋县县城新州。登陆点据人民网与儋州地方史，待页码级核对。 On 16 April 1939 the Kawasaki force of the Taiwan Mixed Brigade and naval landing troops under Colonel Sakagami came ashore at Baimajing on the north bank of the present Yangpu harbour entrance in western Hainan. They took Xinying port on 17 April and Xinzhou, seat of Dan county, on 18 April. The landing site follows People’s Daily Online and Danzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

Another account has Japanese forces landing at Xinying on 25 September and then taking the county town; the date awaits page-level verification.

On 18 April they occupied Xinzhou, seat of Dan county. On 4 May Japanese and puppet troops seized Nada, the key town of western Hainan, using its church as a strongpoint. Dates follow Hainan and Danzhou local histories and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The 120th Division destroyed most of the Japanese Yoshida Battalion at Qihui, a model annihilation battle on the plains.

fields.name: 齐会战斗 Battle of Qihui 齐会歼灭战 Qihui Annihilation Battle
fields.place: 河北河间齐会 Qihui, Hejian, Hebei
fields.summary: 第120师在齐会歼灭日军吉田大队大部，取得平原歼灭战胜利。 The 120th Division destroyed most of the Japanese Yoshida Battalion at Qihui, a model annihilation battle on the plains.
fields.description: 1939 年 4 月 23 日至 25 日，八路军第120师在河北河间齐会地区围歼日军第27师团第3联队吉田大队 800 余人，毙伤日军 700 余人。日军施放毒气，贺龙等 20 余人中毒；白求恩率医疗队在前线连续工作 69 小时，实施手术 115 例。此战是八路军在平原地区首次大量歼敌的范例。 战果数字为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 23 to 25 April 1939 the 120th Division encircled and destroyed most of the Yoshida Battalion of the Japanese 27th Division’s 3rd Regiment at Qihui, Hejian, Hebei, inflicting more than 700 casualties on a force of over 800. Japanese troops used poison gas, poisoning He Long and more than 20 headquarters staff; Norman Bethune’s medical team worked 69 consecutive hours at the front and performed 115 operations. It was a model of large-scale annihilation warfare on the plains. Casualty figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军自三亚、藤桥方向进攻，占领陵水县城。 Japanese forces advanced from Sanya and Tengqiao and occupied Lingshui county town.
fields.description: 1939 年 4 月，日军自三亚、藤桥方向进攻陵水。4 月 28 日，日军占领陵水县城。陵水失守后，日军控制海南东南沿海，并以此为基地向保亭山区渗透。日期有 4 月 21 日、28 日诸说，待页码级核对。 In April 1939 Japanese forces advanced on Lingshui from Sanya and Tengqiao. On 28 April they occupied the county town, gaining control of the southeast coast and a base for penetration into the Baoting mountains. Accounts differ between 21 and 28 April and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Japan completed its first occupation of Hainan, controlling Wenchang, Ding’an, Jiaji, Danxian and other coastal towns.

fields.description: 1939 年 2 月登陆海口、三亚后，日军继续向文昌、定安、嘉积、儋县新州等沿海城镇推进。至 4 月底，日军完成海南岛首轮占领，控制主要港口、县城与交通线。各城具体失守日期待页码级核对。本事件为占领阶段节点，不绘单线。 After landing at Haikou and Sanya in February 1939, Japanese forces pushed toward Wenchang, Ding’an, Jiaji and Xinzhou in Danxian. By the end of April they had completed the first occupation of Hainan, controlling the main ports, county towns and roads. The exact date each town fell awaits page-level verification. This is a phase marker and is not drawn as a single route.

fields.name: 随枣会战 Battle of Suizao 随枣战役 Suizao Campaign
fields.place: 湖北随县（今随州） Suixian (now Suizhou), Hubei
fields.summary: 日军进攻随县、枣阳地区，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，恢复原阵地。 Japanese forces attacked the Suixian and Zaoyang areas; Chinese troops resisted in stages, counterattacked, and restored the original line.
fields.description: 1939 年 5 月，日军第 11 军向随县、枣阳地区进攻，企图打击中国第五战区主力。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，并在日军补给困难时反击，至 5 月下旬恢复原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后的重要作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1939, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Suixian and Zaoyang areas, seeking to strike the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone. Chinese troops used the terrain to resist in stages and counterattacked as Japanese supply lines became strained, restoring the original line by late May. It was an important operation after the war entered the stalemate phase. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 重庆“五三”大轰炸 Chongqing Bombing of 3 May 1939
fields.summary: 1939年5月3日，日机36架轰炸重庆市区，投弹166枚。 On 3 May 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed central Chongqing, dropping 166 bombs.
fields.description: 1939年5月3日，日本海军航空队36架飞机分两批空袭重庆市区，在民权路、飞来寺、国府路、学田湾、两路口等地投下爆炸弹83枚、燃烧弹36枚，以中央公园为中心19条街道被焚。据《民国二十八年度四川各地空袭损害统计表》，当日炸死673人、伤350人，损毁房屋1086幢。日期据重庆市档案馆空袭统计表与《重庆大轰炸》。 On 3 May 1939 thirty-six Japanese naval aircraft attacked central Chongqing in two waves, dropping 83 high-explosive and 36 incendiary bombs around Minquan Road, Feilai Temple, Guofu Road, Xuetianwan and Lianglukou; nineteen streets around Central Park burned. The 1939 Sichuan air-raid statistics record 673 dead, 350 wounded and 1,086 buildings damaged.
