fields.name: 唐聚五牺牲 Death of Tang Juwu
fields.place: 河北迁安平台山 Pingtai Mountain, Qian’an, Hebei
fields.summary: 1939年5月18日，辽宁民众自卫军创始人唐聚五在迁安平台山突围时牺牲，所部200余名官兵同时殉国。 On 18 May 1939 Tang Juwu, founder of the Liaoning People’s Self-Defence Army, was killed breaking out at Pingtai Mountain in Qian’an, with over 200 of his men.
fields.description: 唐聚五 1932 年 4 月 21 日在桓仁誓师成立辽宁民众自卫军，任总司令；1932 年 10 月遭日军重兵「讨伐」，被迫撤入关内，后参加热河、长城抗战。1937 年全面抗战爆发后，唐聚五请缨再上战场，被任为东北游击司令，授陆军中将；在未获饷械的情况下率部北上，得朱德、吕正操支持，进入冀东，与八路军并肩作战，三个月拉起 7000 余人、6 个纵队的游击队，分驻迁安、玉田、宝坻、遵化等县。1939 年 5 月，日伪军对冀东大「扫荡」。5 月 18 日晨，唐聚五部在迁安县平台山（长城脚下柳沟浴村）被包围，突围中腰部中弹，裹伤再战，最后壮烈牺牲；所部 200 余名官兵同时殉国。牺牲时年 40 岁（生年有 1898、1899 两说，另有 41 岁、47 岁说）。国民政府追赠陆军上将，《新华日报》发表社论悼念。本事件不绘路线。 Tang Juwu proclaimed the Liaoning People’s Self-Defence Army at Huanren on 21 April 1932 and led it until a heavy Japanese offensive in October 1932 forced it inside the Great Wall; he later fought in the Rehe and Great Wall campaigns. After the war began in July 1937 he asked for a field command, was appointed commander of the Northeast Guerrillas with the rank of lieutenant-general, and marched north without money or weapons; with the support of Zhu De and Lü Zhengcao he entered eastern Hebei and fought alongside the Eighth Route Army, raising in three months a force of over 7,000 in six columns, stationed in Qian’an, Yutian, Baodi and Zunhua. In May 1939 the Japanese swept eastern Hebei. On the morning of 18 May Tang’s force was surrounded at Pingtai Mountain in Qian’an (Liugouyu village under the Great Wall); hit in the waist during the breakout, he bound the wound and fought on until he was killed, with over 200 of his men. He was 40 (born 1898 or 1899; some sources give 41 or 47). The National Government posthumously promoted him general, and the Xinhua Daily published an editorial in his memory. No route is drawn.

name.zh: 东北抗联第三路军成立

place.zh: 黑龙江德都朝阳山（今五大连池）

summary.zh: 1939年5月30日，东北抗联第三路军总指挥部在德都县朝阳山成立，李兆麟任总指挥。
summary.en: On 30 May 1939 the 3rd Route Army headquarters was established at Chaoyang Mountain in Dedu county under Li Zhaolin.

fields.name: 东北抗联第三路军成立 Formation of the 3rd Route Army
fields.place: 黑龙江德都朝阳山（今五大连池） Chaoyang Mountain, Dedu (modern Wudalianchi), Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1939年5月30日，东北抗联第三路军总指挥部在德都县朝阳山成立，李兆麟任总指挥。 On 30 May 1939 the 3rd Route Army headquarters was established at Chaoyang Mountain in Dedu county under Li Zhaolin.
fields.description: 1939 年 3、4 月间，中共北满临时省委召开第二次执行委员会全体会议，决定去掉「临时」二字改称北满省委，并成立东北抗日联军第三路军总指挥部。5 月，北满省委发出《成立东北抗日联军第三路军》通告；5 月 30 日，第三路军总指挥部在德都县朝阳山后方基地正式成立：总指挥李兆麟（张寿篯），总参谋长许亨植，后冯仲云任政治委员；辖第三、第六、第九、第十一军，全军约 700 人（后编为龙南、龙北两个地区指挥部）。朝阳山由此成为北满抗联的指挥中心与后方基地，设有医院、修械所、被服厂、军政干校。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 In March and April 1939 the North Manchurian provisional provincial committee held its second plenary session, dropped “provisional” from its name and decided to form a headquarters for the 3rd Route Army. In May the committee issued its proclamation on the army’s establishment, and on 30 May the headquarters was formally created at the Chaoyang Mountain base in Dedu county: Li Zhaolin (Zhang Shouqian) as commander, Xu Hengzhi as chief of staff and later Feng Zhongyun as political commissar, commanding the 3rd, 6th, 9th and 11th Armies — about 700 men, later organised into the Longnan and Longbei area commands. Chaoyang Mountain became the command centre and rear base of the North Manchurian United Army, with a hospital, armory, clothing workshop and cadet school. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.
fields.entities: 东北抗日联军 Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1939年6月8日，六六战役中日军攻陷平陆县城，10日占领茅津渡。
summary.en: On 8 June 1939, during the June 6th battle, the Japanese took Pinglu; Maijindu fell on the 10th.

fields.name: 平陆沦陷 Fall of Pinglu
fields.summary: 1939年6月8日，六六战役中日军攻陷平陆县城，10日占领茅津渡。 On 8 June 1939, during the June 6th battle, the Japanese took Pinglu; Maijindu fell on the 10th.
fields.description: 1939年6月6日拂晓，日军第20师团4个联队、第37师团1个联队及骑兵、炮兵共3万余人，在30余架飞机掩护下分九路向中条山西部第四集团军阵地全线进攻，六六战役爆发。日军第20师团第80联队沿张茅大道南下，第79联队由张村、曲村西进，第77联队自芮城二十里岭进犯；第四集团军第38军、第96军及独立第46旅共2.6万人在背水狭长地带苦战。7日，日军从东、西、北三面进逼平陆县城郊，将第96军与独立第46旅压缩于平陆县城、太阳渡一带河滩。6月8日，日军攻陷平陆县城；10日占领茅津渡，隔绝第38军与第96军联系。守军分路突围后反击，6月11日一度恢复平陆、茅津渡，至21日日军退回运城，失地全部收复。日期取华商报专访；郭廷以《中华民国史事日志》记6月11日晋南我军恢复平陆茅津渡，可相印证。 Before dawn on 6 June 1939 the Japanese 20th Division's four regiments, one regiment of the 37th Division, cavalry and artillery, over 30,000 men with more than thirty aircraft, attacked the Fourth Army Group's positions in western Zhongtiao Shan in nine columns, opening the June 6th battle. The 80th Regiment came south along the Zhangdian–Maojindu road, the 79th Regiment west from Zhangcun and Qucun, and the 77th Regiment from Ershiling in Ruicheng; the Chinese 38th Army, 96th Army and independent 46th Brigade, 26,000 men, fought with their backs to the Yellow River. On the 7th the Japanese closed in on Pinglu from east, west and north and squeezed the 96th Army and 46th Brigade into the river flats around the county town and Taiyangdu. On 8 June the Japanese took Pinglu, and on the 10th Maijindu, cutting the link between the 38th and 96th armies. The Chinese broke out in separate columns and counter-attacked; Pinglu and Maijindu were recovered on 11 June, and by the 21st the Japanese had withdrawn to Yuncheng and all lost ground was retaken. The date follows the Huashang Daily interview, corroborated by Guo Tingyi's chronological record that Chinese troops recovered Pinglu and Maijindu on 11 June.

fields.summary: 日军轰炸成都，造成大量平民伤亡。 Japanese aircraft bombed Chengdu, causing heavy civilian casualties.
fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 11 日，日军飞机轰炸成都市区，投弹多枚，造成平民伤亡和房屋损毁。具体伤亡数字各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为战略轰炸惨案，不绘路线。 On 11 June 1939 Japanese aircraft bombed central Chengdu, causing civilian casualties and destroying houses. Accounts of the casualties differ and await page-level verification. This is a strategic-bombing atrocity and is not drawn as a route.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.zh: 日军封锁天津英法租界
name.en: Japanese Blockade of the Tianjin Concessions

summary.zh: 1939年6月14日晨6时起，日军封锁天津英法租界，直至1940年6月方解除。
summary.en: From 6 a.m. on 14 June 1939 the Japanese blockaded the British and French concessions in Tianjin until June 1940.

fields.name: 日军封锁天津英法租界 Japanese Blockade of the Tianjin Concessions
fields.place: 天津英租界 British Concession, Tianjin
fields.summary: 1939年6月14日晨6时起，日军封锁天津英法租界，直至1940年6月方解除。 From 6 a.m. on 14 June 1939 the Japanese blockaded the British and French concessions in Tianjin until June 1940.
fields.description: 1939年4月9日晚，伪天津海关监督兼伪联合准备银行天津支行经理程锡庚在天津英租界大光明影院被抗日杀奸团刺杀。日方要求英租界工部局引渡四名嫌疑人，英方以证据不足拒绝；5月31日日本驻津总领事田代重德发出最后通牒，限6月7日正午前答复。6月14日晨6时起，日军封锁通往英、法租界的7个路口及海河水道，盘问检查出入人员，史称「天津英租界危机」。封锁使租界物资、粮食与交通陷入停顿；英日随后在东京谈判，1939年7月24日克莱琪—有田协议达成，英方承认日军在华「特殊需要」，并将四名嫌疑人引渡。封锁至1940年6月方解除。1941年12月8日太平洋战争爆发后，日军直接进驻天津英租界。本事件不绘路线。 On the evening of 9 April 1939 Cheng Xigeng, puppet customs supervisor at Tianjin and manager of the puppet Federal Reserve Bank branch, was assassinated by the anti-Japanese resistance group at the Guangming cinema inside the British concession. Japan demanded that the concession police hand over four suspects; Britain refused for lack of evidence. On 31 May the Japanese consul-general Tashiro issued an ultimatum expiring at noon on 7 June. From 6 a.m. on 14 June the Japanese army blockaded seven roads into the British and French concessions and the Hai River, searching everyone passing through — the “Tianjin British Concession crisis”. Supplies, food and transport inside the concessions stalled. Britain and Japan negotiated in Tokyo; under the Craigie–Arita agreement of 24 July 1939 Britain recognised Japan’s “special requirements” in China and handed over the four suspects. The blockade was lifted only in June 1940, and on 8 December 1941 Japanese troops entered the concession outright. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 日军在汕头港外妈屿岛登陆，突袭汕头。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed on Mayu Island outside Shantou harbour and attacked the city.

fields.place: 广东汕头妈屿岛 Mayu Island, Shantou, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军在汕头港外妈屿岛登陆，突袭汕头。 Japanese forces landed on Mayu Island outside Shantou harbour and attacked the city.
fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 21 日凌晨，日军第 21 军第 104 师团一部及海军陆战队共约万人，在汕头港外妈屿岛、达濠岛登陆，分路进攻汕头市区。中国守军独立第 9 旅、保安第 5 团等部抵抗。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 Before dawn on 21 June 1939, elements of the Japanese 21st Army’s 104th Division and naval landing forces, about 10,000 men in conventional accounts, landed on Mayu and Dahao islands outside Shantou harbour and attacked the city by several routes. Chinese 9th Independent Brigade and 5th Security Regiment troops resisted. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军攻占汕头市区，汕头沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured central Shantou and the city fell.

fields.name: 汕头沦陷 Fall of Shantou
fields.summary: 日军攻占汕头市区，汕头沦陷。 Japanese forces captured central Shantou and the city fell.
fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 21 日日军登陆后，22 日凌晨三路攻入汕头市区，汕头沦陷。汕头是广州失守后华南最后一个对外通商口岸，沦陷使中国经潮韶公路输入物资的通道被切断。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 After landing on 21 June 1939, Japanese forces entered central Shantou by three routes in the early hours of 22 June, and the city fell. Shantou was the last major external trading port in South China after the fall of Guangzhou; its loss cut China’s supply route via the Chaozhou–Shaoguan road. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军自汕头北上，攻占潮州城。 Japanese forces advanced north from Shantou and captured Chaozhou.
fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 25 日，日军自汕头分两路进攻潮州，在枫溪、浮洋一带遭中国守军独立第 9 旅等部阻击。6 月 27 日上午，日军攻入潮州城，潮州沦陷。日期据汕头市档案馆档案，待页码级核对。 On 25 June 1939 Japanese forces advanced from Shantou toward Chaozhou in two columns and met resistance from the Chinese 9th Independent Brigade near Fengxi and Fuyang. On the morning of 27 June they entered Chaozhou, which then fell. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

Gan’en lies on the southwest coast; after its fall Japanese garrisons at Changjiang and Ya county were linked, giving Japan control of the southwest coast. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年6月28日，27架日机首次轰炸奉节县城，投弹129枚，死伤逾千。
summary.en: On 28 June 1939 twenty-seven Japanese aircraft bombed Fengjie for the first time, dropping 129 bombs and causing over a thousand casualties.

fields.name: 奉节“六二八”大轰炸 Bombing of Fengjie, 28 June 1939
fields.summary: 1939年6月28日，27架日机首次轰炸奉节县城，投弹129枚，死伤逾千。 On 28 June 1939 twenty-seven Japanese aircraft bombed Fengjie for the first time, dropping 129 bombs and causing over a thousand casualties.
fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 28 日下午 3 时 20 分至 5 时 50 分，日机 27 架首次轰炸奉节县城大小西坪、西门、十字街、罗家巷、羊市口、大东门外，投弹 129 枚。县政府统计：震倒房屋 798 间、炸毁 569 间，财产损失约法币 600 万元。伤亡数字两说：《西南大学学报》重大惨案统计表记死 1013 人、伤 1264 人；《侵华日军暴行总录》记炸死 813 人、炸伤 899 人。城西码头街李和顺土陶铺正为儿子办婚宴，宾客百余人刚入席即遭轰炸，一家除一子外全被炸死；永茂兴糖果铺一家炸死 9 人。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 Between 15:20 and 17:50 on 28 June 1939, 27 Japanese aircraft bombed Fengjie county town for the first time, dropping 129 bombs on the west side of town, the West Gate, Cross Street, the Luo family lane, Yangshi Mouth and the area outside the East Gate. The county government recorded 798 houses shaken down and 569 destroyed, with property losses of about six million yuan. Casualty figures differ: the Southwest University study’s table of major tragedies gives 1,013 killed and 1,264 wounded, while A Compendium of Japanese Atrocities gives 813 killed and 899 wounded. A pottery shop on the waterfront was holding a wedding banquet for over a hundred guests when the bombs fell; the family lost all but one son, and a confectionery shop lost nine members. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 29 日，侵占汕头的日军由潮州沿韩江进占澄海，澄海沦陷。至此，韩江、榕江、练江出海口均被日军控制。日期据汕头市档案馆，待页码级核对。 On 29 June 1939 Japanese forces occupying Shantou advanced from Chaozhou along the Han River and occupied Chenghai. With this, the mouths of the Han, Rong and Lian rivers were all under Japanese control. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 7 月，王耀武接任第74军军长，部队驻防赣北高安。此后第74军参加第一次长沙会战、1939 年冬季攻势与上高会战，长期活跃于赣北、湘北之间。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In July 1939 Wang Yaowu took command of the 74th Army, which was stationed at Gao’an in northern Jiangxi. It then fought in the first Battle of Changsha, the winter offensive of 1939, and the Shanggao campaign, remaining active between northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan. name.en: Opening of the Tiandu Iron Mine

place.zh: 海南崖县田独（今三亚田独）

summary.zh: 日军发现并开采田独铁矿，修建田独—榆林铁路与榆林港矿石码头。
summary.en: Japanese forces discovered and began mining the Tiandu iron ore deposit, building the Tiandu–Yulin railway and an ore terminal at Yulin port.

fields.name: 田独铁矿开采 Opening of the Tiandu Iron Mine
fields.place: 海南崖县田独（今三亚田独） Tiandu, Ya county (present-day Sanya), Hainan
fields.summary: 日军发现并开采田独铁矿，修建田独—榆林铁路与榆林港矿石码头。 Japanese forces discovered and began mining the Tiandu iron ore deposit, building the Tiandu–Yulin railway and an ore terminal at Yulin port.
fields.description: 1939 年 7 月，日军随军地质勘探人员在崖县田独发现优质铁矿，随即由石原株式会社组织开采。1940 年 6 月 11 日首次出矿，并修建田独至河口约 10 公里的轻便铁路，在榆林港建万吨级矿石码头。1944 年下半年因盟军封锁海域停产。据日方资料，田独铁矿共开采约 269 万吨、掠运约 268 万吨；数字待页码级核对。 In July 1939 Japanese military geologists discovered high-grade iron ore at Tiandu in Ya county, and the Ishihara interests began mining it. First ore was shipped on 11 June 1940; a roughly 10-km light railway was built from Tiandu to the river mouth, and a 10,000-ton ore terminal was built at Yulin port. Mining stopped in the second half of 1944 under Allied naval blockade. According to Japanese sources, about 2.69 million tons were mined and about 2.68 million tons shipped away; these figures await page-level verification.

name.en: The wrongful killing of Qi Zhizhong

place.zh: 黑龙江佛山县乌拉嘎（今嘉荫）

summary.zh: 1939年7月2日，抗联第十一军军长祁致中在攻打乌拉嘎金矿后被错误处死，年26岁。
summary.en: On 2 July 1939 Qi Zhizhong, commander of the 11th Army, was wrongly executed after the attack on the Wulaga gold mine; he was 26.

fields.name: 祁致中被错杀 The wrongful killing of Qi Zhizhong
fields.place: 黑龙江佛山县乌拉嘎（今嘉荫） Wulaga, Fushan county (modern Jiayin), Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1939年7月2日，抗联第十一军军长祁致中在攻打乌拉嘎金矿后被错误处死，年26岁。 On 2 July 1939 Qi Zhizhong, commander of the 11th Army, was wrongly executed after the attack on the Wulaga gold mine; he was 26.
fields.description: 祁致中 1913 年生于山东曹县，1931 年闯关东到依兰驼腰子金矿当工人，1933 年领导矿工暴动，组织东北山林义勇军「明山队」。1936 年夏改编为东北抗日联军独立师，任师长；1937 年 10 月在富锦县二区扩编为东北抗日联军第十一军，任军长，全军 1500 余人。1937 年 11 月，祁致中赴苏求援被扣押，与赵尚志、戴鸿宾关押一年半；1939 年 5 月获释，任东北抗日联军总司令部副官长。6 月 28 日夜随赵尚志部攻打佛山县乌拉嘎金矿，7 月 2 日在部队转移途中被以「拒不执行命令」为由错误处死，年 26 岁。处死决定的具体过程各说不一：一说赵尚志亲自下令；一说由游击队支委讨论决定、赵尚志因与祁有矛盾而回避。中华人民共和国成立后祁致中被追认为革命烈士，2001 年桦南县建立祁致中纪念塔。本事件不绘路线。 Qi Zhizhong, born at Caoxian in Shandong in 1913, went to the Tuoyaozi gold mine in Yilan in 1931, led a miners’ rising in 1933 and organised the “Mingshan” volunteer band. In summer 1936 it became the independent division of the United Army under him, and in October 1937 it was expanded at Fujin into the 11th Army with over 1,500 men. In November 1937 he crossed into the Soviet Union for supplies, was detained with Zhao Shangzhi and Dai Hongbin for eighteen months, and on release in May 1939 became adjutant-general of the United Army headquarters. On the night of 28 June he took part in Zhao’s attack on the Wulaga gold mine in Fushan county, and on 2 July, during the withdrawal, he was wrongly executed for “refusing orders”, aged 26. Accounts of the decision differ: one has Zhao ordering it, another has the guerrilla branch committee deciding while Zhao, in conflict with Qi, stayed away. He was posthumously recognised as a revolutionary martyr after 1949, and a memorial tower was built at Huanan in 2001. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 中共中央《为抗战两周年纪念对时局宣言》 CCP declaration on the second anniversary of the war
fields.summary: 1939 年 7 月 7 日，中共中央发表宣言，提出「坚持抗战、反对投降，坚持团结、反对分裂，坚持进步、反对倒退」。 On 7 July 1939 the CCP issued the three slogans: persist in resistance, unity and progress; oppose capitulation, split and retrogression.
fields.description: 1939 年 7 月 7 日，中共中央发表《为抗战两周年纪念对时局宣言》，针对日本诱降、汪精卫投敌和国民党内妥协倒退倾向，提出「坚持抗战、反对投降，坚持团结、反对分裂，坚持进步、反对倒退」三大政治口号。宣言强调抗战、团结、进步三者不可分离，号召全国军民克服投降与分裂危险。此后「坚持抗战、反对投降」成为中共在相持阶段处理国共关系的基本方针之一。本事件为政策文件，不绘路线。 On 7 July 1939 the CCP Central Committee issued a declaration on the second anniversary of the war. Against Japanese inducements, Wang Jingwei’s defection and tendencies toward compromise and retrogression within the Kuomintang, it put forward three political slogans: persist in resistance and oppose capitulation; persist in unity and oppose splitting; persist in progress and oppose retrogression. The declaration stressed that resistance, unity and progress were inseparable and called on the army and people to avert the dangers of capitulation and civil conflict. “Persist in resistance, oppose capitulation” became a basic principle in the CCP’s handling of KMT relations during the stalemate. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 东山港登陆 Landing at Dongshan Port
fields.place: 福建东山港 Dongshan port, Fujian
fields.summary: 1939年7月11日，日伪军进犯东山，在港口登陆。 On 11 July 1939 Japanese and puppet forces attacked Dongshan and landed at the port.
fields.description: 7月11日至16日，日伪军进犯东山，守军第75师史克勤旅和县长楼胜利率领地方武装进行反击，日军败退。日期据《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 From 11 to 16 July Japanese and puppet forces attacked Dongshan. The defending 75th Division's Shi Keqin brigade and county magistrate Lou Shengli led local forces in a counter-attack and drove the Japanese back. The date follows the Zhangzhou war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 巫山“七一二”大轰炸 Bombing of Wushan, 12 July 1939
fields.summary: 1939年7月12日，18架日机轰炸巫山县城，投弹61枚，死106人。 On 12 July 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Wushan, dropping 61 bombs and killing 106 people.
fields.description: 1939 年 7 月 12 日上午，日机 18 架轰炸巫山县城，投弹 61 枚，炸毁房屋 105 间。《西南大学学报》统计表记死 106 人、伤 59 人；《侵华日军暴行总录》记炸死 106 人、炸伤 168 人。十字街口两名值勤警察被炸死，只找到一条腿和两截枪管；天圣宫后 5 名老妇被烧死；黄荆坡一弹炸死 10 余人；禹王宫后卖水贫民何邦云一家 4 口全部遇难。此后日机又多次轰炸巫山（1939-07-25、10-24，1940-04-30、07-03、10-30，1941-01-12、05-17、07-06、08-08、08-17）。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 On the morning of 12 July 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Wushan county town, dropping 61 bombs and destroying 105 houses. The Southwest University table gives 106 killed and 59 wounded; A Compendium of Japanese Atrocities gives 106 killed and 168 wounded. Two policemen on duty at the crossroads were killed, leaving only a leg and a broken rifle; five old women burned to death behind the Tiansheng Palace; more than ten people died from one bomb at Huangjingpo; and the family of the water-carrier He Bangyun was wiped out. Further raids followed on 25 July and 24 October 1939, 30 April, 3 July and 30 October 1940, and 12 January, 17 May, 6 July, 8 August and 17 August 1941. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

fields.description: 7月11日至16日，日伪军进犯东山，守军第75师史克勤旅和县长楼胜利率领地方武装进行反击，日军败退。东山保卫战是福建沿海少数成功的抗登陆作战之一。日期据《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 From 11 to 16 July Japanese and puppet forces attacked Dongshan; the 75th Division's Shi Keqin brigade and county magistrate Lou Shengli counter-attacked and drove them back. The defence of Dongshan was one of the few successful anti-landing actions on the Fujian coast. The date follows the Zhangzhou war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 7 月 18 日，日军侵犯昌江，占领新街、墩头、八所，并在北黎设立司令部。昌江、感恩沿海与八所港被日军控制，为后来开采石碌铁矿、修建石八铁路准备了条件。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。 On 18 July 1939 Japanese forces invaded Changjiang, occupied Xinjie, Duntou and Basuo, and established headquarters at Beili. Control of the Changjiang–Gan’en coast and Basuo port prepared the way for mining the Shilu iron ore and building the Shilu–Basuo railway. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 万宁沦陷 Fall of Wanning
fields.summary: 日军占领万宁县城。 Japanese forces occupied Wanning county town.
fields.description: 1939 年 8 月 13 日，日军占领万宁县城。万宁位于海南东南沿海，失守后日军控制万泉河下游与东部海岸，与嘉积、陵水据点相连。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。 On 13 August 1939 Japanese forces occupied Wanning county town. Wanning lies on the southeast coast; after its fall Japan controlled the lower Wanquan River and the east coast, linking the Jiaji and Lingshui garrisons. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 宝安（深圳）沦陷 Fall of Bao’an (Shenzhen)

fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团在宝安登陆，占领南头、深圳，切断粤港交通。 The Japanese 18th Division landed in Bao’an and occupied Nantou and Shenzhen, cutting the Guangzhou–Hong Kong land link.
fields.description: 1939 年 8 月 13 日，日军第 18 师团自虎门出发，在宝安蛇口、西乡等地登陆。8 月 15 日占领南头城，随后控制深圳镇，切断广州与香港之间的陆路交通。日期据《深圳通史》与日本防卫省战史档案，待页码级核对。 On 13 August 1939 the Japanese 18th Division moved from Humen and landed at Shekou and Xixiang in Bao’an. It occupied Nantou on 15 August and then controlled Shenzhen town, cutting the overland link between Guangzhou and Hong Kong. The date follows the Shenzhen History and Japanese defense archives and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 乐山“八一九”大轰炸 Leshan Bombing of 19 August 1939
fields.summary: 1939年8月19日，日机36架轰炸乐山，炸死838人。 On 19 August 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed Leshan, killing 838.
fields.description: 1939年8月19日，日机36架轰炸乐山城区，投弹100余枚，炸毁半个城区，炸死838人、炸伤380余人。乐山为川南文化名城，当时被日军误判为国民政府准备西迁的都城。日期据《乐山日报》与《抗战大后方侵华日军无差别轰炸重大惨案的时空分布考察》。 On 19 August 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed Leshan, dropping over 100 bombs, destroying half the old city and killing 838 people, with more than 380 wounded. The Japanese apparently believed Leshan was a candidate capital for a westward Chinese government move.

fields.name: 日伪军再犯东山 Second Japanese–Puppet Attack on Dongshan
fields.summary: 1939年8月23日，日伪军再犯东山，占领陈城等15个村落，9月4日退出。 On 23 August 1939 Japanese and puppet forces again attacked Dongshan, occupying 15 villages including Chencheng, and withdrew on 4 September.
fields.description: 8月23日，日本指挥官涩谷部和伪军郑天福部，在8架飞机掩护下进犯东山，占领陈城、港口、亲营、古雷庄、岐下等15个村落。8月26日、27日，守军第75师449团和保安第9团奋起抵抗，449团张润生副团长夜战中阵亡。在军民顽强抗击下，日伪军于9月4日退出东山。此为反复争夺，不绘单一路线。 On 23 August the Japanese commander Shibuya and the puppet Zheng Tianfu force, covered by eight aircraft, attacked Dongshan and occupied 15 villages including Chencheng, Gangkou, Qinying, Guleizhuang and Qixia. On 26–27 August the 449th Regiment of the 75th Division and the 9th Security Regiment counter-attacked; Lieutenant Colonel Zhang Runsheng of the 449th was killed in night fighting. Under sustained resistance the Japanese and puppet forces withdrew on 4 September. As repeated fighting, it is not drawn as a single route.

summary.zh: 日本扶植的伪蒙疆联合自治政府在张家口成立。
summary.en: Japan established the puppet Mengjiang United Autonomous Government in Zhangjiakou.

fields.name: 伪蒙疆联合自治政府成立 Establishment of the Mengjiang United Autonomous Government
fields.place: 察哈尔张家口 Zhangjiakou, Chahar
fields.summary: 日本扶植的伪蒙疆联合自治政府在张家口成立。 Japan established the puppet Mengjiang United Autonomous Government in Zhangjiakou.
fields.description: 1939 年 9 月 1 日，日本将察南、晋北、蒙古联盟三个伪政权合并，在张家口成立伪蒙疆联合自治政府，以德穆楚克栋鲁普（德王）为主席。伪政权受日本驻蒙军控制，是日本统治察哈尔、绥远沦陷区的重要工具。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 1 September 1939 Japan merged the three puppet regimes of South Chahar, North Shanxi and the Mongol Federation into the Mengjiang United Autonomous Government in Zhangjiakou, with Demchugdongrub (Prince De) as chairman. Controlled by the Japanese garrison army in Mongolia, it was an instrument of Japanese rule over occupied Chahar and Suiyuan. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1939年9月11日，日机36架轰炸泸县县城。
summary.en: On 11 September 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed Luxian county town.

fields.name: 泸县“九一一”大轰炸 Luxian Bombing of 11 September 1939
fields.summary: 1939年9月11日，日机36架轰炸泸县县城。 On 11 September 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed Luxian county town.
fields.description: 1939年9月11日，日机36架轰炸泸县县城，投弹10枚，死亡1160余人、伤1145人（另载死亡385人、伤445人）。泸县为长江与沱江交汇处的航运要地，是日军轰炸川南的重点。日期据《抗战大后方侵华日军无差别轰炸重大惨案的时空分布考察》。 On 11 September 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed Luxian, dropping ten bombs and killing over 1,160, with 1,145 wounded (another account gives 385 dead and 445 wounded). Luxian, at the junction of the Yangtze and Tuo rivers, was a key shipping point and a focus of Japanese raids on southern Sichuan.

summary.zh: 日军进攻长沙，中国军队在新墙河、汨罗江一线阻击并反击，恢复原阵地。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Changsha; Chinese troops blocked and counterattacked along the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, restoring their original positions.

fields.name: 第一次长沙会战 First Battle of Changsha 长沙会战 First Changsha Campaign 第一次长沙战役 First Changsha Campaign
fields.place: 湖南新墙河一线 Xinqiang River line, Hunan
fields.summary: 日军进攻长沙，中国军队在新墙河、汨罗江一线阻击并反击，恢复原阵地。 Japanese forces attacked Changsha; Chinese troops blocked and counterattacked along the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, restoring their original positions.
fields.description: 1939 年 9 月 14 日，日军集中兵力向湖南新墙河一线发起进攻，企图攻取长沙。中国军队第九战区部队逐次阻击，诱敌深入后侧击、反击，迫使日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后中国正面战场的一次重要防御作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 On 14 September 1939, Japanese forces launched an offensive across the Xinqiang River in Hunan in an attempt to take Changsha. Chinese troops of the Ninth War Zone resisted in stages, drew the Japanese forward, then struck their flanks and counterattacked, forcing a withdrawal to the original line in early October. It was an important defensive battle on China’s frontal battlefield during the stalemate phase. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 1939年9月23日，日军第6、第13师团强渡新墙河，中国守军转移。
summary.en: On 23 September 1939 the Japanese 6th and 13th Divisions forced the Xinqiang River and the Chinese defenders withdrew.

fields.name: 新墙河防线失守 Fall of the Xinqiang River Line
fields.place: 湖南岳阳新墙河 Xinqiang River, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 1939年9月23日，日军第6、第13师团强渡新墙河，中国守军转移。 On 23 September 1939 the Japanese 6th and 13th Divisions forced the Xinqiang River and the Chinese defenders withdrew.
fields.description: 1939年9月18日日军第6、第13师团进攻新墙河北岸，中国第52军第2、第195师胡春华营、史思华营死守，至20日北岸阵地全部陷落。23日凌晨，日军在飞机、重炮和毒气掩护下强渡新墙河，中国守军抗击至中午后转移。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 On 18 September 1939 the Japanese 6th and 13th Divisions attacked the north bank of the Xinqiang River; the Chinese 2nd and 195th Divisions’ Hu Chunhua and Shi Sihua battalions held to the last, and the north-bank positions fell by the 20th. In the early hours of the 23rd the Japanese crossed under air, artillery and gas cover, and the Chinese withdrew after fighting until noon.

fields.name: 营田登陆 Landing at Yingtian
fields.place: 湖南湘阴营田 Yingtian, Xiangyin, Hunan
fields.summary: 1939年9月23日，日军第3师团上村支队在营田登陆，抄袭新墙河守军侧背。 On 23 September 1939 the Uemura detachment of the Japanese 3rd Division landed at Yingtian, turning the Xinqiang River line.
fields.description: 1939年9月23日拂晓，日军第3师团上村支队在海军支援下于洞庭湖东岸营田登陆，抄袭新墙河守军侧背，营田当日失守。日军占领营田后13天内残杀百姓800余人、强奸妇女百人以上。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 At dawn on 23 September 1939 the Uemura detachment of the Japanese 3rd Division landed at Yingtian on the east shore of Dongting Lake with naval support, turning the Xinqiang River line; Yingtian fell the same day. In the following thirteen days the Japanese killed more than 800 civilians and raped over a hundred women.

name.en: Fall of the Miluo River Line

summary.zh: 1939年9月26日，日军第6师团渡过汨罗江，进抵新市。
summary.en: On 26 September 1939 the Japanese 6th Division crossed the Miluo River and reached Xinshi.

fields.name: 汨罗江防线失守 Fall of the Miluo River Line
fields.place: 湖南湘阴汨罗 Miluo, Xiangyin, Hunan
fields.summary: 1939年9月26日，日军第6师团渡过汨罗江，进抵新市。 On 26 September 1939 the Japanese 6th Division crossed the Miluo River and reached Xinshi.
fields.description: 1939年9月25日凌晨日军迫近汨罗江北岸，26日日军第6师团渡过汨罗江进抵新市，在营田登陆的第3师团上村支队突破中国第95师阵地向粤汉路前进。中国第9战区按“后退决战”方针向长沙以东转移。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 The Japanese reached the north bank of the Miluo in the early hours of 25 September 1939; on the 26th the 6th Division crossed and reached Xinshi, while the Uemura detachment from Yingtian broke the Chinese 95th Division and drove on the Canton–Hankou railway. The Chinese Ninth War Zone fell back east of Changsha under its “retreat and decisive battle” plan.

summary.zh: 1939年9月29日，日军第33师团攻占平江，进抵长寿街、龙门厂。
summary.en: On 29 September 1939 the Japanese 33rd Division captured Pingjiang and reached Changshoujie and Longmenchang.

fields.name: 平江沦陷 Fall of Pingjiang
fields.summary: 1939年9月29日，日军第33师团攻占平江，进抵长寿街、龙门厂。 On 29 September 1939 the Japanese 33rd Division captured Pingjiang and reached Changshoujie and Longmenchang.
fields.description: 1939年9月22日日军第33师团自鄂南通城南犯，23日进占麦市、桃树港，29日攻占平江，进抵朱溪厂、龙门厂、长寿街。中国第20、第79军在献钟、南楼岭、桃树港一带夹击，日军未能与湘北主力会合。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 On 22 September 1939 the Japanese 33rd Division advanced south from Tongcheng in southern Hubei, took Maishi and Taoshugang on the 23rd, and captured Pingjiang on the 29th, reaching Zhuxichang, Longmenchang and Changshoujie. The Chinese 20th and 79th Corps counterattacked around Xianzhong and Nanluling, preventing a junction with the main force.

summary.en: On 30 September 1939 a Japanese column reached Yong’an, 30 km north of Changsha, the deepest penetration of the first Changsha campaign.

fields.name: 日军进抵永安 Japanese Reach Yong’an
fields.place: 湖南长沙永安 Yong’an, Changsha, Hunan
fields.summary: 1939年9月30日，日军一部进抵长沙以北30公里的永安，为第一次长沙会战日军南侵最远点。 On 30 September 1939 a Japanese column reached Yong’an, 30 km north of Changsha, the deepest penetration of the first Changsha campaign.
fields.description: 1939年9月28日日军第6师团在福临铺、金井遭中国第195师等部伏击，损失颇重；29日其主力进至桥头驿，一部进抵永安（距长沙30公里）。这是第一次长沙会战日军南侵最远点。10月1日日军开始撤退，至10月8日退回新墙河北岸。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 On 28 September 1939 the Japanese 6th Division was ambushed by the Chinese 195th Division at Fulingpu and Jinjing and suffered heavily; on the 29th its main force reached Qiaotouyi and a detachment reached Yong’an, 30 km from Changsha, the deepest point of the Japanese advance. The Japanese began withdrawing on 1 October and were back north of the Xinqiang by the 8th.

summary.en: On 2 October 1939 Japanese forces occupied Gaoyou.

fields.name: 高邮沦陷 Fall of Gaoyou
fields.summary: 1939年10月2日，日军侵占高邮城。 On 2 October 1939 Japanese forces occupied Gaoyou.
fields.description: 1939年10月2日黎明，8架日机轮番轰炸车逻镇、高邮城，掩护日军独立混成旅两个大队乘汽艇由高邮湖石工头登陆，上午7时许翻越城墙进入高邮城。日军占领后连续屠杀，杀害无辜百姓1200余人。日期据《高邮日报》与高邮市文史资料。 At dawn on 2 October 1939 eight Japanese aircraft bombed Cheluo and Gaoyou, covering two battalions of an independent mixed brigade that landed by motorboat at Shigongtou on Gaoyou Lake and entered the city over the wall around 7 a.m. After the occupation Japanese troops killed more than 1,200 civilians. The date follows the Gaoyou newspaper and local文史 materials.

name.zh: 毛泽东《〈共产党人〉发刊词》
name.en: Mao Zedong’s preface to The Communist

summary.zh: 1939 年 10 月 4 日，毛泽东发表《〈共产党人〉发刊词》，提出统一战线、武装斗争、党的建设三大法宝。
summary.en: On 4 October 1939 Mao published the preface to The Communist, naming the united front, armed struggle and Party building as the three magic weapons.

fields.name: 毛泽东《〈共产党人〉发刊词》 Mao Zedong’s preface to The Communist
fields.summary: 1939 年 10 月 4 日，毛泽东发表《〈共产党人〉发刊词》，提出统一战线、武装斗争、党的建设三大法宝。 On 4 October 1939 Mao published the preface to The Communist, naming the united front, armed struggle and Party building as the three magic weapons.
fields.description: 1939 年 10 月 4 日，毛泽东为中共中央机关刊物《共产党人》创刊号撰写《〈共产党人〉发刊词》，总结中国共产党成立十八年的经验，指出统一战线、武装斗争、党的建设是中国共产党在中国革命中战胜敌人的三个法宝，并把党的建设称为「伟大的工程」。文章强调，统一战线和武装斗争是战胜敌人的两个基本武器，而党的组织则是掌握这两个武器的英勇战士。该文与《中国革命和中国共产党》《新民主主义论》一起，构成抗战时期新民主主义理论的重要文献。本事件为理论文章，不绘路线。 On 4 October 1939 Mao Zedong wrote the preface for the inaugural issue of The Communist, the Central Committee’s journal. Reviewing eighteen years of Party history, he identified the united front, armed struggle and Party building as the three magic weapons with which the CCP had defeated its enemies, and called Party building a “great project”. The united front and armed struggle were the two basic weapons, while the Party organisation was the fighter who wielded them. Together with “The Chinese Revolution and the Chinese Communist Party” and “On New Democracy”, the text became a key statement of New Democratic theory during the war.

summary.zh: 1939年10月13日，18架日机趁赶场轰炸南川县城，死约180人，县城几成瓦砾。
summary.en: On 13 October 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Nanchuan on a market day, killing about 180 people and reducing much of the town to rubble.

fields.name: 南川“十一三”大轰炸 Bombing of Nanchuan, 13 October 1939
fields.summary: 1939年10月13日，18架日机趁赶场轰炸南川县城，死约180人，县城几成瓦砾。 On 13 October 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Nanchuan on a market day, killing about 180 people and reducing much of the town to rubble.
fields.description: 1939 年 10 月 13 日正值南川赶场，上午 10 时许，18 架日机成「品」字形两组飞临县城，先以机枪扫射人群，再轮番轰炸。南街城墙被炸塌，南门河岸商店被砸毁；肖家院防空洞中弹，洞内躲避的男女老少全部遇难；西城龚家塘蒋家楼房被夷平，全家遇难。大火烧至 10 月 14 日午后，县城几成瓦砾，县政府迁至南城外硫磺村杨家祠堂。伤亡与投弹数字两说：《侵华日军暴行总录》记投弹 142 枚（含燃烧弹 5 枚）、死 180 人、伤 130 人、毁房 821 间；《西南大学学报》统计表记投弹 93 枚（另说 130 枚）、死 151 人、伤 142 人。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 On 13 October 1939, a market day in Nanchuan, two groups of 18 Japanese aircraft in wedge formation arrived over the county town at about ten in the morning, machine-gunned the crowds and then bombed in repeated passes. The south-street wall collapsed onto the shops by the South Gate riverbank; the Xiao family’s air-raid shelter took a direct hit and everyone inside was killed; a two-storey house at Gongjiatang in the west of the town was flattened with its whole family. The fire burned until the afternoon of 14 October, leaving the town largely in ruins, and the county government moved to the Yang family ancestral hall at Liuhuang village outside the South Gate. Figures differ: A Compendium of Japanese Atrocities records 142 bombs (5 incendiaries), 180 killed, 130 wounded and 821 houses destroyed, while the Southwest University table records 93 bombs (130 in another account), 151 killed and 142 wounded. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

summary.en: Jin-Cha-Ji troops killed Major General Abe Norihide, commander of the Japanese 2nd Independent Mixed Brigade, at Huangtuling.

fields.name: 黄土岭战斗 Battle of Huangtuling 黄土岭伏击战 Huangtuling Ambush
fields.place: 河北涞源黄土岭 Huangtuling, Laiyuan, Hebei
fields.summary: 晋察冀军区部队在黄土岭击毙日军独立混成第2旅团长阿部规秀中将。 Jin-Cha-Ji troops killed Major General Abe Norihide, commander of the Japanese 2nd Independent Mixed Brigade, at Huangtuling.
fields.description: 1939 年 11 月，日军独立混成第2旅团对晋察冀根据地进行“扫荡”。11 月 7 日，晋察冀军区第一军分区等部在河北涞源黄土岭设伏，击毙旅团长阿部规秀中将，歼敌数百人。阿部规秀是抗战期间被八路军击毙的日军最高级别将领之一。 日期、兵力与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1939 the Japanese 2nd Independent Mixed Brigade conducted a “mopping-up” operation against the Jin-Cha-Ji base area. On 7 November troops of the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region’s 1st Sub-district ambushed the column at Huangtuling, Laiyuan, Hebei, killing brigade commander Major General Abe Norihide and several hundred soldiers. Abe was one of the most senior Japanese officers killed by the Eighth Route Army during the war. Dates, force sizes, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 钦州湾登陆 Landing at Qinzhou Bay
fields.place: 广西钦州湾 Qinzhou Bay, Guangxi
fields.summary: 1939年11月15日，日军第5师团、台湾混成旅团在钦州湾登陆，桂南会战开始。 On 15 November 1939 the Japanese 5th Division and Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Qinzhou Bay, opening the southern Guangxi campaign.
fields.description: 1939年11月15日，日军第21军司令官安藤利吉指挥第5师团、台湾混成旅团及海军陆战队3万余人，在钦州湾龙门港、企沙强行登陆。中国新编第19师抵抗一天后溃退，日军登陆后即分路北上，直指南宁。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 On 15 November 1939 Lt. Gen. Ando Rikichi’s 21st Army, with the 5th Division, the Taiwan Mixed Brigade and naval landing troops—over 30,000 men—forced a landing at Longmen and Qisha in Qinzhou Bay. The Chinese New 19th Division held for a day and then collapsed; the Japanese advanced north toward Nanning.

fields.description: 1939年11月16日日军占领防城。防城为钦州湾登陆后第一个县城，失守后日军沿钦防公路北上，17日占钦县。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 On 16 November 1939 the Japanese took Fangcheng, the first county town after the Qinzhou Bay landing. They then advanced north along the Qinzhou–Fangcheng road and took Qin County on the 17th.

summary.zh: 1939年11月17日，日军占领钦县（今钦州）。
summary.en: On 17 November 1939 the Japanese occupied Qin County (modern Qinzhou).

fields.name: 钦县沦陷 Fall of Qin County
fields.place: 广西钦县 Qin County (Qinzhou), Guangxi
fields.summary: 1939年11月17日，日军占领钦县（今钦州）。 On 17 November 1939 the Japanese occupied Qin County (modern Qinzhou).
fields.description: 1939年11月17日日军占领钦县（今钦州），随即分兵北上，18日进攻小董。钦县为钦州湾登陆后的交通枢纽，失守后日军沿邕钦公路直指南宁。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 On 17 November 1939 the Japanese took Qin County (modern Qinzhou), then divided their force and advanced north, attacking Xiaodong on the 18th. Qin County was the transport hub after the landing, and its loss opened the road along the Yong–Qin highway to Nanning.

summary.en: On 18 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Xiaodong and the Chinese New 19th Division collapsed.

fields.name: 小董失守 Fall of Xiaodong
fields.place: 广西钦县小董 Xiaodong, Qin County, Guangxi
fields.summary: 1939年11月18日，日军进攻小董，中国新编第19师溃退。 On 18 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Xiaodong and the Chinese New 19th Division collapsed.
fields.description: 1939年11月18日日军进攻中国新编第19师师部所在地小董，师长黄固临阵退缩，只身逃跑，部队溃散。日军继续北上，22日傍晚抵达南宁邕江南岸。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 On 18 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Xiaodong, headquarters of the Chinese New 19th Division. Its commander Huang Gu fled alone and the division collapsed. The Japanese continued north and reached the south bank of the Yong River at Nanning on the evening of the 22nd.

summary.zh: 日军在钦州湾登陆后攻占南宁，桂南会战展开。
summary.en: After landing at Qinzhou Bay, Japanese forces captured Nanning, opening the Battle of South Guangxi.

fields.name: 南宁沦陷 Fall of Nanning
fields.summary: 日军在钦州湾登陆后攻占南宁，桂南会战展开。 After landing at Qinzhou Bay, Japanese forces captured Nanning, opening the Battle of South Guangxi.
fields.description: 1939 年 11 月 15 日，日军第 5 师团等在钦州湾登陆，沿邕钦公路北犯。11 月 24 日，日军占领南宁，随后进攻昆仑关。中国军队调集兵力反攻，桂南会战展开。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 15 November 1939 the Japanese 5th Division and other units landed at Qinzhou Bay and advanced north along the Nanning–Qinzhou road. On 24 November they occupied Nanning and then attacked Kunlun Pass. Chinese forces concentrated for a counteroffensive, opening the Battle of South Guangxi. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 1 December 1939 the Japanese captured Gaofeng Pass.

fields.name: 高峰隘失守 Fall of Gaofeng Pass
fields.place: 广西武鸣高峰隘 Gaofeng Pass, Wuming, Guangxi
fields.summary: 1939年12月1日，日军攻占高峰隘。 On 1 December 1939 the Japanese captured Gaofeng Pass.
fields.description: 1939年11月26日起日军在飞机掩护下猛攻高峰隘，中国守军顽强抵抗，12月1日高峰隘失守。高峰隘为南宁至武鸣要冲，失守后南宁北面门户洞开。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 From 26 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Gaofeng Pass under air cover. The Chinese resisted stubbornly, but the pass fell on 1 December. Gaofeng was the key point on the Nanning–Wuming road; its loss opened Nanning’s northern approaches.

summary.zh: 1939年12月4日，日军占领昆仑关。
summary.en: On 4 December 1939 the Japanese occupied Kunlun Pass.

fields.name: 昆仑关失守 Fall of Kunlun Pass
fields.place: 广西昆仑关 Kunlun Pass, Guangxi
fields.summary: 1939年12月4日，日军占领昆仑关。 On 4 December 1939 the Japanese occupied Kunlun Pass.
fields.description: 1939年12月4日日军占领昆仑关。昆仑关为南宁至宾阳要冲，日军据守后切断桂越交通线；12月18日中国第5军反攻，31日收复昆仑关，击毙日军第21旅团长中村正雄。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 On 4 December 1939 the Japanese occupied Kunlun Pass, the key point on the Nanning–Binyang road, cutting the Guangxi–Vietnam supply line. On 18 December the Chinese 5th Corps counterattacked and retook the pass on the 31st, killing Maj. Gen. Nakamura Masao, commander of the Japanese 21st Brigade.

fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 15 日，日军第 18 师团万余人由增城沿增龙公路北上，17 日突破中国第 63 军第 151 师铁扇关门防线，进占小楼、正果。这是第一次粤北会战右路的起点。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 15 December 1939 more than 10,000 troops of the Japanese 18th Division advanced north from Zengcheng along the Zengcheng–Longmen road. summary.en: Chinese forces counterattacked at Kunlun Pass and recaptured the strategic pass after fierce fighting.

fields.name: 昆仑关战役 Battle of Kunlun Pass 昆仑关大捷 Kunlun Pass Victory
fields.place: 广西南宁昆仑关 Kunlun Pass, Nanning, Guangxi
fields.summary: 中国军队反攻昆仑关，经过激战收复关隘，取得昆仑关大捷。 Chinese forces counterattacked at Kunlun Pass and recaptured the strategic pass after fierce fighting.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月，中国军队为收复南宁、夺回昆仑关，对日军发起反攻。中国第 5 军等部在昆仑关与日军激战，反复争夺，最终于 1940 年 1 月收复昆仑关，击毙日军旅团长中村正雄。此役是抗战中期中国军队的一次重要攻坚胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In December 1939, Chinese forces launched a counteroffensive to recover Nanning and retake Kunlun Pass. The Chinese 5th Army and other units fought fierce, seesaw battles against the Japanese at the pass, finally recapturing it in January 1940 and killing the Japanese brigade commander Nakamura Masao. It was an important Chinese offensive victory in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 19 日日军驻蒙军自归绥西进，攻占包头；1940 年 3 月中国军队反攻，一度收复包头、五原。归绥自 1937 年 10 月即为日军占领。 On 19 December 1939 the Japanese garrison army in Mongolia moved west from Guisui and took Baotou; in March 1940 the Chinese army counter-attacked and briefly recovered Baotou and Wuyuan. Guisui had been occupied since October 1937.

fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团占领永汉。 The Japanese 18th Division occupied Yonghan.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 19 日，日军第 18 师团沿增城—龙门一线北上，占领永汉，随后继续向左潭、梅坑推进。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 19 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division advanced north along the Zengcheng–Longmen axis and occupied Yonghan, then continued toward Zuotan and Meikeng. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 20 日，日军近卫混成旅团由从化方向北犯，占领从化县城；21 日进占鸡笼冈，随后分路进攻良口、牛背脊。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 20 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade advanced north from the Conghua direction and occupied Conghua county town; on 21 December it took Jilonggang and then advanced on Liangkou and Niubeiji. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939年12月21日日军一部西进攻陷龙州，截断桂越国际交通线。另有记11月24日与南宁同日占龙州，正文并列。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战》。 On 21 December 1939 a Japanese column drove west and took Longzhou, cutting the Guangxi–Vietnam international route. Another account places the fall on 24 November, the same day as Nanning; that variant is noted.

summary.zh: 日军近卫混成旅团占领良口。
summary.en: The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Liangkou.

fields.name: 良口失守 Fall of Liangkou
fields.place: 广东从化良口 Liangkou, Conghua, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军近卫混成旅团占领良口。 The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Liangkou.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 22 日，日军近卫混成旅团约 3000 人突破中国第 186 师蜈蚣山、热水、鸭洞阵地，占领良口；25 日又占吕田。良口、牛背脊是翁从公路要冲，此后成为中国军队反击的重点。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 22 December 1939 about 3,000 troops of the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade broke the Chinese 186th Division’s positions at Wugongshan, Reshui and Yadong and occupied Liangkou; on 25 December they took Lü tian. Liangkou and Niubeiji were key points on the Wengyuan–Conghua road and later became the focus of the Chinese counterattack. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.place: 广东新丰梅坑、从化吕田 Meikeng, Xinfeng and Lü tian, Conghua, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团占梅坑，近卫混成旅团占吕田。 The Japanese 18th Division took Meikeng and the Guard Mixed Brigade took Lü tian.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 25 日，日军第 18 师团突破中国军队防线，进占画眉堂、梅坑；同日近卫混成旅团集中七八千人突破第 151 师阵地，进占吕田。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 25 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division broke the Chinese line and occupied Huameitang and Meikeng; the same day the Guard Mixed Brigade concentrated 7,000–8,000 troops, broke the 151st Division’s positions and occupied Lü tian. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division occupied Xinfeng.

fields.name: 新丰失守 Fall of Xinfeng
fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团占领新丰。 The Japanese 18th Division occupied Xinfeng.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 28 日，日军第 18 师团占领新丰，粤北战局危急。中国第 12 集团军急调第 54 军由湘入粤增援。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 28 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division occupied Xinfeng, placing northern Guangdong in crisis. The Chinese 12th Group Army urgently moved the 54th Army from Hunan into Guangdong. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 翁源失守 Fall of Wengyuan
fields.summary: 日军近卫混成旅团占领翁源。 The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Wengyuan.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 29 日，日军近卫混成旅团占官渡；30 日占领翁源，31 日占新江。日军三路对粤北形成大包围，但中国军队随即反击。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 29 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade took Guandu; on 30 December it occupied Wengyuan and on 31 December Xinjiang. The three Japanese columns had enveloped northern Guangdong, but the Chinese army counterattacked immediately. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军第 104 师团攻占英德。 The Japanese 104th Division captured Yingde.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 30 日，日军第 104 师团沿粤汉铁路北犯，攻占英德。左路日军逼近曲江，第一次粤北会战进入最紧张阶段。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 30 December 1939 the Japanese 104th Division advanced north along the Canton–Hankou railway and captured Yingde. The left column was closing on Qujiang, the tensest phase of the first northern Guangdong campaign. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 新江失守 Fall of Xinjiang
fields.place: 广东翁源新江 Xinjiang, Wengyuan, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军近卫混成旅团占领新江，逼进曲江。 The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Xinjiang, closing on Qujiang.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 31 日，日军近卫混成旅团占领新江，兵锋直指曲江。1940 年 1 月 1 日，日军因桂南战场吃紧开始全线退却；中国军队追击，至 1 月 16 日收复清远、花县、从化、龙门等地。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 31 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Xinjiang and pointed directly at Qujiang. On 1 January 1940, with the Guangxi front under pressure, the Japanese began a general withdrawal; Chinese forces pursued and by 16 January had recovered Qingyuan, Hua county, Conghua and Longmen. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: In the first northern Guangdong battle the Japanese reached the outskirts of Shaoguan and withdrew.

fields.name: 日军攻韶关未克撤回 Japanese drive on Shaoguan fails
fields.summary: 第一次粤北会战，日军攻至韶关外围后撤回广州。 In the first northern Guangdong battle the Japanese reached the outskirts of Shaoguan and withdrew.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月日军第 18 师团等自广州北犯，第一次粤北会战爆发；中国军队逐次抵抗并反攻，日军攻至韶关外围后于 1940 年 1 月中旬撤回广州。韶关为战时广东省会，始终未陷。 In December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division and others moved north from Guangzhou, opening the first northern Guangdong battle; the Chinese army resisted and counter-attacked, and the Japanese, having reached the outskirts of Shaoguan, withdrew to Guangzhou in mid-January 1940. Shaoguan, the wartime provincial capital, never fell.

fields.name: 萧山沦陷 Fall of Xiaoshan
fields.summary: 1940年1月22日，日军趁大雪偷渡钱塘江，攻占萧山县城。 On 22 January 1940 Japanese forces crossed the Qiantang River in heavy snow and captured Xiaoshan.
fields.description: 1月22日，日军趁大雪天偷渡钱塘江，攻占萧山县城。萧山是钱塘江南岸门户，日军由此打破与浙江守军隔江对峙的局面。日期据《杭州大事记（1940－1945）》与《杭州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 22 January Japanese forces crossed the Qiantang River during heavy snow and captured Xiaoshan. As the gateway on the south bank, Xiaoshan ended the standoff in which Chinese and Japanese forces faced each other across the river. The date follows the Hangzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 伯力会议决定抗联缩编为支队
name.en: The Khabarovsk conference: reduction to brigade-sized detachments

summary.zh: 1940年1月24日，周保中、冯仲云、赵尚志在伯力开会，决定将抗联11个军缩编为10个支队，实行「逐渐收缩、保存实力」。
summary.en: On 24 January 1940 Zhou Baozhong, Feng Zhongyun and Zhao Shangzhi met at Khabarovsk and decided to reduce the 11 armies to ten detachments under a policy of contraction and preservation of strength.

fields.name: 伯力会议决定抗联缩编为支队 The Khabarovsk conference: reduction to brigade-sized detachments
fields.summary: 1940年1月24日，周保中、冯仲云、赵尚志在伯力开会，决定将抗联11个军缩编为10个支队，实行「逐渐收缩、保存实力」。 On 24 January 1940 Zhou Baozhong, Feng Zhongyun and Zhao Shangzhi met at Khabarovsk and decided to reduce the 11 armies to ten detachments under a policy of contraction and preservation of strength.
fields.description: 1940 年 1 月 24 日，中共吉东、北满省委代表周保中、冯仲云、赵尚志在苏联伯力（哈巴罗夫斯克）召开会议（第一次伯力会议），总结东北游击运动，确定「逐渐收缩、保存实力」的方针，决定改组军队体制为「路军—支队—大队—中队—小队」。会议拟定：第一路军各部编为第一、第四、第七支队；第二路军各部编为第二、第五、第八支队；第三路军各部编为第三、第六、第九、第十二支队，共 10 个支队。此时抗联已由鼎盛时的 3 万余人减至不足 2000 人，原有游击根据地大多被破坏。伯力会议后，冯仲云等返回东北传达；第一路军远在南满、被敌隔断，未能及时传达，仍以军、方面军番号活动到 1941 年。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 On 24 January 1940 Zhou Baozhong, Feng Zhongyun and Zhao Shangzhi, representing the Jilin-Dongman and North Manchurian committees, met at Khabarovsk (the first Khabarovsk conference). They reviewed the guerrilla war, adopted a policy of “gradual contraction and preservation of strength”, and reorganised the forces into a hierarchy of route army, detachment, battalion, company and squad. The plan provided for the 1st Route Army to form the 1st, 4th and 7th Detachments, the 2nd the 2nd, 5th and 8th, and the 3rd the 3rd, 6th, 9th and 12th — ten in all. By then the United Army had shrunk from over 30,000 at its height to under 2,000, and most base areas had been destroyed. Feng Zhongyun and others returned to pass on the decisions, but the 1st Route Army, cut off in the south, did not receive them in time and kept its army and front-group designations into 1941. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

fields.description: 1940 年初昆仑关战役结束后，第5军经南宁、百色移驻云南昆明、杨林一带整训。1942 年 2 月，第5军作为中国远征军先头部队自云南入缅。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 After the Battle of Kunlun Pass in early 1940, the 5th Army moved via Nanning and Bose to Kunming and Yanglin in Yunnan for training. In February 1942 it entered Burma as the spearhead of the Chinese Expeditionary Force. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 毛泽东《新民主主义论》发表 Publication of Mao Zedong’s “On New Democracy”
fields.summary: 1940 年 2 月 15 日，毛泽东《新民主主义的政治与新民主主义的文化》在《中国文化》创刊号发表，后改题《新民主主义论》。 On 15 February 1940 Mao’s essay on New Democratic politics and culture appeared in the inaugural issue of Chinese Culture, later titled “On New Democracy”.
fields.description: 1940 年 2 月 15 日，毛泽东的《新民主主义的政治与新民主主义的文化》在延安《中国文化》创刊号发表，后改题《新民主主义论》。文章系统回答中国革命的性质、动力、前途和步骤，指出中国革命必须分两步走：第一步是新民主主义革命，第二步是社会主义革命；新民主主义共和国既不同于欧美式的资产阶级共和国，也不同于苏联式的社会主义共和国，而是几个革命阶级联合专政的民主共和国。文章还阐述了新民主主义的政治、经济和文化纲领。该文与《〈共产党人〉发刊词》《中国革命和中国共产党》一起，标志着新民主主义理论体系的形成。本事件为理论文章，不绘路线。 On 15 February 1940 Mao Zedong’s “The Politics and Culture of New Democracy” appeared in the inaugural issue of Chinese Culture at Yan’an, later retitled “On New Democracy”. It systematically addressed the character, motive forces, prospects and stages of the Chinese revolution, arguing that it must proceed in two steps — first a New Democratic revolution, then a socialist one. The New Democratic republic would differ both from the bourgeois republics of Europe and America and from the Soviet socialist republic, being a democratic republic under the joint dictatorship of several revolutionary classes. The essay also set out New Democratic political, economic and cultural programmes. With the preface to The Communist and “The Chinese Revolution and the Chinese Communist Party”, it marked the formation of New Democratic theory.

fields.summary: 1940年2月22日，日军占领荣成，山东107县全部沦陷。 On 22 February 1940 Japanese forces occupied Rongcheng, completing the occupation of all 107 counties in Shandong.
fields.description: 1940年2月22日，日军占领荣成县。至此，山东全省107个县全部沦陷。荣成是山东最后一个沦陷的县城，此后山东抗战进入全境敌后阶段。日期据《抗战期间沦陷的县城》与《山东抗日战争大事记（1939-1945）》，待页码级核对。 On 22 February 1940 Japanese forces occupied Rongcheng, the last county town in Shandong to fall; all 107 counties were now occupied. The war in Shandong then entered an entirely behind-the-lines phase. The date follows the occupied-county list and the 1939–1945 Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 杨靖宇牺牲 Death of Yang Jingyu
fields.place: 吉林濛江（今靖宇） Mengjiang (modern Jingyu), Jilin
fields.summary: 1940年2月23日，东北抗联第一路军总司令杨靖宇在濛江县城西南孤身战死，年35岁。 On 23 February 1940 Yang Jingyu, commander of the United Army’s 1st Route Army, died fighting alone south-west of Mengjiang county town; he was 35.
fields.description: 杨靖宇原名马尚德，1905 年生于河南确山，1929 年赴东北，历任中共哈尔滨市委书记、满洲省委军委代理书记。1933 年任南满游击队政治委员，1934 年 11 月任东北人民革命军第一军军长兼政委，1936 年 7 月任东北抗日联军第一路军总司令兼政委。1939 年 10 月起，日伪以「野副大讨伐」调集数万人「讨伐」东南满，杨靖宇将部队化整为零；至 1940 年 2 月，身边战士相继牺牲，他孤身与敌周旋五昼夜。2 月 23 日 16 时 30 分，在濛江县城西南 5 公里、标高 490 米附近（保安村三道崴子）被日伪军警包围，拒绝诱降，倚树持枪抵抗，身中数弹牺牲，年 35 岁。日军解剖遗体，胃肠中只有草根、树皮与棉絮。1946 年 2 月 14 日，濛江县改名靖宇县。牺牲时间与地点据黑龙江省档案馆 2025 年披露的日伪档案《绥阳国境警察队本队关于杨靖宇被射杀的通报》。本事件不绘路线。 Yang Jingyu, born Ma Shangde in Queshan, Henan, in 1905, went to the Northeast in 1929 and served as Harbin party secretary and acting head of the Manchurian Provincial Committee’s military department. He became political commissar of the South Manchurian guerrillas in 1933, commander and commissar of the 1st Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army in November 1934, and commander and commissar of the United Army’s 1st Route Army in July 1936. From October 1939 the Japanese “Noshirao punitive campaign” poured tens of thousands of troops into the south-east Manchurian base areas and Yang dispersed his force; by February 1940 his remaining soldiers had died one after another and he fought alone for five days and nights. At 16:30 on 23 February he was surrounded about five kilometres south-west of Mengjiang county town, near elevation marker 490 (Sandaowaizi, Bao’an village); he refused to surrender, fought leaning against a tree and was shot dead, aged 35. The Japanese autopsied him and found only grass, bark and cotton in his stomach. Mengjiang county was renamed Jingyu on 14 February 1946. The time and place follow the puppet police report of 16 March 1940 disclosed by the Heilongjiang Provincial Archives in 2025. No route is drawn.

fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 6 日，日军一部从海路登陆中山唐家、香洲，随后攻陷前山、坦洲、翠亨，配合从顺德南下的主力包围石岐。日期据中山地方史，待页码级核对。 On 6 March 1940 a Japanese force landed by sea at Tangjia and Xiangzhou in Zhongshan and then took Qianshan, Tanzhou and Cuiheng, cooperating with the main force advancing south from Shunde to envelop Shiqi. The date follows Zhongshan local history and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 中共中央《抗日根据地的政权问题》指示（三三制）
name.en: CCP directive on the “three-thirds” system in base-area government

summary.zh: 1940 年 3 月 6 日，毛泽东为中共中央起草指示，提出抗日根据地政权实行「三三制」。
summary.en: On 6 March 1940 Mao drafted the Central Committee directive establishing the “three-thirds” principle in anti-Japanese base-area government.

fields.name: 中共中央《抗日根据地的政权问题》指示（三三制） CCP directive on the “three-thirds” system in base-area government
fields.summary: 1940 年 3 月 6 日，毛泽东为中共中央起草指示，提出抗日根据地政权实行「三三制」。 On 6 March 1940 Mao drafted the Central Committee directive establishing the “three-thirds” principle in anti-Japanese base-area government.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 6 日，毛泽东为中共中央起草《抗日根据地的政权问题》党内指示，指出抗日时期建立的政权是民族统一战线性质的政权，是一切赞成抗日又赞成民主的人们的政权。在人员分配上，规定共产党员占三分之一，非党的左派进步分子占三分之一，不左不右的中间派占三分之一，即「三三制」。指示强调，必须保证共产党员在政权中的领导地位，但领导权不是靠人数多，而是靠正确政策和模范工作去说服党外人士。三三制先在陕甘宁边区陇东、绥德等分区试点，后推广到各抗日根据地。本事件为中央指示，不绘路线。 On 6 March 1940 Mao Zedong drafted for the Central Committee an internal directive on the government of anti-Japanese base areas. It defined the wartime government as a national united-front government of all who supported resistance and democracy, and laid down the “three-thirds” allocation: one third Communists, one third non-Party left progressives, and one third middle-of-the-road elements. It stressed that Communist leadership must be guaranteed, but that leadership rested not on numbers but on correct policies and exemplary work that persuaded non-Party people. The system was piloted in the Longdong and Suide sub-districts of the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region and then extended to other base areas. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 日军藤井兵团入侵中山，占领石岐。
summary.en: The Japanese Fujii Brigade invaded Zhongshan and occupied Shiqi.

fields.name: 中山（石岐）沦陷 Fall of Zhongshan (Shiqi)
fields.place: 广东中山石岐 Shiqi, Zhongshan, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军藤井兵团入侵中山，占领石岐。 The Japanese Fujii Brigade invaded Zhongshan and occupied Shiqi.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 5 日，日军藤井兵团约 1 万人入侵中山，一路从顺德攻入大小黄圃，一路从海路登陆唐家、香洲；3 月 7 日占领石岐，3 月 15 日占小榄，中山县境大部分沦陷。日期据中山地方史，待页码级核对。 On 5 March 1940 the Japanese Fujii Brigade, about 10,000 strong, invaded Zhongshan: one column entered Dahuangpu and Xiaohuangpu from Shunde, another landed by sea at Tangjia and Xiangzhou. Shiqi fell on 7 March and Xiaolan on 15 March, and most of Zhongshan was occupied. The date follows Zhongshan local history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese seizure of the Shilu iron mine

fields.name: 日军占领石碌铁矿 Japanese seizure of the Shilu iron mine
fields.place: 海南昌江石碌 Shilu, Changjiang, Hainan
fields.summary: 日军占领石碌铁矿，随后修铁路、建八所港，掠夺海南铁矿资源。 Japan seized the Shilu iron mine, then built a railway and the Basuo port to extract Hainan’s iron ore.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，日军占领昌江石碌（今属昌江黎族自治县），此后开发石碌铁矿、修建石碌—八所港铁路和八所港，强征大批劳工，将铁矿石运往日本。田独、石碌、羊角岭水晶和那大锡矿是日军在海南重点掠夺的资源。据综述，1939—1945 年海南开采铁矿砂 338 万吨，其中 282 万吨运往日本；数字为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces occupied Shilu in Changjiang (now Changjiang Li Autonomous County). They subsequently developed the Shilu iron mine, built the Shilu–Basuo railway and Basuo port, conscripted large numbers of labourers and shipped iron ore to Japan. Tian du, Shilu, the Yangjiaoling crystal mine and the Nada tin mine were among the resources Japan exploited most intensively in Hainan. According to survey accounts, 3.38 million tons of iron ore were mined in Hainan in 1939–1945, of which 2.82 million tons were shipped to Japan; these figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 保亭沦陷 Fall of Baoting
fields.summary: 日军自陵水方向进攻，占领保亭县城。 Japanese forces advanced from Lingshui and occupied Baoting county town.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻陵水日军出占保亭县城。保亭地处五指山南麓，是日军向中部山区渗透的节点。另有 1940 年 7 月 16 日占领说，日期待页码级核对。 On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Lingshui occupied Baoting county town. Baoting lies on the southern slope of the Wuzhishan range and was a Japanese node for penetration into the central mountains. Another account gives 16 July 1940; the date awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 乐东沦陷 Fall of Ledong
fields.place: 海南乐东抱由 Baoyou, Ledong, Hainan
fields.summary: 日军自崖县方向进攻，占领乐东县城。 Japanese forces advanced from Ya county and occupied Ledong county town.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻崖县日军出占乐东县城（抱由）。乐东地处五指山西南，失守后日军与崖县、感恩据点相连，但山区仍为琼崖抗日武装活动区。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。 On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Ya county occupied Ledong county town (Baoyou). Ledong lies southwest of the Wuzhishan range; after its fall Japanese garrisons linked up with Ya county and Gan’en, but the mountains remained an area of Qiongya anti-Japanese activity. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: By March 1940 Japan had occupied Hainan’s coastal county towns, ports and roads, except Baisha county town and the Wuzhishan mountains.

fields.name: 日军占领海南环岛县城与据点 Japanese Occupation of Hainan’s Coastal County Towns and Garrisons
fields.summary: 至 1940 年 3 月，日军占领海南除白沙县城和五指山周围山区外的环岛县城、港口与交通线。 By March 1940 Japan had occupied Hainan’s coastal county towns, ports and roads, except Baisha county town and the Wuzhishan mountains.
fields.description: 至 1940 年 3 月，日军已占领海南岛 14 个县的县城和大部分市镇：琼山、文昌、定安、澄迈、琼东、乐东、万宁、陵水、临高、儋县、崖县、昌江、感恩、保亭；在环岛沿海和内陆山区设 360 多个军事据点，在县城、乡镇设 195 个维持会/分会。白沙县城和五指山及其周围山区未被长期占领，是琼崖抗日根据地。日军仍不断对根据地“蚕食”“扫荡”。数字据海南史志网综述，待页码级核对。本事件为占领范围总览，不绘单线。 By March 1940 Japan had occupied the county towns and most market towns of Hainan’s 14 counties: Qiongshan, Wenchang, Ding’an, Chengmai, Qiongdong, Ledong, Wanning, Lingshui, Lingao, Dan county, Ya county, Changjiang, Gan’en and Baoting. It established more than 360 military posts along the coast and in the interior and 195 maintenance associations or branches in county and market towns. Baisha county town and the Wuzhishan mountains were not permanently occupied and remained the Qiongya anti-Japanese base area; Japan continued “nibbling” and “sweeping” operations against it. Figures follow Hainan local history and await page-level verification. This is an overview of the occupied area, not a single route.

summary.zh: 1940年4月3日至9日，周保中在虎林主持第七军党代会，决定第七军改编为第二路军第二支队。
summary.en: From 3 to 9 April 1940 Zhou Baozhong chaired the 7th Army congress at Hulin, which turned the army into the 2nd Route Army’s 2nd Detachment.

fields.name: 第七军改编为第二支队 The 7th Army becomes the 2nd Detachment
fields.place: 吉林虎林小木河 Xiaomuhe, Hulin, Jilin
fields.summary: 1940年4月3日至9日，周保中在虎林主持第七军党代会，决定第七军改编为第二路军第二支队。 From 3 to 9 April 1940 Zhou Baozhong chaired the 7th Army congress at Hulin, which turned the army into the 2nd Route Army’s 2nd Detachment.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 28 日，第二路军总指挥周保中、副总指挥赵尚志带小部队到虎林县小木河北部与第七军会合。4 月 3 日至 9 日，周保中主持召开第七军党代表大会，传达伯力会议精神，决定将第七军改编为第二路军第二支队：支队长王汝起，副支队长刘雁来，政治委员王效明；下设两个大队和一個教导大队，原第一师改编为第一大队，第三师改编为第二大队。4 月 21 日，王汝起在饶河虎头山伏击伪山林警察队时牺牲，由王效明继任支队长。会议地点各说不一：一说虎林县小木河，一说宝清县小穆河。本事件取虎林小木河，并存异说。本事件不绘路线。 On 28 March 1940 Zhou Baozhong, commander of the 2nd Route Army, and his deputy Zhao Shangzhi reached the 7th Army north of Xiaomuhe in Hulin county with a small party. From 3 to 9 April Zhou chaired the 7th Army party congress, which relayed the Khabarovsk decisions and converted the army into the 2nd Route Army’s 2nd Detachment: Wang Ruqi as commander, Liu Yanlai as deputy and Wang Xiaoming as political commissar, with two battalions and a training battalion formed from the old 1st and 3rd Divisions. On 21 April Wang Ruqi was killed ambushing a puppet forest police patrol at Hutou Mountain in Raohe, and Wang Xiaoming succeeded him. The meeting place is disputed — Xiaomuhe in Hulin or Xiaomuhe in Baoqing; this entry follows Hulin and notes the variant. No route is drawn.

name.zh: 第三路军改编为四个支队
name.en: The 3rd Route Army becomes four detachments

summary.zh: 1940年4月，冯仲云抵海伦传达伯力会议精神，第三路军改编为第三、第六、第九、第十二支队。
summary.en: In April 1940 Feng Zhongyun reached Hailun with the Khabarovsk decisions, and the 3rd Route Army was reorganised into the 3rd, 6th, 9th and 12th Detachments.

fields.name: 第三路军改编为四个支队 The 3rd Route Army becomes four detachments
fields.summary: 1940年4月，冯仲云抵海伦传达伯力会议精神，第三路军改编为第三、第六、第九、第十二支队。 In April 1940 Feng Zhongyun reached Hailun with the Khabarovsk decisions, and the 3rd Route Army was reorganised into the 3rd, 6th, 9th and 12th Detachments.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 22 日，冯仲云离伯力回国，穿越封锁，4 月 13 日到达海伦，会见第三路军总指挥张寿篯（李兆麟），传达伯力会议精神。随后第三路军将各部改编为四个支队：第三支队（支队长王明贵，政委赵敬夫，参谋长王钧，以德都朝阳山为后方，活动于嫩江、讷河、德都、阿荣旗一带）、第六支队（支队长张光迪，政委于天放，活动于拜泉、明水、海伦、绥化、兰西一带）、第九支队（支队长陈绍宾，政委周云峰，后高禹民，活动于北安、通北、克山、克东、拜泉一带）、第十二支队（支队长戴鸿宾，政委许亨植兼，活动于绥化、望奎、巴彦、肇东、肇州、肇源一带）。改编后取消军一级番号，原第三、第六、第九、第十一军分别编入各支队。具体改编地点各说不一：一说在海伦，一说在木沟河后方基地，一说在南北河，均在 1940 年 4 月。本事件取冯仲云抵达海伦传达之日。本事件不绘路线。 Feng Zhongyun left Khabarovsk on 22 March 1940, crossed the blockade and reached Hailun on 13 April, where he met the 3rd Route Army commander Zhang Shouqian (Li Zhaolin) and passed on the Khabarovsk decisions. The army was then reorganised into four detachments: the 3rd (Wang Minggui, political commissar Zhao Jingfu, chief of staff Wang Jun, based on Chaoyang Mountain in Dedu and operating in Nenjiang, Nehe, Dedu and Arun Banner), the 6th (Zhang Guangdi, Yu Tianfang, in Baiquan, Mingshui, Hailun, Suihua and Lanxi), the 9th (Chen Shaobin, Zhou Yunfeng, later Gao Yumin, in Bei’an, Tongbei, Keshan, Kedong and Baiquan) and the 12th (Dai Hongbin with Xu Hengzhi as concurrent commissar, in Suihua, Wangkui, Bayan, Zhaodong, Zhaozhou and Zhaoyuan). The army-level designations were abolished and the former 3rd, 6th, 9th and 11th Armies were distributed among the detachments. The place of the reorganisation is disputed — Hailun, the Mugouhe base or Nanbeihe, all in April 1940; this entry follows the date of Feng’s arrival at Hailun. No route is drawn.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Zaoyang and Yichang areas; Chinese troops resisted stubbornly, Zhang Zizhong was killed, and Yichang eventually fell.

fields.name: 枣宜会战 Battle of Zaoyang–Yichang 枣宜战役 Zaoyi Campaign
fields.summary: 日军进攻枣阳、宜昌地区，中国军队顽强抵抗，张自忠殉国，宜昌最终失守。 Japanese forces attacked the Zaoyang and Yichang areas; Chinese troops resisted stubbornly, Zhang Zizhong was killed, and Yichang eventually fell.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月，日军第十一军向枣阳、襄阳、宜昌地区发动进攻，企图歼灭中国第五战区主力并控制长江上游门户。中国军队在枣阳、襄阳一线抵抗，第 33 集团军总司令张自忠在宜城南瓜店战斗中殉国。6 月，宜昌失守。此役中国军队伤亡重大，但保持了战区主力。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1940, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Zaoyang, Xiangyang, and Yichang areas, seeking to destroy the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone and control the upper Yangtze gateway. Chinese troops resisted along the Zaoyang–Xiangyang line, and Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Army Group, was killed in action near Nanguadian in Yicheng. Yichang fell in June. Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties but preserved the bulk of the war zone’s strength. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.place: 湖北宜城南瓜店 Nanguadian, Yicheng, Hubei
fields.summary: 第33集团军总司令张自忠在枣宜会战中于南瓜店殉国。 General Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Group Army, died at Nanguadian during the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月，枣宜会战期间，第33集团军总司令张自忠率部渡襄河督战，5 月 16 日在宜城南瓜店被日军包围，力战殉国，是抗战中阵亡的最高级别中国将领之一。 人物事件，随第33集团军路线标注；日期与地点待史料校订。 In May 1940, during the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign, General Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Group Army, crossed the Xiang River to direct operations. On 16 May he was surrounded by Japanese forces at Nanguadian in Yicheng and died fighting, one of the most senior Chinese commanders killed in the war. A biographical event marked with the 33rd Group Army route; dates and location await historical review.

fields.name: 花县失守（第二次粤北） Fall of Hua County (Second Northern Guangdong Campaign)
fields.place: 广东花县 Hua county, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第 104 师团一部进攻花县，县城失守。 Elements of the Japanese 104th Division attacked Hua county and captured the county town.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月 16 日，日军第 104 师团一部与伪军 1000 余人分别由象山、两龙向十八岭、牛牯岭进犯，中国第 158 师抵抗数日后退守福源水、正迳花、街亭一带高地，花县县城失守。6 月 1 日中国军队收复花县。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。本事件不在 123 路线上，标 routeEvent:false。 On 16 May 1940 elements of the Japanese 104th Division and more than 1,000 puppet troops attacked Shibaling and Niuguling from Xiangshan and Lianglong. The Chinese 158th Division resisted for several days before withdrawing to high ground at Fuyuanshui, Zhengjinghua and Jieting, and the county town fell. Chinese forces recovered Hua county on 1 June. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification. This event is not on route 123 and is marked routeEvent:false.

Jiekou fell on 17 May and the Chinese 187th Division withdrew to Hecun, Xinzhuang and Baishishan. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1940 年 5 月 20 日，日军第 38 师团突破中国第 152 师李寨顶阵地，占领良口；22 日又攻占横坑、石榴花顶。中国军队随后在良口东西北三面反击。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 20 May 1940 the Japanese 38th Division broke the Chinese 152nd Division’s Lizhaiding position and occupied Liangkou; on 22 May it took Hengkeng and Shiliuhuading. Chinese forces then counterattacked from the east, west and north of Liangkou. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shiliuhuading and the Chinese 152nd Division fought a stubborn defense.

fields.name: 石榴花顶战斗 Battle of Shiliuhuading
fields.place: 广东从化良口石榴花顶 Shiliuhuading, Liangkou, Conghua, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军进攻石榴花顶，中国第 152 师顽强阻击。 Japanese forces attacked Shiliuhuading and the Chinese 152nd Division fought a stubborn defense.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月 22 日凌晨，日军集中飞机、大炮向石榴花顶阵地猛攻，并施放毒气；中国第 152 师多次击退日军，终因兵力不足退至五指山阵地。24 日中国军队全线反攻，6 月 1 日日军退却，3 日收复良口。日期据从化文史网，待页码级核对。 Before dawn on 22 May 1940 Japanese forces concentrated aircraft and artillery against the Shiliuhuading position and used poison gas; the Chinese 152nd Division repelled several attacks but withdrew to Wuzhishan for lack of strength. On 24 May Chinese forces counterattacked all along the line; the Japanese withdrew on 1 June and Liangkou was recovered on 3 June. The date follows Conghua local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1940年5月31日夜日军第3、第39师团强渡汉水，6月1日攻占襄阳。中国军队3日收复襄阳，日军遂南下进攻宜城、宜昌。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视《抗战老兵忆枣宜会战》。 On the night of 31 May 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions crossed the Han River and took Xiangyang on 1 June. fields.description: 1940年6月3日日军第39师团攻占宜城。宜城为汉水西岸要地，失守后日军第3、第39师团并列南下荆门、当阳。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与维基百科《枣宜会战》。 On 3 June 1940 the Japanese 39th Division took Yicheng on the west bank of the Han River; the 3rd and 39th Divisions then advanced south abreast toward Jingmen and Dangyang.

summary.zh: 1940年6月4日，731部队在农安投撒鼠疫跳蚤，引发鼠疫。
summary.en: On 4 June 1940 Unit 731 dropped plague-infected fleas on Nong’an, triggering an outbreak.

fields.name: 农安细菌战 Nong’an Bacteriological Attack
fields.summary: 1940年6月4日，731部队在农安投撒鼠疫跳蚤，引发鼠疫。 On 4 June 1940 Unit 731 dropped plague-infected fleas on Nong’an, triggering an outbreak.
fields.description: 1940年6月4日，日军731部队在吉林农安投下鼠疫跳蚤5克，致8人死亡，疫情最终传染607人；6月4日至7日又在农安、大赉投撒鼠疫跳蚤。据731部队军医金子顺一博士论文与战后调查，此次鼠疫系日军细菌战“谋略”所致，并与浙江细菌战同期进行。日期据《1940年农安鼠疫》与《关于731部队实施农安细菌战的考察》。 On 4 June 1940 Unit 731 dropped five grams of plague-infected fleas on Nong’an in Jilin, killing eight people and eventually infecting 607. From 4 to 7 June further plague fleas were dropped on Nong’an and Dalai. According to the dissertation of Unit 731 medical officer Kaneko Jun’ichi and postwar research, the outbreak was caused by a Japanese bacteriological warfare operation conducted alongside the Zhejiang attacks.

fields.name: 荆门沦陷 Fall of Jingmen
fields.summary: 1940年6月6日，日军第13师团、池田支队攻占荆门。 On 6 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment captured Jingmen.
fields.description: 1940年6月6日日军第13师团、池田支队攻占荆门。此前日军从钟祥旧口、沙洋强渡汉水，荆门失守后与北线日军对当阳形成南北夹击。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视《抗战老兵忆枣宜会战》。 On 6 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment took Jingmen after crossing the Han River at Jiukou and Shayang. Its fall completed the north–south pincer against Dangyang.

fields.name: 荆州沦陷 Fall of Jingzhou
fields.summary: 1940年6月8日，日军第13师团、池田支队攻占江陵（荆州），同日沙市沦陷。 On 8 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment captured Jiangling (Jingzhou); Shashi fell the same day.
fields.description: 1940年6月8日日军第13师团、池田支队攻占江陵（荆州），同日沙市沦陷。江陵为长江中游重镇，失守后日军沿江西进宜昌。央视记6月7日江陵失守，正文并列。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视。 On 8 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment took Jiangling (Jingzhou), and Shashi fell the same day. Jiangling was the key city of the middle Yangtze; the Japanese then moved upriver toward Yichang. CCTV gives 7 June; that variant is noted.

summary.zh: 1940年6月9日，日军第3、第39师团攻占当阳。
summary.en: On 9 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions captured Dangyang.

fields.name: 当阳沦陷 Fall of Dangyang
fields.summary: 1940年6月9日，日军第3、第39师团攻占当阳。 On 9 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions captured Dangyang.
fields.description: 1940年6月9日日军第3、第39师团攻占当阳。中国第18军第11师在当阳长坂坡一带顽强抵抗，终因两侧友军后撤而撤退。当阳失守后，宜昌门户洞开。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视。 On 9 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions took Dangyang. The Chinese 11th Division of the 18th Corps fought stubbornly around Changbanpo but withdrew when both flanks gave way. The fall of Dangyang opened the gate to Yichang.

summary.zh: 1940年6月10日，日军第3师团攻抵远安，远安沦陷，次日被中国军队克复。
summary.en: On 10 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd Division reached and took Yuan'an, which the Chinese retook the next day.

fields.name: 远安沦陷 Fall of Yuan'an
fields.summary: 1940年6月10日，日军第3师团攻抵远安，远安沦陷，次日被中国军队克复。 On 10 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd Division reached and took Yuan'an, which the Chinese retook the next day.
fields.description: 1940年6月，枣宜会战第二阶段，日军第3师团自襄阳、南漳南下。6月6日荆门失陷后，日军继续西进，6月7日向毛家山、毛家店、石板滩李延年第2军阵地进攻，图攻略远安。6月8日，第3师团自远安以北观音洞一带南攻，当晚突破远安防线；6月10日攻抵远安，远安沦陷。6月11日，中国军队克复远安。远安地处荆山南麓，为当阳、宜昌西北屏障，其失守使宜昌西北门户洞开。日期取《民国军事史》与郭廷以《中华民国史事日志》；《宜昌记忆》《随枣会战之宜昌沦陷》记远安与当阳同日（6 月 9 日）沦陷，异说并存。 In June 1940, in the second phase of the Zaoyang–Yichang battle, the Japanese 3rd Division advanced south from Xiangyang and Nanzhang. After Jingmen fell on 6 June the Japanese pushed west, attacking Li Yannian's 2nd Army at Maojiashan, Maojiadian and Shibantan on the 7th with the aim of taking Yuan'an. On 8 June the 3rd Division attacked south from the Guanyindong area north of Yuan'an and broke the Yuan'an line that evening; on 10 June it reached and took Yuan'an, which the Chinese recovered on the 11th. Yuan'an lies at the southern foot of the Jing hills and covers the north-western approaches to Dangyang and Yichang, so its loss opened Yichang's north-western gate. The date follows the Republican Military History and Guo Tingyi's chronological record; the Yichang Memoir and the account of the fall of Yichang give 9 June, the same day as Dangyang, and both are recorded.

summary.zh: 枣宜会战后期日军攻占宜昌，长江上游门户失守。
summary.en: Late in the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign, Japanese forces captured Yichang, the gateway to the upper Yangtze.

fields.name: 宜昌沦陷 Fall of Yichang
fields.summary: 枣宜会战后期日军攻占宜昌，长江上游门户失守。 Late in the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign, Japanese forces captured Yichang, the gateway to the upper Yangtze.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月，日军发动枣宜会战。6 月 12 日，日军第 13 军等部攻占宜昌，中国军队反攻未克。宜昌是长江上游重要门户，沦陷后重庆受到更大威胁。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1940 Japan launched the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign. On 12 June the Japanese 13th Army and other units captured Yichang; Chinese counterattacks failed to retake it. Yichang was the gateway to the upper Yangtze, and its fall increased the threat to Chongqing. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 日本迫使法国封闭滇越铁路
name.en: Japan Forces Closure of the Yunnan–Indochina Railway

summary.zh: 1940年6月20日，法国屈从日本压力封闭滇越铁路，中国西南国际通道被切断。
summary.en: On 20 June 1940 France yielded to Japanese pressure and closed the Yunnan–Indochina Railway, cutting a key supply route into China.

fields.name: 日本迫使法国封闭滇越铁路 Japan Forces Closure of the Yunnan–Indochina Railway
fields.place: 云南滇越铁路沿线 Yunnan–Indochina Railway, Yunnan
fields.summary: 1940年6月20日，法国屈从日本压力封闭滇越铁路，中国西南国际通道被切断。 On 20 June 1940 France yielded to Japanese pressure and closed the Yunnan–Indochina Railway, cutting a key supply route into China.
fields.description: 1940年6月，法国在对德战争中失败，贝当政府成立。日本借机要求法国殖民政府停止中越运输。6月20日，法国政府屈从日本要求，突然封闭滇越铁路，禁止物资输入中国，中国经越南的西南国际通道被切断。日期据《法国关闭滇越铁路》与《滇越铁路：抗战中不屈的钢铁脊梁》。 In June 1940 France was defeated by Germany and the Petain government took power. Japan seized the moment to demand that the French colonial authorities halt transport between China and Vietnam. On 20 June the French government yielded and abruptly closed the Yunnan–Indochina Railway to goods bound for China, cutting China’s south-western supply route through Vietnam.

fields.name: 宝安（深圳）第三次沦陷 Third Fall of Bao’an (Shenzhen)
fields.place: 广东宝安南头（今深圳） Nantou, Bao’an (present-day Shenzhen), Guangdong

fields.description: 1940 年 6 月 22 日，日军第 18 师团在赤湾登陆，当天占领南头、深圳镇，宝安第三次沦陷。此后日军长期盘踞宝安，直至 1945 年投降。日期据《深圳通史》，待页码级核对。 On 22 June 1940 the Japanese 18th Division landed at Chiwan and occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town the same day, the third fall of Bao’an. Japanese forces then remained in Bao’an until their surrender in 1945. The date follows the Shenzhen History and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces attacked Yongning, burning nearly 300 boats and more than 90 houses and killing over 80 villagers.

fields.name: 永宁惨案 Yongning Massacre
fields.summary: 1940年7月16日，日军进犯永宁，焚毁船舶近300艘、房屋90多座，杀害村民80多人。 On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces attacked Yongning, burning nearly 300 boats and more than 90 houses and killing over 80 villagers.
fields.description: 7月16日，日本侵略军300多人在飞机、军舰掩护下，分3路进犯永宁。驻外高村20多名海防战士浴血奋战。日军占领永宁，大肆烧杀掠夺，十几个村庄惨遭其害，焚毁船舶近300艘、房屋90多座、学校3所，杀害村民80多人，财物被抢劫一空。史称「永宁惨案」。 On 16 July more than 300 Japanese troops, covered by aircraft and warships, attacked Yongning in three columns. More than 20 coastal defence soldiers at Waigao village fought to the death. The Japanese occupied Yongning and burned, killed and looted across more than a dozen villages, destroying nearly 300 boats, over 90 houses and three schools, killing more than 80 villagers and seizing property. It is known as the Yongning massacre.

summary.en: On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces landed at Chongwu, killing 93 people and burning 521 fishing and merchant boats.

fields.name: 崇武惨案 Chongwu Massacre
fields.summary: 1940年7月16日，日军登陆崇武，杀害民众93人，焚毁渔船商船521艘。 On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces landed at Chongwu, killing 93 people and burning 521 fishing and merchant boats.
fields.description: 7月16日，日机6架分2批侵入惠安崇武、獭窟等地轰炸，日舰同时向陆上开炮。稍后，日军500多人从后海、三屿、港墘等处登陆，窜入崇武城；另一支日军200多人从獭窟登陆。仅崇武一地民众死93人、伤40人，被烧毁渔、商船521艘，烧毁房屋566间、庙宇1座，其他财产损失无数。史称「崇武惨案」。 On 16 July six Japanese aircraft in two waves bombed Chongwu and Taku in Hui'an while warships shelled the coast. More than 500 Japanese troops then landed at Houhai, Sanyu and Gangqian and entered Chongwu, while another 200 landed at Taku. In Chongwu alone 93 civilians were killed and 40 wounded, 521 fishing and merchant boats and 566 houses were burned, along with a temple, and other property was lost. It is known as the Chongwu massacre.

fields.name: 镇海沦陷与收复 Zhenhai: Occupation and Recovery
fields.summary: 1940年7月17日，日军侵占镇海，7月22日被中国军队收复。 On 17 July 1940 Japanese forces occupied Zhenhai; Chinese troops recovered it on 22 July.
fields.description: 7月17日，日军侵占镇海城关、小港、江南等地。18日，国民党守军第194师在第16师48团增援下反击，师长陈德法亲临前线指挥，经五昼夜血战，于22日晨击退日军，收复失地，共击毙日军近400名。此役是浙东抗战的重要胜利。日期据《宁波抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 17 July Japanese forces occupied Zhenhai's city area, Xiaogang and Jiangnan. On 18 July the Chinese 194th Division, reinforced by the 48th Regiment of the 16th Division and commanded personally by divisional commander Chen Defa, counter-attacked. After five days and nights of fighting they drove the Japanese back on the morning of 22 July, recovering the lost ground and killing nearly 400 Japanese troops. The date follows the Ningbo war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 日本胁迫英国封闭滇缅公路
name.en: Japan Presses Britain to Close the Burma Road

summary.zh: 1940年7月18日，英国屈从日本压力封闭滇缅公路三个月。
summary.en: On 18 July 1940 Britain yielded to Japanese pressure and closed the Burma Road for three months.

fields.name: 日本胁迫英国封闭滇缅公路 Japan Presses Britain to Close the Burma Road
fields.place: 云南滇缅公路沿线 Burma Road, Yunnan
fields.summary: 1940年7月18日，英国屈从日本压力封闭滇缅公路三个月。 On 18 July 1940 Britain yielded to Japanese pressure and closed the Burma Road for three months.
fields.description: 1940年6月24日，日本向英国提出封锁滇缅公路要求。7月17日英日达成《关于封闭滇缅公路的协定》，规定自7月18日起三个月内禁止通过缅甸向中国运输军械、弹药等物资。滇缅公路被封闭三个月，中国对外通道进一步收窄，10月重新开放。日期据国立政治大学《英国暂时封闭滇缅公路之始末》与光明网《滇缅公路重新开放》。 On 24 June 1940 Japan demanded that Britain close the Burma Road. On 17 July Britain and Japan concluded an agreement providing that for three months from 18 July no arms, ammunition or other supplies would be carried to China through Burma. The road was closed for three months and reopened in October, further narrowing China’s external supply lines.
fields.entities: 日本 Japan 盟军与中国远征军 Allied Forces and Chinese Expeditionary Force

fields.name: 成都“七二四”大轰炸 Chengdu Bombing of 24 July 1940
fields.summary: 1940年7月24日，日机36架空袭成都，投弹135枚。 On 24 July 1940 thirty-six Japanese aircraft raided Chengdu, dropping 135 bombs.
fields.description: 1940年7月24日午后，日机36架空袭成都，投弹135枚，轰炸城东一带，炸死103人、炸伤114人，房屋被毁3425间。中国空军在空战中击落日机1架。日期据《成都空战》与《成都大轰炸》。 On the afternoon of 24 July 1940 thirty-six Japanese aircraft raided Chengdu, dropping 135 bombs on the eastern part of the city, killing 103, wounding 114 and destroying 3,425 rooms. Chinese fighters shot down one Japanese aircraft.
