summary.zh: 1940年7月31日，18架日机轮番轰炸涪陵闹市，投弹逾百枚，死数百人。
summary.en: On 31 July 1940 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed central Fuling repeatedly, dropping over a hundred bombs and killing hundreds.

fields.name: 涪陵“七三一”大轰炸 Bombing of Fuling, 31 July 1940
fields.summary: 1940年7月31日，18架日机轮番轰炸涪陵闹市，投弹逾百枚，死数百人。 On 31 July 1940 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed central Fuling repeatedly, dropping over a hundred bombs and killing hundreds.
fields.description: 1940 年 7 月 31 日中午，日机 18 架自东窜入涪陵，对乌江口西岸闹市区轮番投弹，麻柳嘴、碧霞宫两处中烧夷弹，火势延烧至顺城街、枣子岩一带，城隍庙全毁。《西南大学学报》统计表记投弹 161 枚、死 470 人、伤 340 人；《侵华日军暴行总录》记倾弹 87 枚、死 200 余人、伤 120 余人、毁损房屋 1000 余幢。小东门卢陵会馆关押的壮丁未及疏散，会馆中弹，死伤惨重，事后用盐包裹尸掩埋，尸体过多时夜间投入长江。此前涪陵已遭 1940-05-30（死 95、伤 89）等轰炸；此后 1940-08-19、08-20、10-25 与 1941-08-11、08-22、08-23 再遭空袭。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 At noon on 31 July 1940 eighteen Japanese aircraft came in from the east and bombed the commercial district on the west bank of the Wu River mouth in repeated passes; incendiaries set Mapozui and Bixia Palace alight and the fire spread to Shuncheng Street and Zaoziyan, while the City God Temple was destroyed. The Southwest University table records 161 bombs, 470 killed and 340 wounded; A Compendium of Japanese Atrocities records 87 bombs, over 200 killed, over 120 wounded and more than 1,000 houses damaged or destroyed. Conscripts held in the Luling Guild Hall by the east gate could not be evacuated; the hall took a direct hit with heavy losses, and the dead were wrapped in salt-pack matting and buried, or thrown into the Yangtze at night when there were too many. Fuling had already been bombed on 30 May 1940 (95 killed, 89 wounded) and was hit again on 19 and 20 August and 25 October 1940 and on 11, 22 and 23 August 1941. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1940年8月2日，45架日机分三批轰炸隆昌县城，投弹119枚，死166人。
summary.en: On 2 August 1940 forty-five Japanese aircraft bombed Longchang in three waves, dropping 119 bombs and killing 166 people.

fields.name: 隆昌“八二”大轰炸 Bombing of Longchang, 2 August 1940
fields.summary: 1940年8月2日，45架日机分三批轰炸隆昌县城，投弹119枚，死166人。 On 2 August 1940 forty-five Japanese aircraft bombed Longchang in three waves, dropping 119 bombs and killing 166 people.
fields.description: 1940 年 8 月 2 日午后 1 时许，45 架日机分三批飞临隆昌上空，以俯冲投弹与低空扫射轰炸县城近半小时，共投炸弹 19 枚、破甲弹 94 枚、燃烧弹 6 枚（合计 119 枚），炸毁房屋 6374 间，炸死平民 166 人、炸伤 195 人，其他财产损失 50 余万元。南外河街、顺河街全毁，县政府、县党部、财委会、文庙坝均被炸。县长刘觉民上报称「全城烟火冲天」「县府内外四周炸弹频集」。《西南大学学报》统计表与内江新闻网所引档案数字一致。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 Shortly after one o’clock on 2 August 1940, 45 Japanese aircraft arrived over Longchang in three waves and bombed and strafed the county town for nearly half an hour with 19 high-explosive bombs, 94 armour-piercing bombs and 6 incendiaries — 119 in all — destroying 6,374 rooms, killing 166 civilians and wounding 195, with other property losses of over 500,000 yuan. The Nanwai and Shunhe riverside streets were destroyed and the county government, party office, finance committee and Confucian temple area were hit. Magistrate Liu Juemin reported that “the whole town was in flames” and that bombs fell all around the county offices. The Southwest University table and the figures quoted from archival sources by Neijiang News agree. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

fields.name: 自贡“八一二”大轰炸 Zigong Bombing of 12 August 1940
fields.summary: 1940年8月12日，日机90架轰炸自贡盐场与市区。 On 12 August 1940 ninety Japanese aircraft bombed Zigong’s salt works and urban area.
fields.description: 1940年8月12日，日机90架轰炸自贡，投弹267枚，炸死139人、伤258人（另载死亡92人、伤157人）。自贡为川盐生产中心，日军“102号作战”专门轰炸自贡盐场，1939年10月至1941年8月共遭7次16批轰炸。日期据《抗战大后方侵华日军无差别轰炸重大惨案的时空分布考察》与《抗战时期自贡盐业的“增产加运”》。 On 12 August 1940 ninety Japanese aircraft bombed Zigong, dropping 267 bombs, killing 139 and wounding 258 (another account gives 92 dead and 157 wounded). Zigong was the centre of Sichuan salt production, and Japan’s “Operation 102” specifically targeted its salt works; between October 1939 and August 1941 the city suffered seven raids in sixteen waves.

summary.zh: 1940年8月19日，日机178架次轰炸重庆，投弹500余枚。
summary.en: On 19 August 1940 178 Japanese aircraft attacked Chongqing, dropping more than 500 bombs.

fields.name: 重庆“八一九”大轰炸 Chongqing Bombing of 19 August 1940
fields.summary: 1940年8月19日，日机178架次轰炸重庆，投弹500余枚。 On 19 August 1940 178 Japanese aircraft attacked Chongqing, dropping more than 500 bombs.
fields.description: 1940年8月19日，日军陆海军出动178架次飞机分5次空袭重庆，投弹500余枚，大田湾、两路口、储奇门、较场口等30余处中弹起火，商业区被焚毁殆尽。据重庆防空司令部统计，当日炸死181人、伤132人，毁房786栋1438间。日期据新华网《不应忘却的“重庆大轰炸”》与人民网《影像见证日本对重庆最猛烈轰炸场景》。 On 19 August 1940 the Japanese army and navy flew 178 sorties in five waves against Chongqing, dropping over 500 bombs. More than thirty places including Datianwan, Lianglukou, Chuqimen and Jiaochangkou were hit and set ablaze, and the commercial district was largely destroyed. The air-defence headquarters recorded 181 dead, 132 wounded and 786 buildings (1,438 rooms) destroyed.

fields.name: 百团大战 Hundred Regiments Offensive 百团战役 Hundred Regiments Campaign 正太路破袭战 Zhengding–Taiyuan Railway Sabotage
fields.place: 华北正太铁路沿线（阳泉一带） Along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway in North China (Yangquan area)
fields.summary: 八路军在华北发动大规模破袭战，先后参战部队达一百余个团。 The Eighth Route Army launched a large-scale sabotage campaign in North China involving more than a hundred regiments.
fields.description: 1940 年 8 月 20 日起，八路军在副总司令彭德怀、副参谋长左权指挥下，在华北发动以破袭正太铁路为重点的大规模进攻，先后参战部队达 105 个团，故称“百团大战”。战役分破袭交通线、攻取据点、反“扫荡”三个阶段，持续至 1941 年初，对日军交通线和据点造成较大打击，也促使日军加强对华北敌后根据地的“扫荡”。 参战团数、阶段划分与战果各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 From 20 August 1940, under deputy commander Peng Dehuai and deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan, the Eighth Route Army launched a large offensive in North China centered on sabotaging the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway. Eventually 105 regiments took part, hence the name “Hundred Regiments Offensive.” The campaign had three phases—cutting transport lines, attacking strongpoints, and countering Japanese “mopping-up” operations—and lasted into early 1941, damaging Japanese communications and prompting harsher operations against base areas. Regiment counts, phase divisions, and results vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 正太路破袭战（西段） Sabotage of the western Zhengding–Taiyuan railway
fields.summary: 百团大战第一阶段，第129师破袭正太铁路西段。 In the first phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive, the 129th Division sabotaged the western section of the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway.
fields.description: 1940 年 8 月 20 日夜，百团大战第一阶段开始，八路军第129师以第385旅、第386旅、新编第10旅等部破袭正太铁路西段，重点破坏阳泉至榆次间的铁路、桥梁、隧道和车站，并攻取沿线部分据点。 参战番号与破袭范围各书记载略有出入，待页码级核对。 On the night of 20 August 1940 the first phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive began. The 129th Division, with the 385th, 386th, and new 10th brigades, sabotaged the western section of the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway, concentrating on track, bridges, tunnels, and stations between Yangquan and Yuci and capturing some strongpoints along the line. Participating units and the extent of sabotage vary slightly between accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1940年8月20日，日机126架次再炸重庆，市区38处起火。 On 20 August 1940 126 Japanese aircraft bombed Chongqing again, starting fires in 38 places.
fields.description: 1940年8月20日下午，日机126架次分4批轰炸重庆市区及江北、巴县，望龙门、临江门、大梁子、都邮街、小梁子、千厮门等38处起火，繁华街道被烧成焦土。19、20两日日军共出动289架飞机，投弹943枚，炸死烧死342人、重伤332人。日期据新华网与人民网。 On the afternoon of 20 August 1940 126 Japanese aircraft in four waves bombed Chongqing, Jiangbei and Ba County; fires broke out in thirty-eight places including Wanglongmen, Linjiangmen, Daliangzi, Duyou Street, Xiaoliangzi and Qiansimen. Over the two days the Japanese flew 289 aircraft and dropped 943 bombs, killing 342 and seriously wounding 332.

fields.summary: 日军入侵越南北部后，滇军第60军由赣北调回云南，防守滇越边境。 After Japan moved into northern Vietnam, the Yunnan 60th Army was transferred from northern Jiangxi back to Yunnan to guard the Sino-Vietnamese border.
fields.description: 1940 年 9 月，日军入侵越南北部，威胁滇南。第60军第182、184师由赣北靖安、安义一线调回云南，防守滇越边境。此后第60军长期驻守滇南，直至抗战胜利。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In September 1940 Japan moved into northern Vietnam and threatened southern Yunnan. The 60th Army’s 182nd and 184th Divisions were transferred from Jing’an and Anyi in northern Jiangxi back to Yunnan to guard the Sino-Vietnamese border. The army then held southern Yunnan until the end of the war. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

It was also the hub of rear-area industry, education, and diplomacy. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina and cut the Yunnan–Vietnam railway.

fields.name: 日军进驻法属印度支那北部 Japanese Entry into Northern French Indochina
fields.summary: 日军进驻法属印度支那北部，切断滇越铁路。 Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina and cut the Yunnan–Vietnam railway.
fields.description: 1940 年 9 月，日本趁法国战败，与维希法国达成协议，日军于 9 月 22 日自镇南关进入法属印度支那北部，随后在海防登陆，进驻河内。日军控制越南北部后，切断滇越铁路，并建立轰炸中国西南和南下南洋的基地。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1940, exploiting the French defeat, Japan reached an agreement with Vichy France and on 22 September Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina through Zhennanguan, later landing at Haiphong and occupying Hanoi. Control of northern Vietnam cut the Yunnan–Vietnam railway and gave Japan bases for bombing southwest China and for the southward advance. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 26 September 1940 Japanese forces landed at Haiphong, completing the occupation of northern French Indochina.

fields.name: 日军在海防登陆 Japanese landing at Haiphong
fields.summary: 1940 年 9 月 26 日，日军在越南北部海防登陆，完成对法属印度支那北部的进驻。 On 26 September 1940 Japanese forces landed at Haiphong, completing the occupation of northern French Indochina.
fields.description: 1940 年 9 月 22 日，日军第 5 师团从广西边境越境进攻谅山，同时海军舰艇进入北部湾。9 月 25 日，日军开始向海防发动登陆作战；9 月 26 日，日军在海防以南东塔登陆，坦克上岸并进入海防港，当天战斗结束。此后日军在海防驻约 900 人、河内驻约 600 人，并控制嘉林、老街等机场，切断滇越铁路。日期有 9 月 25 日、26 日两说，本事件取 26 日；登陆点在海防港区，不画到河内。 On 22 September 1940 the Japanese 5th Division crossed from Guangxi and attacked Lang Son while naval vessels entered the Gulf of Tonkin. On 25 September Japanese forces began landing operations against Haiphong; on 26 September they came ashore at Dong Tac south of the port, put tanks ashore and entered Haiphong, and fighting ended that day. Japan then stationed about 900 troops at Haiphong and 600 at Hanoi, took control of Gia Lam and Lao Cai airfields, and cut the Yunnan–Vietnam railway. Sources give 25 or 26 September; this entry uses the 26th and stops at the port, not Hanoi.

fields.name: 第60军防守滇南 60th Army Defends Southern Yunnan
fields.summary: 第60军进驻蒙自、河口一线，防守滇越边境，直至抗战胜利。 The 60th Army held the Mengzi–Hekou line on the Sino-Vietnamese border until the end of the war.
fields.description: 1940 年 10 月起，第60军进驻蒙自、河口一线，依托滇越铁路与红河防线阻止日军由越南侵入云南。滇南防御持续五年，直至 1945 年抗战胜利。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 From October 1940 the 60th Army held the Mengzi–Hekou line, using the Yunnan–Vietnam railway and the Red River defenses to block a Japanese advance from Vietnam into Yunnan. The defense of southern Yunnan lasted five years until the Japanese surrender in 1945. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.summary: 新四军在黄桥反击国民党军，打开苏北局面。 The New Fourth Army counterattacked KMT forces at Huangqiao, opening up northern Jiangsu.
fields.description: 1940 年 10 月，新四军苏北指挥部在江苏泰兴黄桥地区反击国民党军韩德勤部，取得黄桥战役胜利。日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为战役点，不绘行军路线：黄桥战役由新四军苏北指挥部率部自苏南渡江发起，与军部驻地云岭不是同一条路线。 In October 1940, the New Fourth Army’s Northern Jiangsu Command counterattacked KMT forces under Han Deqin at Huangqiao, Taixing, Jiangsu, winning the Battle of Huangqiao. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. This is a battle point with no march route: the Battle of Huangqiao was fought by the N4A Northern Jiangsu Command moving north from southern Jiangsu, not by the headquarters at Yunling.

name.en: Second Japanese Sweep in Southern Anhui

summary.zh: 1940年10月4日，日军1万余人第二次扫荡皖南，攻占泾县、南陵。
summary.en: On 4 October 1940 more than 10,000 Japanese and puppet troops launched a second sweep in southern Anhui, taking Jingxian and Nanling.

fields.name: 日军第二次扫荡皖南 Second Japanese Sweep in Southern Anhui
fields.summary: 1940年10月4日，日军1万余人第二次扫荡皖南，攻占泾县、南陵。 On 4 October 1940 more than 10,000 Japanese and puppet troops launched a second sweep in southern Anhui, taking Jingxian and Nanling.
fields.description: 10月4日，日军第15、第17、第116师团及伪军共1万余人，对皖南发动第二次大规模「扫荡」。叶挺指挥皖南新四军在汀潭、枫坑口、泾县县城等地激战，10月9日收复泾县县城，南陵亦被收复，历时一周，毙伤日伪军近2000人，迫使其撤退。此为多路扫荡，不绘单一路线。 On 4 October more than 10,000 Japanese troops from the 15th, 17th and 116th Divisions and puppet forces launched a second large-scale sweep in southern Anhui. Ye Ting commanded the New Fourth Army in fighting at Tingtan, Fengkengkou and Jingxian; Jingxian was recovered on 9 October and Nanling soon after. The week-long operation killed or wounded nearly 2,000 Japanese and puppet troops and forced a withdrawal. As a multi-column sweep, it is not drawn as a single route.

fields.name: 宁波细菌战 Bacteriological Attack on Ningbo
fields.summary: 日军在宁波投撒鼠疫菌，造成平民感染死亡。 Japanese forces spread plague bacteria in Ningbo, causing civilian infections and deaths.
fields.description: 1940 年 10 月 27 日，日军第 731 部队在宁波开明街一带投撒带有鼠疫菌的跳蚤、谷物等，引发鼠疫流行，造成平民死亡。具体死亡人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为细菌战惨案，不绘路线。注意：事件日期与“宁波沦陷”（1941-04-20）不同，勿混。 On 27 October 1940 the Japanese Unit 731 spread plague-infected fleas and grain around Kaiming Street in Ningbo, triggering a plague outbreak and civilian deaths. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. This is a bacteriological-warfare atrocity and is not drawn as a route. It is distinct from the fall of Ningbo on 20 April 1941.

summary.zh: 百团大战第三阶段，八路军围攻日军冈崎支队，未能全歼。
summary.en: In the third phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive, the Eighth Route Army besieged the Japanese Okazaki Detachment but failed to destroy it.

fields.name: 关家垴战斗 Battle of Guanjianao 关家垴攻坚战 Guanjianao Assault
fields.place: 山西武乡关家垴 Guanjianao, Wuxiang, Shanxi
fields.summary: 百团大战第三阶段，八路军围攻日军冈崎支队，未能全歼。 In the third phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive, the Eighth Route Army besieged the Japanese Okazaki Detachment but failed to destroy it.
fields.description: 1940 年 10 月 30 日至 11 月 1 日，八路军第129师第385旅、第386旅、新编第10旅及决死第1纵队等部在山西武乡关家垴围攻日军第36师团冈崎支队约 500 人。日军依托窑洞和山地工事顽抗，八路军多次攻击未果，自身伤亡较大，最终日军援兵赶到，残部撤走。此战是百团大战第三阶段反“扫荡”中的一场硬仗，也暴露了八路军攻坚能力的不足。 兵力与伤亡数字各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 From 30 October to 1 November 1940 the 129th Division—with the 385th, 386th, and new 10th brigades and the 1st Suicide Squad—besieged about 500 men of the Japanese 36th Division’s Okazaki Detachment at Guanjianao, Wuxiang, Shanxi. The Japanese held out in cave dwellings and hill fortifications; repeated assaults failed and the attackers suffered heavy casualties before Japanese reinforcements arrived and the remnants withdrew. The battle was a hard fight in the third phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive and exposed the Eighth Route Army’s limited capability in attacking fortified positions. Force and casualty figures vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1940年12月12日，9架日机两次轰炸扫射云南驿机场，毁教练机21架、运输机3架。
summary.en: On 12 December 1940 nine Japanese aircraft twice attacked Yunnanyi airfield, destroying 21 trainers and 3 transports.

fields.name: 日机轰炸云南驿机场（1940） Bombing of Yunnanyi Airfield, 1940
fields.place: 云南祥云云南驿 Yunnanyi, Xiangyun, Yunnan
fields.summary: 1940年12月12日，9架日机两次轰炸扫射云南驿机场，毁教练机21架、运输机3架。 On 12 December 1940 nine Japanese aircraft twice attacked Yunnanyi airfield, destroying 21 trainers and 3 transports.
fields.description: 云南驿机场 1929 年始建，1938 年中央空军军官学校初级班迁此后成为飞行训练基地。1940 年 12 月 12 日上午 10 时 12 分，9 架日机首次轰炸扫射机场，刚完成训练的第14期学员已离开机场，停机坪上的 21 架教练机与 3 架运输机来不及隐蔽，全部被炸毁击坏，两名机械师被炸伤；下午 13 时 10 分又遭第二次轰炸扫射。1941 年起机场大规模扩建，成为驼峰航线重要中转站与飞虎队基地；1940—1944 年间日军先后轰炸该机场十余次，修建机场的民工伤亡尤重。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 Yunnanyi airfield was built in 1929 and became a flying training base when the Chinese Air Force cadet school moved its elementary course there in 1938. At 10:12 on 12 December 1940 nine Japanese aircraft attacked the field; the 14th class had just finished training and left the apron, but 21 trainers and 3 transports could not be hidden and were destroyed or damaged, and two mechanics were wounded. A second attack followed at 13:10. The field was greatly expanded from 1941 and became an important Hump route staging post and a Flying Tigers base; between 1940 and 1944 the Japanese bombed it more than ten times, with heavy casualties among the labourers building it. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

fields.name: 中共中央军委发布重建新四军军部命令 CCP Central Military Commission orders the New Fourth Army headquarters rebuilt
fields.summary: 1941 年 1 月 20 日，中共中央军委发布重建新四军军部命令，任命陈毅为代军长、刘少奇为政委。 On 20 January 1941 the CCP Central Military Commission ordered the New Fourth Army headquarters rebuilt, with Chen Yi as acting commander and Liu Shaoqi as political commissar.
fields.description: 1941 年 1 月 6 日皖南事变后，国民党当局于 1 月 17 日宣布撤销新四军番号。1 月 20 日，毛泽东为中共中央军委起草的重建新四军军部命令发布，任命陈毅为国民革命军新编第四军代理军长，张云逸为副军长，刘少奇为政治委员，赖传珠为参谋长，邓子恢为政治部主任。1 月 25 日，新四军新军部在江苏盐城成立，全军整编为七个师又一个独立旅，共九万余人。这是中共在皖南事变后以组织重建回应国民党取消番号的政治军事行动。新四军军部重建的具体经过属军事层，本层只收中央命令。本事件为中央命令，不绘路线。 After the Wannan Incident of 6 January 1941, the Nationalist authorities announced the abolition of the New Fourth Army designation on 17 January. On 20 January the order drafted by Mao Zedong for the CCP Central Military Commission was issued, appointing Chen Yi acting commander of the New Fourth Army, Zhang Yunyi deputy commander, Liu Shaoqi political commissar, Lai Chuanzhu chief of staff and Deng Zihui director of the political department. The new headquarters was established at Yancheng, Jiangsu, on 25 January, and the army was reorganised into seven divisions and one independent brigade, over 90,000 men. The rebuilding was the CCP’s organisational and political answer to the abolition of the designation; the military details belong to the New Fourth Army layer, while this entry records the central order only. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 确山沦陷 Fall of Queshan
fields.summary: 1941年1月26日，日军第11军攻占确山。 On 26 January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army captured Queshan.
fields.description: 1941年1月，日军第11军为打通平汉铁路南段、解除中国军队对信阳日军的威胁，发动豫南会战。日军快速出击，26日攻占确山、邢店、高邑、泌阳一线，27日推进至驻马店、汝南、沙河店、龙王庙一线。日期据维基百科《豫南会战》与央视《抗战史上的今天》。 In January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army launched the Southern Henan campaign to open the southern Beiping–Hankou railway and remove the threat to its Xinyang garrison. Attacking rapidly, it took the Queshan–Xingdian–Gaoyi–Biyang line on the 26th and reached the Zhumadian–Runan–Shahedian–Longwangmiao line on the 27th.

fields.name: 汪雅臣牺牲 Death of Wang Yachen
fields.place: 吉林五常石头亮子 Shitouliangzi, Wuchang, Jilin
fields.summary: 1941年1月29日，抗联第十军军长汪雅臣在五常石头亮子被围，突围中牺牲，年30岁。 On 29 January 1941 Wang Yachen, commander of the 10th Army, was surrounded at Shitouliangzi in Wuchang and killed while breaking out; he was 30.
fields.description: 汪雅臣 1911 年生于山东蓬莱，幼年随家闯关东到五常，九一八后组织反日山林队，报号「双龙」，1935 年春加入中国共产党。1936 年初所部改编为东北人民革命军第八军，任军长；同年 9 月改称东北抗日联军第十军，部队发展至 19 个团 1000 余人，以五常、舒兰、榆树交界的九十五顶子山为根据地。1939 年后日军加紧「讨伐」，第十军化整为零，军部仅余数十人。1941 年 1 月 28 日夜，叛徒郭珍引日军梶田部队突袭；29 日凌晨，日伪军分三路围攻石头亮子宿营地。汪雅臣命副军长张忠喜率主力抢占东南山头突围，自己带少数人守西山掩护。张忠喜以下 20 余人牺牲；汪雅臣胸部、腿部中弹被俘，被抬至贾家沟时殉国，年 30 岁。敌人割下头颅「示众」，1948 年遗首在五常被发现，1955 年安葬于哈尔滨烈士陵园。日期异说：多数资料记 1 月 29 日，东北网《1941 年》大事记记 1 月 20 日。本事件取 1 月 29 日。本事件不绘路线。 Wang Yachen, born at Penglai in Shandong in 1911, came to Wuchang as a child, organised the “Shuanglong” anti-Japanese forest band after the Mukden Incident and joined the Communist Party in spring 1935. In early 1936 his force became the 8th Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army under him, and in September it was renamed the United Army’s 10th Army, growing to nineteen regiments and over 1,000 men based on the Ninety-Five Peaks in the Wuchang–Shulan–Yushu border country. After 1939, under relentless campaigning, the army dispersed and only a few dozen men remained at headquarters. On the night of 28 January 1941 the traitor Guo Zhen led a Japanese raid; at dawn on the 29th the Japanese and puppet troops attacked the Shitouliangzi camp in three columns. Wang ordered his deputy Zhang Zhongxi to seize the south-eastern hill and break out with the main body while he held the western hill with a handful of men. Zhang and over twenty others died; Wang was hit in the chest and legs, captured and died at Jiajiagou, aged 30. The Japanese cut off his head for display; it was found at Wuchang in 1948 and buried in the Harbin Martyrs’ Cemetery in 1955. Most sources give 29 January; a Heilongjiang chronology gives 20 January, and this entry follows the 29th. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 琼崖抗日根据地 Qiongya anti-Japanese base area
fields.place: 海南琼山、文昌一带 Qiongshan–Wenchang, Hainan
fields.summary: 1941 年 2 月，琼崖抗日根据地在琼山、文昌一带坚持斗争；五指山根据地于 1943—1944 年开辟。 In February 1941 the Qiongya base area held out around Qiongshan and Wenchang; the Wuzhishan base was opened in 1943–1944.
fields.description: 1941 年 2 月，美合事变后琼崖特委和独立总队返回琼山、文昌一带，继续坚持抗日斗争。五指山根据地则于 1943—1944 年逐步开辟。时间与范围为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为根据地形成，不绘路线；五指山方向的进军见 1944 年「琼崖纵队挺进五指山」。 In February 1941, after the Meihe Incident, the Qiongya Special Committee and the Independent Corps returned to the Qiongshan–Wenchang area and continued resistance. The Wuzhishan base was opened only in 1943–1944. Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. No route is drawn for this base-area event; the 1944 advance into Wuzhishan is covered separately.

fields.description: 1941 年 1 月 25 日日军第 11 军自信阳北犯，豫南会战爆发；日军攻至舞阳、方城一带，中国军队避免决战、侧击其后，日军于 2 月 11 日撤回信阳。 On 25 January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army moved north from Xinyang, opening the southern Henan battle; it reached Wuyang and Fangcheng, but the Chinese army avoided a decisive battle and struck its rear, so the Japanese withdrew to Xinyang on 11 February.

fields.name: 日军进驻泰州 Japanese Entry into Taizhou
fields.summary: 1941年2月16日，日军独立混成第12旅团进驻泰州。 On 16 February 1941 the Japanese 12th Independent Mixed Brigade entered Taizhou.
fields.description: 1941年2月13日，鲁苏皖边区游击总指挥部副总指挥李长江率部投敌，泰州城沦陷；2月16日，日军独立混成第12旅团进驻泰县县城。新四军随后发起讨逆战役，2月21日攻克泰州后主动撤出。本事件记日军进驻，日期取2月16日，正文并列2月13日、2月15日说。 On 13 February 1941 Li Changjiang, deputy commander of the Lu-Su-Wan guerrilla headquarters, defected with his troops and Taizhou fell; on 16 February the Japanese 12th Independent Mixed Brigade entered the county seat. The New Fourth Army then launched a punitive campaign, took Taizhou on 21 February and withdrew. This event records the Japanese entry on 16 February and notes the 13 and 15 February accounts.

summary.zh: 日军进攻上高，中国军队包围反击，取得上高大捷。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shanggao; Chinese troops encircled and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

fields.name: 上高会战 Battle of Shanggao 上高大捷 Shanggao Victory
fields.summary: 日军进攻上高，中国军队包围反击，取得上高大捷。 Japanese forces attacked Shanggao; Chinese troops encircled and counterattacked, winning a major victory.
fields.description: 1941 年 3 月，日军第十一军向江西上高地区进攻，企图打击中国第九战区部队。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，诱敌深入后实施包围反击，至 4 月上旬收复失地，取得上高会战胜利。此役是抗战中期正面战场的一次重要胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In March 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Shanggao area of Jiangxi, seeking to strike Chinese forces of the Ninth War Zone. Chinese troops resisted in stages using the terrain, drew the Japanese in, then counterattacked and encircled them, recovering the lost ground by early April and winning the Battle of Shanggao. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1941 年 3 月 15 日日军自南昌进攻上高，中国军队第 74 军等部诱敌深入、两翼反击，日军伤亡惨重，4 月 9 日退回南昌，中国军队收复上高、高安、奉新。 On 15 March 1941 the Japanese attacked Shanggao from Nanchang; the Chinese 74th Corps and others drew them in and counter-attacked on both flanks, inflicting heavy losses; the Japanese withdrew to Nanchang on 9 April and the Chinese recovered Shanggao, Gao’an and Fengxin.
fields.entities: 日本 Japan 国民党军集团军 KMT Group Armies

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: Establishment of the Hainan Guard District

summary.zh: 日本海军将海南岛根据地队升格为海南警备府，强化对海南的军事控制。
summary.en: The Japanese navy upgraded the Hainan Island Base Force to the Hainan Guard District, tightening its military control of the island.

fields.name: 海南警备府成立 Establishment of the Hainan Guard District
fields.summary: 日本海军将海南岛根据地队升格为海南警备府，强化对海南的军事控制。 The Japanese navy upgraded the Hainan Island Base Force to the Hainan Guard District, tightening its military control of the island.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 10 日，日本海军将海南岛根据地队升格为海南警备府，隶属中国方面舰队，统辖海口、三亚、榆林等要港和驻岛海军陆战队，把海南建成封锁华南海上交通、进窥法属印度支那和南进的基地。日军在岛上修筑机场、据点，实施「扫荡」与殖民统治。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为建制事件，不绘制路线。 On 10 April 1941 the Japanese navy upgraded the Hainan Island Base Force to the Hainan Guard District under the China Area Fleet, commanding the key ports of Haikou, Sanya and Yulin and the naval landing forces on the island. Hainan became a base for blockading South China’s sea lanes and for Japan’s southward advance toward French Indochina. Japanese forces built airfields and strongpoints and conducted “mopping-up” operations and colonial rule. Dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. This is an institutional event; no route is drawn.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 宁绍战役开始，日军占领绍兴。
summary.en: The Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign began and Japanese forces captured Shaoxing.

fields.name: 绍兴沦陷 Fall of Shaoxing
fields.summary: 宁绍战役开始，日军占领绍兴。 The Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign began and Japanese forces captured Shaoxing.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 16 日，日军第 13 军自杭州附近向钱塘江南岸发动进攻，宁绍战役开始。4 月 17 日凌晨，日军占领绍兴，这是战役中中国方面失守的第一座城市。日期据《近代史研究》相关研究，待页码级核对。 On 16 April 1941 the Japanese 13th Army attacked south across the Qiantang River from near Hangzhou, opening the Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign. In the early hours of 17 April Japanese forces occupied Shaoxing, the first city lost by the Chinese side in the campaign. The date follows research in Modern Chinese History Studies and awaits page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军在飞云江口登陆，占领瑞安县城。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at the Feiyun River mouth and occupied Rui’an.

fields.name: 瑞安沦陷 Fall of Rui’an
fields.summary: 日军在飞云江口登陆，占领瑞安县城。 Japanese forces landed at the Feiyun River mouth and occupied Rui’an.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 18 日，日军一部在瑞安飞云江口登陆，突破中国守军滩头阵地，当日占领瑞安县城，随后北犯温州。日期据温州地方史志，待页码级核对。 On 18 April 1941 a Japanese force landed at the mouth of the Feiyun River, broke through the Chinese beach defenses and occupied Rui’an the same day before advancing north toward Wenzhou. The date follows Wenzhou local histories and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在镇海登陆，镇海县城沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at Zhenhai and captured the county town.

fields.name: 镇海沦陷 Fall of Zhenhai
fields.summary: 日军在镇海登陆，镇海县城沦陷。 Japanese forces landed at Zhenhai and captured the county town.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 19 日拂晓，日军第 5 师团及海军陆战队在镇海口北岸、江南等地登陆，中国守军暂编第 34 师等部抵抗。当日上午镇海县城沦陷，日军沿甬江西犯宁波。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 At dawn on 19 April 1941 the Japanese 5th Division and naval landing forces came ashore on both banks of the Yong River mouth at Zhenhai; Chinese provisional 34th Division troops resisted. The county town fell that morning and the Japanese advanced west along the Yong River toward Ningbo. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在飞云江登陆，占领瑞安、温州。
summary.en: After landing at the Feiyun River, Japanese forces occupied Rui’an and Wenzhou.

fields.name: 温州沦陷 First Fall of Wenzhou
fields.summary: 日军在飞云江登陆，占领瑞安、温州。 After landing at the Feiyun River, Japanese forces occupied Rui’an and Wenzhou.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 18 日，日军在瑞安飞云江口登陆，当日占领瑞安县城；4 月 19 日分兵北犯，占领温州城区。日军在温州掠夺物资后于 5 月初撤出。日期据温州地方史志，待页码级核对。 On 18 April 1941 Japanese forces landed at the Feiyun River mouth and occupied Rui’an; on 19 April they advanced north and took central Wenzhou. After looting supplies, they withdrew in early May. The date follows Wenzhou local histories and awaits page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: Japanese Landing at the Min River Estuary

summary.zh: 日军在闽江口及连江、长乐沿海登陆，第一次福州战役开始。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary and along the Lianjiang and Changle coasts, opening the first battle for Fuzhou.

fields.name: 日军登陆闽江口 Japanese Landing at the Min River Estuary
fields.place: 福建闽江口 Min River estuary, Fujian
fields.summary: 日军在闽江口及连江、长乐沿海登陆，第一次福州战役开始。 Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary and along the Lianjiang and Changle coasts, opening the first battle for Fuzhou.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 19 日拂晓，日军第 48 师团、第 18 师团一部及海军陆战队在闽江口两侧的连江、长乐沿海多处登陆，随后向福州推进。中国守军第 75 师、第 80 师等部抵抗。日期据《福州史志》，待页码级核对。 At dawn on 19 April 1941 the Japanese 48th Division, elements of the 18th Division and naval landing forces came ashore at several points around the Min River estuary and along the Lianjiang and Changle coasts, then advanced on Fuzhou. Chinese 75th and 80th Division troops resisted. The date follows Fuzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军攻占宁波城区，宁波沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured central Ningbo and the city fell.

fields.name: 宁波沦陷 Fall of Ningbo
fields.summary: 日军攻占宁波城区，宁波沦陷。 Japanese forces captured central Ningbo and the city fell.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 19 日日军在镇海登陆后沿甬江西进，4 月 20 日下午攻占宁波江北岸、江东和城区，宁波沦陷。日军占领宁波后封锁港口、掠夺物资。日期据《宁波日报》与宁波市档案馆资料，待页码级核对。 After landing at Zhenhai on 19 April 1941, Japanese forces advanced west along the Yong River and on the afternoon of 20 April captured the north bank, Jiangdong and central Ningbo. The city then fell; Japan closed the port and seized supplies. The date follows Ningbo Daily and municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军攻占福州，福州第一次沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Fuzhou for the first time.

fields.name: 福州沦陷 First Fall of Fuzhou
fields.summary: 日军攻占福州，福州第一次沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Fuzhou for the first time.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 20 日，日军自连江、长乐分路包围福州；4 月 21 日，马尾失守，当晚日军进入福州城区，福州第一次沦陷。福州沦陷后，日军控制闽江口，封锁福建沿海。日期据《福州史志》，待页码级核对。 On 20 April 1941 Japanese forces converged on Fuzhou from Lianjiang and Changle. Mawei fell on 21 April and that evening Japanese troops entered central Fuzhou, which fell for the first time. The occupation gave Japan control of the Min River estuary and the Fujian coast. The date follows Fuzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1941年4月21日，长乐沦陷。
summary.en: On 21 April 1941 Changle fell.

fields.name: 长乐沦陷 Fall of Changle
fields.summary: 1941年4月21日，长乐沦陷。 On 21 April 1941 Changle fell.
fields.description: 4月18日，日军登陆运输舰艇在闽江口海域集结，出动30架飞机对福州及闽江口两岸轮番轰炸。4月19日日军登陆，4月21日长乐、连江、福州相继沦陷。日期据《福州沦陷日》与《福州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 18 April Japanese transports massed off the Min River estuary and 30 aircraft bombed Fuzhou and both banks of the river. Japanese forces landed on 19 April; Changle, Lianjiang and Fuzhou fell in succession on 21 April. The date follows the Fuzhou occupation-day account and chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 21 April 1941 Lianjiang fell.

fields.summary: 1941年4月21日，连江沦陷。 On 21 April 1941 Lianjiang fell.

The date follows the Fuzhou occupation-day account and chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 中条山战役 Battle of South Shanxi 晋南会战 Battle of South Shanxi
fields.place: 山西中条山 Zhongtiao Mountains, Shanxi
fields.summary: 日军围攻中条山中国守军，中国军队遭受重大损失，被迫南渡黄河突围。 Japanese forces besieged Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains; the Chinese army suffered heavy losses and was forced to break out south across the Yellow River.
fields.description: 1941 年 5 月，日军集中兵力围攻山西南部中条山地区的中国军队。中国守军补给困难、指挥协同不足，在日军多路进攻下遭受重大损失，部分部队南渡黄河突围。此役是抗战中期中国正面战场的一次严重失利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1941, Japanese forces concentrated their strength to besiege Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains of southern Shanxi. Hampered by supply difficulties and poor coordination, the Chinese defenders suffered heavy losses under multiple Japanese attacks, and part of the force broke out south across the Yellow River. It was a serious setback for China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: On 8 May 1941 Japanese forces captured Yuanqu during the Zhongtiao Mountains campaign.

fields.name: 垣曲沦陷 Fall of Yuanqu
fields.summary: 1941年5月8日，日军在中条山会战中攻陷垣曲。 On 8 May 1941 Japanese forces captured Yuanqu during the Zhongtiao Mountains campaign.
fields.description: 1941年5月7日傍晚，日军华北方面军第1军等部由东、西、北三面以中央突破方式进攻中条山。8日晨突破中国军队正面阵地，直指垣曲，垣曲当日失守。垣曲地处中条山腹地，第5集团军指挥部所在地，失守后中条山守军被分割。日期据《中条山会战》与台湾荣民文化网《晉南會戰過程》。 At dusk on 7 May 1941 the Japanese First Army attacked the Zhongtiao Mountains from east, west and north with a central breakthrough. On the morning of the 8th it broke the front and drove on Yuanqu, which fell that day. Yuanqu lay in the heart of the mountains and housed the 5th Group Army headquarters; its loss split the Chinese defenders. Dates follow the Zhongtiao campaign article and the Veterans Affairs Council account.

name.zh: 毛泽东《改造我们的学习》

summary.zh: 1941 年 5 月 19 日，毛泽东作《改造我们的学习》报告，批评主观主义，倡导实事求是。
summary.en: On 19 May 1941 Mao delivered “Reform Our Study”, attacking subjectivism and calling for seeking truth from facts.

fields.name: 毛泽东《改造我们的学习》 Mao Zedong’s “Reform Our Study”
fields.summary: 1941 年 5 月 19 日，毛泽东作《改造我们的学习》报告，批评主观主义，倡导实事求是。 On 19 May 1941 Mao delivered “Reform Our Study”, attacking subjectivism and calling for seeking truth from facts.
fields.description: 1941 年 5 月 19 日，毛泽东在延安干部会议上作《改造我们的学习》报告，批评党内存在的不注重研究现状、不注重研究历史、不注重马克思列宁主义应用的主观主义作风，特别是教条主义，提出「实事求是」的学习态度，号召全党把马克思列宁主义与中国革命具体实际相结合。报告与《整顿党的作风》《反对党八股》并称延安整风的三篇基本文献，标志着延安整风运动的开始。本事件为理论报告，不绘路线。 On 19 May 1941 Mao Zedong addressed a Yan’an cadres’ meeting with “Reform Our Study”. He criticised subjectivism, especially dogmatism, among cadres who neglected the study of current conditions, of history and of the application of Marxism-Leninism, and called for the attitude of “seeking truth from facts” and for integrating Marxism-Leninism with the concrete practice of the Chinese revolution. With “Rectify the Party’s Style of Work” and “Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing”, it became one of the three basic texts of the Yan’an rectification movement and marked its beginning. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 重庆“六五”大隧道惨案 Chongqing Tunnel Tragedy of 5 June 1941
fields.summary: 1941年6月5日，日机夜袭重庆，较场口大隧道内大批避难民众窒息、踩踏而死。 On 5 June 1941 Japanese night raiders triggered mass suffocation and trampling in the Jiaochangkou tunnel, killing hundreds of civilians.
fields.description: 1941年6月5日18时18分，日机24架分3批夜袭重庆，空袭警报持续5小时9分钟。大量市民涌入较场口大隧道，洞内缺氧，人群向洞口拥挤，发生窒息、踩踏。官方审查委员会1941年7月3日公布死亡992人、重伤151人；各方统计从数百到上万人不等。日期据新华网与维基百科《重庆隧道惨案》。 At 18:18 on 5 June 1941 twenty-four Japanese aircraft attacked Chongqing in three night waves, with the alarm lasting five hours and nine minutes. Crowds packed the Jiaochangkou tunnel; oxygen ran short and people were crushed and suffocated at the entrances. The official review committee announced 992 dead and 151 seriously wounded on 3 July 1941, though estimates range from several hundred to over ten thousand.

fields.description: 1941 年 5 月 7 日日军进攻中条山，中国军队损失惨重；6 月中旬部分部队突围，南渡黄河退抵洛阳、新安一带整补。 On 7 May 1941 the Japanese attacked the Zhongtiao mountains and inflicted heavy losses; in mid-June part of the Chinese army broke out, crossed the Yellow River and reached Luoyang and Xin’an to refit.

summary.zh: 1941年6月23日，27架日机轰炸松潘县城，死198人、伤497人。

fields.name: 松潘“六二三”大轰炸 Bombing of Songpan, 23 June 1941
fields.summary: 1941年6月23日，27架日机轰炸松潘县城，死198人、伤497人。 On 23 June 1941 twenty-seven Japanese aircraft bombed Songpan, killing 198 and wounding 497.
fields.description: 1941 年 6 月 23 日，日机 27 架轰炸松潘县城，投弹 80 余枚。《西南大学学报》统计表记死 198 人、伤 497 人；另有记载称投弹 245 枚、伤亡约 1100 人。松潘是川西北草地边缘的商贸重镇，无防空设施，县城房屋多为木结构，轰炸后大火蔓延；松潘县小学校死伤尤重（见《重庆大轰炸（含成都、乐山、自贡、松潘）受害史事鉴定书》附录）。日军《战斗详报》记当日先侦察后攻击，1941-08-31 再次侦察并企图轰炸未遂。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 On 23 June 1941 twenty-seven Japanese aircraft bombed Songpan county town, dropping over 80 bombs. The Southwest University table gives 198 killed and 497 wounded; other accounts give 245 bombs and about 1,100 casualties. Songpan was a trading town on the edge of the north-western Sichuan grasslands with no air defences and mostly wooden houses, so fires spread after the raid; the county primary school suffered especially heavy losses (see the appendix to the expert report on the Chongqing, Chengdu, Leshan, Zigong and Songpan bombings). Japanese combat reports record reconnaissance before the attack on the day and another reconnaissance on 31 August 1941 with an attempted raid that was aborted. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1941年7月27日，日机108架连续轰炸成都，为成都大轰炸最惨重的一次。

fields.name: 成都“七二七”大轰炸 Chengdu Bombing of 27 July 1941
fields.summary: 1941年7月27日，日机108架连续轰炸成都，为成都大轰炸最惨重的一次。 On 27 July 1941 108 Japanese aircraft bombed Chengdu in successive waves, the worst raid on the city.
fields.description: 1941年7月27日上午8时30分，日机108架分4批、每批27架，从运城、汉口机场起飞，连续轰炸成都少城公园、盐市口、春熙路、大慈寺一带，中弹街道82条，投弹358枚，炸死575人、伤632人，毁房3585间。日期据四川省地方志办与《成都空战》。 From 8:30 a.m. on 27 July 1941, 108 Japanese aircraft in four waves of twenty-seven took off from Yuncheng and Hankou and bombed Chengdu’s Shaocheng Park, Yanshikou, Chunxi Road and Dacisi area. Eighty-two streets were hit, 358 bombs dropped, 575 killed, 632 wounded and 3,585 rooms destroyed.

name.zh: 日军进驻法属印度支那南部
name.en: Japanese occupation of southern French Indochina

summary.zh: 1941 年 7 月 28 日，日军在法属印度支那南部登陆，进驻西贡、金兰湾等地。
summary.en: On 28 July 1941 Japanese forces landed in southern French Indochina and occupied Saigon and Cam Ranh Bay.

fields.name: 日军进驻法属印度支那南部 Japanese occupation of southern French Indochina
fields.summary: 1941 年 7 月 28 日，日军在法属印度支那南部登陆，进驻西贡、金兰湾等地。 On 28 July 1941 Japanese forces landed in southern French Indochina and occupied Saigon and Cam Ranh Bay.
fields.description: 1941 年 7 月 23 日，日本与维希法国签订共同防御法属印度支那的议定书；7 月 28 日，日军第 25 军先头部队在法属印度支那南部登陆，随后约 14 万日军进入，进驻西贡、金兰湾、边和等地，取得空军基地与海军基地。南部印度支那由此成为日军进攻马来亚、菲律宾和荷属东印度的前进基地。这次进驻不是 1940 年 9 月北部进驻的重复，战略方向已从封锁中国转为夺取东南亚。本事件取西贡登陆点，金兰湾另有驻军，不逐一画线。 On 23 July 1941 Japan and Vichy France signed a protocol on joint defence of French Indochina; on 28 July the leading units of the Japanese 25th Army landed in southern Indochina, followed by some 140,000 troops who occupied Saigon, Cam Ranh Bay and Bien Hoa and acquired air and naval bases. Southern Indochina became the springboard for the invasions of Malaya, the Philippines and the Dutch East Indies. This was not a repetition of the September 1940 occupation of the north: the strategic purpose had shifted from blockading China to seizing Southeast Asia. The entry uses Saigon as the landing point; Cam Ranh Bay is mentioned but not given a separate line.

Known as the “Flying Tigers,” it fought in the Burma theater and in the defense of Chinese airspace. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1941年8月11日，日机两批轰炸宜宾城区，死百余人，城内一半街区被炸。
summary.en: On 11 August 1941 Japanese aircraft bombed central Yibin in two waves, killing over a hundred and destroying half the downtown streets.

fields.name: 宜宾“八一一”大轰炸 Bombing of Yibin, 11 August 1941
fields.summary: 1941年8月11日，日机两批轰炸宜宾城区，死百余人，城内一半街区被炸。 On 11 August 1941 Japanese aircraft bombed central Yibin in two waves, killing over a hundred and destroying half the downtown streets.
fields.description: 1941 年 8 月 11 日上午 9 时 20 分，日机第一批 9 架投爆炸弹 132 枚、燃烧弹 23 枚并机枪扫射城区，死 105 人，城内一半街区被炸，民房商铺被毁，数千人无家可归；约 10 分钟后日机 18 架再次飞临城区上空盘旋。《西南大学学报》统计表记当日日机 27 架、投弹 100 余枚、死 100 余人、伤 100 余人，与《宜宾日报》口径基本一致。宜宾菜坝机场是战时重要空军基地，1939—1941 年共遭 8 次轰炸，日机 12 批 181 架次、投弹 968 枚，炸死 124 人、炸伤 218 人。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 At 09:20 on 11 August 1941 the first wave of nine Japanese aircraft dropped 132 bombs and 23 incendiaries and strafed central Yibin, killing 105 people, destroying half the downtown streets and leaving thousands homeless; about ten minutes later 18 more aircraft circled over the city. The Southwest University table records 27 aircraft, over 100 bombs and over 100 killed and wounded, broadly consistent with the Yibin Daily account. Caiba airfield at Yibin was an important wartime air base and was bombed eight times between 1939 and 1941 — 12 waves and 181 sorties, 968 bombs, 124 killed and 218 wounded. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

summary.en: Japanese forces again attacked Changsha; Chinese troops resisted in stages and counterattacked, forcing a Japanese withdrawal to the original line in early October.

fields.name: 第二次长沙会战 Second Battle of Changsha 第二次长沙战役 Second Changsha Campaign
fields.place: 湖南岳阳新墙河一线 Xinqiang River line, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 日军再次进攻长沙，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。 Japanese forces again attacked Changsha; Chinese troops resisted in stages and counterattacked, forcing a Japanese withdrawal to the original line in early October.
fields.description: 1941 年 9 月，日军第十一军向新墙河、汨罗江一线发起进攻，企图击破中国第九战区主力并攻取长沙。中国军队逐次抵抗，双方在长沙外围激战；日军因补给困难和中国军队侧击，于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役双方均有较大伤亡。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In September 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked across the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, aiming to destroy the main forces of China’s Ninth War Zone and take Changsha. Chinese troops resisted in stages and fought fierce actions on the city’s outskirts. Hampered by supply difficulties and Chinese flank attacks, the Japanese withdrew to their original line in early October. Both sides suffered considerable casualties. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 大云山战斗 Battle of Dayun Mountain
fields.place: 湖南岳阳大云山 Dayun Mountain, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 1941年9月7日，日军第6师团进攻岳阳大云山，第二次长沙会战拉开序幕。 On 7 September 1941 the Japanese 6th Division attacked Dayun Mountain in Yueyang, opening the second Changsha campaign.
fields.description: 1941年9月7日晨，日军第6师团2个联队从忠防、西塘进攻岳阳大云山，中国第58军新11师、第4军第59师等部反击，10日收复大云山。日军以一部牵制中国5个师，主力已在岳阳正面集结，18日强渡新墙河。日期据光明网《9月7日：第二次长沙会战拉开序幕》与《长沙会战》。 On the morning of 7 September 1941 two regiments of the Japanese 6th Division attacked Dayun Mountain from Zhongfang and Xitang. The Chinese New 11th Division and 59th Division counterattacked and recovered the mountain on the 10th. The Japanese used this to pin five Chinese divisions while massing their main force at Yueyang, crossing the Xinqiang on the 18th.

fields.description: 1941年9月18日拂晓，日军第3、第4、第6、第40师团及荒木、早渊支队在320门火炮、50架飞机支援下，向新墙河南岸20公里正面发起总攻，中国第4军第102师阵地两小时内被突破，日军当晚占领黄沙街、大荆街。日期据光明网与《长沙会战》。 At dawn on 18 September 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 4th, 6th and 40th Divisions with the Araki and Hayabuchi detachments attacked a 20-km front south of the Xinqiang River with 320 guns and 50 aircraft. The Chinese 102nd Division’s line broke within two hours, and the Japanese took Huangshajie and Dajingjie that evening.

fields.description: 1941年9月19日日军进抵汨罗江北岸，21日拂晓主力强渡汨罗江，中国第37军抗击后向捞刀河东南转移。日军因破译中国军队电报，改以主力包围汨罗江南岸守军。日期据光明网与《长沙会战》。 The Japanese reached the north bank of the Miluo on 19 September 1941 and crossed in force at dawn on the 21st. The Chinese 37th Corps resisted and then withdrew southeast of the Laodao River. Having broken Chinese codes, the Japanese switched their main effort to encircling the south-bank defenders.

summary.en: The 6th Squad of the 7th Company, 1st Regiment, covered the evacuation of headquarters and civilians and jumped from the cliff after running out of ammunition.

fields.name: 狼牙山五壮士 Five Heroes of Langya Mountain 狼牙山战斗 Battle of Langya Mountain
fields.place: 河北易县狼牙山 Langya Mountain, Yi County, Hebei
fields.summary: 晋察冀军区一团七连六班掩护机关和群众转移，弹尽后跳崖。 The 6th Squad of the 7th Company, 1st Regiment, covered the evacuation of headquarters and civilians and jumped from the cliff after running out of ammunition.
fields.description: 1941 年 9 月 25 日，日军“扫荡”晋察冀边区，晋察冀军区第1军分区第1团第7连第6班班长马宝玉、副班长葛振林和战士宋学义、胡德林、胡福才，为掩护党政机关和群众转移，将日军引向易县狼牙山棋盘陀绝顶，弹尽粮绝后毁枪跳崖。马宝玉、胡德林、胡福才牺牲，葛振林、宋学义被树枝挂住负伤获救。 战斗细节与歼敌数字各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 On 25 September 1941, during a Japanese “mopping-up” campaign in the Jin-Cha-Ji border region, the 6th Squad of the 7th Company, 1st Regiment, 1st Sub-district—squad leader Ma Baoyu, deputy leader Ge Zhenlin, and soldiers Song Xueyi, Hu Delin, and Hu Fucai—drew Japanese troops toward the summit of Qipantuo on Langya Mountain, Yi County, to cover the evacuation of party and government organs and civilians. After running out of ammunition they destroyed their rifles and jumped from the cliff. Ma Baoyu, Hu Delin, and Hu Fucai died; Ge Zhenlin and Song Xueyi were caught by branches and survived with injuries. Details and enemy casualty figures vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 日军自当阳增援宜昌 Japanese reinforcement from Dangyang to Yichang
fields.summary: 日军自当阳向宜昌增援，巩固宜昌防务。 The Japanese moved from Dangyang to reinforce Yichang.
fields.description: 1941 年 9 月下旬中国军队反攻宜昌，日军自当阳、荆门方向增援，10 月中旬守住宜昌。当阳自 1940 年 6 月即为日军占领，是其鄂西据点。 In late September 1941 the Chinese army counter-attacked Yichang and the Japanese reinforced from Dangyang and Jingmen, holding the city by mid-October. Dangyang had been occupied since June 1940 and was their base in western Hubei.

summary.en: On 28 September 1941 the Japanese Hayabuchi detachment entered Changsha, which briefly fell.

fields.name: 长沙一度失守（1941） Changsha Briefly Falls (1941)
fields.summary: 1941年9月28日，日军早渊支队突入长沙市区，长沙一度失守。 On 28 September 1941 the Japanese Hayabuchi detachment entered Changsha, which briefly fell.
fields.description: 1941年9月27日日军第4师团一部与早渊支队渡过捞刀河、浏阳河，28日早渊支队一部自长沙东北角突入城内，当晚全部进入长沙；29日第4师团主力亦开进长沙。日军因粮弹消耗、后方被切断，10月1日开始撤退，10月8日退回新墙河北岸。日期据光明网与《长沙会战》。 On 27 September 1941 parts of the Japanese 4th Division and the Hayabuchi detachment crossed the Laodao and Liuyang rivers; on the 28th the Hayabuchi detachment entered Changsha from the northeast, and the 4th Division’s main force followed on the 29th. With supplies exhausted and its rear cut, the Japanese withdrew from 1 October and were back north of the Xinqiang by the 8th.

fields.name: 株洲沦陷（1941） Fall of Zhuzhou (1941)
fields.summary: 1941年9月29日，日军第3师团一部攻入株洲。 On 29 September 1941 a detachment of the Japanese 3rd Division entered Zhuzhou.
fields.description: 1941年9月29日凌晨，日军第3师团第29旅团攻入株洲，中国暂编第2军第8师在龙头铺、大观塘、荷塘铺一带反击，至29日10时将日军击破，日军向北撤退。株洲是第二次长沙会战日军南侵最南点。日期据株洲文明网与《长沙会战》。 In the early hours of 29 September 1941 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 29th Brigade entered Zhuzhou. The Chinese Provisional 8th Division counterattacked at Longtoupu, Daguantang and Hetangpu and by 10 a.m. had broken the Japanese, who withdrew north. Zhuzhou was the southernmost point of the Japanese advance in the second Changsha campaign.

fields.name: 宜昌毒气战 Yichang Chemical Warfare
fields.summary: 1941年10月，日军在宜昌大规模使用毒气，中国军队1600余人中毒、600人死亡。 In October 1941 the Japanese used poison gas on a large scale at Yichang, gassing over 1,600 Chinese troops and killing 600.
fields.description: 1941年9月底至10月初，中国军队反攻宜昌，一度攻入城区，逼近日军第13师团司令部。日军不顾国际公约，于10月6日、9日、10日大规模使用杀伤性毒化武器，发射毒气炮弹并投掷毒剂炸弹，中国军队1600余人中毒、其中600人死亡。日期据《日军在宜昌使用化学武器》与《日寇在宜昌进行毒气战》。 In late September and early October 1941 Chinese forces counter-attacked at Yichang and briefly broke into the city, threatening the headquarters of the Japanese 13th Division. In violation of international law the Japanese used large quantities of poison gas on 6, 9 and 10 October, firing gas shells and dropping gas bombs; over 1,600 Chinese troops were gassed and 600 died.

name.en: Japanese "Iron Wall" Sweep in the Yimeng Mountains

summary.zh: 1941年11月2日，日军集中5万余人对沂蒙山区发动「铁壁合围」大扫荡。
summary.en: On 2 November 1941 more than 50,000 Japanese troops launched an "iron wall" sweep in the Yimeng Mountains.

fields.name: 日军沂蒙山「铁壁合围」 Japanese "Iron Wall" Sweep in the Yimeng Mountains
fields.summary: 1941年11月2日，日军集中5万余人对沂蒙山区发动「铁壁合围」大扫荡。 On 2 November 1941 more than 50,000 Japanese troops launched an "iron wall" sweep in the Yimeng Mountains.
fields.description: 1941年9月至10月，驻山东日军集中5万余人，在第12军司令官土桥一次指挥下，准备对沂蒙山区发动「铁壁合围」大扫荡。11月2日，八路军鲁中军区部队开始沂蒙山反「扫荡」作战。日军在根据地内烧杀抢夺，群众被害和被抓走1.4万余人，被抢走粮食160余万斤。此为多路合围，不绘单一路线。 From September to October 1941 the Japanese forces in Shandong massed more than 50,000 troops under the 12th Army for an "iron wall" sweep of the Yimeng Mountains. On 2 November the Eighth Route Army's central Shandong military district began counter-sweep operations. Japanese troops burned, killed and looted in the base area; more than 14,000 people were killed or abducted and over 800 tons of grain seized. As a multi-column encirclement, it is not drawn as a single route.

fields.name: 常德细菌战 Bacteriological Attack on Changde
fields.summary: 日军在常德投撒鼠疫菌，引发鼠疫流行。 Japanese aircraft spread plague bacteria over Changde, triggering an outbreak.
fields.description: 1941 年 11 月 4 日，日军第 731 部队飞机在常德城区投撒带有鼠疫菌的跳蚤、谷物等，随后常德爆发鼠疫，造成平民死亡。具体死亡人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为细菌战惨案，不绘路线。 On 4 November 1941 aircraft of the Japanese Unit 731 spread plague-infected fleas and grain over central Changde, and a plague outbreak followed, causing civilian deaths. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. This is a bacteriological-warfare atrocity and is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 黄崖洞保卫战 Defense of Huangyadong
fields.summary: 八路军总部特务团在黄崖洞保卫兵工厂，激战数日。 The headquarters guard regiment defended the Huangyadong arsenal in several days of fighting.
fields.description: 1941 年 11 月，八路军总部特务团在山西黎城黄崖洞与日军激战数日，保卫总部兵工厂。黄崖洞是八路军在敌后最大的兵工厂所在地，此战以少敌多，掩护了兵工厂设备和人员转移。 日期、参战兵力与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1941 the Eighth Route Army headquarters guard regiment fought Japanese forces for several days at Huangyadong, Licheng, Shanxi, defending the headquarters arsenal. Huangyadong housed the Eighth Route Army’s largest arsenal behind enemy lines; the outnumbered defenders covered the evacuation of equipment and personnel. Dates, force sizes, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 珍珠港事件 Attack on Pearl Harbor
fields.place: 美国夏威夷珍珠港 Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, United States
fields.summary: 日本海军偷袭珍珠港，太平洋战争爆发，中国抗战与世界大战连为一体。 The Japanese navy attacked Pearl Harbor, starting the Pacific War and linking China’s resistance to the global conflict.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 7 日（夏威夷时间），日本海军袭击美国太平洋舰队基地珍珠港。美国随即对日宣战，太平洋战争爆发。中国战场成为世界反法西斯战争的重要组成部分。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按夏威夷时间标注，待史料校订。 On 7 December 1941 (Hawaii time), the Japanese navy attacked the US Pacific Fleet base at Pearl Harbor. The United States declared war on Japan, and the Pacific War began. The China theater became an important part of the global anti-fascist war. This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows Hawaii time and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军第 23 军第 38 师团在深圳集结并越过边境进攻香港，12 月 25 日港督杨慕琦投降。深圳自 1938 年 11 月起为日军控制的前沿。 On 8 December 1941 the 38th Division of the Japanese 23rd Army mustered at Shenzhen and crossed the border into Hong Kong; Governor Mark Young surrendered on 25 December. Shenzhen had been a Japanese-controlled outpost since November 1938.

fields.place: 上海公共租界 Shanghai International Settlement
fields.summary: 太平洋战争爆发当日，日军进入上海公共租界。 On the day the Pacific War began, Japanese forces entered the Shanghai International Settlement.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，太平洋战争爆发当天，日军从虹口等处进入上海公共租界，解除英美等国驻军武装，上海“孤岛”时期结束。日军随后控制上海租界的市政、金融和新闻。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 8 December 1941, the day the Pacific War began, Japanese forces entered the Shanghai International Settlement from Hongkou and other points, disarmed British and American troops and ended Shanghai’s “isolated island” period. Japan then controlled the settlement’s administration, finance and press. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 日军进驻鼓浪屿公共租界

summary.zh: 1941年12月8日太平洋战争爆发当天，日军在鼓浪屿登陆，进驻公共租界。
summary.en: On 8 December 1941, the day the Pacific War began, Japanese troops landed on Gulangyu and entered the international settlement.

fields.name: 日军进驻鼓浪屿公共租界 Japanese Entry into the Gulangyu International Settlement
fields.place: 福建厦门鼓浪屿 Gulangyu, Xiamen, Fujian
fields.summary: 1941年12月8日太平洋战争爆发当天，日军在鼓浪屿登陆，进驻公共租界。 On 8 December 1941, the day the Pacific War began, Japanese troops landed on Gulangyu and entered the international settlement.
fields.description: 1938年5月厦门沦陷后，鼓浪屿公共租界成为厦门地区唯一的「孤岛」，十余万难民涌入，中国军队仍守鼓浪屿以西的嵩屿，使其成为沦陷区与内地的海上通道。1939年5月11日伪厦门市商会主席洪立勋在界内遇刺，日军海军陆战队次日登陆，要求由日本人担任工部局负责人兼巡捕长；英、美、法调舰对峙，最终于10月订立《鼓浪屿租界协定》，规定工部局以日本人为监督及警察部部长、禁止悬挂中国国旗。1941年12月8日太平洋战争爆发当天，日军在鼓浪屿登陆，接管公共租界，改组工部局，设集中营收容英美侨民；1943年5月28日汪伪「收回」租界，1945年抗战胜利后由中国政府正式收回。本事件不绘路线。 After Xiamen fell in May 1938 the Gulangyu International Settlement became the only “isolated island” in the Xiamen area; more than 100,000 refugees moved in, and Chinese troops still held Songyu to the west, making the island a sea route between occupied territory and the interior. On 11 May 1939 the puppet chamber-of-commerce chairman Hong Lixun was assassinated on the island; Japanese marines landed the next day and demanded that a Japanese head the municipal council and police. British, American and French warships confronted them, and in October an agreement made a Japanese the supervisor and head of police and banned the Chinese flag. On 8 December 1941, the day the Pacific War began, Japanese troops landed on Gulangyu, took over the settlement, reorganised the municipal council and set up an internment camp for British and American nationals. The Wang Jingwei regime “recovered” the settlement on 28 May 1943, and the Chinese government formally took it back in 1945. No route is drawn.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军第 25 军在马来亚哥打巴鲁登陆，马来亚战役开始。
summary.en: On 8 December 1941 the Japanese 25th Army landed at Kota Bharu, beginning the Malayan campaign.

fields.name: 日军登陆哥打巴鲁 Japanese landing at Kota Bharu
fields.place: 马来亚哥打巴鲁 Kota Bharu, Malaya
fields.summary: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军第 25 军在马来亚哥打巴鲁登陆，马来亚战役开始。 On 8 December 1941 the Japanese 25th Army landed at Kota Bharu, beginning the Malayan campaign.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 4 日，山下奉文指挥的日军第 25 军主力从中国海南岛三亚港出发，在南海舰队掩护下驶向马来半岛。12 月 8 日凌晨，日军在马来亚哥打巴鲁登陆，同时在泰国宋卡、北大年登陆。哥打巴鲁登陆是太平洋战争最早的地面战斗之一，日军迅速夺取附近机场，随后沿马来半岛东岸南下。1942 年 1 月 31 日占领柔佛巴鲁，2 月 15 日攻占新加坡。本事件只记哥打巴鲁登陆，宋卡、北大年另立一条。 On 4 December 1941 the main body of Yamashita Tomoyuki’s 25th Army sailed from Sanya on Hainan Island, covered by the South China Sea fleet, towards the Malay Peninsula. In the early hours of 8 December Japanese troops landed at Kota Bharu in Malaya and simultaneously at Singora and Patani in Thailand. The Kota Bharu landing was one of the first ground battles of the Pacific War; the Japanese quickly took nearby airfields and advanced down the east coast of Malaya, taking Johor Bahru on 31 January 1942 and Singapore on 15 February. This entry covers Kota Bharu only; Singora and Patani have a separate entry.

name.en: Japanese landings at Singora and Patani

summary.zh: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军在泰国宋卡、北大年登陆，越境进入马来亚北部。
summary.en: On 8 December 1941 Japanese forces landed at Singora and Patani in Thailand and crossed into northern Malaya.

fields.name: 日军登陆宋卡、北大年 Japanese landings at Singora and Patani
fields.summary: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军在泰国宋卡、北大年登陆，越境进入马来亚北部。 On 8 December 1941 Japanese forces landed at Singora and Patani in Thailand and crossed into northern Malaya.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军第 25 军一部在泰国宋卡、北大年登陆。宋卡登陆部队经沙头越境进入马来亚吉打州，北大年登陆部队经勿洞进入霹雳州，与哥打巴鲁登陆部队形成多路进攻。泰国政府在日军压力下允许其过境，随后与日本签订同盟条约。日军沿马来半岛东西两岸南下，1942 年 2 月 15 日攻占新加坡。本事件以宋卡为落点，北大年在同一段行动中提及。 On 8 December 1941 part of the Japanese 25th Army landed at Singora and Patani in Thailand. The Singora force crossed at Sadao into Kedah, and the Patani force crossed at Betong into Perak, forming a multi-pronged attack with the Kota Bharu landing. Under Japanese pressure Thailand allowed transit and soon signed an alliance with Japan. The Japanese advanced down both coasts of the Malay Peninsula and took Singapore on 15 February 1942. This entry uses Singora as its point; Patani is mentioned as part of the same operation.

summary.zh: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国政府正式对日本、德国、意大利宣战。
summary.en: After the Pacific War began, the Chinese government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy.

fields.name: 中国对日宣战 China Declares War on Japan
fields.summary: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国政府正式对日本、德国、意大利宣战。 After the Pacific War began, the Chinese government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 9 日，中国国民政府对日本、德国、意大利正式宣战，并宣布与三国所订一切条约、协定、合同一律废止——其中包括 1895 年《马关条约》，从法律上否定日本对台湾、澎湖的占领。中国抗战由此更紧密地融入世界反法西斯同盟。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 9 December 1941 the Chinese National Government declared war on Japan, Germany and Italy and abrogated all treaties, agreements and contracts concluded with them, including the 1895 Treaty of Shimonoseki, thereby denying in law Japan's occupation of Taiwan and the Penghu Islands. China's war effort became part of the wider Allied cause. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await archival review.

name.zh: 中共中央发出精兵简政指示
name.en: CCP Central Committee calls for fewer, better troops and simpler administration

summary.zh: 1941 年 12 月 17 日，中共中央发出指示，号召全党全军实行精兵简政。
summary.en: On 17 December 1941 the CCP Central Committee called on Party and army to reduce troop numbers and simplify administration.

fields.name: 中共中央发出精兵简政指示 CCP Central Committee calls for fewer, better troops and simpler administration
fields.summary: 1941 年 12 月 17 日，中共中央发出指示，号召全党全军实行精兵简政。 On 17 December 1941 the CCP Central Committee called on Party and army to reduce troop numbers and simplify administration.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 17 日，中共中央发出指示，号召全党全军实行精兵简政，克服抗日根据地财政经济的严重困难。此前，开明绅士李鼎铭在陕甘宁边区第二届参议会上提出「精兵简政」提案，得到中共中央重视。精兵简政与对敌斗争、统一领导、拥政爱民、整顿三风、审查干部、时事教育、三三制、减租减息等并列为抗日根据地的十大政策，对克服困难、巩固根据地起了重要作用。本事件为中央指示，不绘路线。 On 17 December 1941 the CCP Central Committee issued a directive calling on the whole Party and army to reduce troop numbers and simplify administration in order to overcome severe financial and economic difficulties in the base areas. The proposal had been raised by the progressive gentry member Li Dingming at the second Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia Border Region Assembly and was taken up by the Central Committee. “Fewer, better troops and simpler administration” became one of the ten major policies of the base areas, alongside struggle against the enemy, unified leadership, support for the government and the people, rectification of the three styles of work, cadre review, current-affairs education, the three-thirds system and rent and interest reduction. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1941 年 12 月 22 日，日军第 14 军在菲律宾吕宋岛林加延湾登陆，菲律宾战役扩大。

fields.name: 日军登陆林加延湾 Japanese landing at Lingayen Gulf
fields.place: 菲律宾吕宋岛林加延湾 Lingayen Gulf, Luzon, Philippines
fields.summary: 1941 年 12 月 22 日，日军第 14 军在菲律宾吕宋岛林加延湾登陆，菲律宾战役扩大。 On 22 December 1941 the Japanese 14th Army landed at Lingayen Gulf on Luzon, widening the Philippine campaign.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 17 日，本间雅晴指挥的日军第 14 军主力从高雄、基隆、马公出发。12 月 22 日，日军在吕宋岛西岸林加延湾登陆，另一部在东南岸拉蒙湾登陆。美军与菲律宾军退守巴丹半岛和科雷吉多要塞，马尼拉于 1942 年 1 月 2 日被日军占领，巴丹于 4 月 9 日陷落，科雷吉多於 5 月 7 日陷落。本事件取林加延湾登陆点，拉蒙湾在同一行动中提及。 On 17 December 1941 the main body of Homma Masaharu’s 14th Army sailed from Kaohsiung, Keelung and Makung. On 22 December it landed at Lingayen Gulf on the west coast of Luzon, while another force landed at Lamon Bay on the east coast. US and Philippine forces withdrew to Bataan and Corregidor; Manila fell on 2 January 1942, Bataan on 9 April and Corregidor on 7 May. This entry uses Lingayen Gulf; Lamon Bay is mentioned as part of the same operation.

summary.zh: 日军第三次进攻长沙，中国军队以“天炉战法”诱敌深入并反击，取得长沙大捷。
summary.en: Japan attacked Changsha for the third time; Chinese forces drew the Japanese in and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

fields.name: 第三次长沙会战 Third Battle of Changsha 长沙大捷 Changsha Victory 第三次长沙战役 Third Changsha Campaign
fields.summary: 日军第三次进攻长沙，中国军队以“天炉战法”诱敌深入并反击，取得长沙大捷。 Japan attacked Changsha for the third time; Chinese forces drew the Japanese in and counterattacked, winning a major victory.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 24 日，日军第十一军再次向长沙进攻。中国第九战区司令长官薛岳采取“天炉战法”，以一部兵力逐次抵抗、诱敌深入，主力从外围侧击、合围。日军攻入长沙外围后补给困难，被迫撤退；中国军队追击，至 1942 年 1 月中旬恢复原阵地。此役是太平洋战争爆发后中国正面战场的一次重要胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 On 24 December 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changsha again. Xue Yue, commander of China’s Ninth War Zone, employed the “heavenly furnace” tactic: a covering force resisted in stages and drew the Japanese inward while the main force struck the flanks and closed the ring. After reaching the outskirts of Changsha, the Japanese faced supply difficulties and were forced to retreat. Chinese forces pursued and restored the original line by mid-January 1942. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield after the outbreak of the Pacific War. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 新墙河防线失守（1941年12月） Fall of the Xinqiang River Line (December 1941)

fields.summary: 1941年12月24日，日军第3、第6、第40师团进攻新墙河，第三次长沙会战开始。 On 24 December 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions attacked the Xinqiang River, opening the third Changsha campaign.
fields.description: 1941年12月24日，日军第11军以第3、第6、第40师团向新墙河发起进攻，中国第20军抗击后转移。日军随后强渡汨罗江，1942年1月1日进攻长沙，遭中国第10军等部顽强抵抗，1月4日撤退，1月15日退回新墙河北岸。日期据维基百科《第三次长沙会战》与《长沙会战》。 On 24 December 1941 the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Xinqiang River with the 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions; the Chinese 20th Corps resisted and withdrew. The Japanese crossed the Miluo and attacked Changsha on 1 January 1942, but after stubborn resistance by the Chinese 10th Corps they withdrew on the 4th and were back north of the Xinqiang by the 15th.

fields.summary: 日军攻占香港，香港沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Hong Kong.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军第 38 师团自深圳进攻香港，经十八日战斗，12 月 25 日港督杨慕琦向日军投降，香港沦陷。香港沦陷使日军控制华南沿海，并切断中国经香港的补给线。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 8 December 1941 the Japanese 38th Division attacked Hong Kong from Shenzhen. After eighteen days of fighting, Governor Mark Young surrendered on 25 December and Hong Kong fell. The occupation gave Japan control of the South China coast and cut China’s supply route through Hong Kong. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1941年12月26日，日军第3、第6、第40师团渡过汨罗江，向长沙推进。中国第9战区按“天炉战法”逐次抵抗，诱敌至长沙外围。日期据维基百科《第三次长沙会战》与《长沙会战》。 On 26 December 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions crossed the Miluo River and advanced on Changsha. fields.name: 日军接管孤军营 Japanese Take Over the Internment Camp
fields.place: 上海胶州路孤军营 Jiaozhou Road camp, Shanghai
fields.summary: 1941年12月28日，日军从公共租界当局手中接管孤军营，将孤军官兵分散服苦役。 On 28 December 1941 the Japanese took over the internment camp from the settlement authorities and dispersed the men to forced labour.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 8 日太平洋战争爆发，日军进入上海公共租界。12 月 28 日，日军从公共租界当局手中接管胶州路孤军营，劝降不成后，将孤军官兵分散押往南京孝陵卫、杭州南星桥、安徽芜湖裕溪口等地服苦役，部分被押往巴布亚新几内亚当劳工。至此，自 1937 年 10 月 31 日撤入租界起，四行孤军在租界被羁留四年余。本事件为接管与押送，不绘路线。 On 8 December 1941 the Pacific War began and Japanese troops entered the Shanghai International Settlement. On 28 December the Japanese took over the Jiaozhou Road camp from the settlement authorities; after the men refused to submit, they were dispersed to forced labour at Xiaolingwei near Nanjing, Nanxingqiao in Hangzhou and Yuxikou in Wuhu, Anhui, with some sent as labourers to Papua New Guinea. The Sihang survivors had thus been held in the settlement for more than four years since 31 October 1937. No route is drawn.

fields.summary: 1942年1月1日，日军第3、第6、第40师团进攻长沙，遭中国第10军顽强抵抗。 On 1 January 1942 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions attacked Changsha and met stubborn resistance from the Chinese 10th Corps.
fields.description: 1942年1月1日，日军第3、第6、第40师团进攻长沙，中国第10军依托城垣和岳麓山炮兵顽强抵抗，日军猛攻4日未能破城，1月4日撤退。中国军队追击，1月15日日军退回新墙河北岸。这是第三次长沙会战的转折点。日期据维基百科《第三次长沙会战》与《长沙会战》。 On 1 January 1942 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions attacked Changsha. The Chinese 10th Corps, supported by artillery on Yuelu Mountain, held the city walls; after four days of assault the Japanese withdrew on 4 January. The Chinese pursued, and by 15 January the Japanese were back north of the Xinqiang. This was the turning point of the third Changsha campaign.

fields.summary: 1942 年 1 月，日军第 15 军以泰国为基地越过泰缅边界进攻缅甸，3 月 8 日占领仰光。 In January 1942 the Japanese 15th Army attacked Burma from Thailand and took Rangoon on 8 March.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军第 15 军从法属印度支那侵入泰国。1942 年 1 月，第 15 军以泰国清迈、来兴为基地，越过泰缅边界进攻丹那沙林，随后沿萨尔温江北上，3 月 8 日占领仰光。中国远征军于 1942 年 2 月入缅，与英军并肩作战，5 月撤退。 必须说明：日军进入缅甸是陆路越境，不是海上登陆仰光 ；本段画陆路 advance，不画 naval。 On 8 December 1941 the Japanese 15th Army entered Thailand from French Indochina. In January 1942, based at Chiang Mai and Tak, it crossed the Thai–Burmese border into Tenasserim, advanced north along the Salween and took Rangoon on 8 March. The Chinese Expeditionary Force entered Burma in February 1942, fought alongside British forces and withdrew in May. The Japanese entered Burma overland, not by an amphibious landing at Rangoon ; this segment is drawn as a land advance, not as naval.

fields.description: 1942 年初，为保卫滇缅公路和支援盟军，中国远征军陆续自云南入缅，与英军协同作战。远征军在缅北、缅中地区与日军激战，后因战局不利而撤退。 本事件日期取 1942 年 2 月的示意时间点，具体入缅日期待史料校订。 In early 1942, to defend the Burma Road and support the Allies, the Chinese Expeditionary Force entered Burma from Yunnan and fought alongside British troops. It engaged Japanese forces in northern and central Burma before withdrawing under unfavorable conditions. The date is an illustrative point in February 1942; the exact entry dates await historical review.

name.en: Mao Zedong’s “Rectify the Party’s Style of Work”

summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月 1 日，毛泽东在中央党校开学典礼作《整顿党的作风》讲演，全党整风全面展开。
summary.en: On 1 February 1942 Mao spoke on rectifying the Party’s style at the Central Party School, launching full-scale rectification.

fields.name: 毛泽东《整顿党的作风》 Mao Zedong’s “Rectify the Party’s Style of Work”
fields.summary: 1942 年 2 月 1 日，毛泽东在中央党校开学典礼作《整顿党的作风》讲演，全党整风全面展开。 On 1 February 1942 Mao spoke on rectifying the Party’s style at the Central Party School, launching full-scale rectification.
fields.description: 1942 年 2 月 1 日，毛泽东在延安中央党校开学典礼上作《整顿党的作风》讲演，提出反对主观主义以整顿学风、反对宗派主义以整顿党风、反对党八股以整顿文风。讲演阐明整风的宗旨是「惩前毖后，治病救人」，强调全党要理论联系实际、密切联系群众、开展批评与自我批评。此后整风运动在延安和各抗日根据地全面展开。整风运动使全党在马克思列宁主义、毛泽东思想基础上达到新的团结，为七大的召开准备了思想条件。本事件为理论讲演，不绘路线。 On 1 February 1942 Mao Zedong spoke at the opening of the Central Party School in Yan’an on rectifying the Party’s style of work. He called for opposing subjectivism to rectify study, sectarianism to rectify Party conduct, and stereotyped Party writing to rectify the style of writing. He explained that the purpose was “to learn from past mistakes to avoid future ones, and to cure the sickness to save the patient”, and stressed integrating theory with practice, maintaining close ties with the masses and practising criticism and self-criticism. Rectification then unfolded across Yan’an and the base areas, bringing the whole Party to a new unity on the basis of Marxism-Leninism and Mao Zedong Thought and preparing the ground for the Seventh Congress. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 毛泽东《反对党八股》 Mao Zedong’s “Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing”
fields.summary: 1942 年 2 月 8 日，毛泽东作《反对党八股》讲演，列举党八股八条罪状。 On 8 February 1942 Mao delivered “Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing”, listing its eight evils.
fields.description: 1942 年 2 月 8 日，毛泽东在延安干部会上作《反对党八股》讲演，列举党八股的空话连篇、装腔作势、无的放矢、语言无味、甲乙丙丁开中药铺、不负责任、流毒全党、害党害国等八条罪状，要求代之以新鲜活泼、为中国老百姓所喜闻乐见的中国作风和中国气派。讲演与《改造我们的学习》《整顿党的作风》共同构成延安整风的基本文献，重点解决文风问题。本事件为理论讲演，不绘路线。 On 8 February 1942 Mao Zedong addressed a Yan’an cadres’ meeting with “Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing”. He listed eight evils: empty verbiage, pretentiousness, aimlessness, insipid language, the mechanical “A, B, C, D” catalogue, irresponsibility, spreading poison through the Party, and harming both Party and country. He called for a fresh and lively Chinese style and spirit that ordinary Chinese would welcome. With “Reform Our Study” and “Rectify the Party’s Style of Work”, the speech formed a basic text of the Yan’an rectification movement, focusing on style of writing. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1942年2月12日，东北抗联创建人之一赵尚志在梧桐河被日特击伤被俘，当日牺牲，年34岁。
summary.en: On 12 February 1942 Zhao Shangzhi, a founder of the United Army, was treacherously wounded and captured by the Wutong River and died the same day; he was 34.

fields.name: 赵尚志牺牲 Death of Zhao Shangzhi
fields.place: 黑龙江汤原梧桐河（今萝北） Wutong River, Tangyuan (modern Luobei), Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1942年2月12日，东北抗联创建人之一赵尚志在梧桐河被日特击伤被俘，当日牺牲，年34岁。 On 12 February 1942 Zhao Shangzhi, a founder of the United Army, was treacherously wounded and captured by the Wutong River and died the same day; he was 34.
fields.description: 赵尚志 1908 年生于热河朝阳，1925 年入党，黄埔军校第四期；1933 年 10 月创建珠河反日游击队，1935 年 1 月任东北人民革命军第三军军长，1936 年 8 月任东北抗日联军第三军军长、北满临时省委执委主席，与杨靖宇并称「南杨北赵」。1938 年赴苏被关押一年半，1939 年任东北抗日联军总司令，1940 年 3 月改任第三路军副总指挥。1941 年秋率 5 人小分队回国，活动于萝北、汤原一带。1942 年 2 月 12 日凌晨，在袭击鹤立县梧桐河伪警察分驻所途中，于吕家菜园子（今鹤北林业局尚志林场）被日特刘德山从背后开枪击伤，昏迷中被俘，当日 7 时牺牲，年 34 岁；另有「伤后 3 小时」「伤后 8 小时」之说（即上午 11 时前后），时刻存异说。日军割下头颅，遗体投入松花江冰窟。1982 年 6 月 8 日中共黑龙江省委为其平反、恢复党籍。牺牲时间据抚顺战犯管理所旧址陈列馆 2025 年披露的日本战犯田井久二郎笔供。本事件不绘路线。 Zhao Shangzhi, born in Chaoyang, Rehe (modern Liaoning), in 1908, joined the party in 1925 and attended the fourth class of the Whampoa Military Academy; he founded the Zhuhe anti-Japanese guerrillas in October 1933, became commander of the 3rd Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army in January 1935, and in August 1936 commander of the United Army’s 3rd Army and chairman of the North Manchurian provisional provincial committee, known with Yang Jingyu as “South Yang, North Zhao”. Detained in the Soviet Union for eighteen months from 1938, he was named commander-in-chief of the United Army in 1939 and deputy commander of the 3rd Route Army in March 1940. In autumn 1941 he returned with five men to operate around Luobei and Tangyuan. In the early hours of 12 February 1942, on the way to attack the Wutong River police post in Heli county, he was shot from behind by the Japanese agent Liu Deshan at the Lü family vegetable plot (modern Shangzhi forest farm, Hebei forestry bureau), captured unconscious and died at seven that morning, aged 34; other accounts give three or eight hours after the shooting (around eleven in the morning), so the exact time is disputed. The Japanese cut off his head and threw his body into the ice of the Songhua River. The Heilongjiang provincial party committee rehabilitated him on 8 June 1982. The time of death follows the confession of the Japanese war criminal Taii Kyūjirō disclosed in 2025. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1942 年 3 月 1 日，日军第 16 军分三路在爪哇登陆，荷属东印度战役进入最后阶段。
summary.en: On 1 March 1942 the Japanese 16th Army landed on Java in three columns, beginning the final phase of the Dutch East Indies campaign.

fields.name: 日军登陆爪哇 Japanese landing on Java
fields.place: 荷属东印度爪哇 Java, Dutch East Indies
fields.summary: 1942 年 3 月 1 日，日军第 16 军分三路在爪哇登陆，荷属东印度战役进入最后阶段。 On 1 March 1942 the Japanese 16th Army landed on Java in three columns, beginning the final phase of the Dutch East Indies campaign.
fields.description: 1942 年 2 月，日军已占领婆罗洲、苏拉威西、苏门答腊南部等地。3 月 1 日，日军第 16 军分三路在爪哇登陆：西路在万丹湾、中路在井里汶、东路在泗水附近。3 月 5 日占领巴达维亚（今雅加达），3 月 9 日荷属东印度荷军投降，3 月 10 日日军占领万隆。爪哇登陆是日军南方作战的重要一环，与马来亚、菲律宾、缅甸战场相互配合。本事件取巴达维亚附近登陆点，三路登陆不逐一画线。 By February 1942 Japan had taken Borneo, Sulawesi and southern Sumatra. On 1 March the 16th Army landed on Java in three columns: the western force at Banten Bay, the central force at Cirebon and the eastern force near Surabaya. Batavia (now Jakarta) fell on 5 March, the Dutch forces in the East Indies surrendered on 9 March, and Bandung was occupied on 10 March. The Java landing was a key part of Japan’s southern offensive, linked with the Malayan, Philippine and Burma campaigns. The entry uses the Batavia area as its point; the three landing columns are not drawn separately.

fields.description: 为把石碌铁矿的矿石运到八所港装船，日军修建石碌—八所铁路，全长约 52 公里。1942 年 3 月铺轨完成，3 月 23 日第一列运矿车由石碌抵达八所。据日方资料，石碌铁矿 1941—1945 年开采约 69.5 万吨、运出约 41 万吨；数字待页码级核对。 To move ore from the Shilu mine to Basuo port, Japan built the roughly 52-km Shilu–Basuo railway. Track laying was completed in March 1942, and on 23 March the first ore train ran from Shilu to Basuo. According to Japanese sources, the Shilu mine produced about 695,000 tons and shipped about 410,000 tons in 1941–1945; these figures await page-level verification.

name.en: Counter-Offensive against the May Day “Mopping-Up” in Central Hebei

place.zh: 河北冀中（河间、饶阳一带）

summary.zh: 日军 5 万余人“拉网扫荡”冀中，冀中军民艰苦反“扫荡”。
summary.en: More than 50,000 Japanese troops conducted a dragnet “mopping-up” of central Hebei; local forces and civilians fought a costly counter-campaign.

fields.name: 冀中反“五一大扫荡” Counter-Offensive against the May Day “Mopping-Up” in Central Hebei 五一大扫荡 May Day Mopping-Up
fields.place: 河北冀中（河间、饶阳一带） Central Hebei (Hejian–Raoyang area)
fields.summary: 日军 5 万余人“拉网扫荡”冀中，冀中军民艰苦反“扫荡”。 More than 50,000 Japanese troops conducted a dragnet “mopping-up” of central Hebei; local forces and civilians fought a costly counter-campaign.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 1 日起，日军华北方面军调集 5 万余人，对冀中抗日根据地发动“五一大扫荡”，采取“铁壁合围”“拉网清剿”战法。冀中军区部队和民兵在极端困难条件下分散游击、坚持反“扫荡”，但根据地大部被分割，部队和群众损失严重，冀中抗战进入最艰苦阶段。 兵力与损失数字各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 From 1 May 1942 the Japanese North China Area Army committed more than 50,000 troops to a “May Day mopping-up” of the central Hebei base area, using “iron-wall encirclement” and dragnet search tactics. Jizhong Military Region troops and militia dispersed into guerrilla warfare and persevered, but most of the base area was cut up and military and civilian losses were severe; the resistance in central Hebei entered its hardest period. Force and loss figures vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: May Day Sweep in Central Hebei

summary.zh: 日军华北方面军对冀中根据地发动“五一大扫荡”。
summary.en: The Japanese North China Area Army launched the “May Day Sweep” against the Central Hebei base area.

fields.name: 冀中五一大扫荡 May Day Sweep in Central Hebei
fields.place: 河北冀中（深县一带） Central Hebei (around Shenxian)
fields.summary: 日军华北方面军对冀中根据地发动“五一大扫荡”。 The Japanese North China Area Army launched the “May Day Sweep” against the Central Hebei base area.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 1 日，日军华北方面军调集第 110 师团、第 27 师团及伪军等部，对冀中抗日根据地发动大规模“扫荡”，企图围歼八路军冀中军区部队。八路军采取分散游击、地道战等方式坚持，根据地遭受严重损失。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。本事件为战役性“扫荡”，不绘单线。 On 1 May 1942 the Japanese North China Area Army deployed the 110th and 27th Divisions and puppet troops in a large-scale sweep of the Central Hebei anti-Japanese base area, aiming to destroy the Eighth Route Army’s Central Hebei Military District. The Eighth Route Army dispersed into guerrilla and tunnel warfare; the base area suffered heavy losses. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. As a campaign-level sweep, it is not drawn as a single route.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: Japanese “Sweep” of the Qiongya Base Area

summary.zh: 日军对琼崖抗日根据地发动“扫荡”，琼崖独立总队反“扫荡”。
summary.en: Japanese forces launched a “sweep” against the Qiongya anti-Japanese base area, and the Qiongya Independent Corps countered it.

fields.name: 日军“扫荡”琼崖根据地 Japanese “Sweep” of the Qiongya Base Area
fields.summary: 日军对琼崖抗日根据地发动“扫荡”，琼崖独立总队反“扫荡”。 Japanese forces launched a “sweep” against the Qiongya anti-Japanese base area, and the Qiongya Independent Corps countered it.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月，日军调集海口、嘉积、那大等据点兵力，对琼山、文昌、定安一带的琼崖抗日根据地发动“扫荡”，企图消灭琼崖独立总队主力。琼崖独立总队以分散游击、民众自卫等方式反“扫荡”，坚持根据地。具体兵力、战斗次数与起止日期待页码级核对。本事件为“扫荡”阶段节点，不绘单线。 In May 1942 Japanese forces drawn from Haikou, Jiaji, Nada and other garrisons launched a “sweep” against the Qiongya base area in Qiongshan, Wenchang and Ding’an, aiming to destroy the main force of the Qiongya Independent Corps. The Corps resisted through dispersed guerrilla warfare and local self-defense. Strength, number of engagements and exact dates await page-level verification. This is a phase marker and is not drawn as a single route.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: Yan’an Forum on Literature and Art

summary.zh: 1942 年 5 月 2—23 日，中共中央在延安召开文艺座谈会，毛泽东发表《在延安文艺座谈会上的讲话》。
summary.en: From 2 to 23 May 1942 the CCP held a forum on literature and art at Yan’an, where Mao delivered his talks on the subject.

fields.name: 延安文艺座谈会 Yan’an Forum on Literature and Art
fields.summary: 1942 年 5 月 2—23 日，中共中央在延安召开文艺座谈会，毛泽东发表《在延安文艺座谈会上的讲话》。 From 2 to 23 May 1942 the CCP held a forum on literature and art at Yan’an, where Mao delivered his talks on the subject.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 2 日至 23 日，中共中央在延安杨家岭召开文艺座谈会，约百名文艺工作者参加。毛泽东作引言和结论，后整理为《在延安文艺座谈会上的讲话》。讲话提出文艺为人民群众、首先为工农兵服务的根本方向，强调文艺工作者要深入工农兵、深入实际，改造世界观，解决立场、态度、工作对象和学习问题；同时阐述普及与提高、政治标准与艺术标准等关系。座谈会是延安整风在文艺界的展开，对此后中国文艺发展产生深远影响。本事件为会议，不绘路线。 From 2 to 23 May 1942 the CCP Central Committee held a forum on literature and art at Yangjialing, Yan’an, attended by about a hundred writers and artists. Mao Zedong gave the opening and concluding speeches, later edited as “Talks at the Yan’an Forum on Literature and Art”. He set the fundamental direction of literature and art for the people, first of all for workers, peasants and soldiers, and urged writers and artists to go among them, immerse themselves in practice, remould their world outlook and settle questions of standpoint, attitude, audience and learning. He also discussed the relationship between popularisation and raising standards and between political and artistic criteria. The forum extended rectification into cultural work and had a lasting influence on Chinese literature and art. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 日军第 56 师团自缅甸侵入滇西，占领畹町。
summary.en: The Japanese 56th Division invaded western Yunnan from Burma and occupied Wanding.

fields.name: 日军侵入滇西 Japanese Invasion of Western Yunnan
fields.summary: 日军第 56 师团自缅甸侵入滇西，占领畹町。 The Japanese 56th Division invaded western Yunnan from Burma and occupied Wanding.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月，日军第 56 师团自缅甸向中国云南边境推进。5 月 3 日，日军占领畹町，随后沿滇缅公路北犯龙陵、腾冲。中国远征军撤退，滇西沦陷。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division advanced from Burma toward the Yunnan border. On 3 May it occupied Wanding and then advanced north along the Burma Road toward Longling and Tengchong. The Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew and western Yunnan fell. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 3 May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division entered western Yunnan from Burma and occupied Zhefang.

fields.name: 遮放沦陷 Fall of Zhefang
fields.summary: 1942年5月3日，日军第56师团自缅甸侵入滇西，占领遮放。 On 3 May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division entered western Yunnan from Burma and occupied Zhefang.

fields.name: 瑞丽沦陷 Fall of Ruili
fields.summary: 1942年5月3日，日军占领瑞丽（勐卯）。 On 3 May 1942 the Japanese occupied Ruili (Mengmao).
fields.description: 1942年5月3日，日军由缅甸攻入滇西，占领瑞丽（勐卯）。瑞丽为滇缅边境重镇，失守后日军控制怒江以西的德宏全境。日期据《滇西土司的抗战》与《日军在滇西设慰安所30余个》。 On 3 May 1942 the Japanese entered western Yunnan from Burma and occupied Ruili (Mengmao), the key border town, gaining control of the Dehong area west of the Salween.

summary.en: Japanese forces advanced north along the Burma Road and occupied Longling.

fields.name: 龙陵沦陷 Fall of Longling
fields.summary: 日军沿滇缅公路北犯，占领龙陵。 Japanese forces advanced north along the Burma Road and occupied Longling.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 4 日，日军第 56 师团一部占领龙陵，随后继续向惠通桥推进。中国军队炸毁惠通桥，阻止日军东渡怒江。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 4 May 1942 a detachment of the Japanese 56th Division occupied Longling and continued toward the Huitong Bridge. Chinese forces blew up the bridge to stop the Japanese from crossing the Salween. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.
