fields.name: 芒市沦陷 Fall of Mangshi
fields.place: 云南潞西芒市 Mangshi, Luxi, Yunnan
fields.summary: 1942年5月4日，日军第56师团占领芒市。 On 4 May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division occupied Mangshi.
fields.description: 1942年5月4日日军第56师团占领芒市，5日日军军团司令部进入芒市城，对城区进行“清城”，居民被迫迁出。芒市为潞西设治局驻地，失守后日军沿滇缅公路直趋龙陵。日期据《日军滇西暴行铁证如山》与《日军在滇西设慰安所30余个》。 On 4 May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division took Mangshi; on the 5th its army headquarters entered the town and cleared the urban area, forcing residents out. Mangshi was the seat of the Luxi administration and its loss opened the road to Longling.

fields.summary: 1942年5月4日，日军占领陇川。 On 4 May 1942 the Japanese occupied Longchuan.

fields.summary: 1942年5月4日，日军占领盈江（干崖）。 On 4 May 1942 the Japanese occupied Yingjiang (Ganya).
fields.description: 1942年5月4日，日军占领盈江（干崖）。盈江为德宏北部土司地区，失守后干崖土司刀京版组织滇西边区自卫军坚持游击。日期据《滇西土司的抗战》与《日军在滇西设慰安所30余个》。 On 4 May 1942 the Japanese occupied Yingjiang (Ganya) in northern Dehong. After its fall the Ganya chieftain Dao Jingban organized the Western Yunnan Border Self-Defence Army and waged guerrilla warfare.

fields.name: 保山大轰炸 Bombing of Baoshan
fields.summary: 1942年5月4日至5日，日军飞机54架轰炸保山，造成重大伤亡。 On 4–5 May 1942 fifty-four Japanese aircraft bombed Baoshan, causing heavy casualties.
fields.description: 1942年5月4日中午，日军27架飞机轰炸保山，半小时后第二批27架再次轰炸；5月5日54架飞机继续轰炸。保山城几乎被毁，死伤万余人，是滇西抗战中的重大惨案。日期据《勿忘历史：1942年5月4日，日军轰炸云南保山》与《日军滇西暴行铁证如山》。 At noon on 4 May 1942 twenty-seven Japanese aircraft bombed Baoshan, followed half an hour later by another twenty-seven; on 5 May fifty-four aircraft attacked again. The city was almost destroyed and more than 10,000 were killed or wounded, one of the worst atrocities of the western Yunnan war.

name.en: Japanese Advance to the Huitong Bridge

place.en: Huitong Bridge on the Salween, Yunnan

summary.zh: 日军进抵惠通桥，中国军队炸桥阻敌。
summary.en: Japanese forces reached the Huitong Bridge, which Chinese troops destroyed to block their advance.

fields.name: 日军进抵惠通桥 Japanese Advance to the Huitong Bridge
fields.place: 云南怒江惠通桥 Huitong Bridge on the Salween, Yunnan
fields.summary: 日军进抵惠通桥，中国军队炸桥阻敌。 Japanese forces reached the Huitong Bridge, which Chinese troops destroyed to block their advance.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 5 日，日军先头部队进抵怒江惠通桥，中国守军炸毁桥梁，阻止日军东进。此后中日两军隔怒江对峙，滇西沦陷区形成。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 5 May 1942 Japanese advance troops reached the Huitong Bridge over the Salween; Chinese defenders blew up the bridge and halted the Japanese eastward advance. The two sides then faced each other across the Salween, and the occupied zone in western Yunnan took shape. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 10 May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division entered Tengchong.

fields.name: 腾冲沦陷 Fall of Tengchong
fields.summary: 1942年5月10日，日军第56师团侵入腾冲县城。 On 10 May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division entered Tengchong.
fields.description: 1942年5月10日午后，日军292人由龙陵方向进入腾冲县城，不费一枪一弹占领全城。腾冲为滇西边城，失守后怒江以西约3万平方公里国土全部沦陷。日期据《日军滇西暴行铁证如山》与方国瑜《抗日战争滇西战事篇》。 In the afternoon of 10 May 1942, 292 Japanese troops entered Tengchong from Longling and occupied the city without a shot. With the fall of this border town, some 30,000 square kilometres west of the Salween were lost.

fields.summary: 1942年5月10日，日军占领梁河（南甸）。 On 10 May 1942 the Japanese occupied Lianghe (Nandian).
fields.description: 1942年5月10日，日军在侵入腾冲的同日占领梁河（南甸）。梁河为南甸土司辖地，失守后怒江以西约3万平方公里国土全部沦陷。日期据《滇西土司的抗战》与《日军滇西暴行铁证如山》。 On 10 May 1942, the same day it entered Tengchong, the Japanese occupied Lianghe (Nandian). With its fall the whole area west of the Salween—some 30,000 square kilometres—was lost.

fields.summary: 日军第 13 军自杭州西进，与南昌日军东西对进。 The Japanese 13th Army moved west from Hangzhou to meet the Nanchang force.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 15 日日军第 13 军自杭州、萧山出动，沿浙赣路西进；南昌方面的日军同时东进，两路在横峰会合，7 月日军撤退，浙赣会战结束。杭州自 1937 年 12 月即为日军占领。 On 15 May 1942 the Japanese 13th Army moved out of Hangzhou and Xiaoshan west along the Zhejiang–Jiangxi railway while the Nanchang force moved east; the columns met at Hengfeng, and the Japanese withdrew in July, ending the campaign. Hangzhou had been occupied since December 1937.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 八路军总部在十字岭突围，副参谋长左权牺牲。
summary.en: The Eighth Route Army headquarters broke out at Shiziling; deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan was killed.

fields.name: 十字岭战斗 Battle of Shiziling
fields.summary: 八路军总部在十字岭突围，副参谋长左权牺牲。 The Eighth Route Army headquarters broke out at Shiziling; deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan was killed.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月，日军对太行根据地进行“扫荡”。5 月 25 日，八路军总部和中共中央北方局机关在山西辽县十字岭一带遭日军合围，副参谋长左权在指挥突围时牺牲，年仅 37 岁。 日期、地点与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1942 Japanese forces conducted a “mopping-up” campaign in the Taihang base area. On 25 May the Eighth Route Army headquarters and the CCP Northern Bureau were encircled near Shiziling, Liaoxian, Shanxi; deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan was killed while directing the breakout at the age of 37. Dates, location, and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 27 日，日军在“五一大扫荡”中对河北定县北疃村施放毒气，杀害躲避在地道中的村民和八路军伤病员。具体死难人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。 On 27 May 1942, during the “May Day Sweep,” Japanese forces used poison gas in Beituan village, Dingxian, Hebei, killing villagers and Eighth Route Army wounded sheltering in tunnels. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

fields.summary: 1942年5月28日，金华沦陷。 On 28 May 1942 Jinhua fell.
fields.description: 5月28日，金华、兰溪同日沦陷。仅据1942年年底统计，金华全县被强奸的妇女就有1370人。日期据《浙赣会战》与《衢州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 Jinhua and Lanxi fell on the same day, 28 May. By the end of 1942, 1,370 women had been raped in Jinhua county alone. The date follows the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign account and the Quzhou chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 5月28日，兰溪城沦陷。当天日军窜进排岭村，纵火烧毁村民吴连根、吴金朝、吴有根等房屋20余间。日期据《浙赣会战》与《衢州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 Lanxi fell on 28 May. That day Japanese troops entered Painling village and burned more than 20 houses belonging to Wu Liangen, Wu Jinchao, Wu Yougen and others. The date follows the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign account and the Quzhou chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军攻占上饶，浙赣铁路东段被打通。 Japanese forces captured Shangrao, opening the eastern section of the Zhejiang–Jiangxi railway.
fields.description: 1942 年 6 月 14 日，日军第 22 师团等部占领上饶，第三战区长官部所在地失守。7 月 1 日，东西两路日军在横峰会合，浙赣铁路被打通。日期据浙赣会战史料，待页码级核对。 On 14 June 1942 the Japanese 22nd Division and other units occupied Shangrao, seat of the Chinese 3rd War Zone headquarters. On 1 July Japanese columns from east and west met at Hengfeng, opening the Zhejiang–Jiangxi railway. The date follows campaign histories and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 第5军第200师退回滇西 200th Division Returns to Western Yunnan
fields.summary: 缅甸战败后，第5军第200师退回滇西，新编第22师退往印度。 After the Burma defeat the 200th Division returned to western Yunnan while the New 22nd Division withdrew to India.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月缅甸战局逆转，第5军被迫撤退。第200师经缅北退回云南保山一带，新编第22师随杜聿明部退往印度。撤退途中损失惨重。 路线为示意简化，仅画第200师回滇主线；新22师退印另见盟军线。日期待史料校订。 In May 1942 the Burma front collapsed and the 5th Army was forced to retreat. The 200th Division returned to the Baoshan area of Yunnan, while the New 22nd Division withdrew to India with Du Yuming’s headquarters. Losses during the retreat were severe. Illustrative simplified route showing only the 200th Division’s return; the New 22nd Division’s withdrawal to India is covered by the Allied layer. Dates await historical review.

summary.en: The Japanese Kogiso Mixed Brigade advanced south along the Jinhua–Lishui–Wenzhou road and occupied Wenzhou.

fields.name: 温州第二次沦陷 Second Fall of Wenzhou
fields.summary: 日军小薗江混成旅团沿金华—丽水—温州公路南犯，占领温州。 The Japanese Kogiso Mixed Brigade advanced south along the Jinhua–Lishui–Wenzhou road and occupied Wenzhou.
fields.description: 1942 年 7 月，日军驻上海的第 13 军所属小薗江混成旅团近千人，沿金华、丽水、青田、温州公路南犯，7 月 1 日占丽水、9 日占青田、11 日占温州，并一度盘踞乐清磐石和瑞安县城，8 月 15 日撤走。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In July 1942 the Japanese 13th Army’s Kogiso Mixed Brigade, about 1,000 strong and based in Shanghai, advanced south along the Jinhua–Lishui–Qingtian–Wenzhou road, occupying Lishui on 1 July, Qingtian on 9 July and Wenzhou on 11 July. It briefly held Pan’shi in Yueqing and Rui’an county town before withdrawing on 15 August. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: After setbacks in Burma, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India and was later reorganized as the Chinese Army in India.

fields.name: 远征军撤往印度 Expeditionary Force Withdraws to India
fields.summary: 缅甸战局失利后，中国远征军部分部队撤往印度，后整编为中国驻印军。 After setbacks in Burma, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India and was later reorganized as the Chinese Army in India.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月前后，缅甸战局恶化，中国远征军部分部队经野人山等路线撤往印度，损失惨重；另一部分退回云南。撤至印度的部队后来在兰姆伽整训，整编为中国驻印军。 本事件日期为示意时间点，撤退路线与时间待史料校订。 Around May 1942, as the situation in Burma deteriorated, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India through difficult routes including the Naga Hills, suffering heavy losses; another part returned to Yunnan. The troops in India were later reorganized and trained at Ramgarh as the Chinese Army in India. The date is an illustrative point; retreat routes and timing await historical review.

fields.description: 1942 年 5 月缅甸战局逆转后，第5军新22师随杜聿明部经野人山向印度撤退，8 月抵达印度雷多（利多）。撤退途中损失惨重，后改编为中国驻印军。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 After the Burma front collapsed in May 1942, the New 22nd Division of the 5th Army withdrew with Du Yuming’s headquarters through the Naga Hills toward India and reached Ledo in August. Losses during the retreat were severe; the division was later reorganized into the Chinese Army in India. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 东北抗联教导旅成立 Formation of the United Army Training Brigade
fields.place: 苏联伯力北野营 Northern Camp near Khabarovsk, USSR
fields.summary: 1942年8月1日，东北抗联教导旅在苏联伯力附近的北野营成立，对外番号为苏联远东方面军独立第88步兵旅。 On 1 August 1942 the United Army training brigade was formed at the northern camp near Khabarovsk, under the cover designation of the Soviet Far Eastern Front’s 88th Independent Infantry Brigade.
fields.description: 1940 年后，东北抗联在日军「三年治安肃正」与反复「大讨伐」下严重减员，主力分批退入苏联境内，在伯力附近的北野营与乌苏里斯克（双城子）附近的南野营整训。1942 年 8 月 1 日，南北野营及仍在东北活动的人员合编为东北抗日联军教导旅，旅长周保中，政治委员（后改政治副旅长）李兆麟，参谋长杨林（沙马尔钦科），副参谋长崔石泉（崔庸健）；辖 4 个步兵教导营与无线电、迫击炮两个直属连。全旅 1000 余人（一说 1500 至 2000 余人，含苏籍与朝鲜籍官兵），对外番号「苏联远东方面军独立第 88 步兵旅」，代号 8461 部队；番号授予时间，一说与成立同日，一说其后正式授予。1942 年 9 月 13 日，教导旅召开全体党员大会，成立中共东北党组织特别支部局（东北党委员会）。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 After 1940, worn down by the Japanese “three-year pacification” and repeated punitive campaigns, the main force of the United Army withdrew in stages into the Soviet Union and trained at the northern camp near Khabarovsk and the southern camp near Ussuriysk (Shuangchengzi). On 1 August 1942 the two camps and the men still operating in Manchuria were merged into the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army Training Brigade, under Zhou Baozhong as commander, Li Zhaolin as political commissar (later political deputy commander), Yang Lin (Shamarchinko) as chief of staff and Cui Shiquan (Choe Yong-gon) as deputy chief of staff, with four infantry training battalions and separate signals and mortar companies. It numbered just over 1,000 men (some accounts say 1,500 to 2,000, including Soviet and Korean personnel) and bore the cover designation “88th Independent Infantry Brigade, Soviet Far Eastern Front”, code 8461; whether the designation was conferred the same day or later is disputed. On 13 September 1942 a general party meeting established the Special Branch Bureau of the Chinese Communist Party in the Independent Brigade (the Northeast Party Committee). This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

fields.name: 许亨植牺牲 Death of Xu Hengzhi
fields.place: 黑龙江庆安青峰岭 Qingfeng Ridge, Qing’an, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 1942年8月3日，抗联第三路军总参谋长兼第三军军长许亨植在庆安青峰岭与日伪军激战中牺牲，年33岁。 On 3 August 1942 Xu Hengzhi, chief of staff of the 3rd Route Army and commander of the 3rd Army, was killed in action at Qingfeng Ridge in Qing’an; he was 33.
fields.description: 许亨植又名李熙山，朝鲜族，1909 年生于朝鲜庆尚北道善山郡，1913 年随家流亡中国东北，1930 年加入中国共产党。历任东北人民革命军第三军团长、师政治部主任，1937 年任抗联第九军政治部主任，1938 年任第三军新编第三师师长，1939 年任第三路军总参谋长兼第三军军长，并兼第十二支队政委。1941 年秋北满抗联主力转入苏联整训后，许亨植率小部队留在庆安、铁力、巴彦、木兰、东兴一带，发展抗日救国会。1942 年 7 月末，许亨植带警卫员陈云祥到巴彦、木兰、东兴检查工作，8 月 2 日返程，宿营于青峰岭下少凌河畔。8 月 3 日清晨因炊烟暴露，被庆安县伪警察队 30 余人包围；激战两个多小时，警卫员陈云祥牺牲，许亨植头部中弹殉国，年 33 岁。日伪将许亨植、陈云祥头颅割下，在庆安县城「示众」。地名说明：伪满称庆城县，民国县名为庆安县，本事件按民国框架写庆安。本事件不绘路线。 Xu Hengzhi, also known as Li Xishan, was a Korean born in 1909 in North Gyeongsang province; his family fled to Manchuria in 1913 and he joined the Communist Party in 1930. He served as a regimental commander and divisional political director in the 3rd Army of the People’s Revolutionary Army, political director of the 9th Army in 1937, commander of the 3rd Army’s new 3rd Division in 1938, and from 1939 chief of staff of the 3rd Route Army and commander of the 3rd Army, concurrently political commissar of the 12th Detachment. After the main North Manchurian force withdrew to the Soviet Union in autumn 1941, Xu stayed behind with small units in Qing’an, Tieli, Bayan, Mulan and Dongxing, building anti-Japanese national salvation associations. In late July 1942 he went with his guard Chen Yunxiang to inspect the Bayan–Mulan–Dongxing area, and on 2 August they camped by the Shaoling River below Qingfeng Ridge. At dawn on 3 August their cooking smoke gave them away and over thirty puppet police from Qing’an surrounded them; after more than two hours Chen was killed and Xu was shot in the head, aged 33. The Japanese cut off both men’s heads and displayed them in Qing’an. The puppet state called the county Qingcheng; the republican name, used here, is Qing’an. No route is drawn.

fields.description: 1942 年 8 月，日军在浙赣战役撤退过程中，在衢州、金华、玉山一带散布鼠疫、霍乱、伤寒等细菌，造成军民感染死亡。具体死亡人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为细菌战惨案，不绘路线。 In August 1942, while withdrawing from the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign, Japanese forces spread plague, cholera and typhoid bacteria around Quzhou, Jinhua and Yushan, causing military and civilian infections and deaths. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. This is a bacteriological-warfare atrocity and is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 中共中央政治局《关于统一抗日根据地党的领导及调整各组织间关系的决定》 Politburo decision on unified Party leadership in base areas
fields.summary: 1942 年 9 月 1 日，中共中央政治局通过「九一决定」，规定抗日根据地实行党的一元化领导。 On 1 September 1942 the Politburo adopted the “September First Decision” establishing unified Party leadership in the base areas.
fields.description: 1942 年 9 月 1 日，中共中央政治局通过《关于统一抗日根据地党的领导及调整各组织间关系的决定》，通称「九一决定」。决定指出，党是无产阶级的先锋队和无产阶级组织的最高形式，应该领导一切其他组织，如军队、政府与民众团体；根据地领导的统一与一元化，应表现在每个根据地有一个统一的领导一切的党的委员会。决定确定中央代表机关（中央局、分局）及各级党委（区党委、地委）为各地区的最高领导机关，统一党政军民工作的领导，同时要求防止党委包办政权和民众团体工作。该决定加强了党的集中统一领导，为克服根据地困难、坚持敌后抗战提供了组织保证。本事件为中央决定，不绘路线。 On 1 September 1942 the CCP Politburo adopted the decision on unifying Party leadership in the anti-Japanese base areas and adjusting relations among organisations, known as the “September First Decision”. It stated that the Party, as the vanguard of the proletariat and the highest form of proletarian organisation, should lead all other bodies — army, government and mass organisations — and that unity and unification in each base area should be expressed in a single leading Party committee. Central representative organs (central bureaux and sub-bureaux) and Party committees at each level were made the highest leading bodies, unifying Party, government, military and mass work, while guarding against Party committees taking over government and mass affairs. The decision strengthened centralised Party leadership and provided organisational guarantees for overcoming difficulties and sustaining resistance behind enemy lines. No route is drawn.

name.zh: 中共东北党组织特别支部局成立
name.en: Formation of the Northeast Party Committee

summary.zh: 1942年9月13日，东北抗联教导旅召开全体党员大会，成立中共东北党组织特别支部局（东北党委员会），统一领导全东北党组织。
summary.en: On 13 September 1942 the training brigade’s party members formed the Special Branch Bureau of the CCP in the Independent Brigade — the Northeast Party Committee — uniting the regional party organisations.

fields.name: 中共东北党组织特别支部局成立 Formation of the Northeast Party Committee
fields.place: 苏联伯力北野营 Northern Camp near Khabarovsk, USSR
fields.summary: 1942年9月13日，东北抗联教导旅召开全体党员大会，成立中共东北党组织特别支部局（东北党委员会），统一领导全东北党组织。 On 13 September 1942 the training brigade’s party members formed the Special Branch Bureau of the CCP in the Independent Brigade — the Northeast Party Committee — uniting the regional party organisations.
fields.description: 1936 年满洲省委撤销后，东北党组织分为南满、吉东、北满三个省委，长期与中央失去联系。1941—1942 年抗联主力退入苏联境内整训，三个省委的建制已难维持。1942 年 8 月 1 日东北抗联教导旅成立。9 月 13 日，教导旅召开全体党员大会，取消原三个省委，成立「独立步兵旅中共东北党组织特别支部局」（亦称东北党委员会），书记崔石泉（崔庸健），副书记金日成、金京石。在东北党组织与中共中央失去联系的情况下，特别支部局成为全东北党组织的临时最高领导机关，统一领导教导旅与留在东北的小部队。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 After the Manchurian Provincial Committee was abolished in 1936 the Manchurian party split into the South, Jidong and North Manchurian committees and lost contact with the centre for years. When the main force withdrew to the Soviet Union in 1941–42, the three committees could no longer function. The training brigade was formed on 1 August 1942; on 13 September its party members met and abolished the three committees, creating the “Special Branch Bureau of the CCP in the Independent Infantry Brigade”, also called the Northeast Party Committee, with Cui Shiquan (Choe Yong-gon) as secretary and Kim Il-sung and Kim Kyong-sok as deputies. With the Manchurian party cut off from the Central Committee, the bureau became its provisional highest organ, directing both the brigade and the small units left in Manchuria. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1942年11月，日军围攻淄川马鞍山，八路军伤病员与守军坚守后失守。
summary.en: In November 1942 Japanese forces attacked Ma'anshan in Zichuan; Eighth Route Army wounded, civilians and defenders held out before the position fell.

fields.name: 马鞍山保卫战 Defence of Ma'anshan
fields.place: 山东淄川马鞍山 Ma'anshan, Zichuan, Shandong
fields.summary: 1942年11月，日军围攻淄川马鞍山，八路军伤病员与守军坚守后失守。 In November 1942 Japanese forces attacked Ma'anshan in Zichuan; Eighth Route Army wounded, civilians and defenders held out before the position fell.
fields.description: 1942年11月，日军对沂蒙山区发动「扫荡」，并出动大批兵力围攻淄川马鞍山。山上八路军伤病员、家属和守军凭险坚守，最终失守。马鞍山是扼沂蒙山区入清河区的门户，此战为日军扫荡中的山地攻防战，不绘单一路线。 In November 1942 Japanese forces swept the Yimeng Mountains and sent a large force against Ma'anshan in Zichuan. Eighth Route Army wounded, family members and defenders held the mountain position before it fell. Ma'anshan was the gateway from the Yimeng Mountains into the Qinghe area; this mountain battle during the Japanese sweep is not drawn as a single route.
fields.entities: 日本 Japan 八路军 Eighth Route Army

fields.name: 日军进犯孟定 Japanese Incursion into Mengding
fields.summary: 1943年2月10日，日军800余人由滇缅铁路附属公路进犯孟定。 On 10 February 1943 more than 800 Japanese troops advanced on Mengding via the Burma railway road.
fields.description: 1943年2月10日，日军800多人及伪军、挑夫1000多人共2000多人，由滇缅铁路附属公路进犯孟定镇，烧毁土司衙门和8万斤仓储粮，抢走黄金96两，打死3人、打伤1人。孟定为滇西南边境要镇，日军此次为短期窜扰，未长期占领。日期据人民网《临沧抗战纪事》。 On 10 February 1943 more than 800 Japanese troops with about 1,000 puppet soldiers and porters—over 2,000 men—advanced on Mengding via the Burma railway road, burning the chieftain’s office and 80,000 jin of grain, seizing 96 taels of gold and killing or wounding several civilians. It was a short raid, not a permanent occupation.

name.en: Japanese Landing on the Leizhou Peninsula

summary.zh: 日军独立混成第 23 旅团在雷州半岛东海岸登陆。
summary.en: The Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade landed on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula.

fields.name: 日军登陆雷州半岛 Japanese Landing on the Leizhou Peninsula
fields.place: 广东雷州通明港 Tongming Port, Leizhou, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军独立混成第 23 旅团在雷州半岛东海岸登陆。 The Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade landed on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula.
fields.description: 1943 年 2 月 16 日晨，日军独立混成第 23 旅团 1600 余人，在海军舰艇和飞机掩护下，于雷州半岛东海岸通明、下岚两港登陆，随即进攻海康县城。此次作战旨在封锁中国海上交通、掠夺物资并支援太平洋战场。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On the morning of 16 February 1943, more than 1,600 troops of the Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade, covered by warships and aircraft, landed at Tongming and Xialan on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula and advanced on Haikang county town. The operation aimed to blockade China’s maritime traffic, seize supplies and support the Pacific theater. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.zh: 上海“无国籍难民指定区”设立

summary.zh: 1943年2月18日，日军在上海虹口设立“无国籍难民指定区”，限犹太难民于5月18日前迁入。
summary.en: On 18 February 1943 the Japanese authorities set up a “designated area for stateless refugees” in Hongkou, Shanghai, requiring Jewish refugees to move in by 18 May.

fields.name: 上海“无国籍难民指定区”设立 Shanghai “Designated Area for Stateless Refugees”
fields.summary: 1943年2月18日，日军在上海虹口设立“无国籍难民指定区”，限犹太难民于5月18日前迁入。 On 18 February 1943 the Japanese authorities set up a “designated area for stateless refugees” in Hongkou, Shanghai, requiring Jewish refugees to move in by 18 May.
fields.description: 1938 年底至 1941 年底，上海因不需入境签证与财产担保，接纳了约 1.8 万至 2 万名来自德国、奥地利、捷克斯洛伐克、波兰的犹太难民，多数聚居在苏州河北岸虹口提篮桥一带。1943 年 2 月 18 日，日本上海方面陆海军当局以“军事需要”为由发布布告，在公共租界虹口划设“无国籍难民指定区”（《关于限制无国籍难民居住营业之布告》），要求 1937 年以后抵沪的无国籍难民于 5 月 18 日前迁入该区，区外居住营业一律禁止，出入须持通行证；俄籍与巴格达犹太人不在此列。该区被英语世界称为“上海隔都”（Shanghai Ghetto），区内同时居住约 10 万中国人。1945 年 8 月日本投降后限制解除。本事件不绘路线。 From late 1938 to the end of 1941 Shanghai, which required neither an entry visa nor a financial guarantee, took in some 18,000–20,000 Jewish refugees from Germany, Austria, Czechoslovakia and Poland, most of them settling in the Tilanqiao area of Hongkou north of Suzhou Creek. On 18 February 1943 the Japanese army and navy authorities in Shanghai issued a proclamation citing military necessity that created a “designated area for stateless refugees” in Hongkou in the International Settlement. Refugees who had arrived after 1937 had to move into the area by 18 May, residence and business outside it were forbidden, and passes were required to leave; Russian and Baghdadi Jews were excluded. English speakers called it the Shanghai Ghetto; about 100,000 Chinese also lived in the same streets. The restrictions ended after Japan's surrender in August 1945. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 雷州半岛沦陷 Fall of the Leizhou Peninsula
fields.summary: 日军占领海康、遂溪，雷州半岛沦陷。 Japanese forces occupied Haikang and Suixi, and the Leizhou Peninsula fell.
fields.description: 1943 年 2 月 16 日日军登陆后，当日占领海康县城，17 日占客路，18 至 19 日相继占领遂溪城月、洋青及遂溪县城。雷州半岛成为日军封锁华南沿海、掠夺物资的占领区。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 After landing on 16 February 1943, Japanese forces occupied Haikang county town the same day, Khelu on 17 February, and Chengyue, Yangqing and Suixi county town on 18–19 February. The Leizhou Peninsula became an occupied zone for blockading the South China coast and seizing supplies. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军海军陆战队占领广州湾西营，广州湾沦陷。

fields.name: 日军占领广州湾 Japanese Occupation of Guangzhouwan
fields.place: 广东广州湾西营（今湛江霞山） Xiyang, Guangzhouwan (present-day Xiashan, Zhanjiang), Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军海军陆战队占领广州湾西营，广州湾沦陷。 Japanese naval landing forces occupied Xiyang, and Guangzhouwan fell.
fields.description: 1943 年 2 月 16 日，日军一部 300 余人在广州湾西营登陆，窜占麻章、赤坎；21 日，日本海军陆战队在西营码头登陆，占领西营市区。法国广州湾租借地当局与日军签订移交协定，广州湾沦陷。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 16 February 1943 a Japanese force of more than 300 landed at Xiyang in Guangzhouwan and occupied Mazhang and Chikan; on 21 February Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Xiyang pier and occupied the urban area. The French authorities of the Guangzhouwan leased territory signed a transfer agreement with Japan, and Guangzhouwan fell. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.place: 海南东方北黎 Beili, Dongfang, Hainan
fields.summary: 榆林—北黎铁路基本完工，在北黎与石八线接轨。 The Yulin–Beili railway was basically completed and joined the Shilu–Basuo line at Beili.
fields.description: 在修建石八线的同时，日军为连接榆林海军基地与北黎、八所等港口，修建榆林—北黎铁路，全长约 187.9 公里。1943 年 3 月基本完工，并在北黎与石八线接轨，形成海南西部铁路骨架。具体通车日待页码级核对。 While building the Shilu–Basuo line, Japan also built the roughly 187.9-km Yulin–Beili railway to link the Yulin naval base with Beili, Basuo and other ports. It was basically completed in March 1943 and joined the Shilu–Basuo line at Beili, forming the railway framework of western Hainan. The exact opening date awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese Sweep of the Chaoxian–Wuwei Centre

summary.zh: 1943年3月17日，日军6000余人分8路扫荡巢无中心区。
summary.en: On 17 March 1943 more than 6,000 Japanese and puppet troops swept the Chaoxian–Wuwei centre in eight columns.

fields.name: 日军扫荡巢无中心区 Japanese Sweep of the Chaoxian–Wuwei Centre
fields.summary: 1943年3月17日，日军6000余人分8路扫荡巢无中心区。 On 17 March 1943 more than 6,000 Japanese and puppet troops swept the Chaoxian–Wuwei centre in eight columns.
fields.description: 3月17日，日军第116师团和第115师团一部及伪军共6000余人，由南京、芜湖、铜陵等地分8路「扫荡」皖中抗日根据地巢（县）无（为）中心区。新四军第七师在地方武装配合下，经两周激战，毙伤日伪军300余人，粉碎了「扫荡」。此为多路扫荡，不绘单一路线。 On 17 March more than 6,000 troops of the Japanese 116th Division, part of the 115th Division and puppet forces swept the Chaoxian–Wuwei centre of the Central Anhui base area in eight columns from Nanjing, Wuhu and Tongling. The New Fourth Army's 7th Division, with local forces, fought for two weeks, killed or wounded more than 300 Japanese and puppet troops and broke the sweep. As a multi-column operation, it is not drawn as a single route.

name.zh: 中共中央政治局会议推举毛泽东为政治局主席、书记处主席
name.en: Politburo elects Mao Zedong chairman of the Politburo and Secretariat

summary.zh: 1943 年 3 月 20 日，中共中央政治局会议推举毛泽东为中央政治局主席、中央书记处主席。
summary.en: On 20 March 1943 the Politburo elected Mao Zedong chairman of both the Politburo and the Secretariat.

fields.name: 中共中央政治局会议推举毛泽东为政治局主席、书记处主席 Politburo elects Mao Zedong chairman of the Politburo and Secretariat
fields.summary: 1943 年 3 月 20 日，中共中央政治局会议推举毛泽东为中央政治局主席、中央书记处主席。 On 20 March 1943 the Politburo elected Mao Zedong chairman of both the Politburo and the Secretariat.
fields.description: 1943 年 3 月 16 日至 20 日，中共中央政治局在延安召开会议，通过《关于中央机构调整及精简的决定》。会议推举毛泽东为中央政治局主席、中央书记处主席；中央书记处由毛泽东、刘少奇、任弼时组成，书记处会议讨论的问题「主席有最后决定之权」。会议还决定设立中央宣传委员会和中央组织委员会，作为政治局和书记处的助理机关，并调整各中央局的分工。这次会议从组织上确立了毛泽东在中央的领导地位，加强了中央的集中统一领导。本事件为组织调整，不绘路线。 From 16 to 20 March 1943 the CCP Politburo met at Yan’an and adopted the decision on adjusting and streamlining central organs. It elected Mao Zedong chairman of the Politburo and of the Secretariat; the Secretariat consisted of Mao, Liu Shaoqi and Ren Bishi, and on matters it discussed “the chairman has the final decision”. The meeting also set up central propaganda and organisation committees as assistant bodies to the Politburo and Secretariat and adjusted the division of work among central bureaux. The meeting established Mao’s leadership position at the centre in organisational terms and strengthened centralised Party leadership. No route is drawn.

fields.summary: 第18军调防宜昌石牌，第11师随后参加石牌保卫战。 The 18th Army moved to Shipai near Yichang, and its 11th Division fought in the defense of Shipai.
fields.description: 1943 年春，第18军调防宜昌以西石牌要塞，第11师担任核心守备。5 月鄂西会战爆发，第11师在石牌与日军激战，守住三峡门户。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In spring 1943 the 18th Army moved to the Shipai fortress west of Yichang, with the 11th Division holding the core positions. When the Western Hubei campaign began in May, the 11th Division fought bitterly at Shipai and held the gateway to the Three Gorges. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1943年4月起，日伪对苏中四分区全面「清乡」，在清乡区边沿构筑竹篱笆封锁线，区内据点增至200余处；4月11日「苏北地区清乡主任公署」在南通城成立。此为过程性统治事件，日期取4月开始，不绘路线。 From April 1943 Japanese and puppet forces carried out a full clearance campaign in the Fourth Sub-district, building bamboo blockade fences along its edges and increasing strongpoints inside to more than 200; on 11 April the "North Jiangsu Clearance Administration" was established in Nantong. This is a process event dated to the start of April and is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 日机大举轰炸云南驿机场（1943） Heavy Bombing of Yunnanyi Airfield, 1943
fields.place: 云南祥云云南驿 Yunnanyi, Xiangyun, Yunnan
fields.summary: 1943年4月26日，54架日机轰炸云南驿机场，扩修机场民工遇难406人。 On 26 April 1943 fifty-four Japanese aircraft bombed Yunnanyi airfield; 406 labourers were killed.
fields.description: 1943 年 4 月 26 日上午 11 时至 12 时，日军 54 架轰炸机、战斗机对云南驿机场及附近村庄实施大规模轰炸扫射。美军航空队起飞应战，击落日机 3 架；但扩修机场的两万余名民工未及疏散，遇难 406 人、重伤 200 人、轻伤 171 人，共伤亡 777 人。当日上午 9 时防空情报已获日军大批飞机来袭的情报并转报美军，但机场未发警报，工地民工误以为是美军增补飞机而未疏散；四周卫兵又堵住路口，加重了伤亡。次日（4 月 27 日）日军 25 架飞机再次袭击，毁美军驱逐机 3 架、伤 5 架，毁运输机 1 架，美方 7 人遇难、5 人受伤，守军 30 人、民工 200 余人遇难。本事件为空袭，不绘路线。 Between 11:00 and 12:00 on 26 April 1943, 54 Japanese bombers and fighters made a large-scale attack on Yunnanyi airfield and nearby villages. US aircraft took off and shot down three Japanese planes, but more than 20,000 labourers expanding the field could not disperse: 406 were killed, 200 seriously and 171 lightly wounded, 777 casualties in all. Air-raid intelligence had reached the field at 09:00 and was passed to the Americans, but no alarm was sounded, so the workers mistook the aircraft for US reinforcements and kept working; guards at the road junctions also stopped them from scattering, worsening the losses. The next day, 27 April, 25 Japanese aircraft attacked again, destroying 3 US fighters and damaging 5, destroying a transport, killing 7 Americans and wounding 5, and killing 30 garrison troops and over 200 labourers. This was an air raid; no route is drawn.

fields.name: 鄂西会战 Battle of West Hubei 石牌保卫战 Defense of Shipai
fields.place: 湖北宜昌石牌 Shipai, Yichang, Hubei
fields.summary: 日军进攻鄂西，中国军队在石牌要塞一带顽强阻击，挫败日军攻势。 Japanese forces attacked western Hubei; Chinese troops stubbornly defended the Shipai fortress area and thwarted the offensive.
fields.description: 1943 年 5 月，日军第十一军向鄂西地区进攻，企图夺取石牌要塞、威胁重庆。中国第六战区部队依托长江三峡地形顽强抵抗，在石牌一带与日军激战，最终迫使日军撤退。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要防御胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked western Hubei, seeking to seize the Shipai fortress and threaten Chongqing. Chinese troops of the Sixth War Zone used the terrain of the Three Gorges to resist stubbornly, fighting fierce actions around Shipai and eventually forcing the Japanese to withdraw. It was an important defensive victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1943 年 5 月 5 日日军第 11 军自荆州、石首一带渡江南犯，鄂西会战爆发；中国军队在石牌、渔洋关一线阻击，6 月日军退回原防。荆州自 1940 年 6 月即为日军占领。 On 5 May 1943 the Japanese 11th Army crossed the Yangtze from the Jingzhou–Shishou area, opening the western Hubei battle; the Chinese army held at Shipai and Yuyangguan, and the Japanese withdrew in June. Jingzhou had been occupied since June 1940.

fields.summary: 1943年5月14日，日军第3师团攻占公安。 On 14 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Gong’an.
fields.description: 1943年5月12日日军第3师团进攻公安，中国第87军第43师弃守西撤，14日日军占领公安。公安失守后，日军第3、第13师团合围松滋、枝江间中国第10集团军。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。 On 12 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division attacked Gong’an; the Chinese 43rd Division of the 87th Corps abandoned it and withdrew west, and the Japanese occupied the town on the 14th. The Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions then closed on the Chinese 10th Army Group between Songzi and Zhijiang.

fields.name: 宜都沦陷 Fall of Yidu
fields.summary: 1943年5月22日，日军野沟支队与伪第29师攻占宜都。 On 22 May 1943 the Japanese Nogawa detachment and the puppet 29th Division captured Yidu.
fields.description: 1943年5月22日，日军野沟支队与伪第29师攻占宜都。宜都为长江南岸要地，失守后日军第39师团从云池渡江，向宜昌西南的偏岩急进。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。 On 22 May 1943 the Japanese Nogawa detachment and the puppet 29th Division took Yidu, a key point on the south bank of the Yangtze. The Japanese 39th Division then crossed at Yunchi and drove on Pianyan southwest of Yichang.

name.en: CCP Central Committee accepts the dissolution of the Comintern

summary.zh: 1943 年 5 月 26 日，中共中央政治局通过决定，完全同意解散共产国际。
summary.en: On 26 May 1943 the CCP Politburo resolved to accept the dissolution of the Comintern.

fields.name: 中共中央通过关于共产国际解散的决定 CCP Central Committee accepts the dissolution of the Comintern
fields.summary: 1943 年 5 月 26 日，中共中央政治局通过决定，完全同意解散共产国际。 On 26 May 1943 the CCP Politburo resolved to accept the dissolution of the Comintern.
fields.description: 1943 年 5 月 15 日，共产国际执行委员会主席团提出《关于提议解散共产国际的决定》，5 月 22 日公布。5 月 26 日，中共中央政治局在延安召开会议，一致通过《关于共产国际执委主席团提议解散共产国际的决定》，表示完全同意。决定指出，共产国际在存在的时期完成了自己的历史使命，对中国人民的革命事业给予了援助；同时强调，很久以来中国共产党人即已能够完全独立地根据自己民族的具体情况和特殊条件，决定自己的政治方针、政策和行动。当晚，中央书记处召开延安干部大会传达，毛泽东作《关于共产国际解散问题的报告》。本事件为中央决定，不绘路线。 On 15 May 1943 the Presidium of the Comintern Executive Committee proposed dissolving the Comintern, and the proposal was published on 22 May. On 26 May the CCP Politburo met at Yan’an and unanimously adopted a decision fully agreeing to the dissolution. It stated that the Comintern had fulfilled its historical mission and had aided the Chinese people’s revolutionary cause, while stressing that for a long time the Chinese Communists had been able to decide their own political line, policies and actions independently on the basis of China’s concrete conditions. That evening the Secretariat convened a Yan’an cadres’ meeting, where Mao Zedong reported on the dissolution. No route is drawn.

summary.en: On 27 June 1943 part of the Japanese 56th Reconnaissance Regiment advanced into Cangyuan.

fields.name: 日军进犯沧源 Japanese Incursion into Cangyuan
fields.summary: 1943年6月27日，日军第56搜索联队一部进犯沧源。 On 27 June 1943 part of the Japanese 56th Reconnaissance Regiment advanced into Cangyuan.
fields.description: 1943年6月27日至7月3日，日军第56搜索联队一个大队700多人及1000多伪军、挑夫近2000人，从缅甸户板经沧源县蛮鸠向耿马县进犯，沿途烧毁孟定街、沙坝、芒掌等6个寨子200多户和3座佛寺。日期据人民网《临沧抗战纪事》与维基百科《沧源抗日斗争》。 From 27 June to 3 July 1943 a battalion of the Japanese 56th Reconnaissance Regiment—over 700 men with more than 1,000 puppet troops and porters—advanced from Hupan in Burma through Manjiu in Cangyuan toward Gengma, burning more than 200 homes in six villages and three Buddhist temples. It was a raid, not a permanent occupation.

summary.zh: 1943年8月，日军在鲁西卫河流域撒播霍乱菌，造成大规模死亡。
summary.en: In August 1943 the Japanese spread cholera bacteria along the Wei River in western Shandong, causing mass deaths.

fields.name: 鲁西细菌战 Luxi Bacteriological Warfare
fields.summary: 1943年8月，日军在鲁西卫河流域撒播霍乱菌，造成大规模死亡。 In August 1943 the Japanese spread cholera bacteria along the Wei River in western Shandong, causing mass deaths.
fields.description: 1943年8月，日军华北方面军实施“十八秋鲁西作战”，由731部队石井四郎指导，利用鲁西暴雨、卫河泛滥之机，掘开卫河、漳河堤坝并飞机撒播霍乱菌，洪水成为传播载体。8月27日起，临清一带霍乱暴发，据战犯笔供，8月下旬至10月下旬有20万以上中国人民死亡。日期据《1943，天灾掩盖惊天人祸》与《1943年日本细菌战致几十万国人命丧霍乱》。 In August 1943 the Japanese North China Area Army carried out Operation “Autumn 1943 in Luxi”, guided by Ishii Shirō of Unit 731. Exploiting heavy rain and flooding, Japanese troops cut the Wei and Zhang river dikes and sprayed cholera bacteria from aircraft, using the floodwater as the vector. Cholera broke out around Linqing from 27 August; according to Japanese war criminal testimony, more than 200,000 Chinese died between late August and late October.

summary.zh: 中国驻印军与盟军自印度利多出发，向缅北日军发起反攻。
summary.en: Chinese forces in India and Allied troops advanced from Ledo to counterattack Japanese forces in northern Burma.

fields.name: 缅北反攻开始 Start of the Northern Burma Counteroffensive
fields.summary: 中国驻印军与盟军自印度利多出发，向缅北日军发起反攻。 Chinese forces in India and Allied troops advanced from Ledo to counterattack Japanese forces in northern Burma.
fields.description: 1943 年 10 月起，中国驻印军新一军等部与美军部队自印度利多出发，向缅北推进，先后进行胡康河谷、孟拱河谷等战役，为打通中印公路创造条件。 本事件日期为示意时间点，作战经过待史料校订。 Beginning in October 1943, the Chinese Army in India, including the New 1st Army, and US units advanced from Ledo into northern Burma, fighting in the Hukawng and Mogaung valleys and helping to open the Ledo Road. fields.summary: 1943 年 10 月 10 日，中共中央决定党的高级干部重新学习党史，整风转入总结历史经验阶段。 On 10 October 1943 the CCP Central Committee called on senior cadres to restudy Party history, moving rectification into a review of historical experience.
fields.description: 1943 年 10 月 10 日，中共中央决定党的高级干部重新学习党的历史和两条路线问题，整风运动由普遍整风转入总结历史经验阶段。此前 9 月起，中央政治局已开始讨论党的历史问题。高级干部通过学习《六大以来》等文献，分清路线是非，为 1945 年 4 月六届七中全会通过《关于若干历史问题的决议》作了准备。这一阶段把整风的思想成果转化为对党史的系统结论，为七大的团结统一奠定基础。本事件为中央决定，不绘路线。 On 10 October 1943 the CCP Central Committee decided that senior cadres should restudy Party history and the question of the two lines, moving rectification from general study to the summing up of historical experience. The Politburo had begun discussing Party history in September. By studying documents such as Since the Sixth Congress, senior cadres clarified questions of line and prepared the way for the resolution on certain historical questions adopted by the Sixth Plenum of the Seventh Central Committee in April 1945. This stage turned the ideological gains of rectification into systematic conclusions on Party history and laid the basis for the unity of the Seventh Congress. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 韩略村战斗 Battle of Hanluecun 韩略村伏击战 Hanluecun Ambush
fields.place: 山西洪洞韩略村 Hanluecun, Hongtong, Shanxi
fields.summary: 第129师386旅16团在韩略村伏击日军战地观战团，歼敌 120 余人。 The 16th Regiment of the 386th Brigade ambushed a Japanese officers’ observation group at Hanluecun, killing more than 120.
fields.description: 1943 年 10 月 24 日，八路军第129师第386旅第16团在团长王近山率领下，于山西洪洞韩略村西侧公路伏击日军华北方面军组织的战地观战团，歼灭少将旅团长以下军官 120 余人，击毁汽车 13 辆。此战打乱了日军对太岳根据地的“扫荡”部署。 歼敌数字与番号细节各书记载略有出入，待页码级核对。 On 24 October 1943 the 16th Regiment of the 386th Brigade, 129th Division, under commander Wang Jinshan, ambushed a Japanese officers’ battlefield observation group organized by the North China Area Army on the road west of Hanluecun, Hongtong, Shanxi. More than 120 officers, including a major-general brigade commander, were killed and 13 vehicles destroyed. The action disrupted Japanese “mopping-up” plans for the Taiyue base area. Casualty figures and unit details vary slightly between accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 常德会战 Battle of Changde 常德保卫战 Defense of Changde
fields.summary: 日军进攻常德，中国守军坚守多日后突围，中国军队随后反攻收复常德。 Japanese forces attacked Changde; the Chinese garrison held out for days before breaking out, and Chinese troops counterattacked to recover the city.
fields.description: 1943 年 11 月，日军第十一军向常德地区发起进攻，企图牵制中国军队并夺取洞庭湖周边粮区。中国第 74 军第 57 师坚守常德城，与日军激战多日，伤亡惨重后突围。中国军队外围部队随即反攻，12 月收复常德。此役战斗激烈，双方均有重大伤亡。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In November 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Changde area, seeking to pin down Chinese forces and seize the rice-producing region around Dongting Lake. The 57th Division of the Chinese 74th Army defended Changde in bitter fighting for many days before breaking out with heavy losses. Chinese forces on the periphery counterattacked and recovered the city in December. Both sides suffered major casualties. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.summary: 1943年11月4日，日机16架轰炸福建战时省会永安，死伤400余人。 On 4 November 1943 sixteen Japanese aircraft bombed Yong’an, the wartime capital of Fujian, causing over 400 casualties.
fields.description: 1943年11月4日下午1时左右，日机16架轰炸福建战时省会永安，投弹135枚，无差别滥投爆炸弹和燃烧弹，死亡209人、受伤186人，流离失所者4022人，烧毁房屋万余间，史称“永安浩劫”。另有死伤600余人之说。日期据《永安浩劫》与福建党史方志网《抗战时期战时省会永安的损失及其影响》。 At about 1 p.m. on 4 November 1943 sixteen Japanese aircraft bombed Yong’an, the wartime capital of Fujian, dropping 135 high-explosive and incendiary bombs indiscriminately. 209 people were killed, 186 wounded and 4,022 made homeless; over 10,000 rooms burned. The raid is known as the “Yong’an Holocaust”; some accounts give over 600 casualties.

summary.zh: 1943年11月7日，日军攻占安乡。
summary.en: On 7 November 1943 the Japanese captured Anxiang.

fields.name: 安乡沦陷 Fall of Anxiang
fields.summary: 1943年11月7日，日军攻占安乡。 On 7 November 1943 the Japanese captured Anxiang.
fields.description: 1943年11月7日日军攻占安乡。安乡为洞庭湖西北门户，失守后日军东路由安乡、汉寿指向常德东南，切断常德守军退路。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 7 November 1943 the Japanese took Anxiang, the northwestern gateway to Dongting Lake. The eastern column then drove via Anxiang and Hanshou toward Changde’s southeast, cutting the defenders’ retreat.

summary.zh: 1943年11月15日，日军第3、第13师团攻陷石门。
summary.en: On 15 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions captured Shimen.

fields.name: 石门沦陷 Fall of Shimen
fields.summary: 1943年11月15日，日军第3、第13师团攻陷石门。 On 15 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions captured Shimen.
fields.description: 1943年11月13日日军第3、第13师团向石门进攻，中国第73军暂5师死守，师长彭士量在突围中殉国，15日晨石门失守。石门为常德西北屏障，失守后日军直趋慈利、桃源。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 13 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions attacked Shimen. The Chinese Provisional 5th Division of the 73rd Corps held on; its commander Peng Shiliang was killed during the breakout, and Shimen fell on the morning of the 15th. The town was Changde’s northwestern shield, and its loss opened the way to Cili and Taoyuan.

summary.zh: 1943年11月17日，日军第116师团攻占澧县。
summary.en: On 17 November 1943 the Japanese 116th Division captured Lixian.

fields.name: 澧县沦陷 Fall of Lixian
fields.summary: 1943年11月17日，日军第116师团攻占澧县。 On 17 November 1943 the Japanese 116th Division captured Lixian.
fields.description: 1943年11月15日晚日军第116师团从澧县以北进攻，中国第44军第150师等部防守，17日澧县失守。日军随后经临澧向常德推进。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On the evening of 15 November 1943 the Japanese 116th Division attacked north of Lixian. The Chinese 150th Division of the 44th Corps defended the town, which fell on the 17th. The Japanese then advanced via Linli toward Changde.

summary.zh: 1943年11月18日，常德会战日军四路入侵临澧，县城沦陷，前后沦陷26天。
summary.en: On 18 November 1943 four Japanese columns entered Linli during the Changde campaign; the county town was occupied for 26 days in all.

fields.name: 临澧沦陷 Fall of Linli
fields.summary: 1943年11月18日，常德会战日军四路入侵临澧，县城沦陷，前后沦陷26天。 On 18 November 1943 four Japanese columns entered Linli during the Changde campaign; the county town was occupied for 26 days in all.
fields.description: 1943年5月8日，日军由津市、澧县进犯临澧县北，合口、新安、团山（今九里、官亭）3乡沦陷，至5月28日日军向湖北方向撤退，澧北3乡沦陷21天。5月13日至31日，日机两次共12架次轰炸临澧县城，投弹74枚，城内数千间房屋被毁。同年11月常德会战，日军第11军四路入侵临澧全境，11月18日县城沦陷，县长齐德修率县机关撤至安化。12月1日晨县城被夺回，6日复陷，12日再次收复，前后沦陷26天。日期取临澧县史志网与《临澧县志》大事记。 On 8 May 1943 the Japanese advanced from Jinshi and Li County into northern Linli; the three townships of Hekou, Xin'an and Tuanshan fell and stayed occupied for 21 days until the Japanese withdrew toward Hubei on 28 May. Between 13 and 31 May twelve Japanese aircraft sorties in two raids bombed the county town with 74 bombs, destroying thousands of houses. In the November 1943 Battle of Changde four columns of the Japanese 11th Army entered Linli, and the county town fell on 18 November; magistrate Qi Dexiu withdrew the county government to Anhua. The town was retaken on the morning of 1 December, lost again on the 6th and recovered on the 12th, 26 days of occupation in all. The date follows the Linli local-history office and the Linli County Gazetteer.

summary.zh: 中美英三国领导人举行开罗会议，发表《开罗宣言》，明确战后归还中国领土。
summary.en: Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.

fields.name: 开罗会议 Cairo Conference
fields.summary: 中美英三国领导人举行开罗会议，发表《开罗宣言》，明确战后归还中国领土。 Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.
fields.description: 1943 年 11 月 22 日至 26 日，蒋介石、罗斯福、丘吉尔在开罗举行会议，讨论对日作战与战后安排。会议发表的《开罗宣言》明确表示，日本所窃取于中国的领土，如东北、台湾、澎湖列岛等，应归还中国。 本事件为外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 From 22 to 26 November 1943, Chiang Kai-shek, Franklin D. Roosevelt, and Winston Churchill met in Cairo to discuss the war against Japan and postwar arrangements. The Cairo Declaration stated that territories Japan had seized from China, including the Northeast, Taiwan, and the Penghu Islands, should be returned to China. This is a diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 1943年11月22日，日军第13师团攻占慈利。
summary.en: On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 13th Division captured Cili.

fields.name: 慈利沦陷 Fall of Cili
fields.summary: 1943年11月22日，日军第13师团攻占慈利。 On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 13th Division captured Cili.
fields.description: 1943年11月17日日军第13师团分三路进攻慈利，中国第74军第58师在赤松山、慈利以南阵地抗击，18日慈利失守，22日日军主力进占慈利。慈利失守后，日军西路由慈利、桃源迂回常德西南。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 17 November 1943 the Japanese 13th Division attacked Cili in three columns. The Chinese 58th Division of the 74th Corps fought at Chisong Mountain and south of Cili; the town fell on the 18th, and the Japanese main force occupied it on the 22nd. The western column then swung through Cili and Taoyuan to cut Changde’s southwest.

summary.zh: 1943年11月22日，日军第3师团攻占桃源。
summary.en: On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Taoyuan.

fields.name: 桃源沦陷 Fall of Taoyuan
fields.summary: 1943年11月22日，日军第3师团攻占桃源。 On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Taoyuan.
fields.description: 1943年11月19日日军第3师团主力由澧水南渡，直扑陬市、桃源，21日以伞兵配合攻占桃源，22日进占桃源县城并切断常德守军与第74军主力的联系。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 19 November 1943 the main force of the Japanese 3rd Division crossed the Li River and drove on Zoushi and Taoyuan. On the 21st, with paratroopers, it took Taoyuan and on the 22nd occupied the county town, cutting the link between Changde’s defenders and the 74th Corps.

summary.zh: 1943年11月22日，常德会战东路日军攻陷汉寿县城，25日拂晓被第197师夺回。
summary.en: On 22 November 1943 the eastern column of the Changde campaign took Hanshou, which the Chinese 197th Division retook at dawn on the 25th.

fields.name: 汉寿沦陷 Fall of Hanshou
fields.summary: 1943年11月22日，常德会战东路日军攻陷汉寿县城，25日拂晓被第197师夺回。 On 22 November 1943 the eastern column of the Changde campaign took Hanshou, which the Chinese 197th Division retook at dawn on the 25th.
fields.description: 1943年常德会战东路，日军第40师团自华容、石首经洞庭湖西岸南下。11月2日，第40师团第234联队进犯第99军防区北景港等地；4日第九战区令布雷队封锁水道，在酉港布雷；5日凌晨日军在飞机掩护下进攻大酉障，与第197师激战。9日，第197师一部由汉寿向安乡方向搜索前进，击溃沿线之敌，但日军后续兵力强大，11月22日汉寿县城沦陷。24日夜第197师反攻，25日拂晓夺回县城，并击退日军多次进攻，直至常德会战结束。县城沦陷日期取《日军侵华战争》与《湖南抗日战争日志》；《侵华日军暴行总录》记11月21日，异说并存。 In the eastern thrust of the 1943 Battle of Changde the Japanese 40th Division advanced south from Huarong and Shishou along the western shore of Dongting Lake. On 2 November its 234th Regiment attacked Beigangzhen in the Chinese 99th Army sector; on the 4th the Ninth War Zone ordered mine-laying parties to block the waterways, and mines were laid at Yougang; before dawn on the 5th the Japanese attacked Dayouzhang under air cover and fought the Chinese 197th Division. On the 9th part of the 197th Division pushed from Hanshou toward Anxiang and drove in the enemy, but Japanese reinforcements proved too strong and Hanshou fell on 22 November. On the night of the 24th the 197th Division counter-attacked and retook the town at dawn on the 25th, beating off repeated Japanese assaults until the end of the campaign. The date follows The Japanese Invasion of China and the Hunan War Log; A Compendium of Japanese Atrocities gives 21 November.

summary.zh: 广东人民抗日游击队东江纵队在惠阳成立。
summary.en: The Dongjiang Column of the Guangdong People’s Anti-Japanese Guerrillas was established at Huiyang.

fields.name: 东江纵队成立 Establishment of the Dongjiang Column
fields.summary: 广东人民抗日游击队东江纵队在惠阳成立。 The Dongjiang Column of the Guangdong People’s Anti-Japanese Guerrillas was established at Huiyang.
fields.description: 1943 年 12 月 2 日，广东人民抗日游击队东江纵队在广东惠阳成立，曾生任司令员，尹林平任政治委员。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On December 2, 1943, the Dongjiang Column of the Guangdong People’s Anti-Japanese Guerrillas was established at Huiyang, Guangdong, with Zeng Sheng as commander and Yin Linping as political commissar. fields.name: 常德沦陷 Fall of Changde
fields.summary: 1943年12月3日，日军攻占常德，中国第57师大部殉国。 On 3 December 1943 the Japanese captured Changde after the Chinese 57th Division was largely destroyed.
fields.description: 1943年11月24日日军环攻常德，中国第74军第57师师长余程万率部死守，激战至12月3日凌晨，守军弹尽粮绝，余程万率残部突围，常德沦陷。12月9日中国军队克复常德。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 24 November 1943 the Japanese encircled and assaulted Changde. The Chinese 57th Division of the 74th Corps, commanded by Yu Chengwan, held on until the early hours of 3 December, when with ammunition and food exhausted Yu broke out with the survivors and the city fell. The Chinese recaptured Changde on 9 December.

fields.description: 1944 年 3 月 5 日，新四军第一师在江苏淮安车桥地区歼灭日伪军，扩大苏中抗日根据地。日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为战役点，不绘行军路线：车桥战役由新四军第一师在苏中发起，与军部驻地盐城不是同一条路线。 On March 5, 1944, the New Fourth Army’s 1st Division destroyed Japanese and puppet forces at Cheqiao, Huai’an, Jiangsu, expanding the Central Jiangsu anti-Japanese base area. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. This is a battle point with no march route: the Battle of Cheqiao was fought by the N4A 1st Division from Central Jiangsu, not by the headquarters at Yancheng.

fields.name: 豫湘桂战役 Operation Ichi-Go 一号作战 Operation Ichi-Go
fields.summary: 日军发动豫湘桂战役，沿平汉、湘桂铁路南犯，中国正面战场遭受重大损失。 Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go south along the Beijing–Hankou and Hunan–Guangxi railways, inflicting heavy losses on China’s frontal battlefield.
fields.description: 1944 年 4 月 17 日，日军发动豫湘桂战役，先后在河南、湖南、广西等地进攻。中国军队虽顽强抵抗，但郑州、长沙、衡阳、桂林、柳州、南宁等地相继失守，正面战场遭受抗战后期最严重的挫折之一。 本事件日期与范围取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 17 April 1944, Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go, attacking across Henan, Hunan, and Guangxi. Despite stubborn Chinese resistance, Zhengzhou, Changsha, Hengyang, Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning fell in succession, one of the most serious setbacks for China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years. Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.summary: 第1战区部队在豫中抗击日军，郑州、许昌、洛阳相继失守。 1st War Zone troops resisted the Japanese in central Henan; Zhengzhou, Xuchang, and Luoyang fell in succession.
fields.description: 1944 年 4 月，日军发动豫中作战。第1战区司令长官蒋鼎文、副司令长官汤恩伯所部在郑州、许昌、洛阳一线抵抗，因指挥失误与兵力分散而节节失利。第36集团军总司令李家钰在撤退中殉国。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In April 1944 the Japanese launched the Central Henan operation. Troops of the 1st War Zone under Jiang Dingwen and Tang Enbo resisted along the Zhengzhou–Xuchang–Luoyang line but were defeated in detail because of command failures and dispersed forces. General Li Jiayu, commander of the 36th Group Army, was killed during the retreat. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 中牟沦陷（1944） Fall of Zhongmou (1944)
fields.summary: 1944年4月18日，日军第37师团在中牟强渡新黄河，豫中会战爆发。 On 18 April 1944 the Japanese 37th Division forced the New Yellow River at Zhongmou, opening the Central Henan campaign.
fields.description: 1944年4月17日夜至18日凌晨，日军第37师团配属独立混成第7旅团在中牟县强渡新黄河，突破暂编第15军阵地，中牟随即失守，豫中会战爆发。日军随后在郑州、新郑、尉氏、洧川等地与第28集团军激战。日期据《豫中会战经过》与《河南的抗战历程》。 On the night of 17–18 April 1944 the Japanese 37th Division with the 7th Independent Mixed Brigade crossed the New Yellow River at Zhongmou, broke the Provisional 15th Corps and took the town, opening the Central Henan campaign. The Japanese then fought the 28th Group Army at Zhengzhou, Xinzheng, Weishi and Weichuan.

fields.name: 郑州沦陷 Fall of Zhengzhou
fields.summary: 豫中会战中日军攻占郑州。 Japanese forces captured Zhengzhou during the Central Henan campaign.
fields.description: 1944 年 4 月，日军发动豫中会战，第 12 军自中牟、邙山头渡过黄河。4 月 23 日，日军占领郑州。郑州沦陷日期有 4 月 19 日、20 日、23 日诸说，此处取“至 4 月 23 日相继攻陷郑州”的记载，待页码级核对。 In April 1944 Japan launched the Central Henan campaign; the 12th Army crossed the Yellow River at Zhongmu and the Mangshan foothills. On 23 April Japanese forces occupied Zhengzhou. Accounts of the date vary among 19, 20 and 23 April; this entry follows the record that Zhengzhou was taken by 23 April and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 密县沦陷 Fall of Mi County
fields.place: 河南密县（今新密） Mi County (modern Xinmi), Henan
fields.summary: 1944年4月24日，日军第37师团、第110师团攻陷密县。 On 24 April 1944 the Japanese 37th and 110th divisions took Mi County after five days of fighting.
fields.description: 1944年4月17日豫中会战开始。日军第37师团第225联队自新郑郭店向密县观音堂进犯，4月19日黄昏与第85军第23师前哨接战，被击退；20日、21日日军增兵再攻观音堂、超化，均被击退。23日第110师团由荥阳南下，威胁五里店阵地侧背，第23师孤军无援，当晚突围转移至密县西南山地。4月24日密县失陷，日军完成第一期作战目标，随后集结兵力南下许昌。日期取《豫中会战经过》与《蒋介石与豫湘桂战役》（引日方战史档案）；另有一说记为4月23日失陷。 The Japanese offensive in central Henan opened on 17 April 1944. The 225th Regiment of the 37th Division advanced from Guodian in Xinzheng toward the Guanyintang post at Mi County and was thrown back by the outposts of the Chinese 85th Army's 23rd Division at dusk on 19 April; Japanese reinforcements attacked Guanyintang and Chaohua on the 20th and 21st and were also repulsed. On the 23rd the 110th Division came south from Xingyang and threatened the rear of the Wulidian position; the 23rd Division, unsupported, broke out that night into the hills south-west of the county town. Mi County fell on 24 April, completing the Japanese first-phase objective before the main body turned south on Xuchang. The date follows the campaign history and a study drawing on Japanese archival records; one account gives 23 April.

summary.zh: 1944年5月4日，日军独立混成第7旅团在连续三日攻城后占领襄城县城。
summary.en: On 4 May 1944, after three days of assault, the Japanese 7th Independent Mixed Brigade took Xiangcheng.

fields.name: 襄城沦陷 Fall of Xiangcheng
fields.summary: 1944年5月4日，日军独立混成第7旅团在连续三日攻城后占领襄城县城。 On 4 May 1944, after three days of assault, the Japanese 7th Independent Mixed Brigade took Xiangcheng.
fields.description: 1944年5月2日，日军独立混成第7旅团5000余人自许昌方向进攻襄城，守军为第12军第22师（原第20师余部），在城郊中冀寨、前冀寨、首山、令武山一带激战。5月3日凌晨，日军攻破城墙突入城内，与守军巷战，并在城西六王冢屠杀避难群众千余人。5月4日凌晨，日军以数倍兵力四面包围县城，第12军军长贺粹之下令第22师撤退，日军占领襄城；第22师与第78军第43师随后一度反击，5日凌晨攻入西关，因汤恩伯令第78军转援鲁山而未能收复。县城陷落日取《中华民族抗战编年》《燃烧的土地》与战史叙述；《侵华日军暴行总录》记5月3日攻破县城，系破城之日，与5月4日完全占领并存。 On 2 May 1944 more than 5,000 men of the Japanese 7th Independent Mixed Brigade attacked Xiangcheng from the Xuchang direction; the town was held by the 22nd Division of the Chinese 12th Army (the remnant of the 20th Division), and the two sides fought at Zhongjizhai, Qianjizhai, Mount Shou and Mount Lingwu around the town. Before dawn on 3 May the Japanese breached the wall and fought the defenders street by street, and at Liuwangzhong west of the town they massacred more than a thousand refugees. Before dawn on 4 May the Japanese surrounded the town in overwhelming strength; the 12th Army commander He Cuizhi ordered the 22nd Division to withdraw and the Japanese occupied Xiangcheng. The 22nd Division and the 43rd Division of the 78th Army counter-attacked and broke into the west suburb before dawn on the 5th, but could not retake the town because Tang Enbo ordered the 78th Army to relieve Lushan. The date of the occupation follows the Chinese chronology, The Burning Land and campaign accounts; A Compendium of Japanese Atrocities gives 3 May for the breaching of the wall, the day the town was first broken into, which is recorded alongside the complete occupation on 4 May.

summary.zh: 1944年5月5日，日军攻陷郾城、漯河。
summary.en: On 5 May 1944 the Japanese captured Yancheng and Luohe.

fields.name: 漯河沦陷 Fall of Luohe
fields.summary: 1944年5月5日，日军攻陷郾城、漯河。 On 5 May 1944 the Japanese captured Yancheng and Luohe.
fields.description: 1944年5月5日，日军攻破五里庙，沙河北岸中国军队阵地崩溃，南撤部队遭日军南北夹击。下午1时日军侵占郾城、突入漯河，守军顾锡九部突围，漯河陷落。漯河时为郾城县辖镇，是平汉铁路南段重镇。日期据《漯河保卫战》与漯河日报。 On 5 May 1944 the Japanese broke the Wulimiao position and the Chinese line north of the Sha River collapsed, with the withdrawing troops caught in a double envelopment. At 1 p.m. the Japanese took Yancheng and entered Luohe; Gu Xijiu’s force broke out and the town fell. Luohe was then a town under Yancheng county and a key point on the southern Beiping–Hankou railway.

summary.zh: 1944年5月5日，日军第27师团攻陷郾城，同日突入漯河。
summary.en: On 5 May 1944 the Japanese 27th Division took Yancheng and broke into Luohe the same day.

fields.name: 郾城沦陷 Fall of Yancheng
fields.summary: 1944年5月5日，日军第27师团攻陷郾城，同日突入漯河。 On 5 May 1944 the Japanese 27th Division took Yancheng and broke into Luohe the same day.
fields.description: 1944年5月2日，日军攻陷临颍后沿平汉线南下，自小商桥分三路进攻漯河、郾城。守军为第89军新编第1师与骑兵第3师。5月2日至4日，日军猛攻五里庙、郾城县城，均被击退；5日拂晓五里庙失守，沙河北岸阵地崩溃，守军渡河南撤，日军随后占领漯河镇外围村庄。5日下午1时，日军侵占郾城并突入漯河，第89军军长顾锡九率部突围。郾城、漯河同日沦陷，日军第91师团随后驻扎漯河。日期取漯河日报地方史与《漯河保卫战》战史。 After taking Linying on 2 May 1944 the Japanese 27th Division advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and attacked Luohe and Yancheng in three columns from Xiaoshangqiao. The Chinese 89th Army's New 1st Division and the 3rd Cavalry Division held the line. Japanese assaults on Wulimiao and the Yancheng county town were beaten back from 2 to 4 May; before dawn on the 5th Wulimiao fell, the north-bank position collapsed and the defenders withdrew across the Sha River, after which the Japanese occupied the villages around Luohe. At one o'clock in the afternoon of 5 May the Japanese took Yancheng and broke into Luohe; the 89th Army commander Gu Xijiu led his men out. Yancheng and Luohe fell the same day, and the Japanese 91st Division afterwards garrisoned Luohe. The date follows local Luohe historiography and the campaign account of the defence of Luohe.

summary.zh: 1944年5月6日，日军攻占登封。
summary.en: On 6 May 1944 the Japanese captured Dengfeng.

fields.name: 登封沦陷 Fall of Dengfeng
fields.summary: 1944年5月6日，日军攻占登封。 On 6 May 1944 the Japanese captured Dengfeng.
fields.description: 至1944年5月6日，日军先后攻占许昌、登封、禹县、郏县、襄城、临汝、宝丰、鲁山等地，一部直抵洛阳龙门附近。登封失守后，日军从东南方向逼近洛阳。日期据《豫中会战经过》与《河南的抗战历程》。 By 6 May 1944 the Japanese had taken Xuchang, Dengfeng, Yu County, Jiaxian, Xiangcheng, Linru, Baofeng and Lushan, with part of their force reaching the vicinity of Longmen. The fall of Dengfeng brought the Japanese toward Luoyang from the southeast.

summary.zh: 1944年5月6日，日军攻陷宝丰县城。
summary.en: On 6 May 1944 the Japanese took Baofeng.

fields.name: 宝丰沦陷 Fall of Baofeng
fields.summary: 1944年5月6日，日军攻陷宝丰县城。 On 6 May 1944 the Japanese took Baofeng.
fields.description: 1944年5月3日郏县失守后，日军战车第3师团、骑兵第4旅团等部继续西进，5月6日攻陷宝丰县城，同日登封、鲁山亦失守。宝丰沦陷后，群众纷纷逃往城西六十里的观音堂山寨避难；5月9日，日军步兵第226联队泽野大队自鲁山方面北犯，在观音堂红玉岭、铁山一带与第31集团军第12军第81师一部遭遇，俘官兵200余人，10日对观音堂实施报复性屠杀，寨内70余人及被俘200余人遇害。日期取《侵华日军暴行总录》与豫中会战战史。 After Jiaxian fell on 3 May 1944 the Japanese 3rd Tank Division and 4th Cavalry Brigade pushed west and took Baofeng on 6 May; Dengfeng and Lushan fell the same day. After the fall, civilians fled to the mountain stronghold of Guanyintang sixty li west of the county town; on 9 May the Japanese 226th Regiment's Sawano battalion came north from Lushan, met troops of the 81st Division, 12th Army, 31st Army Group at Hongyu Ridge and Tieshan near Guanyintang and captured over 200 soldiers, and on the 10th carried out a retaliatory massacre at Guanyintang in which more than seventy villagers and over two hundred prisoners were killed. The date follows A Compendium of Japanese Atrocities and the campaign history of the central Henan battle.

fields.name: 鲁山沦陷 Fall of Lushan
fields.summary: 1944年5月7日，日军占领鲁山。 On 7 May 1944 the Japanese occupied Lushan.
fields.description: 1944年5月7日，日军占领鲁山，随后占领第一战区储备基地下汤。鲁山时为河南省政府驻地之一，失守后省政府迁至内乡丹水镇。日期据《抗日战争中的平顶山》与《豫中会战经过》；后者记5月6日，正文并列。 On 7 May 1944 the Japanese occupied Lushan and then the First War Zone supply base at Xiatang. Lushan was then one of the seats of the Henan provincial government, which moved to Danshui in Neixiang after its fall. The Pingdingshan history gives 7 May; the campaign narrative gives 6 May.

The Japanese then concentrated on Luoyang.

fields.name: 巩县沦陷 Fall of Gong County
fields.place: 河南巩县 Gong County (Gongyi), Henan
fields.summary: 1944年5月9日，日军“菊兵团”攻占巩县。 On 9 May 1944 the Japanese Kiku detachment captured Gong County (Gongyi).
fields.description: 1944年5月9日，自郑州沿陇海铁路西犯的日军“菊兵团”攻占巩县，11日占领偃师，迫近洛阳城东。巩县失守后，日军完成对洛阳东西两面的合围。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与《豫中会战经过》。 On 9 May 1944 the Japanese Kiku detachment, advancing west from Zhengzhou along the Longhai railway, took Gong County and on the 11th Yanshi, closing on Luoyang from the east. The fall of Gong County completed the Japanese encirclement of Luoyang from east and west.

summary.zh: 1944年5月9日，日军第27师团攻陷遂平县城，南进至驻马店与第11旅团会师。
summary.en: On 9 May 1944 the Japanese 27th Division took Suiping and pushed south to Zhumadian, joining the 11th Independent Infantry Brigade.

fields.name: 遂平沦陷 Fall of Suiping
fields.summary: 1944年5月9日，日军第27师团攻陷遂平县城，南进至驻马店与第11旅团会师。 On 9 May 1944 the Japanese 27th Division took Suiping and pushed south to Zhumadian, joining the 11th Independent Infantry Brigade.
fields.description: 1944年5月，日军第27师团由许昌沿平汉线南犯，5月5日陷漯河、郾城，5月8日陷西平。5月9日，第27师团攻陷遂平县城，并南进至驻马店，与由信阳北犯的独立步兵第11旅团会师。遂平县政府与县团队事先移驻西部山区，控制玉山、诸市、文城、金嵖、沈寨及铁路东张店、石寨铺等乡镇；6月，日军在遂平建立维持会。5月13日豫南中国军队一度克复遂平、驻马店，6月日军再陷遂平、确山。此次为遂平第二次沦陷（第一次为 1941 年 1 月 28 日）。日期取驻马店党史方志网、驻马店广视网与《嵖岈山抗战烽火》。 In May 1944 the Japanese 27th Division advanced south from Xuchang along the Beiping–Hankou railway, taking Luohe and Yancheng on 5 May and Xiping on the 8th. On 9 May it took Suiping and pushed south to Zhumadian, where it joined the 11th Independent Infantry Brigade coming north from Xinyang. The Suiping county government and its armed teams had withdrawn to the western hills and still controlled the townships of Yushan, Zhushi, Wencheng, Jincha, Shensai and, east of the railway, Zhangdian and Shizhaipu; in June the Japanese set up a maintenance committee in Suiping. On 13 May Chinese troops in southern Henan briefly recovered Suiping and Zhumadian, and in June the Japanese retook Suiping and Queshan. This was the second occupation of Suiping, the first having been on 28 January 1941. The date follows the Zhumadian party-history gazetteer, Zhumadian TV and the account of the Chaya Mountain resistance.

fields.name: 滇西反攻 Western Yunnan Counteroffensive 滇西缅北反攻 Yunnan–Burma Counteroffensive
fields.summary: 中国远征军强渡怒江，反攻腾冲、龙陵、松山，至 1945 年初收复滇西。 The Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and counterattacked toward Tengchong, Longling, and Songshan, recovering western Yunnan by early 1945.
fields.description: 1944 年 5 月，中国远征军强渡怒江，向腾冲、龙陵、松山等地日军发起反攻。中国军队与盟军协同，经过松山、腾冲、龙陵等激战，至 1945 年 1 月收复畹町，打通中印公路。此役是抗战后期中国军队在滇西的重要反攻，与缅北反攻相互配合。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and launched a counteroffensive against Japanese forces at Tengchong, Longling, Songshan, and other points. Working with Allied forces, Chinese troops fought fierce battles at Songshan, Tengchong, and Longling, recovered Wanding in January 1945, and opened the Ledo Road. The campaign was an important Chinese counteroffensive in western Yunnan in the later war years, coordinated with the northern Burma offensive. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 渑池沦陷 Fall of Mianchi
fields.summary: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团攻陷渑池。 On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division captured Mianchi.
fields.description: 1944年5月9日，驻晋南垣曲的日军第69师团主力强渡黄河，向渑池进攻；12日攻陷渑池、新安，直逼洛阳城西。渑池附近第36集团军西移卢氏附近，洛阳守军陷于孤军苦战。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与《豫中会战经过》；后者记9日渡河、13日各路会合。 On 9 May 1944 the main force of the Japanese 69th Division crossed the Yellow River from Yuanqu in southern Shanxi and attacked Mianchi, taking Mianchi and Xin’an on the 12th and closing on Luoyang from the west. The Chinese 36th Group Army near Mianchi withdrew toward Lushi, leaving Luoyang isolated. The campaign narrative gives 9 May for the crossing and 13 May for the junction of columns.

fields.name: 新安沦陷 Fall of Xin’an
fields.summary: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团攻陷新安。 On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division captured Xin’an.
fields.description: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团在攻陷渑池的同时攻陷新安，进抵洛阳以西。新安失守后，陇海铁路洛阳至潼关段被日军控制，第一战区主力向西转移。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与《豫中会战经过》。 On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division took Xin’an together with Mianchi and reached the approaches west of Luoyang. With Xin’an lost the Japanese controlled the Longhai railway from Luoyang toward Tongguan, and the First War Zone’s main force shifted west.

summary.en: On 13 May 1944 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Brigade took Zhengyang.

fields.name: 正阳沦陷 Fall of Zhengyang
fields.summary: 1944年5月13日，日军独立步兵第11旅团攻陷正阳县城。 On 13 May 1944 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Brigade took Zhengyang.
fields.description: 1944年5月4日，由信阳北犯的日军第11军独立步兵第11旅团攻陷确山县城；5月13日，该部攻陷正阳县城，随后陷汝南县城。正阳沦陷后，国民党地方军政力量西撤，正阳、汝南、确山之间形成真空地带；同年8月29日，新四军第5师豫南游击兵团攻打正阳胡冲店，建立汝（南）正（阳）确（山）县委与行政委员会。1945年3月14日，日军骑兵1300余人、步兵800余人进犯汝南东南，在正阳寒冻镇小王楼屠杀村民200余人。日期取驻马店党史方志网与《刻在正阳大地的抗战记忆》。 On 4 May 1944 the 11th Independent Infantry Brigade of the Japanese 11th Army, advancing north from Xinyang, took Queshan; on 13 May it took Zhengyang and then Runan. After the fall of Zhengyang the Nationalist local administration withdrew west, leaving a vacuum between Zhengyang, Runan and Queshan; on 29 August 1944 the New Fourth Army's southern Henan guerrilla corps attacked Huchongdian in Zhengyang and established the Runan–Zhengyang–Queshan county committee and administration. On 14 March 1945 more than 1,300 Japanese cavalry and 800 infantry raided south-eastern Runan and massacred over 200 villagers at Xiaowanglou in Handong township, Zhengyang. The date follows the Zhumadian party-history gazetteer and the Zhengyang war memoir.

name.en: Enlarged Seventh Plenum of the Sixth Central Committee

summary.zh: 1944 年 5 月 21 日至 1945 年 4 月 20 日，中共扩大的六届七中全会在延安召开，通过《关于若干历史问题的决议》。
summary.en: From 21 May 1944 to 20 April 1945 the enlarged Seventh Plenum met at Yan’an and adopted the resolution on certain historical questions.

fields.name: 中共扩大的六届七中全会 Enlarged Seventh Plenum of the Sixth Central Committee
fields.summary: 1944 年 5 月 21 日至 1945 年 4 月 20 日，中共扩大的六届七中全会在延安召开，通过《关于若干历史问题的决议》。 From 21 May 1944 to 20 April 1945 the enlarged Seventh Plenum met at Yan’an and adopted the resolution on certain historical questions.
fields.description: 1944 年 5 月 21 日至 1945 年 4 月 20 日，中共扩大的六届七中全会在延安杨家岭召开，会期长达十一个月。全会选举毛泽东、朱德、刘少奇、任弼时、周恩来组成主席团，毛泽东为主席团主席；全会期间由主席团处理中央日常工作，中央书记处及政治局停止行使职权。1945 年 4 月 20 日，全会原则通过《关于若干历史问题的决议》，总结建党以来特别是六届四中全会至遵义会议前党的历史及其经验教训，肯定毛泽东运用马克思列宁主义解决中国革命问题的贡献，为七大的召开准备了思想条件。本事件为会议，不绘路线。 From 21 May 1944 to 20 April 1945 the enlarged Seventh Plenum of the Sixth Central Committee met at Yangjialing, Yan’an, over eleven months. It elected a presidium of Mao Zedong, Zhu De, Liu Shaoqi, Ren Bishi and Zhou Enlai, with Mao as chairman; during the plenum the presidium handled daily central work and the Secretariat and Politburo ceased to exercise their functions. On 20 April 1945 the plenum adopted in principle the “Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party”, summing up Party history and its lessons since its founding, especially from the Fourth Plenum of the Sixth Central Committee to the Zunyi Conference, and affirming Mao Zedong’s contribution to solving the problems of the Chinese revolution through Marxism-Leninism. It prepared the ground for the Seventh Congress. No route is drawn.

fields.summary: 1944年5月28日，日军第68、第116师团渡过新墙河，长衡会战开始。 On 28 May 1944 the Japanese 68th and 116th Divisions crossed the Xinqiang River, opening the Changsha–Hengyang campaign.
fields.description: 1944年5月27日日军第11军分三路南犯，中路第68、第116师团于28日上午渡过新墙河，中国第20军抗击后向平江以东山区转移。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 27 May 1944 the Japanese 11th Army advanced south in three columns; the central 68th and 116th Divisions crossed the Xinqiang on the morning of the 28th. The Chinese 20th Corps resisted and withdrew to the hills east of Pingjiang.

fields.description: 5月29日，日伪军围攻淮北灵（璧）五（河）抗日游击区，焚毁18个村庄、1003户、4200余间房屋，打死无辜村民103人，打伤210余人。此为暴行事件，不绘路线。日期与数字据《安徽沦陷大事记（三）》与人民网，待页码级核对。 On 29 May Japanese and puppet troops attacked the Lingbi–Wuhe anti-Japanese guerrilla zone in northern Anhui, burning 18 villages, 1,003 households and more than 4,200 rooms, killing 103 villagers and wounding over 210. This atrocity is not drawn as a route. The date and figures follow the third part of the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 松山战役 Battle of Songshan 松山攻坚战 Songshan Offensive
fields.place: 云南龙陵松山 Songshan, Longling, Yunnan
fields.summary: 中国远征军围攻松山日军据点，经苦战收复松山，打通滇缅公路关键节点。 The Chinese Expeditionary Force captured the Japanese stronghold at Songshan after bitter fighting, opening a key point on the Burma Road.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月至 9 月，中国远征军对云南龙陵松山日军据点发起进攻。日军依托坚固工事顽抗，中国军队付出重大伤亡，最终于 9 月 7 日收复松山，为滇西反攻和滇缅公路恢复通车创造条件。 本事件日期、地点与战果待史料校订。 From June to September 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force attacked the Japanese stronghold at Songshan in Longling, Yunnan. Japanese troops resisted from fortified positions, and Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties before recapturing Songshan on 7 September, facilitating the western Yunnan counteroffensive and the reopening of the Burma Road. Dates, location, and assessments await historical review.

fields.description: 1944年6月5日起，中国远征军第11集团军第2军第9师围攻平达，并攻占象达，追击日军至油菜地。日军第56师团在象达一带构筑据点，掩护龙陵侧翼。日期据《中国远征军滇西作战梗概》与《滇西大反攻：绝地反击 收复国土》。 From 5 June 1944 the Chinese 2nd Army’s 9th Division besieged Pingda, took Xiangda and pursued the Japanese to Youcaidi. The Japanese 56th Division held posts around Xiangda to cover Longling’s flank.

fields.name: 湘阴沦陷 Fall of Xiangyin
fields.summary: 1944年6月8日，日军第58师团攻占湘阴。 On 8 June 1944 the Japanese 58th Division captured Xiangyin.
fields.description: 1944年6月8日日军第58师团第52旅团经汨罗镇、望城坡攻占湘阴。湘阴为长沙北面水陆要地，失守后日军从北面逼近长沙。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 8 June 1944 the 52nd Brigade of the Japanese 58th Division advanced via Miluo and Wangchengpo to take Xiangyin, the water-and-land gateway north of Changsha. Its fall brought the Japanese to Changsha’s northern approaches.

summary.zh: 1944年6月10日，日军战车第3师团突破弘农河防线，灵宝县城、函谷关、虢略镇同日失守。
summary.en: On 10 June 1944 the Japanese 3rd Tank Division broke the Hongnong River line and Lingbao, Hangu Pass and Guolue fell the same day.

fields.name: 灵宝沦陷 Fall of Lingbao
fields.summary: 1944年6月10日，日军战车第3师团突破弘农河防线，灵宝县城、函谷关、虢略镇同日失守。 On 10 June 1944 the Japanese 3rd Tank Division broke the Hongnong River line and Lingbao, Hangu Pass and Guolue fell the same day.
fields.description: 1944年6月，豫中会战后期转为灵宝战役。中国第8战区部队6月1日起反攻陕县，6月5日日军战车第3师团等发起反攻，突破灵虢防线；6月9日多处阵地被突破，第8师副师长王剑岳在毕家寨阵亡。6月10日，日军战车第3师团主力渡过弘农河，突破牛庄—毕家砦防线，中国军队全线后撤，灵宝县城、函谷关、虢略镇同日失守。6月11日中午日军第一军下令东撤，6月15日第39师收复灵宝城，17日基本恢复战前态势。日期取灵宝战役战史（《豫中会战之：灵宝战役》《「灵宝战役」探究》）与《三门峡抗战大事记》。 In June 1944 the central Henan campaign turned into the battle of Lingbao. Chinese Eighth War Zone troops counter-attacked Shanzhou from 1 June; on 5 June the Japanese 3rd Tank Division and other units counter-attacked and broke the Lingbao–Guolue line, and on 9 June several positions were pierced and the 8th Division's deputy commander Wang Jianyue was killed at Bijiazhai. On 10 June the main body of the 3rd Tank Division crossed the Hongnong River and broke the Niuzhuang–Bijiayao line; the Chinese retreated all along the front and Lingbao, Hangu Pass and Guolue fell the same day. At noon on 11 June the Japanese First Army ordered a general withdrawal eastwards; the Chinese 39th Division recovered Lingbao on 15 June and by the 17th the front was back to its previous state. The date follows the campaign histories and the Sanmenxia war chronology.

summary.zh: 1944年6月11日，日军进至阌乡，阌乡沦陷，13日被第39师收复。
summary.en: On 11 June 1944 the Japanese reached and took Wenxiang; the Chinese 39th Division recovered it on the 13th.

fields.name: 阌乡沦陷 Fall of Wenxiang
fields.summary: 1944年6月11日，日军进至阌乡，阌乡沦陷，13日被第39师收复。 On 11 June 1944 the Japanese reached and took Wenxiang; the Chinese 39th Division recovered it on the 13th.
fields.description: 1944年6月10日灵宝防线被突破后，日军一部继续西进。6月11日，阌乡沦陷。日军进至阳平、坡头、金盆、阌乡之线，11日夜至12日晨分股进攻，被第39师与预备第3师击退；11日中午日军第一军已下令全线东撤，13日第39师收复阌乡。阌乡地处陇海铁路河南段最西端，西距潼关仅数十里，其失守使关中一度告急；此后日军退守陕县，潼关与关中摆脱直接威胁。日期取《三门峡抗战大事记》；《豫中会战之：灵宝战役》记13日第39师收复阌乡，可相印证。 After the Lingbao line was broken on 10 June 1944 part of the Japanese force pushed further west. On 11 June Wenxiang fell. The Japanese reached the Yangping–Potou–Jinpen–Wenxiang line and attacked in several columns from the night of the 11th to the morning of the 12th, but were driven back by the Chinese 39th Division and the 3rd Reserve Division; at noon on the 11th the Japanese First Army had already ordered a general withdrawal eastwards, and on the 13th the 39th Division recovered Wenxiang. Wenxiang lay at the western end of the Longhai railway in Henan, only some tens of li from Tongguan, and its loss briefly put Guanzhong in danger; the Japanese then withdrew to Shanzhou and Tongguan was no longer directly threatened. The date follows the Sanmenxia war chronology, corroborated by the campaign history recording the 39th Division's recovery of Wenxiang on the 13th.

summary.en: On 12 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division captured Yiyang.

fields.name: 益阳沦陷 Fall of Yiyang
fields.summary: 1944年6月12日，日军第40师团攻占益阳。 On 12 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division captured Yiyang.
fields.description: 1944年6月12日日军第40师团攻占益阳，随后向宁乡进攻。中国第24集团军第73、第79军对日军实施钳形攻击，益阳一度被中国军队收复。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 12 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division took Yiyang and advanced on Ningxiang. The Chinese 73rd and 79th Corps of the 24th Group Army counterattacked in a pincer, and Yiyang was briefly recovered.

fields.name: 浏阳沦陷 Fall of Liuyang
fields.summary: 1944年6月14日，日军第3师团攻占浏阳。 On 14 June 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Liuyang.
fields.description: 1944年6月14日23时30分，日军第3师团攻占浏阳。此前第13师团从浏阳东南迂回，第68师团从镇头攻向普迹，形成合围。浏阳失守后，日军从东南面威胁长沙、株洲。日期据《长衡会战》与《日军侵华战争》。 At 11:30 p.m. on 14 June 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division took Liuyang, after the 13th Division had swung around its southeast and the 68th Division advanced from Zhentou. Its fall threatened Changsha and Zhuzhou from the southeast.

fields.summary: 长衡会战中，第4军守长沙，与日军第11军激战，长沙于 6 月 19 日失守。 In the Changsha–Hengyang campaign the 4th Army defended Changsha against the Japanese 11th Army; the city fell on 19 June.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月，日军第11军进攻长沙。第4军（军长张德能）在长沙城郊抵抗，因指挥与部署失误，长沙于 6 月 19 日失守，第4军突围。此后日军继续南下进攻衡阳。 日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In June 1944 the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changsha. The 4th Army under Zhang Deneng resisted around the city but, hampered by command and deployment failures, lost Changsha on 19 June and broke out. The Japanese then continued south toward Hengyang. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 醴陵沦陷 Fall of Liling
fields.summary: 1944年6月18日，日军第13师团第65联队攻陷醴陵县城，纵火焚城。 On 18 June 1944 the Japanese 13th Division's 65th Regiment took Liling and burned the town.
fields.description: 1944年6月14日，日军第13师团第65联队自浏阳南部大瑶南下，在芭蕉塘、金鱼石突破第26军阻击，6月18日陷醴陵县城（县政府事前迁明月乡云岩寺）。日军入城后即纵火焚烧，三四十里外可见烟尘，连烧数日；陷城10日后日军移驻城外，再次纵火，县城化为灰烬。7月8日，第58军一度克复醴陵；7月10日，日军第27师团、第34师团再陷醴陵。日军盘踞至1945年，全县4652人被杀。日期取《湖南抗日战争日志》与《醴陵市志》；《侵华日军暴行总录》记6月22日第68师团侵入醴陵，系另一支部队入县境，并存。 On 14 June 1944 the 65th Regiment of the Japanese 13th Division advanced south from Dayao in southern Liuyang, broke the Chinese 26th Army at Bajiaotang and Jinyushi, and on 18 June took Liling; the county government had moved to Yunyan Temple in Mingyue township. The Japanese set fires that were visible thirty or forty li away and burned for days; ten days later they moved out of the town and burned it again, reducing it to ashes. On 8 July the Chinese 58th Army briefly retook Liling, and on 10 July the Japanese 27th and 34th divisions retook it. The Japanese remained until 1945 and killed 4,652 people in the county. The date follows the Hunan War Log and the Liling Gazetteer; A Compendium of Japanese Atrocities records the 68th Division entering Liling on 22 June, a different unit entering the county.

summary.en: On 20 June 1944 the Japanese captured Zhuzhou.

fields.name: 株洲沦陷（1944） Fall of Zhuzhou (1944)
fields.summary: 1944年6月20日，日军攻占株洲。 On 20 June 1944 the Japanese captured Zhuzhou.
fields.description: 1944年6月20日，日军在攻占长沙后沿粤汉铁路南下，先后攻占醴陵、株洲、渌口、湘潭。株洲为粤汉、湘黔铁路交点，失守后日军打开南下衡阳的通道。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 20 June 1944, after taking Changsha, the Japanese advanced south along the Canton–Hankou railway and took Liling, Zhuzhou, Lukou and Xiangtan in succession. Zhuzhou was the junction of the Canton–Hankou and Hunan–Guizhou railways; its fall opened the way to Hengyang.

fields.summary: 1944年6月20日，日军攻占湘潭。 On 20 June 1944 the Japanese captured Xiangtan.
fields.description: 1944年6月20日，日军在攻占株洲的同时攻占湘潭。湘潭为湘江两岸要地，失守后日军沿湘江两岸南下衡阳。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 20 June 1944 the Japanese took Xiangtan together with Zhuzhou. Xiangtan commanded both banks of the Xiang River; its fall opened the advance south toward Hengyang.

summary.en: On 21 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division took Xiangxiang in a night attack.

fields.name: 湘乡沦陷 Fall of Xiangxiang
fields.summary: 1944年6月21日，日军第40师团夜袭攻陷湘乡县城。 On 21 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division took Xiangxiang in a night attack.
fields.description: 1944年6月长衡会战，日军第40师团自宁乡沿湘宁大道南犯，另以第116师团第133联队自湘潭石潭西进，两路约1.8万人会攻湘乡。6月18日第133联队自石潭推进，攻占第32师驻防的东山阵地；19日日军分三路进犯湘乡，20日前锋进入县境水桥，与新编第23师一部接战，另股绕道南薮段、桐瑞台抵城北泉塘。21日第40师团全力攻城，守城警察与湘宁师管区、第23师留守部队奋起抗击，当夜日军夜袭，湘乡县城沦陷。县长周世正组织湘乡县抗敌自卫团，与第73军继续抗敌。日期取《湘乡县志》与《湖南抗日战争日志》。 In the June 1944 Changsha–Hengyang campaign the Japanese 40th Division advanced south from Ningxiang along the Xiangxiang road while the 116th Division's 133rd Regiment moved west from Shitan in Xiangtan, about 18,000 men converging on Xiangxiang. On 18 June the 133rd Regiment took the Dongshan position held by the Chinese 32nd Division; on the 19th the Japanese advanced in three columns, and by the 20th their spearheads had reached Shuiqiao inside the county and engaged the New 23rd Division, while another column came round through Nansouduan and Tongruitai to Quantang north of the town. On the 21st the 40th Division assaulted the town in force; the city police, the Xiangning garrison district troops and the remaining 23rd Division men resisted, but that night a Japanese night attack took the county town. Magistrate Zhou Shizheng organised the Xiangxiang self-defence corps and continued to fight alongside the 73rd Army. The date follows the Xiangxiang County Gazetteer and the Hunan War Log.

summary.zh: 中国第 10 军坚守衡阳 47 天，重创日军，最终衡阳失守。
summary.en: The Chinese 10th Army held Hengyang for 47 days, inflicting heavy losses on Japanese forces before the city fell.

fields.name: 衡阳保卫战 Defense of Hengyang 衡阳会战 Hengyang Campaign
fields.summary: 中国第 10 军坚守衡阳 47 天，重创日军，最终衡阳失守。 The Chinese 10th Army held Hengyang for 47 days, inflicting heavy losses on Japanese forces before the city fell.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中进攻衡阳。中国第 10 军约一万七千人坚守衡阳，面对优势日军的围攻，苦战 47 天，伤亡惨重，弹尽援绝，衡阳于 8 月 8 日失守。此役迟滞了日军南进，是抗战后期著名的城市防御战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为城防示意，待史料校订。 In June 1944, Japanese forces attacked Hengyang during Operation Ichi-Go. The Chinese 10th Army, about 17,000 strong, defended the city against a numerically superior Japanese siege for 47 days. With heavy casualties, ammunition exhausted, and no relief in sight, Hengyang fell on 8 August. The defense delayed the Japanese advance south and became one of the best-known urban defense battles of the later war years. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a sketch of the city defense and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 攸县沦陷 Fall of Youxian
fields.summary: 1944年6月24日，日军东路攻占攸县。 On 24 June 1944 the Japanese eastern column captured Youxian.
fields.description: 1944年6月24日，日军东路第3、第13师团南下攻占攸县、安仁、耒阳，迂回衡阳东南。中国第9战区一度收复攸县、官田，7月15日以后日军再陷攸县。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 24 June 1944 the Japanese eastern 3rd and 13th Divisions drove south and took Youxian, Anren and Leiyang, swinging around Hengyang’s southeast. The Chinese Ninth War Zone briefly recovered Youxian and Guantian, but the Japanese retook Youxian after 15 July.

fields.description: 1944年6月24日，日军东路第3、第13师团攻占耒阳，迂回至衡阳东南约60公里。耒阳为粤汉铁路要地，失守后日军完成对衡阳的东南包围。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 24 June 1944 the Japanese eastern 3rd and 13th Divisions took Leiyang, swinging to about 60 km southeast of Hengyang. Leiyang was a key point on the Canton–Hankou railway; its fall completed the southeastern encirclement of Hengyang.
