fields.name: 安仁沦陷 Fall of Anren
fields.summary: 1944年6月27日，安仁县城及县辖13个乡镇尽陷日军之手。 On 27 June 1944 Anren and all thirteen of its townships fell to the Japanese.
fields.description: 1944年6月，日军第11军攻陷长沙后继续南进。6月27日，安仁县城及县辖13个乡镇尽陷日军之手。日军侵占安仁至1945年8月21日，近10个月，全县13909人死亡、14378人伤残，直接经济损失829亿元法币、间接损失218亿元法币。7月3日，日军第13师团第116联队由安仁进陷耒阳，安仁成为日军南下的跳板。日期取《安仁县志》与《侵华日军暴行总录》。 In June 1944, after taking Changsha, the Japanese 11th Army pushed south. On 27 June the Anren county town and all thirteen of its townships fell. The occupation lasted until 21 August 1945: 13,909 people were killed and 14,378 injured, with direct economic losses of 82.9 billion yuan and indirect losses of 21.8 billion. On 3 July the 116th Regiment of the Japanese 13th Division moved from Anren to take Leiyang, making Anren a stepping stone for the southward advance. The date follows the Anren County Gazetteer and A Compendium of Japanese Atrocities.

summary.zh: 1944年7月14日，日军第3师团经20天城郊争夺后进入茶陵城。
summary.en: On 14 July 1944, after twenty days of fighting around the town, the Japanese 3rd Division entered Chaling.

fields.name: 茶陵沦陷 Fall of Chaling
fields.summary: 1944年7月14日，日军第3师团经20天城郊争夺后进入茶陵城。 On 14 July 1944, after twenty days of fighting around the town, the Japanese 3rd Division entered Chaling.
fields.description: 1944年6月24日日军陷攸县后，第3师团主力即向茶陵挺进，途中遭第44军顽强阻击；进抵城郊后又遭驻防茶陵的第20军猛烈抗击，双方在城郊反复争夺达20天。后第20军奉命调湘桂线，日军于7月14日进入茶陵城。县政府迁至西南50华里的湖口墟，成立党政战斗指挥所，各乡自卫队编为三个抗日自卫大队；东北起赣边界化陇、西南至安仁约200华里公路两侧10至20里沦为敌占区。日军盘踞8个月，始终未能组成伪县政府，1945年2月26日撤离县城。全县9440余人被杀、17011人伤残。日期取《茶陵县志》、茶陵县档案史志局与《湖南抗日战争日志》。 After taking You County on 24 June 1944 the main body of the Japanese 3rd Division pushed toward Chaling, meeting stubborn resistance from the Chinese 44th Army on the way; at the outskirts it was fought hard by the 20th Army garrison, and the two sides contested the approaches for twenty days. The 20th Army was then ordered to the Hunan–Guangxi railway, and on 14 July the Japanese entered Chaling. The county government moved to Hukou, fifty li south-west, and set up a combat command; the township self-defence units were formed into three resistance battalions. The 200-li stretch of road from Jiehua Pass on the Jiangxi border south-west to Anren, for ten to twenty li on either side, became occupied territory. The Japanese stayed eight months, never managing to form a puppet county government, and withdrew from the town on 26 February 1945. More than 9,440 people were killed and 17,011 injured. The date follows the Chaling County Gazetteer, the county archives and the Hunan War Log.

summary.zh: 1944年7月29日，日军再犯宁乡，县城沦陷，周边9乡及城厢镇被占。
summary.en: On 29 July 1944 the Japanese renewed their attack on Ningxiang and the county town fell, followed by nine surrounding townships.

fields.name: 宁乡沦陷 Fall of Ningxiang
fields.summary: 1944年7月29日，日军再犯宁乡，县城沦陷，周边9乡及城厢镇被占。 On 29 July 1944 the Japanese renewed their attack on Ningxiang and the county town fell, followed by nine surrounding townships.
fields.description: 1944年6月长衡会战期间，日军第40师团自益阳、靖港会攻宁乡，守军为第74军第58师第173团另附1营。6月14日日军两个联队分路进攻，16日凌晨突入南门，守军巷战反击；17日日军纵火放毒；18日第79军第98师、第194师与第100军第19师赶到，空军11架助战，日军奉命转赴湘乡，宁乡一度收复。7月下旬日军再犯：7月27日日军两千余人进犯县城，守军第73军第15师第43团第2营及警察据杜家山、印台山抵抗，至29日晨印台山阵地失守，140余名官兵阵亡，县城沦陷，日军随后占领莲花、狮顾、麟峰等9乡及城厢镇，沦陷面积约1419平方公里。日期取《宁乡县志》与宁乡县史志档案局；《湖南抗日战争日志》记7月28日日军进犯、8月2日守军全部殉职后沦陷，异说并存。 During the June 1944 Changsha–Hengyang campaign the Japanese 40th Division attacked Ningxiang from Yiyang and Jinggang; the town was held by the 173rd Regiment of the 74th Army's 58th Division plus one battalion. Two Japanese regiments attacked on 14 June and broke into the south gate before dawn on the 16th, where the defenders fought them street by street; the Japanese set fires and used gas on the 17th; on the 18th the 98th and 194th divisions of the 79th Army and the 19th Division of the 100th Army arrived with eleven aircraft in support, and the Japanese were ordered away to Xiangxiang, so Ningxiang was briefly recovered. The Japanese attacked again in late July: on 27 July over 2,000 men moved on the county town, and the 2nd Battalion of the 73rd Army's 15th Division, 43rd Regiment, with the city police, held Dujiashan and Yintai Mountain until the Yintai position fell on the morning of the 29th; more than 140 officers and men died and the town fell, after which the Japanese occupied the urban district and nine townships including Lianhua, Shigu and Linfeng, some 1,419 square kilometres. The date follows the Ningxiang County Gazetteer and the Ningxiang history and gazetteer office; the Hunan War Log instead records the attack on 28 July and the fall on 2 August after the garrison was annihilated.

fields.name: 丽水第二次沦陷 Second Fall of Lishui
fields.summary: 1944年8月26日，日军再次攻陷丽水县城。 On 26 August 1944 Japanese forces again captured Lishui.
fields.description: 8月26日，日军第70师团和梨冈支队3000余人进犯丽水县城，国军新编第11师63团与日军激战彻夜，团长彭孝儒及大部官兵阵亡，县城沦陷。9月16日，国军新编第11师62团攻克县城。日期据《丽水抗战》，待页码级核对。 On 26 August more than 3,000 troops of the Japanese 70th Division and the Rioka detachment attacked Lishui. The Chinese New 11th Division's 63rd Regiment fought all night; its commander Peng Xiaoru and most of his men died and the county town fell. On 16 September the 62nd Regiment retook the town. The date follows the Lishui chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 温州第三次沦陷 Third Fall of Wenzhou
fields.summary: 日军甲支队自金华经丽水、青田进攻，占领温州并长期盘踞。 The Japanese Kō Detachment advanced from Jinhua via Lishui and Qingtian and occupied Wenzhou for a prolonged period.
fields.description: 1944 年 9 月，日军第 13 军组织甲支队（后改编为独立混成第 89 旅团）共 4 个大队，由黎冈少将指挥，自金华集结，经丽水、青田，于 9 月 9 日占领温州，随后占领乐清西乡和县城，在瓯江口以北沿海构筑工事、修建简易机场，直至 1945 年 6 月才撤出。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1944 the Japanese 13th Army formed the Kō Detachment (later the 89th Independent Mixed Brigade), four battalions under Major General Kogiso, which assembled at Jinhua, advanced via Lishui and Qingtian and occupied Wenzhou on 9 September. It then took western Yueqing and the county town, built fortifications and a simple airfield along the coast north of the Ou River mouth, and did not withdraw until June 1945. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 14 September 1944 the Japanese 13th Division occupied Quanzhou.

fields.name: 全州沦陷 Fall of Quanzhou
fields.place: 广西全州 Quanzhou (Quan County), Guangxi
fields.summary: 1944年9月14日，日军第13师团占领全州。 On 14 September 1944 the Japanese 13th Division occupied Quanzhou.
fields.description: 1944年9月14日凌晨，日军第13师团占领全州（全县）。中国第93军军长陈牧农未奉命令擅自弃守，焚毁大批军用物资，后被枪决。全州为西南补给基地，失守后桂林吃紧。日期据维基百科《桂柳会战》与《桂柳会战》。 In the early hours of 14 September 1944 the Japanese 13th Division took Quanzhou (Quan County). The Chinese 93rd Corps commander Chen Munong abandoned it without orders and burned large stocks; he was later executed. Quanzhou was the southwest supply base, and its loss left Guilin exposed.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.zh: 林伯渠在国民参政会提出成立联合政府
name.en: Lin Boqu proposes a coalition government at the People’s Political Council

summary.zh: 1944 年 9 月 15 日，中共代表林伯渠在国民参政会三届三次会议上提出废止一党专政、成立民主联合政府。
summary.en: On 15 September 1944 CCP representative Lin Boqu called at the People’s Political Council for ending one-party rule and forming a democratic coalition government.

fields.name: 林伯渠在国民参政会提出成立联合政府 Lin Boqu proposes a coalition government at the People’s Political Council
fields.summary: 1944 年 9 月 15 日，中共代表林伯渠在国民参政会三届三次会议上提出废止一党专政、成立民主联合政府。 On 15 September 1944 CCP representative Lin Boqu called at the People’s Political Council for ending one-party rule and forming a democratic coalition government.
fields.description: 1944 年 9 月 15 日，国民参政会三届三次会议在重庆举行，中共代表林伯渠在会上提出废止国民党一党专政、成立民主联合政府的主张，并报告国共谈判经过。此前 9 月 4 日，中共中央已就改组国民政府、成立联合政府问题致电林伯渠、董必武、王若飞。联合政府主张得到中国民主同盟等中间党派和各界人士响应，成为抗战后期国统区民主运动的重要口号。本事件为政治主张的提出，不绘路线。 On 15 September 1944 the third session of the third People’s Political Council opened in Chongqing. CCP representative Lin Boqu called for abolishing the Kuomintang’s one-party dictatorship and forming a democratic coalition government, and reported on the KMT–CCP negotiations. On 4 September the CCP Central Committee had already telegraphed Lin Boqu, Dong Biwu and Wang Ruofei on reorganising the National Government and forming a coalition government. The proposal was taken up by the China Democratic League and other middle parties and became an important slogan of the democratic movement in Nationalist-held areas in the later war years. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1944年9月22日，日军第23军攻陷梧州。
summary.en: On 22 September 1944 the Japanese 23rd Army captured Wuzhou.

fields.name: 梧州沦陷 Fall of Wuzhou
fields.summary: 1944年9月22日，日军第23军攻陷梧州。 On 22 September 1944 the Japanese 23rd Army captured Wuzhou.
fields.description: 1944年9月22日日军第23军攻陷梧州。日军由广东清远沿西江西进，梧州失守后继续向平南、桂平推进，威胁柳州右侧背。日期据维基百科《桂柳会战》与《桂柳会战》。 On 22 September 1944 the Japanese 23rd Army took Wuzhou. Advancing west along the Xi River from Qingyuan in Guangdong, the Japanese then pushed toward Pingnan and Guiping, threatening Liuzhou’s right flank.

fields.name: 日军登陆闽江口 Japanese Landing at the Min River Estuary (1944)

fields.summary: 日军在闽江口登陆，第二次福州战役开始。 Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary, opening the second battle for Fuzhou.
fields.description: 1944 年 9 月 27 日，日军第 62 独立混成旅团在闽江口晓沃、道沃、浦口、东岱等地登陆，28 日占领连江，随后向福州推进。日期据《福州史志》，待页码级核对。 On 27 September 1944 the Japanese 62nd Independent Mixed Brigade landed at Xiaowo, Daowo, Pukou and Dongdai around the Min River estuary, occupied Lianjiang on 28 September and advanced on Fuzhou. The date follows Fuzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 30 September 1944 the Japanese captured Xing’an.

fields.name: 兴安沦陷 Fall of Xing’an
fields.summary: 1944年9月30日，日军攻陷兴安。 On 30 September 1944 the Japanese captured Xing’an.
fields.description: 1944年9月30日日军攻陷兴安。中国第93军、第79军在兴安一线抵抗后撤退；另有记10月1日失守，正文并列。兴安失守后，日军直趋灵川、桂林。日期据《桂柳会战惨败内幕》与《桂柳会战》。 On 30 September 1944 the Japanese took Xing’an after the Chinese 93rd and 79th Corps resisted and withdrew. Another account gives 1 October; that variant is noted. The Japanese then drove on Lingchuan and Guilin.

fields.name: 福州沦陷（第二次） Second Fall of Fuzhou
fields.summary: 日军攻占福州，福州第二次沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Fuzhou for the second time.
fields.description: 1944 年 10 月 1 日，日军自连江分两路进攻福州；10 月 4 日，日军从大北岭和马尾两路攻入福州，福州第二次沦陷。日期据《福州史志》，待页码级核对。 On 1 October 1944 Japanese forces advanced on Fuzhou from Lianjiang in two columns. On 4 October they entered the city from Dabeiling and Mawei, and Fuzhou fell for the second time. The date follows Fuzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 桂平沦陷 Fall of Guiping
fields.summary: 1944年10月11日，日军攻占桂平。 On 11 October 1944 the Japanese captured Guiping.
fields.description: 1944年10月11日日军攻占桂平。中国第64军于10月21日反攻桂平、蒙圩，激战8昼夜，终因日军主力逼近武宣而退守。日期据维基百科《桂柳会战》与《桂柳会战》。 On 11 October 1944 the Japanese took Guiping. The Chinese 64th Corps counterattacked Guiping and Mengxu on 21 October, fighting for eight days before withdrawing as the Japanese main force closed on Wuxuan.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1944年11月5日，日军入侵象县县城，全县450余人被杀。
summary.en: On 5 November 1944 the Japanese entered the Xiang County town; more than 450 residents were killed during the occupation.

fields.name: 象县沦陷 Fall of Xiang County
fields.place: 广西象县（今象州） Xiang County (modern Xiangzhou), Guangxi
fields.summary: 1944年11月5日，日军入侵象县县城，全县450余人被杀。 On 5 November 1944 the Japanese entered the Xiang County town; more than 450 residents were killed during the occupation.
fields.description: 1944年11月5日，日军入侵象县县城。日军所到之处奸淫烧杀，全县计有450余人被杀害。县长事先挟枪款撤离县城，县政府群龙无首。同月下旬，象县参议会推举刘传忠代理县长。中共象县支部在石朋、交址、中平先后开会，部署打入县府、争取国民党军两个营又一个排、派员进入县自卫队、组织“曦社”“读书会”“圣塘山抗敌工作队”等抗日团体，并出版《抗日论坛》。象县沦陷期间各类抗日武装与日军大小作战30余次，毙伤日军400余人，1945年6月19日日军退出县境。日期取广西地情网；来宾地情网《日军入侵来宾始末》记11月6日象县县城沦陷，异说并存。 On 5 November 1944 the Japanese entered the Xiang County town; they killed, raped and burned, and more than 450 residents were killed during the occupation. The county magistrate had withdrawn with the gun funds, leaving the government leaderless; in late November the county assembly named Liu Chuanzhong acting magistrate. The CCP Xiang County branch met at Shipeng, Jiaozhi and Zhongping and arranged to work inside the county government, to win over two battalions and a platoon of Nationalist troops, to place members in the county self-defence corps, and to organise the "Xishe", reading circles and the Shengtangshan resistance work team, publishing the newspaper Kangri Luntan. During the occupation local forces fought more than thirty actions against the Japanese, killing and wounding over 400, and the Japanese withdrew from the county on 19 June 1945. The date follows the Guangxi local-history network; the Laibin local-history network records the town's fall on 6 November.

name.zh: 八路军南下支队挺进湘粤
name.en: The Southward Column Marches toward Hunan and Guangdong

summary.zh: 第359旅主力组成南下支队，从延安出发南征湘粤，进抵广东南雄后奉命北返鄂豫边。
summary.en: The main force of the 359th Brigade formed the Southward Column, marched from Yan’an toward Hunan and Guangdong, and after reaching Nanxiong, Guangdong, was ordered back to the Hubei–Henan border.

fields.name: 八路军南下支队挺进湘粤 The Southward Column Marches toward Hunan and Guangdong 359旅南下 359th Brigade Southward March 国民革命军第十八集团军独立第一游击支队 18th Group Army Independent 1st Guerrilla Detachment
fields.summary: 第359旅主力组成南下支队，从延安出发南征湘粤，进抵广东南雄后奉命北返鄂豫边。 The main force of the 359th Brigade formed the Southward Column, marched from Yan’an toward Hunan and Guangdong, and after reaching Nanxiong, Guangdong, was ordered back to the Hubei–Henan border.
fields.description: 1944 年 11 月 9 日，八路军第359旅主力等 4000 余人组成南下支队（国民革命军第十八集团军独立第一游击支队），在司令员王震、政治委员王首道率领下从延安出发，经晋绥、太岳、豫西，1945 年 1 月 27 日在湖北大悟山与新四军第五师会师；2 月渡长江，3 月进入湘鄂赣边，7 月主力继续南下，8 月 26 日进抵广东南雄西北百顺地区，拟与东江纵队会合。因国民党军重兵堵截，会师未成；日本投降后奉命北返，10 月上旬回到鄂豫边大悟山，随后恢复第359旅番号、编入中原军区。这是八路军在抗战后期的一次远程战略行动。 行军路线与日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 9 November 1944 the main force of the 359th Brigade, over 4,000 strong, formed the Southward Column (officially the 18th Group Army Independent 1st Guerrilla Detachment) under commander Wang Zhen and political commissar Wang Shoudao and set out from Yan’an. Passing through the Jin-Sui, Taiyue and western Henan areas, it joined the New Fourth Army’s 5th Division at Dawushan, Hubei, on 27 January 1945, crossed the Yangtze in February, entered the Hunan–Hubei–Jiangxi border in March, and reached the Baishun area northwest of Nanxiong, Guangdong, on 26 August 1945, intending to link up with the Dongjiang Column. Blocked by strong KMT forces, the link-up failed; after Japan’s surrender the column was ordered north and returned to Dawushan in early October, then resumed the 359th Brigade designation and joined the Central Plains Military District. It was a long-range strategic operation of the late war. Route and dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 柳城沦陷 Fall of Liucheng
fields.summary: 1944年11月9日，日军第13师团出中渡攻陷柳城，威胁柳州左侧背。 On 9 November 1944 the Japanese 13th Division came through Zhongdu and took Liucheng, threatening Liuzhou from the north.
fields.description: 1944年11月，日军第13师团突破桂柳间永福阵地后，以一部出中渡趋柳城，威胁柳州左侧背。11月7日日军侵入柳城县境；11月9日柳城被日军攻陷。随后日军以有力一部约3000人由柳城附近向西突进，第20军将其拒止于宜山以北地区。柳城自11月7日沦陷至1945年7月6日，全县16个乡镇、159个村街中有10个乡镇、90个村街遭日军烧杀掳掠。县城沦陷日期取《桂柳会战》战史与台湾荣民文化网战史；柳城县史志办以11月7日为沦陷期起点（日军侵入县境），两说所指不同，并存。 In November 1944, after breaking the Yongfu position between Guilin and Liuzhou, the Japanese 13th Division sent a force through Zhongdu toward Liucheng, threatening Liuzhou from the north. Japanese troops entered Liucheng county on 7 November and the town fell on 9 November. A Japanese force of some 3,000 men then pushed west from the Liucheng area, and the Chinese 20th Army stopped it north of Yishan. Liucheng remained occupied from 7 November 1944 to 6 July 1945, and ten of its sixteen townships and ninety of its 159 villages were looted and burned. The date of the town's fall follows the campaign history Gui-Liu Huizhan and the Taiwan Veterans Affairs Council's account; the Liucheng county history office dates the start of the occupation from 7 November, when Japanese troops entered the county. The two statements refer to different events.

summary.zh: 1944年11月11日，日军第22师团攻陷迁江县城，此后在迁江设师团指挥所。

fields.name: 迁江沦陷 Fall of Qianjiang
fields.place: 广西迁江（今来宾兴宾） Qianjiang (modern Xingbin, Laibin), Guangxi
fields.summary: 1944年11月11日，日军第22师团攻陷迁江县城，此后在迁江设师团指挥所。 On 11 November 1944 the Japanese 22nd Division took Qianjiang, where it later established a divisional command post.
fields.description: 1944年11月7日，日军第22师团在贵县突破中国军队第64军防线，向迁江、忻城、宜山推进。11月11日迁江县城沦陷（另有记11月12日）。日军随后在迁江县河里乡大贤村设1个师团约2万人的指挥所，并在来宾、迁江两县交通要道和战略要地布防，搜罗汉奸组织“维持会”。11月14日，日军第22师团由迁江渡河，与第104师团分由南、北向第4战区第62、第64军攻击。迁江沦陷期间，两县平民被杀5180人。1945年6月12日迁江县境收复。日期取来宾地情网；中共兴宾区委党史办记11月12日，异说并存。 On 7 November 1944 the Japanese 22nd Division broke the Chinese 64th Army's line at Gui County and advanced on Qianjiang, Xincheng and Yishan. Qianjiang fell on 11 November (some accounts give 12 November). The Japanese then set up a divisional command post for some 20,000 men at Daxian village in Heli township, garrisoned the roads and key points of Laibin and Qianjiang counties, and organised collaborationist "maintenance associations". On 14 November the 22nd Division crossed the river at Qianjiang and, with the 104th Division, attacked the Chinese 62nd and 64th armies from south and north. During the occupation 5,180 civilians in the two counties were killed. Qianjiang county was recovered on 12 June 1945. The date follows the Laibin local-history network; the Xingbin district party-history office gives 12 November.

summary.zh: 1944年11月15日，日军攻陷宜山。
summary.en: On 15 November 1944 the Japanese captured Yishan.

fields.name: 宜山沦陷 Fall of Yishan
fields.summary: 1944年11月15日，日军攻陷宜山。 On 15 November 1944 the Japanese captured Yishan.
fields.description: 1944年11月15日日军攻陷宜山。柳州失守后日军沿黔桂铁路西进，中国第46军等部在宜山一线阻击未果。日期据《桂柳会战惨败内幕》与《中华民族抗战编年（1944年11月）》。 On 15 November 1944 the Japanese took Yishan. After Liuzhou fell the Japanese advanced west along the Guizhou–Guangxi railway; the Chinese 46th Corps and others failed to hold the Yishan line.

fields.summary: 1944年11月17日，日军第104师团攻占忻城。 On 17 November 1944 the Japanese 104th Division captured Xincheng.
fields.description: 1944年11月17日日军第104师团攻占忻城。日军由柳州西进，经忻城向宜山、河池方向追击。日期据《广西地方志·第二次侵桂日军番号及经由路》与维基百科《桂柳会战》。 On 17 November 1944 the Japanese 104th Division took Xincheng. Advancing west from Liuzhou, the Japanese pursued through Xincheng toward Yishan and Hechi.

fields.name: 宾阳沦陷（1944） Fall of Binyang (1944)
fields.summary: 1944年11月21日，日军独立混成第23旅团攻占宾阳。 On 21 November 1944 the Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade captured Binyang.
fields.description: 1944年11月21日日军独立混成第23旅团攻占宾阳。日军第22师团由柳州南下，经上林、昆仑关进攻南宁，宾阳为南宁东北门户。日期据《广西地方志·第二次侵桂日军番号及经由路》与维基百科《桂柳会战》。 On 21 November 1944 the Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade took Binyang. The 22nd Division advanced south from Liuzhou through Shanglin and Kunlun Pass toward Nanning; Binyang was Nanning’s northeastern gateway.

summary.zh: 1944年11月22日，日军攻占河池县城。
summary.en: On 22 November 1944 the Japanese captured Hechi.

fields.name: 河池沦陷 Fall of Hechi
fields.summary: 1944年11月22日，日军攻占河池县城。 On 22 November 1944 the Japanese captured Hechi.
fields.description: 1944年11月22日日军攻占河池县城。日军第13师团由宜山西进，经怀远、金城江进占河池；河池全境至25日沦陷。另有记11月20日、27日，正文并列。日期据河池县抗战资料与《中华民族抗战编年（1944年11月）》。 On 22 November 1944 the Japanese took Hechi. The 13th Division advanced west from Yishan through Huaiyuan and Jinchengjiang; the whole county fell by the 25th. Other accounts give 20 or 27 November; those variants are noted.

summary.en: On 23 November 1944 the Japanese 22nd Division captured Wuming.

fields.name: 武鸣沦陷（1944） Fall of Wuming (1944)
fields.summary: 1944年11月23日，日军第22师团攻占武鸣。 On 23 November 1944 the Japanese 22nd Division captured Wuming.
fields.description: 1944年11月23日日军第22师团攻占武鸣。日军由宾阳西进，24日攻占南宁。日期据《广西地方志·第二次侵桂日军番号及经由路》与维基百科《桂柳会战》。 On 23 November 1944 the Japanese 22nd Division took Wuming, then advanced from Binyang and captured Nanning on the 24th.

summary.zh: 日军在豫湘桂战役中占领南宁，打通大陆交通线的企图一度得逞。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Nanning during Operation Ichi-Go, temporarily achieving their aim of opening a continental transport route.

fields.name: 南宁失守 Fall of Nanning
fields.summary: 日军在豫湘桂战役中占领南宁，打通大陆交通线的企图一度得逞。 Japanese forces captured Nanning during Operation Ichi-Go, temporarily achieving their aim of opening a continental transport route.
fields.description: 1944 年 11 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中继续南犯，11 月 24 日占领南宁。日军企图打通从华北到印度支那的大陆交通线，但战线过长、兵力分散，难以长期巩固。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 In November 1944, Japanese forces continued south during Operation Ichi-Go and captured Nanning on 24 November. Japan sought to open a continental transport route from North China to Indochina, but overextended lines and dispersed forces made it difficult to hold. This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1944年11月25日，日军第3师团第34联队进攻黎明关，贵州境内抗日第一枪打响。
summary.en: On 25 November 1944 the Japanese 34th Regiment attacked Liming Pass, opening the fighting in Guizhou.

fields.name: 黎明关战斗 Battle of Liming Pass
fields.place: 贵州荔波黎明关 Liming Pass, Libo, Guizhou
fields.summary: 1944年11月25日，日军第3师团第34联队进攻黎明关，贵州境内抗日第一枪打响。 On 25 November 1944 the Japanese 34th Regiment attacked Liming Pass, opening the fighting in Guizhou.
fields.description: 1944年11月25日，日军第3师团第34联队2000余人由广西思恩进攻荔波黎明关，中国第97军第196师第587团团长周国仲率部阻击，激战三天两夜，打响贵州境内抗日第一枪。日军久攻不下，从小路迂回，27日黎明关失守。日期据贵州政协《抗战时期荔波的贡献与牺牲》与《黔山抗战烽火》。 On 25 November 1944 more than 2,000 men of the Japanese 3rd Division’s 34th Regiment attacked Liming Pass from Sien in Guangxi. Colonel Zhou Guozhong’s 587th Regiment of the Chinese 97th Corps’ 196th Division held for three days and nights, opening the fighting in Guizhou. Unable to take the pass frontally, the Japanese turned its flank and occupied it on the 27th.

summary.en: On 28 November 1944 the Japanese captured Nandan.

fields.name: 南丹沦陷 Fall of Nandan
fields.summary: 1944年11月28日，日军攻陷南丹。 On 28 November 1944 the Japanese captured Nandan.
fields.description: 1944年11月28日日军攻陷南丹。日军第13师团由河池西进，突破南丹、黎明关，进入贵州，12月2日攻占独山，12月4日撤回广西。日期据《中华民族抗战编年（1944年11月）》与维基百科《桂柳会战》。 On 28 November 1944 the Japanese took Nandan. The 13th Division advanced west from Hechi, broke through Nandan and Liming Pass into Guizhou, took Dushan on 2 December and withdrew into Guangxi on the 4th.

fields.name: 凭祥沦陷（1944） Fall of Pingxiang (1944)
fields.summary: 1944年11月28日，日军由越南突入中国，攻占凭祥。 On 28 November 1944 Japanese forces entered China from Vietnam and captured Pingxiang.
fields.description: 1944年11月28日日军由越南突入中国，攻占凭祥。日军南方军第21军一部由越南进攻广西，与第23军会合于绥渌。日期据维基百科《桂柳会战》与《中华民族抗战编年（1944年11月）》。 On 28 November 1944 Japanese forces crossed from Vietnam into China and took Pingxiang. Part of the Southern Army’s 21st Army advanced into Guangxi and joined the 23rd Army at Suilu.

summary.en: On 30 November 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment captured Sandu.

fields.name: 三都沦陷 Fall of Sandu
fields.summary: 1944年11月30日，日军第3师团第6联队攻占三都县城。 On 30 November 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment captured Sandu.
fields.description: 1944年11月30日下午，日军第3师团第6联队先头部队攻占三都县城，拆毁民房搭浮桥，焚烧上街和老十字一带。12月1日日军由三都取道丹寨北犯都匀，临走时纵火焚城。日期据《日军侵华暴行——贵州篇》与《日军入侵黔南》。 On the afternoon of 30 November 1944 the advance guard of the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment took Sandu, tearing down houses for a pontoon bridge and burning the upper street and Old Cross area. On 1 December the Japanese left Sandu for Danzhai and Duyun, setting the town on fire as they departed.

fields.name: 第74军调防湘西 74th Army Moves to Western Hunan
fields.summary: 第74军调防湘西，编入第4方面军，参加湘西会战。 The 74th Army moved to western Hunan, joined the 4th Front Army, and fought in the Western Hunan campaign.
fields.description: 1944 年底，第74军调防湘西，隶属王耀武第4方面军，担任芷江、雪峰山方向作战任务。1945 年 4 月湘西会战爆发，第74军等部依托雪峰山阵地抗击日军。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In late 1944 the 74th Army moved to western Hunan under Wang Yaowu’s 4th Front Army, tasked with the Zhijiang and Xuefeng Mountains sector. When the Western Hunan campaign began in April 1945, the 74th Army and other units resisted the Japanese from positions in the Xuefeng Mountains. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军攻占贵州独山，黔南事变达到顶点。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Dushan in Guizhou, the high point of the Qiannan Incident.

fields.name: 独山沦陷 Fall of Dushan
fields.summary: 日军攻占贵州独山，黔南事变达到顶点。 Japanese forces captured Dushan in Guizhou, the high point of the Qiannan Incident.
fields.description: 1944 年 12 月 2 日，日军第 13 师团一部攻占贵州独山，震动重庆。12 月 4 日日军开始撤退，12 月 8 日独山光复。日期据《黔南事变》史料，待页码级核对。 On 2 December 1944 a detachment of the Japanese 13th Division captured Dushan in Guizhou, shocking Chongqing. The Japanese began withdrawing on 4 December and Dushan was recovered on 8 December. The date follows Qiannan Incident histories and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1944年12月2日，日军攻占龙州。
summary.en: On 2 December 1944 the Japanese captured Longzhou.

fields.name: 龙州沦陷（1944） Fall of Longzhou (1944)
fields.summary: 1944年12月2日，日军攻占龙州。 On 2 December 1944 the Japanese captured Longzhou.
fields.description: 1944年12月2日日军攻占龙州。日军第22师团沿桂越公路南下，连陷凭祥、龙州，12月10日与从越南突入的日军在绥渌会合，大陆交通线打通。日期据维基百科《桂柳会战》与《中华民族抗战编年（1944年11月）》。 On 2 December 1944 the Japanese took Longzhou. The 22nd Division advanced south along the Guangxi–Vietnam highway through Pingxiang to Longzhou and joined the force from Vietnam at Suilu on 10 December, completing the overland route.

summary.zh: 1944年12月2日，日军第3师团第6联队攻占丹寨（八寨）县城。
summary.en: On 2 December 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment captured Danzhai (Bazhai).

fields.name: 丹寨沦陷 Fall of Danzhai
fields.summary: 1944年12月2日，日军第3师团第6联队攻占丹寨（八寨）县城。 On 2 December 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment captured Danzhai (Bazhai).
fields.description: 1944年12月2日，日军第3师团第6联队第三大队步骑兵约千余人经三都攻占丹寨（八寨）县城，3日上午放火焚烧丹寨后继续向都匀方向进犯。日期据《日军侵华暴行——贵州篇》与《黔山抗战烽火》。 On 2 December 1944 about 1,000 infantry and cavalry of the 3rd Battalion, 6th Regiment, 3rd Division took Danzhai (Bazhai) via Sandu. On the morning of the 3rd they burned the town and pushed on toward Duyun.

summary.en: On 3 December 1944 the Japanese entered Libo.

fields.name: 荔波沦陷 Fall of Libo
fields.summary: 1944年12月3日，日军攻入荔波县城。 On 3 December 1944 the Japanese entered Libo.
fields.description: 1944年12月3日，日军第3师团第34联队攻入荔波县城，4日拂晓撤离。日军在荔波境内屠杀群众近2000人、打伤3000多人。日期据贵州政协《抗战时期荔波的贡献与牺牲》与《日军侵华暴行——贵州篇》。 On 3 December 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 34th Regiment entered Libo and withdrew at dawn on the 4th. In Libo the Japanese killed nearly 2,000 civilians and wounded more than 3,000.

summary.zh: 1944年12月3日，日军前卫进抵都匀以东7公里的牛场，为黔南事变日军最远点。
summary.en: On 3 December 1944 the Japanese advance guard reached Niuchang, 7 km east of Duyun, the deepest point of the Qiannan incident.

fields.name: 日军进抵都匀牛场 Japanese Reach Niuchang near Duyun
fields.summary: 1944年12月3日，日军前卫进抵都匀以东7公里的牛场，为黔南事变日军最远点。 On 3 December 1944 the Japanese advance guard reached Niuchang, 7 km east of Duyun, the deepest point of the Qiannan incident.
fields.description: 1944年12月3日13时，日军第3师团第6联队前卫进至都匀以东13公里的龙坪，13时50分接到就地停止、立即反转的命令，此时其前卫已进至都匀东牛场西面，距都匀县城仅7公里。这是黔南事变日军最远点。日期据《黔山抗战烽火》与《日军入侵黔南》。 At 1 p.m. on 3 December 1944 the advance guard of the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment reached Longping, 13 km east of Duyun. At 1:50 p.m. it received orders to halt and turn back; by then it had reached Niuchang west of the town, only 7 km from Duyun. This was the deepest Japanese penetration of the Qiannan incident.

summary.zh: 日军占领粤北重镇韶关，打通粤汉铁路南段。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Shaoguan, the key northern Guangdong city, opening the southern section of the Canton–Hankou railway.

fields.name: 韶关沦陷 Fall of Shaoguan
fields.place: 广东韶关（曲江） Shaoguan (Qujiang), Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军占领粤北重镇韶关，打通粤汉铁路南段。 Japanese forces captured Shaoguan, the key northern Guangdong city, opening the southern section of the Canton–Hankou railway.
fields.description: 1945 年 1 月，日军第 6 方面军为打通粤汉铁路南段并破坏赣南空军基地，向粤北、赣南发动进攻。1 月 28 日，日军占领粤北重镇曲江（韶关），随后沿粤汉铁路南北展开。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In January 1945 the Japanese 6th Area Army attacked northern Guangdong and southern Jiangxi to open the southern section of the Canton–Hankou railway and destroy air bases in southern Jiangxi. On 28 January it captured Qujiang (Shaoguan), the key city of northern Guangdong, and then expanded along the railway. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Japanese 27th Division captured the Suichuan airfield and advanced south toward Ganzhou.

fields.summary: 日军第 27 师团攻占遂川机场，随后南下进攻赣州。 The Japanese 27th Division captured the Suichuan airfield and advanced south toward Ganzhou.
fields.description: 1945 年 1 月，日军第 27 师团自湘东茶陵、攸县南下，进攻遂川。1 月 31 日，日军攻占遂川机场，随后占领遂川县城，并沿公路南犯赣州。日期有 1 月 30 日、31 日诸说，待页码级核对。 In January 1945 the Japanese 27th Division advanced south from Chaling and Youxian in eastern Hunan toward Suichuan. On 31 January it captured the Suichuan airfield, then the county town, and advanced south along the road toward Ganzhou. Accounts differ between 30 and 31 January and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军自粤北北犯，占领南雄。 Japanese forces advanced north from northern Guangdong and occupied Nanxiong.
fields.description: 1945 年 2 月 1 日，日军占领始兴；2 月 3 日占领南雄。南路日军随后经南雄进入江西，进攻大余、新城，配合北路日军会攻赣州。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 1 February 1945 Japanese forces occupied Shixing and on 3 February Nanxiong. The southern column then entered Jiangxi through Nanxiong, attacked Dayu and Xincheng, and converged with the northern column on Ganzhou. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 赣州沦陷 Fall of Ganzhou
fields.summary: 日军第 27 师团进占赣州，赣南沦陷。 The Japanese 27th Division entered Ganzhou, and southern Jiangxi fell.
fields.description: 1945 年 2 月 5 日，日军第 27 师团进占赣州城，随后占领全城并继续南侵，占领南康、大余、新城等地。赣州于 7 月 12 日被中国军队收复。日期有 2 月 5 日进占、2 月 6 日全城诸说，待页码级核对。 On 5 February 1945 the Japanese 27th Division entered Ganzhou and then occupied the whole city, continuing south to take Nankang, Dayu and Xincheng. Ganzhou was recovered by Chinese forces on 12 July. Accounts differ between entry on 5 February and full occupation on 6 February and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 南康沦陷 Fall of Nankang
fields.summary: 1945年2月6日，南康沦陷。 On 6 February 1945 Nankang fell.
fields.description: 1945年2月，日军为打通赣南、摧毁遂川和赣州机场，向赣州、南康、大余推进。2月5日赣州、大余沦陷，2月6日南康沦陷。南康是赣州西南门户。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与《江西抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 In February 1945 Japanese forces advanced on Ganzhou, Nankang and Dayu to open the way through southern Jiangxi and destroy the Suichuan and Ganzhou airfields. Ganzhou and Dayu fell on 5 February and Nankang on 6 February. Nankang was the southwestern gateway to Ganzhou. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the Jiangxi war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1945 年春，第18军调防湘西沅陵、辰溪集结，作为第4方面军的机动兵团。4 月湘西会战爆发后，第18军随时准备增援雪峰山方向。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In spring 1945 the 18th Army assembled at Yuanling and Chenxi in western Hunan as the 4th Front Army’s mobile corps. When the Western Hunan campaign began in April, it stood ready to reinforce the Xuefeng Mountains sector. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 曼德勒收复 Recapture of Mandalay
fields.summary: 盟军与中国驻印军收复曼德勒，缅北反攻取得重要进展。 Allied and Chinese forces recaptured Mandalay, a major advance in the northern Burma counteroffensive.
fields.description: 1945 年 3 月，盟军与中国驻印军在缅北反攻中推进至曼德勒地区，并于 3 月 20 日收复曼德勒。此后盟军继续南下，缅甸战局趋于明朗。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与作战归属表述待史料校订。 In March 1945, Allied and Chinese forces in the northern Burma counteroffensive reached the Mandalay area and recaptured the city on 20 March. Allied forces continued southward, and the situation in Burma became increasingly clear. This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and unit attributions await historical review.

summary.en: On 30 March 1945 the Japanese captured Xixiakou.

fields.name: 西峡口沦陷 Fall of Xixiakou
fields.summary: 1945年3月30日，日军攻占西峡口。 On 30 March 1945 the Japanese captured Xixiakou.
fields.description: 1945年3月30日拂晓，日军第110师团、战车第3师团等部向西峡口进犯，西峡口当日沦陷。中国守军退守重阳店，至4月7日击退日军进攻，歼敌四千余人。日期据《豫西鄂北会战》与光明网《西峡口之战》。 At dawn on 30 March 1945 the Japanese 110th Division and 3rd Tank Division attacked Xixiakou, which fell the same day. The Chinese defenders withdrew to Chongyangdian and by 7 April had beaten off the Japanese attack, killing more than 4,000. Both cited accounts give 30 March.

fields.name: 樊城沦陷 Fall of Fancheng
fields.summary: 1945年3月30日，日军攻占樊城。 On 30 March 1945 the Japanese captured Fancheng.

The Japanese then moved west against Gucheng in support of the Laohekou operation. Wikipedia gives 26 March for Xiangyang–Fancheng; that variant is noted.

fields.name: 南阳沦陷 Fall of Nanyang
fields.summary: 1945年4月1日，日军攻占南阳。 On 1 April 1945 the Japanese captured Nanyang.
fields.description: 1945年3月22日，日军发动豫西鄂北战役，开始进袭南阳。4月1日南阳失守。日军第110师团、战车第3师团等部随后西进，攻击西峡口、淅川。日期据《河南的抗战历程》《豫西鄂北会战》与《抗战最伟大的省——河南》。 On 22 March 1945 the Japanese launched the Western Henan–Northern Hubei campaign and attacked Nanyang, which fell on 1 April. The Japanese 110th Division and 3rd Tank Division then drove west against Xixiakou and Xichuan. The cited accounts agree on 1 April.

fields.summary: 1945年4月1日，日军攻占淅川（老城）。 On 1 April 1945 the Japanese captured Xichuan (Laocheng).
fields.description: 1945年3月30日西峡口失守后，日军第110师团继续西进，4月1日陷淅川（今老城镇），即向重阳店方向攻击。另有记载称淅川在1945年2月沦陷，为河南最后沦陷的县城，日期待考，正文并列。日期取《豫西鄂北会战》。 After Xixiakou fell on 30 March 1945 the Japanese 110th Division drove west and took Xichuan (modern Laocheng) on 1 April, then attacked toward Chongyangdian. Another account places the fall in February 1945 and calls Xichuan the last Henan county to fall; that variant remains unresolved and is noted here. The date follows the Western Henan–Northern Hubei campaign history.

fields.name: 谷城沦陷 Fall of Gucheng
fields.summary: 1945年4月7日，日军攻占谷城，占领5天后撤退。 On 7 April 1945 the Japanese captured Gucheng and withdrew five days later.
fields.description: 1945年4月7日，日军第39师团一部攻占谷城，至12日撤退，占领谷城5天。谷城为襄河以西要地，日军占谷城旨在策应老河口作战。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与襄阳日报《日军在襄阳地区的主要罪行》。 On 7 April 1945 a detachment of the Japanese 39th Division took Gucheng and withdrew on the 12th, occupying the town for five days. Gucheng was a key point west of the Han River, and the operation was intended to support the attack on Laohekou.

fields.name: 老河口沦陷 Fall of Laohekou
fields.summary: 豫西鄂北会战中日军攻占老河口机场。 Japanese forces captured the Laohekou airfield during the Western Henan–Northern Hubei campaign.

summary.zh: 日军进攻湘西芷江机场，中国军队反击，取得湘西会战胜利。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Zhijiang airfield in western Hunan; Chinese troops counterattacked and won the Battle of West Hunan.

fields.name: 湘西会战 Battle of West Hunan 雪峰山会战 Battle of Xuefeng Mountains
fields.summary: 日军进攻湘西芷江机场，中国军队反击，取得湘西会战胜利。 Japanese forces attacked the Zhijiang airfield in western Hunan; Chinese troops counterattacked and won the Battle of West Hunan.
fields.description: 1945 年 4 月，日军发动湘西会战，企图破坏芷江空军基地。中国军队依托雪峰山地形顽强抵抗并反击，至 6 月收复失地，日军伤亡惨重。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要胜利，也是日本投降前中国军队的最后一次大规模攻势防御作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In April 1945, Japanese forces launched the Battle of West Hunan in an attempt to destroy the Zhijiang air base. Chinese troops used the terrain of the Xuefeng Mountains to resist stubbornly and counterattack, recovering the lost ground by June and inflicting heavy casualties on the Japanese. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the final year of the war and one of the Chinese army’s last large-scale defensive-offensive operations before Japan’s surrender. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

name.en: Japanese advance from Shaoyang into western Hunan

summary.en: The Japanese moved from Shaoyang and Dong’an against the Zhijiang airfield.

fields.name: 日军自邵阳进攻湘西 Japanese advance from Shaoyang into western Hunan
fields.summary: 日军自邵阳、东安出动，进攻芷江机场。 The Japanese moved from Shaoyang and Dong’an against the Zhijiang airfield.
fields.description: 1945 年 4 月 9 日日军第 20 军自邵阳、东安出动，进攻芷江机场，湘西会战爆发；中国军队在雪峰山一线阻击并反攻，6 月日军退回原防。邵阳自 1944 年 9 月即为日军占领。 On 9 April 1945 the Japanese 20th Army moved from Shaoyang and Dong’an against the Zhijiang airfield, opening the western Hunan battle; the Chinese army held and counter-attacked along the Xuefeng mountains, and the Japanese withdrew in June. Shaoyang had been occupied since September 1944.

summary.en: On 16 April 1945 the Japanese 34th Division and 58th Brigade of the 68th Division captured Xinning.

fields.name: 新宁沦陷 Fall of Xinning
fields.summary: 1945年4月16日，日军第34师团、第68师团第58旅团攻占新宁。 On 16 April 1945 the Japanese 34th Division and 58th Brigade of the 68th Division captured Xinning.
fields.description: 1945年4月上旬，日军第34师团及第68师团第58旅团分由东安、全县向新宁进犯，4月12日进攻新宁，中国第74军第58师一个营坚守3日，15日日军增援，16日新宁失守。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。 In early April 1945 the Japanese 34th Division and the 58th Brigade of the 68th Division advanced on Xinning from Dong’an and Quanxian. They attacked on 12 April; a battalion of the Chinese 58th Division held for three days, but after Japanese reinforcements arrived Xinning fell on the 16th.

summary.zh: 1945年4月21日，日军第116师团攻占洞口。
summary.en: On 21 April 1945 the Japanese 116th Division captured Dongkou.

fields.name: 洞口沦陷 Fall of Dongkou
fields.summary: 1945年4月21日，日军第116师团攻占洞口。 On 21 April 1945 the Japanese 116th Division captured Dongkou.
fields.description: 1945年4月21日，日军第116师团第133联队猛攻洞口，中国守军第74军第57师一部抵抗后撤退，洞口失守。洞口为湘黔公路要隘，失守后日军直逼雪峰山主阵地。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。 On 21 April 1945 the 133rd Regiment of the Japanese 116th Division stormed Dongkou; part of the Chinese 57th Division of the 74th Corps resisted and withdrew, and the town fell. Dongkou was a key pass on the Hunan–Guizhou highway, and its loss brought the Japanese to the main Xuefeng Mountain positions.

name.en: Seventh National Congress of the CCP

summary.zh: 1945 年 4 月 23 日至 6 月 11 日，中共七大在延安举行，确立毛泽东思想为党的指导思想。
summary.en: From 23 April to 11 June 1945 the Seventh Congress met at Yan’an and established Mao Zedong Thought as the Party’s guiding ideology.

fields.name: 中共七大 Seventh National Congress of the CCP
fields.summary: 1945 年 4 月 23 日至 6 月 11 日，中共七大在延安举行，确立毛泽东思想为党的指导思想。 From 23 April to 11 June 1945 the Seventh Congress met at Yan’an and established Mao Zedong Thought as the Party’s guiding ideology.
fields.description: 1945 年 4 月 23 日至 6 月 11 日，中国共产党第七次全国代表大会在延安杨家岭中央大礼堂举行。出席正式代表 547 人、候补代表 208 人，代表全党 121 万党员。毛泽东致开幕词《两个中国之命运》，作《论联合政府》政治报告；朱德作《论解放区战场》军事报告，刘少奇作《关于修改党章的报告》，周恩来作《论统一战线》发言。大会制定「放手发动群众，壮大人民力量，在我党的领导下，打败日本侵略者，解放全国人民，建立一个新民主主义的中国」的政治路线，通过新党章，确立毛泽东思想为党的指导思想。七大使全党在思想上、政治上、组织上达到空前团结，为抗战胜利和解放战争胜利奠定基础。本事件为会议，不绘路线。 From 23 April to 11 June 1945 the Seventh National Congress of the CCP met in the Yangjialing central auditorium at Yan’an. There were 547 full delegates and 208 alternate delegates, representing 1.21 million Party members. Mao Zedong delivered the opening address “The Two Chinas” and the political report “On Coalition Government”; Zhu De reported on the liberated areas, Liu Shaoqi on the revision of the Party Constitution, and Zhou Enlai on the united front. The congress set the political line of “boldly mobilising the masses, expanding the people’s forces, defeating the Japanese aggressors under the Party’s leadership, liberating the whole people and building a New Democratic China”, adopted a new Party Constitution, and established Mao Zedong Thought as the guiding ideology. It brought unprecedented ideological, political and organisational unity and laid the foundation for victory in the war and in the later civil war. No route is drawn.

summary.zh: 1945年4月27日，日军第68师团围攻武冈，中国守军坚守至5月7日解围。
summary.en: On 27 April 1945 the Japanese 68th Division besieged Wugang; the Chinese garrison held out until relieved on 7 May.

fields.name: 武冈保卫战 Defence of Wugang
fields.summary: 1945年4月27日，日军第68师团围攻武冈，中国守军坚守至5月7日解围。 On 27 April 1945 the Japanese 68th Division besieged Wugang; the Chinese garrison held out until relieved on 7 May.
fields.description: 1945年4月27日，日军第68师团3000余人围攻武冈，中国第74军第58师一个加强营依托糯米三合土城墙坚守，至5月7日中国第121师、第44师增援，内外夹击，日军撤退，武冈解围。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。 On 27 April 1945 more than 3,000 Japanese of the 68th Division besieged Wugang. A reinforced battalion of the Chinese 58th Division held the walls, built with glutinous-rice mortar, until the Chinese 121st and 44th Divisions arrived on 7 May and attacked from inside and outside; the Japanese withdrew and the siege was lifted.

summary.en: On 29 April 1945 the 58th Brigade of the Japanese 68th Division captured Wuyang.

fields.name: 武阳沦陷 Fall of Wuyang
fields.place: 湖南绥宁武阳 Wuyang, Suining, Hunan
fields.summary: 1945年4月29日，日军第68师团第58旅团攻占武阳。 On 29 April 1945 the 58th Brigade of the Japanese 68th Division captured Wuyang.
fields.description: 1945年4月26日日军第68师团第58旅团进攻武阳，中国第74军第58师第174团9连苦战4昼夜，全连殉国，29日武阳失守。5月1日中国第94军第5师克复武阳，歼敌1500余人。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。 On 26 April 1945 the 58th Brigade of the Japanese 68th Division attacked Wuyang. The 9th Company of the Chinese 174th Regiment, 58th Division, fought for four days and was wiped out; Wuyang fell on the 29th. On 1 May the Chinese 5th Division of the 94th Corps retook Wuyang, killing more than 1,500 Japanese.

fields.summary: 中国军队在广西发起反攻，先后收复桂林、柳州、南宁等地。 Chinese forces counterattacked in Guangxi, recovering Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning.
fields.description: 1945 年 5 月，第4战区部队在桂北发起反攻，先后收复柳州、桂林，将日军逐出广西。此役与湘西会战、滇西反攻同为抗战末期中国军队的局部反攻。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In May 1945 4th War Zone troops launched a counteroffensive in northern Guangxi, recovering Liuzhou and Guilin and driving the Japanese out of the province. Together with the Western Hunan campaign and the western Yunnan counteroffensive, it was one of the limited Chinese counteroffensives at the end of the war. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.summary: 新6军自云南空运芷江，担任湘西会战总预备队。 The New 6th Army was airlifted from Yunnan to Zhijiang as the general reserve for the Western Hunan campaign.
fields.description: 1945 年 5 月，新6军（廖耀湘部）近三万人自云南昆明空运湖南芷江，担任湘西会战总预备队并担负芷江机场守备。此时战局已趋稳定，新6军未及全面参战。 空运航线为示意直线，非地面行军；日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In May 1945 nearly 30,000 troops of the New 6th Army under Liao Yaoxiang were airlifted from Kunming, Yunnan, to Zhijiang, Hunan, as the general reserve for the Western Hunan campaign and to guard Zhijiang airfield. By then the situation had stabilized and the army did not enter combat in full. Shown as a schematic air bridge, not a ground march; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 中共七届一中全会 First Plenum of the Seventh Central Committee
fields.summary: 1945 年 6 月 19 日，七届一中全会选举毛泽东为中央委员会主席，形成第一代中央领导集体。 On 19 June 1945 the First Plenum elected Mao Zedong chairman of the Central Committee, forming the first-generation leadership.
fields.description: 1945 年 6 月 19 日，中共七届一中全会在延安杨家岭召开。全会选举毛泽东、朱德、刘少奇、周恩来、任弼时、陈云、康生、高岗、彭真、董必武、林伯渠、张闻天、彭德怀为中央政治局委员；选举毛泽东、朱德、刘少奇、周恩来、任弼时为中央书记处书记；选举毛泽东为中央委员会主席。根据七大党章「中央委员会主席即为中央政治局主席与中央书记处主席」的规定，毛泽东兼任中央政治局主席、中央书记处主席。以毛泽东为核心的党的第一代中央领导集体正式形成。本事件为组织选举，不绘路线。 On 19 June 1945 the First Plenum of the Seventh Central Committee met at Yangjialing, Yan’an. It elected Mao Zedong, Zhu De, Liu Shaoqi, Zhou Enlai, Ren Bishi, Chen Yun, Kang Sheng, Gao Gang, Peng Zhen, Dong Biwu, Lin Boqu, Zhang Wentian and Peng Dehuai to the Politburo; Mao, Zhu De, Liu Shaoqi, Zhou Enlai and Ren Bishi to the Secretariat; and Mao Zedong as chairman of the Central Committee. Under the new Party Constitution’s provision that the Central Committee chairman is also chairman of the Politburo and Secretariat, Mao held all three posts. The first generation of central leadership with Mao at its core was formally constituted. No route is drawn.

fields.name: 花冈惨案 Hanaoka Massacre
fields.place: 日本秋田花冈 Hanaoka, Akita, Japan
fields.summary: 1945年6月30日，被掳中国劳工在秋田花冈矿山起义，遭日本军警镇压，约400余人死亡。 On 30 June 1945 Chinese forced labourers rose up at the Hanaoka mine in Akita and were crushed by Japanese police and troops, with over 400 deaths.
fields.description: 1945年6月30日，被掳至日本秋田县花冈矿山的中国劳工900余人因不堪虐待发动起义，遭日本军警镇压。据中日各方调查，419人死亡（另有418人、560人之说）。花冈事件是日本强掳中国劳工罪行的代表性事件。日期据《花冈惨案》与《1945年6月30日花冈惨案发生》。 On 30 June 1945 more than 900 Chinese labourers deported to the Hanaoka mine in Akita, Japan, rose up against their treatment and were suppressed by Japanese military police. Chinese and Japanese investigations put the death toll at 419, with other accounts giving 418 or 560. The Hanaoka uprising is a representative case of Japan’s forced deportation of Chinese labour.

fields.name: 广岛原子弹爆炸 Atomic Bombing of Hiroshima
fields.summary: 美国在广岛投下原子弹，加速了日本投降的进程。 The United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, accelerating Japan’s surrender.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 6 日凌晨，美军 B-29「埃诺拉·盖伊」号从马里亚纳群岛提尼安岛北机场起飞，飞往广岛；8 时 15 分在广岛上空投下原子弹，造成大量人员伤亡。8 月 9 日，美军又在长崎投下原子弹。核打击与苏联出兵东北共同加速了日本投降。本事件线路见 allied-forces 层「提尼安岛—广岛」。 In the early hours of 6 August 1945 a US B-29, the Enola Gay, took off from North Field on Tinian in the Mariana Islands for Hiroshima and dropped an atomic bomb over the city at 08:15, causing massive casualties. On 9 August the United States dropped a second bomb on Nagasaki. The nuclear strikes, together with the Soviet entry into the war in the Northeast, accelerated Japan’s surrender. The route is shown in the allied-forces layer as Tinian–Hiroshima.

summary.zh: 1945 年 8 月 6 日与 9 日，美军 B-29 自提尼安岛北机场起飞，分别空袭广岛、长崎。
summary.en: On 6 and 9 August 1945 US B-29s took off from North Field on Tinian to bomb Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

fields.name: 美军自提尼安岛出击 US atomic mission from Tinian
fields.place: 马里亚纳群岛提尼安岛 Tinian, Mariana Islands
fields.summary: 1945 年 8 月 6 日与 9 日，美军 B-29 自提尼安岛北机场起飞，分别空袭广岛、长崎。 On 6 and 9 August 1945 US B-29s took off from North Field on Tinian to bomb Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 6 日凌晨，美国陆军航空军第 509 混合大队的 B-29 轰炸机「埃诺拉·盖伊」号（Enola Gay）从马里亚纳群岛提尼安岛北机场起飞，飞往日本广岛。8 月 9 日，同大队的 B-29「博克斯卡」号（Bockscar）从同一基地起飞，飞往长崎。两次任务均为单机远程空袭，航程约 2,500 公里。提尼安岛是美军在 1944 年夺取的马里亚纳基地，B-29 由此可直接空袭日本本土。本事件为出击节点，具体航线见 allied-forces 层「提尼安岛—广岛」「提尼安岛—长崎」。 In the early hours of 6 August 1945 a B-29 of the US Army Air Forces’ 509th Composite Group, the Enola Gay, took off from North Field on Tinian in the Mariana Islands for Hiroshima. On 9 August another B-29 of the same group, Bockscar, left the same base for Nagasaki. Both were single-aircraft long-range missions of about 2,500 km. Tinian was a Mariana base seized by US forces in 1944, from which B-29s could strike the Japanese home islands directly. This entry records the departure; the routes are in the allied-forces layer as Tinian–Hiroshima and Tinian–Nagasaki.

summary.en: The Soviet Union declared war on Japan and invaded Northeast China, rapidly collapsing the Kwantung Army.

fields.name: 苏联对日宣战与出兵东北 Soviet Declaration of War on Japan and Invasion of the Northeast
fields.place: 中国东北（哈尔滨方向） Northeast China (Harbin direction)
fields.summary: 苏联对日宣战并出兵中国东北，关东军迅速崩溃。 The Soviet Union declared war on Japan and invaded Northeast China, rapidly collapsing the Kwantung Army.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 8 日（莫斯科时间），苏联对日宣战；8 月 9 日，苏军从东、北、西三个方向进入中国东北和朝鲜北部，进攻日本关东军。关东军在短时间内瓦解，日本投降进程明显加快。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按中国通行的 8 月 9 日标注，地点取东北方向示意点，待史料校订。 The Soviet Union declared war on Japan on 8 August 1945 (Moscow time); on 9 August, Soviet forces entered Northeast China and northern Korea from the east, north, and west, attacking the Japanese Kwantung Army. The Kwantung Army collapsed quickly, significantly accelerating Japan’s surrender. This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows the conventional Chinese usage of 9 August, and the location is an illustrative point in the Northeast pending historical review.

name.en: Mao Zedong Issues “The Last Battle against the Japanese”

summary.zh: 毛泽东发表声明，号召全国规模反攻。
summary.en: Mao Zedong issued a statement calling for a nationwide counter-offensive.

fields.name: 《对日寇的最后一战》发表 Mao Zedong Issues “The Last Battle against the Japanese” 对日寇的最后一战 The Last Battle against the Japanese
fields.summary: 毛泽东发表声明，号召全国规模反攻。 Mao Zedong issued a statement calling for a nationwide counter-offensive.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 9 日，毛泽东在延安发表《对日寇的最后一战》声明，指出对日战争已处在最后阶段，号召中国人民的一切抗日力量举行全国规模的反攻，八路军、新四军及其他人民军队应在一切可能条件下，对不愿投降的侵略者及其走狗实行广泛进攻。 声明文本以《毛泽东选集》第三卷所收版本为准。 On 9 August 1945 Mao Zedong issued the statement “The Last Battle against the Japanese” in Yan’an, declaring that the war against Japan had entered its final stage and calling on all Chinese anti-Japanese forces to launch a nationwide counter-offensive. The Eighth Route Army, New Fourth Army, and other people’s forces were to attack widely wherever the invaders and their collaborators refused to surrender. The text follows the version collected in Selected Works of Mao Zedong, vol. 3.

name.en: The United Army with the Soviet Offensive, August 1945

summary.zh: 1945年8月9日苏军进攻东北，东北抗联教导旅以向导、翻译和伞降小分队配合，战后分赴东北57个战略要点。
summary.en: When the Soviet offensive began on 9 August 1945 the United Army training brigade supplied guides, interpreters and airborne teams, and afterwards took over 57 strategic points in Manchuria.

fields.name: 东北抗联配合苏军反攻东北 The United Army with the Soviet Offensive, August 1945
fields.place: 中国东北（牡丹江方向） Northeast China (Mudanjiang axis)
fields.summary: 1945年8月9日苏军进攻东北，东北抗联教导旅以向导、翻译和伞降小分队配合，战后分赴东北57个战略要点。 When the Soviet offensive began on 9 August 1945 the United Army training brigade supplied guides, interpreters and airborne teams, and afterwards took over 57 strategic points in Manchuria.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 8 日苏联对日宣战，9 日零时苏军三个方面军进攻东北。抗联教导旅此前已抽调 340 余名指战员分到三个方面军担任向导、翻译，另派 20 余支小分队伞降牡丹江、佳木斯、哈尔滨、齐齐哈尔、长春、沈阳等地侦察。8 月 9 日，教导旅召开誓师大会；8 月 11 日，周保中率部由伯力附近营地登舰过江。日本投降后，抗联 400 余人分成 57 个进驻小组，以苏军卫戍副司令身份进入东北各战略要点，恢复党组织、建立人民武装；9 月改编为东北人民自卫军，周保中任总司令。本事件为配合苏军行动的战略节点，不绘路线（苏军进攻轴线见盟军层）。 The Soviet Union declared war on Japan on 8 August 1945 and three fronts attacked Manchuria at midnight on the 9th. The United Army training brigade had already assigned over 340 officers and men as guides and interpreters to the three fronts and sent more than twenty small teams by parachute to reconnoitre Mudanjiang, Jiamusi, Harbin, Qiqihar, Changchun and Shenyang. The brigade held a pledge rally on 9 August, and on the 11th Zhou Baozhong led his men aboard ship and crossed the river from the camp near Khabarovsk. After the Japanese surrender more than 400 men formed 57 entry groups and, as deputy Soviet garrison commanders, took over strategic points across the Northeast, restoring party organisations and raising local forces; in September they were renamed the Northeast People’s Self-Defence Army under Zhou Baozhong. This is a strategic node of the Soviet campaign and no route is drawn; Soviet axes appear in the Allied layer.
fields.entities: 东北抗日联军 Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1945 年 8 月 9 日，美国在长崎投下原子弹，同日苏联对日宣战。
summary.en: On 9 August 1945 the United States dropped an atomic bomb on Nagasaki; the same day the Soviet Union declared war on Japan.

fields.name: 长崎原子弹爆炸 Atomic bombing of Nagasaki
fields.summary: 1945 年 8 月 9 日，美国在长崎投下原子弹，同日苏联对日宣战。 On 9 August 1945 the United States dropped an atomic bomb on Nagasaki; the same day the Soviet Union declared war on Japan.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 9 日，美军 B-29「博克斯卡」号在长崎投下原子弹，造成大量人员伤亡。同日，苏联对日宣战并出兵中国东北。核打击与苏联出兵共同加速了日本投降；8 月 15 日日本宣布无条件投降，9 月 2 日签署投降书。长崎是继广岛之后第二个遭受原子弹轰炸的城市。本事件为国际事件，线路见 allied-forces 层「提尼安岛—长崎」。 On 9 August 1945 the US B-29 Bockscar dropped an atomic bomb on Nagasaki, causing massive casualties. The same day the Soviet Union declared war on Japan and sent troops into Northeast China. The nuclear strike and the Soviet entry together accelerated Japan’s surrender; Japan announced unconditional surrender on 15 August and signed the instrument of surrender on 2 September. Nagasaki was the second city, after Hiroshima, to be struck by an atomic bomb. The route is shown in the allied-forces layer as Tinian–Nagasaki.
fields.entities: 盟军与中国远征军 Allied Forces and Chinese Expeditionary Force

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: The Eighth Route Army Launches the General Counter-Offensive

summary.zh: 朱德连续发布七道反攻命令，八路军向华北日伪军全面进攻。
summary.en: Zhu De issued seven counter-offensive orders; the Eighth Route Army attacked Japanese and puppet forces across North China.

fields.name: 八路军发动大反攻 The Eighth Route Army Launches the General Counter-Offensive 八路军全面反攻 Eighth Route Army General Counter-Offensive
fields.summary: 朱德连续发布七道反攻命令，八路军向华北日伪军全面进攻。 Zhu De issued seven counter-offensive orders; the Eighth Route Army attacked Japanese and puppet forces across North China.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 10 日至 11 日，八路军总司令朱德以延安总部名义连续发布七道反攻命令，要求各解放区抗日武装向附近城镇、交通要道的日伪军送出通牒，限期缴械，对拒绝投降者坚决消灭；同时命令晋绥、晋察冀、山东和冀热辽部队向东北及华北各城市推进。各解放区部队随即展开全面反攻，至 9 月 2 日共解放县以上城市 150 座。 命令序号与时间以中央档案馆藏件为准，战果统计为通行说法。 From 10 to 11 August 1945 Zhu De, commander-in-chief of the Eighth Route Army, issued seven counter-offensive orders in the name of the Yan’an headquarters. Anti-Japanese forces in the liberated areas were to send ultimatums to Japanese and puppet troops in nearby towns and along transport routes, demand surrender within a set time, and destroy those who refused. Forces in the Jin-Sui, Jin-Cha-Ji, Shandong, and Ji-Re-Liao areas were ordered to advance toward cities in North China and the Northeast. The liberated areas then launched a general counter-offensive; by 2 September they had liberated 150 county-level towns and cities. Order numbers and times follow the documents held by the Central Archives; the tally of liberated cities follows conventional accounts.

summary.en: The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.

fields.name: 日本宣布无条件投降 Japan Announces Unconditional Surrender
fields.summary: 日本天皇广播《终战诏书》，宣布接受《波茨坦公告》，中国抗日战争取得胜利。 The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 15 日，日本天皇裕仁通过广播发布《终战诏书》，宣布接受中美英苏四国发表的《波茨坦公告》，实际上宣布无条件投降。中国各地举行庆祝活动，抗日战争取得胜利。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 15 August 1945, Emperor Hirohito broadcast the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War, accepting the Potsdam Declaration issued by China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union—in effect announcing unconditional surrender. Celebrations took place across China, marking victory in the war of resistance. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 田独铁矿劳工死亡万余人，遗骸葬于田独万人坑。
summary.en: More than 10,000 laborers died at the Tiandu iron mine, and their remains were buried in the Tiandu mass grave.

fields.name: 田独万人坑 Tiandu Mass Grave
fields.place: 海南三亚田独 Tiandu, Sanya, Hainan
fields.summary: 田独铁矿劳工死亡万余人，遗骸葬于田独万人坑。 More than 10,000 laborers died at the Tiandu iron mine, and their remains were buried in the Tiandu mass grave.
fields.description: 日军为掠夺田独铁矿，从上海、广州、香港、澳门、汕头、厦门等沦陷区诱骗、强征劳工，并在海南各县强抽民夫。劳工在日军和工头押制下从事高强度劳动，病死、饿死、打死、烧死、活埋者众多。战后调查与《海南铁矿志》记载死亡万余人；1945 年 8 月日军投降时，田独铁矿仅存 1713 人。具体数字待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。 To extract the Tiandu iron ore, Japan deceived and forcibly recruited laborers from Shanghai, Guangzhou, Hong Kong, Macao, Shantou and Xiamen and impressed villagers across Hainan. Under Japanese guards and foremen they performed heavy labor, and many died of disease, starvation, beatings, burning or burial alive. Postwar investigations and the Hainan Iron Mine Gazetteer record more than 10,000 deaths; when Japan surrendered in August 1945 only 1,713 laborers remained at Tiandu. These figures await page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Mao Zedong goes to Chongqing for peace talks

summary.zh: 1945 年 8 月 28 日，毛泽东、周恩来、王若飞由延安飞抵重庆，与国民党进行和平谈判。
summary.en: On 28 August 1945 Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai and Wang Ruofei flew from Yan’an to Chongqing for peace talks with the Kuomintang.

fields.name: 毛泽东赴重庆谈判 Mao Zedong goes to Chongqing for peace talks
fields.summary: 1945 年 8 月 28 日，毛泽东、周恩来、王若飞由延安飞抵重庆，与国民党进行和平谈判。 On 28 August 1945 Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai and Wang Ruofei flew from Yan’an to Chongqing for peace talks with the Kuomintang.
fields.description: 抗战胜利后，蒋介石三次电邀毛泽东赴重庆共商国是。1945 年 8 月 23 日，中共中央政治局扩大会议决定同国民党谈判，派毛泽东、周恩来、王若飞为代表，并决定毛泽东赴渝期间由刘少奇代理中央主席职务。8 月 28 日，毛泽东、周恩来、王若飞在赫尔利、张治中陪同下由延安飞抵重庆，谈判持续 43 天。中共提出和平、民主、团结的方针，在解放区政权和军队问题上作出一定让步，但坚持人民军队和解放区不能交给国民党一党专政的政府。10 月 10 日双方签署《双十协定》。本事件为政治行程，线路见 ccp 层「延安—重庆」。 After Japan’s surrender Chiang Kai-shek three times invited Mao Zedong to Chongqing. On 23 August 1945 an enlarged Politburo meeting decided to negotiate, appointing Mao, Zhou Enlai and Wang Ruofei as representatives and arranging for Liu Shaoqi to act as Central Committee chairman while Mao was away. On 28 August, accompanied by Patrick Hurley and Zhang Zhizhong, Mao, Zhou and Wang flew from Yan’an to Chongqing; the talks lasted 43 days. The CCP stood for peace, democracy and unity, made concessions on the questions of liberated-area government and armed forces, but refused to hand the people’s army and liberated areas to a one-party KMT government. On 10 October the two sides signed the Double Tenth Agreement.

fields.place: 日本东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰 USS Missouri, Tokyo Bay, Japan
fields.summary: 日本代表在东京湾签署投降书，第二次世界大战正式结束。 Japanese representatives signed the instrument of surrender in Tokyo Bay, formally ending the Second World War.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 2 日，日本政府代表在东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰上签署投降书，中、美、英、苏等同盟国代表签字接受。至此，中国抗日战争与第二次世界大战正式结束。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On 2 September 1945, Japanese government representatives signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay, and representatives of the Allied powers, including China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union, accepted it. China’s war of resistance and the Second World War formally ended. This is a political event with no route drawn; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 富阳宋殿洽降 Surrender Talks at Songdian, Fuyang
fields.place: 浙江富阳宋殿 Songdian, Fuyang, Zhejiang
fields.summary: 1945年9月4日，侵浙日军在富阳宋殿村洽降。 On 4 September 1945 the Japanese forces in Zhejiang attended surrender talks at Songdian in Fuyang.
fields.description: 9月4日，侵浙日军投降仪式在富阳宋殿村举行，第三战区副司令长官韩德勤代表中国政府主持接受日军投降仪式；侵杭日军最高指挥官、第133师团长野地嘉平代表日方呈交投降日军的兵力、驻地、指挥系统、官长姓名等图表。富阳人民后来把宋殿村改为受降村。受降事件，不绘路线。 On 4 September the surrender ceremony for Japanese forces in Zhejiang was held at Songdian in Fuyang. Lieutenant General Han Deqin, deputy commander of the Third War Zone, presided for China; the senior Japanese commander in Hangzhou, Lieutenant General Noji Kahei of the 133rd Division, submitted charts of Japanese strength, dispositions, command system and officers. The village was later renamed Shouxiang (Surrender) village. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 中国战区受降仪式 Surrender Ceremony in the China Theater
fields.summary: 中国战区受降仪式在南京举行，何应钦代表中国接受冈村宁次投降。 The surrender ceremony for the China Theater was held in Nanjing, where He Yingqin accepted the surrender of Okamura Yasuji on behalf of China.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 9 日，中国战区受降仪式在南京中央军校大礼堂举行。中国陆军总司令何应钦代表中国战区最高统帅接受日本驻华派遣军总司令冈村宁次投降，在华日军向中国缴械。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 9 September 1945 the surrender ceremony for the China Theater was held in the auditorium of the Central Military Academy in Nanjing. He Yingqin, commander-in-chief of the Chinese Army, accepted the surrender of Okamura Yasuji, commander of the Japanese forces in China, on behalf of the supreme command of the China Theater, and Japanese troops in China laid down their arms. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 上海受降 Shanghai Surrender Ceremony
fields.summary: 1945年9月11日，汤恩伯主持上海地区日军受降仪式。 On 11 September 1945 Tang Enbo presided over the Japanese surrender ceremony in Shanghai.
fields.description: 1945年9月11日，第三方面军司令官汤恩伯在上海主持日军受降仪式，日军代表松井久太郎在投降书上签字。上海受降是中国战区16个受降区之一，负责接受上海及周边地区日军缴械。日期据《伟大胜利——中国受降档案》与《中国战区十六场大受降》。 On 11 September 1945 Tang Enbo, commander of the Third Front Army, presided over the Japanese surrender ceremony in Shanghai, and the Japanese representative Matsui Kyūtarō signed the instrument of surrender. Shanghai was one of the sixteen surrender zones of the China Theater, responsible for disarming Japanese forces in and around the city.

fields.name: 太原受降 Japanese Surrender at Taiyuan
fields.summary: 1945年9月13日，第二战区司令长官阎锡山在太原接受日军投降。 On 13 September 1945 Yan Xishan, commander of the Second War Zone, accepted the Japanese surrender at Taiyuan.
fields.description: 1945年9月13日，日军第1军司令官澄田赉四郎在太原受领中国第二战区司令长官部第一号命令，开始部署投降事宜。第二战区共接受日军第1军及第114师团、第3、第10、第14独立旅团、第5独立骑兵团等部六万余人投降，并遣返日侨四万人。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据国家档案局《伟大胜利——中国受降档案》与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》。 On 13 September 1945 Lt. Gen. Teita Raishiro, commander of the Japanese First Army, received Order No. 1 from the Chinese Second War Zone headquarters at Taiyuan and began arranging the surrender. The Second War Zone accepted over 60,000 Japanese troops of the First Army, the 114th Division and the 3rd, 10th and 14th Independent Brigades and 5th Independent Cavalry Regiment, and repatriated 40,000 Japanese civilians. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event. Dates follow the National Archives’ surrender records and the Shanxi county gazetteer compilation.

fields.name: 长沙受降 Japanese Surrender at Changsha
fields.summary: 1945年9月15日，第四方面军司令官王耀武在长沙接受日军第20军投降。 On 15 September 1945 Wang Yaowu, commander of the Chinese Fourth Front Army, accepted the surrender of the Japanese 20th Army at Changsha.
fields.description: 1945年9月15日，第四方面军司令官王耀武在长沙岳麓山湖南大学科学馆接受日军第20军司令官坂西一良中将投降。长衡岳受降区负责接受长沙、衡阳、岳阳地区日军，日军第20军、第64、第68、第116师团及独立第17、第81、第82旅团等部约7万人投降。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据湖南省档案局《湖南地区日军受降报告书档案》与《人民日报海外版》受降档案。 On 15 September 1945 Wang Yaowu, commander of the Fourth Front Army, accepted the surrender of Lt. Gen. Sakanishi Ichiro, commander of the Japanese 20th Army, at the Hunan University science building on Yuelu Mountain in Changsha. The Changsha–Hengyang–Yueyang surrender zone covered some 70,000 Japanese troops of the 20th Army, the 64th, 68th and 116th Divisions and the 17th, 81st and 82nd Independent Brigades. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

summary.zh: 张发奎在广州接受田中久一投降。
summary.en: Zhang Fakui accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu in Guangzhou.

fields.name: 广州受降 Surrender of Japanese Forces in Guangzhou
fields.place: 广东广州中山纪念堂 Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, Guangzhou, Guangdong
fields.summary: 张发奎在广州接受田中久一投降。 Zhang Fakui accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu in Guangzhou.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 16 日上午 10 时，中国第二方面军司令官张发奎在广州中山纪念堂接受日本第 23 军司令官兼香港占领地总督田中久一投降，受降范围包括广州、雷州半岛与海南岛。日期据中国受降档案，待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。 At 10:00 on 16 September 1945 Zhang Fakui, commander of the Chinese 2nd Front Army, accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu, commander of the Japanese 23rd Army and governor of occupied Hong Kong, at the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Guangzhou. The surrender covered Guangzhou, the Leizhou Peninsula and Hainan. The date follows Chinese surrender archives and awaits page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 香港受降 Hong Kong Surrender Ceremony
fields.summary: 1945年9月16日，驻港日军在香港总督府向盟军投降。 On 16 September 1945 the Japanese garrison in Hong Kong surrendered to the Allies at Government House.
fields.description: 1945年9月16日，英国皇家海军夏悫中将在香港总督府代表英国政府和中国战区最高统帅蒋介石接受日军投降，日本陆军冈田梅吉少将、海军藤田类太郎中将在投降书上签字。中国、美国、加拿大代表出席。日期据《香港重光》与《1945.9.16，香港受降仪式照片》。 On 16 September 1945 Rear Admiral Cecil Harcourt of the Royal Navy accepted the Japanese surrender at Government House in Hong Kong on behalf of the British government and Generalissimo Chiang Kai-shek of the China Theater. Major General Okada Umekichi of the Japanese army and Vice Admiral Fujita Ruitarō of the navy signed; Chinese, American and Canadian representatives attended.

summary.en: On 18 September 1945 all Japanese troops in Hangzhou were disarmed.

fields.name: 杭州日军缴械 Disarmament of Japanese Troops in Hangzhou
fields.summary: 1945年9月18日，驻杭日军全部缴械。 On 18 September 1945 all Japanese troops in Hangzhou were disarmed.
fields.description: 9月7日，陈纯白率部进入杭州市区，从伪市长吴念中处接收伪杭州市政府；9月18日，驻杭日军全部缴械。月底，杭州周围的新四军部队和各县抗日民主政府干部开始北撤，省政府各机关迁回杭州。受降事件，不绘路线。 On 7 September Chen Chunbai led troops into Hangzhou and took over the puppet municipal government from mayor Wu Nianzhong; on 18 September all Japanese troops in Hangzhou were disarmed. At the end of the month New Fourth Army units around Hangzhou and county democratic government cadres began withdrawing north, and provincial government offices returned to the city. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

fields.summary: 1945年9月18日，第六战区司令长官孙蔚如在汉口接受日军第六方面军投降。 On 18 September 1945 Sun Weiru, commander of the Chinese Sixth War Zone, accepted the surrender of the Japanese Sixth Area Army at Hankou.
fields.description: 1945年9月18日下午3时，第六战区司令长官孙蔚如在汉口中山公园受降堂接受日军第六方面军司令官冈部直三郎大将率属21万人投降。武汉受降区负责接受武汉、沙市、宜昌地区日军。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据国家档案局《伟大胜利——中国受降档案》与人民网《1945，难忘的武汉之夏》。 At 3 p.m. on 18 September 1945 Sun Weiru, commander of the Chinese Sixth War Zone, accepted the surrender of Gen. Okabe Tasaburo, commander of the Japanese Sixth Area Army, and 210,000 troops at the surrender hall in Hankou’s Zhongshan Park. The Wuhan surrender zone covered Wuhan, Shashi and Yichang. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

summary.zh: 1945 年 9 月，中共中央决定成立东北局，彭真为书记；9 月 18 日彭真等到达沈阳开始工作。
summary.en: In September 1945 the CCP set up its Northeast Bureau under Peng Zhen; Peng and others reached Shenyang on 18 September.

fields.name: 中共中央东北局在沈阳成立 CCP Northeast Bureau established at Shenyang
fields.summary: 1945 年 9 月，中共中央决定成立东北局，彭真为书记；9 月 18 日彭真等到达沈阳开始工作。 In September 1945 the CCP set up its Northeast Bureau under Peng Zhen; Peng and others reached Shenyang on 18 September.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 14 日，中共中央政治局听取关于东北情况的汇报后，决定成立中共中央东北局，彭真为书记，陈云、程子华、伍修权、林枫等为委员。9 月 18 日，彭真、陈云等到达沈阳，东北局开始工作，统一领导东北的党政军工作。此后中共中央又调派大批干部和部队进入东北，建立东北根据地。东北局的成立是抗战胜利后中共争取东北的战略部署，也与东北抗日联军、东北党委员会的历史收束相衔接。本事件为组织成立，线路见 ccp 层「延安—沈阳」。 On 14 September 1945, after hearing a report on the Northeast, the CCP Politburo decided to establish the Northeast Bureau with Peng Zhen as secretary and Chen Yun, Cheng Zihua, Wu Xiuquan and Lin Feng as members. On 18 September Peng Zhen, Chen Yun and others reached Shenyang and the Bureau began work, unifying Party, government and military leadership in the Northeast. The Central Committee then sent large numbers of cadres and troops into the region to build base areas. The Bureau’s establishment was part of the CCP’s strategic bid for the Northeast after Japan’s surrender and dovetailed with the closing of the history of the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army and the Northeast Party Committee.

fields.name: 漯河受降 Japanese Surrender at Luohe
fields.summary: 1945年9月20日，第五战区在郾城（漯河）接受日军投降。 On 20 September 1945 the Chinese Fifth War Zone accepted the Japanese surrender at Yancheng (Luohe).
fields.description: 1945年9月20日，第五战区在郾城（漯河）山西会馆举行受降仪式，司令长官刘峙主持，日军第12军司令官鹰森孝在投降书上签字，在郾城投降日军31560人。漯河为全国16个受降区之一。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据《日军郑州投降纪实》与《受降亭》。 On 20 September 1945 the Fifth War Zone held a surrender ceremony at the Shanxi Guild Hall in Yancheng (Luohe), presided over by commander Liu Zhi; Lt. Gen. Takamori of the Japanese 12th Army signed the instrument of surrender, and 31,560 Japanese troops surrendered at Yancheng. Luohe was one of the sixteen surrender zones in China. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

fields.name: 郑州受降 Japanese Surrender at Zhengzhou
fields.summary: 1945年9月22日，第一战区在郑州接受日军第12军投降。 On 22 September 1945 the Chinese First War Zone accepted the surrender of the Japanese 12th Army at Zhengzhou.
fields.description: 1945年9月22日，第一战区在郑州前进指挥所举行受降仪式，由战区参谋长李昆岗主持，日军第12军司令官鹰森孝向胡宗南部投降，在郑州投降日军43334人。郑州受降区原定洛阳，后因日军第12军军部驻郑州而改在郑州。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据《日军郑州投降纪实》与《重读抗战·河南》。 On 22 September 1945 the First War Zone held a surrender ceremony at its Zhengzhou advance headquarters, presided over by Chief of Staff Li Kungang; Lt. Gen. Takamori of the Japanese 12th Army surrendered to Hu Zongnan’s forces, with 43,334 Japanese troops laying down arms at Zhengzhou. The surrender site had originally been Luoyang but was moved to Zhengzhou because the 12th Army headquarters was there. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

fields.description: 9月24日下午3时，在蚌埠国民党军第十战区前进指挥所礼堂内举行第九受降区受降仪式，由第十战区司令长官李品仙、前进指挥所主任张金等主持，日军代表第6军司令官十川次郎在投降书上签字。受降事件，不绘路线。 At 3 p.m. on 24 September the Ninth Surrender District ceremony was held in the advance command post of the Chinese Tenth War Zone in Bengbu, presided over by Tenth War Zone commander Li Pinxian and advance command post director Zhang Jin. The Japanese representative, Lieutenant General Jūkawa Jirō, commander of the 6th Army, signed the instrument of surrender. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 汕头受降 Surrender of Japanese Forces in Shantou
fields.summary: 余汉谋在汕头接受田中久一代表投降。 Yu Hanmou accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu’s representative in Shantou.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 28 日上午 9 时，中国第七战区司令长官余汉谋派代表徐景唐在汕头“潮汕前进指挥所”接受日军第 23 军参谋长富田直亮代表田中久一投降，受降范围包括曲江、潮汕地区。日期据中国受降档案，待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。 At 09:00 on 28 September 1945 Xu Jingtang, representing Chinese 7th War Zone commander Yu Hanmou, accepted the surrender of Major General Tomita Naoaki, chief of staff of the Japanese 23rd Army and representative of Tanaka Hisakazu, at the Chaoshan advance command post in Shantou. The surrender covered Qujiang and the Chaoshan region. The date follows Chinese surrender archives and awaits page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

fields.description: 9月28日，国民党海军第二舰队司令李世甲、厦门要港司令刘德浦在鼓浪屿海滨饭店举行驻厦日军受降仪式，驻厦日军司令官原田清一海军中将在投降书上签字。受降事件，不绘路线。 On 28 September the Chinese navy's 2nd Fleet commander Li Shijia and Xiamen port commander Liu Depu held the surrender ceremony for the Japanese garrison at the Gulangyu seaside hotel; Vice Admiral Harada Seiichi, commander of the Xiamen garrison, signed the instrument of surrender. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 河内受降 Hanoi Surrender Ceremony
fields.summary: 1945年9月28日，卢汉在河内接受越南北纬16度以北日军投降。 On 28 September 1945 Lu Han accepted the surrender of Japanese forces north of the 16th parallel in Hanoi.
fields.description: 1945年9月28日上午10时，中国战区越北区受降仪式在越南河内原法国驻越总督府举行，第一方面军司令官卢汉主持，日本第38军司令官土桥勇逸中将签字投降。越南北纬16度以北地区属中国战区16个受降区之一。日期据《抗战胜利后中国军队越南受降》与国家档案局档案。 At 10 a.m. on 28 September 1945 the surrender ceremony for the northern Indochina zone of the China Theater was held at the former French governor-general’s palace in Hanoi. Lu Han, commander of the First Front Army, presided, and Lieutenant General Tsuchihashi Yuitsu, commander of the Japanese 38th Army, signed the surrender. The area north of the 16th parallel was one of the sixteen surrender zones of the China Theater.

name.en: Surrender of Japanese Forces in Hainan

summary.zh: 国民党第 46 军渡海接收海南，日军海南警备府所部投降。
summary.en: The Chinese 46th Army crossed to Hainan to receive the surrender of the Japanese Hainan Guard District.

fields.name: 海南受降 Surrender of Japanese Forces in Hainan
fields.summary: 国民党第 46 军渡海接收海南，日军海南警备府所部投降。 The Chinese 46th Army crossed to Hainan to receive the surrender of the Japanese Hainan Guard District.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月，国民党第 46 军渡海进入海南。10 月初，叶佩高、朱晖日在海口成立前进指挥所，负责对日受降；10 月中旬起，第 188 师、新编第 19 师、第 175 师分批登陆，接收日军武器、器材与物资。日军海南警备府所部投降。精确受降仪式日期与各批接收日程待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。 In September 1945 the Chinese 46th Army crossed to Hainan. In early October Ye Peigao and Zhu Huiri established an advance command post at Haikou to handle the Japanese surrender; from mid-October the 188th, New 19th and 175th Divisions landed in batches and took over Japanese weapons, equipment and supplies. The Japanese Hainan Guard District surrendered. The exact ceremony date and reception schedule await page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

fields.summary: 1945年10月6日，天津举行日军受降仪式。 On 6 October 1945 a Japanese surrender ceremony was held in Tianjin.
fields.description: 10月6日，天津举行日军受降仪式，接收天津地区日军。天津是华北重要港口和日军华北方面军的重要据点。受降事件，不绘路线。日期据中国受降档案与《中国抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。 On 6 October a surrender ceremony was held in Tianjin to receive the Japanese forces in the Tianjin area. Tianjin was a major North China port and an important base of the Japanese North China Area Army. This surrender event is not drawn as a route. The date follows the Chinese surrender archives and the Chinese war history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1945年10月10日，北平太和殿举行日军受降仪式。 On 10 October 1945 the Japanese surrender ceremony was held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony in Beiping.
fields.description: 10月10日，北平太和殿举行日军受降仪式，第十一战区司令长官孙连仲代表中国政府受降，日军华北方面军司令官根本博在投降书上签字。受降事件，不绘路线。日期据中国受降档案与《中国抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。 On 10 October the surrender ceremony was held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony in Beiping. Sun Lianzhong, commander of the 11th War Zone, received the surrender for China, and General Nemoto Hiroshi, commander of the Japanese North China Area Army, signed the instrument of surrender. This surrender event is not drawn as a route. The date follows the Chinese surrender archives and the Chinese war history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Signing of the Double Tenth Agreement

summary.zh: 1945 年 10 月 10 日，国共双方在重庆签署《政府与中共代表会谈纪要》（双十协定）。
summary.en: On 10 October 1945 the two sides signed the “Summary of Conversations between the Government and the CCP Delegation”, the Double Tenth Agreement.

fields.name: 《双十协定》签署 Signing of the Double Tenth Agreement
fields.summary: 1945 年 10 月 10 日，国共双方在重庆签署《政府与中共代表会谈纪要》（双十协定）。 On 10 October 1945 the two sides signed the “Summary of Conversations between the Government and the CCP Delegation”, the Double Tenth Agreement.
fields.description: 1945 年 10 月 10 日，经过 43 天谈判，国共双方代表在重庆签署《政府与中共代表会谈纪要》，通称《双十协定》。纪要确定和平建国的基本方针，确认避免内战、实现政治民主化、军队国家化等原则，并决定召开政治协商会议。但在解放区政权和人民军队两个核心问题上，双方未达成协议：中共要求承认解放区民选政府和人民军队，国民党坚持「军令政令统一」。协定签字后，毛泽东于 10 月 11 日返回延安，周恩来、王若飞留渝继续谈判。本事件为政治谈判结果，线路见 ccp 层「重庆—延安」。 On 10 October 1945, after 43 days of talks, the two delegations in Chongqing signed the “Summary of Conversations between the Government and the CCP Delegation”, known as the Double Tenth Agreement. It fixed the basic policy of peaceful national reconstruction, affirmed the principles of avoiding civil war, political democratisation and nationalisation of the armed forces, and provided for a Political Consultative Conference. On the two core issues of liberated-area government and the people’s army, however, no agreement was reached: the CCP sought recognition of elected governments and people’s forces in the liberated areas, while the KMT insisted on unified military and administrative command. After the signing Mao returned to Yan’an on 11 October, leaving Zhou Enlai and Wang Ruofei to continue talks.

summary.zh: 1945 年 10 月 11 日，毛泽东在签署《双十协定》后由重庆返回延安。
summary.en: On 11 October 1945 Mao Zedong returned to Yan’an from Chongqing after signing the Double Tenth Agreement.

fields.name: 毛泽东返回延安 Mao Zedong returns to Yan’an
fields.summary: 1945 年 10 月 11 日，毛泽东在签署《双十协定》后由重庆返回延安。 On 11 October 1945 Mao Zedong returned to Yan’an from Chongqing after signing the Double Tenth Agreement.
fields.description: 1945 年 10 月 11 日，毛泽东在张治中陪同下由重庆飞返延安，结束 43 天的重庆谈判。周恩来、王若飞留在重庆继续与国民党谈判。毛泽东返回延安后，在中共中央政治局会议上报告谈判情况，指出《双十协定》暴露了国民党当局的内战方针，中共必须做好应付内战的准备，同时继续争取和平民主。本事件为政治行程，线路见 ccp 层「重庆—延安」。 On 11 October 1945 Mao Zedong, accompanied by Zhang Zhizhong, flew back to Yan’an from Chongqing, ending 43 days of negotiations. Zhou Enlai and Wang Ruofei stayed in Chongqing to continue talks. After returning, Mao reported on the negotiations at a Politburo meeting, arguing that the Double Tenth Agreement had exposed the KMT authorities’ civil-war policy, that the CCP must prepare for a civil war while continuing to strive for peace and democracy.

name.zh: 东北党委员会移交中共中央东北局
name.en: The Northeast Party Committee hands over to the Northeast Bureau

summary.zh: 1945年10月，周保中、崔石泉向中共中央东北局移交东北党委员会的组织关系、党费与档案，东北党委员会正式撤销。
summary.en: In October 1945 Zhou Baozhong and Cui Shiquan handed the Northeast Party Committee’s organisation, funds and archives to the CCP Northeast Bureau, which dissolved the committee.

fields.name: 东北党委员会移交中共中央东北局 The Northeast Party Committee hands over to the Northeast Bureau
fields.summary: 1945年10月，周保中、崔石泉向中共中央东北局移交东北党委员会的组织关系、党费与档案，东北党委员会正式撤销。 In October 1945 Zhou Baozhong and Cui Shiquan handed the Northeast Party Committee’s organisation, funds and archives to the CCP Northeast Bureau, which dissolved the committee.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月苏联对日宣战后，东北抗联教导旅配合苏军返回东北，400 余人分成 57 个进驻小组，以苏军卫戍副司令身份进入各战略要点。9 月 8 日周保中率队到长春，随后赴沈阳向中共中央东北局汇报。10 月 20 日，东北局接受东北党委员会移交的全部组织关系、党费与档案，东北党委员会正式撤销。至此，自 1936 年满洲省委撤销后与中央失去联系近十年的东北党组织，重新接回组织系统。10 月 31 日，中共中央决定将进入东北的部队与东北人民自卫军合编为东北人民自治军（1946 年 1 月改称东北民主联军），抗联完成了自己的历史使命。本事件为建制事件，不绘路线。 After the Soviet declaration of war in August 1945 the training brigade returned to Manchuria with the Red Army; more than 400 men in 57 groups entered the strategic points as deputy Soviet garrison commanders. Zhou Baozhong reached Changchun on 8 September and then reported to the CCP Northeast Bureau in Shenyang. On 20 October the bureau took over the Northeast Party Committee’s entire organisation, funds and archives, and the committee was formally dissolved. The Manchurian party, cut off from the centre for nearly a decade since 1936, was thus reconnected. On 31 October the Central Committee merged the forces entering Manchuria with the Northeast People’s Self-Defence Army into the Northeast People’s Autonomous Army (renamed the Northeast Democratic United Army in January 1946), closing the United Army’s history. This is an organisational event and no route is drawn.

fields.name: 台湾光复 Retrocession of Taiwan
fields.summary: 中国战区台湾省受降仪式在台北举行，台湾光复。 The Taiwan surrender ceremony of the China Theater was held in Taipei, and Taiwan returned to China.
fields.description: 1945 年 10 月 25 日，中国战区台湾省受降仪式在台北举行，日本台湾总督安藤利吉向中国代表陈仪投降，台湾及澎湖列岛回归中国。 法理链条：1895 年《马关条约》割让台湾、澎湖予日本；1941 年 12 月 9 日中国对日宣战并废止中日间一切条约；1943 年《开罗宣言》规定日本所窃取的中国领土（东北、台湾、澎湖列岛等）必须归还中国；1945 年《波茨坦公告》重申《开罗宣言》条款必须实施。抗战期间台湾虽处于日本殖民统治之下，中国从未放弃主权。 本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。 On 25 October 1945 the surrender ceremony for Taiwan was held in Taipei: Japanese Governor-General Andō Rikichi surrendered to the Chinese representative Chen Yi, and Taiwan and the Penghu Islands returned to China. The legal chain: the Treaty of Shimonoseki ceded Taiwan and the Penghu Islands to Japan in 1895; on 9 December 1941 China declared war on Japan and abrogated all Sino-Japanese treaties; the 1943 Cairo Declaration stipulated that territories Japan had stolen from China, including Manchuria, Taiwan and the Penghu Islands, must be restored; the 1945 Potsdam Proclamation reaffirmed that the Cairo terms must be carried out. Although Taiwan was under Japanese colonial rule during the war, China never renounced sovereignty. This is a surrender event with no route drawn.

fields.description: 12月27日，济南、青岛、德州地区受降典礼在山东省立图书馆「奎虚书藏」举行，由第十一战区副司令长官李延年中将主持，日军第43军司令官细川忠康等代表签降。山东区受降主官为李延年，日军投降代表为第43军司令官细川忠康。受降事件，不绘路线。 On 27 December the surrender ceremony for the Jinan, Qingdao and Dezhou areas was held at the Kui Xu Shu Cang building of the Shandong Provincial Library, presided over by Lieutenant General Li Yannian, deputy commander of the 11th War Zone. Lieutenant General Hosokawa Tadamasa, commander of the Japanese 43rd Army, and other representatives signed. The surrender is not drawn as a route.
