atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

summary.zh: 隋代沟通淮安与扬州的邗沟，是隋唐大运河连接淮河与长江的南段。
summary.en: The Sui Hangou canal linked Huai’an and Yangzhou, connecting the Huai and the Yangtze in the southern Sui–Tang system.

fields.name: 隋代邗沟 The Sui Hangou canal
fields.summary: 隋代沟通淮安与扬州的邗沟，是隋唐大运河连接淮河与长江的南段。 The Sui Hangou canal linked Huai’an and Yangzhou, connecting the Huai and the Yangtze in the southern Sui–Tang system.
fields.description: 邗沟始凿于春秋吴王夫差，隋代加以疏浚改线。隋文帝开山阳渎，隋炀帝大业年间复开邗沟，自山阳（今淮安）南至江都（今扬州）入长江，沟通淮河与长江。邗沟是隋唐大运河的南段，也是后来京杭大运河里运河的前身。本事件为运河工程，线路见「淮安—扬州（邗沟）」。 The Hangou canal was first cut under King Fuchai of Wu and was dredged and realigned in the Sui period. Emperor Wen opened the Shanyang channel and Emperor Yang reopened the Hangou, running from Shanyang (Huai’an) south to Jiangdu (Yangzhou) and the Yangtze, linking the Huai and the Yangtze. It was the southern section of the Sui–Tang Grand Canal and the forerunner of the later Li canal. The route is shown as Huai’an–Yangzhou.

atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

summary.zh: 扬州（江都）是隋代邗沟南端与长江交汇处的运河枢纽。
summary.en: Yangzhou (Jiangdu) was the canal hub where the Sui Hangou met the Yangtze.

fields.name: 隋代江都 Sui Jiangdu
fields.summary: 扬州（江都）是隋代邗沟南端与长江交汇处的运河枢纽。 Yangzhou (Jiangdu) was the canal hub where the Sui Hangou met the Yangtze.
fields.description: 江都（今扬州）位于邗沟南端、长江北岸，是隋唐大运河连接江南河与淮河的关键节点。隋炀帝开邗沟后，江都成为巡幸、转漕与南北商旅集散之地；唐代继续在此设仓、造船，刘晏漕运改革即以扬州为造船与转输中心。本事件为运河枢纽节点，不绘路线。 Jiangdu (present-day Yangzhou) stood at the southern end of the Hangou on the north bank of the Yangtze, the key node linking the Jiangnan canal with the Huai system. After Emperor Yang opened the Hangou, Jiangdu became a centre for imperial tours, grain transshipment and north–south trade; the Tang continued to build granaries and ships there, and Liu Yan’s reforms made Yangzhou a shipbuilding and transshipment hub. No route is drawn.

atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

summary.zh: 隋大业年间营建含嘉仓，唐代沿用，是洛阳运河枢纽的皇家粮仓。
summary.en: The Hanjia Granary was built under the Sui and used by the Tang as the imperial store at the Luoyang canal hub.

fields.name: 含嘉仓营建 Construction of the Hanjia Granary
fields.summary: 隋大业年间营建含嘉仓，唐代沿用，是洛阳运河枢纽的皇家粮仓。 The Hanjia Granary was built under the Sui and used by the Tang as the imperial store at the Luoyang canal hub.
fields.description: 含嘉仓位于隋唐洛阳城北，隋大业年间营建，唐代继续使用，是隋唐大运河洛阳枢纽的皇家粮仓。遗址发现仓窖数百座，出土铭砖记载储粮来源、数量与入仓时间，可证江淮漕粮经通济渠、汴河转运至洛阳。日期取隋大业年间（605 年起），具体营建年待考。 The Hanjia Granary lay north of the Sui–Tang city of Luoyang. Built under the Sui and continued in use under the Tang, it was the imperial store of the Luoyang canal hub. Hundreds of granary pits have been excavated, and inscribed bricks record the origin, quantity and date of stored grain, evidence that Jiangnan grain reached Luoyang via the Tongji and Bian canals. The date is the Daye era from 605; the exact year awaits verification.

fields.name: 裴耀卿改革漕运 Pei Yaoqing’s reform of grain transport
fields.place: 河南河阴（今荥阳） Heyin (Xingyang), Henan
fields.summary: 开元二十一年，裴耀卿改直运为分段转运，置河阴等仓，三年运七百万石。 In 733 Pei Yaoqing replaced through-shipping with segmented transport and set up granaries, moving seven million shi in three years.
fields.description: 唐玄宗开元二十一年（733），裴耀卿任京兆尹、江淮都转运使，改革漕运。他改直运为分段转运：于河阴置河阴仓，河清置柏崖仓，三门东置集津仓、西置盐仓；江南漕船至河口入仓，官雇舟分入河、洛，避免江南船工不习黄河水性的风险。三年运粮七百万石，省陆运钱三十万缗。日期取 733 年，具体月日待考。 In 733, the twenty-first year of Kaiyuan, Pei Yaoqing became governor of the capital region and transport commissioner and reformed grain transport. He replaced through-shipping with segmented transport: granaries were set up at Heyin, Baiya, Jijin and the Salt Storehouse at Sanmen; southern boats unloaded at the river mouth and official vessels carried the grain into the Yellow River and Luo. In three years 7,000,000 shi were moved, saving 300,000 strings of cash in overland costs. The date is 733; the exact month and day await verification.

atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

name.en: Liu Yan’s reform of grain transport

summary.zh: 广德二年，刘晏主持疏浚汴渠、造歇艎支江船，改直运为分段转运。
summary.en: In 764 Liu Yan dredged the Bian canal and replaced through-shipping with segmented transport.

fields.name: 刘晏改革漕运 Liu Yan’s reform of grain transport
fields.summary: 广德二年，刘晏主持疏浚汴渠、造歇艎支江船，改直运为分段转运。 In 764 Liu Yan dredged the Bian canal and replaced through-shipping with segmented transport.
fields.description: 唐代宗广德二年（764），刘晏领东都、河南、淮西、江南东西转运使，主持漕运改革。他组织疏浚汴渠，在扬州设船场造「歇艎支江船」二千艘，每船受千斛；改直运为分段转运，使江船不入汴、汴船不入河、河船不入渭，沿扬州、汴口、河阴、渭口置仓转输；又用盐利雇募船工，十船为纲，军官押运。改革后江淮漕粮岁运四十万至一百一十万石，损耗大减。本事件为制度事件，不绘路线。 In 764, the second year of Guangde under Emperor Daizong, Liu Yan took charge of transport for the eastern capital, Henan, Huaixi and the Jiangnan regions and reformed the grain system. He dredged the Bian canal, built 2,000 “Xiehuang Zhijiang” barges at Yangzhou (each carrying 1,000 hu), replaced through-shipping with segmented transport so that river boats did not enter the Bian, Bian boats did not enter the Yellow River and river boats did not enter the Wei, and set up granaries at Yangzhou, the Bian mouth, Heyin and the Wei mouth. He hired crews with salt revenue, grouped ten boats into a convoy and had officers escort them. Annual deliveries rose to 400,000–1,100,000 shi with much less loss. This is an institutional event, so no route is drawn.

name.en: Six million shi on the Bian River

summary.zh: 北宋真宗时，汴河岁运江淮米达六百万石，为北宋漕运最高额之一。
summary.en: Under Emperor Zhenzong the Bian River carried up to six million shi of Jiangnan and Huai grain a year, among the highest Northern Song totals.

fields.name: 汴河岁运六百万石 Six million shi on the Bian River
fields.summary: 北宋真宗时，汴河岁运江淮米达六百万石，为北宋漕运最高额之一。 Under Emperor Zhenzong the Bian River carried up to six million shi of Jiangnan and Huai grain a year, among the highest Northern Song totals.
fields.description: 北宋以汴河为立国之本。真宗大中祥符年间，汴河岁运江淮米达六百万石，为北宋漕运最高额之一。汴河引黄河水，泥沙淤积严重，朝廷每年清淤、狭河、护堤；岁运额与河道维护能力直接相关。日期取 1010 年代表年，具体年份待考。 The Northern Song regarded the Bian River as the foundation of the state. Under Emperor Zhenzong, in the Dazhong Xiangfu era, the Bian carried up to 6,000,000 shi of grain from the Jiangnan and Huai regions a year, among the highest totals of the dynasty. Because the Bian drew on the silt-laden Yellow River, the court dredged, narrowed and diked it every year; the annual total depended directly on maintenance. The date is a representative year around 1010; the exact year awaits verification.

atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

name.en: Diverting the Luo River into the Bian Canal

summary.zh: 元丰二年，宋用臣主持引洛水入汴，避开黄河泥沙，改善汴河漕运。
summary.en: In 1079 Song Yongchen diverted the Luo into the Bian, avoiding Yellow River silt and improving transport.

fields.name: 导洛通汴 Diverting the Luo River into the Bian Canal
fields.summary: 元丰二年，宋用臣主持引洛水入汴，避开黄河泥沙，改善汴河漕运。 In 1079 Song Yongchen diverted the Luo into the Bian, avoiding Yellow River silt and improving transport.
fields.description: 北宋汴河原引黄河水，泥沙淤积严重，每年需大量人力清淤。元丰二年（1079）三月，宋神宗命宋用臣提举导洛通汴；四月甲子兴工，自巩县任村沙谷至河阴汴口开河五十余里，引伊、洛水入汴，并闭断黄河汴口。六月戊申完工，历时四十五日。工程使汴河由「黄汴」变为「清汴」，泥沙大减，四时通漕；但洛水夏秋涨落不定，水量有限，仍不能完全解决浅涩问题。本事件为水利工程，不绘路线。 The Northern Song Bian canal originally drew on the Yellow River and silted heavily, requiring massive annual dredging. In 1079 Emperor Shenzong ordered Song Yongchen to divert the Luo into the Bian. Work began in April, cutting a channel of more than fifty li from Rencun in Gong County to the Bian mouth at Heyin, leading the Yi and Luo rivers into the Bian and closing the Yellow River intake. It was completed in June after forty-five days. The “Yellow Bian” became the “Clear Bian”, silt fell sharply and transport ran in all seasons; but the Luo’s summer-autumn fluctuations and limited flow left shallows unresolved. No route is drawn.

atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

name.en: Kaifeng and the Bian River market towns

summary.zh: 北宋开封以汴河为漕运主干，汴河两岸码头、仓场与市镇连成一线。
summary.en: Northern Song Kaifeng depended on the Bian River, and wharves, granaries and market towns lined its banks.

fields.name: 开封汴河市镇 Kaifeng and the Bian River market towns
fields.summary: 北宋开封以汴河为漕运主干，汴河两岸码头、仓场与市镇连成一线。 Northern Song Kaifeng depended on the Bian River, and wharves, granaries and market towns lined its banks.
fields.description: 北宋东京开封以汴河为漕运主干，江淮粮船经汴河入京。汴河穿城而过，州桥、相国寺桥一带为码头与商业中心；《东京梦华录》记汴河「自西京洛口分水入京城」，城内河道与蔡河、五丈河相通，沿岸有仓场、邸店、酒楼与瓦子，形成「因运而兴」的市镇带。张择端《清明上河图》所绘即以汴河两岸的码头与市镇为对象，年代与地点另有异说。本事件为城镇经济节点，不绘路线；日期取 1100 年代表年。 Northern Song Kaifeng, the eastern capital, depended on the Bian River for grain transport, and grain boats from the Jiangnan and Huai regions entered the city by it. The Bian ran through the city, with the Zhouqiao and Xiangguosi bridges as wharf and commercial centres. The Dongjing Meng Hua Lu records that the Bian drew water from the Luo mouth at the western capital into the city, and the inner waterways connected with the Cai and Wuzhang rivers; granaries, inns, taverns and entertainment quarters lined the banks, forming a canal-generated belt of market towns. Zhang Zeduan’s Qingming Shanghe Tu depicts wharves and towns on the Bian, though its date and location are disputed. This is a town-economy node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1100.

atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

name.en: The Southern Song makes Lin’an its temporary capital

summary.zh: 绍兴八年，南宋以临安为行在（名义首都仍为汴京），江南运河成为行在的漕运通道。
summary.en: In 1138 the Southern Song made Lin’an its temporary capital (xingzai) while nominally retaining Bianjing, and the Jiangnan canal became the court’s grain route.

fields.name: 南宋以临安为行在 The Southern Song makes Lin’an its temporary capital 南宋定都临安 Southern Song capital at Lin’an
fields.summary: 绍兴八年，南宋以临安为行在（名义首都仍为汴京），江南运河成为行在的漕运通道。 In 1138 the Southern Song made Lin’an its temporary capital (xingzai) while nominally retaining Bianjing, and the Jiangnan canal became the court’s grain route.
fields.description: 绍兴八年（1138），南宋正式以临安（今杭州）为行在（皇帝临时驻地），名义上仍以汴京为首都。临安位于江南运河南端，经运河可北接镇江、扬州，转入长江与淮河；行在所需的粮米、布帛、木材与日用百货多由江南运河输入。南宋在临安设转运司、仓场与河码头，城北湖墅、江涨桥一带因运河而兴。严格说，临安是「行在」而非正式首都；「定都临安」是后世的通行简写。本事件为政治事件，不绘路线。 In 1138 the Southern Song formally made Lin’an (present-day Hangzhou) its xingzai, the emperor’s temporary residence, while Bianjing remained the nominal capital. At the southern end of the Jiangnan canal, Lin’an was linked north to Zhenjiang and Yangzhou and thence to the Yangtze and Huai. Grain, cloth, timber and daily goods for the court came largely by the Jiangnan canal. The Southern Song set up transport offices, granaries and wharves, and the city’s northern lakeside and riverine quarters grew around the canal. Strictly speaking Lin’an was a temporary capital, not the formal capital; “establishing the capital at Lin’an” is a later shorthand. No route is drawn.

summary.en: In the Southern Song the Hushu and Jiangzhangqiao area north of Lin’an grew into a market town around the canal wharves.

fields.name: 临安湖墅市镇 The Hushu market town at Lin’an
fields.place: 浙江杭州湖墅 Hushu, Hangzhou, Zhejiang
fields.summary: 南宋临安城北湖墅、江涨桥一带因运河码头形成市镇。 In the Southern Song the Hushu and Jiangzhangqiao area north of Lin’an grew into a market town around the canal wharves.
fields.description: 南宋临安城北的湖墅、江涨桥一带位于江南运河入城段，是粮船、商船停泊与转运的码头区。据《梦粱录》《咸淳临安志》，此处有米市、鱼行、船行、货栈与仓场，外来商旅在此卸货入城；城北河道与城内河网相连，形成「运河—湖墅—城内」的运输链。湖墅市镇是运河沿线「因运而兴」的典型节点。本事件为城镇经济节点，不绘路线。 The Hushu and Jiangzhangqiao area north of Southern Song Lin’an lay on the Jiangnan canal’s approach to the city and served as the wharf zone for grain and merchant boats. According to the Mengliang Lu and Xianchun Lin’an Zhi, it had rice markets, fish and boat brokers, warehouses and granaries where travelling merchants unloaded goods for the city; the northern waterways connected with the city’s canal network, forming a “canal–Hushu–city” transport chain. Hushu is a classic canal-generated town. No route is drawn.

name.en: Guo Shoujing surveys the canal routes

fields.name: 郭守敬勘察运河 Guo Shoujing surveys the canal routes
fields.summary: 至元十二年，郭守敬勘察汶、泗、卫水道，为元代山东运河与通惠河奠定技术基础。 In 1275 Guo Shoujing surveyed the Wen, Si and Wei waters, laying the technical basis for the Yuan Shandong canals and Tonghui River.
fields.description: 元至元十二年（1275），元世祖命郭守敬勘察汶、泗、卫相邻地区水道，为开凿济州河、会通河与通惠河作技术准备。郭守敬绘图上报，提出引汶、泗水济运的方案，并测定地形高差，奠定元代山东运河与通惠河工程的基础。日期取 1275 年。 In 1275, the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, Kublai Khan ordered Guo Shoujing to survey the waterways between the Wen, Si and Wei rivers as technical preparation for the Jizhou, Huitong and Tonghui canals. Guo mapped the terrain, measured heights and proposed diverting the Wen and Si to supply the canal, laying the basis for the Yuan works in Shandong and the Tonghui River. The date is 1275.

atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

summary.zh: 至元二十年，济州河竣工，自济宁北至安山，接通大清河。
summary.en: In 1283 the Jizhou River was completed from Jining north to Anshan, linking to the Daqing River.

fields.name: 济州河开凿 Opening of the Jizhou River
fields.summary: 至元二十年，济州河竣工，自济宁北至安山，接通大清河。 In 1283 the Jizhou River was completed from Jining north to Anshan, linking to the Daqing River.
fields.description: 元至元十七年（1280），朝廷采纳姚演、马之贞等建议，决定开济州河。工程于至元十九年（1282）十二月正式施工，至次年八月竣工，自济州（今济宁）鲁桥引汶、泗水，北至须城（今东平）安山，全长约一百五十里，接通大清河。济州河使江南漕船可经泗水、济州河北上，但安山以北仍需陆运至临清，或由利津出海；直到 1289 年会通河开通，南北直航才实现。本事件为水利工程，线路见「济宁—安山（济州河）」。 In 1280 the Yuan court adopted proposals by Yao Yan and Ma Zhizhen to open the Jizhou River. Work began in December 1282 and was completed in August 1283, running from the Luqiao area of Jizhou (Jining) north to Anshan in Xucheng (Dongping), about 150 li, using the Wen and Si rivers and linking to the Daqing River. It allowed grain boats from the south to reach Anshan, but goods still had to go overland to Linqing or by sea from Lijin until the Huitong River opened in 1289. The route is shown as Jining–Anshan.

fields.name: 马之贞主持会通河 Ma Zhizhen directs the Huitong River works

fields.description: 至元二十六年（1289），漕运副使马之贞与寿张尹韩仲晖、太史院令史边源等主持开凿会通河，自安山至临清，长二百五十余里，引汶、泗水济运，沿河建闸三十余座，以时启闭。会通河开通后，京杭大运河全线贯通。日期取 1289 年，具体月日待考。 In 1289 Ma Zhizhen, transport vice-commissioner, with Han Zhonghui, magistrate of Shouzhang, and Bian Yuan of the Astronomical Bureau, directed the Huitong River works from Anshan to Linqing, over 250 li, diverting the Wen and Si to supply the canal and building more than thirty locks opened and closed according to water levels. With the Huitong open, the Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal ran through. The date is 1289; the exact month and day await verification.

atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

summary.zh: 永乐九年，宋礼、白英修会通河，引汶水至南旺分水，解决运河「水脊」难题。
summary.en: In 1411 Song Li and Bai Ying diverted the Wen River to Nanwang, solving the canal’s summit water problem.

fields.name: 南旺分水枢纽 The Nanwang water-diversion hub
fields.place: 山东汶上南旺 Nanwang, Wenshang, Shandong
fields.summary: 永乐九年，宋礼、白英修会通河，引汶水至南旺分水，解决运河「水脊」难题。 In 1411 Song Li and Bai Ying diverted the Wen River to Nanwang, solving the canal’s summit water problem.
fields.description: 明永乐九年（1411），工部尚书宋礼奉命疏浚会通河，采纳汶上老人白英的建议，在汶河戴村筑坝遏水，开小汶河引汶水至南旺；南旺为运河全线最高点，号称「水脊」。工程在汶、运交汇处筑石护岸，设鱼嘴状「水拨刺」分水南北，并设南旺、蜀山、马踏等水柜蓄水，沿河置闸节流。民间称「七分朝天子，三分下江南」，实际分流比例随水势调整。南旺枢纽使会通河获得稳定水源，保障京杭大运河明清近六百年通航。 In 1411, the ninth year of Yongle, Minister of Works Song Li was ordered to dredge the Huitong River. On the advice of the Wenshang water expert Bai Ying, he built the Daicun dam across the Wen, cut the Xiao Wen channel and led the Wen to Nanwang, the highest point of the canal, known as the “water ridge”. At the Wen–canal junction the engineers built stone revetments and a fish-mouth divider to split the flow north and south, created reservoirs at Nanwang, Shushan and Mata, and placed locks along the channel. The popular saying “seven parts to the emperor, three to the south” describes the ideal split; actual proportions varied with water levels. The hub gave the Huitong River a stable water supply and kept the Grand Canal navigable for nearly six centuries under the Ming and Qing.

name.en: Pan Shuzheng petitions to dredge the Huitong River

summary.en: In 1411 Pan Shuzheng, sub-prefect of Jining, petitioned to dredge the Huitong River; the Yongle Emperor agreed and ordered Song Li to begin work.

fields.name: 潘叔正上书疏浚会通河 Pan Shuzheng petitions to dredge the Huitong River
fields.summary: 永乐九年，济宁州同知潘叔正上书请疏浚会通河，明成祖采纳，命宋礼等兴工。 In 1411 Pan Shuzheng, sub-prefect of Jining, petitioned to dredge the Huitong River; the Yongle Emperor agreed and ordered Song Li to begin work.
fields.description: 永乐九年（1411），济宁州同知潘叔正上书，言会通河四百五十余里，淤塞者三分之一，请疏浚以通漕运。明成祖采纳，命工部尚书宋礼、刑部侍郎金纯、都督同知周长征民夫十六万余人疏浚会通河；随后宋礼采纳白英建议，建南旺分水枢纽。日期取 1411 年。 In 1411 Pan Shuzheng, sub-prefect of Jining, petitioned that one third of the 450-li Huitong River was silted and asked for dredging to restore grain transport. The Yongle Emperor agreed and ordered Minister of Works Song Li, Vice Minister of Justice Jin Chun and Commander Zhou Chang to mobilise more than 160,000 labourers. Song Li then adopted Bai Ying’s plan and built the Nanwang water-diversion hub. The date is 1411.

fields.name: 陈瑄开清江浦 Chen Xuan opens the Qingjiangpu channel
fields.summary: 永乐十三年，陈瑄开清江浦，使漕船自淮安直达淮河，免陆运过坝。 In 1415 Chen Xuan opened the Qingjiangpu channel, letting grain boats reach the Huai directly and avoid portage over the dams.
fields.description: 永乐十三年（1415），总督漕运陈瑄开清江浦，自淮安城西管家湖凿渠二十里，导水入淮，使漕船免过仁字坝、车轮坝陆运之劳，直达淮河。清江浦由此成为明清漕运总督驻地与运河重镇。日期取 1415 年。 In 1415 Chen Xuan, director-general of grain transport, opened the Qingjiangpu channel, cutting a twenty-li canal from Guanjiacu Lake west of Huai’an to lead water into the Huai and allow grain boats to bypass the Renzi and Chelun dams and their portage. Qingjiangpu became the seat of the Ming–Qing grain transport commissioner and a major canal town. The date is 1415.

name.en: The Dezhou granary and South Canal transshipment

summary.zh: 明代在德州设中转仓，南来漕粮于此收贮、盘拨，再转入北运。

fields.name: 德州仓与南运河转运 The Dezhou granary and South Canal transshipment
fields.summary: 明代在德州设中转仓，南来漕粮于此收贮、盘拨，再转入北运。 Under the Ming a transshipment granary at Dezhou stored and re-loaded southbound grain before it continued north.
fields.description: 明初沿用元代运河，永乐年间疏浚会通河后全线通漕。明廷沿运设淮安、徐州、临清、德州等中转仓（通行说法为「四仓」），漕粮分程盘拨；德州位于卫河（南运河）段，为山东北段重要仓场与码头，南来粮船在此交仓、换船。仓名、建置年份与存粮额待考；日期取 1450 年代表年。 The early Ming used the Yuan canal, and after the Huitong River was dredged in the Yongle reign the whole line carried grain again. The court set up transshipment granaries along the canal at Huai’an, Xuzhou, Linqing and Dezhou (conventionally the “four granaries”), and grain was re-loaded stage by stage. Dezhou stood on the Wei, the southern canal, and was an important granary and wharf on the northern Shandong section where grain boats handed over their cargo and changed vessels. The granary names, foundation dates and storage quotas await verification; the date is a representative year around 1450.

summary.en: The Linqing customs house, set up in the Xuande reign, was one of the canal’s main tax barriers and long ranked among the highest in revenue.

fields.name: 临清钞关 The Linqing customs house
fields.summary: 明宣德年间设临清钞关，为运河沿线重要税关，商税收入长期居前列。 The Linqing customs house, set up in the Xuande reign, was one of the canal’s main tax barriers and long ranked among the highest in revenue.
fields.description: 明宣德四年（1429）始设钞关，临清为运河沿线钞关之一。往来商船按载货量纳税；临清因会通河与卫河交汇、南北商货辐辏，成为运河税关重镇，商税收入长期居各关前列（具体数额异说较多，不取）。临清同时设有中转仓。本事件为税关与商业节点，不绘路线；日期取 1450 年代表年。 Customs houses were established from 1429, the fourth year of Xuande, and Linqing was one of them. Merchant boats paid duty according to cargo volume; because the Huitong and Wei rivers met there and goods from north and south converged, Linqing became a major customs town whose revenue long ranked among the highest of the canal barriers (the exact figures vary and are not adopted here). Linqing also had a transshipment granary. This is a customs and commercial node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1450.

name.en: The Tongzhou granaries and grain entering the capital

summary.zh: 明代通州为漕粮入京门户，设仓场收贮，再经通惠河或陆运入京。
summary.en: Tongzhou was the gateway for grain entering the Ming capital: it was stored in local granaries, then carried on by the Tonghui River or overland.

fields.name: 通州仓与漕粮入京 The Tongzhou granaries and grain entering the capital
fields.summary: 明代通州为漕粮入京门户，设仓场收贮，再经通惠河或陆运入京。 Tongzhou was the gateway for grain entering the Ming capital: it was stored in local granaries, then carried on by the Tonghui River or overland.
fields.description: 明代漕粮经运河抵通州，于张家湾、通州一带卸船入仓，再经通惠河或陆路车运入京仓。通州设有大运仓等仓场（仓名与建置年代待考），是京仓体系的前端。明中期多次修治通惠河，部分漕粮得以水运至北京城下，但多数年份仍需陆运。本事件为仓场节点，不绘路线；日期取 1450 年代表年。 Ming tribute grain reached Tongzhou by canal, was unloaded at Zhangjiawan and Tongzhou into granaries, and then went on to the capital’s granaries by the Tonghui River or by cart. Tongzhou had granaries such as the Dayun store (names and foundation dates await verification) and formed the front end of the capital granary system. The Tonghui River was repaired several times in the mid-Ming so that part of the grain could go by water to the walls of Beijing, but in most years carts were still needed. This is a granary node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1450.

fields.description: 济宁位于会通河与泗水交汇处，元代开河后成为鲁西南漕运枢纽；明清时期州城内外码头、仓场、商号密集，江淮粮船、货船在此停泊转运。济宁也是河道总督、漕运官员驻节与治河物资集散之地。日期取 1450 年代表年，具体市镇形成时间待考。 Jining stood where the Huitong River met the Si. After the Yuan canal works it became a grain-transport hub in southwest Shandong; under the Ming and Qing, wharves, granaries and shops clustered inside and outside the city, and grain and merchant boats from the Jiangnan and Huai regions stopped there for transshipment. It was also a seat for river and grain officials and a depot for river-works supplies. The date is a representative year around 1450; the exact period of the town’s growth awaits verification.

fields.name: 万恭总理河道 Wan Gong directs river management
fields.summary: 隆庆末至万历初，万恭总理河道，主张束水攻沙，治理黄河与运河。 In the late Longqing and early Wanli reigns Wan Gong directed river management, advocating confined-flow scouring of the Yellow River and canal.
fields.description: 隆庆末至万历初，万恭总理河道，治理黄河与运河。他主张「束水攻沙」，修堤束窄河身、以水刷沙，并在山东、淮扬一带修闸、浚河、筑堤；所著《治水筌蹄》总结其治河经验。日期取 1570 年代表年，具体任职月日待考。 From the late Longqing into the early Wanli reign Wan Gong directed river management, dealing with both the Yellow River and the canal. He advocated “confining the flow to scour the sand”, narrowing channels with dikes so that water would cut away sediment, and built locks, dredged channels and raised dikes in Shandong and the Huai–Yangzhou region. His Treatise on Water Control (Zhishui Quanti) summarised the experience. The date is a representative year around 1570; exact appointment dates await verification.

fields.name: 潘季驯治河保运 Pan Jixun manages the rivers to protect the canal
fields.summary: 万历六年，潘季驯总理河道，筑高家堰、塞崔镇决口，以束水攻沙保护运河。 In 1578 Pan Jixun directed river management, building the Gaojiayan dike and closing the Cuizhen breach to protect the canal by confined-flow scouring.
fields.description: 万历六年（1578），潘季驯总理河道，提出「筑堤束水、以水攻沙」，筑高家堰、塞崔镇决口、修清口，保护黄河与运河交汇段。其《河防一览》总结明代治河经验，强调堤防、缕堤、遥堤与减水坝配合，影响清代靳辅等人。日期取 1578 年。 In 1578 Pan Jixun became director-general of river management. He argued for “building dikes to confine the flow and using water to attack sand”, built the Gaojiayan dike, closed the Cuizhen breach and repaired the Qingkou junction to protect the meeting of the Yellow River and the canal. His Comprehensive Survey of River Defence (Hefang Yilan) summarised Ming practice, stressing the coordination of inner, outer and distant dikes with flood-relief dams, and influenced Qing engineers such as Jin Fu. The date is 1578.

fields.name: 靳辅、陈潢治河 Jin Fu and Chen Huang manage the rivers
fields.summary: 康熙十六年，靳辅任河道总督，陈潢协助，筑高家堰、疏清口、开中河。 In 1677 Jin Fu became river viceroy and, with Chen Huang, built the Gaojiayan dike, cleared the Qingkou and opened the Middle River.
fields.description: 康熙十六年（1677），靳辅任河道总督，幕僚陈潢协助，提出「因势利导、束水攻沙」，筑高家堰、疏清口、开中河，使运河避开黄河险段。工程保障了康熙年间漕运，但也留下河床抬高、清口淤积等长期问题。日期取 1677 年。 In 1677 Jin Fu became river viceroy and, with his adviser Chen Huang, pursued “guiding the flow with the terrain and confining water to scour sand”. They rebuilt the Gaojiayan dike, cleared the Qingkou and opened the Middle River so that the canal could avoid the most dangerous stretch of the Yellow River. The works secured grain transport in the Kangxi reign but left long-term problems of raised beds and silting at Qingkou. The date is 1677.

He removed the barrier dam across the Yellow River, cleared the Qingkou and strengthened the Gaojiayan dike, continuing Jin Fu’s approach and restoring the Yellow River to its old channel so that the canal could flow. His Complete Book of River Management (Zhihe Quanshu) records early Qing river administration and works. The date is 1700.

fields.description: 清代苏州是江南漕粮与丝货的集散中心。城西枫桥为著名米市，湖广、江西米船经运河而来；阊门内外为商货码头，丝绸、棉布由此北运。苏州织造、漕粮转运与丝米贸易相互支撑，府城与运河、娄江、吴淞江水网连成一体。本事件为市场节点，不绘路线；日期取 1750 年代表年。 Qing Suzhou was a collection and distribution centre for Jiangnan tribute grain and silk. The Fengqiao market west of the city was a famous rice market reached by grain boats from Huguang and Jiangxi via the canal; the Changmen quarter inside and outside the gate was a goods wharf from which silk and cotton cloth went north. The Suzhou imperial silkworks, grain transshipment and the silk-rice trade supported one another, and the prefectural city was linked into the canal, Lou and Wusong river network. This is a market node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1750.

fields.name: 扬州盐运 Yangzhou’s salt trade
fields.summary: 清代两淮盐运使司驻扬州，盐船经运河转运，盐商云集。 The Qing Lianghuai salt commissioner sat at Yangzhou, salt boats moved by canal trade routes, and salt merchants gathered in the city.
fields.description: 清代两淮盐运使司驻扬州，两淮盐场所产之盐经运河与长江转运各地；盐商聚集扬州，园林、书院与市镇因盐利而兴。盐运与漕运共用运河航道，但管理机关不同：盐政归盐运使司，漕粮归漕运总督，两条系统在淮扬段并行。本事件为盐运与市场节点，不绘路线；日期取 1750 年代表年。 Under the Qing the Lianghuai salt commissioner was based at Yangzhou, and salt from the Lianghuai salterns was shipped to markets by canal and Yangtze. Salt merchants gathered in Yangzhou, and gardens, academies and market towns grew on salt profits. Salt and tribute grain shared the canal channel but had separate administrations: salt under the salt commissioner, grain under the director-general of grain transport, the two systems running side by side on the Huai–Yangzhou section. This is a salt-trade and market node; no route is drawn. The date is a representative year around 1750.

fields.name: 陶澍、贺长龄漕粮海运 Tao Shu and He Changling ship grain by sea
fields.summary: 道光六年，陶澍、贺长龄主持漕粮海运，自上海雇商船运至天津。 In 1826 Tao Shu and He Changling organised sea transport of grain from Shanghai to Tianjin using merchant ships.
fields.description: 道光六年（1826），江苏巡抚陶澍、布政使贺长龄主持漕粮海运，雇商船自上海运苏、松、常、镇、太仓漕米至天津，以避运河淤塞。此次海运成功，为近代漕运改革先声；贺长龄辑《海运全案》记其始末。日期取 1826 年。 In 1826 Tao Shu, governor of Jiangsu, and He Changling, provincial administration commissioner, organised the sea transport of grain. Merchant ships carried the tribute rice of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang and Taicang from Shanghai to Tianjin, bypassing the silted canal. The success was a precedent for modern transport reform; He Changling compiled the Complete Record of Sea Transport (Haiyun Quanan). The date is 1826.

atlasTitle.en: The Grand Canal

name.en: The Yellow River changes course and damages the canal

summary.zh: 咸丰五年，黄河在兰考铜瓦厢决口改道，冲断运河，山东段漕运受阻。
summary.en: In 1855 the Yellow River burst its banks at Tongwaxiang in Lankao and changed course, breaking the canal and disrupting grain transport in Shandong.

fields.name: 黄河改道冲击运河 The Yellow River changes course and damages the canal
fields.summary: 咸丰五年，黄河在兰考铜瓦厢决口改道，冲断运河，山东段漕运受阻。 In 1855 the Yellow River burst its banks at Tongwaxiang in Lankao and changed course, breaking the canal and disrupting grain transport in Shandong.
fields.description: 清咸丰五年（1855）六月，黄河在河南兰考铜瓦厢决口，向北改道，经长垣、东明、濮州、范县、寿张、张秋，穿运河后夺大清河入海。改道冲断会通河，山东段运河淤塞，漕运受阻；此后黄河长期夺大清河入海，运河治理更加困难。铜瓦厢改道是京杭大运河由盛转衰的关键自然—工程事件。日期取决口发生的 1855 年 8 月（咸丰五年六月），具体日待考。 In the sixth month of the fifth year of Xianfeng (August 1855), the Yellow River burst at Tongwaxiang in Lankao, Henan, and shifted north through Changyuan, Dongming, Puzhou, Fanxian, Shouzhang and Zhangqiu, crossing the canal and taking over the Daqing River to the sea. The shift cut the Huitong River, silted the Shandong section and obstructed grain transport; thereafter the Yellow River long followed the Daqing channel, making canal management far harder. The Tongwaxiang shift was the key natural and engineering event in the Grand Canal’s decline. The date is given as August 1855 (sixth month of Xianfeng 5); the exact day awaits verification.

fields.description: 同治十一年（1872），李鸿章创办轮船招商局，总局设上海，承运江浙漕粮，兼营客货。招商局以蒸汽轮船取代部分木帆船漕运，标志着运河漕运向近代航运过渡。日期取 1872 年。 In 1872 Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company, headquartered in Shanghai. It carried tribute grain from Jiangsu and Zhejiang and also operated passenger and freight services. Its steamships replaced part of the wooden-sail grain fleet and marked the transition from canal transport to modern shipping. The date is 1872.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

name.zh: 照金苏区反“围剿”与红军撤离
name.en: KMT encirclement of Zhaojin and the Red Army's withdrawal

place.zh: 陕西耀县照金（今铜川市耀州区照金镇）
place.en: Zhaojin, Yao county, Shaanxi (today Zhaojin town, Yaozhou district, Tongchuan)

summary.zh: 国民党军 4 个正规团及各县民团围攻照金，刘志丹率主力撤离；10 月 18 日薛家寨失守，陕甘边党政军转入外线。
summary.en: Four KMT regular regiments and county militia attacked Zhaojin. Liu Zhidan led the main force out; Xuejiazhai fell on 18 October and the border base shifted to exterior lines.

fields.name: 照金苏区反“围剿”与红军撤离 KMT encirclement of Zhaojin and the Red Army's withdrawal
fields.place: 陕西耀县照金（今铜川市耀州区照金镇） Zhaojin, Yao county, Shaanxi (today Zhaojin town, Yaozhou district, Tongchuan)
fields.summary: 国民党军 4 个正规团及各县民团围攻照金，刘志丹率主力撤离；10 月 18 日薛家寨失守，陕甘边党政军转入外线。 Four KMT regular regiments and county militia attacked Zhaojin. Liu Zhidan led the main force out; Xuejiazhai fell on 18 October and the border base shifted to exterior lines.
fields.description: 1933 年 10 月 12 日，国民党以杨子恒为总指挥，调集 4 个正规团及耀县、淳化、旬邑等县民团数千人，携带大炮向照金苏区发起大规模“围剿”。刘志丹率红二十六军主力主动撤离照金，转至外线作战；习仲勋等留在照金坚持斗争，随后撤出薛家寨。10 月 18 日，敌军在叛徒引路下从后沟石缝攀上薛家寨，寨内守军与边区机关突围，薛家寨失守。陕甘边党政军随后向包家寨、南梁方向转移，11 月 3—5 日在包家寨召开联席会议，决定恢复红二十六军、创建以南梁为中心的根据地。 On 12 October 1933 the KMT, under Yang Ziheng, sent four regular regiments and several thousand militia from Yao, Chunhua and Xunyi counties with artillery against the Zhaojin base. Liu Zhidan withdrew the main force of the 26th Red Army to exterior lines, while Xi Zhongxun and others stayed behind and later left Xuejiazhai. On 18 October, guided by a traitor, enemy troops climbed the rear gorge into Xuejiazhai; the defenders and border organs broke out and the stronghold fell. The border party, government and army then moved toward Baojiazhai and Nanliang, where the 3–5 November conference decided to restore the 26th Red Army and build the Nanliang base.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 甘肃合水包家寨（今蒿咀铺乡张举塬村）

summary.zh: 陕甘边特委与红军临时总指挥部联席会议，决定恢复红二十六军、以南梁为中心创建根据地。
summary.en: A joint conference of the border special committee and the provisional Red Army command decided to restore the 26th Red Army and build the base around Nanliang.

fields.name: 包家寨会议 Baojiazhai conference
fields.place: 甘肃合水包家寨（今蒿咀铺乡张举塬村） Baojiazhai, Heshui, Gansu (Zhangjuyuan village, Haozipu)
fields.summary: 陕甘边特委与红军临时总指挥部联席会议，决定恢复红二十六军、以南梁为中心创建根据地。 A joint conference of the border special committee and the provisional Red Army command decided to restore the 26th Red Army and build the base around Nanliang.
fields.description: 1933 年 11 月 3—5 日，中共陕甘边区特委、陕甘边区革命委员会和红军临时总指挥部在合水县包家寨（今蒿咀铺乡张举塬村）召开联席会议。会议总结照金失守的教训，决定撤销红军临时总指挥部，恢复红二十六军、成立第四十二师（王泰吉任师长、高岗任政委、刘志丹任参谋长），进军南梁建立根据地，并划分陕北安定、陇东南梁、关中照金三路游击区。11 月 8 日在平定川莲花寺宣布红四十二师成立，全师 500 余人。会议旧址在张举塬村东峁，坐标取蒿咀铺乡代表点。 From 3 to 5 November 1933 the Shaanxi-Gansu Border Special Committee, the border revolutionary committee and the provisional Red Army command met at Baojiazhai (Zhangjuyuan village, Haozipu township, Heshui). Reviewing the loss of Zhaojin, the conference abolished the provisional command, restored the 26th Red Army and formed its 42nd Division (Wang Taiji commander, Gao Gang political commissar, Liu Zhidan chief of staff), decided to march on Nanliang and build the base there, and divided three guerrilla zones — Anding in northern Shaanxi, Nanliang in eastern Gansu, Zhaojin in Guanzhong. On 8 November the 42nd Division was proclaimed at Lianhuasi, Pingdingchuan, some 500 strong. The meeting site is at the eastern ridge of Zhangjuyuan; the coordinate uses the Haozipu township point.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

name.en: First counter-encirclement campaign in the Shaanxi-Gansu border area

summary.zh: 红四十二师转外线作战，经 30 余次战斗挫败国民党军对南梁的“围剿”。
summary.en: The 42nd Division fought on exterior lines and broke the KMT encirclement of Nanliang in over 30 actions.

fields.name: 陕甘边第一次反“围剿” First counter-encirclement campaign in the Shaanxi-Gansu border area
fields.place: 甘肃华池南梁 Nanliang, Huachi, Gansu
fields.summary: 红四十二师转外线作战，经 30 余次战斗挫败国民党军对南梁的“围剿”。 The 42nd Division fought on exterior lines and broke the KMT encirclement of Nanliang in over 30 actions.
fields.description: 1934 年 2 月，国民党西安绥署调集第十七路军驻陇东警备第二旅 2 个团、陕西警备骑兵旅 2 个团、第 42 师 1 个团及第 86 师一部和民团共万余人，分路合击以南梁为中心的陕甘边苏区。红四十二师以部分游击队袭扰牵制，主力转至外线：3 月经三道川、蔺家砭、李家梁战斗歼骑兵旅第二团 4 个连，4 月 11 日在西华池歼 700 余人，5 月上旬在三里塬歼 2 个连，5 月下旬北返南梁，6 月在马子川击退第 86 师 1 个营。经 30 余次战斗，毙伤国民党军及民团 3000 余人，挫败围剿，南梁根据地得到巩固并扩大。陕北方向的同期反围剿另见「陕北苏区第一次反“围剿”」。 In February 1934 the Xi’an garrison headquarters sent over 10,000 troops — two regiments of the 2nd Security Brigade in eastern Gansu, two of the Shaanxi Security Cavalry Brigade, one regiment of the 42nd Division, part of the 86th Division and militia — against the Shaanxi-Gansu border base centred on Nanliang. Leaving guerrillas to harass and pin the enemy, the 42nd Division moved to exterior lines: in March it destroyed four companies of the cavalry brigade’s 2nd Regiment at Sandaochan, Linjiabian and Lijialiang; on 11 April it annihilated over 700 men at Xihuachi; in early May two companies at Sanliyuan; in late May it returned north to Nanliang and in June drove off a battalion of the 86th Division at Mazichuan. In over 30 actions it killed or wounded more than 3,000 KMT troops and militia, breaking the campaign and consolidating and expanding the Nanliang base. The simultaneous campaign in northern Shaanxi is a separate event.

name.zh: 陕甘边区革命委员会成立
name.en: Founding of the Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Committee

place.zh: 甘肃华池南梁小河沟四合台

summary.zh: 陕甘边区革命委员会在南梁小河沟四合台成立，习仲勋任主席。
summary.en: The Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Committee was founded at Sihetai, Nanliang, with Xi Zhongxun as chairman.

fields.name: 陕甘边区革命委员会成立 Founding of the Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Committee
fields.place: 甘肃华池南梁小河沟四合台 Sihetai, Xiaohegou, Nanliang, Huachi, Gansu
fields.summary: 陕甘边区革命委员会在南梁小河沟四合台成立，习仲勋任主席。 The Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Committee was founded at Sihetai, Nanliang, with Xi Zhongxun as chairman.
fields.description: 1934 年 2 月 25 日，中共红四十二师党委主持在南梁小河沟四合台村召开群众大会，成立新的陕甘边区革命委员会，选举习仲勋为主席，白天章、贾生秀任副主席，蔡子伟任政治秘书长。革命委员会的成立标志陕甘苏区初具规模；同年 11 月 1—7 日，陕甘边区苏维埃政府在荔园堡成立。 On 25 February 1934 a mass meeting convened by the 42nd Division’s party committee at Sihetai, Xiaohegou, Nanliang, founded a new Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Committee, electing Xi Zhongxun chairman with Bai Tianzhang and Jia Shengxiu as vice-chairmen and Cai Ziwei as political secretary. Its founding marked the emergence of the Shaanxi-Gansu Soviet area; the border Soviet government proper was established at Liyuanpu on 1–7 November the same year.

fields.place: 甘肃合水西华池（今合水县城） Xihuachi, Heshui, Gansu (today’s Heshui county town)
fields.summary: 红四十二师在西华池歼陇东警备第二旅第五团团部及两个营。 The 42nd Division destroyed the headquarters and two battalions of the 5th Regiment, 2nd Security Brigade, at Xihuachi.
fields.description: 1934 年 4 月 11 日，红四十二师在西华池（今合水县城）地区歼灭国民党陇东警备第二旅第五团团部及 2 个营，计 700 余人，缴枪 500 余支。此战为陕甘边第一次反“围剿”外线作战的重要一仗；另有一说记为 4 月 2 日、毙俘 600 余人。 On 11 April 1934 the 42nd Division annihilated the headquarters and two battalions of the 5th Regiment, 2nd Security Brigade, at Xihuachi (today’s Heshui county town) — over 700 men — and captured more than 500 rifles. It was a key action on the exterior lines of the first counter-encirclement campaign; another account gives 2 April and 600-odd killed and captured.

summary.en: The 42nd Division destroyed two companies of the Shaanxi guerrilla detachment in an encounter at Sanliyuan, Chunhua.

fields.name: 三里塬战斗 Action at Sanliyuan
fields.place: 陕西淳化三里塬（今十里塬镇三里塬村一带） Sanliyuan, Chunhua, Shaanxi (Sanliyuan village, Shilixiang town)
fields.summary: 红四十二师在淳化三里塬遭遇战中歼陕西游击支队两个连。 The 42nd Division destroyed two companies of the Shaanxi guerrilla detachment in an encounter at Sanliyuan, Chunhua.
fields.description: 1934 年 5 月上旬，红四十二师在淳化三里塬与国民党陕西游击支队遭遇，歼其 2 个连。此后国民党军以 8 个团兵力开始新的“围剿”，红四十二师于 5 月下旬北返南梁。三里塬取今淳化县十里塬镇三里塬村一带代表点，战场具体位置待核。 In early May 1934 the 42nd Division encountered the KMT Shaanxi guerrilla detachment at Sanliyuan, Chunhua, and destroyed two of its companies. The KMT then began a new encirclement with eight regiments, and the division returned north to Nanliang in late May. Sanliyuan uses the Sanliyuan village area of Shilixiang town, Chunhua; the exact battle site awaits verification.

name.zh: 陕北苏区第一次反“围剿”
name.en: First counter-encirclement campaign in northern Shaanxi

place.zh: 陕西安定县城（今子长市安定镇）
place.en: Anding county town (Anding town, Zichang), Shaanxi

summary.zh: 陕北游击队与红四十二师第三团协同，打破第八十六师对陕北苏区的“清剿”。
summary.en: Northern Shaanxi guerrillas and the 42nd Division’s 3rd Regiment broke the 86th Division’s clearance of the northern Shaanxi Soviet area.

fields.name: 陕北苏区第一次反“围剿” First counter-encirclement campaign in northern Shaanxi
fields.place: 陕西安定县城（今子长市安定镇） Anding county town (Anding town, Zichang), Shaanxi
fields.summary: 陕北游击队与红四十二师第三团协同，打破第八十六师对陕北苏区的“清剿”。 Northern Shaanxi guerrillas and the 42nd Division’s 3rd Regiment broke the 86th Division’s clearance of the northern Shaanxi Soviet area.
fields.description: 1934 年 5 月起，井岳秀第八十六师及各县民团共 1.5 万余人对陕北苏区“清剿”。7 月 8 日陕北游击队总指挥部在安定杨道峁成立，谢子长任总指挥；7 月 17 日攻入安定县城，释放被捕党员和群众 200 余人。7 月下旬谢子长南下南梁与红四十二师会合，任师政委；8 月 15 日率红三团及陕北游击队第 1、2、5 支队返回安定，经景武家塌、张家圪台、河口镇、董家寺等战斗，拔除三个据点，歼敌 200 余人、俘 100 余人；谢子长在 8 月 26 日河口镇战斗中胸部负伤。历时三个多月，打破了对陕北苏区的第一次“围剿”。这与陕甘边方向 1934 年 2—6 月的反“围剿”是同一轮“围剿”的两个战场。 From May 1934 Jing Yuexiu’s 86th Division and county militia, over 15,000 strong, cleared the northern Shaanxi Soviet area. On 8 July the Northern Shaanxi Guerrilla Headquarters was formed at Yangdaomao, Anding, under Xie Zichang; on 17 July it took Anding county town and freed over 200 imprisoned party members and supporters. In late July Xie went south to Nanliang, joined the 42nd Division and became its political commissar; on 15 August he returned to Anding with the 3rd Regiment and the 1st, 2nd and 5th guerrilla detachments, and through the actions at Jingwujiajia, Zhangjiagetai, Hekou and Dongjiasi the reds destroyed three enemy posts, killing over 200 and capturing more than 100. Xie was wounded in the chest at Hekou on 26 August. In just over three months the first encirclement of northern Shaanxi was broken — the second theatre of the same round that included the February–June campaign in the Shaanxi-Gansu border area.

name.en: Red Sixth Army Group sets out westward

summary.zh: 红六军团从湘赣苏区突围，开始西征。
summary.en: The Red Sixth Army Group broke out of the Hunan-Jiangxi Soviet area and began its westward expedition.

fields.name: 红六军团西征出发 Red Sixth Army Group sets out westward
fields.summary: 红六军团从湘赣苏区突围，开始西征。 The Red Sixth Army Group broke out of the Hunan-Jiangxi Soviet area and began its westward expedition.
fields.description: 1934 年 8 月 7 日，红六军团从湘赣苏区遂川一带出发西征，为中央红军战略转移探路。日期与出发地点为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On August 7, 1934, the Red Sixth Army Group set out westward from the Suichuan area of the Hunan-Jiangxi Soviet area, scouting the way for the Central Red Army’s strategic transfer. fields.name: 国民党军第二道封锁线（湘军、粤军） KMT Second Blockade Line (Hunan and Guangdong Armies) 第二道封锁线 Second Blockade Line 汝城—城口封锁线 Rucheng–Chengkou Blockade Line

fields.summary: 国民党军在汝城—城口间构筑第二道封锁线，红军于 11 月 5—8 日突破。 KMT forces built the second blockade line between Rucheng and Chengkou; the Red Army broke through on 5–8 November.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月初，蒋介石令湘军何键、粤军陈济棠在湖南汝城至广东城口间构筑第二道封锁线，以碉堡群控制湘粤通道。11 月 1 日，中革军委令红一军团夺取城口、红三军团夺取汝城；红一军团第二师第六团第一营急行军 220 余里，于 11 月 2 日夜袭占城口；汝城守敌较多，红军以一部监视，主力于 11 月 5 日从汝城、城口间分三路通过，至 11 月 8 日全部突破封锁线。本坐标为汝城—城口间代表点，具体碉堡线待考。 In early November 1934, Chiang Kai-shek ordered He Jian’s Hunan troops and Chen Jitang’s Guangdong troops to build the second blockade line between Rucheng in Hunan and Chengkou in Guangdong, using blockhouses to control the Hunan–Guangdong corridor. On 1 November the CMC ordered the First Army Corps to take Chengkou and the Third Army Corps to take Rucheng. The 1st Battalion of the 6th Regiment, Second Division, marched over 220 li and seized Chengkou by night on 2 November. Rucheng was too strongly held, so the Red Army monitored it and moved the main force through the Rucheng–Chengkou gap in three columns from 5 November, completing the breakthrough by 8 November. The coordinate is a representative point between Rucheng and Chengkou; the exact blockhouse line awaits verification.

place.zh: 湖南永顺万坪镇龙家寨（十万坪）

summary.zh: 红二、六军团在永顺龙家寨十万坪伏击国民党军陈渠珍部，取得会师后第一个大胜仗。
summary.en: The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups ambushed Chen Quzhen’s Hunan forces at Shiwangping and won their first major victory after joining forces.

fields.name: 十万坪大捷 Victory at Shiwangping 龙家寨战斗 Battle of Longjiazhai
fields.place: 湖南永顺万坪镇龙家寨（十万坪） Longjiazhai (Shiwangping), Wanping, Yongshun, Hunan
fields.summary: 红二、六军团在永顺龙家寨十万坪伏击国民党军陈渠珍部，取得会师后第一个大胜仗。 The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups ambushed Chen Quzhen’s Hunan forces at Shiwangping and won their first major victory after joining forces.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月 13 日红二、六军团主动撤离永顺县城北撤，16 日黄昏在龙家寨十万坪谷地伏击尾追的国民党军陈渠珍部龚仁杰、周燮卿两旅，战至深夜，又在把总河击溃杨其昌旅；17 日在龙家寨开庆功大会，18 日重占永顺县城。此役歼敌 1000 余人、俘 2000 余人，缴枪 2200 余支，是两军团会师后第一个大胜仗。万坪镇即旧龙家寨，镇政府驻十万坪，战场在今万坪镇上坪、碑立坪一带。 On 13 November 1934 the Second and Sixth Army Groups deliberately abandoned Yongshun and withdrew north. At dusk on 16 November they ambushed the pursuing brigades of Gong Renjie and Zhou Xieqing of Chen Quzhen’s Hunan army in the Shiwangping valley at Longjiazhai, and late that night routed Yang Qichang’s brigade at Bazonghe. A victory rally was held at Longjiazhai on 17 November and Yongshun was retaken on 18 November. The battle killed over 1,000 and captured over 2,000 enemy troops with more than 2,200 rifles, the first major victory after the two army groups joined. Wanping town is the former Longjiazhai; its government seat is at Shiwangping and the battlefield lies around today’s Shangping and Beiliping villages.

name.zh: 国民党军湘江封锁线（湘军、桂军）

summary.zh: 国民党军以湘江为第四道封锁线，湘军由全州南下、桂军由兴安与灌阳北上，企图夹击中央红军。
summary.en: Kuomintang forces used the Xiang River as a fourth blockade line, with Hunan troops driving south from Quanzhou and Guangxi troops north from Xing’an and Guanyang to trap the Central Red Army.

fields.name: 国民党军湘江封锁线（湘军、桂军） KMT Xiang River Blockade
fields.summary: 国民党军以湘江为第四道封锁线，湘军由全州南下、桂军由兴安与灌阳北上，企图夹击中央红军。 Kuomintang forces used the Xiang River as a fourth blockade line, with Hunan troops driving south from Quanzhou and Guangxi troops north from Xing’an and Guanyang to trap the Central Red Army.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月，国民党军以第四路军（何键部）和桂军（白崇禧部）等依托湘江构筑第四道封锁线，集结重兵堵截中央红军。湘军刘建绪部由全州南下，桂军由兴安、灌阳北上，企图在湘江以东夹击红军。红军在屏山、大坪、凤凰嘴、界首等渡口和新圩、脚山铺、光华铺等阻击阵地与敌激战，最终突破封锁线，但伤亡重大。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1934, Kuomintang forces including the Fourth Route Army (He Jian) and Guangxi forces (Bai Chongxi) established a fourth blockade line along the Xiang River and concentrated troops to intercept the Central Red Army. Liu Jianxu’s Hunan troops drove south from Quanzhou while Guangxi troops moved north from Xing’an and Guanyang, seeking to crush the Red Army east of the river. The Red Army fought at the Pingshan, Daping, Fenghuangzui, and Jieshou ferries and at the Xinxu, Jiaoshanpu, and Guanghuapu blocking positions before breaking through at heavy cost. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 广西兴安界首渡口（湘江战役主渡口）
place.en: Jieshou Ferry, Xing’an, Guangxi (main crossing of the Xiang River battle)

summary.zh: 中央红军在兴安、全州、灌阳间强渡湘江，突破第四道封锁线，由八万余人锐减至三万余人。
summary.en: The Central Red Army crossed the Xiang River between Xing’an, Quanzhou, and Guanyang, breaking the fourth blockade line and falling from over 80,000 to about 30,000 troops.

fields.name: 湘江战役 Battle of the Xiang River 湘江血战 Battle of the Xiang River 突破第四道封锁线 Breaking the Fourth Blockade Line
fields.place: 广西兴安界首渡口（湘江战役主渡口） Jieshou Ferry, Xing’an, Guangxi (main crossing of the Xiang River battle)
fields.summary: 中央红军在兴安、全州、灌阳间强渡湘江，突破第四道封锁线，由八万余人锐减至三万余人。 The Central Red Army crossed the Xiang River between Xing’an, Quanzhou, and Guanyang, breaking the fourth blockade line and falling from over 80,000 to about 30,000 troops.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月 27 日至 12 月 1 日，中央红军在广西兴安、全州、灌阳之间的湘江上游抢渡，突破国民党军第四道封锁线。红军先后控制屏山、大坪、凤凰嘴、界首等渡口，以新圩、脚山铺、光华铺三大阻击战掩护中央纵队渡江。11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日，军委第一、第二纵队从界首浮桥渡江；红五、红八、红九军团等部则在下游凤凰嘴涉渡。12 月 1 日下午界首浮桥被炸毁，担任后卫的红五军团第三十四师、红三军团第十八团被阻于湘江以东，损失惨重。此役后中央红军由出发时的八万余人锐减至三万余人。 From 27 November to 1 December 1934, the Central Red Army crossed the upper Xiang River between Xing’an, Quanzhou, and Guanyang in Guangxi, breaking the Kuomintang’s fourth blockade line. The Red Army controlled the Pingshan, Daping, Fenghuangzui, and Jieshou ferries in succession and used the Xinxu, Jiaoshanpu, and Guanghuapu blocking battles to cover the crossing of the central column. On 30 November and 1 December, the First and Second Columns of the Military Commission crossed over the Jieshou pontoon bridge, while the Fifth, Eighth, and Ninth Army Corps forded downstream at Fenghuangzui. When the Jieshou bridge was blown up on the afternoon of 1 December, the rearguard Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps and the Eighteenth Regiment of the Third Army Corps were cut off east of the river and suffered heavy losses. The Central Red Army fell from more than 80,000 troops at the start of the Long March to about 30,000.

place.zh: 广西灌阳水车镇（灌江沿岸）
place.en: Shuiche, Guanyang, Guangxi (along the Guan River)

summary.zh: 红五军团第三十四师担任全军总后卫，在道县蒋家岭至灌阳水车一线节节阻击，12 月 1 日被阻于湘江东岸。
summary.en: The Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps served as the army’s final rearguard, fighting delaying actions from Jiangjialing in Daoxian to Shuiche in Guanyang before being cut off east of the Xiang River on 1 December.

fields.name: 红三十四师后卫阻击 Thirty-Fourth Division Rearguard Action 红三十四师绝命后卫 Thirty-Fourth Division’s Desperate Rearguard 水车阻击战 Shuiche Blocking Battle
fields.place: 广西灌阳水车镇（灌江沿岸） Shuiche, Guanyang, Guangxi (along the Guan River)
fields.summary: 红五军团第三十四师担任全军总后卫，在道县蒋家岭至灌阳水车一线节节阻击，12 月 1 日被阻于湘江东岸。 The Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps served as the army’s final rearguard, fighting delaying actions from Jiangjialing in Daoxian to Shuiche in Guanyang before being cut off east of the Xiang River on 1 December.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月 27 日至 29 日，红五军团第三十四师奉命在湖南道县蒋家岭、永安关、雷口关一线节节阻击追敌，掩护红八、红九军团西进。29 日 15 时，中革军委电令该师赶赴灌阳新圩接防，30 日晨在水车一带掩护红八军团离开灌阳，随即遭桂军飞机轰炸和地面进攻。12 月 1 日，该师由水车赶往枫树脚接防时，渡口和道路已被切断，全师被阻于湘江东岸。此后经全州安和文塘、灌阳板桥铺等地突围，损失惨重，余部转战湘南。本坐标为水车镇代表点，具体阵地范围待实地核对。 From 27 to 29 November 1934, the Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps fought delaying actions at Jiangjialing, Yong’an Pass, and Leikou Pass in Daoxian, Hunan, covering the westward movement of the Eighth and Ninth Army Corps. At 15:00 on 29 November the Military Commission ordered the division to relieve the defenses at Xinxu, Guanyang. At dawn on 30 November it covered the Eighth Army Corps’ departure from Guanyang at Shuiche, then came under air attack and ground assault by Guangxi troops. On 1 December, as the division moved from Shuiche toward Fengshujiao, the ferries and roads were already cut, leaving the whole division stranded east of the Xiang River. It subsequently broke out through Wentang in Anhe, Quanzhou, and Banqiaopu in Guanyang at heavy cost, with survivors continuing to fight in southern Hunan. This coordinate is the representative point of Shuiche town; the exact position of the defensive line awaits field verification.

fields.place: 广西全州凤凰镇大坪村与绍水镇洛口村之间 Between Daping Village, Fenghuang, and Luokou Village, Shaoshui, Quanzhou, Guangxi
fields.summary: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，红一军团主力最早由此渡过湘江，被称为“突破湘江第一渡”。 One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle, where the main force of the First Army Corps made the earliest crossing, known as the “first ferry of the Xiang River breakthrough.”
fields.description: 大坪渡口位于全州县凤凰镇大坪村与绍水镇洛口村之间的湘江上，东岸为大坪村，西岸为洛口村，是全州历史上的古渡。1934 年 11 月 27 日凌晨，红一军团第二师及红一师第二团趁桂军南撤之机，从大坪渡口渡过湘江，成为湘江战役中最早过江的红军部队，因此被称为“红军长征突破湘江第一渡”。随后红一军团控制了屏山至界首约 30 公里的湘江渡口。本坐标为根据里程与河道走向推算的近似位置，待现场实测。 Daping Ferry crosses the Xiang River between Daping Village in Fenghuang and Luokou Village in Shaoshui, Quanzhou. In the early hours of 27 November 1934, the Second Division of the First Army Corps and the Second Regiment of the First Division crossed here while Guangxi troops were withdrawing south, making them the earliest Red Army units across the Xiang River and earning the site the name “first ferry of the Xiang River breakthrough.” The First Army Corps then controlled the ferries along some 30 km of river from Pingshan to Jieshou. This coordinate is estimated from distances and river alignment and awaits field verification.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 广西灌阳新圩镇（枫树脚、板桥铺、酒海井一带）
place.en: Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi (Fengshujiao, Banqiaopu, and Jiuhaijing area)

summary.zh: 红三军团第五师在新圩阻击北上桂军，是湘江战役三大阻击战的首战。
summary.en: The Fifth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Xinxu, the first of the three major blocking battles of the Xiang River campaign.

fields.name: 新圩阻击战 Xinxu Blocking Battle 新圩阻击战（灌阳） Xinxu Blocking Battle (Guanyang) 枫树脚阻击战 Fengshujiao Blocking Battle
fields.place: 广西灌阳新圩镇（枫树脚、板桥铺、酒海井一带） Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi (Fengshujiao, Banqiaopu, and Jiuhaijing area)
fields.summary: 红三军团第五师在新圩阻击北上桂军，是湘江战役三大阻击战的首战。 The Fifth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Xinxu, the first of the three major blocking battles of the Xiang River campaign.
fields.description: 新圩位于灌阳县西北部，是灌阳通往湘江的必经之路。1934 年 11 月 28 日拂晓，红三军团第五师在新圩、枫树脚、板桥铺一线阻击北上的桂军，战斗持续三天，伤亡 2000 余人；红六师第十八团接防后大部牺牲。新圩阻击战是湘江战役三大阻击战的首战，保住了中央红军前往湘江渡口的通道。现建有新圩阻击战酒海井红军纪念园。 Xinxu lies in northwestern Guanyang on the route from Guanyang to the Xiang River. At dawn on 28 November 1934, the Fifth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked the northward advance of Guangxi troops at Xinxu, Fengshujiao, and Banqiaopu. The three-day battle cost more than 2,000 casualties; the Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, which took over the position, was largely destroyed. As the first of the three major blocking battles, Xinxu kept open the Central Red Army’s route to the Xiang River ferries. The Xinxu Blocking Battle Jiuhai Well Red Army Memorial Park now stands nearby.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 广西全州才湾镇脚山铺（觉山铺）

summary.zh: 红一军团在脚山铺阻击南下湘军，是湘江战役中投入兵力最多、红军牺牲最大的阻击战。
summary.en: The First Army Corps blocked the southward advance of Hunan troops at Jiaoshanpu, the largest and costliest blocking battle of the Xiang River campaign.

fields.name: 脚山铺阻击战 Jiaoshanpu Blocking Battle 觉山铺阻击战 Jueshanpu Blocking Battle 脚山阻击战 Jiaoshan Blocking Battle
fields.place: 广西全州才湾镇脚山铺（觉山铺） Jiaoshanpu (Jueshanpu), Caiwan, Quanzhou, Guangxi
fields.summary: 红一军团在脚山铺阻击南下湘军，是湘江战役中投入兵力最多、红军牺牲最大的阻击战。 The First Army Corps blocked the southward advance of Hunan troops at Jiaoshanpu, the largest and costliest blocking battle of the Xiang River campaign.
fields.description: 脚山铺又称觉山铺，位于全州县才湾镇，北距全州城约 15 公里，南距界首渡口约 30 公里，桂黄公路穿山而过。1934 年 11 月 29 日起，红一军团第二师及第一师在脚山铺、鲁板桥、白沙河一线阻击湘军刘建绪部。战斗持续三天，红一军团伤亡约 2000 人，红五团政委易荡平牺牲，完成了掩护中央纵队和后续部队渡江的任务。现地建有红军长征湘江战役纪念园、纪念馆。 Jiaoshanpu, also written Jueshanpu, lies in Caiwan, Quanzhou, about 15 km from Quanzhou town and 30 km from Jieshou Ferry, where the Guilin–Huangshahe road cuts through the hills. From 29 November 1934, the Second Division and First Division of the First Army Corps blocked Liu Jianxu’s Hunan troops along the Jiaoshanpu, Lubanqiao, and Baisha River line. The three-day battle cost the First Army Corps about 2,000 casualties, including the death of Fifth Regiment commissar Yi Dangping, but covered the crossing of the central column and follow-up units. The Red Army Long March Xiang River Battle Memorial Park and Museum now stand at the site.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

place.zh: 广西兴安界首镇南光华铺（桂黄公路旁）
place.en: Guanghuapu south of Jieshou, Xing’an, Guangxi (beside the Guilin–Huangshahe road)

summary.zh: 红三军团第四师在光华铺阻击北上桂军，保卫界首渡口，红十团两任团长先后牺牲。
summary.en: The Fourth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Guanghuapu to protect Jieshou Ferry; two successive commanders of the Tenth Regiment were killed.

fields.name: 光华铺阻击战 Guanghuapu Blocking Battle 界首阻击战 Jieshou Blocking Battle 光华铺阻击战旧址 Guanghuapu Blocking Battle Site
fields.place: 广西兴安界首镇南光华铺（桂黄公路旁） Guanghuapu south of Jieshou, Xing’an, Guangxi (beside the Guilin–Huangshahe road)
fields.summary: 红三军团第四师在光华铺阻击北上桂军，保卫界首渡口，红十团两任团长先后牺牲。 The Fourth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Guanghuapu to protect Jieshou Ferry; two successive commanders of the Tenth Regiment were killed.
fields.description: 光华铺位于兴安县界首镇南约 3 至 5 公里、桂黄公路旁，是界首渡口的南面屏障。1934 年 11 月 28 日红三军团第四师接防界首后，以第十团前出光华铺，阻击由兴安北上的桂军。29 日夜间至 12 月 1 日，双方在光华铺、渠口、石门一线反复争夺，红十团团长沈述清、师参谋长杜中美先后牺牲，红三军团伤亡约 1000 人，掩护军委纵队从界首渡江。 Guanghuapu lies about 3–5 km south of Jieshou, Xing’an, beside the Guilin–Huangshahe road, and formed the southern shield of Jieshou Ferry. After the Fourth Division of the Third Army Corps took over the Jieshou defenses on 28 November 1934, it pushed the Tenth Regiment forward to Guanghuapu to block Guangxi troops advancing north from Xing’an. From the night of 29 November to 1 December, the two sides fought repeatedly over Guanghuapu, Qukou, and Shimen. Tenth Regiment commander Shen Shuqing and corps chief of staff Du Zhongmei were killed in succession, and the Third Army Corps suffered about 1,000 casualties while covering the crossing of the Military Commission’s columns at Jieshou.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

name.en: Eighteenth Regiment’s Blocking Action at Xinxu

place.zh: 广西灌阳新圩镇楠木山村、陈家背一带
place.en: Nanmushan and Chenjiabei, Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi

summary.zh: 红三军团第六师第十八团在新圩楠木山接防，以一团之众阻击桂军数个师，几乎全部牺牲。
summary.en: The Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, Third Army Corps, took over at Nanmushan near Xinxu and blocked several Guangxi divisions with a single regiment, suffering near-total losses.

fields.name: 红十八团新圩阻击 Eighteenth Regiment’s Blocking Action at Xinxu 楠木山阻击战 Nanmushan Blocking Battle 红十八团楠木山战斗 Eighteenth Regiment at Nanmushan
fields.place: 广西灌阳新圩镇楠木山村、陈家背一带 Nanmushan and Chenjiabei, Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi
fields.summary: 红三军团第六师第十八团在新圩楠木山接防，以一团之众阻击桂军数个师，几乎全部牺牲。 The Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, Third Army Corps, took over at Nanmushan near Xinxu and blocked several Guangxi divisions with a single regiment, suffering near-total losses.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月 30 日黄昏，红三军团第六师第十八团在新圩接替伤亡惨重的红五师，担负阻击桂军、掩护后续部队渡江的任务。据国防部报道，团长曾春鉴、参谋长吴子雄决定以两个营扼守楠木山村附近的炮楼山，一个营布防陈家背；另有资料称团长姓名至今未查清。12 月 1 日拂晓，桂军向楠木山阵地猛攻，红军弹药耗尽后展开白刃格斗。炮楼山失守后，部队向陈家背靠拢，又在向湘江转移途中被分割包围于全州古岭头一带，1800 余人大部分牺牲。本坐标为楠木山村附近代表点，具体阵地待实地核对。 At dusk on 30 November 1934, the Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, Third Army Corps, relieved the badly mauled Fifth Division at Xinxu and took over the task of blocking Guangxi troops to cover the crossing of follow-up units. According to the Ministry of National Defense account, commander Zeng Chunjian and chief of staff Wu Zixiong deployed two battalions on Paolou Hill near Nanmushan and one battalion at Chenjiabei; other sources state that the commander’s name has never been established. At dawn on 1 December, Guangxi troops stormed the Nanmushan positions, and the Red Army, its ammunition exhausted, fought hand to hand. After Paolou Hill fell the unit fell back toward Chenjiabei and was then surrounded and split apart near Gulingtou in Quanzhou while moving toward the Xiang River; most of its more than 1,800 men were killed. This coordinate is a representative point near Nanmushan village; the exact positions await field verification.

summary.zh: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，红一军团第一师由此渡过湘江赶赴脚山铺。
summary.en: One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle, where the First Division of the First Army Corps crossed to reach Jiaoshanpu.

fields.name: 屏山渡口 Pingshan Ferry 屏山古渡 Pingshan Ancient Ferry 坪山渡口 Pingshan Ferry
fields.place: 广西全州枧塘镇金屏村屏山屯湘江两岸 Pingshan, Jinping Village, Jiantang, Quanzhou, Guangxi
fields.summary: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，红一军团第一师由此渡过湘江赶赴脚山铺。 One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle, where the First Division of the First Army Corps crossed to reach Jiaoshanpu.
fields.description: 屏山渡口位于全州县枧塘镇金屏村屏山屯湘江两岸，距全州城约 10 公里，渡口宽约 500 米，南北两岸为石山，下游有拦河堰可涉渡。1934 年 11 月 30 日凌晨，红一军团第一师从湖南道县急行军赶到，由屏山渡渡过湘江，与从大坪渡江的红二师在脚山铺会合，参加阻击湘军的战斗。本坐标为根据里程与河道走向推算的近似位置，待现场实测。 Pingshan Ferry lies on the Xiang River at Pingshan, Jinping Village, Jiantang, Quanzhou, about 10 km from Quanzhou town. The ferry is about 500 m wide, flanked by rocky hills, with a downstream weir that can be forded. At dawn on 30 November 1934, the First Division of the First Army Corps arrived from Daoxian in Hunan by forced march, crossed at Pingshan, and joined the Second Division at Jiaoshanpu to block the Hunan troops. This coordinate is estimated from distances and river alignment and awaits field verification.

place.en: Jieshou, Xing’an, Guangxi, on the Xiang River near Sanguantang (Red Army Hall)

summary.zh: 湘江战役主渡口，军委第一、第二纵队于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日由浮桥渡过湘江。
summary.en: The main crossing of the Xiang River battle, where the First and Second Columns of the Military Commission crossed over a pontoon bridge on 30 November–1 December.

fields.name: 界首渡口 Jieshou Ferry 界首古渡 Jieshou Ancient Ferry 界首渡 Jieshou Crossing
fields.place: 广西兴安界首镇湘江边（三官堂/红军堂附近） Jieshou, Xing’an, Guangxi, on the Xiang River near Sanguantang (Red Army Hall)
fields.summary: 湘江战役主渡口，军委第一、第二纵队于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日由浮桥渡过湘江。 The main crossing of the Xiang River battle, where the First and Second Columns of the Military Commission crossed over a pontoon bridge on 30 November–1 December.
fields.description: 界首渡口位于兴安县界首镇湘江边，与全州县相邻，是湘江上游的重要古渡。1934 年 11 月 30 日凌晨，军委第一纵队在工兵架设的浮桥上游过湘江；第二纵队随红三军团行动，当日黄昏渡江。12 月 1 日下午，工兵奉命炸毁浮桥。渡口西岸的三官堂（红军堂）曾是红军渡江指挥部，彭德怀、朱德、周恩来等在此指挥渡江与阻击战。 Jieshou Ferry lies on the Xiang River at Jieshou, Xing’an, near the border with Quanzhou, and was an important ancient crossing on the upper Xiang. At dawn on 30 November 1934, the First Column of the Military Commission crossed over a pontoon bridge built by engineers; the Second Column, moving with the Third Army Corps, crossed at dusk that day. On the afternoon of 1 December, engineers blew up the bridge on orders. Sanguantang (Red Army Hall) on the west bank served as the crossing command post, where Peng Dehuai, Zhu De, and Zhou Enlai directed the crossing and blocking battles.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

place.zh: 广西全州凤凰镇和平村建安司湘江边
place.en: Jian’ansi, Heping Village, Fenghuang, Quanzhou, Guangxi

summary.zh: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，也是红军牺牲最多的渡口；界首浮桥被炸后，后续部队改由此涉渡。
summary.en: One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle and the crossing with the heaviest Red Army casualties; follow-up units forded here after the Jieshou bridge was destroyed.

fields.name: 凤凰嘴渡口 Fenghuangzui Ferry 麻子渡 Mazidu Ferry 建安司渡口 Jian’ansi Ferry
fields.place: 广西全州凤凰镇和平村建安司湘江边 Jian’ansi, Heping Village, Fenghuang, Quanzhou, Guangxi
fields.summary: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，也是红军牺牲最多的渡口；界首浮桥被炸后，后续部队改由此涉渡。 One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle and the crossing with the heaviest Red Army casualties; follow-up units forded here after the Jieshou bridge was destroyed.
fields.description: 凤凰嘴渡口位于全州县凤凰镇和平村建安司湘江边，又名麻子渡，与上游约 10 公里的界首渡口隔江相望。1934 年 12 月 1 日，界首浮桥被炸毁后，红九军团、红五军团第十三师、红八军团等部改由凤凰嘴渡口及下游董家堰涉渡。渡口江面开阔、两岸无遮蔽，红军遭敌机轰炸和追兵射击，伤亡惨重，是湘江战役中牺牲最多的渡口。1934 年 9 月红六军团西征时也曾在此渡过湘江。本坐标为根据里程与河道走向推算的近似位置，待现场实测。 Fenghuangzui Ferry, also called Mazidu, lies on the Xiang River at Jian’ansi, Heping Village, Fenghuang, Quanzhou, about 10 km downstream of Jieshou. On 1 December 1934, after the Jieshou pontoon bridge was destroyed, the Ninth Army Corps, the Thirteenth Division of the Fifth Army Corps, the Eighth Army Corps, and other units forded here and at the Dongjiayan weir downstream. The open river and exposed banks left the Red Army vulnerable to air attack and pursuing fire, making this the deadliest crossing of the campaign. The Sixth Army Corps had also crossed here during its westward expedition in September 1934. This coordinate is estimated from distances and river alignment and awaits field verification.

fields.description: 1934 年 12 月 10 日，红二十五军在陕西洛南县庾家河与国民党军激战，军长程子华、副军长徐海东负伤。番号与伤情为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On December 10, 1934, the Red 25th Army fought a fierce battle with KMT forces at Yujiahe, Luonan, Shaanxi; commander Cheng Zihua and deputy commander Xu Haidong were wounded. fields.description: 1934 年 11 月 26 日，中共湘鄂川黔省委、省革命委员会、省军区在大庸县城成立；12 月 10 日机关迁至永顺塔卧，塔卧成为苏区中心，直至 1935 年 4 月 12 日迁往龙山兴隆街。 The Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou provincial party committee, revolutionary committee and military district were established at Dayong on 26 November 1934. On 10 December the organs moved to Tawo in Yongshun, which remained the centre of the Soviet area until they moved to Xinglongjie in Longshan on 12 April 1935.

place.en: Qilin Temple, Shimashen Village, Gongba, Daoxian, Hunan

summary.zh: 红三十四师师长陈树湘在道县石马神村被俘途中断肠明志，年仅 29 岁。
summary.en: Thirty-Fourth Division commander Chen Shuxiang, while being carried prisoner through Shimashen in Daoxian, tore open his own wound and died aged 29.

fields.name: 陈树湘断肠明志 Chen Shuxiang’s Sacrifice at Shimashen 陈树湘牺牲 Death of Chen Shuxiang 石马神断肠明志 Shimashen Martyrdom
fields.place: 湖南道县蚣坝镇石马神村麒麟庙 Qilin Temple, Shimashen Village, Gongba, Daoxian, Hunan
fields.summary: 红三十四师师长陈树湘在道县石马神村被俘途中断肠明志，年仅 29 岁。 Thirty-Fourth Division commander Chen Shuxiang, while being carried prisoner through Shimashen in Daoxian, tore open his own wound and died aged 29.
fields.description: 1934 年 12 月，红三十四师完成掩护主力渡江后折返湘南。12 月 10 日，师长陈树湘在江华牯子江渡口战斗中腹部重伤；12 日，余部在道县四马桥早和田遭伏，陈树湘与警卫员在馒头岭冯督庙（洪都庙）附近被俘。12 月 18 日上午，道县保安团将其押往县城，行至蚣坝镇石马神村麒麟庙休息时，陈树湘趁敌不备，从腹部伤口绞断肠子，壮烈牺牲，年仅 29 岁。本坐标为石马神村代表点，麒麟庙遗址具体位置待实测。 In December 1934, after covering the main force’s crossing, the Thirty-Fourth Division turned back toward southern Hunan. On 10 December commander Chen Shuxiang was gravely wounded in the abdomen at the Guzijiang ferry in Jianghua; on 12 December the remnants were ambushed at Zaohetian near Simaqiao, Daoxian, and Chen and his guards were captured near Fengdu Temple (Hongdu Temple) at Mantouling. On the morning of 18 December, as the Daoxian security regiment carried him toward the county town, the party stopped to rest at Qilin Temple in Shimashen Village, Gongba. Chen seized the moment, tore open his abdominal wound, and died aged 29. This coordinate is a representative point for Shimashen village; the exact site of Qilin Temple awaits field verification.

It reaffirmed the Liping decision and required major military actions to be discussed by the Political Bureau.

fields.place: 贵州瓮安江界河（乌江防线代表点） Jiangjiehe, Weng’an, Guizhou (representative point of the Wu River defense line)
fields.summary: 国民党黔军王家烈部依托乌江设防，企图阻止红军北上遵义。 Guizhou troops under Wang Jialie defended the Wu River to block the Red Army’s advance on Zunyi.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月，黔军第 25 军副军长兼教导师师长侯之担部在乌江北岸茶山关、孙家渡、江界河、袁家渡、回龙场等 10 余处渡口部署 5 个团又 1 个机炮营，防线长约 200 里，并毁船、拆房、构筑工事，企图阻止红军北渡。红军分三路从江界河、回龙场、茶山关等渡口突破，至 1 月 6 日全部渡江。本坐标为江界河渡口代表点，防线沿乌江展开。 In January 1935, Hou Zhidan, deputy commander of the Guizhou 25th Army and commander of the training division, deployed five regiments and one machine-gun/artillery battalion at more than ten ferries on the north bank of the Wu River, including Chashanguan, Sunjiadu, Jiangjiehe, Yuanjiadu, and Huilongchang. The line was about 200 li long; the defenders destroyed boats, demolished houses, and built fortifications to block the Red Army. The Red Army broke through at Jiangjiehe, Huilongchang, Chashanguan, and other ferries, crossing completely by 6 January. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiangjiehe Ferry; the line extended along the Wu River.

summary.zh: 中央红军从江界河、回龙场、茶山关等渡口强渡乌江，进占遵义。

fields.name: 强渡乌江 Forcing the Wu River
fields.place: 贵州瓮安江界河渡口 Jiangjiehe Ferry, Weng’an, Guizhou
fields.summary: 中央红军从江界河、回龙场、茶山关等渡口强渡乌江，进占遵义。 The Central Red Army forced the Wu River at Jiangjiehe, Huilongchang, and Chashanguan and advanced on Zunyi.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 1 日至 6 日，中央红军分三路强渡乌江：红 1 军团第 2 师第 4 团在江界河、红 1 师第 1 团在回龙场、红 3 军团在茶山关等渡口渡江。红军以竹筏、浮桥突破黔军侯之担部防线，击溃黔军 4 个团、2 个营约 4000 人，至 6 日全部渡过乌江，进占遵义。此役是长征以来第一个较大胜利，为遵义会议召开创造了条件。本坐标为江界河渡口代表点。 From 1 to 6 January 1935 the Central Red Army crossed the Wu River in three routes: the 4th Regiment of the 2nd Division, First Army Corps, at Jiangjiehe; the 1st Regiment of the 1st Division at Huilongchang; and the Third Army Corps at Chashanguan and other ferries. Using bamboo rafts and pontoon bridges, the Red Army broke the defense line of Hou Zhidan’s Guizhou troops, routed four regiments and two battalions (about 4,000 men), and by 6 January had crossed the river and entered Zunyi. It was the first major victory since the Long March began and created conditions for the Zunyi Conference. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiangjiehe Ferry.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

fields.place: 贵州余庆大乌江镇回龙场渡口 Huilongchang Ferry, Dawujiang, Yuqing, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红 1 师第 1 团在回龙场渡口强渡乌江，红 1 军团主力与红 9 军团由此过江。 The 1st Regiment, 1st Division, forced the Wu River at Huilongchang; the main force of the First Army Corps and the 9th Army Corps crossed there.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 1 日，红 1 军团第 1 师第 1 团在团长杨得志、政委黎林率领下进至回龙场渡口，8 名勇士乘竹筏偷渡被巨浪吞没。2 日深夜，红军在鱼子塘等水势较缓处强渡成功，击溃北岸黔军一个营；3 日凌晨架设浮桥，至 4 日红 1 军团主力及红 9 军团渡江完毕。本坐标为回龙场渡口代表点。 On 1 January 1935 the 1st Regiment of the 1st Division, First Army Corps, under Yang Dezhi and political commissar Li Lin, reached Huilongchang Ferry; eight men on a bamboo raft were lost in the waves. Late on 2 January the Red Army crossed successfully at calmer points such as Yuzitang, routed a Guizhou battalion on the north bank, and built a pontoon bridge before dawn on 3 January; by 4 January the main force of the First Army Corps and the 9th Army Corps had crossed. The coordinate is a representative point at Huilongchang Ferry.

fields.summary: 红 1 师在袁家渡等渡口组织佯渡与侦察，红 9 军团担任侧后掩护。 The 1st Division feinted and reconnoitered at Yuanjiadu and nearby ferries while the 9th Army Corps covered the flank.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 1 日，红 1 师兵分几路，在袁家渡、梁家渡、回龙渡、沙湾等渡口组织强渡，因对岸守军火力与江水湍急未获成功；袁家渡一带由川南边防第一旅易少荃部驻防。中革军委同时规定红 9 军团在回龙场、袁家渡及其以北地区掩护红 1 军团侧后。袁家渡因此更多承担佯渡、侦察与掩护任务，主渡点仍在回龙场、江界河、茶山关。本坐标为袁家渡代表点。 On 1 January 1935 the 1st Division tried crossings at several ferries including Yuanjiadu, Liangjiadu, Huilongdu, and Shawan, but enemy fire and the swift current defeated the attempts; the Yuanjiadu area was held by Yi Shaokun’s 1st Border Defence Brigade. The CMC also assigned the 9th Army Corps to cover the flank of the 1st Army Corps at Huilongchang, Yuanjiadu, and points north. Yuanjiadu therefore served mainly for feints, reconnaissance, and flank cover, while the main crossings remained at Huilongchang, Jiangjiehe, and Chashanguan. The coordinate is a representative point at Yuanjiadu.

fields.place: 贵州瓮安江界河渡口 Jiangjiehe Ferry, Weng’an, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红 4 团在江界河渡口强渡乌江，中央纵队与红 5 军团由此过江。 The 4th Regiment forced the Wu River at Jiangjiehe, and the central column and 5th Army Corps crossed there.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 1 日，红 1 军团第 2 师第 4 团进至江界河渡口，耿飚、杨成武侦察后决定佯攻老渡口、主攻上游新渡口。1 月 2 日，毛振华率 7 名勇士泅渡失败；夜间 18 名勇士乘竹筏偷渡，5 人潜伏北岸。3 日拂晓，60 余只竹筏在火力掩护下强渡，毛振华等 5 人从敌后接应，红军占领北岸，工兵架起浮桥，军委纵队与红 5 军团由此过江。本坐标为江界河渡口代表点。 On 1 January 1935 the 4th Regiment of the 2nd Division, First Army Corps, reached Jiangjiehe Ferry. After reconnaissance, Geng Biao and Yang Chengwu decided to feint at the old ferry and attack the upper new ferry. On 2 January Mao Zhenhua led seven men in a failed swim; that night eighteen men crossed by bamboo raft, with five hiding on the north bank. At dawn on 3 January more than sixty rafts crossed under fire while Mao and his five men attacked from the rear, seizing the north bank. Engineers built a pontoon bridge, and the CMC column and 5th Army Corps crossed there. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiangjiehe Ferry.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

fields.name: 茶山关渡口 Chashanguan Ferry 茶山关渡口 Chashan Pass Ferry
fields.place: 贵州开阳茶山关渡口 Chashanguan Ferry, Kaiyang, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红 3 军团在茶山关渡口渡江，守敌不战而逃。 The Third Army Corps crossed at Chashanguan; the defenders fled without a fight.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 3 日，红 3 军团第 4 师第 10 团进至茶山关渡口，守敌刘翰吾部在得知回龙场、江界河失守后连夜弃阵逃回遵义。红军在当地船工协助下捞起沉船、架设浮桥，1 月 4 日至 6 日红 3 军团分别从桃子台、茶山关、楠木渡渡过乌江，进入遵义尚嵇一带。本坐标为茶山关渡口代表点。 On 3 January 1935 the 10th Regiment of the 4th Division, Third Army Corps, reached Chashanguan Ferry. After learning that Huilongchang and Jiangjiehe had fallen, Liu Hanwu’s defenders abandoned their positions and fled to Zunyi. With local boatmen the Red Army raised sunken boats and built a pontoon bridge; from 4 to 6 January the Third Army Corps crossed at Taozitai, Chashanguan, and Nanmudu and entered the Shangji area of Zunyi. The coordinate is a representative point at Chashanguan Ferry.

summary.en: The 13th Regiment of the 3rd Army Corps’ 5th Division forced the Wu River at Sunjiadu, killing the Guizhou machine-gun battalion commander.

fields.name: 孙家渡渡口 Sunjiadu Ferry 孙家渡 Sunjia Ferry
fields.place: 贵州瓮安珠藏附近乌江孙家渡 Sunjiadu on the Wu River near Zhuzang, Weng’an, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红 3 军团第 5 师第 13 团在孙家渡强渡乌江，打死黔军机炮营长。 The 13th Regiment of the 3rd Army Corps’ 5th Division forced the Wu River at Sunjiadu, killing the Guizhou machine-gun battalion commander.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 3 日上午，红 3 军团第 5 师第 13 团在孙家渡再次组织强渡，以炮火轰击北岸工事，打死黔军机炮营长赵宪群，敌军心动摇。红军一部登上北岸，与黔军第五团第一营激战并重创该营，但因过去兵力太少不能立足，一度撤回南岸。当日下午，红军把上游预制的竹筏浮桥横送过江，南岸两三千人由浮桥冲锋，守敌被迫向遵义撤退；红军经珠藏包抄江界河守敌后路。本坐标为孙家渡代表点。 On the morning of 3 January 1935 the 13th Regiment of the 5th Division, Third Army Corps, renewed the assault at Sunjiadu, shelling the north-bank works and killing Zhao Xianqun, the Guizhou machine-gun battalion commander, which shook enemy morale. Part of the Red Army gained the north bank and battered the 1st Battalion of the Guizhou 5th Regiment, but was too few to hold and withdrew to the south bank. That afternoon the Red Army floated a prefabricated bamboo-raft bridge across upstream; two to three thousand men charged over it, forcing the defenders back toward Zunyi, and the Red Army moved via Zhuzang to cut off the Jiangjiehe defenders’ rear. The coordinate is a representative point at Sunjiadu.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

fields.name: 桃子台渡口 Taozitai Ferry 桃子台 Taozitai
fields.place: 贵州开阳乌江桃子台渡口 Taozitai Ferry on the Wu River, Kaiyang, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红 3 军团第 4 师第 10 团在桃子台渡口开始渡江。 The 10th Regiment of the 4th Division, Third Army Corps, began crossing at Taozitai.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 3 日，红 3 军团第 4 师第 10 团进至桃子台渡口，守敌已不战而逃，但渡船被拖向北岸沉入水中。1 月 4 日红军在桃子台组织过江，因水深流急、船只少，一整天才渡过约一个团；第 4、5、6 师随即转至下游茶山关、楠木渡同时渡江。本坐标为桃子台渡口代表点。 On 3 January 1935 the 10th Regiment of the 4th Division, Third Army Corps, reached Taozitai; the defenders had fled, but the boats had been towed to the north bank and sunk. On 4 January the Red Army began crossing at Taozitai; because the water was deep and swift and boats scarce, only about one regiment crossed in a whole day, so the 4th, 5th, and 6th Divisions shifted downstream to cross simultaneously at Chashanguan and Nanmudu. The coordinate is a representative point at Taozitai.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

fields.name: 楠木渡渡口 Nanmudu Ferry 楠木渡 Nanmu Ferry
fields.place: 贵州开阳乌江楠木渡渡口 Nanmudu Ferry on the Wu River, Kaiyang, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红 3 军团由楠木渡渡江，进入遵义尚嵇一带。 The Third Army Corps crossed at Nanmudu and entered the Shangji area of Zunyi.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 4 日至 6 日，红 3 军团在桃子台渡江受阻后，转至下游茶山关、楠木渡同时组织渡江。楠木渡与茶山关之间江面较宽，红军以船渡与浮桥并用，渡过后经尚嵇进入遵义县境；1 月 5 日红 3 军团进至懒板凳（今南白镇）。至 1 月 6 日，中央红军全部渡过乌江。本坐标为楠木渡渡口代表点。 From 4 to 6 January 1935, after the crossing at Taozitai stalled, the Third Army Corps shifted downstream to cross simultaneously at Chashanguan and Nanmudu. At Nanmudu the river was wider; the Red Army used both boats and a pontoon bridge, then passed through Shangji into Zunyi county, reaching Lanbandeng (present-day Nanbai) on 5 January. By 6 January the entire Central Red Army had crossed the Wu River. The coordinate is a representative point at Nanmudu.

summary.zh: 确立毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位，是长征的转折点。
summary.en: Establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army; a turning point of the Long March.

fields.name: 遵义会议 Zunyi meeting 遵义政治局扩大会议 Zunyi Politburo Enlarged Meeting
fields.summary: 确立毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位，是长征的转折点。 Establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army; a turning point of the Long March.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 15 日至 17 日，中共中央政治局扩大会议在遵义召开，总结第五次反“围剿”失败和长征初期失利的教训，实际确立了毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位。 From January 15 to 17, 1935, an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau was held at Zunyi. It reviewed the failures of the fifth counter-encirclement campaign and the early Long March, and effectively established Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army.

fields.name: 陕北省苏维埃政府成立 Founding of the Northern Shaanxi Provincial Soviet Government
fields.place: 陕西赤源（安定）白庙岔 Baimiaocha, Chiyuan (Anding), Shaanxi
fields.summary: 陕北第一次工农兵代表大会在白庙岔召开，成立陕北省苏维埃政府，马明方任主席。 The first Northern Shaanxi workers’, peasants’ and soldiers’ congress met at Baimiaocha and founded the provincial Soviet government under Ma Mingfang.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 25 日至 31 日，陕北第一次工农兵代表大会在赤源县（今子长）白庙岔召开，150 余名代表出席，选举产生陕北省苏维埃执行委员会，马明方任主席，崔田民、霍维德任副主席，下设土地、粮食、财政、教育、劳动、内务、贸易、保卫等部门，通过《工农民主政府组织法》《土地法》《劳动法》《婚姻法》等法令；1 月 31 日举行群众大会庆祝。陕北省苏维埃政府成立后辖赤源、秀延、延安、绥德、佳县等 16 个县级苏维埃政权，所辖武装主要为红二十七军。 From 25 to 31 January 1935 the first Northern Shaanxi workers’, peasants’ and soldiers’ congress met at Baimiaocha, Chiyuan county (today Zichang), with over 150 delegates. It elected the provincial Soviet executive committee under Ma Mingfang, with Cui Tianmin and Huo Weide as vice-chairmen, and set up departments of land, grain, finance, education, labour, interior, trade and security, adopting organic, land, labour and marriage laws; a mass rally celebrated the founding on 31 January. The government administered 16 county-level Soviets, including Chiyuan, Xiuyan, Yan’an, Suide and Jiaxian, and its armed force was chiefly the 27th Red Army.

summary.zh: 红军在土城与川军激战，随后一渡赤水。
summary.en: The Red Army fights a fierce battle with Sichuan troops at Tucheng, then crosses the Chishui River for the first time.

fields.name: 土城战役 Battle of Tucheng 土城战斗 Battle of Tucheng
fields.place: 贵州习水青杠坡（土城） Qinggangpo, Tucheng, Xishui, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红军在土城与川军激战，随后一渡赤水。 The Red Army fights a fierce battle with Sichuan troops at Tucheng, then crosses the Chishui River for the first time.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 28 日，中央红军在贵州习水土城地区与川军郭勋祺部激战，因敌情判断有误未能取胜，随即西渡赤水河。 On January 28, 1935, the Central Red Army fought Guo Xunqi’s Sichuan troops at Tucheng, Xishui, Guizhou. After failing to win because of a misjudgment of enemy strength, it crossed the Chishui River to the west.

name.en: First crossing of the Chishui River

summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Tucheng and Yuanhou and enters southern Sichuan.

fields.name: 一渡赤水 First crossing of the Chishui River 一渡赤水河 First Crossing of the Chishui
fields.place: 贵州习水土城渡口（浑溪口） Tucheng ferry (Hunxikou), Xishui, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红军从土城、元厚西渡赤水河，进入川南。 The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Tucheng and Yuanhou and enters southern Sichuan.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 28 日土城青杠坡战斗失利后，中革军委决定放弃在赤水—泸州间北渡长江的计划，改从土城、元厚西渡赤水河。29 日拂晓，红军从土城浑溪口、蔡家沱和元厚沙沱、川祖庙等渡口渡过赤水河，进入四川古蔺、叙永地区，随后转进云南扎西集结。 After the setback at Qinggangpo on 28 January 1935, the Central Revolutionary Military Commission abandoned the plan to cross the Yangtze near Chishui–Luzhou and ordered a westward crossing at Tucheng and Yuanhou. At dawn on 29 January, the Red Army crossed at Hunxikou and Caijiatuo near Tucheng and at Shatuo and Chuanzumiao near Yuanhou, entered Gulin and Xuyong in Sichuan, and then moved to Zhaxi in Yunnan.

name.en: Hunan Army and Other Forces Encircles the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou Soviet Area

summary.zh: 国民党军以湘军何键（后刘建绪）第四路军等部为主，对湘鄂川黔苏区发动“围剿”。
summary.en: Kuomintang forces led by He Jian’s (later Liu Jianxu’s) Hunan Fourth Route Army launched an encirclement campaign against the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou Soviet area.

fields.name: 湘军等“围剿”湘鄂川黔苏区 Hunan Army and Other Forces Encircles the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou Soviet Area
fields.summary: 国民党军以湘军何键（后刘建绪）第四路军等部为主，对湘鄂川黔苏区发动“围剿”。 Kuomintang forces led by He Jian’s (later Liu Jianxu’s) Hunan Fourth Route Army launched an encirclement campaign against the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou Soviet area.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月起，国民党军以湘军何键（后刘建绪）第四路军等部为主，编成 6 个纵队、约 11 万人，并有湘鄂两省及中央军部队参加，对湘鄂川黔苏区发动“围剿”；红二、六军团先在慈利、大庸正面阻击受挫，4 月撤离塔卧、龙家寨北移，随后在陈家河、桃子溪转败为胜。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From February 1935 Kuomintang forces led by He Jian’s (later Liu Jianxu’s) Hunan Fourth Route Army, organised into six columns of about 110,000 men with other Hunan, Hubei and Central Army units, encircled the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou Soviet area. The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups first tried to hold the enemy frontally at Cili and Dayong and suffered setbacks; in April they withdrew north from Tawo and Longjiazhai and then turned defeat into victory at Chenjiahe and Taoziqi. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 红二十六、二十七军抗击国民党军第二次“围剿”。 The 26th and 27th Red Armies resisted the second KMT encirclement campaign.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月起，国民党军调集兵力对陕甘苏区发动第二次“围剿”，红二十六军、红二十七军并肩作战，至 6 月先后攻克多座县城。兵力与起止月份为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From February 1935, KMT forces concentrated troops for a second encirclement campaign against the Shaanxi-Gansu Soviet area. The 26th and 27th Red Armies fought side by side and took several county seats by June. Troop strengths and start/end months follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 5 日，中共陕甘边特委与陕北特委在子洲周家硷召开联席会议，成立中共西北工作委员会和西北革命军事委员会，统一两根据地党和红军的领导。机构名称为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On February 5, 1935, the Shaanxi-Gansu border and northern Shaanxi special committees held a joint meeting at Zhoujiachan, Zizhou, establishing the Northwest Working Committee and the Northwest Revolutionary Military Commission to unify Party and Red Army leadership across the two base areas. Institution names follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
