fields.name: 华家岭阻击战 Huajialing Blocking Battle 大墩梁阻击战 Dadunliang Blocking Battle 华家岭战斗 Huajialing Battle
fields.place: 甘肃通渭、会宁交界华家岭大墩梁 Dadunliang, Huajialing, on the Tongwei–Huining border, Gansu
fields.summary: 红五军在华家岭大墩梁阻击敌军，罗南辉与 880 余名指战员牺牲。 The Fifth Army blocked the enemy at Dadunliang, Huajialing; Luo Nanhui and over 880 officers and men were killed.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月，红一、二、四方面军在会宁、静宁地区会师后，国民党王均部、毛炳文部紧追。红五军副军长罗南辉奉命率部在通渭、会宁交界的华家岭大墩梁阻击，他此前已负伤，仍躺在担架上指挥。10 月 22 日至 23 日，红五军在大墩梁与敌军 9 个团激战，敌机 7 架轮番轰炸，红军多次反冲锋未能打退敌军，罗南辉和 880 余名指战员牺牲，完成了掩护主力转移的任务。本坐标为大墩梁代表点。 In October 1936, after the First, Second, and Fourth Front Armies met at Huining and Jingning, Wang Jun’s and Mao Bingwen’s forces pressed close. Luo Nanhui, deputy commander of the Fifth Army, was ordered to block them at Dadunliang in Huajialing on the Tongwei–Huining border; already wounded, he commanded from a stretcher. On 22–23 October the Fifth Army fought nine enemy regiments at Dadunliang while seven aircraft bombed in relays. Repeated counterattacks failed to drive the enemy back; Luo Nanhui and over 880 officers and men were killed, but the main force was covered in its withdrawal. The coordinate is a representative point at Dadunliang.

fields.name: 土木堡之变 The Tumu crisis
fields.summary: 明英宗亲征瓦剌，在土木堡兵败被俘。 Emperor Yingzong campaigned against the Oirats and was captured at Tumu.

fields.summary: 日军撤出汉城，明军与朝鲜军进驻。 The Japanese withdrew from Hanseong and Ming and Korean troops entered.
fields.description: 万历二十一年（1593）正月明军平壤大捷后南下，四月日军因粮尽与议和撤出汉城，五月明军与朝鲜军进驻。此后双方在和谈与战事之间反复，至万历二十六年（1598）露梁海战方告结束。 After the Ming victory at Pyongyang in the first month of 1593 the army moved south; in the fourth month the Japanese withdrew from Hanseong for lack of grain and to negotiate, and in the fifth month Ming and Korean troops entered. name.en: Li Zicheng proclaims the Dashun dynasty

summary.zh: 李自成在西安称王，国号大顺，随即东征北京。
summary.en: Li Zicheng proclaimed the Dashun dynasty at Xi’an and marched east on Beijing.

fields.name: 李自成建大顺 Li Zicheng proclaims the Dashun dynasty
fields.summary: 李自成在西安称王，国号大顺，随即东征北京。 Li Zicheng proclaimed the Dashun dynasty at Xi’an and marched east on Beijing.
fields.description: 崇祯十七年（1644）正月，李自成在西安称王，国号大顺，改元永昌，设置百官，随后率军东征，经太原、大同、宣府、居庸关，三月十九日攻入北京。 In the first month of 1644 Li Zicheng took the royal title at Xi’an, proclaimed the Dashun dynasty with the era name Yongchang, appointed officials and marched east through Taiyuan, Datong, Xuanfu and Juyongguan, entering Beijing on 19 March.

summary.zh: 多尔衮率军自盛京出师，准备经山海关入关。
summary.en: Dorgon marched from Shengjing to enter China via Shanhaiguan.

fields.name: 多尔衮自盛京出师 Dorgon marches from Shengjing
fields.summary: 多尔衮率军自盛京出师，准备经山海关入关。 Dorgon marched from Shengjing to enter China via Shanhaiguan.
fields.description: 顺治元年（1644）四月初九，多尔衮率满蒙汉军自盛京出师，原拟绕道入援；途中接吴三桂请兵书，遂直趋山海关，四月二十二日与吴三桂合兵击败李自成军，五月初二入北京。 On 9 April 1644 Dorgon marched from Shengjing with Manchu, Mongol and Chinese troops; on the way he received Wu Sangui’s plea for help, headed for Shanhaiguan, joined Wu to defeat Li Zicheng on 22 April and entered Beijing on 2 May.

summary.zh: 李自成攻入北京，崇祯帝自缢，明朝灭亡。
summary.en: Li Zicheng took Beijing; the Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself, ending the Ming.

fields.name: 甲申之变 The Jiashen catastrophe
fields.summary: 李自成攻入北京，崇祯帝自缢，明朝灭亡。 Li Zicheng took Beijing; the Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself, ending the Ming.
fields.description: 1644 年 4 月，李自成率大顺军攻入北京，崇祯帝在煤山自缢，明朝灭亡，随后清军入关。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In April 1644 Li Zicheng’s Dashun army entered Beijing. The Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself on Coal Hill, ending the Ming dynasty, and Qing forces soon entered China proper. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The coastal evacuation and sea ban

summary.zh: 清廷下令东南沿海迁界禁海。
summary.en: The Qing ordered coastal evacuation and a maritime ban.

fields.name: 迁界禁海 The coastal evacuation and sea ban
fields.summary: 清廷下令东南沿海迁界禁海。 The Qing ordered coastal evacuation and a maritime ban.
fields.description: 1661 年，清廷为切断郑氏补给，下令东南沿海迁界禁海，居民内迁，沿海经济受到重创。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为政治决策/政治运动，不绘制行军路线。 In 1661 the Qing court ordered coastal evacuation and a maritime ban to cut off Zheng Chenggong’s supplies. Residents were moved inland and the coastal economy suffered heavily. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. This is a political decision/movement; no march route is drawn.

summary.zh: 清军自瑷珲出师，六月围攻雅克萨。
summary.en: The Qing army marched from Aihun and besieged Albazin in the sixth month.

fields.name: 清军自瑷珲出师 Qing army marches from Aihun

fields.summary: 清军围攻雅克萨，俄军投降。 Qing forces besieged Albazin and forced the Russian garrison to surrender.

fields.description: 1773 年，清廷开馆编纂《四库全书》，汇集历代典籍，同时大量禁毁“违碍”书籍，成为清代文化控制与文献整理的双重象征。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1773 the Qing court began compiling the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries, gathering texts from across history while also banning and destroying many works deemed objectionable—a dual symbol of literary compilation and cultural control. atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 福康安连克擦木、济咙，西藏全境收复。
summary.en: Fukanggan took Chamu and Gyirong, completing the recovery of Tibet.

fields.name: 清军攻克济咙 Qing army takes Gyirong
fields.place: 西藏济咙（今吉隆） Gyirong (Jilong), Tibet
fields.summary: 福康安连克擦木、济咙，西藏全境收复。 Fukanggan took Chamu and Gyirong, completing the recovery of Tibet.
fields.description: 乾隆五十七年（1792）五月六日福康安、海兰察冒雨分五路攻擦木山隘，初七日克之；初八日败济咙援军，初十日克济咙，斩六百余、俘二百余，西藏全境收复。随后清军越喜马拉雅山入廓尔喀境，八月廓尔喀请降。 On 6 May 1792 Fukanggan and Hailanca attacked the Chamu pass in five columns during rain and took it on the 7th; on the 8th they beat the relief force from Gyirong and on the 10th took Gyirong, killing over 600 and capturing over 200, completing the recovery of Tibet. The army then crossed the Himalaya into Nepal and in the eighth month received Gorkha’s surrender.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

place.zh: 西藏吉隆热索桥（中尼界桥）

summary.zh: 清军入廓尔喀境，在热索桥突破廓军河防。
summary.en: The Qing army entered Gorkha territory and broke the river defence at the Rasuwagadhi bridge.

fields.name: 热索桥之战 Battle of the Rasuwagadhi bridge
fields.place: 西藏吉隆热索桥（中尼界桥） Rasuwagadhi bridge, Gyirong, Tibet
fields.summary: 清军入廓尔喀境，在热索桥突破廓军河防。 The Qing army entered Gorkha territory and broke the river defence at the Rasuwagadhi bridge.
fields.description: 乾隆五十七年（1792）五月十四日清军过藏廓边界摆吗奈撒，十五日在热索桥与廓军激战：正面佯攻北岸碉楼，另遣土兵越山绕至上游伐木为筏渡河，袭南岸碉房，主力乘势搭桥夺取三座石碉。此后清军历协布鲁、东觉、噶勒拉、堆补木诸战，七月底逼近廓尔喀都城阳布，八月受降。 On 14 May 1792 the Qing army crossed the Tibet–Gorkha boundary at Paimainaisa; on the 15th it fought at the Rasuwagadhi bridge, feinting against the north-bank blockhouse while tribal troops crossed upstream on rafts to storm the south-bank posts, the main body then bridging the river and taking three stone blockhouses. The army went on to fight at Chukla, Dongjue, Ghalela and Dunbumu, closing on the Gorkha capital in late July and receiving its surrender in the eighth month.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The Qing campaign against the Gurkhas

summary.zh: 福康安率军入藏，击退廓尔喀。
summary.en: Fu Kang’an led Qing forces into Tibet and repelled the Gurkhas.

fields.name: 平定廓尔喀 The Qing campaign against the Gurkhas
fields.summary: 福康安率军入藏，击退廓尔喀。 Fu Kang’an led Qing forces into Tibet and repelled the Gurkhas.
fields.description: 1792 年，廓尔喀入侵西藏，福康安率清军入藏反击，收复失地并逼近廓尔喀，随后订立《钦定藏内善后章程》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1792 the Gurkhas invaded Tibet. Fu Kang’an led Qing forces into Tibet, recovered the lost territory, and advanced toward Nepal, leading to the Qing regulations for Tibet. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The British Macartney embassy met the Qianlong Emperor, but its trade requests were refused.

fields.name: 马戛尔尼使华 The Macartney embassy
fields.summary: 英国使团觐见乾隆，通商请求被拒。 The British Macartney embassy met the Qianlong Emperor, but its trade requests were refused.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1796 年，白莲教在湖北襄阳等地起事，迅速波及四川、湖北、陕西，清廷调集重兵镇压，至 1804 年才基本平定。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1796 the White Lotus movement rose in Xiangyang and other parts of Hubei, spreading quickly into Sichuan and Shaanxi. The Qing deployed large forces and suppressed the rebellion only around 1804. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 英国舰队封锁珠江口，鸦片战争爆发。
summary.en: The British fleet blockaded the Pearl River estuary, beginning the First Opium War.

fields.name: 鸦片战争 The First Opium War
fields.summary: 英国舰队封锁珠江口，鸦片战争爆发。 The British fleet blockaded the Pearl River estuary, beginning the First Opium War.
fields.description: 1840 年，英国以禁烟为借口派舰队封锁珠江口，进攻虎门，鸦片战争爆发，清朝战败后签订《南京条约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1840 Britain used the opium crackdown as a pretext to blockade the Pearl River estuary and attack Humen, beginning the First Opium War. After defeat the Qing signed the Treaty of Nanjing. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Hong Xiuquan rose at Jintian and founded the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

fields.summary: 洪秀全在金田起义，建太平天国。 Hong Xiuquan rose at Jintian and founded the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

The movement later captured Nanjing and became the largest internal war of the Qing period. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Zongli Yamen was established, launching the Self-Strengthening Movement.

fields.name: 洋务运动 The Self-Strengthening Movement
fields.summary: 总理衙门设立，洋务运动兴起。 The Zongli Yamen was established, launching the Self-Strengthening Movement.
fields.description: 1861 年，清廷设立总理各国事务衙门，随后创办近代军工、民用企业与新式学堂，史称洋务运动，试图“师夷长技以自强”。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1861 the Qing established the Zongli Yamen (Foreign Office), followed by modern arsenals, enterprises, and schools. The Self-Strengthening Movement sought to adopt Western technology while preserving Qing rule. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

It later merged with the Jiangnan Arsenal’s translation department and became an important institution of Self-Strengthening education. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 福州船政局 The Fuzhou Navy Yard
fields.summary: 左宗棠创办福州船政局。 Zuo Zongtang founded the Fuzhou Navy Yard.
fields.description: 1866 年，左宗棠在福州马尾创办福州船政局，附设船政学堂，培养海军与造船人才，是洋务运动的重要海军基地。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1866 Zuo Zongtang founded the Fuzhou Navy Yard at Mawei, with a naval school attached. It trained naval officers and shipbuilders and became a key base of the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 福州船政学堂开学，培养海军与造船人才。
summary.en: The Fuzhou Naval School opened to train naval officers and shipbuilders.

fields.name: 福州船政学堂 The Fuzhou Naval School
fields.summary: 福州船政学堂开学，培养海军与造船人才。 The Fuzhou Naval School opened to train naval officers and shipbuilders.
fields.description: 1867 年，福州船政学堂（求是堂艺局）在马尾开学，分前学堂与后学堂，分别培养造船与驾驶人才，被誉为中国近代海军的摇篮。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1867 the Fuzhou Naval School opened at Mawei with separate departments for shipbuilding and navigation, earning a reputation as the cradle of China’s modern navy. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷派遣首批幼童赴美留学。
summary.en: The Qing sent the first group of young students to study in the United States.

fields.name: 留美幼童 The Chinese Educational Mission
fields.summary: 清廷派遣首批幼童赴美留学。 The Qing sent the first group of young students to study in the United States.
fields.description: 1872 年，在容闳推动下，清廷派遣首批幼童赴美留学，至 1875 年共派出四批，后因保守派反对于 1881 年撤回。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1872, promoted by Yung Wing, the Qing sent the first group of young students to the United States; four batches followed by 1875, but the mission was recalled in 1881 amid conservative opposition. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company

summary.zh: 李鸿章创办轮船招商局。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company.

fields.name: 轮船招商局 The China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company
fields.summary: 李鸿章创办轮船招商局。 Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company.
fields.description: 1872 年，李鸿章在上海创办轮船招商局，经营江海航运，与外国轮船公司竞争，是洋务运动“官督商办”的代表企业。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1872 Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company in Shanghai to operate river and coastal shipping in competition with foreign firms, a representative “official supervision and merchant management” enterprise. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The western army marches through the pass

summary.zh: 左宗棠自兰州移驻肃州，刘锦棠率军出关收复新疆。
summary.en: Zuo Zongtang moved to Suzhou and Liu Jintang led the army through the pass to recover Xinjiang.

fields.name: 西征军出关 The western army marches through the pass
fields.summary: 左宗棠自兰州移驻肃州，刘锦棠率军出关收复新疆。 Zuo Zongtang moved to Suzhou and Liu Jintang led the army through the pass to recover Xinjiang.
fields.description: 光绪元年（1875）五月清廷命左宗棠为钦差大臣督办新疆军务；二年（1876）四月左宗棠自兰州移驻肃州，刘锦棠率军出关，先克古牧地、乌鲁木齐，三年（1877）克达坂城、吐鲁番，阿古柏败死，四年（1878）正月除伊犁外新疆收复。 In the fifth month of 1875 the court made Zuo Zongtang imperial commissioner for Xinjiang; in the fourth month of 1876 he moved from Lanzhou to Suzhou and Liu Jintang led the army through the pass, taking Gucheng and Ürümqi, then Dabancheng and Turpan in 1877 as Yaqub Beg fell, so that by the first month of 1878 Xinjiang except Ili was recovered.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 左宗棠率军收复新疆，除伊犁外全境平定。
summary.en: Zuo Zongtang recovered Xinjiang, pacifying the region except for Ili.

fields.name: 左宗棠收复新疆 Zuo Zongtang recovers Xinjiang
fields.place: 新疆乌鲁木齐 Urumqi, Xinjiang
fields.summary: 左宗棠率军收复新疆，除伊犁外全境平定。 Zuo Zongtang recovered Xinjiang, pacifying the region except for Ili.
fields.description: 1876—1878 年，左宗棠率清军西征，先后收复北疆与南疆，除沙俄占据的伊犁外，新疆重归清朝控制。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 1876 to 1878 Zuo Zongtang led Qing forces westward, recovering northern and southern Xinjiang. Except for Ili, held by Russia, the region returned to Qing control. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the Kaiping Mines to exploit coal deposits.

fields.name: 开平矿务局 The Kaiping Mines
fields.summary: 李鸿章创办开平矿务局，开采煤矿。 Li Hongzhang founded the Kaiping Mines to exploit coal deposits.
fields.description: 1878 年，李鸿章创办开平矿务局，采用机器开采煤矿，为轮船、军工与铁路提供燃料，是洋务民用企业的重要代表。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1878 Li Hongzhang founded the Kaiping Mines, using modern machinery to extract coal for steamships, arsenals, and railways, a major civilian enterprise of the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 天津水师学堂 The Tianjin Naval Academy
fields.summary: 李鸿章创办天津水师学堂。 Li Hongzhang founded the Tianjin Naval Academy.
fields.description: 1880 年，李鸿章在天津创办水师学堂，由严复任总教习，培养北洋海军军官，是继福州船政学堂之后又一座海军学校。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1880 Li Hongzhang founded the Tianjin Naval Academy, with Yan Fu as chief instructor, to train officers for the Beiyang Navy. It was the second major naval school after Fuzhou. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 法国舰队袭击马尾，福建水师覆没。
summary.en: The French fleet attacked Mawei and destroyed the Fujian fleet.

fields.name: 中法战争 The Sino-French War
fields.summary: 法国舰队袭击马尾，福建水师覆没。 The French fleet attacked Mawei and destroyed the Fujian fleet.
fields.description: 1884 年，中法战争爆发，法国舰队在马尾袭击福建水师，福建水师几乎全军覆没；清军随后在镇南关等地取得胜利，最终签订《中法新约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1884 the Sino-French War broke out. The French fleet attacked the Fujian fleet at Mawei, almost annihilating it; Qing forces later won at Zhennanguan, and the war ended with the Treaty of Tianjin. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清廷将台湾升格为省，刘铭传任巡抚。
summary.en: The Qing elevated Taiwan to a province, with Liu Mingchuan as governor.

fields.name: 台湾建省 Taiwan becomes a province
fields.summary: 清廷将台湾升格为省，刘铭传任巡抚。 The Qing elevated Taiwan to a province, with Liu Mingchuan as governor.
fields.description: 1885 年，清廷在中法战争后决定加强台湾防务，将台湾升格为省，以刘铭传为首任巡抚，推动铁路、电报与新政建设。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1885, after the Sino-French War, the Qing strengthened Taiwan’s defenses and elevated it to a province, appointing Liu Mingchuan as first governor; he promoted railways, telegraphs, and modern reforms. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷颁布《北洋海军章程》，北洋海军正式成军。
summary.en: The Qing promulgated the Beiyang Navy regulations, formally establishing the fleet.

fields.name: 北洋海军成军 The Beiyang Navy is established
fields.summary: 清廷颁布《北洋海军章程》，北洋海军正式成军。 The Qing promulgated the Beiyang Navy regulations, formally establishing the fleet.
fields.description: 1888 年，清廷颁布《北洋海军章程》，北洋海军正式成军，拥有定远、镇远等铁甲舰，一度号称亚洲第一，但此后军费与训练渐弛。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1888 the Qing promulgated the Beiyang Navy regulations, formally establishing the fleet with the ironclads Dingyuan and Zhenyuan. Briefly rated the strongest in Asia, it later suffered from declining funding and training. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks.

fields.name: 汉阳铁厂 The Hanyang Ironworks
fields.summary: 张之洞创办汉阳铁厂。 Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks.
fields.description: 1890 年，张之洞在汉阳创办铁厂，1894 年投产，是当时亚洲最大的钢铁企业之一，后与汉阳兵工厂、湖北织布局构成湖北洋务工业体系。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1890 Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks, which began production in 1894 and became one of Asia’s largest steel enterprises, anchoring Hubei’s Self-Strengthening industrial complex. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 丰岛海战爆发，清军败于日本。
summary.en: The Battle of Pungdo began the First Sino-Japanese War, and the Qing were defeated.

fields.name: 甲午战争 The First Sino-Japanese War
fields.summary: 丰岛海战爆发，清军败于日本。 The Battle of Pungdo began the First Sino-Japanese War, and the Qing were defeated.
fields.description: 1894 年，日本海军在丰岛海面袭击清军运兵船，甲午战争爆发；清军在海陆战场接连失利，最终签订《马关条约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1894 the Japanese navy attacked Qing transports near Pungdo, beginning the First Sino-Japanese War. After defeats on land and sea, the Qing signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 丰岛海战 The Battle of Fengdao
fields.summary: 日本舰队在丰岛附近袭击清军运兵船。 The Japanese fleet attacked Chinese transports near Fengdao.
fields.description: 1894 年 7 月 25 日，日本联合舰队在朝鲜丰岛附近袭击清军运兵船，击沉高升号，甲午战争由此爆发。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 25 July 1894 the Japanese Combined Fleet attacked Chinese transports near Fengdao off Korea and sank the Kowshing, marking the outbreak of the First Sino-Japanese War. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军进攻成欢，清军败退牙山。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Seonghwan and drove the Qing army back to Asan.

fields.name: 成欢之战 The Battle of Seonghwan
fields.summary: 日军进攻成欢，清军败退牙山。 Japanese forces attacked Seonghwan and drove the Qing army back to Asan.
fields.description: 1894 年 7 月 29 日，日军进攻驻守朝鲜成欢的清军，清军战败后向牙山方向退却，聂士成等率部突围，甲午陆战由此展开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 29 July 1894 Japanese forces attacked the Qing garrison at Seonghwan. After defeat the Qing troops withdrew toward Asan, with Nie Shicheng’s units breaking out, opening the land war of 1894–95. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清军与日军在平壤激战，清军败退。
summary.en: Qing and Japanese forces fought at Pyongyang, and the Qing army retreated.

fields.name: 平壤战役 The Battle of Pyongyang
fields.summary: 清军与日军在平壤激战，清军败退。 Qing and Japanese forces fought at Pyongyang, and the Qing army retreated.
fields.description: 1894 年 9 月，清军集结平壤与日军决战，激战一日后败退，退回鸭绿江以北，朝鲜战局急转直下。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1894 Qing forces concentrated at Pyongyang for a decisive battle. After a day of fighting they were defeated and withdrew north of the Yalu, and the war in Korea turned sharply against China. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The Battle of the Yellow Sea

summary.zh: 北洋水师与日本联合舰队在黄海激战。
summary.en: The Beiyang Fleet and the Japanese Combined Fleet fought in the Yellow Sea.

fields.name: 黄海海战 The Battle of the Yellow Sea
fields.summary: 北洋水师与日本联合舰队在黄海激战。 The Beiyang Fleet and the Japanese Combined Fleet fought in the Yellow Sea.
fields.description: 1894 年 9 月 17 日，北洋水师护送运兵船返航时在黄海大东沟附近与日本联合舰队遭遇，激战数小时，北洋水师损失多艘军舰，失去黄海制海权。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 17 September 1894 the Beiyang Fleet, escorting transports home, encountered the Japanese Combined Fleet near the Yalu estuary. After hours of fighting the Chinese fleet lost several ships and command of the Yellow Sea. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军突破鸭绿江防线，攻占九连城。
summary.en: Japanese forces broke the Yalu defense line and captured Jiuliancheng.

fields.name: 九连城之战 The Battle of Jiuliancheng
fields.summary: 日军突破鸭绿江防线，攻占九连城。 Japanese forces broke the Yalu defense line and captured Jiuliancheng.
fields.description: 1894 年 10 月，日军在鸭绿江架桥渡江，进攻九连城与安东，清军防线崩溃，鸭绿江防线失守，日军由此进入辽东。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1894 Japanese forces bridged the Yalu, attacked Jiuliancheng and Andong, and broke the Qing river defense, opening the way into Liaodong. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军突破鸭绿江，攻占旅顺。
summary.en: Japanese forces crossed the Yalu and captured Lüshun.

fields.name: 辽东战役 The Liaodong campaign
fields.summary: 日军突破鸭绿江，攻占旅顺。 Japanese forces crossed the Yalu and captured Lüshun.
fields.description: 1894 年 10 月起，日军突破鸭绿江防线，接连攻占安东、金州与旅顺，并在旅顺制造大屠杀，北洋海防体系崩溃。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From October 1894 Japanese forces broke through the Yalu defenses and captured Andong, Jinzhou, and Lüshun, carrying out a massacre at Lüshun and collapsing the Beiyang coastal defense system. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军攻占威海卫，北洋水师覆没。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Weihaiwei and destroyed the Beiyang Fleet.

fields.name: 威海卫之战 The Battle of Weihaiwei
fields.summary: 日军攻占威海卫，北洋水师覆没。 Japanese forces captured Weihaiwei and destroyed the Beiyang Fleet.
fields.description: 1895 年，日军海陆夹攻威海卫，北洋水师困守刘公岛，提督丁汝昌拒降自尽，北洋水师全军覆没。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1895 Japanese land and naval forces attacked Weihaiwei. The Beiyang Fleet, trapped at Liugong Island, was destroyed after Admiral Ding Ruchang refused to surrender and took his own life. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军进攻澎湖，清军抵抗失利。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Penghu and defeated the Qing garrison.

fields.name: 澎湖之役 The Battle of Penghu
fields.summary: 日军进攻澎湖，清军抵抗失利。 Japanese forces attacked Penghu and defeated the Qing garrison.
fields.description: 1895 年 3 月，日军进攻澎湖，清军抵抗失利，马公陷落。澎湖失守使清廷在《马关条约》谈判中更为被动。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In March 1895 Japanese forces attacked Penghu. The Qing garrison resisted but was defeated and Magong fell, weakening China’s position in the Shimonoseki negotiations. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 李鸿章与日本签订《马关条约》。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki with Japan.

fields.name: 马关条约 The Treaty of Shimonoseki
fields.summary: 李鸿章与日本签订《马关条约》。 Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki with Japan.
fields.description: 1895 年 4 月，李鸿章在日本马关与日方签订《马关条约》，割让台湾、澎湖与辽东半岛，赔款二亿两，允许日本在华设厂，震动朝野。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In April 1895 Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki at Shimonoseki, ceding Taiwan, the Penghu Islands, and the Liaodong Peninsula, imposing a 200-million-tael indemnity, and permitting Japanese factories in China, shocking the Qing court and public. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 俄德法干涉，日本归还辽东。
summary.en: Russia, Germany, and France forced Japan to return the Liaodong Peninsula.

fields.name: 三国干涉还辽 The Triple Intervention
fields.summary: 俄德法干涉，日本归还辽东。 Russia, Germany, and France forced Japan to return the Liaodong Peninsula.
fields.description: 1895 年《马关条约》签订后，俄、德、法三国干涉，迫使日本将辽东半岛归还清朝，清廷以额外赔款赎回。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 After the Treaty of Shimonoseki in 1895, Russia, Germany, and France intervened and forced Japan to return the Liaodong Peninsula to the Qing, which paid an additional indemnity. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The establishment of the Taiwan Governor-General’s Office

summary.zh: 日本在台北设立台湾总督府。
summary.en: Japan established the Governor-General’s Office in Taipei.

fields.name: 台湾总督府设立 The establishment of the Taiwan Governor-General’s Office
fields.summary: 日本在台北设立台湾总督府。 Japan established the Governor-General’s Office in Taipei.
fields.description: 1895 年 5 月，日本在台北设立台湾总督府，桦山资纪任首任总督，开始对台湾的殖民统治，与台湾民主国的抵抗同时展开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1895 Japan established the Taiwan Governor-General’s Office in Taipei, with Kabayama Sukenori as first governor-general, beginning colonial rule even as the Republic of Formosa resisted. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 台湾士绅宣布成立台湾民主国，抵抗日军。
summary.en: Taiwanese elites proclaimed the Republic of Formosa to resist the Japanese invasion.

fields.name: 台湾民主国 The Republic of Formosa
fields.summary: 台湾士绅宣布成立台湾民主国，抵抗日军。 Taiwanese elites proclaimed the Republic of Formosa to resist the Japanese invasion.
fields.description: 1895 年 5 月，台湾士绅与官员在台北宣布成立台湾民主国，年号永清，试图阻止日本接收台湾，随后展开乙未战争，至同年 10 月失败。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1895 Taiwanese elites and officials in Taipei proclaimed the Republic of Formosa, with the era name Yongqing, to resist Japanese annexation. The subsequent Yiwei War ended in defeat by October. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军登陆台湾，台湾军民展开乙未战争。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed in Taiwan, beginning the Yiwei War of resistance.

fields.name: 乙未战争 The Yiwei War
fields.summary: 日军登陆台湾，台湾军民展开乙未战争。 Japanese forces landed in Taiwan, beginning the Yiwei War of resistance.
fields.description: 1895 年 5 月 29 日，日军在澳底登陆，台湾军民展开乙未战争，历经台北、新竹、苗栗、彰化、台南等战，至 10 月台南陷落而告终。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 29 May 1895 Japanese forces landed at Aodi, beginning the Yiwei War. Taiwanese and Qing forces fought through Taipei, Hsinchu, Miaoli, Changhua, and Tainan until the fall of Tainan in October. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军进攻新竹，台湾义军与黑旗军抵抗。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Hsinchu; Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army resisted.

fields.name: 新竹保卫战 The defense of Hsinchu
fields.summary: 日军进攻新竹，台湾义军与黑旗军抵抗。 Japanese forces attacked Hsinchu; Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army resisted.
fields.description: 1895 年 7 月，日军进攻新竹，台湾义军与黑旗军据城抵抗，激战后新竹失守，日军继续向南推进。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In July 1895 Japanese forces attacked Hsinchu. Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army defended the town, but it fell after heavy fighting and the Japanese advanced southward. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军在三角涌遭台湾义军伏击。
summary.en: Japanese forces were ambushed by Taiwanese militia at Sanxia.

fields.name: 三角涌战役 The Battle of Sanxia
fields.summary: 日军在三角涌遭台湾义军伏击。 Japanese forces were ambushed by Taiwanese militia at Sanxia.
fields.description: 1895 年 7 月，日军在三角涌（今三峡）一带遭台湾义军伏击，伤亡较重，随后调集援军反攻，三角涌一带成为乙未战争的重要战场。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In July 1895 Japanese forces were ambushed by Taiwanese militia near Sanxia (then Sanshiayong), suffering notable casualties before reinforcements counterattacked. The area became an important battlefield of the Yiwei War. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 张之洞奏设湖北枪炮厂。
summary.en: Zhang Zhidong established the Hubei Arsenal.

fields.name: 湖北枪炮厂 The Hubei Arsenal
fields.summary: 张之洞奏设湖北枪炮厂。 Zhang Zhidong established the Hubei Arsenal.
fields.description: 1895 年，张之洞在汉阳奏设湖北枪炮厂，引进德国机器制造枪炮，后称汉阳兵工厂，其“汉阳造”步枪长期装备中国军队。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1895 Zhang Zhidong established the Hubei Arsenal at Hanyang with German machinery to produce rifles and artillery. Later known as the Hanyang Arsenal, its “Hanyang” rifle equipped Chinese armies for decades. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军进攻苗栗，义军抵抗后撤退。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Miaoli; the militia resisted and withdrew.

fields.name: 苗栗之战 The Battle of Miaoli
fields.summary: 日军进攻苗栗，义军抵抗后撤退。 Japanese forces attacked Miaoli; the militia resisted and withdrew.
fields.description: 1895 年 8 月，日军进攻苗栗，台湾义军与黑旗军抵抗后撤退，苗栗失守，日军逼近大甲溪。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In August 1895 Japanese forces attacked Miaoli. Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army resisted before withdrawing, Miaoli fell, and the Japanese approached the Dajia River. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The Battle of the Dajia River

summary.zh: 日军渡大甲溪，义军阻击失利。
summary.en: Japanese forces crossed the Dajia River after defeating the militia.

fields.name: 大甲溪之战 The Battle of the Dajia River
fields.place: 台湾大甲溪 Dajia River, Taiwan
fields.summary: 日军渡大甲溪，义军阻击失利。 Japanese forces crossed the Dajia River after defeating the militia.
fields.description: 1895 年 8 月，日军渡大甲溪进攻台中，台湾义军与黑旗军依托河岸阻击，最终失利，台中门户洞开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In August 1895 Japanese forces crossed the Dajia River toward Taichung. Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army defended the riverbank but were defeated, opening the route to Taichung. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军进攻八卦山，台湾义军与黑旗军激战。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Bagua Mountain; Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army fought back.

fields.name: 八卦山战役 The Battle of Bagua Mountain
fields.summary: 日军进攻八卦山，台湾义军与黑旗军激战。 Japanese forces attacked Bagua Mountain; Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army fought back.
fields.description: 1895 年 8 月，日军进攻彰化八卦山，台湾义军与黑旗军据险抵抗，激战后彰化失守，吴汤兴、徐骧等阵亡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In August 1895 Japanese forces attacked Bagua Mountain at Changhua. Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army resisted from strong positions, but Changhua fell after heavy fighting and leaders such as Wu Tangxing and Xu Xiang were killed. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军攻占台南，乙未战争结束。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Tainan, ending the Yiwei War.

fields.name: 台南陷落 The fall of Tainan
fields.summary: 日军攻占台南，乙未战争结束。 Japanese forces captured Tainan, ending the Yiwei War.
fields.description: 1895 年 10 月，日军进攻台南，刘永福内渡，台湾民主国灭亡，乙未战争结束，台湾进入日本殖民统治时期。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1895 Japanese forces took Tainan. Liu Yongfu fled to the mainland, the Republic of Formosa collapsed, and the Yiwei War ended, beginning the period of Japanese colonial rule in Taiwan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清廷以赎金换回辽东半岛。
summary.en: The Qing redeemed the Liaodong Peninsula with an indemnity.

fields.name: 辽南条约 The Treaty of Liaonan
fields.summary: 清廷以赎金换回辽东半岛。 The Qing redeemed the Liaodong Peninsula with an indemnity.
fields.description: 1895 年 11 月，中日签订《辽南条约》，清廷以三千万两白银赎回辽东半岛，日军撤出旅顺、大连，三国干涉还辽至此落地。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1895 China and Japan signed the Treaty of Liaonan. The Qing paid a 30-million-tael indemnity to redeem the Liaodong Peninsula, and Japanese forces withdrew from Lüshun and Dalian, concluding the Triple Intervention settlement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清军接收旅顺，处理善后与海防重建。
summary.en: Qing forces recovered Lüshun and began postwar reconstruction.

fields.name: 旅顺善后 The recovery of Lüshun
fields.summary: 清军接收旅顺，处理善后与海防重建。 Qing forces recovered Lüshun and began postwar reconstruction.
fields.description: 1895 年 12 月，清军接收旅顺，处理日军撤离后的善后事宜，重建海防与地方秩序，但北洋海防已难以恢复旧观。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1895 Qing forces recovered Lüshun and handled postwar matters after the Japanese withdrawal, rebuilding coastal defense and local order, though the Beiyang defense system never regained its former strength. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 简大狮在台北一带起事抗日。
summary.en: Jian Dashi rose against the Japanese in the Taipei area.

fields.name: 简大狮抗日 Jian Dashi’s resistance
fields.summary: 简大狮在台北一带起事抗日。 Jian Dashi rose against the Japanese in the Taipei area.
fields.description: 1895 年底，简大狮在台北一带起事抗日，袭击日军据点，后转战台湾北部，最终失败并内渡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 At the end of 1895 Jian Dashi rose against Japanese rule in the Taipei area, attacking Japanese posts and later moving across northern Taiwan before his ultimate defeat and return to the mainland. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 台北芝山岩的日本教师遭袭击，日方展开报复。
summary.en: Japanese teachers at Zhishanyan were attacked, prompting reprisals.

fields.name: 芝山岩事件 The Zhishanyan incident
fields.summary: 台北芝山岩的日本教师遭袭击，日方展开报复。 Japanese teachers at Zhishanyan were attacked, prompting reprisals.

Japanese forces responded with reprisal sweeps. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军在云林进行报复性扫荡。
summary.en: Japanese forces carried out reprisal sweeps in Yunlin.

fields.name: 云林事件 The Yunlin incident
fields.summary: 日军在云林进行报复性扫荡。 Japanese forces carried out reprisal sweeps in Yunlin.
fields.description: 1896 年 6 月，日军在云林一带进行报复性扫荡，造成大量平民死亡，史称云林事件（云林大屠杀）。具体死亡人数仍有争议，本文只记事件性质。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In June 1896 Japanese forces carried out reprisal sweeps in the Yunlin area, causing heavy civilian deaths, an event known as the Yunlin incident (or Yunlin massacre). Casualty figures remain disputed; this entry records only the nature of the event. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 柯铁虎等据铁国山坚持抗日游击。
summary.en: Ke Tiehu and others based their resistance at Tieguoshan.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 德国租借胶州湾，列强掀起瓜分狂潮。
summary.en: Germany leased Jiaozhou Bay, setting off a scramble for concessions.

fields.name: 列强租借港湾 The scramble for concessions
fields.summary: 德国租借胶州湾，列强掀起瓜分狂潮。 Germany leased Jiaozhou Bay, setting off a scramble for concessions.
fields.description: 1898 年，德国强迫清廷租借胶州湾，俄、英、法、日等国随后纷纷租借港湾、划分势力范围，中国面临被瓜分的危机。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1898 Germany forced the Qing to lease Jiaozhou Bay. Russia, Britain, France, and Japan soon leased ports and carved out spheres of influence, confronting China with the threat of partition. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 光绪帝下诏变法，百日维新开始。
summary.en: The Guangxu Emperor issued reform edicts, beginning the Hundred Days’ Reform.

fields.summary: 光绪帝下诏变法，百日维新开始。 The Guangxu Emperor issued reform edicts, beginning the Hundred Days’ Reform.

In September the Empress Dowager Cixi staged a coup and ended the reforms. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 林少猫在阿猴一带组织抗日。

fields.name: 林少猫抗日 Lin Shaomao’s resistance
fields.summary: 林少猫在阿猴一带组织抗日。 Lin Shaomao organized resistance around Akau (Pingtung).
fields.description: 1898 年，林少猫在阿猴（今屏东）一带组织抗日，控制地方并袭击日军，后与日方谈判，1902 年失败。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1898 Lin Shaomao organized resistance around Akau (modern Pingtung), controlling local areas and attacking Japanese forces. He later negotiated with the Japanese and was defeated in 1902. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The Boxer Uprising and the Eight-Nation Alliance

summary.zh: 义和团进入北京，八国联军侵华。
summary.en: The Boxers entered Beijing and the Eight-Nation Alliance intervened.

fields.name: 义和团与八国联军 The Boxer Uprising and the Eight-Nation Alliance
fields.summary: 义和团进入北京，八国联军侵华。 The Boxers entered Beijing and the Eight-Nation Alliance intervened.
fields.description: 1900 年，义和团运动高涨并进入北京，清廷对列强宣战；八国联军攻占北京，慈禧太后西逃，次年签订《辛丑条约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1900 the Boxer movement spread to Beijing and the Qing court declared war on the powers. The Eight-Nation Alliance captured Beijing, the court fled west, and the Boxer Protocol was signed in 1901. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The Mutual Protection of Southeast China

summary.zh: 东南督抚与列强达成互保协议。
summary.en: Southeast governors and foreign powers agreed to mutual protection.

fields.name: 东南互保 The Mutual Protection of Southeast China
fields.summary: 东南督抚与列强达成互保协议。 Southeast governors and foreign powers agreed to mutual protection.
fields.description: 1900 年义和团运动期间，刘坤一、张之洞等东南督抚与列强驻沪领事达成“东南互保”协议，避免战火波及东南各省，显示清廷中央权威的衰落。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 During the Boxer crisis of 1900, governors Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong reached a “mutual protection” agreement with foreign consuls in Shanghai, keeping the war out of southeastern provinces and revealing the decline of central authority. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清廷推行新政，废科举、练新军。
summary.en: The Qing launched the New Policies, abolishing the civil service exams and creating a modern army.

fields.name: 清末新政 The Late Qing reforms
fields.summary: 清廷推行新政，废科举、练新军。 The Qing launched the New Policies, abolishing the civil service exams and creating a modern army.
fields.description: 1901 年起，清廷推行新政，包括改革官制、废科举、练新军、兴学堂等，试图挽救统治危机，但未能阻止革命。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 1901 the Qing implemented the New Policies, reforming the bureaucracy, abolishing the civil service examinations, creating a modern army, and founding schools. The reforms failed to prevent revolution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The abolition of the imperial examinations

summary.zh: 清廷诏废科举，千年科举制终结。
summary.en: The Qing abolished the imperial examinations after a millennium.

fields.name: 废科举 The abolition of the imperial examinations
fields.summary: 清廷诏废科举，千年科举制终结。 The Qing abolished the imperial examinations after a millennium.
fields.description: 1905 年 9 月，清廷诏令自 1906 年起停止科举，延续千年的科举制度终结，新式学堂成为主要上升通道。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1905 the Qing court ordered the imperial examinations stopped from 1906, ending a system that had lasted a millennium and making modern schools the main path to advancement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.zh: 上海城厢内外总工程局

summary.zh: 上海绅商成立城厢内外总工程局。
summary.en: Shanghai elites founded the General Works Bureau.

fields.name: 上海城厢内外总工程局 The Shanghai General Works Bureau
fields.summary: 上海绅商成立城厢内外总工程局。 Shanghai elites founded the General Works Bureau.
fields.description: 1905 年 10 月，上海地方绅商成立城厢内外总工程局，办理市政、警务与公益，是清末地方自治的重要实践。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1905 Shanghai elites founded the General Works Bureau for the city’s inner and outer districts, handling municipal administration, policing, and public welfare—an important experiment in late Qing local self-government. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清廷派五大臣出洋考察宪政。
summary.en: The Qing sent five ministers abroad to study constitutional government.

fields.summary: 清廷派五大臣出洋考察宪政。 The Qing sent five ministers abroad to study constitutional government.
fields.description: 1905 年 12 月，清廷派载泽、端方等五大臣出洋考察宪政，为预备立宪做准备，回国后推动了 1906 年的预备立宪诏。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1905 the Qing sent ministers including Zaitze and Duanfang abroad to study constitutional government, preparing for the 1906 announcement of preparations for a constitution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 袁世凯在天津试办地方自治。
summary.en: Yuan Shikai experimented with local self-government in Tianjin.

fields.description: 1906 年，袁世凯在天津试办地方自治，设立天津自治局，推行议事会与董事会，成为清末地方自治的样板。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1906 Yuan Shikai experimented with local self-government in Tianjin, establishing the Tianjin Self-Government Bureau with councils and boards, a model for late Qing local autonomy. atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清廷宣布预备立宪。
summary.en: The Qing court announced preparations for constitutional government.

fields.name: 预备立宪 The preparation for constitutional government
fields.summary: 清廷宣布预备立宪。 The Qing court announced preparations for constitutional government.
fields.description: 1906 年，清廷在五大臣出洋考察后宣布“预备仿行宪政”，推行官制改革，但进展缓慢，未能挽回人心。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1906, after the five ministers’ overseas investigations, the Qing court announced preparations for constitutional government and reformed the bureaucracy, but progress was slow and failed to restore public confidence. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》。
summary.en: The Qing court issued the Principles of the Constitution.

fields.name: 钦定宪法大纲 The Principles of the Constitution
fields.summary: 清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》。 The Qing court issued the Principles of the Constitution.
fields.description: 1908 年，清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》，规定君上大权，并以九年为预备立宪期限，被立宪派批评为“假立宪”。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1908 the Qing court issued the Principles of the Constitution, preserving broad imperial powers and setting a nine-year preparatory period. Constitutionalists criticized it as “fake constitutionalism.” Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Qing promulgated regulations on urban and rural local self-government.

fields.summary: 清廷颁布城镇乡地方自治章程。 The Qing promulgated regulations on urban and rural local self-government.
fields.description: 1909 年 1 月，清廷颁布《城镇乡地方自治章程》，推行地方自治，设立议事会与董事会，为立宪派参与地方政治提供制度空间。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In January 1909 the Qing promulgated regulations on local self-government in towns and villages, establishing councils and boards and giving constitutionalists an institutional foothold in local politics. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 各省咨议局成立，立宪派进入地方政治。
summary.en: Provincial assemblies were established, bringing constitutionalists into local politics.

fields.name: 咨议局成立 The provincial assemblies
fields.summary: 各省咨议局成立，立宪派进入地方政治。 Provincial assemblies were established, bringing constitutionalists into local politics.
fields.description: 1909 年，清廷在各省设立咨议局，作为地方议事机构，立宪派借此扩大政治影响，推动召开国会请愿运动。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1909 the Qing established provincial assemblies as local deliberative bodies. atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The petition movement for a parliament

summary.zh: 各省代表赴京请愿，要求速开国会。
summary.en: Provincial delegates petitioned Beijing for an early national parliament.

fields.name: 国会请愿运动 The petition movement for a parliament
fields.summary: 各省代表赴京请愿，要求速开国会。 Provincial delegates petitioned Beijing for an early national parliament.
fields.description: 1910 年，各省咨议局与商会、教育会等团体发起三次国会请愿运动，要求缩短预备立宪期限、速开国会，清廷仅小幅让步，立宪派日益失望。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1910 provincial assemblies, chambers of commerce, and educational associations launched three petition campaigns demanding that the Qing shorten the preparatory period and convene a parliament. The court made only minor concessions, and constitutionalists grew increasingly disillusioned. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 各省咨议局代表在北京成立联合会。
summary.en: Delegates from provincial assemblies formed a federation in Beijing.

fields.name: 各省咨议局联合会 The federation of provincial assemblies
fields.summary: 各省咨议局代表在北京成立联合会。 Delegates from provincial assemblies formed a federation in Beijing.
fields.description: 1910 年 8 月，各省咨议局代表在北京成立联合会，协调请愿速开国会与立宪事宜，成为立宪派跨省联合的重要平台。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In August 1910 delegates from provincial assemblies formed a federation in Beijing to coordinate petitions for an early parliament and constitutional government, creating an important cross-provincial platform for constitutionalists. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The election of the Advisory Council

summary.zh: 资政院议员选举后开院，立宪派进入中央议事机构。
summary.en: After elections, the Advisory Council opened, bringing constitutionalists into a central deliberative body.

fields.name: 资政院选举 The election of the Advisory Council
fields.summary: 资政院议员选举后开院，立宪派进入中央议事机构。 After elections, the Advisory Council opened, bringing constitutionalists into a central deliberative body.
fields.description: 1909 年各省选举资政院议员，1910 年 10 月资政院开院，成为清末立宪派参与中央政治的重要平台，但权限有限，未能满足速开国会的要求。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1909 the provinces elected members of the Advisory Council, which opened in October 1910 as a central deliberative body for constitutionalists. Its powers were limited, however, and it failed to satisfy demands for a parliament. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The Advisory Council impeaches the Grand Council

summary.zh: 资政院弹劾军机大臣，要求责任内阁。
summary.en: The Advisory Council impeached the Grand Council and demanded a responsible cabinet.

fields.name: 资政院弹劾军机大臣 The Advisory Council impeaches the Grand Council
fields.summary: 资政院弹劾军机大臣，要求责任内阁。 The Advisory Council impeached the Grand Council and demanded a responsible cabinet.
fields.description: 1910 年 12 月，资政院第一次常年会弹劾军机大臣，要求设立责任内阁，与清廷发生正面冲突，显示资政院与皇权的张力。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1910 the Advisory Council’s first annual session impeached the Grand Council and demanded a responsible cabinet, clashing directly with the court and revealing the tension between the council and imperial authority. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清廷成立皇族主导的内阁，立宪派失望。
summary.en: The Qing formed a cabinet dominated by imperial kinsmen, disappointing constitutionalists.

fields.name: 皇族内阁 The Royal Cabinet
fields.summary: 清廷成立皇族主导的内阁，立宪派失望。 The Qing formed a cabinet dominated by imperial kinsmen, disappointing constitutionalists.
fields.description: 1911 年 5 月，清廷成立新内阁，13 名阁员中皇族占 7 人，被称为“皇族内阁”，立宪派大失所望，进一步转向革命。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1911 the Qing formed a new cabinet with seven of thirteen members from the imperial clan. Dubbed the “Royal Cabinet,” it deeply disappointed constitutionalists and pushed many toward revolution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

fields.name: 保路运动 The Railway Protection Movement
fields.summary: 四川保路运动爆发，成为辛亥革命导火索。 The Sichuan Railway Protection Movement erupted, helping trigger the 1911 Revolution.
fields.description: 1911 年，清廷宣布铁路国有，激起四川保路运动，清廷调湖北新军入川镇压，削弱了武汉防务，为武昌起义创造了条件。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为政治决策/政治运动，不绘制行军路线。 In 1911 the Qing move to nationalize railways sparked the Sichuan Railway Protection Movement. Troops were drawn from Hubei to suppress it, weakening Wuhan’s defenses and creating conditions for the Wuchang Uprising. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. This is a political decision/movement; no march route is drawn.

summary.en: Constitutionalists founded the Xianyouhui in Beijing.

fields.description: 1911 年 6 月，宪友会在北京成立，试图整合立宪派力量，推动宪政，但清廷随即成立皇族内阁，立宪派进一步失望。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In June 1911 the Xianyouhui was founded in Beijing to unite constitutionalist forces and promote constitutional government. The court’s formation of the Royal Cabinet soon afterward deepened their disillusionment. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 武昌起义爆发，各省响应。
summary.en: The Wuchang Uprising broke out and provinces across China responded.

fields.name: 辛亥革命 The 1911 Revolution

fields.description: 1911 年 10 月 10 日，新军在武昌起义，攻占湖广总督署，各省随后纷纷响应，清朝统治迅速瓦解。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 10 October 1911, New Army units rose in Wuchang and seized the Hubei governor’s office. Provinces across China soon responded, and Qing rule rapidly collapsed. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Feng Guozhang’s Beiyang troops attacked, the city briefly fell, and the fighting spread to the foreign concessions. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1911 年 11 月 3 日，上海革命党人与商团起义，攻占江南制造总局，成立沪军都督府，陈其美任都督。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 3 November 1911 Shanghai revolutionaries and militia rose, seized the Jiangnan Arsenal, and established the Shanghai military government under Chen Qimei. summary.en: The Jiangsu–Zhejiang allied forces captured Nanjing.

Emperor Zhenzong of Song went to the front, and the two sides negotiated the Chanyuan Treaty, fixing the border and requiring Song annual payments to Liao. Dates and terms follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Song army was ambushed by Western Xia forces at Haoshuichuan and suffered heavy losses.

fields.name: 好水川之战 Battle of Haoshuichuan
fields.place: 宁夏隆德北好水川（今甜水河一带） Haoshuichuan north of Longde, Ningxia
fields.summary: 宋军在好水川被西夏军伏击，损失惨重。 The Song army was ambushed by Western Xia forces at Haoshuichuan and suffered heavy losses.
fields.description: 庆历元年（1041）二月，元昊率十万众自天都山、折姜南下，沿瓦亭川抵好水川设伏，另遣偏师至怀远城诱敌。韩琦命任福率一万八千人自镇戎军经怀远城、得胜寨趋羊牧隆城，出夏军之后；任福在张家堡被诱，脱离辎重追击，二月十四日在好水川中伏，宋军大败，任福、桑怿、武英、王珪等战死，士卒阵亡一万余人。旧数据作 1040 年，实为庆历元年（1041）二月。 In the second month of 1041 Li Yuanhao marched south from Tiandu shan and Zhejiang along the Wating river and laid an ambush at Haoshuichuan, sending a detachment to lure the Song army at Huaiyuan. Han Qi ordered Ren Fu with 18,000 men from Zhenrongjun via Huaiyuan and Desheng towards Yangmulong to fall on the enemy’s rear; lured at Zhangjiabao, Ren Fu abandoned his baggage and was ambushed at Haoshuichuan on 14 February. The Song army was routed and Ren Fu, Sang Yi, Wu Ying and Wang Gui were killed with over 10,000 men. The old data dated the battle 1040; it was actually the second month of 1041.

summary.en: Han Qi hurried to Zhenrongjun and gave Ren Fu 18,000 men against Li Yuanhao.

fields.name: 韩琦赴镇戎军调兵 Han Qi mobilises at Zhenrongjun
fields.place: 宁夏固原（宋镇戎军） Guyuan, Ningxia (Song Zhenrongjun)
fields.summary: 韩琦闻元昊谋寇渭州，急趋镇戎军调兵万八千人付任福。 Han Qi hurried to Zhenrongjun and gave Ren Fu 18,000 men against Li Yuanhao.
fields.description: 庆历元年（1041）二月，韩琦巡边至高平，闻元昊阅兵折姜、谋寇渭州，急趋镇戎军，尽出守兵并募敢勇共一万八千人，命环庆路副都部署任福统率，令自镇戎军经怀远城、得胜寨至羊牧隆城出夏军之后，并再三戒其持重。任福轻进，遂有好水川之败。 In the second month of 1041 Han Qi, on the frontier at Gaoping, learned that Li Yuanhao was massing at Zhejiang for an attack on Weizhou. He hurried to Zhenrongjun, turned out the garrison and raised 18,000 men under Ren Fu, ordering him to march via Huaiyuan and Desheng to Yangmulong and strike the enemy’s rear, warning him repeatedly to be cautious. Ren Fu advanced rashly and was destroyed at Haoshuichuan.

name.en: Gao Shengtai usurps the Dali throne

summary.zh: 权臣高升泰废段正明，建立大中国，后还政段氏。
summary.en: The minister Gao Shengtai deposed Duan Zhengming and briefly founded the state of Dazhong.

fields.name: 高升泰代立 Gao Shengtai usurps the Dali throne
fields.summary: 权臣高升泰废段正明，建立大中国，后还政段氏。 The minister Gao Shengtai deposed Duan Zhengming and briefly founded the state of Dazhong.
fields.description: 1094 年大理权臣高升泰废段正明自立，国号大中国；1096 年高升泰死，其子高泰明遵遗命还政段氏，迎段正淳立，大理国进入后理国时期。此后高氏世为相国，分治善阐等府，形成国都羊苴咩城与东京善阐并重的格局。 In 1094 the Dali minister Gao Shengtai deposed Duan Zhengming and proclaimed the Great China; on his death in 1096 his son Gao Taiming restored the Duan house and enthroned Duan Zhengchun, beginning the Later Dali period. The Gao family then held the chancellorship hereditarily and governed Shanchan and other fu, giving the realm two centres, the capital Yangjumie and the eastern capital Shanchan.

summary.zh: 方腊在睦州起义，攻占江南多州。
summary.en: Fang La rose at Muzhou and captured several prefectures in Jiangnan.

fields.name: 方腊起义 The Fang La rebellion
fields.summary: 方腊在睦州起义，攻占江南多州。 Fang La rose at Muzhou and captured several prefectures in Jiangnan.
fields.description: 宣和二年（1120）十月初九，方腊在睦州青溪县帮源洞起事，以诛朱勔为名，数日聚众数万。十一月二十二日在青溪息坑全歼两浙路常驻官军五千人，十二月克睦州、歙州，二十九日攻入杭州。宋廷以童贯为江淮荆浙宣抚使，率十五万禁军及西北蕃汉兵南下，宣和三年（1121）二月围杭州、三月复睦州与青溪、四月破帮源洞，方腊被擒，八月伏诛。 On 9 October 1120 Fang La rose at Bangyuan cave in Qingxi, Muzhou, in the name of punishing Zhu Mian, gathering tens of thousands within days. On 22 November he destroyed the 5,000-strong standing army of Liangzhe at Xikeng, took Muzhou and Shezhou in the twelfth month and entered Hangzhou on the 29th. The court sent Tong Guan south with 150,000 men; Hangzhou was besieged in the second month of 1121, Muzhou and Qingxi recovered in the third and Bangyuan cave broken in the fourth, Fang La being captured and executed in the eighth month.

summary.zh: 方腊军攻入杭州，杀两浙路制置使陈建、廉访使赵约。
summary.en: Fang La’s army entered Hangzhou, killing the Liangzhe commissioner Chen Jian and the inspector Zhao Yue.

fields.name: 方腊攻占杭州 Fang La takes Hangzhou
fields.summary: 方腊军攻入杭州，杀两浙路制置使陈建、廉访使赵约。 Fang La’s army entered Hangzhou, killing the Liangzhe commissioner Chen Jian and the inspector Zhao Yue.
fields.description: 宣和二年（1120）十二月，方腊军自睦州、歙州东进，攻克富阳、新城，二十九日进逼杭州。知州赵霆弃城走，义军入城，杀两浙路制置使陈建、廉访使赵约，纵火六日。杭州既失，东南震动，宋廷急命童贯率十五万军南下。 In the twelfth month of 1120 Fang La’s army moved east from Muzhou and Shezhou, took Fuyang and Xincheng and closed on Hangzhou on the 29th. Governor Zhao Ting fled, the rebels entered and killed the Liangzhe commissioner Chen Jian and inspector Zhao Yue, burning the city for six days. With Hangzhou lost the south-east was shaken and the court sent Tong Guan south with 150,000 men.

summary.en: The Song army closed on Bangyuan cave, captured Fang La and ended the revolt.

fields.name: 帮源洞之战 Battle of Bangyuan cave
fields.place: 浙江淳安（青溪）帮源洞 Bangyuan cave, Chun’an (Qingxi), Zhejiang
fields.summary: 宋军合围帮源洞，方腊被擒，起义失败。 The Song army closed on Bangyuan cave, captured Fang La and ended the revolt.
fields.description: 宣和三年（1121）四月，王禀自睦州、刘镇自歙州合围青溪帮源洞。二十四日官军自洞后突入、纵火为号，前后夹击，义军战死七万余人；二十六日方腊及其妻、子、丞相方肥等五十二人被俘，七月解往汴京，八月伏诛。 In the fourth month of 1121 Wang Bing from Muzhou and Liu Zhen from Shezhou closed on Bangyuan cave in Qingxi. On the 24th the Song troops broke in from the rear and lit fires as a signal, attacking from both sides; over 70,000 rebels died. On the 26th Fang La, his family and chancellor Fang Fei — 52 people — were captured, sent to Kaifeng in the seventh month and executed in the eighth.

fields.description: 1163 年，宋孝宗即位后发动隆兴北伐，宋军初胜后因将领不和在宿州大败，最终与金朝再订和议。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1163, Emperor Xiaozong launched the Longxing northern expedition. After initial success, the Song army was routed at Suzhou because of disagreements among commanders, leading to another peace with Jin. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Genghis Khan invaded Western Xia, besieged Zhongxing, and accepted a marriage peace.

fields.summary: 成吉思汗攻西夏，围中兴府，西夏纳女求和。 Genghis Khan invaded Western Xia, besieged Zhongxing, and accepted a marriage peace.

Western Xia sued for peace by offering a princess, postponing its destruction. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 成吉思汗在野狐岭大败金军。
summary.en: Genghis Khan defeated the Jin army at Yehuling.

fields.name: 野狐岭之战 The Battle of Yehuling
fields.summary: 成吉思汗在野狐岭大败金军。 Genghis Khan defeated the Jin army at Yehuling.
fields.description: 1211 年三月，成吉思汗自漠北率军南下伐金，经汪古部领地入塞。七月，蒙古军在野狐岭（今河北万全北）大破金军主力，金军精锐丧失殆尽；蒙古军随即南下，1215 年攻占中都。 In the third month of 1211 Chinggis Khan marched south from north of the desert against Jin through Ongud territory. In the seventh month the Mongol army destroyed the Jin main force at Yehuling (north of modern Wanquan, Hebei), wiping out its best troops; the Mongols then moved south and took Zhongdu in 1215.

Emperor Xuanzong had already moved the court to Kaifeng, and Jin’s control of North China was severely weakened. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Mongol forces took Zhongxing and ended Western Xia.

Genghis Khan died the same year. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

The Song garrison held out for months, and Möngke died in camp, prompting a Mongol withdrawal. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 元军用回回炮破樊城，守将范天顺自缢、牛富赴火死。
summary.en: Yuan counterweight trebuchets broke Fancheng; Fan Tianshun and Niu Fu died.

fields.name: 樊城之战 Battle of Fancheng
fields.place: 湖北襄阳樊城 Fancheng, Xiangyang, Hubei
fields.summary: 元军用回回炮破樊城，守将范天顺自缢、牛富赴火死。 Yuan counterweight trebuchets broke Fancheng; Fan Tianshun and Niu Fu died.
fields.description: 至元十年（1273）正月，阿里海牙用西域亦思马因所献回回炮攻樊城，先断襄樊间浮桥，使襄阳不能援，水陆夹攻，破其城。守将范天顺自缢，牛富率死士巷战，身负重伤后赴火死。樊城既破，襄阳成孤城，二月吕文焕出降。 In the first month of 1273 Ali Haya used the counterweight trebuchets of the Western Muslim Isma’il against Fancheng, first cutting the pontoon bridge so Xiangyang could not help, then attacking by land and water and breaking the city. Fan Tianshun hanged himself; Niu Fu fought in the streets with a hundred men and, badly wounded, threw himself into the flames. With Fancheng taken Xiangyang stood alone and Lü Wenhuan surrendered in the second month.

atlasTitle.en: Song–Yuan

summary.zh: 元军攻破襄阳，南宋长江中游防线崩溃。
summary.en: Yuan forces captured Xiangyang, collapsing the Southern Song’s middle Yangtze defense.

fields.name: 襄阳之战 The Battle of Xiangyang
fields.summary: 元军攻破襄阳，南宋长江中游防线崩溃。 Yuan forces captured Xiangyang, collapsing the Southern Song’s middle Yangtze defense.
fields.description: 蒙古军自 1267 年起围襄阳，筑堡于鹿门山、白河口断宋援，围城五年不下。至元十年（1273）正月，阿里海牙用回回炮攻破樊城，守将范天顺自缢、牛富赴火死；二月移炮攻襄阳，一炮中谯楼，守将吕文焕出降。襄阳既失，元军顺汉水入江，南宋江防随之崩溃。 The Mongols besieged Xiangyang from 1267, building forts at Lumen shan and Baihekou to cut Song relief, but the city held for five years. In the first month of 1273 Ali Haya’s counterweight trebuchets broke Fancheng, where Fan Tianshun and Niu Fu died; in the second month the guns were turned on Xiangyang, a shot struck its drum tower and Lü Wenhuan surrendered. With Xiangyang lost the Yuan fleets entered the Yangtze and the Song river defences collapsed.

fields.summary: 元军自襄阳南下，渡江攻占鄂州。 Yuan forces moved south from Xiangyang, crossed the Yangtze, and took Ezhou.
fields.description: 1274 年，元军在襄阳陷落后沿汉水南下，渡长江攻占鄂州，南宋长江防线全面动摇。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1274, after the fall of Xiangyang, Yuan forces moved down the Han River, crossed the Yangtze, and captured Ezhou, shaking the entire Southern Song river defense. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Song–Yuan

summary.zh: 元军在丁家洲大败南宋水军，直逼临安。
summary.en: Yuan forces routed the Southern Song navy at Dingjiazhou and advanced on Lin’an.

fields.name: 丁家洲之战 The Battle of Dingjiazhou
fields.summary: 元军在丁家洲大败南宋水军，直逼临安。 Yuan forces routed the Southern Song navy at Dingjiazhou and advanced on Lin’an.
fields.description: 1275 年，元军沿江东下，在丁家洲击败南宋水军主力，宋军溃败，临安门户洞开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1275, Yuan forces advanced east along the Yangtze and defeated the main Southern Song fleet at Dingjiazhou. The Song army collapsed, leaving Lin’an exposed. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 元军进逼临安，南宋朝廷投降。 Yuan forces approached Lin’an, and the Southern Song court surrendered.
fields.description: 1276 年，元军攻至临安，谢太后与宋恭帝出降，南宋朝廷投降，残余势力继续南逃。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1276, Yuan forces reached Lin’an. Empress Dowager Xie and Emperor Gong surrendered, while remaining Song loyalists fled south. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 元军围攻崖山，南宋最后抵抗失败。
summary.en: Yuan forces attacked Yamen, ending the last Southern Song resistance.

fields.name: 崖山海战 The Battle of Yamen
fields.summary: 元军围攻崖山，南宋最后抵抗失败。 Yuan forces attacked Yamen, ending the last Southern Song resistance.
fields.description: 1279 年，元军与南宋残部在崖山海战，宋军大败，陆秀夫负幼帝投海，南宋灭亡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1279, Yuan forces defeated the remaining Southern Song fleet at Yamen. Lu Xiufu jumped into the sea with the child emperor, ending the Southern Song. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 581 年，北周外戚杨坚接受静帝禅让，建立隋朝，改元开皇，仍都长安。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 581, Yang Jian, a relative of the Northern Zhou imperial family, accepted Emperor Jing’s abdication, founded the Sui, and kept Chang’an as the capital. atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 隋军攻入建康，陈朝灭亡，南北统一。
summary.en: Sui forces entered Jiankang, ending the Chen dynasty and reunifying north and south.

fields.name: 隋灭陈 The Sui conquer Chen
fields.summary: 隋军攻入建康，陈朝灭亡，南北统一。 Sui forces entered Jiankang, ending the Chen dynasty and reunifying north and south.
fields.description: 589 年，隋军分路南下，攻入建康，陈后主被俘，陈朝灭亡，结束自西晋末年以来近三百年的分裂。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 589, Sui forces advanced south along several routes and entered Jiankang. Emperor Houzhu of Chen was captured, ending the Chen dynasty and nearly three centuries of division since the fall of Western Jin. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opens the Tongji Canal

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开凿通济渠，连接洛阳与淮河。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Tongji Canal, linking Luoyang with the Huai River.

fields.name: 隋炀帝开凿通济渠 Emperor Yang of Sui opens the Tongji Canal
fields.summary: 隋炀帝开凿通济渠，连接洛阳与淮河。 Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Tongji Canal, linking Luoyang with the Huai River.
fields.description: 605 年，隋炀帝下令开凿通济渠，自洛阳引谷、洛水入黄河，再引黄河水入淮河，成为隋唐大运河的核心河段。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 605, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the Tongji Canal to be dug, linking Luoyang with the Yellow River and then the Huai River. It became a core section of the Sui-Tang Grand Canal. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开江南河，自京口至余杭八百余里。
summary.en: Emperor Yang opened the Jiangnan canal from Jingkou to Yuhang, over 800 li.

fields.name: 开江南河 Opening of the Jiangnan canal
fields.place: 浙江杭州（余杭） Hangzhou (Yuhang), Zhejiang
fields.summary: 隋炀帝开江南河，自京口至余杭八百余里。 Emperor Yang opened the Jiangnan canal from Jingkou to Yuhang, over 800 li.
fields.description: 大业六年（610）炀帝下令开江南河，自京口（今镇江）引长江水南至余杭（今杭州）入钱塘江，全长八百余里，宽十余丈，可通龙舟。至此以洛阳为中心、北起涿郡南至余杭的大运河全线贯通。 In 610 Emperor Yang ordered the Jiangnan canal dug from Jingkou (Zhenjiang) south to Yuhang (Hangzhou) and into the Qiantang, over 800 li long and wide enough for the imperial dragon boats. With this the Grand Canal from Zhuojun in the north to Yuhang in the south, centred on Luoyang, was complete.

summary.zh: 隋炀帝征高句丽，围攻辽东城不克。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui campaigned against Goguryeo but failed to take Liaodong.

fields.name: 辽东之役 The Liaodong campaign
fields.summary: 隋炀帝征高句丽，围攻辽东城不克。 Emperor Yang of Sui campaigned against Goguryeo but failed to take Liaodong.
fields.description: 612 年，隋炀帝亲征高句丽，隋军渡辽水围攻辽东城，久攻不下，此后接连失利，成为隋末动乱的导火索之一。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 612, Emperor Yang of Sui personally campaigned against Goguryeo. Sui forces crossed the Liao River and besieged Liaodong but failed to take it, and later defeats contributed to the unrest that ended the Sui. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

He then gradually subdued regional rivals. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Li Shimin defeated Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass, laying the basis for unification.

fields.name: 虎牢关之战 The Battle of Hulao Pass
fields.place: 河南虎牢关 Hulao Pass, Henan
fields.summary: 李世民在虎牢关击败窦建德，奠定统一基础。 Li Shimin defeated Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass, laying the basis for unification.

Dou Jiande marched to relieve it, but Li Shimin seized Hulao Pass, defeated and captured Dou, and Wang Shichong at Luoyang then surrendered. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Li Shimin launched a coup at Xuanwu Gate and soon became emperor.

fields.summary: 李世民在玄武门发动政变，随后即位。 Li Shimin launched a coup at Xuanwu Gate and soon became emperor.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 唐太宗励精图治，出现政治清明、经济发展的贞观之治。
summary.en: Emperor Taizong’s conscientious rule produced the orderly and prosperous Zhenguan era.

fields.name: 贞观之治 The Zhenguan era
fields.summary: 唐太宗励精图治，出现政治清明、经济发展的贞观之治。 Emperor Taizong’s conscientious rule produced the orderly and prosperous Zhenguan era.
fields.description: 627 年起，唐太宗重用魏徵、房玄龄等，轻徭薄赋、完善制度，史称贞观之治。年份为通行说法，具体起讫待史料校订。 From 627, Emperor Taizong relied on ministers such as Wei Zheng and Fang Xuanling, lightened taxes, and improved institutions, an era later called the Zhenguan governance. Dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 唐军击败东突厥，颉利可汗被俘。

fields.place: 内蒙古阴山 Yinshan, Inner Mongolia
fields.summary: 唐军击败东突厥，颉利可汗被俘。 Tang forces defeated the Eastern Turks and captured Illig Qaghan.
fields.description: 630 年，李靖率唐军出阴山，突袭东突厥牙帐，颉利可汗败走被俘，东突厥灭亡。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 630, Li Jing led Tang forces across the Yin Mountains and attacked the Eastern Turkic camp. Illig Qaghan fled and was captured, ending the Eastern Turkic Khaganate. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 文成公主远嫁吐蕃赞普松赞干布。
summary.en: Princess Wencheng married Songtsen Gampo of Tubo.

fields.name: 文成公主入藏 Princess Wencheng goes to Tubo
fields.summary: 文成公主远嫁吐蕃赞普松赞干布。 Princess Wencheng married Songtsen Gampo of Tubo.
fields.description: 641 年，唐太宗以文成公主嫁吐蕃赞普松赞干布，公主经青海入藏，促进唐蕃和亲与文化交流。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 641, Emperor Taizong sent Princess Wencheng to marry Songtsen Gampo of Tubo. She traveled through Qinghai to Lhasa, promoting peace and cultural exchange between Tang and Tubo. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Tang defeat the Western Turks

summary.zh: 苏定方率唐军击败西突厥，唐朝控制西域。
summary.en: Su Dingfang defeated the Western Turks, extending Tang control over the Western Regions.

fields.name: 唐灭西突厥 The Tang defeat the Western Turks
fields.place: 西域伊犁 Ili, Western Regions
fields.summary: 苏定方率唐军击败西突厥，唐朝控制西域。 Su Dingfang defeated the Western Turks, extending Tang control over the Western Regions.
fields.description: 657 年，唐将苏定方率军进攻西突厥，在伊犁河流域击败阿史那贺鲁，西突厥汗国灭亡，唐朝随后设都护府管理西域。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 657, the Tang general Su Dingfang campaigned against the Western Turks, defeated Ashina Helu in the Ili region, and ended the Western Turkic Khaganate. Tang subsequently established protectorates in the Western Regions. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 唐与新罗联军在白江口击败倭国与百济联军。
summary.en: Tang and Silla forces defeated the Yamato and Baekje fleet at Baekgang.

fields.name: 白江口之战 The Battle of Baekgang
fields.place: 朝鲜锦江 Geum River, Korea
fields.summary: 唐与新罗联军在白江口击败倭国与百济联军。 Tang and Silla forces defeated the Yamato and Baekje fleet at Baekgang.
fields.description: 663 年，唐与新罗联军在白江口与倭国、百济联军水战，唐军水师以少胜多，焚毁大量敌船，百济复国运动失败。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 663, a Tang–Silla fleet fought the Yamato and Baekje forces at Baekgang. The Tang squadron, though outnumbered, destroyed many enemy ships, ending the Baekje restoration movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 武则天称帝，改唐为周，成为中国唯一女皇帝。
summary.en: Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor, changed the dynasty to Zhou, and became China’s only female sovereign.

fields.name: 武则天称帝 Wu Zetian proclaims the Zhou
fields.summary: 武则天称帝，改唐为周，成为中国唯一女皇帝。 Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor, changed the dynasty to Zhou, and became China’s only female sovereign.
fields.description: 690 年，武则天在洛阳称帝，改国号为周，史称武周，成为中国历史上唯一正统女皇帝。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 690, Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor at Luoyang and changed the dynastic name to Zhou, becoming the only woman to rule China as sovereign in the orthodox line. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 张柬之等发动政变，逼武则天退位，唐中宗复位。
summary.en: Zhang Jianzhi and others forced Wu Zetian to abdicate and restored Emperor Zhongzong.

fields.name: 神龙政变 The Shenlong coup
fields.summary: 张柬之等发动政变，逼武则天退位，唐中宗复位。 Zhang Jianzhi and others forced Wu Zetian to abdicate and restored Emperor Zhongzong.
fields.description: 705 年，张柬之、桓彦范等联合禁军发动神龙政变，逼武则天退位，唐中宗复位，恢复唐朝国号。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 705, Zhang Jianzhi, Huan Yanfan, and others, with palace guard support, launched the Shenlong coup, forced Wu Zetian to abdicate, and restored Emperor Zhongzong and the Tang dynastic name. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 唐玄宗开元年间政局稳定、经济繁荣。
summary.en: The Kaiyuan era of Emperor Xuanzong saw stable government and economic prosperity.

fields.name: 开元盛世 The Kaiyuan era
fields.summary: 唐玄宗开元年间政局稳定、经济繁荣。 The Kaiyuan era of Emperor Xuanzong saw stable government and economic prosperity.
fields.description: 713 年起，唐玄宗任用姚崇、宋璟等，整顿吏治、发展生产，唐朝进入开元盛世，成为当时世界最强盛的国家之一。年份为通行说法，具体起讫待史料校订。 From 713, Emperor Xuanzong appointed able ministers such as Yao Chong and Song Jing, reformed administration, and promoted production, ushering in the Kaiyuan prosperity that made Tang one of the strongest states of its time. Dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 唐军与阿拔斯王朝在怛罗斯交战，唐军失利。
summary.en: Tang forces fought the Abbasid army at Talas and were defeated.

fields.name: 怛罗斯之战 The Battle of Talas
fields.summary: 唐军与阿拔斯王朝在怛罗斯交战，唐军失利。 Tang forces fought the Abbasid army at Talas and were defeated.
fields.description: 751 年，高仙芝率唐军与阿拔斯王朝及葛逻禄联军在怛罗斯交战，因葛逻禄倒戈，唐军大败。此战常被与造纸术西传联系起来，具体细节待史料校订。 In 751, Gao Xianzhi’s Tang army fought an Abbasid and Karluk coalition at Talas. The Karluks switched sides, and the Tang force was routed. The battle is often linked to the westward transmission of papermaking; details await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 安禄山在范阳起兵，南下攻唐。
summary.en: An Lushan rose at Fanyang and marched south against the Tang.

fields.name: 安史之乱爆发 The An–Shi Rebellion begins
fields.summary: 安禄山在范阳起兵，南下攻唐。 An Lushan rose at Fanyang and marched south against the Tang.
fields.description: 755 年，平卢、范阳、河东三镇节度使安禄山以讨杨国忠为名在范阳起兵，率军南下，安史之乱爆发。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 755, An Lushan, military governor of three northern garrisons, rose at Fanyang in the name of removing Yang Guozhong and marched south, beginning the An–Shi Rebellion. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 唐玄宗西逃途中，禁军在马嵬驿哗变。
summary.en: The imperial guards mutinied at Mawei Post as Emperor Xuanzong fled west.

fields.name: 马嵬驿之变 The Mawei Post mutiny
fields.summary: 唐玄宗西逃途中，禁军在马嵬驿哗变。 The imperial guards mutinied at Mawei Post as Emperor Xuanzong fled west.
fields.description: 756 年，安禄山军攻破潼关，唐玄宗西逃，禁军在马嵬驿哗变，杀杨国忠，逼死杨贵妃，玄宗随后入蜀。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 756, An Lushan’s forces broke through Tong Pass. Emperor Xuanzong fled west, and the imperial guards mutinied at Mawei Post, killing Yang Guozhong and forcing Yang Guifei’s death before the emperor continued to Sichuan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 张巡、许远坚守睢阳，阻遏叛军南下。
summary.en: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held Suiyang, blocking the rebels’ southward advance.

fields.name: 睢阳之战 The Siege of Suiyang
fields.summary: 张巡、许远坚守睢阳，阻遏叛军南下。 Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held Suiyang, blocking the rebels’ southward advance.
fields.description: 757 年，安史叛军围攻睢阳，张巡、许远率军坚守数月，城破殉难，但牵制叛军，保全江淮财赋之地。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 757, An–Shi rebels besieged Suiyang. Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held the city for months before it fell and they died, but their resistance tied down rebel forces and protected the Jiang-Huai revenue region. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 史朝义兵败自杀，安史之乱结束。
summary.en: Shi Chaoyi’s defeat and suicide ended the An–Shi Rebellion.

fields.name: 安史之乱结束 The An–Shi Rebellion ends
fields.summary: 史朝义兵败自杀，安史之乱结束。 Shi Chaoyi’s defeat and suicide ended the An–Shi Rebellion.
fields.description: 763 年，史朝义在唐军追击下兵败自杀，安史之乱结束，但河北藩镇割据局面由此形成。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 763, Shi Chaoyi was defeated and took his own life while fleeing Tang forces, ending the An–Shi Rebellion. The aftermath left powerful military governors entrenched in Hebei. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 吐蕃军趁唐西北空虚攻入长安，短暂占据。
summary.en: Tubo forces exploited Tang weakness in the northwest and briefly occupied Chang’an.

fields.name: 吐蕃攻陷长安 Tubo forces take Chang’an
fields.summary: 吐蕃军趁唐西北空虚攻入长安，短暂占据。 Tubo forces exploited Tang weakness in the northwest and briefly occupied Chang’an.
fields.description: 763 年，吐蕃军乘唐廷忙于平定安史余部，攻入长安，唐代宗出逃，吐蕃军占据十五日后退出。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 763, while the Tang court was preoccupied with the remnants of the An–Shi Rebellion, Tubo forces entered Chang’an. Emperor Daizong fled, and the Tibetans withdrew after about fifteen days. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 杨炎推行两税法，改革赋税制度。
summary.en: Yang Yan introduced the Two-Tax System, reforming Tang taxation.

fields.name: 两税法 The Two-Tax System
fields.summary: 杨炎推行两税法，改革赋税制度。 Yang Yan introduced the Two-Tax System, reforming Tang taxation.
fields.description: 780 年，唐德宗采纳杨炎建议，推行两税法，按户等与田亩征税，分夏、秋两季缴纳，改变了以人丁为主的租庸调制。日期与制度为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 780, Emperor Dezong adopted Yang Yan’s proposal and introduced the Two-Tax System, taxing households and land and collecting in summer and autumn, replacing the head-tax-based zu-yong-diao system. Dates and institutions follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 河朔三镇半独立，形成长期藩镇割据。
summary.en: The three Hebei garrisons became semi-independent, entrenching long-term military autonomy.

fields.name: 河朔藩镇割据 The Hebei military governors
fields.summary: 河朔三镇半独立，形成长期藩镇割据。 The three Hebei garrisons became semi-independent, entrenching long-term military autonomy.
fields.description: 安史之乱后，魏博、成德、卢龙三镇节度使拥兵自重，781 年前后公开对抗中央，形成河朔藩镇割据局面。年份与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 After the An–Shi Rebellion, the military governors of Weibo, Chengde, and Lulong kept private armies and increasingly defied the court; around 781 they openly resisted central authority, entrenching the Hebei garrison system. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

name.en: Zhu Tao campaigns against Li Weiyue

summary.zh: 幽州留后朱滔奉诏南下讨成德李惟岳，破之于束鹿。
summary.en: Zhu Tao of Youzhou marched south against Li Weiyue of Chengde and defeated him at Shulu.

fields.name: 朱滔奉诏讨李惟岳 Zhu Tao campaigns against Li Weiyue
fields.summary: 幽州留后朱滔奉诏南下讨成德李惟岳，破之于束鹿。 Zhu Tao of Youzhou marched south against Li Weiyue of Chengde and defeated him at Shulu.
fields.description: 建中二年（781）正月成德节度使李宝臣死，其子李惟岳求袭不允，与魏博田悦、淄青李正己连兵拒命。朝廷诏幽州留后朱滔讨李惟岳；朱滔自幽州出兵，军于莫州，与易州张孝忠合兵，十一月在束鹿大破李惟岳，进围深州。次年朝廷割深州与康日知，朱滔求深州不得，遂反，南下救田悦至魏州。 In the first month of 781 Li Baochen of Chengde died and his son Li Weiyue was refused succession, so he joined Tian Yue and Li Zhengji in revolt. The court ordered Zhu Tao of Youzhou against him; Zhu Tao marched out, camped at Mozhou, joined Zhang Xiaozhong of Yizhou, routed Li Weiyue at Shulu in the eleventh month and besieged Shenzhou. The next year, denied Shenzhou, he turned against the court and marched south to Weizhou to aid Tian Yue.

summary.zh: 泾原兵变爆发，朱泚据长安称帝。
summary.en: The Jingyuan troops mutinied, and Zhu Ci seized Chang’an and proclaimed himself emperor.

fields.name: 泾原兵变 The Jingyuan mutiny
fields.summary: 泾原兵变爆发，朱泚据长安称帝。 The Jingyuan troops mutinied, and Zhu Ci seized Chang’an and proclaimed himself emperor.
fields.description: 783 年，泾原镇士兵因赏赐不满在长安哗变，拥立朱泚为帝，唐德宗出逃奉天，唐朝中央权威再受重创。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 783, troops from Jingyuan mutinied in Chang’an over inadequate rewards, backed Zhu Ci as emperor, and forced Emperor Dezong to flee to Fengtian, further damaging central authority. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 唐与吐蕃举行长庆会盟，划定边界。
summary.en: Tang and Tubo concluded the Changqing treaty and fixed their border.

fields.name: 唐蕃会盟 The Tang–Tubo treaty
fields.summary: 唐与吐蕃举行长庆会盟，划定边界。 Tang and Tubo concluded the Changqing treaty and fixed their border.
fields.description: 821 年，唐与吐蕃在长安与逻些互遣使者会盟，约定各守边界、互不侵扰，史称长庆会盟，盟碑现存拉萨大昭寺前。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 821, Tang and Tubo exchanged envoys and concluded the Changqing treaty, pledging to respect their border and refrain from attacks. The treaty stele still stands before the Jokhang in Lhasa. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 唐文宗谋诛宦官失败，宦官专权加剧。
summary.en: Emperor Wenzong’s plot against the eunuchs failed, deepening eunuch dominance.

fields.name: 甘露之变 The Ganlu Incident
fields.summary: 唐文宗谋诛宦官失败，宦官专权加剧。 Emperor Wenzong’s plot against the eunuchs failed, deepening eunuch dominance.
fields.description: 835 年，唐文宗与李训、郑注设计诛杀宦官，事泄失败，宦官大肆屠杀朝臣，史称甘露之变，此后宦官完全控制朝政。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 835, Emperor Wenzong, with Li Xun and Zheng Zhu, plotted to kill the dominant eunuchs. The plot was exposed and failed; the eunuchs massacred officials in what became known as the Ganlu Incident and thereafter dominated the court. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Emperor Wuzong ordered temples destroyed and monks laicized, dealing a heavy blow to Buddhism.

fields.name: 会昌灭佛 The Huichang persecution of Buddhism
fields.summary: 唐武宗下令拆寺汰僧，佛教受到沉重打击。 Emperor Wuzong ordered temples destroyed and monks laicized, dealing a heavy blow to Buddhism.
fields.description: 845 年，唐武宗在道士赵归真等影响下推行灭佛政策，拆毁大量寺院、勒令僧尼还俗，史称会昌灭佛，与北魏太武帝、北周武帝灭佛并称。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 845, influenced by Daoist advisers such as Zhao Guizhen, Emperor Wuzong persecuted Buddhism, destroying many temples and forcing monks and nuns to return to lay life. The campaign is grouped with earlier imperial persecutions of Buddhism. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
