atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 张议潮起兵收复敦煌，归附唐朝。
summary.en: Zhang Yichao rose, recovered Dunhuang, and submitted to the Tang.

fields.name: 归义军收复敦煌 The Guiyi Army recovers Dunhuang
fields.summary: 张议潮起兵收复敦煌，归附唐朝。 Zhang Yichao rose, recovered Dunhuang, and submitted to the Tang.
fields.description: 大中二年（848）沙州豪族张议潮趁吐蕃内乱起兵，逐吐蕃守将，收复沙州，同年东进收复瓜州，随即遣使分十道绕行沙漠赴长安报捷，其中悟真一支经天德军于大中四年（850）抵达。此后又收复伊、肃、甘等州，大中五年（851）遣兄张议潭献十一州图籍，唐置归义军，以张议潮为节度使。 In 848 Zhang Yichao, a wealthy Shazhou family head, rose amid Tibetan disorder, expelled the Tibetan commander and recovered Shazhou; that year he moved east and took Guazhou, then sent ten groups of envoys across the deserts to Chang’an, of which Wuzhen’s party reached the court via Tiande in 850. Further prefectures followed, and in 851 his brother Zhang Yitan presented the registers of eleven prefectures; the Tang established the Guiyi Army with Zhang Yichao as its commissioner.

summary.zh: 张议潮收复伊州，归义军势力伸入西域东端。
summary.en: Zhang Yichao recovered Yizhou, extending the Guiyi Army to the eastern edge of the Western Regions.

fields.name: 归义军收复伊州 Guiyi Army recovers Yizhou
fields.place: 新疆哈密（伊州） Hami (Yizhou), Xinjiang
fields.summary: 张议潮收复伊州，归义军势力伸入西域东端。 Zhang Yichao recovered Yizhou, extending the Guiyi Army to the eastern edge of the Western Regions.
fields.description: 大中四年（850），张议潮在收复沙、瓜二州后继续东进，收复伊州（今新疆哈密），归义军势力伸入西域东端。同年是否收复西州（吐鲁番）史料有争议，一说为回鹘所据。 In 850, after recovering Shazhou and Guazhou, Zhang Yichao pushed east and recovered Yizhou (modern Hami), extending the Guiyi Army to the eastern edge of the Western Regions. Whether Xizhou (Turpan) was recovered the same year is disputed, one account holding it was held by the Uyghurs.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 张淮深率蕃汉兵七千东征，克复凉州，河陇故地尽复。
summary.en: Zhang Huaishen led 7,000 troops east and took Liangzhou, completing the recovery of Hexi and Longyou.

fields.name: 归义军收复凉州 Guiyi Army recovers Liangzhou
fields.place: 甘肃武威（凉州） Wuwei (Liangzhou), Gansu
fields.summary: 张淮深率蕃汉兵七千东征，克复凉州，河陇故地尽复。 Zhang Huaishen led 7,000 troops east and took Liangzhou, completing the recovery of Hexi and Longyou.
fields.description: 大中十二年（858）八月，张议潮命侄张淮深率蕃、汉兵七千东征凉州，吐蕃集重兵于姑臧，围攻三年。咸通二年（861）三月克复凉州，表奏朝廷，“河陇陷没百余年，至是悉复故地”。咸通四年（863）唐复置凉州节度使，以张议潮兼领；咸通八年（867）张议潮入朝，侄张淮深留守归义军。 In the eighth month of 858 Zhang Yichao sent his nephew Zhang Huaishen east with 7,000 Tibetan and Chinese troops against Liangzhou, where the Tibetans concentrated their forces; the siege lasted three years. Liangzhou fell in the third month of 861 and the recovery was reported to the court — “the Hexi and Longyou lands, lost for over a century, were all recovered”. In 863 the Tang restored the Liangzhou command and gave it to Zhang Yichao; in 867 he went to court and Zhang Huaishen took charge of the Guiyi Army.

atlasTitle.en: Sui–Tang

summary.zh: 桂州戍卒在庞勋率领下起义，北上攻占徐州。
summary.en: Pang Xun led mutinous garrison troops from Guizhou northward and captured Xuzhou.

fields.name: 庞勋起义 Pang Xun’s revolt
fields.place: 广西桂林（桂州） Guilin (Guizhou), Guangxi
fields.summary: 桂州戍卒在庞勋率领下起义，北上攻占徐州。 Pang Xun led mutinous garrison troops from Guizhou northward and captured Xuzhou.
fields.description: 咸通四年（863）唐廷为援安南在徐泗募兵二千，分八百人戍守桂州，约定三年一换。至咸通九年（868）已戍六年，徐泗观察使崔彦曾以军帑空虚为由请再留一年，戍卒愤怒。七月，牙官许佶、赵可立等杀都将王仲甫，推粮料判官庞勋为首，劫库兵北还，所过剽掠，州县莫能御，成为唐末大规模民变的前奏。 In 863 the court raised 2,000 men in Xu and Si for Annam and stationed 800 at Guizhou on a three-year rotation. By 868 they had served six years and governor Cui Yanzeng, pleading empty coffers, asked for one more; the garrison mutinied. In the seventh month officers Xu Ji and Zhao Keli killed commander Wang Zhongfu, chose the supply officer Pang Xun as leader, broke into the stores and marched north, plundering as they went while local officials could not stop them — a prelude to the great revolts of the late Tang.

summary.en: Pang Xun marched north, took Suzhou and Xuzhou and gathered tens of thousands, shaking the Huai region.

fields.name: 庞勋攻占徐州 Pang Xun takes Xuzhou
fields.place: 江苏徐州（彭城） Xuzhou (Pengcheng), Jiangsu
fields.summary: 庞勋北上攻占宿州、徐州，众至数万，震动江淮。 Pang Xun marched north, took Suzhou and Xuzhou and gathered tens of thousands, shaking the Huai region.
fields.description: 咸通九年（868）十月，庞勋自桂州北还的八百戍卒沿途扩至六七千人，十日攻占宿州，十三日击败徐州援军，十七日进抵彭城，城中军民响应，不到一个时辰破城，囚观察使崔彦曾，开府库募兵，旬日聚众五万。此后攻濠、滁、和等州，围泗州，断江淮漕运。十年九月为康承训、朱邪赤心所败，庞勋死于蕲县。 In the tenth month of 868 Pang Xun’s 800 returning garrison, grown to six or seven thousand, took Suzhou on the tenth, beat the relief force on the thirteenth and reached Pengcheng on the seventeenth; the townspeople rose, the city fell within an hour, governor Cui Yanzeng was imprisoned and the treasury opened, drawing 50,000 men within ten days. He then took Hao, Chu and He prefectures and besieged Sizhou, cutting the Huai grain route. In the ninth month of 869 he was defeated by Kang Chengxun and Zhuye Chixin and died at Qixian.

fields.name: 黄巢起义 The Huang Chao rebellion
fields.summary: 黄巢在冤句起兵，转战南北。 Huang Chao rose at Yuanju and campaigned across the country.
fields.description: 875 年，黄巢响应王仙芝起义，在冤句起兵，此后转战黄淮、江南，并于 880 年北上攻入长安。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 875, Huang Chao rose at Yuanju in response to Wang Xianzhi’s rebellion and campaigned through the Yellow-Huai and Jiangnan regions before marching north and taking Chang’an in 880. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 黄巢入长安 Huang Chao enters Chang’an
fields.summary: 黄巢军攻入长安，建立大齐政权。 Huang Chao’s forces entered Chang’an and established the Qi regime.
fields.description: 880 年，黄巢军攻入长安，唐僖宗逃往成都，黄巢称帝，国号大齐，但未能稳定控制关中。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 880, Huang Chao’s forces entered Chang’an. Emperor Xizong fled to Chengdu, and Huang Chao proclaimed himself emperor of the Qi dynasty, though he failed to secure control of the Guanzhong region. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 192 年，曹操入兖州，击败青州黄巾，收编降众三十余万，选其精锐组成青州兵，成为此后征战的核心力量。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 192, Cao Cao entered Yan Province, defeated the Qingzhou Yellow Turbans, and incorporated more than 300,000 surrendered followers, selecting the elite as the Qingzhou troops who became the core of his later armies. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

summary.zh: 孙策渡江，击败刘繇，奠定江东基业。
summary.en: Sun Ce crossed the Yangtze, defeated Liu Yao, and laid the foundation of Jiangdong.

fields.name: 孙策定江东 Sun Ce secures Jiangdong
fields.summary: 孙策渡江，击败刘繇，奠定江东基业。 Sun Ce crossed the Yangtze, defeated Liu Yao, and laid the foundation of Jiangdong.
fields.description: 兴平二年（195）孙策以助袁术攻刘繇为名，自历阳渡江，兵五六千，先破横江、当利，转战牛渚、秣陵，击破笮融、薛礼，进至曲阿击走刘繇。孙策军令整肃，十余日间得兵二万余、马千余匹，威震江东。建安元年（196）又破严白虎、降王朗，自领会稽太守。 In 195 Sun Ce, nominally helping Yuan Shu against Liu Yao, crossed the Yangtze at Liyang with five or six thousand men, took Hengjiang and Dangli, fought through Niuzhu and Moling, defeated Ze Rong and Xue Li and drove Liu Yao from Qua. With strict discipline he gained over 20,000 troops and more than a thousand horses within ten days, overawing the Lower Yangtze. In 196 he defeated Yan Baihu, forced Wang Lang’s surrender and took the title of Kuaiji governor.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

place.zh: 浙江绍兴（会稽郡治山阴）

summary.zh: 孙策渡浙江攻会稽，王朗败降，孙策自领会稽太守。
summary.en: Sun Ce crossed the Zhejiang, defeated Wang Lang and took the title of Kuaiji governor.

fields.name: 孙策攻取会稽 Sun Ce takes Kuaiji
fields.place: 浙江绍兴（会稽郡治山阴） Shaoxing, Zhejiang (Shanyin, seat of Kuaiji)
fields.summary: 孙策渡浙江攻会稽，王朗败降，孙策自领会稽太守。 Sun Ce crossed the Zhejiang, defeated Wang Lang and took the title of Kuaiji governor.
fields.description: 建安元年（196）孙策破吴郡严白虎后引兵渡浙江攻会稽。会稽太守王朗据固陵坚守，孙策数次渡水强攻不克；用叔父孙静之计，夜燃火为疑兵、分军由查渎道突袭高迁屯，斩周昕，王朗败走东冶，孙策追破之，王朗投降。孙策自领会稽太守，以吴景为丹杨太守、孙贲为豫章太守、朱治为吴郡太守。 In 196, after defeating Yan Baihu in Wu commandery, Sun Ce crossed the Zhejiang against Kuaiji. Governor Wang Lang held Guling and beat off several assaults; on the advice of his uncle Sun Jing, Sun Ce lit decoy fires at night and sent a column by the Chadu road to surprise Gaoqian tun, killing Zhou Xin. Wang Lang fled to Dongye, was routed again and surrendered. Sun Ce took the title of Kuaiji governor and appointed Wu Jing, Sun Ben and Zhu Zhi to Danyang, Yuzhang and Wu.

name.en: Cao Cao welcomes Emperor Xian and moves the capital to Xu

place.zh: 豫州颍川许县（今河南许昌）

summary.zh: 曹操迎汉献帝自洛阳东迁许县，从此“奉天子以令不臣”，取得政治主动权。
summary.en: Cao Cao escorted Emperor Xian from Luoyang to Xu county, gaining the political initiative of acting in the emperor’s name.

fields.name: 曹操迎献帝都许 Cao Cao welcomes Emperor Xian and moves the capital to Xu
fields.place: 豫州颍川许县（今河南许昌） Xu county, Yingchuan (modern Xuchang, Henan)
fields.summary: 曹操迎汉献帝自洛阳东迁许县，从此“奉天子以令不臣”，取得政治主动权。 Cao Cao escorted Emperor Xian from Luoyang to Xu county, gaining the political initiative of acting in the emperor’s name.
fields.description: 建安元年（196）七月，献帝在杨奉、韩暹、董承等护送下还洛阳，宫室残破、百官乏食。曹操采纳荀彧“奉主上以从民望”之议，率军至洛阳，以洛阳残破、漕运艰难为由，于八月庚申（公历 10 月 7 日）奉车驾出轘辕东行，迁都许县；献帝以曹操为大将军，封武平侯。此后曹操以天子名义号令诸侯，在政治上取得对各路势力的优势。迎驾与迁都的具体日程，《三国志》《后汉书》所载略有出入，此处取通行说法。 In the seventh month of 196 Emperor Xian returned to a ruined Luoyang under the escort of Yang Feng, Han Xian and Dong Cheng. Cao Cao, advised by Xun Yu to support the emperor and win popular support, came to Luoyang. Citing the city’s ruin and supply difficulties, he moved the court east through Huanyuan on the gengshen day of the eighth month (7 October 196) to Xu county. The emperor made him general-in-chief and marquis of Wuping. Cao Cao thereafter acted in the emperor’s name, gaining a political advantage over rival warlords. The Sanguozhi and Hou Hanshu differ in detail; the conventional account is followed here.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

place.zh: 荆州南阳宛城（今河南南阳）

summary.zh: 曹操南征张绣，张绣先降后叛，夜袭曹营，曹操败走，曹昂、曹安民、典韦战死。
summary.en: Cao Cao marched against Zhang Xiu. Zhang Xiu surrendered, then revolted and raided Cao’s camp; Cao fled, losing his son Cao Ang, nephew Cao Anmin and guard Dian Wei.

fields.name: 宛城之战 Battle of Wancheng
fields.place: 荆州南阳宛城（今河南南阳） Wancheng, Nanyang (modern Nanyang, Henan)
fields.summary: 曹操南征张绣，张绣先降后叛，夜袭曹营，曹操败走，曹昂、曹安民、典韦战死。 Cao Cao marched against Zhang Xiu. Zhang Xiu surrendered, then revolted and raided Cao’s camp; Cao fled, losing his son Cao Ang, nephew Cao Anmin and guard Dian Wei.
fields.description: 建安二年（197）正月，曹操率军至淯水，张绣举众投降。曹操纳张济遗孀为妾，张绣愤恨；又闻曹操欲杀己，遂用贾诩之计突袭曹营。曹操仓促应战，败走舞阴，长子曹昂、侄子曹安民、校尉典韦战死，曹操亦中流矢。此战使曹操失去继承人与宿卫大将，张绣则一度据南阳自守；建安四年张绣再降，官渡之战中为曹操所用。日期依《资治通鉴》系于建安二年正月，具体日份待考。 In the first month of 197 Cao Cao reached the Yu river and Zhang Xiu surrendered. Cao took Zhang Ji’s widow as a concubine, angering Zhang Xiu, who also learned that Cao planned to kill him. On Jia Xu’s advice Zhang Xiu raided Cao’s camp. Cao fled to Wuyin; his eldest son Cao Ang, nephew Cao Anmin and guard commander Dian Wei were killed, and Cao himself was wounded by a stray arrow. The defeat cost Cao his heir and his chief bodyguard, while Zhang Xiu held Nanyang for a time. Zhang surrendered again in 199 and served Cao at Guandu. The date follows the Zizhi Tongjian’s first month of 197; the exact day is uncertain.

place.zh: 兖州东郡白马（今河南滑县东）
place.en: Baima, Dong commandery (east of modern Hua county, Henan)

summary.zh: 袁绍遣颜良围白马，曹操声东击西解围，关羽斩颜良；又于延津诱敌斩文丑。
summary.en: Yuan Shao sent Yan Liang to besiege Baima. Cao Cao relieved it by a feint, Guan Yu killed Yan Liang, and Cao then lured and killed Wen Chou at Yanjin.

fields.name: 白马延津之战 Battles of Baima and Yanjin
fields.place: 兖州东郡白马（今河南滑县东） Baima, Dong commandery (east of modern Hua county, Henan)
fields.summary: 袁绍遣颜良围白马，曹操声东击西解围，关羽斩颜良；又于延津诱敌斩文丑。 Yuan Shao sent Yan Liang to besiege Baima. Cao Cao relieved it by a feint, Guan Yu killed Yan Liang, and Cao then lured and killed Wen Chou at Yanjin.
fields.description: 建安五年（200）二月，袁绍遣颜良攻东郡太守刘延于白马。四月，曹操用荀攸之计，佯向延津渡河，诱袁绍分兵，自率轻骑东袭白马；关羽于阵中斩颜良，解白马之围。曹操随即沿河西撤，袁绍渡河追击，曹操于延津南设伏，弃辎重诱敌，大破追兵，斩文丑。此役为官渡之战的前哨，袁绍连失颜良、文丑两员大将。 In the second month of 200 Yuan Shao sent Yan Liang against Liu Yan at Baima. In the fourth month Cao Cao, on Xun You’s advice, feigned a crossing at Yanjin to split Yuan’s forces, then led light cavalry east to relieve Baima; Guan Yu killed Yan Liang in the field. Cao withdrew along the river. Yuan crossed in pursuit, and Cao set an ambush south of Yanjin, abandoning baggage as bait and routing the pursuers, killing Wen Chou. The battles were the prelude to Guandu and cost Yuan Shao two of his best commanders.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

summary.zh: 曹操在官渡击败袁绍，统一北方的基础奠定。
summary.en: Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao at Guandu, laying the basis for unifying the north.

fields.name: 官渡之战 The Battle of Guandu
fields.summary: 曹操在官渡击败袁绍，统一北方的基础奠定。 Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao at Guandu, laying the basis for unifying the north.
fields.description: 建安五年（200）二月袁绍进军黎阳，四月曹操斩颜良、诛文丑；八月袁绍连营而进，逼官渡；十月袁绍运粮万余车屯乌巢，曹操用许攸之计，亲率步骑五千夜袭，焚其粮草，张郃、高览降曹，袁军崩溃，袁绍仅率八百骑渡河北走。曹操坑杀降卒七万余。官渡之战奠定了曹操统一北方的基础。 In the second month of 200 Yuan Shao advanced to Liyang and in the fourth month Cao Cao killed Yan Liang and Wen Chou. In the eighth month Yuan Shao closed up on Guandu in a long line of camps; in the tenth month, with over 10,000 grain carts at Wuchao, Cao Cao took Xu You’s advice, led 5,000 horse and foot on a night raid, burned the grain, and as Zhang He and Gao Lan surrendered the Yuan army collapsed, Yuan Shao crossing the Yellow River north with only 800 riders. Cao Cao buried over 70,000 prisoners. The battle laid the basis for Cao Cao’s unification of the north.

place.zh: 兖州陈留乌巢（今河南延津东南，一说封丘西）
place.en: Wuchao, Chenliu (southeast of modern Yanjin, Henan; some place it west of Fengqiu)

summary.zh: 许攸降曹献计，曹操夜袭乌巢，焚袁绍粮草，斩淳于琼，官渡战局逆转。
summary.en: Xu You defected and advised Cao Cao to raid Wuchao. Cao burned Yuan Shao’s grain, killed Chunyu Qiong and turned the tide at Guandu.

fields.name: 乌巢焚粮 Burning of Wuchao
fields.place: 兖州陈留乌巢（今河南延津东南，一说封丘西） Wuchao, Chenliu (southeast of modern Yanjin, Henan; some place it west of Fengqiu)
fields.summary: 许攸降曹献计，曹操夜袭乌巢，焚袁绍粮草，斩淳于琼，官渡战局逆转。 Xu You defected and advised Cao Cao to raid Wuchao. Cao burned Yuan Shao’s grain, killed Chunyu Qiong and turned the tide at Guandu.
fields.description: 建安五年（200）十月，袁绍谋士许攸因家人犯法获罪，怒而降曹，告以袁绍粮草尽屯乌巢、守备不严。曹操留荀攸、曹洪守营，自率步骑五千，用袁军旗号夜行，直趋乌巢，围屯纵火。袁绍不听张郃救乌巢之议，仅遣轻骑救援，主力攻曹营不下；乌巢粮尽焚，淳于琼等被杀。袁军军心崩溃，张郃、高览降曹，袁绍仅率八百骑北渡。乌巢地望有延津、封丘等说，今取延津东南代表点。 In the tenth month of 200 Yuan Shao’s adviser Xu You, facing punishment over his family, defected to Cao Cao and revealed that Yuan’s grain was stored at Wuchao under weak guard. Cao left Xun You and Cao Hong to hold camp and led five thousand horse and foot under Yuan colors at night to Wuchao, surrounded the depot and set it ablaze. Yuan rejected Zhang He’s advice to relieve Wuchao, sent only light cavalry, and failed to take Cao’s camp. With the grain gone and Chunyu Qiong killed, Yuan’s army collapsed; Zhang He and Gao Lan surrendered and Yuan fled north with some eight hundred riders. The location of Wuchao is disputed between Yanjin and Fengqiu; a representative point southeast of Yanjin is used.

summary.zh: 曹操轻骑追刘备于长坂坡，刘备败走。
summary.en: Cao Cao’s fast cavalry caught Liu Bei at Changban, and Liu Bei fled.

fields.name: 长坂坡之战 The Battle of Changban
fields.summary: 曹操轻骑追刘备于长坂坡，刘备败走。 Cao Cao’s fast cavalry caught Liu Bei at Changban, and Liu Bei fled.
fields.description: 建安十三年（208）九月曹操至襄阳，闻刘备南走，弃辎重，率精骑五千急追，一日一夜行三百余里，在当阳长坂追上。刘备军众十余万、辎重数千辆，日行十余里，被冲散；刘备弃妻子，与诸葛亮、张飞、赵云等数十骑走汉津，会关羽水军退往夏口。赵云抱护后主，张飞据水断桥。 In the ninth month of 208 Cao Cao reached Xiangyang and, hearing that Liu Bei had gone south, abandoned his baggage and drove 5,000 picked cavalry over 300 li in a day and a night, catching him at Changban in Dangyang. Liu Bei’s column of over 100,000 people and thousands of carts, making only ten-odd li a day, was scattered; Liu Bei abandoned his family and fled with Zhuge Liang, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun and a few dozen riders to Hanjin, joining Guan Yu’s flotilla and withdrawing to Xiakou. Zhao Yun shielded the infant heir and Zhang Fei held the broken bridge.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

name.en: Guan Yu floods the seven armies

place.zh: 荆州襄阳樊城（今湖北襄阳樊城）

summary.zh: 关羽围樊城，汉水暴涨，于禁七军皆没，于禁降、庞德被杀，关羽威震华夏。
summary.en: Guan Yu besieged Fancheng. The Han river flooded and Yu Jin’s seven armies were destroyed; Yu Jin surrendered, Pang De was killed, and Guan Yu’s prestige peaked.

fields.name: 关羽水淹七军 Guan Yu floods the seven armies
fields.place: 荆州襄阳樊城（今湖北襄阳樊城） Fancheng, Xiangyang (modern Fancheng, Xiangyang, Hubei)
fields.summary: 关羽围樊城，汉水暴涨，于禁七军皆没，于禁降、庞德被杀，关羽威震华夏。 Guan Yu besieged Fancheng. The Han river flooded and Yu Jin’s seven armies were destroyed; Yu Jin surrendered, Pang De was killed, and Guan Yu’s prestige peaked.
fields.description: 建安二十四年（219）七月，关羽率荆州军北伐，围曹仁于樊城，曹操遣于禁、庞德率七军救援。八月，汉水暴涨，于禁所部七军被淹，于禁投降，庞德力战被擒杀。关羽乘势围樊城、襄阳，许都以南群盗响应，曹操一度议迁都以避其锋。此役为关羽军事生涯的顶点，也直接促使孙权与曹操联合、吕蒙袭取荆州。 In the seventh month of 219 Guan Yu led the Jingzhou army north and besieged Cao Ren at Fancheng. Cao Cao sent Yu Jin and Pang De with seven armies to relieve it. In the eighth month the Han river flooded; Yu Jin’s seven armies were submerged, Yu Jin surrendered, and Pang De was captured and killed after a hard fight. Guan Yu pressed the siege of Fancheng and Xiangyang, bandits south of Xuchang responded, and Cao Cao briefly considered moving the capital. The victory was the height of Guan Yu’s career and prompted Sun Quan to ally with Cao Cao and send Lü Meng against Jingzhou.

fields.summary: 吕蒙白衣渡江，袭取江陵，关羽败走。 Lü Meng crossed the Yangtze in disguise and seized Jiangling, forcing Guan Yu’s retreat.
fields.description: 建安二十四年（219）关羽围樊城、后方空虚，吕蒙称病还建业，荐陆逊代屯陆口，使关羽放松戒备；关羽调后方兵赴樊城后，吕蒙自寻阳发兵，伏精兵于船中，使白衣摇橹作商贾，昼夜兼行，尽收江边屯候，遂袭公安、江陵。傅士仁、糜芳先后投降，关羽后方尽失，败走麦城。此役起点为寻阳，非陆口。 In 219, with Guan Yu besieging Fancheng and his rear thin, Lu Meng feigned illness and returned to Jianye, recommending Lu Xun to hold Lukou and lull Guan Yu; once Guan Yu drew his rear troops north, Lu Meng set out from Xunyang with picked men hidden in the ships, disguised the rowers as merchants, moved day and night, swept up the riverbank watch posts and seized Gong’an and Jiangling. Fu Shiren and Mi Fang surrendered in turn, Guan Yu lost his rear and was defeated at Maicheng. The starting point was Xunyang, not Lukou.

fields.name: 曹操去世 Death of Cao Cao
fields.place: 司隶洛阳（今河南洛阳） Luoyang (modern Luoyang, Henan)
fields.summary: 建安二十五年正月庚子，曹操病逝于洛阳，年六十六；曹丕嗣位，汉魏禅代进入倒计时。 Cao Cao died at Luoyang in the first month of 220 aged sixty-six. Cao Pi succeeded him, and the Han–Wei abdication followed within the year.
fields.description: 建安二十五年（220）正月，曹操自汉中还至洛阳，庚子日（公历 1 月 23 日）病逝，年六十六。遗令薄葬、将士不得离屯。曹丕自邺城嗣魏王位，同年十月受汉献帝禅让，建立魏朝。曹操之死标志着汉末群雄时代的终结与三国鼎立的开端。《三国志》仅记“崩于洛阳”，未载明确死因，后世头风等说均无确证。 In the first month of 220 Cao Cao returned from Hanzhong to Luoyang and died there on the gengzi day (23 January 220), aged sixty-six. His will ordered a simple burial and forbade troops to leave their posts. Cao Pi succeeded as King of Wei from Ye and in the tenth month accepted Emperor Xian’s abdication, founding Wei. Cao’s death marks the end of the warlord era and the beginning of the Three Kingdoms. The Sanguozhi records only that he “died at Luoyang”; later explanations such as chronic headache are unproven.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

place.zh: 豫州颍川繁阳亭（今河南临颍繁城）
place.en: Fanyang Pavilion, Yingchuan (modern Fancheng, Linying, Henan)

summary.zh: 曹丕在繁阳亭受汉献帝禅让，称帝建魏，改元黄初，定都洛阳，东汉灭亡。
summary.en: Cao Pi accepted Emperor Xian’s abdication at Fanyang Pavilion, founded Wei, changed the era to Huangchu and made Luoyang the capital, ending the Eastern Han.

fields.name: 曹丕称帝 Cao Pi founds Wei
fields.place: 豫州颍川繁阳亭（今河南临颍繁城） Fanyang Pavilion, Yingchuan (modern Fancheng, Linying, Henan)
fields.summary: 曹丕在繁阳亭受汉献帝禅让，称帝建魏，改元黄初，定都洛阳，东汉灭亡。 Cao Pi accepted Emperor Xian’s abdication at Fanyang Pavilion, founded Wei, changed the era to Huangchu and made Luoyang the capital, ending the Eastern Han.
fields.description: 延康元年（220）十月，汉献帝下诏禅位，曹丕三让后于十月辛未（公历 12 月 11 日）在颍川繁阳亭登坛受禅，改元黄初，国号魏，定都洛阳；十二月追尊曹操为武皇帝。汉朝四百余年统治至此结束，三国中的曹魏正式建立。受禅地点有繁阳亭、许昌等说，今从《三国志·文帝纪》裴注所引《献帝传》繁阳亭说。 In the tenth month of 220 Emperor Xian issued the abdication edict. After three ritual refusals Cao Pi ascended the altar at Fanyang Pavilion in Yingchuan on the xinwei day (11 December 220), changed the era to Huangchu, proclaimed the state of Wei and made Luoyang the capital; in the twelfth month Cao Cao was posthumously honoured as Emperor Wu. Four centuries of Han rule ended and Wei formally began. The site of the abdication is given as Fanyang Pavilion or Xuchang; the Fanyang account in the commentary to the Wendi ji is followed.

name.en: Sun Quan moves the capital to Wuchang

summary.zh: 孙权自公安迁都鄂县，改名武昌，以拒刘备东下。
summary.en: Sun Quan moved his capital from Gong’an to E county, renaming it Wuchang, to face Liu Bei’s eastward advance.

fields.name: 孙权迁都武昌 Sun Quan moves the capital to Wuchang
fields.place: 湖北鄂州（吴武昌） Ezhou, Hubei (Wu Chang)
fields.summary: 孙权自公安迁都鄂县，改名武昌，以拒刘备东下。 Sun Quan moved his capital from Gong’an to E county, renaming it Wuchang, to face Liu Bei’s eastward advance.
fields.description: 建安二十六年（221）四月，孙权自公安迁都鄂县，改名武昌，以武昌、下雉、寻阳、阳新、柴桑、沙羡六县置武昌郡。此后至黄龙元年（229）还都建业，武昌为吴之国都。228 年石亭之战前，孙权即自武昌进驻皖口。 In the fourth month of 221 Sun Quan moved his capital from Gong’an to E county and renamed it Wuchang, creating Wuchang commandery from six counties including Wuchang, Xiazhi, Xunyang, Yangxin, Chaisang and Shaxian. Until the return to Jianye in 229 Wuchang was the Wu capital; before the battle of Shiting in 228 Sun Quan moved from Wuchang to Wankou.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

summary.zh: 刘备在成都武担山之南即皇帝位，国号汉，改元章武，以承汉祚。
summary.en: Liu Bei took the imperial throne south of Wudan Hill in Chengdu, proclaimed the state of Han and changed the era to Zhangwu.

fields.name: 刘备称帝 Liu Bei proclaims himself emperor
fields.place: 益州成都（今四川成都） Chengdu (modern Chengdu, Sichuan)
fields.summary: 刘备在成都武担山之南即皇帝位，国号汉，改元章武，以承汉祚。 Liu Bei took the imperial throne south of Wudan Hill in Chengdu, proclaimed the state of Han and changed the era to Zhangwu.
fields.description: 章武元年（221）四月丙午（公历 5 月 15 日），刘备在成都武担山之南即皇帝位，国号仍为“汉”，改元章武，以诸葛亮为丞相。此前曹丕代汉，传言献帝遇害，刘备为之发丧，遂以汉室宗亲身份继承汉统，史称蜀汉。即位仪式在成都城内，无军事行军，故不设路线。 On the bingwu day of the fourth month of 221 (15 May 221) Liu Bei took the throne south of Wudan Hill in Chengdu. He kept the state name Han, changed the era to Zhangwu and made Zhuge Liang chancellor. After Cao Pi replaced the Han and rumours spread that Emperor Xian had been killed, Liu Bei held mourning and claimed the Han succession as a member of the imperial clan; historians call his state Shu Han. The ceremony took place inside Chengdu with no military march, so no route is drawn.

fields.name: 夷陵之战（刘备） The Battle of Yiling (Liu Bei)
fields.summary: 刘备东征孙权，在夷陵被陆逊击败。 Liu Bei campaigned east against Sun Quan and was defeated by Lu Xun at Yiling.
fields.description: 221 年，刘备称帝后率军东征孙权，沿三峡推进至夷陵，次年被陆逊火攻击败，退守白帝城。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 221, after declaring himself emperor, Liu Bei campaigned east against Sun Quan, advancing through the Three Gorges to Yiling. The next year Lu Xun defeated him with fire attacks, and he withdrew to Baidi City. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

place.zh: 益州益州郡滇池（今云南昆明晋宁）
place.en: Dianchi, Yizhou commandery (modern Jinning, Kunming, Yunnan)

summary.zh: 诸葛亮率军南征，马忠、李恢分道并进，平定南中四郡，稳定蜀汉后方。
summary.en: Zhuge Liang campaigned in the south with Ma Zhong and Li Hui on separate axes, pacifying the four southern commanderies and securing Shu Han’s rear.

fields.name: 诸葛亮南征 Zhuge Liang’s southern campaign
fields.place: 益州益州郡滇池（今云南昆明晋宁） Dianchi, Yizhou commandery (modern Jinning, Kunming, Yunnan)
fields.summary: 诸葛亮率军南征，马忠、李恢分道并进，平定南中四郡，稳定蜀汉后方。 Zhuge Liang campaigned in the south with Ma Zhong and Li Hui on separate axes, pacifying the four southern commanderies and securing Shu Han’s rear.
fields.description: 建兴三年（225）三月，诸葛亮率主力自成都南下，经僰道、越嶲，五月渡泸水（金沙江），深入南中；马忠攻牂牁，李恢攻益州郡，三路并进。诸葛亮采纳马谡“攻心为上”之策，对当地首领孟获七擒七纵（此说出自《华阳国志》《汉晋春秋》，《三国志》本传未载细节），南中四郡平定。战后蜀汉调整郡县、征调南中物资兵员，为随后的北伐提供后方。具体进军路线与“七擒”地点异说较多，本段为示意简化。 In the third month of 225 Zhuge Liang led the main force south from Chengdu through Bodao and Yuexi, crossed the Lu river (Jinsha) in the fifth month and entered the south. Ma Zhong attacked Zangke and Li Hui Yizhou commandery on separate axes. On Ma Su’s advice to “win hearts rather than cities”, Zhuge is said to have captured and released the local leader Meng Huo seven times—an account found in the Huayang Guozhi and Han Jin Chunqiu but not detailed in the Sanguozhi. The four commanderies were pacified; Shu Han reorganised counties and drew supplies and troops from the south for the northern expeditions. The route and the “seven captures” sites are disputed; this line is schematic.

fields.name: 街亭之战 The Battle of Jieting
fields.summary: 马谡失守街亭，诸葛亮首次北伐退军。 Ma Su lost Jieting, forcing Zhuge Liang’s first northern expedition to retreat.
fields.description: 228 年，诸葛亮出祁山，命马谡守街亭。马谡舍水上山，被张郃断绝水道击溃，诸葛亮退军。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 228, Zhuge Liang advanced to Qishan and ordered Ma Su to hold Jieting. Ma Su abandoned the water source and camped on a hill; Zhang He cut his supply of water and defeated him, forcing Zhuge Liang to withdraw. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 石亭之战 The Battle of Shiting
fields.summary: 陆逊在石亭大败曹休，吴军巩固江淮。 Lu Xun defeated Cao Xiu at Shiting, securing the Wu position along the Huai and Yangtze.
fields.description: 黄武七年（228）五月鄱阳太守周鲂断发诈降，诱魏扬州牧曹休率步骑十万向皖城；八月孙权至皖口，以陆逊为大都督，朱桓、全琮为左右督，各督三万人迎击。陆逊自为中部，三道俱进，冲击曹休伏兵，追至夹石，斩获万余，牛马车辆军资略尽。曹休败走，赖贾逵疑兵接应才得脱，九月惭愤疽发而死。 皖口即今安庆山口乡，石亭在今潜山东北（一说怀宁或桐城境），两地相距约 30 公里。 In the fifth month of 228 the Poyang governor Zhou Fang cut off his hair in a feigned surrender, luring the Wei governor Cao Xiu with 100,000 horse and foot towards Wancheng. In the eighth month Sun Quan reached Wankou and made Lu Xun commander-in-chief, with Zhu Huan and Quan Cong as left and right commanders, each with 30,000 men. Lu Xun took the centre and advanced in three columns, breaking Cao Xiu’s ambush and pursuing to Jiashi, killing and capturing over 10,000 and taking nearly all his transport and stores. Cao Xiu escaped only through Jia Kui’s deceptive flags, and died of shame and a festering wound in the ninth month. Wankou is modern Shankou in Anqing; Shiting lies north-east of Qianshan (some accounts put it in Huaining or Tongcheng), about 30 km away.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

place.zh: 司隶右扶风陈仓（今陕西宝鸡）

summary.zh: 诸葛亮出散关围陈仓，郝昭坚守二十余日，蜀军粮尽退兵，斩魏追将王双。
summary.en: Zhuge Liang left Sanguan and besieged Chencang. Hao Zhao held for over twenty days; the Shu army withdrew for lack of food and killed the pursuing Wei general Wang Shuang.

fields.name: 陈仓之战 Battle of Chencang
fields.place: 司隶右扶风陈仓（今陕西宝鸡） Chencang, Youfufeng (modern Baoji, Shaanxi)
fields.summary: 诸葛亮出散关围陈仓，郝昭坚守二十余日，蜀军粮尽退兵，斩魏追将王双。 Zhuge Liang left Sanguan and besieged Chencang. Hao Zhao held for over twenty days; the Shu army withdrew for lack of food and killed the pursuing Wei general Wang Shuang.
fields.description: 建兴六年（228）冬，诸葛亮趁魏军东下、关中空虚，出散关围攻陈仓。魏将郝昭以千余人拒守，诸葛亮用云梯、冲车、地道等法攻城，郝昭随方拒之，二十余日不克。蜀军粮尽，又闻魏援军将至，遂退兵；魏将王双率骑追击，被诸葛亮回军斩杀。此役显示蜀军攻坚能力不足，也促使诸葛亮此后更重视粮运与陇右。陈仓城址在今陕西宝鸡陈仓区一带，坐标为示意。 In the winter of 228 Zhuge Liang took advantage of the Wei army’s move east and the weakness of the Guanzhong garrison to leave Sanguan and besiege Chencang. The Wei commander Hao Zhao held with about a thousand men; Zhuge used scaling ladders, battering rams and tunnels, and Hao countered each device. After more than twenty days the Shu army ran short of food and, hearing that relief was coming, withdrew. The Wei general Wang Shuang pursued and was killed when Zhuge turned on him. The siege exposed Shu’s weakness in reducing fortresses and pushed Zhuge to pay more attention to supply and the Longyou region. The site lies in modern Chencang district, Baoji; the point is schematic.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

summary.zh: 孙权在武昌称帝，国号吴，改元黄龙；同年九月迁都建业。
summary.en: Sun Quan took the imperial throne at Wuchang, proclaimed the state of Wu and changed the era to Huanglong; in the ninth month he moved the capital to Jianye.

fields.name: 孙权称帝 Sun Quan proclaims himself emperor
fields.place: 荆州武昌（今湖北鄂州） Wuchang (modern Ezhou, Hubei)
fields.summary: 孙权在武昌称帝，国号吴，改元黄龙；同年九月迁都建业。 Sun Quan took the imperial throne at Wuchang, proclaimed the state of Wu and changed the era to Huanglong; in the ninth month he moved the capital to Jianye.
fields.description: 黄龙元年（229）四月丙申（公历 5 月 23 日），孙权在武昌（今湖北鄂州）即皇帝位，国号吴，改元黄龙，追尊孙坚为武烈皇帝、孙策为长沙桓王。此前孙权已据江东、取荆州、破刘备于夷陵，至此正式与魏、汉鼎足。同年秋九月，孙权迁都建业（今江苏南京），以陆逊辅太子孙登留守武昌。称帝后吴、蜀互遣使申盟，共约灭魏分天下。 On the bingshen day of the fourth month of 229 (23 May 229) Sun Quan took the throne at Wuchang (modern Ezhou, Hubei), proclaimed the state of Wu, changed the era to Huanglong, and posthumously honoured Sun Jian and Sun Ce. Having already held the Lower Yangzi, taken Jingzhou and defeated Liu Bei at Yiling, he now stood as the third sovereign. In the ninth month he moved the capital to Jianye (modern Nanjing), leaving Lu Xun to assist the crown prince Sun Deng at Wuchang. Wu and Shu exchanged envoys and renewed their alliance to divide Wei.

fields.name: 五丈原 Zhuge Liang at Wuzhang Plain
fields.place: 陕西五丈原 Wuzhang Plain, Shaanxi
fields.summary: 诸葛亮最后一次北伐，驻军五丈原，病逝军中。 Zhuge Liang’s final northern expedition camped at Wuzhang Plain, where he died.
fields.description: 234 年，诸葛亮率军出斜谷，驻五丈原与司马懿对峙，因积劳成疾病逝军中，蜀军退走。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 234, Zhuge Liang marched through the Xie Valley and camped at Wuzhang Plain facing Sima Yi. He died of illness in camp, and the Shu army withdrew. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

place.zh: 扬州九江郡合肥新城（今安徽合肥）
place.en: Hefei New City, Jiujiang (modern Hefei, Anhui)

summary.zh: 孙权率十万攻合肥新城，守军拒守，吴军攻城不克、士卒多病而退。
summary.en: Sun Quan attacked Hefei New City with 100,000 men; the garrison held out and the Wu army withdrew after failing to take it and losing men to sickness.

fields.name: 合肥新城之战 Siege of Hefei New City
fields.place: 扬州九江郡合肥新城（今安徽合肥） Hefei New City, Jiujiang (modern Hefei, Anhui)
fields.summary: 孙权率十万攻合肥新城，守军拒守，吴军攻城不克、士卒多病而退。 Sun Quan attacked Hefei New City with 100,000 men; the garrison held out and the Wu army withdrew after failing to take it and losing men to sickness.
fields.description: 青龙二年（234）五月，孙权乘诸葛亮出斜谷、魏军西顾之机，率十万之众攻合肥新城。魏征东将军满宠欲率军赴援，田豫等认为吴军大举而来、意在诱敌，劝其持重；守军据城拒守，吴军攻城二十余日不下，士卒多病，又闻魏明帝亲率大军东来，遂烧攻具退走。此役与同年诸葛亮五丈原之战相呼应，显示魏军两线作战仍能守住淮南。合肥新城为满宠所筑，故城在今合肥西北，坐标为示意。 In the fifth month of 234 Sun Quan, exploiting Zhuge Liang’s advance through Xie valley and Wei’s focus on the west, attacked Hefei New City with 100,000 men. The Wei general Man Chong wanted to march to its relief, but Tian Yu and others argued that the massive Wu move was a lure and advised caution. The garrison held the city; after more than twenty days the siege failed, sickness spread, and on hearing that Emperor Ming was coming east with the main army Sun burned his siege engines and withdrew. The siege echoed Zhuge Liang’s Wuzhang Plain campaign that year and showed that Wei could hold Huainan while fighting on two fronts. Man Chong built the new city northwest of modern Hefei; the point is schematic.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

place.zh: 益州汉中郡兴势（今陕西洋县北）
place.en: Xingshi, Hanzhong (north of modern Yang county, Shaanxi)

summary.zh: 曹爽率十余万攻汉中，王平据兴势拒守，费祎率援军断其后，魏军退走。
summary.en: Cao Shuang attacked Hanzhong with over 100,000 men. Wang Ping held Xingshi and Fei Yi cut the Wei line of retreat, forcing a withdrawal.

fields.name: 兴势之战 Battle of Xingshi
fields.place: 益州汉中郡兴势（今陕西洋县北） Xingshi, Hanzhong (north of modern Yang county, Shaanxi)
fields.summary: 曹爽率十余万攻汉中，王平据兴势拒守，费祎率援军断其后，魏军退走。 Cao Shuang attacked Hanzhong with over 100,000 men. Wang Ping held Xingshi and Fei Yi cut the Wei line of retreat, forcing a withdrawal.
fields.description: 正始五年（244）三月，曹爽不听司马懿劝阻，率十余万人自骆谷攻汉中。蜀汉镇北大将军王平以不满三万之众，采纳护军刘敏之议，先据兴势险要，多张旗帜绵延百余里；曹爽军入谷后补给困难，牛马骡驴多死。费祎又率军自成都东援，进据三岭截断魏军退路，曹爽苦战得脱，死伤甚众。此役是曹爽声望由盛转衰的起点，也巩固了蜀汉汉中防线。 In the third month of 244 Cao Shuang, ignoring Sima Yi’s objections, led more than 100,000 men through Luo valley against Hanzhong. Wang Ping, with fewer than 30,000, followed the advice of the protector Liu Min and occupied the Xingshi defile first, spreading banners over a hundred li. Once in the valley Cao Shuang’s supply line failed and many transport animals died. Fei Yi brought reinforcements east from Chengdu and seized the Sanling passes, cutting the retreat; Cao Shuang escaped after hard fighting with heavy losses. The battle marked the turning point in Cao Shuang’s fortunes and secured Shu Han’s Hanzhong front.

summary.zh: 司马懿发动政变，控制曹魏朝政。
summary.en: Sima Yi launched a coup and took control of the Wei court.

fields.name: 高平陵之变 The Gaopingling Incident
fields.summary: 司马懿发动政变，控制曹魏朝政。 Sima Yi launched a coup and took control of the Wei court.
fields.description: 魏正始十年（249）正月，曹爽兄弟陪魏帝曹芳出洛阳谒高平陵；司马懿以郭太后名义闭城门、占武库、控制禁军，并派曹爽所信之人劝其归降，指洛水为誓。曹爽回洛阳交出兵权，旋以谋反罪被族诛，司马氏专权自此始。 In the first month of 249 Cao Shuang and his brothers accompanied Emperor Cao Fang out of Luoyang to sacrifice at Gaopingling. Sima Yi, in the empress dowager’s name, closed the gates, seized the arsenal and controlled the palace guards, then sent men Cao Shuang trusted to offer terms, swearing by the Luo River. Cao Shuang returned to Luoyang and gave up his command, and was soon executed with his clan on a treason charge, beginning Sima family rule.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

name.en: Deng Ai crosses the Yinping trail

summary.zh: 邓艾自阴平道行无人之地七百余里，凿山通道，破江油，直逼成都。
summary.en: Deng Ai crossed the Yinping trail through seven hundred li of uninhabited country, cut a road through the mountains, took Jiangyou and threatened Chengdu.

fields.name: 邓艾偷渡阴平 Deng Ai crosses the Yinping trail
fields.place: 益州阴平（今甘肃文县） Yinping (modern Wen county, Gansu)
fields.summary: 邓艾自阴平道行无人之地七百余里，凿山通道，破江油，直逼成都。 Deng Ai crossed the Yinping trail through seven hundred li of uninhabited country, cut a road through the mountains, took Jiangyou and threatened Chengdu.
fields.description: 景元四年（263）十月，魏军三路伐蜀，钟会主力攻剑阁，姜维坚守不下。邓艾率偏师自阴平道，行无人之地七百余里，凿山通道、造作桥阁，山高谷深、粮运将匮，濒于危殆；至江油，蜀守将马邈投降。邓艾继续南下，破涪城，与诸葛瞻战于绵竹。此役绕过剑阁天险，是魏灭蜀的关键奇袭。阴平道具体路线异说较多，本段为示意简化。 In the tenth month of 263 the Wei army advanced in three columns. Zhong Hui’s main force was held at Jiange by Jiang Wei. Deng Ai took a detached force along the Yinping trail, crossing more than seven hundred li of uninhabited country, cutting a road and building bridges and galleries; with mountains high, valleys deep and supplies nearly exhausted, the column came close to disaster. At Jiangyou the Shu commander Ma Miao surrendered. Deng continued south, took Fu and fought Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu. The march bypassed the Jiange barrier and was the decisive stroke of the conquest of Shu. The exact Yinping route is disputed; this line is schematic.

fields.name: 魏灭蜀之战 Wei conquers Shu
fields.summary: 邓艾偷渡阴平，直取成都，蜀汉灭亡。 Deng Ai crossed Yinping by a side route and took Chengdu, ending Shu Han.
fields.description: 263 年，魏军分路伐蜀，邓艾偷渡阴平，击败诸葛瞻，进逼成都，刘禅投降。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 263, Wei launched a multi-pronged invasion of Shu. Deng Ai crossed Yinping by an unexpected route, defeated Zhuge Zhan, and advanced on Chengdu, where Liu Shan surrendered. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Three Kingdoms

place.zh: 益州广汉郡绵竹（今四川德阳绵竹）

summary.zh: 邓艾破诸葛瞻于绵竹，诸葛瞻父子战死，成都门户洞开，刘禅出降。
summary.en: Deng Ai defeated Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu; Zhuge Zhan and his son died, Chengdu lay open and Liu Shan surrendered.

fields.name: 绵竹之战 Battle of Mianzhu
fields.place: 益州广汉郡绵竹（今四川德阳绵竹） Mianzhu, Guanghan (modern Mianzhu, Deyang, Sichuan)
fields.summary: 邓艾破诸葛瞻于绵竹，诸葛瞻父子战死，成都门户洞开，刘禅出降。 Deng Ai defeated Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu; Zhuge Zhan and his son died, Chengdu lay open and Liu Shan surrendered.
fields.description: 景元四年（263）十一月，邓艾自江油南下，破涪城，蜀汉卫将军诸葛瞻率诸军拒于绵竹。诸葛瞻不听黄崇抢占险要之谏，列阵平地；邓艾遣子邓忠与师纂分左右夹击，蜀军大败，诸葛瞻及子诸葛尚、尚书张遵等战死。绵竹失守后，成都无险可守，刘禅采纳谯周之议，遣使向邓艾投降，蜀汉灭亡。绵竹故城在今四川德阳绵竹市一带，坐标为示意。 In the eleventh month of 263 Deng Ai advanced south from Jiangyou, took Fu, and met the Shu general Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu. Zhuge Zhan ignored Huang Chong’s advice to seize the high ground and drew up on open ground. Deng sent his son Deng Zhong and Shi Zuan to attack from both wings; the Shu army was routed and Zhuge Zhan, his son Zhuge Shang and the minister Zhang Zun were killed. With Mianzhu lost Chengdu had no defensible line; Liu Shan took Qiao Zhou’s advice, sent envoys to surrender to Deng Ai, and Shu Han ended. The old city lies near modern Mianzhu, Deyang; the point is schematic.

atlasTitle.en: West Route Army

name.en: West Route Army Crosses the Yellow River

summary.zh: 红四方面军一部从靖远虎豹口西渡黄河，后组建西路军。
summary.en: Part of the Fourth Front Army crossed the Yellow River at Hubaokou in Jingyuan and was later organized as the West Route Army.

fields.name: 西路军渡黄河 West Route Army Crosses the Yellow River 靖远渡河 Jingyuan River Crossing 虎豹口渡河 Hubaokou Crossing
fields.place: 甘肃靖远虎豹口 Hubaokou, Jingyuan, Gansu
fields.summary: 红四方面军一部从靖远虎豹口西渡黄河，后组建西路军。 Part of the Fourth Front Army crossed the Yellow River at Hubaokou in Jingyuan and was later organized as the West Route Army.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月 24 日夜，红四方面军第 30 军在靖远虎豹口强渡黄河成功；至 28 日，第 30 军、第 9 军和方面军总部渡河；30 日，第 5 军从三角城渡河。渡河部队共 2.18 万余人，11 月 11 日组建西路军，执行宁夏战役与河西作战任务。本坐标为虎豹口渡口代表点。 On the night of 24 October 1936, the 30th Army of the Fourth Front Army forced the Yellow River at Hubaokou in Jingyuan. By 28 October the 30th Army, 9th Army, and the Fourth Front Army headquarters had crossed; on 30 October the 5th Army crossed at Sanjiaocheng. More than 21,800 troops crossed and were organized as the West Route Army on 11 November to carry out the Ningxia campaign and operations in the Hexi Corridor. The coordinate is a representative point at the Hubaokou ferry.

fields.place: 甘肃景泰一条山 Yitiaoshan, Jingtai, Gansu
fields.summary: 西路军在景泰一条山击退马家军，歼敌 1000 余人。 The West Route Army repulsed the Ma clique at Yitiaoshan in Jingtai, killing or wounding over 1,000 enemy troops.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月 31 日至 11 月 4 日，红四方面军河西部队占领景泰一条山大部分村寨；11 月 3 日马步芳、马步青集中 3 个骑兵旅、2 个步兵旅猛攻，红军激战三昼夜，歼敌 1000 余人，将敌击退。此役为西路军西进古浪、永昌打开通道。本坐标为一条山镇代表点。 From 31 October to 4 November 1936, the Fourth Front Army’s river-crossing troops occupied most villages at Yitiaoshan in Jingtai. On 3 November Ma Bufang and Ma Buqing concentrated three cavalry brigades and two infantry brigades for a fierce attack; the Red Army fought for three days and nights, killed or wounded more than 1,000 enemy troops, and drove them back. The battle opened the way for the West Route Army’s advance to Gulang and Yongchang. The coordinate is a representative point at Yitiaoshan town.
fields.entities: 西路军（红四方面军一部） West Route Army (part of the Fourth Front Army)

atlasTitle.en: West Route Army

summary.zh: 红 9 军在古浪与马家军血战，毙伤敌 2000 余人，自身伤亡 2400 余人。
summary.en: The 9th Army fought a bloody battle with the Ma clique at Gulang, killing or wounding over 2,000 enemy troops while suffering more than 2,400 casualties.

fields.name: 古浪战役 Battle of Gulang 古浪三战 Three Battles of Gulang 古浪血战 Gulang Bloodbath
fields.place: 甘肃古浪县城 Gulang county town, Gansu
fields.summary: 红 9 军在古浪与马家军血战，毙伤敌 2000 余人，自身伤亡 2400 余人。 The 9th Army fought a bloody battle with the Ma clique at Gulang, killing or wounding over 2,000 enemy troops while suffering more than 2,400 casualties.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 11 日至 18 日，红 9 军西进古浪，在干柴洼、横梁山、古浪城与马家军激战；18 日马家军集中骑兵、步兵在飞机大炮掩护下猛攻，红军巷战后撤出。此役毙伤敌 2000 余人，红 9 军伤亡 2400 余人，排以上干部损失严重，有「古浪三战，九军折半」之说。本坐标为古浪县城代表点。 From 11 to 18 November 1936, the 9th Army advanced west to Gulang and fought the Ma clique at Ganchaiwa, Hengliang Mountain, and Gulang town. On 18 November the Ma forces concentrated cavalry and infantry, supported by aircraft and artillery, and stormed the town; the Red Army withdrew after street fighting. The battle killed or wounded more than 2,000 enemy troops, while the 9th Army suffered more than 2,400 casualties, with heavy losses among officers at company level and above; it was said that “three battles at Gulang halved the 9th Army.” The coordinate is a representative point at Gulang county town.
fields.entities: 西路军（红四方面军一部） West Route Army (part of the Fourth Front Army)

atlasTitle.en: West Route Army

summary.zh: 西路军在永昌、山丹建立临时根据地，苦战 40 天，减员至 1.5 万。
summary.en: The West Route Army established a temporary base at Yongchang and Shandan, fought for forty days, and was reduced to 15,000 troops.

fields.name: 永昌山丹防御 Defense of Yongchang and Shandan 永昌山丹战役 Yongchang–Shandan Campaign 甘北根据地 Ganbei Base Area
fields.place: 甘肃永昌县城 Yongchang county town, Gansu
fields.summary: 西路军在永昌、山丹建立临时根据地，苦战 40 天，减员至 1.5 万。 The West Route Army established a temporary base at Yongchang and Shandan, fought for forty days, and was reduced to 15,000 troops.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 18 日至 12 月 28 日，西路军占领永昌、山丹，在东起凉州西四十里铺、西至山丹的狭长地带建立甘北根据地，与马家军多次激战，歼敌 6000 余人，自身由 2.18 万减至 1.5 万。12 月 28 日突围西进临泽、高台。本坐标为永昌县城代表点。 From 18 November to 28 December 1936, the West Route Army occupied Yongchang and Shandan and established the Ganbei base area in the narrow corridor from west of Liangzhou to Shandan. It fought the Ma clique repeatedly, killing or wounding more than 6,000 enemy troops, while its own strength fell from 21,800 to 15,000. On 28 December it broke out westward toward Linze and Gaotai. The coordinate is a representative point at Yongchang county town.

summary.en: The 5th Army held Gaotai; Dong Zhentang, Yang Keming, and others died, and the town fell.

fields.summary: 红 5 军坚守高台，董振堂、杨克明等牺牲，高台失守。 The 5th Army held Gaotai; Dong Zhentang, Yang Keming, and others died, and the town fell.
fields.description: 1937 年 1 月 1 日，红 5 军攻占高台；1 月 12 日马家军集中兵力包围，红军苦战 9 昼夜，1 月 20 日高台失守。军长董振堂、政治部主任杨克明等 2000 余人牺牲。本坐标为高台县城代表点。 On 1 January 1937 the 5th Army captured Gaotai. On 12 January the Ma clique concentrated its forces and besieged the town; after nine days and nights of fighting, Gaotai fell on 20 January. More than 2,000 people, including army commander Dong Zhentang and political department director Yang Keming, were killed. The coordinate is a representative point at Gaotai county town.

summary.en: The 30th Army annihilated the Qinghai Gendarmerie Regiment at Xidongbao, its greatest victory in the Hexi Corridor.

fields.name: 西洞堡大捷 Victory at Xidongbao 西洞堡战斗 Battle of Xidongbao 西洞堡歼灭战 Xidongbao Annihilation Battle
fields.place: 甘肃张掖西洞堡、龙首堡一带 Xidongbao and Longshoubao area, Zhangye, Gansu
fields.summary: 红 30 军在西洞堡全歼青海宪兵团，取得河西最大胜利。 The 30th Army annihilated the Qinghai Gendarmerie Regiment at Xidongbao, its greatest victory in the Hexi Corridor.
fields.description: 1937 年 1 月 27 日，红 30 军在西洞堡、龙首堡抓住战机，以第 88、89 师出击，全歼马步芳青海宪兵团，击溃第 100 师手枪团，毙敌 800 余人，缴枪 1200 余支及大批物资。这是西路军进入河西后最大的一次军事胜利。本坐标为西洞堡/龙首堡代表点。 On 27 January 1937, the 30th Army seized the opportunity at Xidongbao and Longshoubao, committing the 88th and 89th Divisions. It annihilated Ma Bufang’s Qinghai Gendarmerie Regiment, routed the 100th Division’s pistol regiment, killed or wounded more than 800 enemy troops, and captured over 1,200 guns and large quantities of supplies. It was the West Route Army’s greatest victory after entering the Hexi Corridor. The coordinate is a representative point at Xidongbao/Longshoubao.

fields.description: 1937 年 1 月 28 日，西路军军政委员会在张掖龙首堡张福寿屯庄召开扩大会议，分析东进受阻形势，决定重建骑兵师、集中兵力重返倪家营，伺机歼敌。本坐标为龙渠/龙首堡代表点。 On 28 January 1937, the West Route Army’s military and political committee held an enlarged meeting at Zhangfushou Farmstead in Longshoubao, Zhangye. It analyzed the blocked eastward route and decided to rebuild the cavalry division and concentrate forces to return to Nijia Yingzi to seek opportunities against the enemy. The coordinate is a representative point at Longqu/Longshoubao.

summary.zh: 西路军在倪家营子与马家军血战 40 昼夜，被迫突围。
summary.en: The West Route Army fought the Ma clique at Nijia Yingzi for forty days and nights before breaking out.

fields.name: 倪家营子战斗 Battle of Nijia Yingzi 倪家营子血战 Nijia Yingzi Bloodbath 倪家营子保卫战 Defense of Nijia Yingzi
fields.place: 甘肃临泽倪家营子 Nijia Yingzi, Linze, Gansu
fields.summary: 西路军在倪家营子与马家军血战 40 昼夜，被迫突围。 The West Route Army fought the Ma clique at Nijia Yingzi for forty days and nights before breaking out.
fields.description: 1937 年 1 月 31 日至 2 月 27 日，西路军在临泽倪家营子 43 个堡寨与马家军激战，击退多次大规模进攻，歼敌近万人，自身伤亡严重；2 月 27 日突围西进三道柳沟。本坐标为倪家营子代表点。 From 31 January to 27 February 1937, the West Route Army fought the Ma clique in forty-three fortified villages at Nijia Yingzi in Linze. It repulsed several large-scale attacks and killed or wounded nearly 10,000 enemy troops, but suffered heavy casualties itself; on 27 February it broke out westward toward Sandaoliugou. The coordinate is a representative point at Nijia Yingzi.

summary.en: The remnants of the 9th Army and part of the Women’s Independent Regiment fought at Liyuankou, covering the main force’s entry into the Qilian Mountains.

fields.summary: 红 9 军余部与妇女独立团一部在梨园口血战，掩护主力进入祁连山。 The remnants of the 9th Army and part of the Women’s Independent Regiment fought at Liyuankou, covering the main force’s entry into the Qilian Mountains.
fields.description: 1937 年 3 月 12 日，西路军在临泽梨园口与尾追马家军骑兵、步兵激战，红 9 军余部与妇女独立团一部几乎全部牺牲，掩护西路军余部进入祁连山。本坐标为梨园口代表点。 On 12 March 1937, the West Route Army fought pursuing Ma clique cavalry and infantry at Liyuankou in Linze. The remnants of the 9th Army and part of the Women’s Independent Regiment were almost entirely lost, covering the entry of the remaining West Route Army into the Qilian Mountains. The coordinate is a representative point at Liyuankou.

fields.name: 石窝会议 Shiwo Meeting 石窝山会议 Shiwo Mountain Meeting 西路军军政委员会会议 West Route Army Military and Political Committee Meeting
fields.place: 甘肃肃南石窝山 Shiwo Mountain, Sunan, Gansu
fields.summary: 西路军军政委员会在石窝山开会，决定分散游击、徐陈回陕北。 The West Route Army’s military and political committee met at Shiwo Mountain and decided to disperse into guerrilla units, with Xu and Chen returning to northern Shaanxi.
fields.description: 1937 年 3 月 14 日，西路军军政委员会在肃南石窝山召开紧急会议，决定徐向前、陈昌浩离开部队回陕北汇报，余部编为左、右、机动三个支队，组成西路军工作委员会，李先念率左支队向新疆方向转战。本坐标为石窝山代表点。 On 14 March 1937, the West Route Army’s military and political committee held an emergency meeting at Shiwo Mountain in Sunan. It decided that Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao should leave the army and report back to northern Shaanxi; the remaining troops were divided into left, right, and mobile detachments under a West Route Army work committee, with Li Xiannian leading the left detachment toward Xinjiang. The coordinate is a representative point at Shiwo Mountain.

fields.description: 1937 年 4 月底，李先念率西路军左支队 400 余人到达甘新交界的星星峡；5 月 1 日前后，党中央代表陈云、滕代远等到星星峡接应，5 月 7 日到达乌鲁木齐，整编为「新兵营」。本坐标为星星峡镇代表点。 At the end of April 1937, Li Xiannian led more than 400 survivors of the West Route Army’s left detachment to Xingxingxia on the Gansu–Xinjiang border. fields.description: 贞观四年（630）初，玄奘偷渡玉门关后进入莫贺延碛。途中失手打翻水囊，又迷失道路，五天四夜滴水未进，几乎渴死。他默念观音名号，发誓「宁可就西而死，岂归东而生」，最终由老马引至野马泉，得以生还。 In early 630, after slipping past Yumen Pass, Xuanzang entered the Moheyan Desert. He dropped his water bag and lost his way, going five days and nights without water and nearly dying of thirst. He vowed to press west rather than turn back, and was at last led by his old horse to a spring.

fields.description: 玄奘走出莫贺延碛后抵达伊吾。当地玉佛寺的汉僧听说故乡来人，衣未及整便抱泣相迎。高昌王麴文泰闻讯，立即遣使携马匹来迎，请玄奘西行高昌。 After crossing the Moheyan Desert Xuanzang reached Yiwu. A Chinese monk at the local jade-Buddha monastery wept at meeting a traveler from home, and King Qu Wentai of Gaochang sent envoys with horses to invite him onward.

fields.description: 玄奘在龟兹停留，观察当地佛教与音乐，随后翻越凌山。 Xuanzang stayed at Kucha, observed local Buddhism and music, and then crossed the Bedel Pass.

atlasTitle.en: Silk Road: Xuanzang’s Journey

summary.zh: 玄奘越凌山后抵大清池，记其「洪涛浩汗，惊波汩㴔」。
summary.en: After the Bedel Pass Xuanzang reaches the Great Clear Lake, a vast and wave-tossed water.

fields.name: 大清池 Great Clear Lake 热海 伊塞克湖 Issyk-Kul
fields.place: 大清池（今伊塞克湖） Great Clear Lake (Issyk-Kul)
fields.summary: 玄奘越凌山后抵大清池，记其「洪涛浩汗，惊波汩㴔」。 After the Bedel Pass Xuanzang reaches the Great Clear Lake, a vast and wave-tossed water.
fields.description: 翻越凌山后，玄奘抵达大清池。《大唐西域记》记此湖「周千四五百里，东西长，南北狭，四面负山，众流交凑」，虽处无热之区却「洪涛浩汗，惊波汩㴔」，是当时中亚商道上的重要地标。 After crossing the Bedel Pass Xuanzang reached the Great Clear Lake. The Records of the Western Regions describes a lake over a thousand li around, long east to west and narrow north to south, ringed by mountains and fed by many streams, its waves vast and restless.

summary.en: Xuanzang travels west through the Thousand Springs, Talas and Chach into Sogdiana.

fields.summary: 玄奘经千泉、怛罗斯、赭时西行，进入河中地区。 Xuanzang travels west through the Thousand Springs, Talas and Chach into Sogdiana.
fields.description: 自碎叶川西行，玄奘经千泉、怛罗斯、白水城与赭时（今塔什干），进入以撒马尔罕为中心的河中地区。这一线是西突厥控制下的粟特商道，玄奘沿途记录城邑、物产与突厥可汗的游牧势力。 From the Suyab valley Xuanzang traveled west through the Thousand Springs, Talas, Isfijab and Chach (Tashkent) into the Sogdian lands around Samarkand, recording the towns, goods and nomad power of the Western Turks along the way.

fields.name: 迦湿弥罗 Kashmir 罽宾 克什米尔 Kashmir
fields.place: 迦湿弥罗（今克什米尔） Kashmir
fields.summary: 玄奘在迦湿弥罗住约两年，学《俱舍论》等经论。 Xuanzang spends about two years in Kashmir studying the Abhidharma and logic.
fields.description: 631 年冬，玄奘入迦湿弥罗，住约两年，从僧称法师学《俱舍论》《顺正理论》及因明、声明等，并抄写当地所藏经论。此地是当时说一切有部的重要中心。 In the winter of 631 Xuanzang entered Kashmir and stayed about two years, studying the Abhidharma-kosa, the Nyayanusara and Buddhist logic under the master Sengcheng, and copying the texts preserved there.

summary.zh: 玄奘在迦湿弥罗从僧称法师学《俱舍论》《顺正理论》。
summary.en: In Kashmir Xuanzang studies the Abhidharmakosa and the Nyayanusara under the master Sengcheng.

fields.name: 僧称授《俱舍》 Studying the Kosa under Sengcheng 俱舍论 顺正理论 僧称 Sengcheng
fields.place: 迦湿弥罗（今克什米尔） Kashmir
fields.summary: 玄奘在迦湿弥罗从僧称法师学《俱舍论》《顺正理论》。 In Kashmir Xuanzang studies the Abhidharmakosa and the Nyayanusara under the master Sengcheng.
fields.description: 玄奘住阇耶因陀罗寺，从僧称法师学《阿毗达磨俱舍论》《阿毗达磨顺正理论》。僧称年近七十，解深经论，为迦湿弥罗众僧所推；见玄奘慧悟，叹曰「此支那僧，智力宏博，汝曹不及」。迦湿弥罗当时是说一切有部的重镇，论藏完备。年月经研究推定。 Xuanzang lodged at the Jayendra monastery and studied the Abhidharmakosa and the Nyayanusara under the master Sengcheng, then nearly seventy and the most respected scholar in Kashmir. Impressed by his pupil, Sengcheng told the monks that none of them could match the Chinese monk's understanding. Kashmir was then a stronghold of the Sarvastivada with a complete Abhidharma canon. Dates are scholarly estimates.

fields.name: 第四次结集 The Fourth Council 迦腻色迦 Kaniska 大毗婆沙论 第四次结集
fields.place: 迦湿弥罗（今克什米尔） Kashmir
fields.summary: 玄奘参礼迦腻色迦王结集之处，五百罗汉造《大毗婆沙论》之地。 Xuanzang visits the site of Kaniska's council, where five hundred arhats compiled the Mahavibhasa.
fields.description: 迦湿弥罗是第四次结集之地。迦腻色迦王时，五百阿罗汉在此会集，造《阿毗达磨大毗婆沙论》，为说一切有部的纲领性著作。玄奘参礼结集伽蓝与窣堵波，后来在长安译出此论二百卷。年月经研究推定。 Kashmir was the seat of the fourth Buddhist council: under King Kaniska five hundred arhats assembled here and compiled the Abhidharma-mahavibhasa, the great summa of the Sarvastivada. Xuanzang visited the council's monastery and stupa, and later translated the work in two hundred fascicles at Chang'an. Dates are scholarly estimates.

fields.summary: 玄奘学成辞行，出迦湿弥罗南下，经磔迦东行。 His studies done, Xuanzang leaves Kashmir for the North Indian plain.
fields.description: 在迦湿弥罗首尾二年，玄奘学成辞行，出山南下，经磔迦国东行，进入北印度平原。此后一路东行，经至那仆底、阇烂达罗、秣兔罗，至曲女城。年月经研究推定。 After two years in Kashmir Xuanzang took his leave, came down from the mountains and traveled east through Taki into the North Indian plain, passing Chinasthana, Jalandhara and Mathura on the way to Kanauj. Dates are scholarly estimates.

fields.summary: 玄奘至至那仆底，从调伏光学《对法论》《显宗论》。 Xuanzang studies the Abhidharma at Chinasthana, the land of the Chinese hostage.
fields.description: 至那仆底，唐言「汉封」。相传迦腻色迦王征服东土后，将汉地质子安置于此，因而得名；当地桃称「至那尔」（汉持来），梨称「至那罗阇弗呾逻」（汉王子），国人「深敬东土」。玄奘在此从调伏光法师学《对法论》《显宗论》。 Chinasthana means “Chinese fief”. Legend holds that King Kaniska settled a Chinese hostage here, and the region’s peaches and pears are still named after the Chinese prince. Xuanzang studied the Abhidharma texts here under Dharmapala’s disciple.

fields.description: 634 年，玄奘入那烂陀寺，礼戒贤论师为师。那烂陀是当时印度最高的佛教学府，僧徒数千，每日讲座百余所。入学年份有 633、634 诸说，本专题取 634 年，属研究推定。 In 634 Xuanzang entered Nalanda and became a disciple of Silabhadra. Nalanda was the foremost Buddhist university of India, with thousands of monks and a hundred lectures a day. The year of entry is given as 633 or 634; this atlas adopts 634.

fields.description: 玄奘在那烂陀寺师从戒贤论师，学《瑜伽师地论》，兼习《显扬圣教论》《对法论》等，前后约五年。寺中僧徒数千，戒律严整，每日百余讲座。玄奘因通晓三藏，被推为「十德」之一，为寺众讲《摄大乘论》《唯识抉择论》，并著《会宗论》《制恶见论》回应师子光、般若毱多诸说。 At Nalanda Xuanzang studied the Yogacarabhumi under Silabhadra for about five years, along with other Yogacara and Abhidharma texts. Recognised as one of the ten masters versed in the three baskets, he lectured to the assembly and composed works defending the Yogacara school against rival interpretations.

fields.name: 戒贤开讲 Silabhadra's Lectures 戒贤 尸罗跋陀罗 Silabhadra
fields.place: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦） Nalanda Monastery (Bihar, India)
fields.summary: 戒贤论师重开讲席，为玄奘讲《瑜伽师地论》。 Silabhadra reopens the lecture hall to teach Xuanzang the Yogacarabhumi.
fields.description: 戒贤（Śīlabhadra）时年逾百，已多年不讲。闻玄奘自支那而来，命弟子引见，叹其求法之志，遂重开讲堂，为讲《瑜伽师地论》，首尾十五月。那烂陀寺僧徒数千，讲座日百余所，玄奘自此入五年学程。开讲月日属研究推定。 Silabhadra was over a hundred and had long ceased lecturing. Hearing that Xuanzang had come from China, he reopened the hall and taught the Yogacarabhumi for fifteen months. With thousands of monks and a hundred lectures a day, Nalanda was the foremost Buddhist university of India. The month is a scholarly estimate.

fields.name: 研习瑜伽 Studying the Yogacarabhumi 瑜伽师地论 Yogacarabhumi
fields.place: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦） Nalanda Monastery (Bihar, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘在那烂陀随戒贤研习《瑜伽师地论》，以此为主课。 At Nalanda Xuanzang makes the Yogacarabhumi his principal subject.
fields.description: 《瑜伽师地论》是瑜伽行派的根本论，戒贤所传。玄奘在此论上用功最久，归国后译出百卷，成为汉传唯识学的骨干。听讲之外，兼参与寺中论议。年月经研究推定。 The Yogacarabhumi is the foundational treatise of the Yogacara school and the text Silabhadra transmitted. Xuanzang devoted most of his five years to it and later translated it in a hundred fascicles, the backbone of East Asian Consciousness-Only thought. Dates are scholarly estimates.

fields.description: 五年之间，玄奘于《瑜伽》之外遍学《显扬圣教论》《阿毗达磨杂集论》《集量论》《中论》《百论》，并及因明、声明、医方、术数，通晓三藏，为寺众所推。具体年月属研究推定。 Beyond the Yogacarabhumi, Xuanzang studied the Abhidharma-samuccaya, the Pramana-samuccaya, the Madhyamaka-karika and the Sata-sastra, together with Buddhist logic, grammar, medicine and mathematics, earning the regard of the community. Dates are scholarly estimates.

fields.name: 听《顺正理论》 Studying the Nyayanusara 顺正理论 Nyāyānusāra Nyayanusara
fields.place: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦） Nalanda Monastery (Bihar, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘在那烂陀听《阿毗达磨顺正理论》，与《瑜伽》互相发明。 Xuanzang studies the Nyayanusara at Nalanda alongside the Yogacarabhumi.
fields.description: 《顺正理论》为众贤论师破世亲《俱舍论》之作，义理精严。玄奘在那烂陀随戒贤门下听此论，与《瑜伽师地论》《显扬圣教论》互相发明。据《大慈恩寺三藏法师传》，五年间《瑜伽》听三遍，此论亦在讲席之列。年月经研究推定。 The Nyayanusara, by Samghabhadra, refutes Vasubandhu's Abhidharmakosa and is noted for its rigour. Xuanzang heard it expounded at Nalanda under Silabhadra's circle, setting it beside the Yogacarabhumi and the Abhidharma-samuccaya. The Biography records that he heard the Yogacarabhumi three times in five years; the month here is a scholarly estimate.

fields.name: 造《会宗论》 Composing the Hui-zong-lun 会宗论 师子光 Simhacandra
fields.place: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦） Nalanda Monastery (Bihar, India)
fields.summary: 师子光以《中》《百》破瑜伽，玄奘造《会宗论》三千颂会通，寺众叹服。 Against Simhacandra's attack on Yogacara, Xuanzang writes three thousand verses reconciling the schools.
fields.description: 那烂陀寺师子光讲《中论》《百论》，斥《瑜伽师地论》为非，门人从之者众。玄奘以「圣人立教各随所宜」造《会宗论》三千颂，会通中观与瑜伽，戒贤与寺众称善。此事原并入「那烂陀著论」，本轮前移至此。年月经研究推定。 Simhacandra lectured on the Madhyamaka and Sata-sastras and dismissed the Yogacarabhumi, drawing many followers. Xuanzang composed three thousand verses of the Hui-zong-lun reconciling Madhyamaka and Yogacara, to the approval of Silabhadra and the community. Previously folded into the later Nalanda treatises, the episode is dated here by scholarly estimate.

fields.name: 论破外道 Debating the Lokayata 顺世外道 Lokayata
fields.place: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦） Nalanda Monastery (Bihar, India)
fields.summary: 顺世外道悬义四十条于寺门，玄奘往复论难，外道辞屈。 A Lokayata challenger posts forty theses at the gate; Xuanzang refutes him.
fields.description: 有顺世外道来那烂陀求论，书四十条义悬于寺门，约「堕负者斩首谢之」，寺僧无人敢应。玄奘请与对论，往复数番，外道辞屈请斩，玄奘止之，但令归信。年月经研究推定。 A Lokayata teacher came to Nalanda and posted forty theses at the gate, offering his head to whoever could refute them. None of the monks dared answer; Xuanzang took up the debate, and after several exchanges the challenger conceded. Xuanzang spared him and asked only that he accept the teaching. Dates are scholarly estimates.

fields.name: 王舍城 Rajgir 罗阅祇 灵鹫山 耆阇崛山 竹林精舍 拉杰吉尔 Rajgir
fields.place: 王舍城（今印度拉杰吉尔） Rajgir (Bihar, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘巡礼王舍城，登灵鹫山，访竹林精舍与第一次结集处。 Xuanzang visits Rajgir, climbs Vulture Peak and sees the first council site.
fields.description: 王舍城是摩揭陀国旧都，佛陀一生多处说法地。玄奘登灵鹫山（耆阇崛山），访竹林精舍、迦兰陀池，以及佛灭后第一次结集的七叶窟。《大唐西域记》卷九记此城「外郭已坏，无复遗堵」，与那烂陀仅数十里之遥。 Rajgir, the old capital of Magadha, was a favourite preaching ground of the Buddha. Xuanzang climbed Vulture Peak, visited the Bamboo Grove and the Sattapanni cave where the first council was held, and recorded that the city’s outer walls were already in ruins.

fields.description: 耽摩栗底（今西孟加拉邦塔姆卢克）是东印度出海口，商舶云集，与南海、僧伽罗通航。玄奘在此闻海上诸国与佛牙故事，仍决意陆行。沿途并记三摩呾吒、羯罗拏苏伐剌那诸国。年月经研究推定。 Tamralipti, near modern Tamluk in West Bengal, was the outlet of eastern India, crowded with ships bound for the southern seas and Sri Lanka. Xuanzang heard there of the maritime kingdoms and the Buddha's tooth, but chose to travel overland, recording Samatata and Karnasuvarna on the way. Dates are scholarly estimates.

fields.place: 驮那羯磔迦（今印度安得拉邦） Dhanyakataka (Andhra Pradesh, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘南下达案达罗，至驮那羯磔迦，从苏部底等学大乘论。 Reaching Andhra, Xuanzang studies Mahayana treatises at Dhanyakataka.
fields.description: 驮那羯磔迦（今安得拉邦阿马拉瓦蒂一带）为案达罗国故地，大乘与部派并盛，城南有阿摩罗伐底大塔。玄奘在此从苏部底、苏利婆二僧学大乘论。年月经研究推定。 Dhanyakataka, around modern Amaravati in Andhra Pradesh, was the heartland of the Andhra country where Mahayana and the schools flourished side by side, with the great stupa nearby. Xuanzang studied Mahayana treatises under two local monks. Dates are scholarly estimates.

place.zh: 建志城（今印度泰米尔纳德邦）

summary.zh: 玄奘至达罗毗荼建志城，护法论师故里。
summary.en: Xuanzang reaches Kanci, birthplace of Dharmapala, in the Dravida country.

fields.name: 建志城 Kanci 建志补罗 Kāñcī Kanci
fields.place: 建志城（今印度泰米尔纳德邦） Kanci (Tamil Nadu, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘至达罗毗荼建志城，护法论师故里。 Xuanzang reaches Kanci, birthplace of Dharmapala, in the Dravida country.
fields.description: 建志城（今甘吉布勒姆）为达罗毗荼国都，护法（Dharmapāla）论师出生地，僧伽学术甚盛。玄奘在此停留问学，并记南印度诸国风土。年月经研究推定。 Kanci, modern Kanchipuram, was the capital of the Dravida country and the birthplace of Dharmapala; its monastic learning was famous. Xuanzang stayed to study and recorded the customs of the southern kingdoms. Dates are scholarly estimates.

place.zh: 秣罗矩吒（今印度泰米尔纳德邦）

summary.zh: 玄奘至印度南端秣罗矩吒，闻僧伽罗佛牙事。
summary.en: At the southern tip of India Xuanzang hears of the Buddha's tooth in Sri Lanka.

fields.name: 秣罗矩吒 Malakuta 秣罗矩吒国 Malakūṭa Malakuta
fields.place: 秣罗矩吒（今印度泰米尔纳德邦） Malakuta (Tamil Nadu, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘至印度南端秣罗矩吒，闻僧伽罗佛牙事。 At the southern tip of India Xuanzang hears of the Buddha's tooth in Sri Lanka.
fields.description: 秣罗矩吒（今马杜赖一带）临海，玄奘在此闻僧伽罗国（今斯里兰卡）有佛牙、供养无缺；以路远海险未往，后来义净才由海路至彼。年月经研究推定。 Malakuta, around modern Madurai, faces the sea. There Xuanzang heard that Simhala — Sri Lanka — kept the Buddha's tooth with unbroken offerings; the sea route was perilous and he did not cross, though Yijing later did. Dates are scholarly estimates.

place.zh: 摩诃剌佗（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）

summary.zh: 玄奘沿西海岸北上，经恭建那补罗、摩诃剌佗诸国。
summary.en: Xuanzang turns north up the west coast through Konkanapura and Maharastra.

fields.name: 摩诃剌佗 Maharastra 摩诃剌佗国 Mahārāṣṭra Maharastra
fields.place: 摩诃剌佗（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦） Maharastra (India)
fields.summary: 玄奘沿西海岸北上，经恭建那补罗、摩诃剌佗诸国。 Xuanzang turns north up the west coast through Konkanapura and Maharastra.
fields.description: 摩诃剌佗国人轻财尚义、善战，玄奘记其风俗与伽蓝。自南印度北上，经恭建那补罗、摩诃剌佗、跋禄羯呫婆诸国，走向西海岸。年月经研究推定。 The people of Maharastra were described as despising wealth, honoring their word and skilled in war. Xuanzang came north from the far south through Konkanapura and Maharastra toward the west coast. Dates are scholarly estimates.

place.zh: 伐腊毗（今印度古吉拉特邦）

summary.zh: 玄奘至西海岸伐腊毗，正量部盛行、商舶辐辏之地。
summary.en: At Valabhi on the western coast Xuanzang finds the Sammitiya school and a busy port.

fields.name: 伐腊毗 Valabhi 伐腊毗国 Valabhī Valabhi
fields.place: 伐腊毗（今印度古吉拉特邦） Valabhi (Gujarat, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘至西海岸伐腊毗，正量部盛行、商舶辐辏之地。 At Valabhi on the western coast Xuanzang finds the Sammitiya school and a busy port.
fields.description: 伐腊毗（今古吉拉特邦瓦拉）为西印度大港与佛学中心，正量部盛行，义净后来亦至此求学。玄奘记其僧徒、伽蓝与商舶往来，随后东行北归。年月经研究推定。 Valabhi, near modern Vala in Gujarat, was a great western port and a center of the Sammitiya school, where Yijing later studied. Xuanzang recorded its monks, monasteries and shipping before turning east for the return. Dates are scholarly estimates.

place.zh: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦）

summary.zh: 玄奘经摩腊婆、邬阇衍那北归那烂陀，五印度巡礼至此结束。
summary.en: Xuanzang returns north through Malava and Ujjayini, closing his pilgrimage.

fields.name: 还归那烂陀 Return to Nalanda 巡礼归来 End of the pilgrimage
fields.place: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦） Nalanda Monastery (Bihar, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘经摩腊婆、邬阇衍那北归那烂陀，五印度巡礼至此结束。 Xuanzang returns north through Malava and Ujjayini, closing his pilgrimage.
fields.description: 玄奘自伐腊毗东行，经摩腊婆、邬阇衍那、掷枳陀诸国，还归那烂陀寺。五印度巡礼前后约三年，行程数千里，所历百余国，后多载入《大唐西域记》。归期属研究推定。 From Valabhi Xuanzang went east through Malava, Ujjayini and other lands back to Nalanda. The pilgrimage had lasted about three years and covered more than a hundred kingdoms, most of them later recorded in the Records of the Western Regions. The date is a scholarly estimate.

place.zh: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦）

summary.zh: 玄奘在那烂陀著《制恶见论》，驳般若毱多，戒日王遣使迎请。
summary.en: At Nalanda Xuanzang writes the Zhi-e-jian-lun refuting Prajnagupta, and King Harsha sends for him.

fields.name: 那烂陀著论 Treatises Composed at Nalanda 制恶见论 师子光 般若毱多
fields.place: 那烂陀寺（今印度比哈尔邦） Nalanda Monastery (Bihar, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘在那烂陀著《制恶见论》，驳般若毱多，戒日王遣使迎请。 At Nalanda Xuanzang writes the Zhi-e-jian-lun refuting Prajnagupta, and King Harsha sends for him.
fields.description: 巡礼五印度归来，玄奘在那烂陀寺著《制恶见论》一千六百颂，驳般若毱多的《破大乘论》，并设十八日无遮论场。戒日王读到后大悦，遣使迎请玄奘，遂有曲女城大会。《会宗论》则成于游学期间（637 年，见「造《会宗论》」）。 Returning from his pilgrimage, Xuanzang composed sixteen hundred verses of the Zhi-e-jian-lun at Nalanda, refuting Prajnagupta's attack on the Mahayana, and set out the argument for eighteen days. King Harsha, delighted on reading it, sent for him — the prelude to the Kanauj assembly. The Hui-zong-lun had been written earlier, during his studies.

place.zh: 迦摩缕波（今印度阿萨姆邦）

summary.zh: 鸠摩罗王遣使迎请，玄奘东行至迦摩缕波。
summary.en: King Kumara invites Xuanzang east to Kamarupa.

fields.name: 迦摩缕波 Kamarupa 迦摩缕波国 鸠摩罗王 东印度 阿萨姆 Assam 古瓦哈提 Guwahati
fields.place: 迦摩缕波（今印度阿萨姆邦） Kamarupa (Assam, India)
fields.summary: 鸠摩罗王遣使迎请，玄奘东行至迦摩缕波。 King Kumara invites Xuanzang east to Kamarupa.
fields.description: 迦摩缕波在今阿萨姆一带，「周万余里，国大都城周三十余里」，是东印度的大国。国王鸠摩罗遣使迎请玄奘，玄奘初辞，使者以毁那烂陀相胁，遂东行至其国，为王授戒。戒日王闻讯大怒，鸠摩罗王亲自送玄奘西行，二王相会于恒河之滨，同赴曲女城大会。 Kamarupa, in present-day Assam, was a great kingdom of eastern India. Its king Kumara invited Xuanzang, who at first declined; when envoys threatened to destroy Nalanda he went east and administered the precepts to the king. Harsha was furious at the news, and Kumara personally escorted Xuanzang west, the two kings meeting on the Ganges before the assembly at Kanauj.

atlasTitle.en: Silk Road: Xuanzang’s Journey

summary.zh: 戒日王在曲女城设大会，玄奘为论主，十八日无人能破。
summary.en: King Harsha holds a great assembly at Kanauj where Xuanzang defeats all challengers.

fields.name: 曲女城大会 Assembly at Kanauj 羯若鞠阇 卡瑙季 Kannauj 曲女城法会
fields.place: 曲女城（今印度卡瑙季） Kanauj (Kannauj, India)
fields.summary: 戒日王在曲女城设大会，玄奘为论主，十八日无人能破。 King Harsha holds a great assembly at Kanauj where Xuanzang defeats all challengers.
fields.description: 戒日王为玄奘在曲女城设大法会，十八国国王、三千余僧、二千外道列席。玄奘为论主，立「真唯识量」，声明若有一字可破便斩首相谢。十八日无人发论，大乘众尊之为「大乘天」，小乘众尊之为「解脱天」。大会年份有 641、642、643 诸说，本专题取 643 年，属研究推定。 King Harsha convened a great assembly at Kanauj with eighteen kings, three thousand monks and two thousand non-Buddhists. Xuanzang, as defender, set forth his thesis and offered his head if anyone could refute a single word. For eighteen days no one challenged him, and he was hailed as “Mahayanadeva” and “Moksadeva”. The year is disputed (641/642/643); this atlas adopts 643.

place.zh: 钵罗耶伽（今印度普拉亚格拉吉）

summary.zh: 戒日王在钵罗耶伽举行五年一度的无遮大会，会后玄奘辞归。
summary.en: Harsha holds the quinquennial assembly at Prayaga, after which Xuanzang takes his leave.

fields.name: 钵罗耶伽无遮大会 Great Assembly at Prayaga 钵逻耶伽 阿拉哈巴德 Allahabad 普拉亚格拉吉 Prayagraj
fields.place: 钵罗耶伽（今印度普拉亚格拉吉） Prayaga (Prayagraj, India)
fields.summary: 戒日王在钵罗耶伽举行五年一度的无遮大会，会后玄奘辞归。 Harsha holds the quinquennial assembly at Prayaga, after which Xuanzang takes his leave.
fields.description: 曲女城大会后，戒日王移驾钵罗耶伽，举行五年一度的无遮大会，历时七十五日，道俗五十余万人赴会，王与群臣倾库施僧。会毕，玄奘再三请归，戒日王与鸠摩罗王挽留不成，遂赠大象、金钱与经像，遣使护送。 After Kanauj the king moved to Prayaga for the quinquennial assembly, which lasted seventy-five days and drew more than half a million people; the king and his ministers emptied the treasury in almsgiving. When it ended, Xuanzang asked leave to return and could not be dissuaded.

place.zh: 钵罗耶伽（今印度普拉亚格拉吉）

summary.zh: 玄奘辞别戒日王，自钵罗耶伽启程归国。
summary.en: Xuanzang takes leave of King Harsha and sets out for home from Prayaga.

fields.name: 启程归国 Departure for home 辞归 东归
fields.place: 钵罗耶伽（今印度普拉亚格拉吉） Prayaga (Prayagraj, India)
fields.summary: 玄奘辞别戒日王，自钵罗耶伽启程归国。 Xuanzang takes leave of King Harsha and sets out for home from Prayaga.
fields.description: 643 年夏，玄奘在钵罗耶伽无遮大会后辞别戒日王，携六百五十七部梵本佛经与佛像启程归国。戒日王遣使护送，玄奘北行经憍赏弥、呾叉始罗，渡信度河，越兴都库什山。 In the summer of 643, after the great assembly at Prayaga, Xuanzang took leave of King Harsha and started home with 657 Sanskrit texts and Buddhist images, escorted by the king’s envoys.

atlasTitle.en: Silk Road: Xuanzang’s Journey

name.en: Loss of the Scriptures in the Indus

summary.zh: 玄奘渡信度河遇风浪，五十夹经本与花种落水。
summary.en: Xuanzang’s boat capsizes in the Indus and fifty bundles of scriptures are lost.

fields.name: 信度河失经 Loss of the Scriptures in the Indus 印度河 Indus 呾叉始罗
fields.place: 信度河（今印度河） Indus River
fields.summary: 玄奘渡信度河遇风浪，五十夹经本与花种落水。 Xuanzang’s boat capsizes in the Indus and fifty bundles of scriptures are lost.
fields.description: 玄奘归途经呾叉始罗，渡信度河时遇风浪，船身倾覆，五十夹经本与从印度携来的花种尽数落水。他在迦毕试停留五十余日，遣人往乌仗那抄补所失经本。这是《西游记》「通天河湿经」的原型之一。 On his homeward road, crossing the Indus near Taxila, Xuanzang’s boat was caught by a squall and capsized; fifty bundles of manuscripts and the flower seeds he was carrying were lost. He stayed more than fifty days at Kapisa while messengers went to Udyana to copy the missing texts.

atlasTitle.en: Silk Road: Xuanzang’s Journey

place.zh: 迦毕试（今阿富汗贝格拉姆一带）

summary.zh: 失经后驻迦毕试五十余日，遣人往乌仗那抄补经本。
summary.en: Xuanzang stays at Kapisa for over fifty days, sending men to Udyana to copy the lost texts.

fields.name: 迦毕试抄经 Copying Lost Texts at Kapisa 迦毕试国 贝格拉姆 Bagram 佛顶骨城
fields.place: 迦毕试（今阿富汗贝格拉姆一带） Kapisa (Bagram region, Afghanistan)
fields.summary: 失经后驻迦毕试五十余日，遣人往乌仗那抄补经本。 Xuanzang stays at Kapisa for over fifty days, sending men to Udyana to copy the lost texts.
fields.description: 信度河失经后，玄奘北行至迦毕试，停留五十余日。他遣人携财物往乌仗那国抄写所失经本，同时参访城北的佛顶骨城与诸寺。迦毕试是由印度入中亚的必经之地，玄奘在此整理经像行装，再北越兴都库什山。 After losing the manuscripts in the Indus, Xuanzang went north to Kapisa and stayed more than fifty days, sending men with funds to Udyana to copy the lost texts while visiting the shrine of the Buddha’s skull-bone and the monasteries around the city, before crossing the Hindu Kush.

atlasTitle.en: Silk Road: Xuanzang’s Journey

summary.zh: 玄奘归途抵活国，闻高昌已灭，改走天山南道。
summary.en: At Kunduz Xuanzang learns that Gaochang has fallen and changes his route.

fields.name: 活国 Kunduz 昆都士 Kunduz
fields.place: 活国（今阿富汗昆都士） Kunduz (Afghanistan)
fields.summary: 玄奘归途抵活国，闻高昌已灭，改走天山南道。 At Kunduz Xuanzang learns that Gaochang has fallen and changes his route.
fields.description: 玄奘北越兴都库什山，抵活国。此地原为突厥叶护可汗长子呾度设所居，其子继位后迎玄奘供养。玄奘在此闻知高昌王麴文泰已于 640 年去世、高昌已为唐所灭，遂放弃当年「归途留住高昌三年」之约，改由葱岭走天山南道归国。 Crossing the Hindu Kush northward, Xuanzang reached Kunduz, where the son of the Turkic chief received him. There he learned that King Qu Wentai of Gaochang had died in 640 and that Gaochang had been annexed by the Tang, so he gave up his promise to spend three years there and took the southern Tianshan road instead.

atlasTitle.en: Silk Road: Xuanzang’s Journey

place.zh: 波谜罗川（今帕米尔高原）

summary.zh: 玄奘越葱岭，经波谜罗川大龙池，冰雪千里。
summary.en: Xuanzang crosses the Pamirs past the great dragon lake, through snow and ice.

fields.name: 波谜罗川 The Pamir Valleys 葱岭 大龙池 瓦罕 Wakhan
fields.place: 波谜罗川（今帕米尔高原） Pamir highlands
fields.summary: 玄奘越葱岭，经波谜罗川大龙池，冰雪千里。 Xuanzang crosses the Pamirs past the great dragon lake, through snow and ice.
fields.description: 自活国东行，玄奘翻越葱岭，入波谜罗川。《大唐西域记》卷十二记此川「东西千余里，南北百余里，狭隘之处不逾十里」，川中有大龙池，「东西三百余里，南北五十余里，据大葱岭内，当赡部洲中，其地最高」；一路积雪弥漫，途路难涉。 East of Kunduz Xuanzang crossed the Pamirs into the high valleys. The Records describes a corridor a thousand li long and a great dragon lake three hundred li across, the highest ground in Jambudvipa, with snow lying on the passes.

place.zh: 朅盘陀（今新疆塔什库尔干）

summary.zh: 玄奘越葱岭、波谜罗川，抵朅盘陀。
summary.en: Xuanzang crosses the Pamirs and reaches Tashkurgan.

fields.name: 朅盘陀 Kashgar’s Pamir state 塔什库尔干 Tashkurgan 公主堡
fields.place: 朅盘陀（今新疆塔什库尔干） Tashkurgan (Xinjiang)
fields.summary: 玄奘越葱岭、波谜罗川，抵朅盘陀。 Xuanzang crosses the Pamirs and reaches Tashkurgan.
fields.description: 玄奘自活国东行，越葱岭、经波谜罗川，抵朅盘陀。《大唐西域记》记其「国大都城依峻岭」，并载建国传说：汉公主远嫁波利剌斯，途遇兵乱，避于孤峰，与日神感而生子，遂王此地，故国王自称「汉日天种」。 Traveling east from Kunduz, Xuanzang crossed the Pamirs and the Wakhan valley to Tashkurgan. The Records of the Western Regions describes its capital perched on a steep ridge and records the founding legend of a Chinese princess who took refuge on the peak and bore a son of the sun, from whom its kings claimed descent.

summary.zh: 玄奘出葱岭抵佉沙，沿塔里木盆地南缘东行。
summary.en: Xuanzang comes down from the Pamirs to Kashgar and turns east along the southern Tarim.

fields.name: 佉沙（疏勒） Kashgar 疏勒 喀什 Kashgar 喀什噶尔
fields.summary: 玄奘出葱岭抵佉沙，沿塔里木盆地南缘东行。 Xuanzang comes down from the Pamirs to Kashgar and turns east along the southern Tarim.
fields.description: 出葱岭后，玄奘抵佉沙。《大唐西域记》记此地「人性犷暴，俗多诡诈，不甚崇信佛法」，与于阗的崇佛形成对照。此后沿塔里木盆地南缘，经斫句迦至于阗。 Descending from the Pamirs, Xuanzang reached Kashgar, which the Records describes as a fierce and little-Buddhist land, in contrast with devout Khotan. From there he followed the southern edge of the Tarim basin eastward.

summary.zh: 玄奘经斫句迦东行，记其山阜连属、佛塔众多。
summary.en: Xuanzang passes Chakuka, a stony land of many stupas, on the way to Khotan.

fields.name: 斫句迦 Chakuka 叶城 Yecheng 朱俱波
fields.place: 斫句迦（今新疆叶城） Chakuka (Yecheng, Xinjiang)
fields.summary: 玄奘经斫句迦东行，记其山阜连属、佛塔众多。 Xuanzang passes Chakuka, a stony land of many stupas, on the way to Khotan.
fields.description: 出疏勒东南行，玄奘经斫句迦。《西域记》卷十二记其「周千余里，国大都城周十余里，山阜连属，砾石弥漫」，国中有罗汉塔与数百僧徒，是塔里木盆地南缘的小国。此后沿山麓东行，抵于阗。 Southeast of Kashgar Xuanzang passed through Chakuka, which the Records describes as a thousand li around, its capital a dozen li, a land of connected hills and gravel plains with stupas of arhats and several hundred monks.

summary.zh: 玄奘抵于阗，上表太宗，等待归国敕命。
summary.en: Xuanzang reaches Khotan and waits for the emperor’s permission to return.

fields.name: 于阗 Khotan 瞿萨旦那 Khotan
fields.summary: 玄奘抵于阗，上表太宗，等待归国敕命。 Xuanzang reaches Khotan and waits for the emperor’s permission to return.
fields.description: 644 年春，玄奘沿塔里木盆地南缘抵于阗。因前路须待朝廷准许，他在此停留数月，上表报告携经归国，并应于阗王请求讲《瑜伽师地论》。 In the spring of 644 Xuanzang reached Khotan along the southern Tarim route. He stayed several months while awaiting the court’s permission, sending a memorial and teaching the Yogacarabhumi at the king’s request.

fields.place: 于阗（今新疆和田） Khotan (Hotan, Xinjiang)
fields.summary: 太宗得于阗上表，敕令沿途迎送，并请玄奘速来相见。 Taizong answers Xuanzang’s memorial from Khotan and orders an escort along the road.
fields.description: 玄奘在于阗上表后，太宗答敕曰「闻师访道殊域，今得归还，欢喜无量，可即速来，与朕相见」，并令于阗等道诸国护送，沿途供给人力鞍乘。玄奘遂整装东行。 Replying to Xuanzang’s memorial from Khotan, Emperor Taizong wrote that he rejoiced at the monk’s return and bade him come quickly to court, ordering the states along the road to escort him and supply horses and bearers.

fields.summary: 玄奘经尼壤，过大泽中的古精绝故地。 Xuanzang passes Niya, a small city in a great marsh on the southern Tarim road.
fields.description: 出于阗东行，玄奘经媲摩，抵尼壤。《西域记》卷十二记「尼壤城周三四里，在大泽中」，泽地湿热难行，是塔里木南道上的要站；再东即折摩驮那故国（且末）、纳缚波故国（若羌）。 East of Khotan Xuanzang passed Pimo and reached Niya, which the Records describes as a city three or four li around set in a great marsh, a staging point on the southern Tarim road toward Charchlik and Dunhuang.

fields.description: 644 年秋，玄奘自于阗东行，沿塔里木盆地南缘经若羌抵达沙州。他在此再次上表，报告携经归国。太宗得表后敕令敦煌官吏于流沙迎接，并命沿途州县供给。 In autumn 644 Xuanzang came east from Khotan along the southern Tarim route to Shazhou, where he sent another memorial announcing his return with the scriptures. Taizong ordered officials to meet him at the edge of the desert and supply him along the road.

fields.summary: 宝船六十二艘、将士二万七千八百余人，另有马船、粮船、水船、战船。 Sixty-two treasure ships and 27,800 men, plus horse transports, grain ships, water ships and warships.
fields.description: 《明史·郑和传》记「造大舶，修四十四丈、广十八丈者六十二」，将士二万七千八百余人。船队按职能分宝船、马船、粮船、水船、战船，另有通事、火长、医官与匠人。宝船尺度的折算历来有争议，此处按《明史》记录并注明「一说」。 The History of Ming records 62 great ships of 44 zhang by 18 zhang and 27,800 men. The fleet was organised by function into treasure ships, horse transports, grain ships, water ships and warships, with interpreters, navigators, physicians and craftsmen. The metric conversion of the treasure-ship dimensions is disputed; the History of Ming figures are given here with that caveat.

fields.description: 船队携带大量锦绮、绫罗、瓷器、铁器、铜钱，以及雨伞、烧珠、木梳等日用品，既用于赏赐各国君主，也用于民间互市。回程则载香料、宝石与珍禽异兽。 The fleet carried bolts of brocade and gauze, porcelain, ironware and copper cash, along with umbrellas, glass beads and combs — for gifts to rulers and for market exchange alike. The return cargo was spices, gems and exotic animals.

fields.place: 长江口外（今东海） Off the Yangtze estuary
fields.summary: 船队以水罗盘定针路，昼夜兼行。 The fleet steered by water compass along recorded compass courses.
fields.description: 明代航海以水罗盘（指南浮针）配合「针路」簿，记录各港口之间的罗经方位与更数（航程单位）。《郑和航海图》即以此体系绘成，是船队能够在无地标的远洋保持航向的基础。 Ming navigation used a floating-needle compass together with written sailing directions recording the bearing and the number of watches between ports. The Zheng He Nautical Chart was drawn in exactly this system, and it is what allowed the fleet to hold a course out of sight of land.

summary.en: The fleet carried great quantities of Yongle cash, which circulated across Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean.

fields.name: 永乐通宝与铜钱外流 Yongle coinage abroad 永乐通宝 Yongle tongbao
fields.summary: 船队携带大量永乐通宝，铜钱随之流入东南亚与印度洋。 The fleet carried great quantities of Yongle cash, which circulated across Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean.
fields.description: 永乐通宝随船队流入占城、爪哇、满剌加、旧港等地，日本、越南与东非沿岸均有出土。铜钱外流既便利了互市，也造成国内钱荒之议。 Yongle tongbao coins travelled with the fleet to Champa, Java, Malacca and Palembang, and have been excavated in Japan, Vietnam and along the East African coast. The outflow eased market exchange but prompted concern about a domestic coin shortage.

name.en: Waiting for the monsoon at Changle

summary.zh: 船队自刘家港南下，泊福建长乐太平港修船候风，随后从五虎门出洋。
summary.en: The fleet sails south from Liujiagang and anchors at Taiping Port in Changle to refit and wait for the north-east monsoon, then puts out through the Wuhu Gate.

fields.name: 长乐太平港候风 Waiting for the monsoon at Changle 太平港 Taiping Harbour 长乐 Changle
fields.place: 福建长乐太平港 Taiping Port, Changle, Fujian
fields.summary: 船队自刘家港南下，泊福建长乐太平港修船候风，随后从五虎门出洋。 The fleet sails south from Liujiagang and anchors at Taiping Port in Changle to refit and wait for the north-east monsoon, then puts out through the Wuhu Gate.
fields.description: 郑和船队沿海南下，在长乐太平港驻泊数月，修补船具、补充给养，等待冬季东北季风。此后船队自闽江口五虎门扬帆，经台湾海峡南下。 The fleet moved down the coast and lay at Taiping Port for several months, repairing gear and taking on supplies while waiting for the winter north-east monsoon. It then sailed out through the Wuhu Gate at the mouth of the Min River and headed south through the Taiwan Strait.

fields.summary: 横渡印度洋时以「牵星板」观测北极星高度定纬度。 On the Indian Ocean crossing the fleet measured the altitude of Polaris with star boards to fix latitude.
fields.description: 「过洋牵星」用十二块牵星板测星体出水高度，换算出南北位置，与罗盘针路互补。《郑和航海图》在孟加拉湾与阿拉伯海航段逐段标注「指某星若干指」，即牵星数据。 The technique used a set of twelve star boards to measure the altitude of a star above the horizon and convert it into a north–south position, complementing the compass course. The Nautical Chart annotates the Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea legs with star altitudes.

fields.description: 满剌加扼守马六甲海峡，愿依附明朝以抗暹罗。郑和奉敕册封其酋长拜里米苏剌为国王，赐银印、冠带、袍服与锦绮；满剌加自此成为船队在西洋最重要的中转基地。 Malacca controlled the Strait of Malacca and sought Ming protection against Siam. Zheng He invested its chief Parameswara as king, granting a silver seal, robes, belt and brocade; Malacca became the fleet’s most important base in the western ocean.

fields.description: 旧港为三佛齐故地，广东人陈祖义聚众海上，劫掠往来番商。郑和先礼后兵，遣使招谕；陈祖义诈降，暗中筹备袭击船队，为次年的旧港之战埋下伏笔。 Palembang, the old centre of Srivijaya, was held by the Guangdong-born pirate Chen Zuyi, who preyed on passing traders. Zheng He opened with diplomacy and sent envoys to summon him; Chen feigned surrender while preparing an ambush, setting the stage for the battle of 1407.

fields.summary: 爪哇东西二王交战，西王军队误杀登岸贸易的明军一百七十人，西王遣使谢罪献金。 Civil war in Java leads the western king’s troops to kill 170 Ming soldiers who had come ashore to trade; the king sends envoys to apologize and offer gold.
fields.description: 船队在爪哇登岸贸易时，恰逢满者伯夷东西二王内战，西王军队误杀明朝官军一百七十人。西王畏惧明廷问罪，遣使谢罪并献黄金赎罪；郑和以通商大局为重，未加报复。 While the fleet was trading ashore in Java, the civil war between the eastern and western kings of Majapahit led the western king’s troops to kill 170 Ming soldiers by mistake. Fearing retribution, the king sent envoys to apologize and offered gold; Zheng He put the wider interests of trade first and did not retaliate.

summary.zh: 船队在古里开市，以瓷器、丝绸、铜钱交易胡椒、宝石与珍珠。
summary.en: The fleet opens a market at Calicut, trading porcelain, silk and copper cash for pepper, gems and pearls.

fields.name: 古里开市 Opening the market at Calicut 科泽科德 Kozhikode 卡利卡特 Calicut
fields.place: 古里（今印度科泽科德） Calicut (India)
fields.summary: 船队在古里开市，以瓷器、丝绸、铜钱交易胡椒、宝石与珍珠。 The fleet opens a market at Calicut, trading porcelain, silk and copper cash for pepper, gems and pearls.
fields.description: 古里是西洋诸国商船汇聚的贸易总汇，西番马匹、东国布匹与各国珊瑚珍珠都在此集散。船队在此开市，用中国瓷器、丝织品与铜钱换取胡椒、宝石、珍珠和乳香，并补给返航物资。 Calicut was the great emporium of the western ocean, where horses from the west, cloth from the east, and coral and pearls from many lands all changed hands. The fleet opened a market there, exchanging Chinese porcelain, silk and copper cash for pepper, gems, pearls and frankincense, and took on supplies for the return.

fields.description: 1407 年，郑和船队在旧港击败陈祖义为首的海盗势力，维护了马六甲海峡的航行安全。 In 1407, Zheng He’s fleet defeated the pirate forces led by Chen Zuyi at Palembang, helping secure navigation through the Strait of Malacca.
