name.en: Hou Xian’s overland mission to Ü-Tsang

summary.zh: 侯显由陆路出使乌思藏，与郑和的海路互为表里。
summary.en: Hou Xian travelled overland to Ü-Tsang, complementing Zheng He’s maritime missions.

fields.name: 侯显陆路使乌思藏 Hou Xian’s overland mission to Ü-Tsang
fields.summary: 侯显由陆路出使乌思藏，与郑和的海路互为表里。 Hou Xian travelled overland to Ü-Tsang, complementing Zheng He’s maritime missions.
fields.description: 侯显为宦官，永乐初奉命入藏迎请哈立麻（得银协巴），此后多次经陆路往返乌思藏与尼泊尔，是明代经略藏区的主要使者之一。海路与陆路并进，构成永乐朝对外经营的两翼。 Hou Xian, a eunuch, was sent to Tibet in the early Yongle reign to invite Halima (Deshin Shekpa), and afterwards travelled repeatedly overland to Ü-Tsang and Nepal. The maritime and overland missions together formed the two arms of Yongle’s foreign policy.

summary.en: Before carrying foreign envoys home, the fleet assembles at Taiping Port to refit and wait for the monsoon.

fields.summary: 船队护送各国使臣返国前，先在长乐太平港集结修船，候季风出洋。 Before carrying foreign envoys home, the fleet assembles at Taiping Port to refit and wait for the monsoon.
fields.description: 第二次下西洋以送还各国使臣为主。船队自太仓南下，在长乐太平港驻泊，检修船只、补充给养，待东北季风稳定后出五虎门。 The second voyage was chiefly a mission to carry foreign envoys home. The fleet sailed south from Taicang, lay at Taiping Port to overhaul ships and take on supplies, and left through the Wuhu Gate once the north-east monsoon settled.

fields.description: 占城是船队南下的第一处大港。郑和在此送还随船归国的占城使者，宣读敕谕、颁赐冠带与彩币，随后继续南行。 Champa was the first great port on the southward run. Zheng He returned the Champa envoys who had travelled with the fleet, read the imperial edict and bestowed robes and brocade, then sailed on.

fields.summary: 郑和专程出使暹罗，劝谕其停止侵扰满剌加、归还所夺印诰，暹罗王遣使贡方物谢罪。 Zheng He goes to Siam to urge it to stop harassing Malacca and return the seized seals; the Siamese king sends tribute and apologizes.
fields.description: 暹罗拘扣占城朝贡使者，又夺取明朝赐给苏门答剌、满剌加的印诰。郑和奉命率使团入暹罗交涉，劝谕睦邻；暹罗王随后遣使贡方物谢罪。 Siam had detained Champa’s tribute envoys and seized the seals the Ming court had granted to Samudera and Malacca. Zheng He led a mission into Siam to remonstrate and urge good-neighbourly conduct; the Siamese king afterwards sent envoys with tribute and an apology.

fields.description: 满剌加此时仍受暹罗侵扰。船队在此停泊补给，重申明朝对满剌加的册封，作为前往印度洋前的最后一处大港。 Malacca was still under pressure from Siam. The fleet stopped to resupply and reaffirmed Ming enfeoffment, treating the port as its last great base before the Indian Ocean.

name.en: Waiting for the monsoon at Samudera

place.zh: 苏门答剌（今印尼苏门答腊）

summary.zh: 船队经苏门答剌、南巫里，进入印度洋。
summary.en: The fleet passes Samudera and Lamuri and enters the Indian Ocean.

fields.name: 苏门答剌候风 Waiting for the monsoon at Samudera 须文答剌 Samudera 巴赛 Pasai
fields.place: 苏门答剌（今印尼苏门答腊） Samudera (Sumatra, Indonesia)
fields.summary: 船队经苏门答剌、南巫里，进入印度洋。 The fleet passes Samudera and Lamuri and enters the Indian Ocean.
fields.description: 苏门答剌与南巫里扼守马六甲海峡西口，是船队出印度洋前的候风与补给点。船队在此补充淡水，等待西行季风。 Samudera and Lamuri guarded the western mouth of the Strait of Malacca and served as the fleet’s last watering and provisioning stop before the Indian Ocean. There the ships waited for the westward monsoon.
fields.entities: 第二次下西洋 Second Voyage

summary.zh: 郑和在锡兰山布施佛寺，立中文、泰米尔文、波斯文三体碑，此碑今存科伦坡博物馆。
summary.en: Zheng He makes offerings at a Ceylonese temple and sets up a trilingual stele in Chinese, Tamil and Persian, now in the Colombo Museum.

fields.place: 锡兰山（今斯里兰卡） Ceylon (Sri Lanka)
fields.summary: 郑和在锡兰山布施佛寺，立中文、泰米尔文、波斯文三体碑，此碑今存科伦坡博物馆。 Zheng He makes offerings at a Ceylonese temple and sets up a trilingual stele in Chinese, Tamil and Persian, now in the Colombo Museum.
fields.description: 船队向锡兰山佛寺布施金银、丝绢、香油、蜡烛与金莲花等物，并立《布施锡兰山佛寺碑》，以中文、泰米尔文、波斯文分别向佛、印度教神祇与伊斯兰教真主献礼，体现对当地信仰的尊重。 The fleet gave gold, silver, silk, fragrant oil, candles and golden lotuses to a temple in Ceylon and set up the Galle Trilingual Inscription, written in Chinese, Tamil and Persian and dedicating offerings to the Buddha, to Hindu deities and to Allah—a mark of respect for local faiths.

fields.description: 加异勒位于印度半岛东南端，是胡椒与棉布的重要集散地。船队在此交易，并补充前往马拉巴尔海岸的补给。 Kayal, at the south-eastern tip of the Indian peninsula, was an important market for pepper and cotton cloth. The fleet traded there and took on supplies for the Malabar coast.

fields.description: 古里是西洋贸易总汇。船队在此完成本轮贸易，采办胡椒、宝石与乳香，随后转舵返航，经锡兰山、满剌加北归。 Calicut was the great emporium of the western ocean. The fleet completed its trade there, took on pepper, gems and frankincense, then turned back through Ceylon and Malacca.

fields.description: 第三次下西洋出航前，船队在长乐太平港停泊近两月，修船、补给、候风；十二月东北季风起，自五虎门出洋南下。 Before the third voyage the fleet lay at Taiping Port for nearly two months, repairing ships, provisioning and waiting for the monsoon; when the north-east wind rose in the twelfth month it sailed out through the Wuhu Gate.

place.zh: 满剌加（今马来西亚马六甲）

summary.zh: 郑和在满剌加设立官厂，立排栅城垣、四门更鼓楼，内建库藏仓廒，作为物资转运与候风基地。
summary.en: Zheng He establishes a walled depot at Malacca with gate towers, storehouses and granaries, serving as a transshipment and monsoon base.

fields.place: 满剌加（今马来西亚马六甲） Malacca (Melaka, Malaysia)
fields.summary: 郑和在满剌加设立官厂，立排栅城垣、四门更鼓楼，内建库藏仓廒，作为物资转运与候风基地。 Zheng He establishes a walled depot at Malacca with gate towers, storehouses and granaries, serving as a transshipment and monsoon base.
fields.description: 据《瀛涯胜览》，满剌加官厂“立排栅、城垣，设四门更鼓楼，夜则提铃巡警。内又立重栅小城，盖造库藏仓廒”。返航船只在此驻泊，钱粮货物存入库中，各船分䑸前往诸番贸易。 According to Ma Huan, the Malacca depot had palisades and walls, drum towers over four gates with night patrols, and an inner stockaded compound with storehouses and granaries. Returning ships anchored offshore, goods and provisions were kept in the depot, and the fleet split into squadrons for trade in different countries.

summary.en: The king of Ceylon, Alakeshvara, refuses due respect and plots against the fleet; Zheng He sees through it and sails away.

fields.name: 初至锡兰山 First call at Ceylon 锡兰 Ceylon 斯里兰卡 Sri Lanka
fields.place: 锡兰山（今斯里兰卡） Ceylon (Sri Lanka)
fields.summary: 锡兰山国王亚烈苦奈儿“负固不恭，谋害舟师”，郑和察觉后率队离开。 The king of Ceylon, Alakeshvara, refuses due respect and plots against the fleet; Zheng He sees through it and sails away.
fields.description: 船队初至锡兰山，亚烈苦奈儿索取财物并暗图袭击。郑和察觉其意图，未作纠缠，率船队转往他国，为回程的锡兰山之战埋下伏笔。 On its first call at Ceylon the fleet found King Alakeshvara demanding treasure and secretly planning an attack. Zheng He saw the trap, avoided a confrontation and took the fleet on to other ports—setting up the battle on the return leg.

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

summary.zh: 回程再至锡兰山，亚烈苦奈儿诱郑和入国并发兵五万围攻船队；郑和率两千人夜袭王城，生擒亚烈苦奈儿及其家属。
summary.en: On the return leg Alakeshvara lures Zheng He inland and sends 50,000 men against the fleet; Zheng He storms the capital by night with 2,000 men and captures the king and his family.

fields.name: 锡兰山之战 Battle of Ceylon 锡兰 Ceylon 斯里兰卡 Sri Lanka
fields.place: 锡兰山（今斯里兰卡） Ceylon (Sri Lanka)
fields.summary: 回程再至锡兰山，亚烈苦奈儿诱郑和入国并发兵五万围攻船队；郑和率两千人夜袭王城，生擒亚烈苦奈儿及其家属。 On the return leg Alakeshvara lures Zheng He inland and sends 50,000 men against the fleet; Zheng He storms the capital by night with 2,000 men and captures the king and his family.
fields.description: 郑和回程再访锡兰山，亚烈苦奈儿诱其入国、索要财物，被拒后发兵五万围攻船队，并伐木阻断归路。郑和趁其国中空虚，率随从两千人取小道夜袭王城，破城擒王。永乐九年六月船队还朝，献俘于朝。 On the return the fleet called at Ceylon again. Alakeshvara lured Zheng He inland and demanded treasure; when refused he sent 50,000 men to surround the fleet and felled trees to cut off its retreat. With the capital stripped of defenders, Zheng He led 2,000 men by a side path in a night assault, took the city and captured the king and his household. The fleet returned to court in the sixth month of 1411 with the captives.
fields.entities: 第三次下西洋 Third Voyage

summary.zh: 郑和还朝，献俘亚烈苦奈儿；成祖赦其罪，诏令锡兰山另择贤者为王。
summary.en: Zheng He presents the captured king at court; the Yongle Emperor pardons him and orders Ceylon to choose a worthy ruler.

fields.name: 献俘亚烈苦奈儿 Captives presented at Nanjing 应天 Yingtian 京师 Capital
fields.summary: 郑和还朝，献俘亚烈苦奈儿；成祖赦其罪，诏令锡兰山另择贤者为王。 Zheng He presents the captured king at court; the Yongle Emperor pardons him and orders Ceylon to choose a worthy ruler.
fields.description: 永乐九年六月，船队返抵南京，献所俘锡兰山国王亚烈苦奈儿及家属。朝臣多主张处死，成祖以其愚昧无知，赦免释放，并遣使诏令锡兰山另立贤君。此役后“海外诸番，益服天子威德”。 In the sixth month of 1411 the fleet returned to Nanjing and presented Alakeshvara and his family. Many at court urged execution, but the Yongle Emperor pardoned him as ignorant and had him released, sending envoys to install a worthy ruler in Ceylon. Afterwards, it was said, the overseas states stood in greater awe of the Ming court’s virtue.

fields.name: 马欢随行记注 Ma Huan joins as interpreter
fields.summary: 马欢以通事身份随第四次下西洋，记录沿途风土，后成《瀛涯胜览》。 Ma Huan sailed on the fourth voyage as interpreter and later compiled the Yingya Shenglan.
fields.description: 马欢，会稽人，通阿拉伯语，先后四次随郑和出使。所撰《瀛涯胜览》记二十国山川、人物、物产、风俗，是研究下西洋最直接的一手文献之一。 Ma Huan of Kuaiji spoke Arabic and sailed on four of the voyages. His Yingya Shenglan describes the geography, people, products and customs of some twenty countries and remains one of the most direct primary sources for the voyages.

fields.name: 苏麻离青入华 Smalt cobalt reaches China 苏泥勃青 Sumali cobalt
fields.summary: 自波斯一带输入的钴料「苏麻离青」，成就永乐、宣德青花。 Cobalt pigment imported from Persia made the Yongle and Xuande blue-and-white wares possible.
fields.description: 永乐、宣德青花所用钴料多来自波斯（今伊朗）一带，称「苏麻离青」或「苏泥勃青」，发色浓艳并带铁锈斑。下西洋保障了此料的稳定输入，也带回了器型与纹样的新样稿。 The cobalt used in Yongle and Xuande blue-and-white came largely from Persia, known as sumali qing; it fires to a deep, brilliant blue with iron-rust speckles. The voyages secured a steady supply and brought new shapes and motifs as well.

summary.en: On the return leg the usurper Sekandar attacks the fleet at Samudera; Zheng He joins forces with the local army, defeats him and captures him at Lamuri.

fields.summary: 归国途中再至苏门答剌，伪王弟苏干剌率众截杀官军；郑和与当地军队合击，追至南巫里生擒苏干剌。 On the return leg the usurper Sekandar attacks the fleet at Samudera; Zheng He joins forces with the local army, defeats him and captures him at Lamuri.
fields.description: 苏干剌弑君自立，因明朝不赏而怀怨。船队归国途中再至苏门答剌，苏干剌领兵数万邀击官军。郑和率明军与苏门答剌军队合战，苏干剌败走，追至南巫里将其生擒。 Sekandar had seized the throne and nursed a grievance at being denied Ming recognition. When the fleet called at Samudera on its way home he attacked with tens of thousands of men. Zheng He fought alongside the legitimate king’s troops, routed him and pursued him to Lamuri, where he was taken prisoner.

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

summary.zh: 船队护送十九国使臣归国，在长乐太平港集结候风。
summary.en: The fleet, carrying envoys of nineteen states home, assembles at Taiping Port to wait for the monsoon.

fields.place: 福建长乐太平港 Taiping Port, Changle, Fujian
fields.summary: 船队护送十九国使臣归国，在长乐太平港集结候风。 The fleet, carrying envoys of nineteen states home, assembles at Taiping Port to wait for the monsoon.
fields.description: 第五次下西洋以送还忽鲁谟斯、古里、满剌加等十九国使臣为主。船队在长乐太平港修船补给，待季风出洋。 The fifth voyage was chiefly to return envoys from Hormuz, Calicut, Malacca and sixteen other states. The fleet refitted and provisioned at Taiping Port before sailing on the monsoon.

summary.en: The fleet reaches Champa, returns its envoys and bestows gifts on the king.

fields.description: 占城是船队南下的第一站。郑和在此送还占城使臣，颁赐锦绮，并补充淡水与食物。 Champa was the first stop on the southward run. Zheng He returned its envoys, distributed brocade and took on water and food.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

place.zh: 满剌加（今马来西亚马六甲）

summary.zh: 船队在满剌加驻泊，转运颁赐诸国的锦绮纱罗，并按目的地分䑸。
summary.en: The fleet anchors at Malacca, transfers the silk and brocade destined for many states, and divides into squadrons by destination.

fields.name: 满剌加分䑸 Squadrons split at Malacca 马六甲 Malacca 满剌加 Melaka
fields.place: 满剌加（今马来西亚马六甲） Malacca (Melaka, Malaysia)
fields.summary: 船队在满剌加驻泊，转运颁赐诸国的锦绮纱罗，并按目的地分䑸。 The fleet anchors at Malacca, transfers the silk and brocade destined for many states, and divides into squadrons by destination.
fields.description: 满剌加官厂是船队的物资中转站。船队在此卸下颁赐诸国的锦绮纱罗，分拨各船，随后按目的地分䑸西行。 The Malacca depot was the fleet’s transshipment centre. There the ships unloaded the silk and brocade intended for the various states, redistributed the cargo, and split into squadrons for their different destinations.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

summary.zh: 船队经苏门答剌、南巫里进入印度洋。
summary.en: The fleet passes Samudera and Lamuri into the Indian Ocean.

fields.summary: 船队经苏门答剌、南巫里进入印度洋。 The fleet passes Samudera and Lamuri into the Indian Ocean.
fields.description: 船队在苏门答剌补充给养，随后经南巫里西行，横渡印度洋。 The fleet took on supplies at Samudera, then sailed west by Lamuri to cross the Indian Ocean.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

summary.zh: 船队泊锡兰山，分遣船队经溜山驶往东非、经古里驶向阿拉伯半岛。
summary.en: The fleet anchors at Ceylon and sends detachments via the Maldives to East Africa and via Calicut to Arabia.

fields.name: 锡兰山分遣 Detachments sent from Ceylon 锡兰 Ceylon 斯里兰卡 Sri Lanka
fields.place: 锡兰山（今斯里兰卡） Ceylon (Sri Lanka)
fields.summary: 船队泊锡兰山，分遣船队经溜山驶往东非、经古里驶向阿拉伯半岛。 The fleet anchors at Ceylon and sends detachments via the Maldives to East Africa and via Calicut to Arabia.
fields.description: 据记载，第五次下西洋在锡兰山分遣船队：一经溜山驶往东非木骨都束、卜剌哇、麻林地，一经古里驶向阿拉伯半岛与忽鲁谟斯。 Records indicate that the fifth voyage divided its forces at Ceylon: one detachment sailed via the Maldives to Mogadishu, Brava and Malindi in East Africa, another via Calicut towards Arabia and Hormuz.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

summary.zh: 郑和奉敕诏赐柯枝国王印诰，封其国中大山为镇国山，并立碑铭。
summary.en: By imperial order Zheng He invests the king of Cochin with seals and patents, names the country’s great mountain “Guardian Mountain” and sets up a stele.

fields.name: 册封柯枝国王 Investing the king of Cochin 科钦 Cochin Kochi Kochi
fields.summary: 郑和奉敕诏赐柯枝国王印诰，封其国中大山为镇国山，并立碑铭。 By imperial order Zheng He invests the king of Cochin with seals and patents, names the country’s great mountain “Guardian Mountain” and sets up a stele.
fields.description: 柯枝早与明朝通好，曾请明廷为其勒石封山。郑和此次携成祖御制碑文，诏赐国王印诰，封国中大山为“镇国山”，勒石立碑。 Cochin had long been on good terms with the Ming and had asked the court to inscribe its mountain. Zheng He brought an imperially composed text, invested the king with seals and patents, named the great mountain “Guardian of the Realm” and had the inscription carved in stone.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

summary.zh: 船队抵古里，交易胡椒、宝石，补充远航物资。
summary.en: The fleet reaches Calicut to trade pepper and gems and replenish stores.

fields.name: 古里交易 Trading at Calicut 科泽科德 Kozhikode 卡利卡特 Calicut
fields.place: 古里（今印度科泽科德） Calicut (India)
fields.summary: 船队抵古里，交易胡椒、宝石，补充远航物资。 The fleet reaches Calicut to trade pepper and gems and replenish stores.
fields.description: 古里是西洋贸易总汇。船队在此交易胡椒、宝石与乳香，并补充前往波斯湾与阿拉伯半岛的物资。 Calicut was the great emporium of the western ocean. The fleet traded for pepper, gems and frankincense and provisioned for the run to the Persian Gulf and Arabia.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

place.zh: 忽鲁谟斯（今伊朗霍尔木兹）

summary.zh: 船队抵忽鲁谟斯，颁赐国王与后妃大臣，采购宝石、香料与马匹。
summary.en: The fleet reaches Hormuz, bestows gifts on the king, court and ministers, and buys gems, spices and horses.

fields.name: 忽鲁谟斯颁赐 Gifts at Hormuz 霍尔木兹 Hormuz 忽鲁谟斯 Ormus
fields.place: 忽鲁谟斯（今伊朗霍尔木兹） Hormuz (Iran)
fields.summary: 船队抵忽鲁谟斯，颁赐国王与后妃大臣，采购宝石、香料与马匹。 The fleet reaches Hormuz, bestows gifts on the king, court and ministers, and buys gems, spices and horses.
fields.description: 忽鲁谟斯是波斯湾口的贸易枢纽，各国商货云集。郑和在此颁赐锦绮彩帛，并采购宝石、珍珠、香料与良马。 Hormuz was the trading hub at the mouth of the Persian Gulf, where goods from many lands converged. Zheng He distributed silk and brocade and purchased gems, pearls, spices and fine horses.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

summary.zh: 船队访问阿丹，沟通红海与印度洋贸易。
summary.en: The fleet visits Aden, connecting Red Sea and Indian Ocean trade.

fields.name: 访问阿丹 Visit to Aden 亚丁 Aden
fields.summary: 船队访问阿丹，沟通红海与印度洋贸易。 The fleet visits Aden, connecting Red Sea and Indian Ocean trade.
fields.description: 阿丹扼守红海海口，是东西方商货的转运中心。船队在此交易宝石、珍珠、珊瑚与香料，并送还随船归国的阿丹使臣。 Aden guarded the mouth of the Red Sea and was a transshipment centre for goods between east and west. The fleet traded for gems, pearls, coral and spices and returned the Aden envoys.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

summary.zh: 船队抵木骨都束，国王率百官迎候，赠狮子、花福鹿。
summary.en: The fleet reaches Mogadishu, where the king and his officials welcome it and present lions and spotted deer.

fields.name: 木骨都束朝贡 Tribute at Mogadishu 摩加迪沙 Mogadishu
fields.place: 木骨都束（今索马里摩加迪沙） Mogadishu (Somalia)
fields.summary: 船队抵木骨都束，国王率百官迎候，赠狮子、花福鹿。 The fleet reaches Mogadishu, where the king and his officials welcome it and present lions and spotted deer.
fields.description: 木骨都束位于东非索马里海岸。国王率文武百官迎候，船队以瓷器、丝绸回赠，并获狮子、花福鹿等方物。 Mogadishu lies on the Somali coast of East Africa. The king and his officials came out to welcome the fleet, which gave porcelain and silk in return and received lions, spotted deer and other local products.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

place.zh: 卜剌哇（今索马里布拉瓦）

summary.zh: 船队抵卜剌哇，获赠千里骆驼与鸵鸡。
summary.en: The fleet reaches Brava and receives long-distance camels and ostriches.

fields.summary: 船队抵卜剌哇，获赠千里骆驼与鸵鸡。 The fleet reaches Brava and receives long-distance camels and ostriches.
fields.description: 卜剌哇与木骨都束相邻，以畜牧与贸易为生。船队在此交易，获赠千里骆驼、鸵鸡等方物。 Brava, neighbouring Mogadishu, lived by herding and trade. The fleet traded there and received camels, ostriches and other local products.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

place.zh: 麻林地（今肯尼亚马林迪）

summary.zh: 船队南抵麻林地，这是郑和船队到达的最南端之一。
summary.en: The fleet sails south to Malindi, one of the southernmost points it reached.

fields.name: 南至麻林地 South to Malindi 马林迪 Malindi
fields.place: 麻林地（今肯尼亚马林迪） Malindi (Kenya)
fields.summary: 船队南抵麻林地，这是郑和船队到达的最南端之一。 The fleet sails south to Malindi, one of the southernmost points it reached.
fields.description: 麻林地（今肯尼亚马林迪）位于赤道以南，是船队东非航线的南端。船队在此交易象牙、香料，并收集当地物产与见闻。 Malindi, in present-day Kenya, lies south of the equator and marked the southern end of the East African run. The fleet traded for ivory and spices and gathered local products and information.
fields.entities: 第五次下西洋 Fifth Voyage

summary.en: The fleet returns with envoys from Hormuz, Aden, Mogadishu and others bringing lions, qilin and long-horned horses.

fields.name: 诸国贡麒麟 Qilin and other tribute at court 顺天府 Shuntian 京师 Capital
fields.summary: 船队还朝，忽鲁谟斯、阿丹、木骨都束等国随船入贡狮子、麒麟、长角马等。 The fleet returns with envoys from Hormuz, Aden, Mogadishu and others bringing lions, qilin and long-horned horses.
fields.description: 永乐十七年，船队返回，忽鲁谟斯进狮子、金钱豹、西马，阿丹进麒麟，祖法儿进长角马，木骨都束进花福鹿与狮子，卜剌哇进千里骆驼与鸵鸡。成祖下诏按等级赏赐下西洋将士。 In 1419 the fleet returned: Hormuz sent lions, leopards and western horses, Aden a qilin, Dhofar long-horned horses, Mogadishu spotted deer and lions, and Brava camels and ostriches. The Yongle Emperor ordered rewards for the officers and men according to rank.

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

name.en: Envoys of sixteen states sail home

summary.zh: 第六次下西洋送十六国使臣还国，船队兼具外交与护送职能。
summary.en: The sixth voyage carried home the envoys of sixteen states — diplomacy and escort in one.

fields.name: 十六国使臣随船还国 Envoys of sixteen states sail home
fields.summary: 第六次下西洋送十六国使臣还国，船队兼具外交与护送职能。 The sixth voyage carried home the envoys of sixteen states — diplomacy and escort in one.
fields.description: 永乐十九年（1421）正月，十六国使臣随船归国。下西洋不仅是宣示与贸易，也是朝贡体系下的「送使」与「迎使」；船队因此常兼有外交使团与护航舰队的双重身份。 In the first month of 1421 the envoys of sixteen states sailed home with the fleet. The voyages were as much about escorting envoys within the tribute system as about display and trade, so the fleet doubled as embassy and convoy.

summary.en: To catch the north-east monsoon the fleet hurries south, stopping only briefly at Taiping Port before putting to sea.

fields.summary: 为赶东北季风，船队迅速南下，在长乐太平港短暂停泊后出洋。 To catch the north-east monsoon the fleet hurries south, stopping only briefly at Taiping Port before putting to sea.
fields.description: 永乐十九年正月，成祖命郑和送十六国使臣归国。船队为赶季风，自太仓迅速南下，在长乐太平港补充给养后即出五虎门。 In the first month of 1421 the Yongle Emperor ordered Zheng He to carry envoys of sixteen states home. Racing the monsoon, the fleet hurried south from Taicang, took on supplies at Taiping Port and immediately left through the Wuhu Gate.

fields.summary: 榜葛剌遣使献「麒麟」（长颈鹿），举朝以为祥瑞。 Bengal sent a “qilin” — a giraffe — which the court received as an auspicious omen.
fields.description: 永乐十二年（1414）榜葛剌已献麒麟，永乐十九年（1421）再贡。所谓麒麟即长颈鹿，原产东非，经阿拉伯与印度海商转贩至孟加拉。宫廷命画工绘《瑞应麒麟图》，是中外物质交流的著名个案。 Bengal had already sent a giraffe in 1414 and sent another in 1421. The “qilin” was a giraffe, native to East Africa and carried to Bengal by Arab and Indian Ocean traders. Court painters produced the celebrated Giraffe as a Auspicious Portent, a famous case of material exchange.

fields.description: 忽鲁谟斯是波斯湾口的贸易枢纽。郑和在此颁赐锦绮，采购宝石、珍珠与良马，并送还忽鲁谟斯使臣。 Hormuz was the trading hub at the mouth of the Persian Gulf. Zheng He distributed brocade, bought gems, pearls and fine horses, and returned the Hormuz envoys.

summary.zh: 船队在祖法儿开读赏赐，当地人以乳香、血竭、芦荟、没药换取纻丝、瓷器。
summary.en: At Dhofar the fleet reads the imperial gifts, and locals trade frankincense, dragon’s blood, aloes and myrrh for silk and porcelain.

fields.name: 祖法儿开市 Market at Dhofar 佐法尔 Dhofar 祖法儿 Zufar
fields.place: 祖法儿（今阿曼佐法尔） Dhofar (Oman)
fields.summary: 船队在祖法儿开读赏赐，当地人以乳香、血竭、芦荟、没药换取纻丝、瓷器。 At Dhofar the fleet reads the imperial gifts, and locals trade frankincense, dragon’s blood, aloes and myrrh for silk and porcelain.
fields.description: 据《瀛涯胜览》，中国宝船到祖法儿，“开读赏赐毕，其王差头目遍谕国人，皆将乳香、血竭、芦荟、没药、安息香、苏合油、木别子之类，来换易纻丝、瓷器等物”。祖法儿因此成为船队在阿拉伯半岛南部的重要贸易点。 According to Ma Huan, when the Chinese treasure ships reached Dhofar the imperial gifts were read out, and the king had his officers tell the whole country to bring frankincense, dragon’s blood, aloes, myrrh, benzoin, storax and similar goods to exchange for silk and porcelain. Dhofar thus became a key trading point in southern Arabia.

summary.zh: 朝贡以「勘合」验真，回赐常倍于贡物，形成制度化的官方贸易。
summary.en: Tribute was verified by tallies, and return gifts often exceeded the tribute — institutionalised official trade.

fields.name: 勘合与回赐 Tally verification and return gifts 朝贡贸易 Tribute trade
fields.summary: 朝贡以「勘合」验真，回赐常倍于贡物，形成制度化的官方贸易。 Tribute was verified by tallies, and return gifts often exceeded the tribute — institutionalised official trade.
fields.description: 明廷向海外诸国颁发勘合，贡使持勘合比对，以防伪冒。贡物入官，回赐以丝帛、瓷器、钱钞，价值常高于贡物。其实质是以国家财政支撑的官方贸易，也是下西洋难以长期维系的原因之一。 The Ming court issued tallies to foreign states; envoys presented the matching half on arrival to prevent imposture. Tribute entered the treasury, and return gifts of silk, porcelain and cash usually exceeded its value — official trade underwritten by the state, and one reason the voyages were hard to sustain.

summary.zh: 仁宗即位当日下诏：下西洋诸番国宝船悉皆停止，已泊福建、太仓者俱回南京。
summary.en: On the day of his accession the Hongxi emperor ordered all treasure ships to stop; those already at Fujian or Taicang were to return to Nanjing.

fields.name: 罢西洋宝船 The treasure fleet is halted 仁宗即位诏 Hongxi accession edict
fields.summary: 仁宗即位当日下诏：下西洋诸番国宝船悉皆停止，已泊福建、太仓者俱回南京。 On the day of his accession the Hongxi emperor ordered all treasure ships to stop; those already at Fujian or Taicang were to return to Nanjing.
fields.description: 永乐二十二年八月十五日（1424-08-15），仁宗朱高炽即位，颁即位诏：「下西洋诸番国宝船，悉皆停止，如已在福建、太仓等处安泊者，俱回南京，将带去货物仍于内府该库交收。诸番国有进贡使臣当回去者，只量拨人船护送前去。原差去内外官员速皆回京，民稍人等各发宁家。」同诏又要「各处修造下番海船，悉皆停止」。同日罢迤西市马与云南、交阯采办，《明史·仁宗本纪》概括为「罢西洋宝船」。《殊域周咨录》记此诏出自户部尚书夏原吉之请。 On 15 August 1424 the Hongxi emperor issued his accession edict: all treasure ships bound for the Western Ocean were to stop, those already anchored in Fujian or Taicang were to return to Nanjing with their cargo handed to the imperial treasury, and shipbuilding for overseas voyages was to cease. The same day saw the end of horse purchasing in the northwest and of procurement in Yunnan and Jiaozhi. The History of Ming sums it up as “abolishing the Western Ocean treasure ships”; the Shuyu Zhouzi Lu attributes the edict to the request of the minister Xia Yuanji.
fields.entities: 第六次下西洋 Sixth Voyage

fields.name: 郑和守备南京 Zheng He becomes Nanjing garrison commander
fields.summary: 仁宗命郑和领下番官军守南京，下西洋船队转为城防与宫室营缮。 Zheng He was ordered to garrison Nanjing with the fleet’s troops; the voyages gave way to city defence and palace repairs.
fields.description: 洪熙元年二月初八（1425-02-08），《明仁宗实录》载：「命太监郑和领下番官军守南京，于内则与内官王景弘、朱卜花、唐观保协同管事；遇外有事，同襄城伯李隆、驸马都尉沐昕商议的当，然后施行。」下西洋的部队就此转为南京守备。此后六年间郑和主持修缮南京宫殿、天地坛与大祀殿，下西洋暂停。 On 8 February 1425 the Veritable Records of Hongxi record the order that Zheng He should garrison Nanjing with the troops of the Western Ocean fleet, working with the eunuchs Wang Jinghong, Zhu Buhua and Tang Guanbao internally and with the nobles Li Long and Mu Xin on external affairs. The voyage troops thus became the Nanjing garrison. Over the next six years Zheng He supervised repairs to the Nanjing palaces and altars while the voyages were suspended.

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

name.en: The Xuande emperor restarts the voyages

summary.zh: 宣宗遣郑和、王景弘赍诏往谕二十国及旧港宣慰司，第七次下西洋启动。
summary.en: The Xuande emperor sent Zheng He and Wang Jinghong with an edict to twenty countries and the Palembang commission, launching the seventh voyage.

fields.name: 宣德重启下西洋 The Xuande emperor restarts the voyages
fields.summary: 宣宗遣郑和、王景弘赍诏往谕二十国及旧港宣慰司，第七次下西洋启动。 The Xuande emperor sent Zheng He and Wang Jinghong with an edict to twenty countries and the Palembang commission, launching the seventh voyage.
fields.description: 宣德五年六月初九（1430-06-29），《明宣宗实录》载「遣太监郑和等赍诏往谕诸番国」，诏曰「尔诸番国远处海外，未有闻知，兹特遣太监郑和、王景弘等赍诏往谕」，所列凡忽鲁谟斯、锡兰山、古里、满剌加、柯枝、卜剌哇、木骨都束、喃渤利、苏门答剌、剌撒、溜山、阿鲁、甘巴里、阿丹、佐法儿、竹步、加异勒等二十国及旧港宣慰司。距仁宗罢宝船已六年。 On 29 June 1430 the Veritable Records of Xuande record the dispatch of Zheng He and Wang Jinghong with an edict to the Western Ocean states, naming twenty countries — Hormuz, Ceylon, Calicut, Malacca, Cochin, Brava, Mogadishu, Lambri, Samudera, Lasa, the Maldives, Aru, Cambay, Aden, Dhofar, Juba, Kayal and others — together with the Palembang commission. Six years had passed since the Hongxi emperor halted the fleet.

fields.description: 巩珍，应天人，宣德五年（1430）随郑和、王景弘出使，归后撰《西洋番国志》，记二十国，内容多可与《瀛涯胜览》《星槎胜览》互证。 Gong Zhen of Yingtian sailed with Zheng He and Wang Jinghong in 1430 and afterwards wrote the Xiyang Fanguo Zhi, covering twenty countries and largely corroborating the Yingya Shenglan and Xingcha Shenglan.

fields.name: 通事、火长与医官 Interpreters, navigators and physicians
fields.summary: 船队职司齐备：通事译语、火长掌针路、医官主医药，另有匠人、水手与军士。 The fleet carried interpreters, navigators, physicians, craftsmen, sailors and soldiers.
fields.description: 据《瀛涯胜览》《西洋番国志》，船队设正使太监、副使监丞、少监、内监，下辖火长（掌罗盘针路）、舵工、班碇手、通事（译语）、买办、书算手、医官与各色匠人。分工明确，是远航得以持续的组织基础。 According to the Yingya Shenglan and Xiyang Fanguo Zhi, the fleet was headed by chief and deputy envoys and included compass navigators, helmsmen, anchor handlers, interpreters, pursers, clerks, physicians and craftsmen of many trades — the organisational basis that made repeated long voyages possible.

name.en: The dimensions of the treasure ships

summary.zh: 宝船「修四十四丈、广十八丈」，尺度之说聚讼未决。
summary.en: The treasure ships are recorded as 44 zhang long and 18 zhang wide; the figure remains disputed.

fields.name: 宝船尺度与船型 The dimensions of the treasure ships
fields.summary: 宝船「修四十四丈、广十八丈」，尺度之说聚讼未决。 The treasure ships are recorded as 44 zhang long and 18 zhang wide; the figure remains disputed.
fields.description: 《明史·郑和传》记宝船长四十四丈四尺、宽十八丈。按明尺折算约长 130 米，远超同期欧洲船只，因此有学者主张尺制或记载有误，一说为「五千料」巨舶。南京宝船厂遗址发现的大型作塘，可容此类船体建造。 The History of Ming gives the treasure ships as 44.4 zhang long and 18 zhang wide — roughly 130 m, far larger than any contemporary European vessel. Some scholars therefore argue the unit or the record is corrupt; another reading is a 5,000-liao ship. The large slipways excavated at the Nanjing treasure-ship yard could accommodate hulls of this scale.

summary.zh: 《郑和航海图》以针路与牵星记录自南京至东非的航程。
summary.en: The Nautical Chart records the route from Nanjing to East Africa by compass course and star altitude.

fields.name: 《郑和航海图》 The Zheng He Nautical Chart
fields.summary: 《郑和航海图》以针路与牵星记录自南京至东非的航程。 The Nautical Chart records the route from Nanjing to East Africa by compass course and star altitude.
fields.description: 图见茅元仪《武备志》（1621）卷二四〇，存图二十页、四十幅，标地名五百余处，自南京宝船厂起，经东南亚、印度、阿拉伯半岛至东非。是中国现存最早的远洋航海图，也是下西洋航线的核心实证。 Preserved in Mao Yuanyi’s Wubeizhi (1621), the chart runs to twenty pages and forty panels with more than 500 place names, from the Nanjing shipyard through Southeast Asia, India and Arabia to East Africa. It is the earliest surviving Chinese ocean-going chart and the key evidence for the voyage routes.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage

fields.description: 宣德六年，船队抵长乐太平港，在此停留约半年，重修天妃宫、检修船只，等待冬季东北季风。 In 1431 the fleet reached Taiping Port and stayed for about half a year, rebuilding the Tianfei temple, overhauling ships and waiting for the winter north-east monsoon.

fields.description: 宣德六年二月，宣宗因满剌加国王欲亲赴明朝朝贡而被暹罗阻拦，命郑和前往暹罗传谕，要求其与邻国和好、不得阻挠朝贡。 In the second month of 1431, because Siam had blocked the king of Malacca from coming to pay tribute, the Xuande Emperor ordered Zheng He to carry an edict to Siam demanding good relations with its neighbours and an end to interference with tribute missions.

fields.description: 船队在长乐候风期间重修天妃宫，立《天妃灵应之记》碑，碑文记述历次下西洋的时间和主要经历，是研究郑和航海的重要实物史料。 While waiting at Changle the fleet rebuilt the temple of the sea goddess Tianfei and erected the “Tianfei Lingying” stele. Its text records the dates and main events of the voyages and remains a key contemporary source for Zheng He’s navigation.

fields.description: 船队出五虎门后南行至占城，开读宣宗敕书，颁赐国王与头目，并送还占城使臣。 After leaving through the Wuhu Gate the fleet sailed south to Champa, read the Xuande Emperor’s edict, bestowed gifts on the king and chiefs, and returned the Champa envoys.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage
fields.pinyin: di zhan cheng zhan cheng gui ren zhan cheng jin yue nan gui ren chuan dui zi wu hu men chu yang di zhan cheng ban ci guo wang bing song hai shi chen chuan dui chu wu hu men hou nan xing zhi zhan cheng kai du xuan zong chi shu ban ci guo wang yu tou mu bing song huan zhan cheng shi chen wai jiao di qi ci xia xi yang dizhancheng zhancheng guiren zhancheng jinyuenanguiren chuanduiziwuhumenchuyang dizhancheng banciguowangbingsonghaishichen chuanduichuwuhumenhounanxingzhizhancheng kaiduxuanzongchishu banciguowangyutoumu bingsonghuanzhanchengshichen waijiao diqicixiaxiyang

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

summary.zh: 船队抵旧港宣慰司，抚谕当地华人头目。
summary.en: The fleet reaches the Palembang commission and reassures the local Chinese leaders.

fields.name: 旧港宣慰司 The Palembang pacification commission 巴邻旁 Palembang 巨港 Palembang
fields.summary: 船队抵旧港宣慰司，抚谕当地华人头目。 The fleet reaches the Palembang commission and reassures the local Chinese leaders.
fields.description: 旧港在第一次下西洋后设宣慰司，以华侨施进卿为宣慰使。船队此次南巡，抚谕当地头目，重申明朝的羁縻统治。 After the first voyage a pacification commission had been set up at Palembang under the Chinese settler Shi Jinqing. On this voyage the fleet visited again, reassuring local leaders and restating Ming suzerainty.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage
fields.pinyin: jiu gang xuan wei si ba lin pang ju gang jiu gang jin yin ni ju gang chuan dui di jiu gang xuan wei si fu yu dang di hua ren tou mu jiu gang zai di yi ci xia xi yang hou she xuan wei si yi hua qiao shi jin qing wei xuan wei shi chuan dui ci ci nan xun fu yu dang di tou mu chong shen ming chao de ji mi tong zhi zhi du di qi ci xia xi yang jiugangxuanweisi balinpang jugang jiugang jinyinnijugang chuanduidijiugangxuanweisi fuyudangdihuarentoumu jiugangzaidiyicixiaxiyanghoushexuanweisi yihuaqiaoshijinqingweixuanweishi chuanduicicinanxun fuyudangditoumu chongshenmingchaodejimitongzhi zhidu diqicixiaxiyang

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

place.zh: 锦石（今印尼格雷西克，满者伯夷外港）

summary.zh: 船队访问爪哇，与满者伯夷王廷通好。
summary.en: The fleet visits Java and opens friendly relations with the Majapahit court.

fields.name: 访问爪哇 Visiting Java 革儿昔 Gresik 格雷西克 Gresik
fields.place: 锦石（今印尼格雷西克，满者伯夷外港） Gresik (outport of Majapahit, modern Indonesia)
fields.summary: 船队访问爪哇，与满者伯夷王廷通好。 The fleet visits Java and opens friendly relations with the Majapahit court.
fields.description: 爪哇是南洋人口最稠密、物产最丰富的地区之一。船队在此交易香料、蔗糖与布匹，并与满者伯夷王廷通好。 Java was among the most populous and productive regions of the southern seas. The fleet traded for spices, sugar and cloth and established friendly relations with the Majapahit court.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage
fields.pinyin: fang wen zhao wa ge er xi ge lei xi ke jin shi jin yin ni ge lei xi ke man zhe bo yi wai gang chuan dui fang wen zhao wa yu man zhe bo yi wang ting tong hao zhao wa shi nan yang ren kou zui chou mi wu chan zui feng fu de di qu zhi yi chuan dui zai ci jiao yi xiang liao zhe tang yu bu pi bing yu man zhe bo yi wang ting tong hao wai jiao di qi ci xia xi yang fangwenzhaowa geerxi geleixike jinshi jinyinnigeleixike manzheboyiwaigang chuanduifangwenzhaowa yumanzheboyiwangtingtonghao zhaowashinanyangrenkouzuichoumi wuchanzuifengfudediquzhiyi chuanduizaicijiaoyixiangliao zhetangyubupi bingyumanzheboyiwangtingtonghao waijiao diqicixiaxiyang

place.zh: 满剌加（今马来西亚马六甲）

summary.zh: 船队在满剌加驻泊，重申册封，并等候分䑸。
summary.en: The fleet anchors at Malacca, reaffirms its enfeoffment and waits while squadrons form.

fields.name: 满剌加驻泊 Anchoring at Malacca 马六甲 Malacca 满剌加 Melaka
fields.place: 满剌加（今马来西亚马六甲） Malacca (Melaka, Malaysia)
fields.summary: 船队在满剌加驻泊，重申册封，并等候分䑸。 The fleet anchors at Malacca, reaffirms its enfeoffment and waits while squadrons form.
fields.description: 满剌加是船队在西洋的中转基地。郑和在此重申明朝对满剌加的册封与保护，并安排前往天方与东非的航程。 Malacca was the fleet’s base in the western ocean. Zheng He reaffirmed Ming enfeoffment and protection and arranged the runs to Mecca and East Africa.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage

summary.zh: 船队经苏门答剌、南巫里进入印度洋。
summary.en: The fleet passes Samudera and Lamuri into the Indian Ocean.

fields.place: 苏门答剌（今印尼苏门答腊） Samudera (Sumatra, Indonesia)
fields.summary: 船队经苏门答剌、南巫里进入印度洋。 The fleet passes Samudera and Lamuri into the Indian Ocean.
fields.description: 船队在苏门答剌补充给养，经南巫里西行，横渡印度洋前往锡兰山。 The fleet provisioned at Samudera and sailed west by Lamuri, crossing the Indian Ocean to Ceylon.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

summary.zh: 船队泊锡兰山，补充淡水与食物。
summary.en: The fleet anchors at Ceylon for water and food.

fields.place: 锡兰山（今斯里兰卡） Ceylon (Sri Lanka)
fields.summary: 船队泊锡兰山，补充淡水与食物。 The fleet anchors at Ceylon for water and food.
fields.description: 锡兰山是横渡印度洋后的第一处大港。船队在此取水、修整，并送还锡兰山使臣。 Ceylon was the first great port after the ocean crossing. The fleet watered and refitted there and returned the Ceylonese envoys.

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

summary.zh: 船队抵古里，郑和在此分派使者前往天方（麦加）。
summary.en: At Calicut Zheng He sends envoys on to Mecca.

fields.name: 古里分遣天方 Detachment sent to Mecca 科泽科德 Kozhikode 卡利卡特 Calicut
fields.place: 古里（今印度科泽科德） Calicut (India)
fields.summary: 船队抵古里，郑和在此分派使者前往天方（麦加）。 At Calicut Zheng He sends envoys on to Mecca.
fields.description: 古里是第七次下西洋的西行枢纽。郑和在此分遣使者，随当地商船前往天方（麦加）朝觐并采办方物；主队则继续前往忽鲁谟斯、阿丹。 Calicut was the hinge of the seventh voyage’s westward run. Zheng He sent envoys on local ships to Mecca to perform the pilgrimage and obtain exotic goods, while the main fleet continued to Hormuz and Aden.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage

summary.zh: 船队抵忽鲁谟斯，颁赐国王，采购宝石、香料与马匹。
summary.en: The fleet reaches Hormuz, bestows gifts on the king and buys gems, spices and horses.

fields.place: 忽鲁谟斯（今伊朗霍尔木兹） Hormuz (Iran)
fields.summary: 船队抵忽鲁谟斯，颁赐国王，采购宝石、香料与马匹。 The fleet reaches Hormuz, bestows gifts on the king and buys gems, spices and horses.
fields.description: 忽鲁谟斯是波斯湾口的贸易枢纽。郑和在此颁赐锦绮，采购宝石、珍珠、香料与良马，并送还忽鲁谟斯使臣。 Hormuz was the trading hub at the mouth of the Persian Gulf. Zheng He distributed brocade, bought gems, pearls, spices and fine horses, and returned the Hormuz envoys.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage

summary.en: The fleet reaches Aden, rejoins the envoys returning from Mecca and buys frankincense, myrrh and gems.

fields.name: 阿丹会合 Rendezvous at Aden 亚丁 Aden
fields.summary: 船队抵阿丹，与赴天方使者会合，采购乳香、没药与宝石。 The fleet reaches Aden, rejoins the envoys returning from Mecca and buys frankincense, myrrh and gems.
fields.description: 阿丹扼守红海海口。船队在此采购乳香、没药、宝石与香料，并与自天方返回的使者会合，随后南下东非。 Aden guarded the mouth of the Red Sea. The fleet bought frankincense, myrrh, gems and spices there, rejoined the envoys returning from Mecca, and then sailed south to East Africa.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

summary.zh: 郑和船队分遣队访问天方，完成朝觐与贸易。
summary.en: A detachment of Zheng He’s fleet visited Mecca for pilgrimage and trade.

fields.name: 天方 Mecca 麦加 Mecca 天方 Makkah
fields.place: 天方（今沙特麦加） Mecca (modern Saudi Arabia)
fields.summary: 郑和船队分遣队访问天方，完成朝觐与贸易。 A detachment of Zheng He’s fleet visited Mecca for pilgrimage and trade.
fields.description: 郑和在古里分遣使者，随当地商船前往天方（麦加）朝觐，并采办麒麟、狮子、鸵鸟等方物。使者往返历时数月，其后在阿丹与主队会合。 At Calicut Zheng He sent envoys on local ships to Mecca to perform the pilgrimage and obtain qilin, lions, ostriches and other exotic goods. The round trip took several months, and the envoys rejoined the fleet at Aden.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage

summary.zh: 船队南至木骨都束，交换象牙、香料与方物。
summary.en: The fleet sails south to Mogadishu to exchange for ivory, spices and local products.

fields.place: 木骨都束（今索马里摩加迪沙） Mogadishu (Somalia)
fields.summary: 船队南至木骨都束，交换象牙、香料与方物。 The fleet sails south to Mogadishu to exchange for ivory, spices and local products.
fields.description: 木骨都束是东非航线的重要停靠点。船队在此以瓷器、丝绸交换象牙、香料与牲畜，并补充淡水。 Mogadishu was a key stop on the East African run. The fleet exchanged porcelain and silk for ivory, spices and livestock, and took on fresh water.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage

summary.en: The fleet reaches Brava to trade for ivory and spices.

summary.zh: 船队南至竹步，随后折返古里。
summary.en: The fleet sails south to Juba, then turns back towards Calicut.

fields.place: 竹步（今索马里朱巴河口） Juba river mouth (modern Somalia)
fields.summary: 船队南至竹步，随后折返古里。 The fleet sails south to Juba, then turns back towards Calicut.
fields.description: 竹步是船队东非航线的南端停靠点之一。船队在此交易象牙、香料，随后折返古里；郑和即在归程中病逝于古里。 Juba was one of the southernmost stops on the East African run. The fleet traded for ivory and spices and then turned back towards Calicut, where Zheng He died on the return journey.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage

summary.en: Zheng He dies at Calicut during the seventh voyage.

fields.name: 郑和卒于古里 Zheng He dies at Calicut 科泽科德 Kozhikode 卡利卡特 Calicut
fields.summary: 郑和在第七次航行途中卒于古里。 Zheng He dies at Calicut during the seventh voyage.
fields.description: 1433 年，郑和在第七次下西洋归程中病逝于古里，终年六十余岁。船队由太监王景弘等率领，于是年七月返抵南京。 卒地有争议：《非幻庵香火圣像记》（1457）称「至癸丑岁，卒于古里国」，郑鹤声、郑一钧据此主张卒于古里；陈平平（2014）认为该记载错乱、据《大明都知监太监洪公寿葬铭》出使古里者为副使洪保，另有卒于南京说。 In 1433, on the return leg of the seventh voyage, Zheng He died at Calicut in his sixties. The fleet returned to Nanjing in the seventh month under the eunuch Wang Jinghong and others.

name.en: Wang Jinghong brings the fleet home

summary.zh: 郑和卒后，船队由正使太监王景弘率领继续返航，七月初六抵南京。
summary.en: After Zheng He’s death the fleet continued home under the chief envoy Wang Jinghong, reaching Nanjing on 22 July 1433.

fields.name: 王景弘领队归国 Wang Jinghong brings the fleet home
fields.place: 锡兰山（今斯里兰卡） Ceylon
fields.summary: 郑和卒后，船队由正使太监王景弘率领继续返航，七月初六抵南京。 After Zheng He’s death the fleet continued home under the chief envoy Wang Jinghong, reaching Nanjing on 22 July 1433.
fields.description: 郑和卒于返航途中后，船队由正使太监王景弘率领继续西归，经锡兰山、苏门答剌、满剌加，据祝允明《前闻记》所记日程，宣德八年七月初六（1433-07-22）抵南京。王景弘原名单通（一作贵通），自首次下西洋即为副使，长于航务；宣德九年（1434）又奉命出使苏门答剌，后世或称「第八次下西洋」。 After Zheng He died on the homeward passage the fleet continued west under the chief envoy Wang Jinghong, calling at Ceylon, Samudera and Malacca and reaching Nanjing on 22 July 1433 according to the itinerary in Zhu Yunming’s Qianwen Ji. Wang Jinghong, originally named Guitong, had sailed as vice-envoy since the first voyage and was responsible for navigation; in 1434 he was sent again to Samudera, sometimes counted as an eighth voyage.

atlasTitle.en: Zheng He’s Voyages

summary.zh: 返航载回香料、宝石、珍禽与各国贡物。
summary.en: The fleet returned with spices, gems, exotic animals and tribute goods.

fields.name: 宝船返航所载 What the fleet brought home
fields.summary: 返航载回香料、宝石、珍禽与各国贡物。 The fleet returned with spices, gems, exotic animals and tribute goods.
fields.description: 回程货物以胡椒、苏木、沉香、乳香、没药、宝石、珍珠、象牙、犀角为主，另有麒麟、狮子、鸵鸟等。香料一项后来成为明廷财政与民间市场的大宗，也改变了中国人的饮食与医药。 The return cargo was dominated by pepper, sappanwood, aloeswood, frankincense, myrrh, gems, pearls, ivory and rhinoceros horn, besides giraffes, lions and ostriches. Spices in particular became a major item in court revenue and in ordinary markets, changing Chinese cooking and pharmacy.
fields.entities: 第七次下西洋 Seventh Voyage
